articles.title: The central Pacific Ocean just broke a temperature record. Experts say it might signal a new kind of El Niño.
articles.author: Sascha Pare

paras.en: The sea surface temperature in a key section of the central equatorial Pacific Ocean has now surpassed all previous temperatures on record for this region, exceeding 86 degrees Fahrenheit (30 degrees Celsius) for the first time, according to preliminary data released Monday (Oct. 5).
paras.zh: 根据周一（10 月 5 日）公布的初步数据，赤道中部太平洋关键海域的海面温度现已超过该地区以往有记录的所有温度，首次超过 86 华氏度（30 摄氏度）。

paras.en: Specifically, these temperatures occurred in the Niño 3.4 region, located between 5 degrees north and 5 degrees south latitude, and 120 degrees west and 170 degrees west longitude. Researchers use this region to monitor the progression of El Niño, the warm phase of a multiyear natural climate pattern that's currently in full swing and steadily intensifying. But how significant is this new record, and could it be a harbinger of increasingly extreme El Niño events in the future?
paras.zh: 具体来说，这些气温发生在尼诺3.4区域，位于北纬5度和南纬5度、西经120度和西经170度之间。研究人员利用该地区来监测厄尔尼诺现象的进展，厄尔尼诺现象是多年自然气候模式的温暖阶段，目前正在全面展开并稳步加强。但这一新记录有多重要？它是否是未来日益极端的厄尔尼诺事件的预兆？

paras.en: At this time of the year, sea surface temperatures above 86 F are common in the western Pacific warm pool, a mass of water located northeast of Australia. But the Niño 3.4 region is nowhere near the warm pool and usually has much cooler temperatures. This latest data indicates "an exceptionally warm state for this part of the tropical Pacific," said Jin-Yi Yu, a professor of Earth system science at the University of California, Irvine.
paras.zh: 每年的这个时候，位于澳大利亚东北部的西太平洋暖池的海面温度通常高于 86 华氏度。但厄尔尼诺 3.4 地区距离暖水池很远，而且通常气温要低得多。加州大学欧文分校地球系统科学教授于金一表示，这一最新数据表明“热带太平洋的这一地区正处于异常温暖的状态”。

paras.en: "If the reported daily El Niño 3.4 temperature above 30°C is verified in the observational dataset, it would be an extraordinary record," Yu told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: “如果厄尔尼诺3.4每日报告的气温高于30°C，在观测数据集中得到证实，那将是一个非凡的记录，”于在一封电子邮件中告诉Live Science。

paras.en: Other experts agreed. A Niño 3.4 sea surface temperature above 86 F is a "very significant" new record, Timothy Osborn, a professor of climate science and the director of the Climatic Research Unit at the University of East Anglia in the U.K., told Live Science in an email. Mat Collins, a professor of climate systems and the head of mathematics and statistics at the University of Exeter in the U.K., also called the temperature "very significant" in an email to Live Science.
paras.zh: 其他专家也表示同意。英国东安格利亚大学气候科学教授兼气候研究室主任蒂莫西·奥斯本（Timothy Osborn）在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》，尼诺3.4海面温度高于86华氏度是一个“非常重要”的新纪录。英国埃克塞特大学气候系统教授兼数学和统计学负责人马特·柯林斯(Mat Collins)在给《生活科学》的电子邮件中也称气温“非常重要”。

paras.en: But it's important to note that absolute temperature is not the standard way of measuring the strength of El Niño, Osborn said. Researchers usually assess El Niño intensity by comparing sea surface temperatures in the Niño 3.4 region with the average conditions there or with sea surface temperatures across the rest of the tropics, with the latter method removing a skew in the data caused by the climate-change-induced heating of oceans globally.
paras.zh: 但奥斯本说，值得注意的是，绝对温度并不是测量厄尔尼诺现象强度的标准方法。研究人员通常通过将厄尔尼诺3.4地区的海面温度与该地区的平均条件或其他热带地区的海面温度进行比较来评估厄尔尼诺现象的强度，后一种方法消除了由气候变化引起的全球海洋加热造成的数据偏差。

paras.en: "On those measures, the current event is already close to being the strongest [El Niño] on record and will likely soon exceed previous records given that the event is forecast to strengthen further," Osborn said. "For some measures, it is already record-breaking for the time of year."
paras.zh: 奥斯本说：“根据这些指标，当前的厄尔尼诺现象已经接近有记录以来最强的厄尔尼诺现象，而且鉴于预计该现象将进一步加强，很可能很快就会超过之前的记录。” “就某些指标而言，这已经打破了今年同期的记录。”

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: El Niño events happen when warm water in the western tropical Pacific Ocean migrates eastward along the equator, toward South America. This boosts global temperatures, triggering heavy rainfall and floods in regions like East Africa, southern China, the southern U.S. and the Pacific coast of equatorial South America, while places such as Indonesia, the Philippines, southern Africa and northern South America experience drought.
paras.zh: 当西热带太平洋的暖水沿着赤道向东迁移到南美洲时，就会发生厄尔尼诺现象。这导致全球气温升高，在东非、中国南部、美国南部和南美洲赤道太平洋沿岸等地区引发强降雨和洪水，而印度尼西亚、菲律宾、非洲南部和南美洲北部等地区则出现干旱。

paras.en: "El Nino impacts are greatest across the tropics and in the lands around the Pacific Ocean," Osborn said. "An El Nino with record strength is very significant because it greatly disrupts the atmospheric circulation which controls the weather patterns including patterns of rainfall."
paras.zh: 奥斯本说：“厄尔尼诺现象对热带地区和太平洋沿岸地区的影响最为严重。” “创纪录强度的厄尔尼诺现象非常重要，因为它极大地扰乱了控制天气模式（包括降雨模式）的大气环流。”

paras.en: As of Oct. 6, the temperature anomaly in the Niño 3.4 region is 6 F (3.34 C) above average and rising. A typical El Niño increases Niño 3.4 temperatures by a maximum of 1.8 to 3.6 F (1 to 2 C) above average, so the current condition is "exceptionally large," Yu said. "This indicates that a very strong, or what is sometimes called a 'super,' El Niño is developing."
paras.zh: 截至 10 月 6 日，厄尔尼诺 3.4 地区的气温异常比平均水平高 6 华氏度（3.34 摄氏度），并且还在上升。典型的厄尔尼诺现象会使厄尔尼诺 3.4 的气温比平均温度高出最多 1.8 至 3.6 华氏度（1 至 2 摄氏度），因此目前的情况“异常严重”，Yu 说。 “这表明一种非常强烈的厄尔尼诺现象，或者有时被称为‘超级’的厄尔尼诺现象正在发展。”

paras.en: This year's El Niño is being amplified by human-driven global warming, which has increased background ocean temperatures. As a result, it's likely that sea surface temperatures in the Niño 3.4 region will keep rising over the coming weeks and peak in November or December, before declining again in 2027, Collins said.
paras.zh: 今年的厄尔尼诺现象因人类导致的全球变暖而加剧，导致海洋背景温度升高。柯林斯表示，因此，尼诺 3.4 地区的海面温度可能会在未来几周内持续上升，并在 11 月或 12 月达到峰值，然后在 2027 年再次下降。

paras.en: "The Niño 3.4 anomaly is very likely to remain extremely large and may increase further," Yu said, echoing forecasters' suggestions that it could reach 7.2 F (4 C) by November.
paras.zh: Yu 说：“尼诺 3.4 异常现象很可能仍然非常大，并可能进一步增加。”这呼应了预报员的建议，即到 11 月，其温度可能达到 7.2 华氏度（4 摄氏度）。

paras.en: The world is on the brink of crossing a critical warming threshold, raising the question of whether the current conditions can be considered a new normal for future El Niños.
paras.zh: 世界正处于跨越临界变暖阈值的边缘，引发了一个问题：当前的情况是否可以被视为未来厄尔尼诺现象的新常态。

paras.en: While it's likely that future El Niños will be more extreme than past ones, on average, not every El Niño will be record-breaking and as dramatic as the one unfolding now, because these events tend to be very variable, Collins said.
paras.zh: 柯林斯说，虽然未来的厄尔尼诺现象可能会比过去更加极端，但平均而言，并不是每一次厄尔尼诺现象都会破纪录并且像现在发生的那样引人注目，因为这些事件往往变化很大。

paras.en: As climate change intensifies, the big worry is that certain regions will be primed for extreme conditions even before an El Niño strikes, Osborn said. For example, regions that are getting drier due to global warming could see catastrophic droughts if they overlap with areas that experience dryness during El Niño events. Likewise, places that are getting wetter could see worse deluges of rain and flooding if they coincide with areas with higher precipitation during El Niños. But that doesn't necessarily mean extreme El Niños are the new normal, he said.
paras.zh: 奥斯本说，随着气候变化加剧，人们最担心的是，即使在厄尔尼诺现象发生之前，某些地区也将面临极端条件。例如，由于全球变暖而变得更加干旱的地区，如果与厄尔尼诺事件期间经历干旱的地区重叠，可能会出现灾难性的干旱。同样，如果气候变得越来越潮湿的地区与厄尔尼诺现象期间降水量较高的地区同时发生，可能会出现更严重的降雨和洪水。但这并不一定意味着极端厄尔尼诺现象将成为新常态，他说。

paras.en: Instead, the location and duration of El Niño events may be transforming, Yu suggested. "In research by my group and collaborators, we have documented changes not only in El Niño intensity, but also in where the warming occurs and how long events persist," he said.

Yu and his colleagues helped to introduce the idea that we are seeing the emergence of two distinct types of El Niño: the eastern Pacific El Niño and the central Pacific El Niño. "Many El Niño events in the earlier observational record were dominated by warming in the eastern tropical Pacific, whereas Central Pacific El Niño events became much more prominent in recent decades," he explained, adding that El Niños have also been lasting longer.
paras.zh: 于和他的同事帮助介绍了这样一个想法，即我们正在看到两种不同类型的厄尔尼诺现象的出现：东太平洋厄尔尼诺和中太平洋厄尔尼诺。他解释说：“早期观测记录中的许多厄尔尼诺事件主要是由于东热带太平洋变暖所致，而中太平洋厄尔尼诺事件在近几十年来变得更加突出。”他补充说，厄尔尼诺现象的持续时间也更长。

paras.en: Global warming may be creating a new kind of El Niño by strengthening atmosphere-ocean interactions in the subtropical Pacific, Yu said. If these interactions combine with processes in the equatorial Pacific, where eastern Pacific El Niños emerge, they might trigger unusually strong events with extreme heating in the central Pacific.
paras.zh: 于说，全球变暖可能会通过加强副热带太平洋的大气-海洋相互作用而产生一种新型厄尔尼诺现象。如果这些相互作用与东太平洋厄尔尼诺现象出现的赤道太平洋的过程结合起来，它们可能会引发异常强烈的事件，导致中太平洋出现极端升温。

paras.en: "That provides a physical reason to take the possibility of more frequent extreme El Niño events in a warmer climate seriously," Yu said. "But I would distinguish that from saying that every El Niño will become progressively stronger."
paras.zh: 于说：“这提供了一个物理理由，让我们认真对待气候变暖时发生更频繁的极端厄尔尼诺事件的可能性。” “但我将这与每次厄尔尼诺现象都会变得越来越强的说法区分开来。”

paras.en: Sascha is a U.K.-based staff writer at Live Science. She holds a bachelor’s degree in biology from the University of Southampton in England and a master’s degree in science communication from Imperial College London. Her work has appeared in The Guardian and the health website Zoe. Besides writing, she enjoys playing tennis, bread-making and browsing second-hand shops for hidden gems.
paras.zh: Sascha 是 Live Science 驻英国的特约撰稿人。她拥有英国南安普顿大学生物学学士学位和伦敦帝国理工学院科学传播硕士学位。她的作品曾出现在《卫报》和健康网站 Zoe 上。除了写作之外，她还喜欢打网球、制作面包和逛二手店寻找隐藏的宝石。

articles.title: 'Freakish' discovery of 9 million-year-old capybara tooth supports idea that Atacama wasn't always a desert
articles.author: Damien Pine

paras.en: Researchers have discovered a roughly 9 million year old tooth belonging to a large, water-loving relative of modern day capybaras in the Atacama Desert of northern Chile. The fossilized molar adds to previous evidence suggesting that it's unlikely the Atacama, one of the driest places on Earth, was continuously dry for the last 40 million years.
paras.zh: 研究人员在智利北部阿塔卡马沙漠发现了一颗大约 900 万年前的牙齿，属于现代水豚的大型喜水近亲。这颗臼齿化石进一步证明，地球上最干旱的地方之一阿塔卡马不太可能在过去 4000 万年里持续干旱。

paras.en: The Atacama Desert, possibly the oldest desert on Earth, takes up the northern third of Chile. It's bounded by the Chilean Coast Range to the west, which blocks rain from the Pacific Ocean, and the enormous Andes to the east, which obstruct rain from the Atlantic Ocean. The driest part of the desert's hyperarid region gets less than 0.08 inches (2 mm) of rainfall a month.
paras.zh: 阿塔卡马沙漠可能是地球上最古老的沙漠，占据了智利北部的三分之一。它西边是智利海岸山脉，阻挡了来自太平洋的降雨，东边是巨大的安第斯山脉，阻挡了来自大西洋的降雨。沙漠极度干旱地区最干燥的地区每月降雨量不到 0.08 英寸（2 毫米）。

paras.en: Recent research estimates the Atacama's hyperarid core started forming between 47.8 million and 33.9 million years ago, in the Mid- to Late-Eocene, 20 million years before the Andes formed. It suggests the mountain ranges weren't the cause for the desert's aridification, and may have only intensified it.
paras.zh: 最近的研究估计，阿塔卡马的超级干旱核心开始形成于 4780 万年前至 3390 万年前，即始新世中晚期，比安第斯山脉形成早 2000 万年。这表明山脉并不是沙漠干旱化的原因，而且可能只会加剧干旱化。

paras.en: Capybaras (Hydrochoerus hydrochaeris) — the world's largest rodent — exclusively live close to stable freshwater sources and feed on plants that also require water to grow, so the discovery of an extinct capybara relative (Hydrochoerus Cardiatherium) tooth in the Atacama Desert is very strange.
paras.zh: 水豚 (Hydrochoerus Hydrochaeris) 是世界上最大的啮齿动物，它们专门生活在稳定的淡水源附近，以也需要水才能生长的植物为食，因此在阿塔卡马沙漠中发现已灭绝的水豚近亲 (Hydrochoerus Cardiatherium) 牙齿是非常奇怪的。

paras.en: "Finding a capybara tooth in a marine deposit in what today is one of the driest regions on Earth is just freakish," Priscilla Martinez, a geoscientist at the University of Arizona and co-author of a new paper describing the discovery, said in a statement.
paras.zh: 亚利桑那大学地球科学家、描述这一发现的新论文的合著者普里西拉·马丁内斯在一份声明中说：“在当今地球上最干旱的地区之一的海洋沉积物中发现水豚牙齿真是太奇怪了。”

paras.en: Capybaras are native to South America, although today, they are not found in Chile, where the tooth was unearthed, according to the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN).
paras.zh: 据国际自然保护联盟 (IUCN) 称，水豚原产于南美洲，但如今在出土水豚牙齿的智利却找不到它们的踪影。

paras.en: The tooth isn't the only clue that the Atacama was a wetter place in the late Miocene. Researchers found it in a layer holding the remains of a shallow marine environment that existed between 7 million and 10 million years ago, according to the statement. And they've also found microscopic pieces of plants, known as phytoliths, revealing that palm trees, grasses, gingers and other flowering plants grew there in what may have been a subtropical forest.
paras.zh: 这颗牙齿并不是证明阿塔卡马地区在中新世晚期是一个湿润地区的唯一线索。声明称，研究人员在 700 万至 1000 万年前存在的浅海环境遗迹层中发现了它。他们还发现了被称为植硅体的植物微观碎片，表明棕榈树、草、生姜和其他开花植物生长在可能是亚热带森林的地方。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: These findings and others are part of a growing body of evidence that the Atacama Desert was once wet enough for crocodiles and freshwater fish to thrive and palms to grow. The new study, published Sept. 5 in the journal Scientific Reports, shows that capybara relatives lived there as well during the late Miocene, which, because they are semiaquatic animals, is further evidence to support the hypothesis of a sporadically moist Atacama.
paras.zh: 这些发现和其他发现是越来越多证据的一部分，表明阿塔卡马沙漠曾经足够潮湿，适合鳄鱼和淡水鱼繁衍生息，也适合棕榈树生长。 9 月 5 日发表在《科学报告》杂志上的这项新研究表明，在中新世晚期，水豚的亲戚也生活在那里，因为它们是半水生动物，这进一步证明了阿塔卡马地区存在零星湿润的假说。

paras.en: The researchers aren't sure how exactly capybaras moved into the Atacama Desert. Although there were capybaras in South America at the time, the Andes created an 18,000-foot-high (5,500 meters) barrier between their current habitats and the site where the tooth was found. The researchers theorized that, instead of traversing the mountains, the ancient capybaras migrated along the western coast of South America, following wetlands, rivers and other water sources.
paras.zh: 研究人员不确定水豚究竟是如何进入阿塔卡马沙漠的。尽管当时南美洲也有水豚，但安第斯山脉在它们目前的栖息地和发现水豚牙齿的地点之间形成了一道 18,000 英尺高（5,500 米）的屏障。研究人员推测，古代水豚并没有穿越山脉，而是沿着湿地、河流和其他水源沿着南美洲西海岸迁徙。

paras.en: According to Samantha Hopkins, an Earth sciences professor at the University of Oregon who was not involved in the study, it's unlikely the tooth found its way to the site without capybaras living there.
paras.zh: 俄勒冈大学地球科学教授萨曼莎·霍普金斯（Samantha Hopkins）没有参与这项研究，她表示，如果没有水豚生活在那里，这颗牙齿不太可能到达该地点。

paras.en: "If you wanted to find a way that this capybara could be here while the Atacama was still as dry as it is today, you'd have a hard row to hoe," she told Live Science in an email, because the size of the tooth makes it hard to transport it long distances. The desert wind couldn't have blown it such a long way, and while large carcasses can float down waterways for miles, "if you're going to invoke a large enough waterway to do this, you've demonstrated that the Atacama wasn't as dry as it is today anyway."
paras.zh: 她在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》杂志：“如果你想找到一种方法，在阿塔卡马仍然像今天这样干燥的时候，让这只水豚出现在这里，你将很难锄地，”她在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》，因为牙齿的大小使其很难长距离运输。沙漠风不可能把它吹这么远，虽然大型尸体可以沿着水道漂浮数英里，“如果你要调用足够大的水道来做到这一点，你就已经证明了阿塔卡马河无论如何也不像今天那么干燥。”

paras.en: Gutstein, C. S., Martinez, P. R., Carrapa, B., Clementz, M. T., Cherem, J. J., Cozzuol, M. A., Strömberg, C. a. E., Suárez, M. E., Chavarría, C. C., & Roux, J. P. L. (2026). Late Miocene capybara in the Atacama Desert reveals a wetter climate and a transcontinental dispersal pathway. Scientific Reports. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-026-67368-2
paras.zh: Gutstein, C. S.、Martinez, P. R.、Carrapa, B.、Clementz, M. T.、Cherem, J. J.、Cozzuol, M. A.、Strömberg, C. a. E.、Suárez, M. E.、Chavarría, C. C. 和 Roux, J. P. L. (2026)。阿塔卡马沙漠中中新世晚期的水豚揭示了更湿润的气候和跨大陆的扩散途径。科学报告。 https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-026-67368-2

paras.en: Damien Pine (he/him) is a freelance writer, artist, and former NASA engineer. He writes about science, physics, tech, art, and other topics with a focus on making complicated ideas accessible. He has a degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Connecticut, and he gets really excited every time he sees a cat.
paras.zh: 达米恩·派恩（Damien Pine）（他/他）是一位自由作家、艺术家和前美国宇航局工程师。他撰写的文章涉及科学、物理、技术、艺术和其他主题，重点是让复杂的想法变得容易理解。他拥有康涅狄格大学机械工程学位，每次看到猫他都会非常兴奋。

articles.title: Big dogs age faster at an epigenetic level, new study finds
articles.author: RJ Mackenzie

paras.en: Great Danes and mastiffs rarely live more than a decade, while Chihuahuas can live twice as long. Exactly why big dogs die younger than small ones do has been unclear — but new findings may help to solve that mystery.
paras.zh: 大丹犬和獒犬的寿命很少超过十年，而吉娃娃犬的寿命可以是其两倍。究竟为什么大型犬比小型犬更早死亡尚不清楚，但新的发现可能有助于解开这个谜团。

paras.en: The research, published Thursday (Oct. 8) in the journal Science, looked at a chemical code written on top of dogs' DNA. This code, called the methylome, consists of chemical tags called methyl groups, which bind to DNA's building blocks.
paras.zh: 这项研究于周四（10 月 8 日）发表在《科学》杂志上，研究了写在狗 DNA 上的化学密码。这种代码称为甲基化组，由称为甲基的化学标签组成，这些标签与 DNA 的构建模块结合。

paras.en: Proteins constantly access DNA, loading up the information written in its code and taking that data away to be turned into new proteins for the cell. But these methyl groups can act as tiny roadblocks that stop that process in its tracks.
paras.zh: 蛋白质不断地访问 DNA，加载其代码中写入的信息，并将这些数据转化为细胞的新蛋白质。但这些甲基可以充当微小的障碍，阻止这一过程的进行。

paras.en: These groups are one type of "epigenetic marker," which collectively help to control gene activity, and their arrangement on DNA changes predictably as animals age, study co-author Blaise Mariner, a bioinformatician at Arizona State University, told Live Science. Across many studies and species, including humans, scientists have used this data to build epigenetic clocks that track animals' biological ages.
paras.zh: 研究合著者、亚利桑那州立大学生物信息学家布莱斯·马里纳 (Blaise Mariner) 告诉《Live Science》，这些群体是“表观遗传标记”的一种，它们共同帮助控制基因活性，并且随着动物年龄的增长，它们在 DNA 上的排列会发生可预测的变化。在包括人类在内的许多研究和物种中，科学家们利用这些数据建立了表观遗传时钟来跟踪动物的生物年龄。

paras.en: Dogs happen to be a great species for studying aging. Their owners devotedly track what they eat, how they live, and how their health changes over time. So Mariner and his colleagues built epigenetic clocks using DNA in blood samples taken from 894 dogs enrolled in the long-term Dog Aging Project based at the University of Washington.
paras.zh: 狗恰好是研究衰老的绝佳物种。它们的主人会专门追踪它们的饮食、生活方式以及健康状况随时间的变化。因此，Mariner 和他的同事利用来自华盛顿大学长期狗衰老项目的 894 只狗的血液样本中的 DNA 构建了表观遗传时钟。

paras.en: These samples revealed how the dogs' immune cells aged. These cells patrol the whole body, so "they're a really good measure of systemic aging," study co-author Noah Snyder-Mackler, a genomicist at Arizona State University, told Live Science.
paras.zh: 这些样本揭示了狗的免疫细胞如何老化。这些细胞在整个身体中巡逻，因此“它们是衡量系统衰老的一个非常好的指标”，该研究的合著者、亚利桑那州立大学的基因组学家诺亚·斯奈德-麦克勒（Noah Snyder-Mackler）告诉《生活科学》。

paras.en: The team found that changes in DNA methylation closely tracked biological aging, in that the dogs with older-than-expected epigenetic ages had a higher risk of death from any cause. Once they looked at how different sizes of dogs aged, clear differences emerged.
paras.zh: 研究小组发现，DNA甲基化的变化与生物衰老密切相关，表观遗传年龄大于预期的狗因任何原因死亡的风险更高。一旦他们观察了不同体型的狗的衰老情况，就会发现明显的差异。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: "Using our biomarker, this epigenetic clock, big dogs were aging a little bit faster per year of life than small dogs," Snyder-Mackler said.
paras.zh: 斯奈德-麦克勒说：“使用我们的生物标记物，即表观遗传时钟，大型犬的每年衰老速度比小型犬要快一些。”

paras.en: A key epigenetic change linked to larger body size was the loss of methyl groups at stretches of DNA called transposable elements. Also called "jumping genes," these elements can potentially move around the genome, but the methyl groups help stop them from doing so. But when that methylation is lost, the jumping genes can become too active and end up damaging other genes and causing inflammation, a key process that ramps up with age.
paras.zh: 与体型变大相关的一个关键表观遗传变化是称为转座元件的 DNA 片段中甲基基团的丢失。这些元素也被称为“跳跃基因”，可能会在基因组中移动，但甲基有助于阻止它们这样做。但当甲基化丢失时，跳跃基因可能会变得过于活跃，最终会损害其他基因并引起炎症，这是一个随着年龄增长而加剧的关键过程。

paras.en: In short, the new data suggests that out-of-control jumping genes may contribute to big dogs' faster aging.
paras.zh: 简而言之，新数据表明，失控的跳跃基因可能导致大型犬更快衰老。

paras.en: In aging dogs, the team found that some regions of the genome with few chemical tags became more methylated, while other areas that had been choked with methyl groups gradually lost them. Additionally, at least in terms of their epigenetics, dogs' immune cells appear to become more similar to one another as they age. Mariner said this "loss of cell identity" is a key hypothesis for what happens to the body as it ages.
paras.zh: 在衰老的狗中，研究小组发现基因组中一些化学标签很少的区域变得更加甲基化，而其他被甲基基团堵塞的区域则逐渐失去它们。此外，至少在表观遗传学方面，随着年龄的增长，狗的免疫细胞似乎变得更加相似。马里纳说，这种“细胞身份的丧失”是身体随着年龄增长而发生变化的一个关键假设。

paras.en: Immune cells are carefully specialized for different roles, such as preventing cancer or killing viruses. As these cells become more similar to one another, they become less able to fulfill their specialized roles, studies suggest.
paras.zh: 免疫细胞经过精心专门设计，具有不同的作用，例如预防癌症或杀死病毒。研究表明，随着这些细胞彼此变得更加相似，它们履行其特殊职责的能力就会降低。

paras.en: Humans have bred big dogs for size, and Snyder-Mackler said this push for large body size may have come at a cost.
paras.zh: 人类培育大型犬是为了体型较大，斯奈德-麦克勒表示，这种对体型较大的追求可能是有代价的。

paras.en: "Their bodies have to make this trade-off between really rapid growth and maintenance of that," he said, "versus investment in the immune system and integrity of the organism." For now, that idea is a hypothesis, though, as the current study doesn't directly address why big dogs' epigenetic aging has come to be this way.
paras.zh: “他们的身体必须在真正的快速生长和维持快速生长之间做出权衡，”他说，“与对免疫系统和有机体完整性的投资。”不过，目前这个想法还只是一个假设，因为目前的研究并没有直接解释为什么大型犬的表观遗传衰老会变成这样。

paras.en: Now, the team wants to build more informative clocks as the Dog Aging Project recruits more pooches to follow for longer periods. Snyder-Mackler said the team's data currently explains only part of how dogs' epigenetic ages vary. "What we really want to know is, what explains the rest of that variation?" he said.
paras.zh: 现在，随着狗老化项目招募更多的狗来进行更长时间的跟踪，该团队希望建立更多信息的时钟。斯奈德-麦克勒表示，该团队的数据目前只能部分解释狗的表观遗传年龄如何变化。 “我们真正想知道的是，如何解释其余的变异？”他说。

paras.en: The team was keen to build predictive models that might help dog owners anticipate their pets' age-related health concerns, Snyder-Mackler added.
paras.zh: 斯奈德-麦克勒补充说，该团队热衷于建立预测模型，帮助狗主人预测宠物与年龄相关的健康问题。

paras.en: What we learn about dogs from these studies may help us understand human aging, too. That's partly because dogs get some of the same diseases we do, but it's chiefly because they share humans' living spaces and environments.
paras.zh: 我们从这些研究中了解到的关于狗的知识也可能有助于我们了解人类的衰老。部分原因是狗会患上一些与我们相同的疾病，但主要是因为它们与人类共享生活空间和环境。

paras.en: "We're going to start looking, at the molecular level, [at] how these environmental exposures or experiences impact health and aging in dogs, which is going to be directly translatable to humans who are living in those same exact environments," Snyder-Mackler said.
paras.zh: 斯奈德-麦克勒说：“我们将开始在分子水平上研究这些环境暴露或经历如何影响狗的健康和衰老，这将直接适用于生活在同样环境中的人类。”

paras.en: "Most people love dogs," he added. "That means we can get a lot of really good data on them."
paras.zh: “大多数人都喜欢狗，”他补充道。 “这意味着我们可以获得很多关于它们的非常好的数据。”

paras.en: RJ Mackenzie is an award-nominated science and health journalist. He has degrees in neuroscience from the University of Edinburgh and the University of Cambridge. He became a writer after deciding that the best way of contributing to science would be from behind a keyboard rather than a lab bench. He has reported on everything from brain-interface technology to shape-shifting materials science, and from the rise of predatory conferencing to the importance of newborn-screening programs. He is a former staff writer of Technology Networks.
paras.zh: RJ Mackenzie 是一位荣获奖项提名的科学与健康记者。他拥有爱丁堡大学和剑桥大学的神经科学学位。在决定为科学做出贡献的最佳方式是在键盘后面而不是在实验室工作台后面后，他成为了一名作家。他报道了从大脑接口技术到变形材料科学，从掠夺性会议的兴起到新生儿筛查计划的重要性等各个方面。他是《科技网络》的前特约撰稿人。

articles.title: Thieves Pulled Off Another Shocking Art Heist in France. This Time, They Took a 330-Pound Bronze Book Cover Designed by Salvador Dalí

paras.en: Another flagrant museum heist has rocked France. On Sunday night or Monday morning, thieves stole an enormous bronze book cover designed by Salvador Dalí from a small contemporary art collection in the town of Issoire in central France.
paras.zh: 另一起明目张胆的博物馆抢劫案震惊了法国。周日晚上或周一早上，窃贼从法国中部伊苏瓦尔镇的一个小型当代艺术收藏品中偷走了萨尔瓦多·达利设计的巨大青铜书籍封面。

paras.en: The cover belongs to a massive book titled Livre de l’Apocalypse. The work was the collective achievement of seven artists and seven writers who, between 1958 and 1961, were recruited by French publisher Joseph Forêt to interpret and illustrate parts of the Book of Revelation, the canonical last book of the New Testament. These leading creatives—including Ossip Zadkine, Léonard Foujita, Jean Cocteau and Jean Giono—contributed 150 scroll-sized pages of text and biblical scenes that took more than 2,000 hours to complete, according to the Telegraph’s Henry Samuel.
paras.zh: 该封面属于一本名为《启示录》的巨著。该作品是七位艺术家和七位作家的集体成就，他们在 1958 年至 1961 年间被法国出版商 Joseph Forêt 招募，负责解释和插图《新约圣经》最后一本书《启示录》的部分内容。据《每日电讯报》的 Henry Samuel 报道，这些顶尖创意人士——包括 Ossip Zadkine、Léonard Foujita、Jean Cocteau 和 Jean Giono——贡献了 150 页卷轴大小的文本和圣经场景，花了 2000 多个小时才完成。

paras.en: Dalí’s cover leaves a fittingly grand first impression. He created it using a now-lost wax casting technique. Featuring a prominent crucifix, it is made from a constellation of materials, including bronze, gemstones, pearls, forks and seashells. Considered the most expensive book in the world at the time of its creation, the work is likewise famed for its enormous heft. It weighs roughly 463 pounds, with the cover alone tipping the scales at 330 pounds.
paras.zh: 达利的封面给人留下了恰如其分的宏伟第一印象。他使用现已失传的蜡铸造技术创造了它。它以突出的十字架为特色，由多种材料制成，包括青铜、宝石、珍珠、叉子和贝壳。该书在创作时被认为是世界上最昂贵的书，同样因其巨大的分量而闻名。它重约 463 磅，仅盖子重达 330 磅。

paras.en: “It is a monumental work, a masterpiece, unique in the world,” Christian Karoutzos, the book’s owner, who runs an art restoration company and contemporary art gallery in Issoire, tells Olivier Vidal and Christelle Marquès of ICI Pays d’Auvergne, a French radio station. “France was murdered last night. French heritage was murdered.”
paras.zh: “这是一部不朽的作品，一部杰作，在世界上独一无二，”这本书的主人克里斯蒂安·卡鲁佐斯（Christian Karoutzos）在伊苏瓦尔经营着一家艺术修复公司和当代艺术画廊，他告诉法国 ICI Pays d’Auvergne 广播电台的奥利维尔·维达尔（Olivier Vidal）和克里斯泰尔·马奎斯（Christelle Marquès）。 “法国昨晚被谋杀了。法国传统被谋杀了。”

paras.en: The book’s cover and several parchments were on display at Karoutzos’ small private contemporary art center when an unknown number of thieves forced their way through an exterior gate and demolished the book’s plexiglass display case. “They arrived like vandals. They smashed everything,” Karoutzos tells La Montagne’s David Allignon.
paras.zh: 这本书的封面和几张羊皮纸正在卡鲁佐斯的小型私人当代艺术中心展出，当时数量不详的窃贼闯入外门，拆毁了这本书的有机玻璃展示柜。 “他们像破坏者一样到来。他们砸碎了一切，”卡鲁佐斯告诉《蒙塔涅报》的大卫·阿利尼翁。

paras.en: Though all of the book’s parchments were left untouched, authorities remain baffled as to how the theft of such a heavy artwork was carried out so seamlessly.
paras.zh: 尽管这本书的所有羊皮纸都没有被碰过，但当局仍然困惑于如何如此天衣无缝地盗窃如此沉重的艺术品。

paras.en: Valued at 2 million francs at the time of its creation—about $408,000 in 1961 dollars and $4.5 million in today’s money—the book is considered priceless by many for its history and cultural significance. Issoire Mayor Bertrand Barraud described it as “the work of a lifetime” and called its loss “incalculable,” according to Euronews’ Christina Molle.
paras.zh: 这本书在创作时价值 200 万法郎（以 1961 年美元计算约为 408,000 美元，以今天的货币计算为 450 万美元），因其历史和文化意义而被许多人认为是无价之宝。据欧洲新闻台的克里斯蒂娜·莫尔报道，伊苏瓦尔市市长伯特兰·巴罗称其为“一生的工作”，并称其损失“无法估量”。

paras.en: “It has significant artistic value in and of itself, far greater than the individual value of each of the objects that make it up,” Jean-Christophe Castelain, editor-in-chief of the Journal des Arts, tells France24 in a translated interview. “What thief would be interested in an object that weighs 210 kilos? I’ll leave that question open.”
paras.zh: 《艺术杂志》主编让-克里斯托夫·卡斯特兰 (Jean-Christophe Castelain) 在翻译后的采访中告诉 France24：“它本身就具有重要的艺术价值，远远大于构成它的每件物品的个体价值。” “哪个小偷会对重 210 公斤的物体感兴趣？我不会回答这个问题。”

paras.en: For more than a decade after its completion in 1961, the book toured nearly 150 exhibitions around the world, including a stop at the French pavilion at the 1964 World’s Fair in Queens, New York.
paras.zh: 该书于 1961 年完成后的十多年来，在世界各地举办了近 150 个展览，其中包括在 1964 年纽约皇后区世界博览会的法国馆停留。

paras.en: “On exhibit will be a huge quarter‐ton volume, L’Apocalypse, a French translation of the Revelation of St. John the Divine,” the New York Times’ Walter Carlson reported at the time. “The volume was insured for $1 million for its trip from France. Admission will be charged to see it.”
paras.zh: “展出的将是一本重达四分之一吨的巨著《启示录》，这是《圣约翰启示录》的法文译本，”《纽约时报》的沃尔特·卡尔森当时报道道。 “该书从法国出发的旅程已投保 100 万美元。观看该作品需付费。”

paras.en: - The Unisphere, a giant stainless steel globe sculpture that was designed by Gilmore D. Clarke for the 1964 World’s Fair, is still visible at Flushing Meadows Corona Park in Queens.
paras.zh: - Unisphere 是一座巨大的不锈钢地球仪雕塑，由吉尔莫·D·克拉克 (Gilmore D. Clarke) 为 1964 年世界博览会设计，如今在皇后区的法拉盛梅多斯可乐娜公园 (Flushing Meadows Corona Park) 中仍然可见。

paras.en: - At its dedication ceremony, New York City planner Robert Moses said the Unisphere was “built to remain as a permanent feature of the park, reminding succeeding generations of a pageant of surpassing interest and significance.”
paras.zh: - 在落成仪式上，纽约市规划师罗伯特·摩西表示，大地球仪“的建造是为了作为公园的永久特色，提醒后代这是一场具有超越意义和意义的盛会。”

paras.en: Karoutzos bought the massive book in 2003 for “several million euros,” as he tells Le Figaro’s Alix Vermande. The tome’s previous owners had intended to divide it up and sell the separate pieces.
paras.zh: 卡鲁佐斯在 2003 年以“几百万欧元”的价格买下了这本巨著，他告诉《费加罗报》的阿利克斯·维芒德 (Alix Vermande)。这本书的前主人打算将其分割并出售单独的部分。

paras.en: The heist is the latest in a series of high-profile art thefts carried out across Europe in the past few months. In September, thieves stole four Pierre-Auguste Renoir paintings worth an estimated $2.5 million from a museum on the French Riviera. In August, 3,000-year-old Bronze Age artifacts were looted from Villena, Spain; that same month, four Renaissance works by Antonello da Messina were taken from a museum in Sicily.
paras.zh: 这起盗窃案是过去几个月欧洲各地发生的一系列备受瞩目的艺术品盗窃案中的最新一起。 9 月，窃贼从法国里维埃拉的一家博物馆偷走了四幅皮埃尔·奥古斯特·雷诺阿的画作，估计价值 250 万美元。 8 月，西班牙维耶纳 (Villena) 的 3000 年前青铜器时代文物被洗劫一空；同月，安东内罗·达·梅西纳的四件文艺复兴时期作品被从西西里岛的一家博物馆盗走。

articles.title: Flu Season Started Early in Parts of the U.S., and Experts Say You Should Consider Getting the Seasonal Jab ASAP. Here's What to Know

paras.en: Every year, autumn brings gorgeous foliage, crisp air, shorter days—and a slew of respiratory illnesses. Flu season usually starts in October or November, but infection data suggests it has kicked off early in parts of the Northern Hemisphere.
paras.zh: 每年秋天都会带来绚丽的树叶、清新的空气、较短的白天以及一系列呼吸道疾病。流感季节通常在十月或十一月开始，但感染数据显示，在北半球部分地区，流感季节已经提前开始。

paras.en: Flu rates began rising in August or September in many western states, including California, Washington, Alaska and Hawaii. That’s unusual because the respiratory illness typically starts in the Southeast and spreads toward the West Coast. Infection rates have also been unusually early in places like Japan and the United Kingdom.
paras.zh: 在许多西部州，包括加利福尼亚州、华盛顿州、阿拉斯加和夏威夷，流感发病率从八月或九月开始上升。这是不寻常的，因为呼吸道疾病通常始于东南部并向西海岸传播。日本和英国等地的感染率也异常早。

paras.en: We’re “looking at an early flu season this year,” said James Watt, deputy director of infectious diseases at the California Department of Public Health, at a briefing on October 6, reports Catherine Ho at the San Francisco Chronicle.
paras.zh: 据《旧金山纪事报》的凯瑟琳·何 (Catherine Ho) 报道，加州公共卫生部传染病副主任詹姆斯·瓦特 (James Watt) 在 10 月 6 日的新闻发布会上表示，我们“预计今年流感季节会提前”。

paras.en: This early rise is concerning because people haven’t started getting their vaccines yet, says Danielle Zerr, an infectious-diseases specialist at Seattle Children’s, to Lena H. Sun at the Washington Post. “The way flu is circulating now, you wanted that vaccine in you two weeks ago, if not even a little before that.”
paras.zh: 西雅图儿童医院的传染病专家丹妮尔·泽尔 (Danielle Zerr) 向《华盛顿邮报》的莉娜·H·孙 (Lena H. Sun) 表示，这种早期上升令人担忧，因为人们还没有开始接种疫苗。 “按照流感现在的传播方式，你在两周前就需要接种疫苗，甚至更早一点。”

paras.en: Here’s what you need to know about this year’s early flu season.
paras.zh: 以下是您需要了解的有关今年早期流感季节的信息。

paras.en: The flu is caused by an infection with an influenza virus. There are two subtypes of Influenza A—H3N2 and H1N1—and one type of Influenza B, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). The severity of each season depends on which version of the virus is spreading. H3N2 influenza strains are linked to more severe flu seasons and more hospitalizations. This year, the other one, H1N1, is dominating.
paras.zh: 流感是由流感病毒感染引起的。根据美国疾病控制与预防中心 (CDC) 的数据，甲型流感有两种亚型——H3N2 和 H1N1——以及一种乙型流感。每个季节的严重程度取决于正在传播的病毒版本。 H3N2 流感病毒株与更严重的流感季节和更多的住院治疗有关。今年，另一种 H1N1 流感占据主导地位。

paras.en: Flu spreads via droplets spewed when an infected person coughs, sneezes or talks. Symptoms generally appear one to four days after infection. Signs of illness can include fever or feverish chills, cough, sore throat, runny nose, muscle aches and fatigue. A sick individual is most contagious during their first three days of symptoms.
paras.zh: 流感通过感染者咳嗽、打喷嚏或说话时喷出的飞沫传播。症状通常在感染后一到四天出现。疾病迹象可能包括发烧或发烧发冷、咳嗽、喉咙痛、流鼻涕、肌肉酸痛和疲劳。病人在出现症状的前三天最具传染性。

paras.en: Since 2010, the flu has resulted in between 120,000 and 710,000 hospitalizations and has contributed to between 6,300 and 52,000 deaths each year in the U.S., according to estimates by the CDC.
paras.zh: 据美国疾病预防控制中心估计，自 2010 年以来，流感每年在美国导致 120,000 至 710,000 人住院治疗，并导致 6,300 至 52,000 人死亡。

paras.en: Experts don’t know for sure, but one possibility is that a new variant of H1N1 evolved a mutation that is better at evading some people’s immune systems. “That’s our best argument for what’s going on right now in terms of this early flu season,” says Alex Greninger, a virologist at the University of Washington, to Rob Stein at NPR.
paras.zh: 专家们并不确定，但一种可能性是，H1N1 流感的一种新变种进化出了一种突变，能够更好地逃避某些人的免疫系统。华盛顿大学病毒学家亚历克斯·格雷宁格 (Alex Greninger) 对美国公共广播电台 (NPR) 的罗布·斯坦因 (Rob Stein) 表示：“这是我们对当前流感季节早期所发生情况的最佳论据。”

paras.en: Another reason might be that because H3N2 dominated last year’s flu season, people have less recent immunity against the version that’s currently running rampant, Helen Chu, an infectious-diseases specialist at the University of Washington, tells the Washington Post.
paras.zh: 华盛顿大学传染病专家 Helen Chu 告诉《华盛顿邮报》，另一个原因可能是，由于 H3N2 主导了去年的流感季节，人们最近对目前猖獗的 H3N2 病毒的免疫力较低。

paras.en: It’s still too soon to tell what this year’s season will look like. Looking at the Southern Hemisphere can offer clues, since our seasons are flipped, writes Katelyn Jetelina for Your Local Epidemiologist. “Flu season was severe in many places this summer,” she explains, with Argentina recording its highest number of flu-like illness cases in a decade. That doesn’t necessarily mean things will look the same in the Northern Hemisphere, but it’s something epidemiologists are keeping an eye on.
paras.zh: 现在判断今年的季节会是什么样子还为时过早。凯特琳·杰特琳娜为当地流行病学家写道，观察南半球可以提供线索，因为我们的季节交替。她解释说：“今年夏天，许多地方的流感季节都很严重。”阿根廷的流感样疾病病例数创下十年来最高。这并不一定意味着北半球的情况会一样，但流行病学家正在密切关注。

paras.en: What’s more, “an early start doesn’t necessarily mean a more severe season,” says James Hay, an epidemiologist at the University of Oxford in England, to Nature’s Mariana Lenharo.
paras.zh: 此外，英国牛津大学的流行病学家詹姆斯·海伊 (James Hay) 对《自然》杂志的玛丽安娜·伦哈罗 (Mariana Lenharo) 表示，“提早开始并不一定意味着疫情会更加严重”。

paras.en: Flu vaccines for 2026-27 are already available, and the best thing you can do is get your shot as early as possible—even if you got one last year. The vaccine is adjusted every year to target the strains that researchers predict will be circulating that season. While it’s hard for them to get it exactly right, vaccines still offer an important level of protection that can reduce the severity of the illness.
paras.zh: 2026-27 年流感疫苗已经上市，您能做的最好的事情就是尽早接种——即使您去年接种过疫苗。该疫苗每年都会进行调整，以针对研究人员预测将在该季节传播的菌株。虽然他们很难做到完全正确，但疫苗仍然提供了重要的保护水平，可以减轻疾病的严重程度。

paras.en: “This is one of those seasons where the key message is to go get vaccinated now,” Greninger tells Nature.
paras.zh: 格雷宁格告诉《自然》杂志：“这是关键信息是立即接种疫苗的季节之一。”

articles.title: Just Inches Below the Forest Floor, Archaeologists in Germany Unearthed a Roman Temple Likely Dedicated to Mars, the God of War

paras.en: Archaeologists in Germany have discovered the remains of a Roman temple that appears to have been dedicated to Mars, the god of war.
paras.zh: 德国考古学家发现了一座罗马神庙的遗迹，这座神庙似乎是供奉战神马尔斯的。

paras.en: The structure was concealed just beneath the forest floor in the foothills of the eastern Taunus Mountains, on the northern outskirts of Frankfurt, according to a September 25 announcement from the Hesse State Office for Monument Preservation.
paras.zh: 根据黑森州纪念碑保护办公室 9 月 25 日的公告，该建筑隐藏在法兰克福北郊陶努斯山脉东部山麓的森林地面下方。

paras.en: The temple is rectangular and measures about 16 feet long. Inside, it appears to have contained a smaller, square chamber with just three roughly 20-inch-thick walls, Thomas Kurella reports for Hessenschau. Archaeologists believe the structure could be an ambulatory temple, with the three-walled central prayer room accessible through a wooden gate or door and surrounded by covered walkways.
paras.zh: 寺庙呈长方形，长约16英尺。托马斯·库雷拉 (Thomas Kurella) 为 Hessenschau 报道称，里面似乎包含一个较小的方形房间，只有三层大约 20 英寸厚的墙壁。考古学家认为，该建筑可能是一座流动寺庙，其三墙中央祈祷室可通过木门或门进入，周围环绕着有盖的走道。

paras.en: Researchers found an inscription suggesting that the temple was dedicated to Mars, according to Live Science’s Kristina Killgrove. They also unearthed a fragment of a statue that may have portrayed the war god. Another statuette likely represents Victoria, the Roman goddess of victory who often appears alongside Mars and was worshipped by the Roman military. The artifact is broken, but it still clearly bears the hallmarks of Victoria: wings, a palm branch and a laurel wreath, per Hessenschau.
paras.zh: 据《Live Science》的克里斯蒂娜·基尔格罗夫称，研究人员发现了一段铭文，表明这座神庙是献给火星的。他们还出土了可能描绘战神的雕像的碎片。另一尊小雕像很可能代表罗马胜利女神维多利亚，她经常与玛尔斯一起出现，并受到罗马军队的崇拜。这件文物已破损，但仍清晰地带有维多利亚的标志：翅膀、棕榈树枝和月桂花环（根据 Hessenschau 的说法）。

paras.en: Archaeologists unearthed this temple during ongoing excavations of the Kapersburg fort—a Roman military fortification thought to date back to the second century C.E.—and its neighboring village, known as a “vicus,” which likely housed the soldiers’ families, merchants and other civilians.
paras.zh: 考古学家在卡珀斯堡堡垒（据认为可以追溯到公元二世纪的罗马军事防御工事）及其邻近的村庄（被称为“vicus”）的持续挖掘过程中发现了这座寺庙，该村庄可能居住着士兵的家人、商人和其他平民。

paras.en: The fort was likely constructed under the reign of Emperor Trajan or Emperor Hadrian, per Live Science. A Roman military unit called the Numerus Nidensium was stationed there for roughly 150 years, until the fort was abandoned in the middle of the third century C.E. The group likely originated in the nearby Roman town of Nida, now the Heddernheim quarter of Frankfurt.
paras.zh: 据《Live Science》报道，这座堡垒很可能是在图拉真皇帝或哈德良皇帝统治时期建造的。一支名为“Numerus Nidensium”的罗马军事单位驻扎在那里大约 150 年，直到公元三世纪中叶该堡垒被废弃。该组织可能起源于附近的罗马城镇奈达，即现在的法兰克福海德海姆区。

paras.en: Researchers believe roughly 160 men were stationed at the fort, while up to 700 people lived in the nearby village, per Hessenschau.
paras.zh: 据 Hessenschau 报道，研究人员认为这座堡垒驻扎了大约 160 人，附近村庄则居住着多达 700 人。

paras.en: The site is part of the Upper Germanic-Rhaetian Limes, which became a UNESCO World Heritage site in 2005. This 342-mile stretch, which runs between the Rhine and the Danube rivers, formed part of the Roman Empire’s border, marking not only its military frontier but also the limits of its economic and cultural influence.
paras.zh: 该遗址是上日耳曼-雷蒂亚界线的一部分，于 2005 年成为联合国教科文组织世界遗产。这条 342 英里的河段横跨莱茵河和多瑙河，是罗马帝国边界的一部分，不仅标志着其军事边界，也标志着其经济和文化影响力的界限。

paras.en: Archaeologists have been excavating the fort for decades. However, they recently turned their attention toward the adjacent settlement after drought, pests and a storm cleared away some of the surrounding forest.
paras.zh: 几十年来，考古学家一直在挖掘这座堡垒。然而，由于干旱、害虫和暴风雨摧毁了周围的一些森林，他们最近将注意力转向了邻近的定居点。

paras.en: Because of the site’s location in the wooded foothills, it has remained largely untouched for centuries, leaving well-preserved structures and artifacts just beneath the top layer of soil. Previous excavations have unearthed a Roman votive stone, which is now on view at a museum in nearby Rosbach vor der Höhe.
paras.zh: 由于该遗址位于树木繁茂的山麓，几个世纪以来基本上没有受到任何影响，在土壤表层下留下了保存完好的结构和文物。之前的挖掘工作中出土了一块罗马许愿石，目前在 Rosbach vor der Höhe 附近的一家博物馆展出。

paras.en: This year, in addition to the temple, researchers found the remains of craft activities, including blacksmith pits and baking ovens that may have been used for drying grain, per Live Science. They didn’t find as many houses as they had suspected, suggesting that the site once functioned as an interstitial area between the fort and the settlement.
paras.zh: 据《Live Science》报道，今年，除了寺庙之外，研究人员还发现了手工艺活动的遗迹，包括铁匠坑和可能用于干燥谷物的烤炉。他们没有找到像他们怀疑的那样多的房屋，这表明该地点曾经是堡垒和定居点之间的间隙区域。

paras.en: The Romans held two festivals in honor of Mars each year, one in the spring and one in the fall. He was seen as the protector of not only Rome but also the Roman way of life.
paras.zh: 罗马人每年举行两个节日来纪念火星，一个在春天，一个在秋天。他不仅被视为罗马的保护者，也是罗马生活方式的保护者。

paras.en: Next to the recently excavated temple, a piece of jewelry from a later period indicates that the site continued to see use after the Roman military presence dissipated. The archaeologists are currently deciphering a Latin inscription on another votive stone from within the temple chamber, which may reveal further information, or even the name, of the ancient village near the Kapersburg fort.
paras.zh: 在最近出土的寺庙旁边，一件晚期的珠宝表明，在罗马军事存在消失后，该遗址继续被使用。考古学家目前正在破译神庙室内另一块许愿石上的拉丁文铭文，这可能会揭示卡珀斯堡堡垒附近古村庄的更多信息，甚至名称。

articles.title: Lowe’s Promo Codes and Deals: Up to $300 Off Appliances
articles.author: Molly Higgins

paras.en: Lowe’s Home Improvement grew the old-fashioned way, working its way up from a single, small, family-owned North Carolina general store founded in 1921. But the Lowe’s hardware store empire is plenty big these days. A tool-filled Lowe’s superstore is now about as big as a New York City block. The focus is mostly on appliances and tools for the home DIYer, rather than large building contractors. I like to pop in for grill and griddle tools or just some propane. But you can also buy a pre-finished door complete with the frame—or the lumber, sanders, routers, and saws you’d use to make your own door, including the hinges and the wood stain. It’s easy to get lost in the endless aisles if you love the smell of plaster and wood dust, but it’s easier to find the best Lowe’s deals on the website. This roundup includes Lowe’s daily deals, a promo code, and a Lowe's offer code for 40% off appliances, plus info on the Lowe’s rewards program and military discounts.
paras.zh: Lowe's Home Improvement 公司以老式方式发展，从一家成立于 1921 年的北卡罗来纳州小型家族经营杂货店发展而来。但如今，Lowe's 五金店帝国已相当庞大。一家装满工具的劳氏超市现在大约有纽约街区那么大。重点主要是家庭 DIY 爱好者的电器和工具，而不是大型建筑承包商。我喜欢去买烧烤和煎锅工具，或者只是一些丙烷。但您也可以购买带有框架的预成品门，或者用于制作自己的门的木材、打磨机、铣机和锯，包括铰链和木材着色剂。如果您喜欢石膏和木屑的气味，很容易在无尽的过道中迷路，但在网站上找到最优惠的 Lowe's 商品更容易。本综述包括 Lowe's 每日优惠、促销代码和 Lowe's 电器 40% 折扣优惠代码，以及有关 Lowe's 奖励计划和军事折扣的信息。

paras.en: With Lowe’s Deals, you can get up to 35% off select major appliances. During this Lowe’s Deals sales period, you can save up to $2,000 when you bundle select KitchenAid appliances and an additional $100 on select Whirlpool and Maytag laundry pairs. Plus, there are hundreds of select and best-selling appliances like refrigerators, dishwashers, microwaves, ranges, freezers, and more.
paras.zh: 通过 Lowe's Deals，您可以享受精选主要家电高达 35% 的折扣。在此 Lowe's Deals 促销期间，捆绑精选 KitchenAid 电器可节省高达 2,000 美元，购买精选 Whirlpool 和 Maytag 洗衣机组合还可额外节省 100 美元。此外，还有数百种精选和畅销电器，如冰箱、洗碗机、微波炉、炉灶、冰柜等。

paras.en: Save up to 70% on Select Kitchen and Bathroom Products
paras.zh: 购买精选厨房和浴室产品最高可节省 70%

paras.en: It’s no secret that kitchen and bathroom remodels are the most costly home improvement projects any homeowner can take on. For those bigger (and much more costly) renovations, Lowe’s is helping you save more the more you spend. This means you can get up to an additional: 10% off when you spend $750-$1,999, 20% off when you spend $2,000-$4,999, and 30% off when you spend over $5,000. This Lowe’s savings on kitchen and bath program is ideal for homeowners doing a complete room reno, potentially saving thousands of dollars over the course of the project.
paras.zh: 众所周知，厨房和浴室改造是任何房主可以承担的最昂贵的家居装修项目。对于那些规模更大（而且成本更高）的装修，Lowe's 可以帮助您花得越多，节省的就越多。这意味着您可以享受额外优惠：消费 750 美元至 1,999 美元时可享受 10% 的折扣，消费 2,000 美元至 4,999 美元时可享受 20% 的折扣，消费超过 5,000 美元时可享受 30% 的折扣。 Lowe’s 的厨房和浴室节省计划非常适合进行完整房间翻新的房主，在项目过程中可能节省数千美元。

paras.en: Quick Ways to Save at Lowe’s: Text Alerts and Daily Deals
paras.zh: 在 Lowe’s 省钱的快速方法：短信提醒和每日优惠

paras.en: Join the MyLowe’s Rewards Program, Get Maximum Benefits
paras.zh: 加入 MyLowe 奖励计划，获得最大福利

paras.en: If you’re planning major work this year or just like to putter around, it’s probably worth picking up a MyLowe’s Rewards Program membership. Each eligible purchase accrues points that pay out in $5 increments of in-store credit at Lowe’s. Like many loyalty programs, you get more benefits the more you spend at the store, including free shipping on all purchases, including small ones, member-only discounts, and point boosters for better discounts.
paras.zh: 如果您今年计划开展重大工作或只是想闲逛，那么可能值得加入 MyLowe’s 奖励计划会员资格。每次符合条件的购买都会累积积分，并以 5 美元的 Lowe’s 店内积分为增量进行支付。与许多忠诚度计划一样，您在商店消费越多，获得的福利就越多，包括所有购买商品（包括小件商品）免运费、会员专享折扣以及积分加成以获得更好的折扣。

paras.en: There are three membership tiers, depending on what you buy. One large appliance might already qualify you for the highest tier of rewards, at which point you might as well. These are the three tiers, based on the total cost of what you’ve bought at Lowe’s in the past year. Bronze ($0-$499): $35 minimum for free shipping; 1 point per $1 spent. Silver ($500-$1,999): Free shipping; 1.25 points per $1 spent. Gold ($2,000+): Free shipping; 1.5 points per $1 spent.
paras.zh: 会员级别分为三个级别，具体取决于您购买的商品。一台大型设备可能已经让您有资格获得最高级别的奖励，此时您也可以。这些是三个等级，基于您过去一年在劳氏购买的商品的总成本。青铜级 ($0-$499)：最低 35 美元免运费；每消费 1​​ 美元可得 1 积分。银牌（$500-$1,999）：免运费；每消费 1​​ 美元可赚取 1.25 积分。黄金级（2,000 美元以上）：免运费；每消费 1​​ 美元可赚取 1.5 积分。

paras.en: For contractors, there’s a separate MyLowe’s Pro Rewards Program that offers Lowe’s in-store credit in $1 increments for every 100 points earned. (Points expire in half-yearly increments, on June 30 and December 31.) Benefits include member-only deals, volume discounts, free standard shipping in the contiguous United States, and a 20% paint discount after an annual spend of $3,000 or more. Other benefits include analytics and spend reports, online order quoting, and purchase authorization for specified crew members.
paras.zh: 对于承包商，有一个单独的 MyLowe’s Pro 奖励计划，每赚取 100 点积分即可获得 Lowe’s 店内积分，增量为 1 美元。 （积分每半年到期一次，有效期为 6 月 30 日和 12 月 31 日。）福利包括会员专享优惠、批量折扣、美国本土免费标准送货，以及每年消费 3,000 美元或以上后享受 20% 的油漆折扣。其他好处包括分析和支出报告、在线订单报价以及特定机组人员的购买授权。

paras.en: 10% Military Discount, Plus Free MyLowe’s Silver Status
paras.zh: 10% 军事折扣，另加免费 MyLowe 银卡会员资格

paras.en: All verified active military, veterans, and military spouses are eligible for a 10% discount on full-price items—meaning items don’t have to be on sale to qualify. This is available through what Lowe’s calls the Everyday Military Discount program. When you enroll, you also get an immediate upgrade to Silver status in the MyLowe’s Rewards program, which means more rewards points per dollar and free shipping on all orders in the contiguous United States.
paras.zh: 所有经过验证的现役军人、退伍军人和军人配偶都有资格享受全价商品 10% 的折扣，这意味着商品不必打折即可获得资格。这可以通过 Lowe’s 所谓的“日常军事折扣”计划获得。注册后，您还可以立即升级到 MyLowe 奖励计划中的白银会员资格，这意味着每美元可获得更多奖励积分，并且美国本土的所有订单均可免费送货。

paras.en: Get a free Silver status upgrade instantly when you enroll in our Military Discount program and validate through ID.me. MyLowe’s Rewards Silver status members receive free standard shipping (excludes AK and HI) and earn more points per dollar.
paras.zh: 当您注册我们的军事折扣计划并通过 ID.me 进行验证时，即可立即获得免费的银级身份升级。 MyLowe’s Rewards 银卡会员可享受免费标准运费（AK 和 HI 除外），并且每美元可赚取更多积分。

paras.en: Another way to get 5% off items you need regularly is to set up a Lowe’s subscription. This is good for items ranging from cleaning products, air and water filters, lawn care, pet goods, plumbing, and batteries. Shipping is free, and delivery happens automatically.
paras.zh: 另一种获得定期需要的商品 5% 折扣的方法是订阅 Lowe’s。这适用于清洁产品、空气和水过滤器、草坪护理、宠物用品、管道和电池等物品。免费送货，并且自动送货。

paras.en: Make Sure to Check Lowe’s Price Guarantee
paras.zh: 请务必查看 Lowe's 价格保证

paras.en: You may not realize that Lowe’s has a Lowest Price Guarantee policy, which means that if you find a lower price on an identical item, Lowe’s will match the competitor’s price. All you need to do is chat with a Lowe’s employee in-store or call 1-877-465-6937. Plus, the Lowest Price Guarantee includes the price of the item(s) plus shipping or delivery costs.
paras.zh: 您可能没有意识到劳氏有最低价格保证政策，这意味着如果您发现相同商品的价格更低，劳氏将与竞争对手的价格相匹配。您所需要做的就是与 Lowe’s 店内员工聊天或致电 1-877-465-6937。另外，最低价格保证包括商品价格加上运费或送货费用。

articles.title: Ulta Promo Codes: Up to 20% Off in October 2026
articles.author: Boutayna Chokrane

paras.en: At Ulta Beauty, you can stock up on skincare, makeup, and haircare, then head to the salon for brows shaped, hair styled, and ears pierced, all in one visit. You’ll find brands like Dior, Estée Lauder, and Gucci alongside more affordable favorites and drugstore staples. Many locations feature a Benefit Cosmetics BrowBar, so you can sample products and book an in-store brow service in the same visit. Ulta’s return policy is very forgiving, allowing you to return “gently used” products within 30 days for a full refund. Add in its weekly sales, the 21+ Days of Beauty Event, and stackable Ulta coupons, and you’ll rarely pay full price.
paras.zh: 在 Ulta Beauty，您可以购买护肤品、化妆品和护发产品，然后前往沙龙进行修眉、做发型和打耳洞，这一切都可以一次性完成。您会发现迪奥、雅诗兰黛和古驰等品牌，以及更实惠的最爱和药店主打商品。许多门店都设有 Benefit Cosmetics BrowBar，因此您可以在一次访问店内品尝产品并预订店内修眉服务。 Ulta 的退货政策非常宽松，允许您在 30 天内退回“轻度使用”的产品并获得全额退款。再加上每周的促销、超过 21 天的美容活动以及可叠加的 Ulta 优惠券，您很少会支付全价。

paras.en: I’ve tested a wide range of beauty products sold at Ulta, from hair tools and red-light therapy devices for hair growth to LED devices, pimple patches, and lip balms. Here’s how to shop smarter, with the best Ulta promo codes and Ulta coupons to keep on your radar.
paras.zh: 我测试过 Ulta 出售的各种美容产品，从美发工具和用于毛发生长的红光治疗设备到 LED 设备、痘痘贴和润唇膏。以下是如何更明智地购物，让您时刻关注最好的 Ulta 促销代码和 Ulta 优惠券。

paras.en: One of the best ways to save regularly on both small, everyday purchases and bigger beauty tech and tools is to shop Ulta’s weekly and daily sales. With Ulta’s Daily & Weekly Beauty Steals, you’ll find up to 50% off everything from perfume to facial cleansers to makeup essentials. You can save big on brands like Ralph Lauren, Murad, Bumble & Bumble, and more.
paras.zh: 无论是日常小额购买还是大型美容技术和工具，定期节省开支的最佳方法之一就是购买 Ulta 的每周和每日促销活动。通过 Ulta 的每日和每周 Beauty Steals，您会发现从香水到洗面奶再到化妆必需品的所有商品均可享受高达 50% 的折扣。您可以节省大量购买 Ralph Lauren、Murad、Bumble & Bumble 等品牌的费用。

paras.en: 15% Off at Ulta Beauty When You Download the App
paras.zh: 下载 Ulta Beauty 应用程序即可享受 15% 折扣

paras.en: If you already shop at Ulta often, downloading and using the Ulta app is one of the best ways to save money on purchases you were planning to make. All you need to do is download the Ulta app (for free) by texting "Beauty" to 95637. From there, you’ll receive an Ulta promo code, APP15, for 15% off your next purchase. Plus, with the Ulta app, you’ll be able to virtually try on thousands of beauty products with GLAMlab, use the Ulta Foundation Matcher to match your skin tone and find your best shade, and get an AI-powered skin analysis for customized skin care recommendations.
paras.zh: 如果您已经经常在 Ulta 购物，下载并使用 Ulta 应用程序是您计划购买时省钱的最佳方法之一。您所需要做的就是发送短信“Beauty”至 95637，下载 Ulta 应用程序（免费）。从那里，您将收到 Ulta 促销代码 APP15，下次购买可享受 15% 的折扣。此外，借助 Ulta 应用程序，您将能够通过 GLAMlab 虚拟试用数千种美容产品，使用 Ulta Foundation Matcher 来匹配您的肤色并找到最佳色调，并获得人工智能驱动的皮肤分析以提供定制的皮肤护理建议。

paras.en: Plus, Ulta app members get exclusive in-app features, offers, and deals. You’ll also be able to monitor your membership rewards status and points, and get notified of app-exclusive deals, discounts, brand offers, and more. And with the handy barcode scanner, shopping has never been easier—you can scan any product’s barcode to see information on ingredients and product reviews. When you’re an Ulta member, you’ll get 1 point for every $1 spent and birthday perks.
paras.zh: 此外，Ulta 应用程序会员还可获得独家应用程序内功能、优惠和优惠。您还可以监控您的会员奖励状态和积分，并获得有关应用程序独家优惠、折扣、品牌优惠等的通知。借助方便的条形码扫描仪，购物变得前所未有的简单 - 您可以扫描任何产品的条形码以查看有关成分和产品评论的信息。当您是 Ulta 会员时，每消费 1​​ 美元即可获得 1 积分以及生日福利。

paras.en: Use Ulta Beauty Rewards for Ulta Discounts
paras.zh: 使用 Ulta Beauty Rewards 享受 Ulta 折扣

paras.en: The Ulta Beauty Rewards program is free to join and offers many perks with minimal effort. First, you earn points for every dollar you spend. The program has multiple tiers: standard members earn 1 point per dollar; platinum members earn 1.25 points; and diamond members earn 1.5 points. To qualify for platinum status, you need to spend $500 per year, and diamond members must spend $1,200 annually.
paras.zh: Ulta Beauty Rewards 计划可免费加入，并以最少的努力提供许多福利。首先，您花费的每一美元都可以赚取积分。该计划有多个等级：标准会员每消费 1​​ 美元可赚取 1 点积分；白金会员赚取1.25积分；钻石会员可获得1.5积分。要获得白金会员资格，您需要每年花费 500 美元，钻石会员则必须每年花费 1,200 美元。

paras.en: These points can be redeemed for discounts, and the best part is that they do not expire. (To activate your rewards, you need to download the Ulta Beauty app.) Here's how the points translate into savings: 100 points give you $3 off, 250 points offer an $8 discount, 500 points save you $17.50, and 750 points grant you $30 off.
paras.zh: 这些积分可以兑换折扣，而且最好的一点是它们不会过期。 （要激活您的奖励，您需要下载 Ulta Beauty 应用程序。）以下是积分如何转化为折扣：100 点积分可优惠 3 美元，250 点积分可优惠 8 美元，500 点积分可节省 17.5 美元，750 点积分可优惠 30 美元。

paras.en: During your birthday month, you get even more special perks. These include earning extra points on every qualifying purchase, a free gift, and a $10 coupon exclusively for platinum and diamond members. Other benefits include exclusive beauty deals, early access to sales, and full-size gifts for diamond members. Diamond members also get a $25 discount on beauty services and free shipping on orders over $25.
paras.zh: 在您的生日月份，您将获得更多特别福利。其中包括每次符合资格的购买即可赚取额外积分、一份免费礼物以及专为白金和钻石会员提供的 10 美元优惠券。其他福利包括独家美容优惠、抢先销售以及为钻石会员提供的全尺寸礼物。钻石会员还可享受美容服务 25 美元折扣，订单超过 25 美元可免运费。

paras.en: Unlock Free Standard Shipping on Your $35 Purchase
paras.zh: 购买满 35 美元即可解锁免费标准运费

paras.en: All online customers qualify for free standard shipping on purchases of $35 or more. It's easy to reach that amount at Ulta, even with all the discounts.
paras.zh: 所有在线客户购买满 35 美元或以上均可享受免费标准运费。即使有各种折扣，在 Ulta 也很容易达到这个金额。

paras.en: What We’ve Learned From Tracking Ulta Beauty Coupon Deals
paras.zh: 我们从跟踪 Ulta Beauty 优惠券交易中学到了什么

paras.en: We’ve been doing this for a while, and we’ve become pretty good at tracking and identifying the best offers available and bringing them to you, of course. We check Ulta often, testing the Ulta coupon codes ourselves and bringing them to you here weekly (if not more often). These are often deals for things like 20% off certain beloved brands or beauty categories, as well as BOGO deals.
paras.zh: 我们这样做已经有一段时间了，当然，我们已经非常擅长跟踪和识别可用的最佳优惠并将其带给您。我们经常检查 Ulta，亲自测试 Ulta 优惠券代码，并每周将它们带给您（如果不是更频繁的话）。这些优惠通常是某些受欢迎的品牌或美容类别的 20% 折扣，以及 BOGO 优惠。

articles.title: TurboTax Full Service Coupons This October 2026
articles.author: Molly Higgins

paras.en: TurboTax has been my go-to for self-filing taxes for years. It’s good enough for me—and literally millions of other users. TurboTax has quickly become a favorite for its easy-to-use self-filing services and easy access to assistance from tax professionals. TurboTax offers free self-service for qualifying people, TurboTax Live Assisted, where you file online with tax expert help if needed, and TurboTax Full Service, where a tax expert will do your taxes and review them with you before filing.
paras.zh: 多年来，TurboTax 一直是我自助报税的首选。这对我以及数百万其他用户来说已经足够好了。 TurboTax 因其易于使用的自助报税服务和轻松获得税务专业人士的帮助而迅速成为人们的最爱。 TurboTax 为符合资格的人员提供免费自助服务、TurboTax Live Assisted（您可以在需要时在税务专家的帮助下在线报税）和 TurboTax Full Service（税务专家将在报税前与您一起办理报税并进行审核）。

paras.en: To help you navigate the often confusing process of filing taxes, I’ve written a guide on How to Pay Your Taxes Online and The Best Tax Services. In both, I included TurboTax and similar services to help you choose the right option for your specific tax needs. WIRED also has TurboTax coupons to save money as you begin the always-annoying task of filing your taxes this year. Canadian customers click here; these coupons are not for you.
paras.zh: 为了帮助您应对经常令人困惑的报税过程，我编写了一份关于如何在线纳税和最佳税务服务的指南。在这两者中，我都包含了 TurboTax 和类似的服务，以帮助您选择适合您的特定税务需求的正确选项。 《连线》还提供 TurboTax 优惠券，让您在今年开始执行总是令人烦恼的报税任务时节省开支。加拿大客户点击这里；这些优惠券不适合您。

paras.en: Save 10% With TurboTax Service Codes and 2026 Early Filing Offers
paras.zh: 使用 TurboTax 服务代码和 2026 年提前申报优惠可节省 10%

paras.en: Right now, you can get an extra 10% off Federal online tax filings with today’s TurboTax coupons. This price includes W-2 and 1040, with state returns for an additional fee. With ExpertFull Service, a tax professional will do your taxes for you. It costs a bit more than DIY, but it can save you headaches and messes when it comes to what you owe. Prices only get higher as tax season approaches, so file now to get the best price of the season.
paras.zh: 现在，您可以使用今天的 TurboTax 优惠券在联邦在线报税时获得额外 10% 的折扣。此价格包括 W-2 和 1040，州申报表需额外付费。通过 ExpertFull Service，税务专业人员将为您办理报税。它的成本比 DIY 贵一点，但是当涉及到你所欠的钱时，它可以为你省去麻烦和麻烦。随着报税季节的临近，价格只会上涨，因此请立即提交以获得本季度的最佳价格。

paras.en: If your taxes are a bit more straightforward but you still have some questions, TurboTax Expert Assist (Live) offers the best of both worlds, letting you file online yourself with tax expert help nearby if you need it. With these TurboTax deals, you’ll get 10% off TurboTax Live Assisted, with options starting at only $36 and (temporarily) capping out at $150 if you want to fully hand off your taxes. (Like the above service, this discount is for Federal tax products, and filing early is the best way to ensure you’re getting the lowest price of the season).
paras.zh: 如果您的税务比较简单，但仍有一些问题，TurboTax Expert Assist（Live）可以提供两全其美的服务，让您可以在需要时在附近的税务专家帮助下自行在线报税。通过这些 TurboTax 优惠，您将获得 TurboTax Live Assisted 10% 的折扣，起价仅为 36 美元，如果您想完全免除税款，（暂时）上限为 150 美元。 （与上述服务一样，此折扣适用于联邦税产品，提前提交是确保您获得当季最低价格的最佳方式）。

paras.en: *Price estimates are provided before a tax expert starts work on your taxes. Estimates are based on the initial information you provide about your tax situation, including forms you upload to assist your expert in preparing your tax return and forms or schedules we think you’ll need to file based on what you tell us about your tax situation. Final price is determined at the time of print or electronic filing and may vary based on your actual tax situation, forms used to prepare your return, and forms or schedules included in your individual return. Prices are subject to change without notice and may impact your final price.
paras.zh: *价格估算是在税务专家开始处理您的税款之前提供的。估算基于您提供的有关您税务状况的初始信息，包括您上传的用于协助您的专家准备纳税申报表的表格，以及我们认为您需要根据您告诉我们的有关您的税务状况提交的表格或时间表。最终价格在打印或电子申报时确定，可能会根据您的实际税务情况、用于准备纳税申报表的表格以及个人纳税申报表中包含的表格或时间表而有所不同。价格如有变更，恕不另行通知，并可能影响您的最终价格。

paras.en: Give a 20% Off TurboTax Discount Code, Get up to $500
paras.zh: 提供 TurboTax 折扣代码 20% 折扣，最高可获 500 美元

paras.en: To save even more, get a TurboTax referral link. When your friends use it, they can get 20% off TurboTax federal products if they’re new customers. As an added bonus, for each friend who files using your link, you’ll get a $25 gift card—you can earn up to a whopping $500 in gift cards (at this point, you’re basically getting another refund in gift cards). Here’s the nitty-gritty: friends can receive 20% off the preparation and filing of a federal tax return or a business federal tax return through a TurboTax Online or TurboTax Live product through October 31. You’ll get an email with the gift card or charitable donation within 45 days of your friend’s purchase. (Restrictions apply to TurboTax Free Edition, Intuit TurboTax Verified Pro, TurboTax State returns, TurboTax CD/Download products, and other add-on offerings.)
paras.zh: 要节省更多，请获取 TurboTax 推荐链接。当您的朋友使用它时，如果他们是新客户，他们可以享受 TurboTax 联邦产品 20% 的折扣。作为额外的奖励，对于每个使用您的链接提交文件的朋友，您将获得一张 25 美元的礼品卡 - 您最多可以赚取高达 500 美元的礼品卡（此时，您基本上会获得另一笔礼品卡退款）。实际情况如下：截至 10 月 31 日，朋友通过 TurboTax Online 或 TurboTax Live 产品准备和提交联邦纳税申报表或企业联邦纳税申报表可享受 20% 的折扣。您将在朋友购买后 45 天内收到一封包含礼品卡或慈善捐款的电子邮件。 （限制适用于 TurboTax 免费版、Intuit TurboTax Verified Pro、TurboTax State 申报表、TurboTax CD/下载产品和其他附加产品。）

paras.en: Save up to 20% on TurboTax Business Services
paras.zh: TurboTax 商业服务可节省高达 20%

paras.en: If you’re a small business owner, Expert Assist is likely the best service for you, with qualified tax experts ready to help with any tricky filing questions. Right now, if you file your business tax returns with TurboTax, you’ll get 20% off one 2025 personal federal tax return. This service is best for those with S-corps and partnerships, and TurboTax will match you with a small business tax expert who knows your industry to maximize your deductions.
paras.zh: 如果您是小型企业主，专家协助可能是最适合您的服务，合格的税务专家随时准备帮助解决任何棘手的申报问题。现在，如果您通过 TurboTax 提交企业纳税申报表，您将获得一份 2025 年个人联邦纳税申报表 20% 的折扣。这项服务最适合那些拥有 S 军团和合作伙伴的企业，TurboTax 将为您匹配一位了解您所在行业的小型企业税务专家，以最大限度地提高您的扣除额。

paras.en: In addition to the 20% off one personal tax filing offer for business customers, you can also get 10% off Business Expert Full Service and Expert Assist for small business owners. This discount applies to TurboTax federal products only (meaning no state products are included). These savings are in addition to early-season discounts..
paras.zh: 除了为企业客户提供一份个人报税优惠 20% 的优惠外，您还可以为小型企业主享受 10% 的商业专家全方位服务和专家协助优惠。此折扣仅适用于 TurboTax 联邦产品（意味着不包括州产品）。这些节省是在早季折扣之外的。

paras.en: As mentioned above, users can file for free with TurboTax Free Edition. Around 37% of taxpayers qualify. This service is for simple Form 1040 returns only (no schedules except for the Earned Income Tax Credit, Child Tax Credit, Student Loan Interest, and Schedule 1-A). While this may not be the right fit for every type of tax filer, it works for those with simple finances. Do a little research to see if TurboTax Free Edition may be right for you to save big instead of spending big. TurboTax Free Edition includes $0 to file for Federal taxes and $0 for State taxes. This service is ideal for simple uploads, like W-2s, where all you’ll need to do is import, upload, or snap a photo of your W–2 and TurboTax will autofill your info for you, saving you time and potential headaches.
paras.zh: 如上所述，用户可以使用 TurboTax 免费版免费报税。大约 37% 的纳税人符合资格。该服务仅适用于简单的 1040 表格申报（除了劳动所得税抵免、儿童税收抵免、学生贷款利息和附表 1-A 之外，没有附表）。虽然这可能并不适合所有类型的纳税人，但它适用于财务状况简单的人。做一些研究，看看 TurboTax 免费版是否适合您节省大笔钱而不是花大钱。 TurboTax Free 版包括 0 美元的联邦税和 0 美元的州税。该服务非常适合简单上传，例如 W-2，您只需导入、上传或拍摄 W-2 的照片，TurboTax 就会自动填充您的信息，从而节省您的时间和潜在的麻烦。

paras.en: There are other ways to save, too, with TurboTax discount codes for military members. As a thank-you, military members can file their own taxes and get both their federal and state returns done for free (returns only, no schedules, except for EITC, CTC, student loan interest, and Schedule 1-A).
paras.zh: 还有其他方式可以节省开支，例如使用针对军人的 TurboTax 折扣代码。作为答谢，军人可以自行报税并免费获得联邦和州申报表（只有申报表，没有时间表，除了 EITC、CTC、学生贷款利息和附表 1-A）。

paras.en: If you have complicated taxes or just want that extra peace of mind this year, I’d recommend working with a local TurboTax expert to file your taxes. With this service, you’ll be matched with a tax expert tailored to your unique tax situation, starting at $129. It also includes W-2 and 1040 forms (state filing is an additional cost). Plus, you can connect online from the comfort of your home, or at a TurboTax store or Expert office near you.
paras.zh: 如果您有复杂的税务问题，或者只是想今年更加安心，我建议您与当地的 TurboTax 专家合作报税。通过这项服务，我们将为您匹配一位根据您独特的税务情况量身定制的税务专家，起价为 129 美元。它还包括 W-2 和 1040 表格（州备案需额外付费）。此外，您可以在舒适的家中或在您附近的 TurboTax 商店或 Expert 办公室进行在线连接。

paras.en: Other Free TurboTax Tools for Tax Season
paras.zh: 报税季节的其他免费 TurboTax 工具

paras.en: In addition to plans tailored to individuals’ needs, TurboTax offers other helpful resources for this tax season, including a Tax Refund Calculator that lets you estimate your 2026 return by answering questions about your life and income. TurboTax also offers a Tax Bracket Calculator to help you estimate your 2025 taxable income. All you need to do is enter your tax year, filing status, and taxable income to calculate your estimated tax rate.
paras.zh: 除了根据个人需求量身定制的计划外，TurboTax 还为本纳税季提供其他有用的资源，包括退税计算器，可让您通过回答有关您的生活和收入的问题来估算 2026 年的回报。 TurboTax 还提供税级计算器，帮助您估算 2025 年应税收入。您所需要做的就是输入您的纳税年度、报税身份和应税收入来计算您的估计税率。

paras.en: With TurboTax, you start for free and pay only when you file—plus you get 100% accurate calculations, guaranteed. That’s not all. TurboTax also offers a “Maximum Refund Guarantee,” meaning that if you get a larger refund or less tax due from another tax preparation method, they’ll refund the applicable TurboTax federal and/or state purchase price paid. You can also get quick answers to any tax questions from AI-Powered Intuit Assist. For the lazy filers among us (myself included), you can upload or snap a photo of your W-2, and the info will be autofilled for you.
paras.zh: 使用 TurboTax，您可以免费开始，仅在提交时付费 - 而且您可以保证获得 100% 准确的计算。这还不是全部。 TurboTax 还提供“最高退款保证”，这意味着如果您通过其他报税方法获得更大的退款或更少的税款，他们将退还适用的 TurboTax 联邦和/或州购买价格。您还可以通过人工智能驱动的 Intuit Assist 快速获得任何税务问题的答案。对于我们这些懒惰的申报者（包括我自己），您可以上传或拍摄 W-2 的照片，系统会自动为您填充信息。

paras.en: TurboTax service codes are unique codes, usually issued by customer support for specific situations. You’ll need to enter the code in the "I have a service code" field before payment. These single-use codes are for any technical or billing issues you may encounter during the tax filing process.
paras.zh: TurboTax 服务代码是唯一的代码，通常由客户支持针对特定情况发布。付款前，您需要在“我有服务代码”字段中输入代码。这些一次性代码适用于您在报税过程中可能遇到的任何技术或计费问题。

paras.en: Even if you don’t have a service code, don’t fret—there are still many ways to get TurboTax coupons, including a 10% discount when you file before Tax Day (April 15). Plus, you can get 20% off with TurboTax referral codes if you use a friend’s invite link. If you send your link to a friend and they purchase an online TurboTax product, you’ll receive e-gift cards of up to $500 as a reward from TurboTax. Save on federal and business tax filings by following here for limited-time offers throughout the 2026 tax season.
paras.zh: 即使您没有服务代码，也不必担心，仍然有很多方法可以获得 TurboTax 优惠券，包括在纳税日（4 月 15 日）之前报税可享受 10% 的折扣。此外，如果您使用朋友的邀请链接，您还可以通过 TurboTax 推荐代码享受 20% 的折扣。如果您将链接发送给朋友，并且他们购买了在线 TurboTax 产品，您将收到高达 500 美元的电子礼品卡，作为 TurboTax 的奖励。关注此处，了解 2026 年报税季的限时优惠，节省联邦税和营业税申报费用。

paras.en: If you have a complicated tax situation or just want that extra peace of mind this year, I’d recommend working with a local TurboTax expert to file your taxes. With this service, you’ll be matched with a tax expert tailored to your unique tax situation, starting at $129. It also includes W-2 and 1040 forms (state filing is an additional cost). Plus, you can connect online from the comfort of your home or at a TurboTax store or Expert office near you.
paras.zh: 如果您的税务情况很复杂，或者只是想今年更加安心，我建议您与当地的 TurboTax 专家合作报税。通过这项服务，我们将为您匹配一位根据您独特的税务情况量身定制的税务专家，起价为 129 美元。它还包括 W-2 和 1040 表格（州备案需额外付费）。此外，您可以在舒适的家中或在您附近的 TurboTax 商店或 Expert 办公室进行在线连接。

articles.title: Fuel distributors urged to await guidance on Trump's diesel order

paras.en: Oct. 8 (UPI) -- Fuel distributors, wholesalers and retailers are being warned against changing their business practices in response to President Donald Trump's executive order that seeks to ease restrictions on the sale of red-dyed diesel and urged to wait for further guidance.
paras.zh: 10 月 8 日 (UPI)——燃料分销商、批发商和零售商被警告不要改变其商业行为，以响应唐纳德·特朗普总统的行政命令，该命令旨在放宽对红色柴油销售的限制，并敦促他们等待进一步的指导。

paras.en: Trump on Monday directed government agencies to determine whether they can defer taxes and provide penalty for the sale and use of red-dyed diesel in highway vehicles. The fuel is exempt from federal highway fuel taxes and is generally restricted to off-road uses, such as in farming equipment and for heating.
paras.zh: 特朗普周一指示政府机构确定是否可以推迟纳税并对公路车辆销售和使用红色柴油进行处罚。该燃料免征联邦公路燃油税，并且通常仅限于越野用途，例如农业设备和供暖。

paras.en: Under the order, the Treasury is directed to determine whether it can defer -- not remove -- the federal excise tax and explore ways to eliminate the obligation to pay the tax when due on qualifying transactions from Monday when it was issued through Dec. 31.
paras.zh: 根据该命令，财政部将确定是否可以推迟（而不是取消）联邦消费税，并探索如何消除从周一发布到 12 月 31 日期间符合条件的交易到期缴税的义务。

paras.en: The order is intended to lower diesel costs amid reduced global supplies. However, questions remain because it does not itself authorize the use of red-dyed diesel in highway vehicles, eliminate the federal excise tax or override state laws and Environmental Protection Agency regulations.
paras.zh: 该命令旨在在全球供应减少的情况下降低柴油成本。然而，问题仍然存在，因为它本身并不授权在公路车辆中使用红色柴油，取消联邦消费税或凌驾于州法律和环境保护局法规之上。

paras.en: Concerns also persist over potential penalties for truckers and others who use the red-dyed diesel, because dye residue could remain in tanks and fuel filters for months, even after the temporary penalty relief expires at the end of the year.
paras.zh: 人们还担心卡车司机和其他使用红色柴油的人可能受到处罚，因为即使在年底临时处罚减免到期后，染料残留物也可能在油箱和燃油过滤器中残留数月之久。

paras.en: In a Tuesday note to members, the Energy Marketers of America, a federation of 48 state and regional trade associations representing family-owned and -operated small business energy marketers, is urging them to wait for federal and state guidance before changing their dyed-diesel sales, tax collection, record-keeping or compliance practices.
paras.zh: 美国能源营销者协会是一个由 48 个州和地区贸易协会组成的联盟，代表家族拥有和经营的小企业能源营销者，在周二给会员的一份说明中，敦促他们在改变染色柴油销售、税收、记录保存或合规做法之前等待联邦和州的指导。

paras.en: "Importantly, the Executive Order does not itself authorize highway sales or on-highway use of dyed diesel fuel. Whether relief is available, whom it covers and on what conditions depend on Treasury determinations and guidance not yet issued. State actions also may be necessary," it said in the note that was sent to UPI.
paras.zh: “重要的是，行政命令本身并不授权高速公路销售或在高速公路上使用染色柴油。是否可以提供救济、救济对象以及救济条件取决于财政部的决定和尚未发布的指导。国家行动也可能是必要的，”它在发给 UPI 的说明中表示。

paras.en: "EMA members, therefore, should proceed with caution."
paras.zh: “因此，EMA 成员应谨慎行事。”

paras.en: The Treasury has until Saturday under the order to determine whether it can legally defer the federal diesel taxes on red-dyed diesel used in highway vehicles and to direct the Internal Revenue Service to announce relief from certain penalties associated with its sale and use.
paras.zh: 根据该命令，财政部必须在周六之前确定是否可以合法地推迟对公路车辆使用的红染柴油征收联邦柴油税，并指示国税局宣布免除与其销售和使用相关的某些处罚。

paras.en: EMA said that, pending guidance on covered taxpayers and payment dates, "marketers should consider documenting any such sales and customer use."
paras.zh: EMA 表示，在等待有关纳税人和付款日期的指导之前，“营销人员应考虑记录任何此类销售和客户使用情况。”

paras.en: It said that fuel distributors could ultimately be liable for the 24.4-cent-per-gallon federal excise tax when the deferral expires, as the executive order does not eliminate it outright.
paras.zh: 该公司表示，延期到期后，燃料分销商最终可能需要缴纳每加仑 24.4 美分的联邦消费税，因为行政命令并未完全取消该税。

paras.en: Ten states have also issued emergency relief measures of their own. but the orders vary, resulting in different rules for fuel distributors and drivers depending on the state.
paras.zh: 十个州也发布了各自的紧急救援措施。但命令有所不同，导致不同州对燃油经销商和司机的规则不同。

paras.en: EMA also warned that, given existing supply constraints, added demand during the harvest season and the start of the heating season could strain dyed diesel and heating fuel supplies.
paras.zh: EMA还警告说，鉴于现有的供应限制，收获季节和取暖季节开始期间的需求增加可能会使染色柴油和取暖燃料供应紧张。

articles.title: U.S. issues fresh round of Iran sanctions amid war stalemate

paras.en: Oct. 9 (UPI) -- The United States announced a fresh round of sanctions targeting Iran's shadow fleet of vessels transporting Iranian petroleum and petrochemical products and buyers of those products on Thursday, as the Trump administration tightens its financial vise as it seeks an end to the war.
paras.zh: 10 月 9 日（UPI）——周四，美国宣布对伊朗运输伊朗石油和石化产品的影子船队以及这些产品的买家实施新一轮制裁，特朗普政府在寻求结束战争的同时收紧了金融钳制。

paras.en: The State Department said it sanctioned 10 entities, six individuals and five vessels on Thursday as the Treasury blacklisted 17 vessels, targeting networks involved in transporting and trading petroleum and petrochemical products, proceeds from which the Trump administration says its malign activities.
paras.zh: 美国国务院表示，周四对 10 个实体、6 名个人和 5 艘船只实施了制裁，财政部将 17 艘船只列入黑名单，针对涉及石油和石化产品运输和交易的网络，特朗普政府称其从事恶意活动。

paras.en: "These entities have channeled millions of dollars to the Iranian regime, bolstering one of its most critical revenue streams and enabling its continued illicit conduct," the State Department said in a statement.
paras.zh: 美国国务院在一份声明中表示：“这些实体向伊朗政权输送了数百万美元，增强了其最重要的收入来源之一，并使其继续进行非法行为。”

paras.en: The sanctions are part of President Donald Trump's Operation Economic Outcast, which was launched by the Treasury on Aug. 24, with the goal of cutting Iran off from foreign sources of funds.
paras.zh: 这些制裁是唐纳德·特朗普总统经济放逐行动的一部分，该行动由财政部于8月24日发起，旨在切断伊朗的外国资金来源。

paras.en: Iran's aviation industry, Russian banks linked to Iranian financial institutions and Iran's shadow fleet are among the industries and networks targeted by sanctions under Operation Economic Outcast, which, along with the U.S. military blockade of shipments to and from Iranian ports, has reduced external revenue sources for Tehran, the Treasury said.
paras.zh: 美国财政部表示，伊朗航空业、与伊朗金融机构有联系的俄罗斯银行以及伊朗影子舰队都是“经济流亡者行动”制裁的目标行业和网络，加上美国对进出伊朗港口的军事封锁，减少了德黑兰的外部收入来源。

paras.en: "Treasury is starving the tyrannical regime in Tehran of the money it uses to wage war in the region, and we will continue exposing those who enable the regime's oil sales," Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said in a statement.
paras.zh: 美国财政部长斯科特·贝森特（Scott Bessent）在一份声明中表示：“财政部正在让德黑兰的暴政政权缺乏用于在该地区发动战争的资金，我们将继续揭露那些帮助该政权销售石油的人。”

paras.en: "No enabler of Iranian sanctions evasion is safe from the full force of Treasury's authorities."
paras.zh: “伊朗逃避制裁的任何推动者都无法免受财政部当局的全力打击。”

paras.en: Trump has long turned to sanctions in his effort to coerce Iran to the negotiating table on a new agreement aimed at preventing it from acquiring a nuclear weapon. Since the United States and Israel attacked Iran on Feb. 28, launching the ongoing war, Iran has restricted access to the Strait of Hormuz, and Trump has sought to squeeze Iran with sanctions and the blockade to force it into talks in an effort to restore freedom of navigation through the vital energy transport route.
paras.zh: 特朗普长期以来一直诉诸制裁，试图迫使伊朗坐上谈判桌，达成一项旨在阻止其获得核武器的新协议。自2月28日美国和以色列袭击伊朗并发动持续战争以来，伊朗已限制进入霍尔木兹海峡，特朗普一直试图通过制裁和封锁来挤压伊朗，迫使其进行谈判，以恢复这条重要能源运输路线的航行自由。

paras.en: Although direct military exchanges between Washington and Tehran have subsided in recent weeks, the war continues. Trump on Thursday said he would not attack Iran before the Nov. 3 midterm elections.
paras.zh: 尽管华盛顿和德黑兰之间的直接军事交流最近几周有所减弱，但战争仍在继续。特朗普周四表示，他不会在 11 月 3 日中期选举之前攻击伊朗。

paras.en: He also said on social media that his administration is having "productive discussions" with Iran.
paras.zh: 他还在社交媒体上表示，他的政府正在与伊朗进行“富有成效的讨论”。

articles.title: DOJ sues Denver over law enforcement mask ban

paras.en: Oct. 9 (UPI) -- Federal lawyers have filed a civil lawsuit against the city and county of Denver alleging a law prohibiting federal law enforcement officers from wearing masks is unconstitutional.
paras.zh: 10 月 9 日（UPI）——联邦律师对丹佛市和县提起民事诉讼，指控禁止联邦执法人员戴口罩的法律违宪。

paras.en: Denver elected officials began developing the federal law enforcement mask ban in the summer of 2025 in response to Immigration and Customs Enforcement and Customs and Border Protection operations conducted in cities across the country as part of Trump's aggressive immigration enforcement campaign to detain and deport immigrants.
paras.zh: 丹佛民选官员于 2025 年夏天开始制定联邦执法口罩禁令，以回应移民和海关执法局以及海关和边境保护局在全国各城市开展的行动，这是特朗普拘留和驱逐移民的激进移民执法行动的一部分。

paras.en: The legislation, signed into law in March, prohibits law enforcement officers, including federal officers, from covering their faces during law enforcement actions. It also dictates that their names, badge numbers or other identification be visible or provided upon request, and prohibits officers from concealing their identities with facial coverings inside city facilities. Violations are punishable with a fine up to $999 and up to 300 days in jail.
paras.zh: 该法案于三月签署成为法律，禁止执法人员，包括联邦官员，在执法行动中遮盖脸部。它还规定他们的姓名、徽章号码或其他身份证明必须可见或应要求提供，并禁止官员在城市设施内用面部遮盖物隐藏自己的身份。违规者将被处以最高 999 美元的罚款和最高 300 天的监禁。

paras.en: The Justice Department filed its lawsuit challenging the law Thursday, alleging it violates the Supremacy Clause of the U.S. Constitution because of the the local government's attempt to regulate the federal government.
paras.zh: 美国司法部周四提起诉讼，对该法律提出质疑，称该法律违反了美国宪法的至高无上条款，因为当地政府试图监管联邦政府。

paras.en: The federal lawyers further alleged that the law also threatens the safety of federal law enforcement officers.
paras.zh: 联邦律师进一步声称，该法律还威胁到联邦执法人员的安全。

paras.en: "Even beyond the sovereign injury, compliance with the ordinance would endanger officers and reduce operational effectiveness by, among other things, subjecting them to doxxing, harassment and threats to their physical safety," the lawsuit states.
paras.zh: 诉讼称：“即使除了主权伤害之外，遵守该条例也会使官员面临人肉搜索、骚扰和人身安全威胁等，从而危及他们的安全并降低行动效率。”

paras.en: "Federal law enforcement officers and agents cannot and will not comply with the ordinance, which is unconstitutional and recklessly disregards officer safety, public safety and federal operational needs."
paras.zh: “联邦执法人员和特工不能也不会遵守该法令，该法令违宪，并且肆意无视官员安全、公共安全和联邦运作需求。”

paras.en: A spokesman for Denver Mayor Mike Johnston told The Denver Post that they will fight the lawsuit.
paras.zh: 丹佛市市长迈克·约翰斯顿的发言人告诉《丹佛邮报》，他们将抗击这起诉讼。

paras.en: "Denverites deserve to know who is arresting them and what they're being arrested for," the spokesman, Jon Ewing, said.
paras.zh: 发言人乔恩·尤因 (Jon Ewing) 说：“丹佛人应该知道是谁逮捕了他们以及他们因何而被捕。”

paras.en: "Banning facial coverings for law enforcement is commonsense and Constitutional, and we look forward to defending our position and the rights or our residents in court."
paras.zh: “禁止执法时佩戴面部遮盖物是常识，也是符合宪法的，我们期待在法庭上捍卫我们的立场和权利或我们居民的权利。”

paras.en: The lawsuit comes a week after the Justice Department filed similar litigation against a law prohibiting law enforcement from wearing masks in Maryland.
paras.zh: 该诉讼发生一周前，司法部针对马里兰州禁止执法人员戴口罩的法律提起了类似诉讼。

paras.en: Under Attorney General Todd Blanche's direction, the Justice Department has filed lawsuits against nine different jurisdictions.
paras.zh: 在总检察长托德·布兰奇的指导下，司法部已针对九个不同的司法管辖区提起诉讼。

articles.title: Troye Sivan, Remi Wolf, Slayyyter & Pitbull: New Music Friday Guide
articles.author: Lyndsey Havens

paras.en: Billboard’s Friday Music Guide serves as a handy guide to New Music Friday’s most essential releases each week — the key music that everyone will be talking about today, and that will be dominating playlists this weekend and beyond.
paras.zh: Billboard 的周五音乐指南是每周周五新音乐最重要版本的便捷指南 - 今天每个人都会谈论的关键音乐，并且将在本周末及以后的播放列表中占据主导地位。

paras.en: Last week, we featured Noah Kahan, Victoria Monét, Drake and Miranda Lambert.
paras.zh: 上周，我们邀请了诺亚·卡汉、维多利亚·莫奈、德雷克和米兰达·兰伯特。

paras.en: This week, Troye Sivan’s anticipated fourth album is out; Slayyyyter drops another preview of her upcoming companion LP, and Remi Wolf’s Mud arrives … plus much more. Check out all of this week’s picks below:
paras.zh: 本周，Troye Sivan 备受期待的第四张专辑即将发行； Slayyyyter 发布了她即将推出的同伴 LP 的另一张预览，Remi Wolf 的 Mud 也到了……还有更多。查看以下本周所有精选内容：
