paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Already certain aspects of this new era are becoming clear. Many of the results, experts say, are far better written than the Navier-Stokes proof, suggesting that OpenAI’s math team is working to overcome its model’s inability to explain its math clearly to humans. Hector Pasten, a mathematician at the Pontifical Catholic University of Chile, says the papers he’s looked at improve on the company’s notorious lack of citations. “I think they are doing a better job of giving credit,” he says.
paras.zh: 这个新时代的某些方面已经变得清晰起来。专家表示，许多结果比纳维-斯托克斯证明要好得多，这表明 OpenAI 的数学团队正在努力克服其模型无法向人类清楚解释数学的问题。智利天主教大学数学家赫克托·帕斯滕 (Hector Pasten) 表示，他所研究的论文改善了该公司臭名昭著的缺乏引用的问题。 “我认为他们在给予信任方面做得更好，”他说。

paras.en: But the quality remains extremely uneven—mathematicians are finding some papers readable and others utterly nonsensical. “Others are much, much harder to make sense of—they’re sort of this AI slop,” says Roland Bauerschmidt, a mathematician at New York University. “If I had received these by e-mail from a nobody, I probably would have deleted it, it’s so badly written.”
paras.zh: 但质量仍然极其参差不齐——数学家发现一些论文可读，而另一些则完全毫无意义。纽约大学数学家罗兰·鲍尔施密特 (Roland Bauerschmidt) 表示：“其他的则很难理解——它们有点像人工智能的废话。” “如果我通过电子邮件收到这些，我可能会删除它，它写得太糟糕了。”

paras.en: Even much of that seeming nonsense, though, is ostensibly correct. At this point, 42 percent of the results are coded in the programming language Lean, which means their logic is almost certainly sound, even if their English-language write-up is too hard to follow.
paras.zh: 不过，即使很多看似无稽之谈，表面上也是正确的。此时，42% 的结果是用 Lean 编程语言编码的，这意味着它们的逻辑几乎肯定是正确的，即使它们的英文书写太难以理解。

paras.en: On the other hand, three of the papers have already been withdrawn after experts uncovered a significant error, causing some to question the more than half of the proofs that aren’t yet Lean-verified. “While I expect most of these will ultimately be found to be correct, or at least correctable, we should expect some of the proofs to contain mistakes, possibly serious ones,” says Andrew Sutherland, a mathematician at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.
paras.zh: 另一方面，在专家发现一个重大错误后，其中三篇论文已经被撤回，导致一些人对一半以上尚未经过精益验证的证明提出质疑。麻省理工学院数学家安德鲁·萨瑟兰（Andrew Sutherland）表示：“虽然我预计其中大部分最终都会被证明是正确的，或者至少是可以纠正的，但我们应该预料到一些证明会包含错误，甚至可能是严重的错误。”

paras.en: The community’s reaction to the way OpenAI chose to drop the results has been mixed, to say the least. Sutherland argues that OpenAI should also release the problems its model failed to solve, which the company has said number in the thousands. “I expect they will not want to do that,” he adds, “but that is how open science works. You need to report your negative results along with your positive results.”
paras.zh: 至少可以说，社区对 OpenAI 选择放弃结果的方式反应不一。 Sutherland 认为 OpenAI 还应该公布其模型未能解决的问题，该公司称此类问题有数千个。 “我预计他们不会愿意这样做，”他补充道，“但这就是开放科学的运作方式。你需要在报告积极结果的同时报告你的消极结果。”

paras.en: The lack of transparency goes further. A number of mathematicians have told Scientific American that they doubt anyone on OpenAI’s team would have thought to ask some of the questions the model answered, either because they’re extremely niche or because they contradict a belief most experts previously held. Several independently suggested that it seems the model itself is coming up with problems to solve, perhaps in an extended conversation between a swarm of agents. This idea seems corroborated by the fact that a number of papers contain strikingly similar ideas and methods—as if their authors were communicating. OpenAI didn’t reply to a request for comment on this question.
paras.zh: 缺乏透明度的情况更进一步。许多数学家告诉《科学美国人》，他们怀疑 OpenAI 团队中的任何人都会考虑提出该模型所回答的一些问题，要么是因为这些问题非常小众，要么是因为它们与大多数专家之前持有的信念相矛盾。一些人独立地表示，模型本身似乎正在提出需要解决的问题，也许是在一群智能体之间的长时间对话中。许多论文包含惊人相似的想法和方法，这一事实似乎证实了这一观点——就好像它们的作者在交流一样。 OpenAI 没有回复对此问题的置评请求。

paras.en: Others in the community have been more outspoken in their criticism. A statement from the Association for Human Mathematics decries the company’s actions. “Releasing over 700 files at once is not a demonstration of scholarship, but a demonstration of power,” it reads. “We urge mathematicians to discontinue their work with OpenAI and to return to a vision of science that centers human understanding.”
paras.zh: 社区中的其他人则更加直言不讳地提出批评。人类数学协会的一份声明谴责了该公司的行为。 “一次性公布700多个文件不是学术的展示，而是权力的展示，”它写道。 “我们敦促数学家停止与 OpenAI 的合作，回归以人类理解为中心的科学愿景。”

articles.title: The most exciting claims from OpenAI’s heap of new proofs

paras.en: On Tuesday afternoon OpenAI dropped more than 700 manuscripts reporting proofs, solutions and progress on 372 open problems across theoretical research.
paras.zh: 周二下午，OpenAI 发布了 700 多份手稿，报告了理论研究中 372 个开放问题的证明、解决方案和进展。

paras.en: It will take time for mathematicians to trudge through all the artificial-intelligence-generated results. No one, not even OpenAI researchers themselves, has been able to even read through everything yet. And not all of the proofs were certified as correct by the automatic logic verification platform Lean—in fact, some have already been retracted after outside scientists found mistakes. OpenAI also did not include full prompts or run-time details for how their agents uncovered the proofs, and officials admitted in a blog post about the results that citations and written descriptions of findings could be improved in future releases.
paras.zh: 数学家需要时间来研究所有人工智能生成的结果。目前还没有人能够读懂所有内容，甚至包括 OpenAI 研究人员本身。并不是所有的证明都被自动逻辑验证平台 Lean 证明是正确的——事实上，有些证据在外部科学家发现错误后已经被撤回。 OpenAI 也没有提供有关其代理如何发现证据的完整提示或运行时详细信息，官员们在一篇有关结果的博客文章中承认，在未来的版本中可以改进对结果的引用和书面描述。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: Despite these issues, experts say the results are jaw-dropping. The papers span mathematics, theoretical computer science, physics, and more. Some of the discoveries could have easily netted a human author a top research award just a year ago
paras.zh: 尽管存在这些问题，专家表示结果还是令人瞠目结舌。这些论文涵盖数学、理论计算机科学、物理学等。就在一年前，其中一些发现可以轻松地为人类作者赢得最高研究奖

paras.en: Here are just some of the most important problems OpenAI claims to have solved, according to the experts.
paras.zh: 专家们表示，以下只是 OpenAI 声称已经解决的一些最重要的问题。

paras.en: The Riemann hypothesis is the scariest open problem in math—experts told Scientific American earlier this year that they barely think about it because they have no idea how to even start tackling it. That might have just changed.
paras.zh: 黎曼猜想是数学中最可怕的开放性问题——专家们今年早些时候告诉《科学美国人》，他们几乎没有考虑过这个问题，因为他们甚至不知道如何开始解决它。这可能刚刚改变。

paras.en: The hypothesis centers on a special, complicated equation called the Riemann zeta function—specifically, which numbers you can put into this function to make it come out to zero. If you could magically know all of these special inputs, you would essentially know all of the prime numbers—mathematicians’ favorite objects and the building blocks of the entire number line.
paras.zh: 该假设以一个称为黎曼 zeta 函数的特殊复杂方程为中心，具体来说，您可以将哪些数字放入该函数中以使其结果为零。如果你能神奇地知道所有这些特殊输入，你基本上就会知道所有素数——数学家最喜欢的物体和整个数轴的构建块。

paras.en: OpenAI’s drop contains two major results about these “zeros.” One proves the “quasi-Riemann hypothesis,” which is a huge step toward the holy grail of proving the full thing. “Plenty of applications of the Riemann hypothesis did not need the full Riemann hypothesis,” says Hector Pasten, a mathematician at the Pontifical Catholic University of Chile. “The quasi-Riemann hypothesis is way more than enough for many applications.” For instance, mathematicians now have a better estimate of where the primes sit as you go up the number line than they ever had before.
paras.zh: OpenAI 的下降包含有关这些“零”的两个主要结果。有人证明了“准黎曼假设”，这是朝着证明全部事实的圣杯迈出的一大步。 “黎曼假设的大量应用并不需要完整的黎曼假设，”智利天主教大学数学家赫克托·帕斯滕 (Hector Pasten) 说。 “拟黎曼假设对于许多应用来说已经足够了。”例如，数学家现在可以比以前更好地估计沿着数轴上升时素数的位置。

paras.en: As to whether this proof is a path toward solving the full hypothesis, it’s too early to say. “Some people claim it is progress toward Riemann; other people say it’s not,” Pasten says. “Usually the word progress makes sense after the fact, when you see how it eventually gets solved.”
paras.zh: 至于这个证明是否是解决整个假设的一条途径，现在说还为时过早。 “有些人声称这是向黎曼迈进；其他人则说不是，”帕斯滕说。 “通常，当你看到问题最终如何得到解决时，“进步”这个词才有意义。”

paras.en: The second result shows that neither the zeta function nor many of its generalizations, called “Dirichlet L-functions,” have a “Siegel zero,” a certain, especially problematic type of zero that would contradict the hypothesis. “This is not just progress on Siegel zeros—it settles the question,” Pasten says. “This is amazing.”
paras.zh: 第二个结果表明，zeta 函数及其许多推广（称为“狄利克雷 L 函数”）都没有“西格尔零”，这是一种与假设相矛盾的特定的、特别有问题的零类型。 “这不仅仅是西格尔零点的进展——它解决了问题，”帕斯滕说。 “这太棒了。”

paras.en: Hilbert’s 10th problem is about which mathematical truths are and are not knowable. It asks whether it’s possible to build an algorithm that sorts all simple algebra problems into two piles. One pile holds equations that have whole-number solutions, such as y2 = 2x (where x = 2 and y = 2 is a solution). The other pile consists of equations without a solution in which the variables are whole numbers, such as y2 + x2 = –1.
paras.zh: 希尔伯特的第十个问题是关于哪些数学真理是可知的，哪些是不可知的。它询问是否可以构建一种算法，将所有简单的代数问题分为两堆。一堆包含具有整数解的方程，例如 y2 = 2x（其中 x = 2 和 y = 2 是一个解）。另一堆由没有解的方程组成，其中变量是整数，例如 y2 + x2 = –1。

paras.en: In 1970 mathematician Yuri Matiyasevich showed that such an algorithm is impossible. No computer can tell you whether or not any equation has a solution with whole numbers. But since then mathematicians have been struggling to extend this result, asking if a computer can sort equations when you allow their variables to have a wider range of values, such as fractions, square roots or imaginary numbers. OpenAI’s model proved that even when the variables are allowed to be any rational number—a whole number or a fraction—the mathematical world remains unsortable.
paras.zh: 1970 年，数学家 Yuri Matiyasevich 证明这样的算法是不可能的。没有计算机可以告诉你任何方程是否有整数解。但从那时起，数学家们一直在努力扩展这个结果，询问当你允许方程的变量具有更广泛的值（例如分数、平方根或虚数）时，计算机是否可以对方程进行排序。 OpenAI 的模型证明，即使变量可以是任何有理数（整数或分数），数学世界仍然是不可排序的。

paras.en: The new proof uses two of Pasten’s ideas from seemingly different areas of mathematics—even he hadn’t realized they could be put together in this way. “It’s extremely surprising to me that they connect,” Pasten says. “Their general strategy is original.”
paras.zh: 新的证明使用了帕斯滕的两个看似不同的数学领域的想法——即使他也没有意识到它们可以以这种方式组合在一起。 “他们之间的联系让我感到非常惊讶，”帕斯滕说。 “他们的总体策略是原创的。”

paras.en: The Kakeya conjecture can be thought of as sliding and twirling a piece of chalk around on a tablet so that it points in every direction but covers as small an area with chalk as possible. Mathematician Hong Wang won a Fields medal this summer for solving the three-dimensional version of this problem with mathematician Joshua Zahl. In that version, you twirl the stick around in midair—showing the minimum possible 3D space the twirl can occupy. Now OpenAI’s model has solved the problem for four dimensions.
paras.zh: 挂谷猜想可以被认为是在平板电脑上滑动和旋转一块粉笔，使其指向各个方向，但用粉笔覆盖尽可能小的区域。今年夏天，数学家王宏因与数学家约书亚·扎尔 (Joshua Zahl) 一起解决了该问题的三维版本而获得了菲尔兹奖。在该版本中，您在半空中旋转棍子 - 显示旋转可以占据的最小可能的 3D 空间。现在OpenAI的模型已经从四个维度解决了这个问题。

paras.en: Other important number theory results include Artin’s conjecture on primitive roots, which is about special number systems that stop at a certain, highest number, as well as a proof of perhaps the most famous conjecture of storied problem-poser Paul Erdős and progress that is relevant to the Langlands program, a sweeping set of conjectures sometimes called “a Grand Unified Theory of Mathematics.”
paras.zh: 其他重要的数论成果包括阿廷关于原根的猜想，该猜想涉及到停止于某个最高数字的特殊数系，以及对著名问题提出者保罗·埃尔多斯（Paul Erdős）最著名的猜想的证明，以及与朗兰兹纲领相关的进展，朗兰兹纲领是一组广泛的猜想，有时被称为“数学大统一理论”。

paras.en: On its face, the “nonlinear sigma model” doesn’t sound like it has anything to do with particle physics. At every point on a grid, you place an arrow in a different direction to represent interacting, spinning atoms. The goal is to show that rotations of the arrows in one place cannot be detected far away. But that aim bears a striking, hidden resemblance to “the Yang-Mills existence and mass gap problem,” one of the five remaining Millennium Prize Problems, which aims to underpin the “Standard Model” of particle physics with rigorous mathematics. “This goes back 50 years, much like Yang-Mills, and is widely considered the ‘warm-up’ for Yang-Mills,” says Michael Douglas, a mathematical physicist at Harvard University.
paras.zh: 从表面上看，“非线性西格玛模型”听起来与粒子物理学没有任何关系。在网格上的每个点上，您都可以在不同方向上放置一个箭头来表示相互作用、旋转的原子。目标是证明箭头在一个地方的旋转无法在很远的地方被检测到。但这一目标与“杨-米尔斯存在性和质量间隙问题”有着惊人的、隐藏的相似之处，这是剩下的五个千年奖问题之一，旨在用严格的数学来支撑粒子物理学的“标准模型”。哈佛大学数学物理学家迈克尔·道格拉斯 (Michael Douglas) 表示：“这可以追溯到 50 年前，就像杨米尔斯一样，并且被广泛认为是杨米尔斯的‘热身’。”

paras.en: OpenAI’s repository contains several papers claiming to completely resolve the equivalent of the Yang-Mills problem for this simpler model. New York University mathematician Roland Bauerschmidt says the first of these papers is both groundbreaking and comprehensible. “I haven’t digested it or understood all the details, but it seems very reasonable,” he says. The rest of the papers related to this problem are incomprehensible slop, he says, too hard for even a human expert to verify. “The second paper is horrible,” Bauerschmidt says. “If these results had been sent to me by a nobody, I would have deleted the e-mail.”
paras.zh: OpenAI 的存储库包含几篇论文，声称完全解决了这个更简单模型的 Yang-Mills 问题的等效问题。纽约大学数学家罗兰·鲍尔施密特表示，第一篇论文既具有开创性又易于理解。 “我还没有消化它或理解所有细节，但它看起来非常合理，”他说。他说，与这个问题相关的其余论文都是难以理解的废话，即使是人类专家也很难验证。 “第二篇论文太糟糕了，”鲍尔施密特说。 “如果这些结果是由任何人发送给我的，我就会删除该电子邮件。”

paras.en: Physicists know a strange state of matter called the “Bose-Einstein condensate” is possible because researchers have made it in a lab—winning them the 2001 Nobel Prize in Physics. This material is where all the atoms in a gas occupy the exact same quantum state, producing weird quantum effects at unusually macroscopic scales. Albert Einstein originally predicted its existence in work that built upon a 1924 paper by physicist Satyendra Nath Bose, but he only proved that the state is mathematically possible for an unrealistic gas where no two atoms interact. OpenAI’s model extended the prediction to a case with interactions. It used similar techniques to prove a major conjecture about the math of ferromagnetism—one that the famous mathematical physicist Freeman Dyson erroneously claimed with two collaborators in 1976.
paras.zh: 物理学家知道一种被称为“玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚”的奇怪物质状态是可能存在的，因为研究人员已经在实验室中实现了这种状态，并为他们赢得了 2001 年诺贝尔物理学奖。在这种材料中，气体中的所有原子都占据完全相同的量子态，在异常宏观尺度上产生奇怪的量子效应。阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦最初在物理学家 Satyendra Nath Bose 1924 年发表的论文基础上预测了这种状态的存在，但他只是证明了对于没有两个原子相互作用的不切实际的气体来说，这种状态在数学上是可能的。 OpenAI 的模型将预测扩展到具有交互的案例。它使用类似的技术来证明一个关于铁磁性数学的重大猜想——著名数学物理学家弗里曼·戴森 (Freeman Dyson) 与两名合作者在 1976 年错误地提出了这个猜想。

paras.en: Anyone who's taken a linear algebra course can attest that matrices—ensembles of numbers in a two-dimensional array—underpin many different fields of computer science. Manipulating and performing operations on them quickly is important for computer graphics, complex simulations and machine learning itself. “Matrix multiplication is needed all over the place," says Virginia Vassilevska Williams, a computer science professor at MIT who researches the problem. "But also, its complexity is one of the great mysteries in computer science." Multiplying two matrices together requires a tedious amount of arithmetic.
paras.zh: 任何学习过线性代数课程的人都可以证明矩阵（二维数组中的数字集合）是计算机科学许多不同领域的基础。快速操纵和执行它们对于计算机图形、复杂模拟和机器学习本身非常重要。 “到处都需要矩阵乘法，”研究这个问题的麻省理工学院计算机科学教授 Virginia Vassilevska Williams 说。 “而且，它的复杂性也是计算机科学中最大的谜团之一。”将两个矩阵相乘需要大量繁琐的算术。

paras.en: The number of mathematical operations it takes to do these matrix multiplications scales with the cube of the length of the matrices. Scientists have sought a way to shrink the size of the exponent. If they had to do fewer than a cube of the length, it could mean exponential time savings. A few years ago, Vassilevska Williams and her colleagues had gotten that exponent down from 3 to around 2.37, the lowest ever achieved. Problem 107 claims a new lowest boundof 9⁄4, or 2.25. Paper 109 supposedly uses similar methods to find new, faster ways to multiply integers together, too. “In a maybe diabolical sense, the advance on matrix multiplication can be seen as an attempt by the LLMs to speed themselves up," Vassilevska Williams says.
paras.zh: 进行这些矩阵乘法所需的数学运算数量与矩阵长度的立方成正比。科学家们正在寻找一种缩小指数大小的方法。如果他们必须做的长度少于立方体，则可能意味着指数级的时间节省。几年前，Vassilevska Williams 和她的同事将该指数从 3 降至 2.37 左右，这是有史以来达到的最低值。问题 107 声称新的最低界限为 9⁄4，即 2.25。 Paper 109 据说也使用类似的方法来寻找新的、更快的整数相乘方法。 “从某种意义上来说，矩阵乘法的进步可以被视为法学硕士为加快自己的速度而做出的尝试，”Vassilevska Williams 说。

paras.en: If algorithms research is about the best ways to solve problems, complexity theory asks the reverse: How hard is it to find the best solutions to problems—the ideal algorithms that can’t be beat? This challenge involves thinking about what kinds of resources a computer has at its disposal and asking which resources let one solve more problems. A classic quandary about problems computers can solve called P versus NP, likely one of the hardest of the Millenium Prize Problems, is perhaps the most famous complexity problem.
paras.zh: 如果算法研究是关于解决问题的最佳方法，那么复杂性理论则提出了相反的问题：找到问题的最佳解决方案（不可击败的理想算法）有多难？这一挑战涉及思考计算机可以使用哪些类型的资源，并询问哪些资源可以让人们解决更多问题。关于计算机可以解决的问题的经典难题称为 P 与 NP，这可能是千年奖问题中最难的问题之一，也可能是最著名的复杂性问题。

paras.en: A key to both algorithms and complexity is asking how the solution or problem scales with the size of its input. For example, in the case of multiplication, researchers would want to know not just the best way to multiply two 100-digit numbers but how long it takes to multiply numbers of any size as a function of how many digits they have.
paras.zh: 算法和复杂性的关键是询问解决方案或问题如何随着输入的大小而扩展。例如，在乘法的情况下，研究人员不仅想知道两个 100 位数字相乘的最佳方法，还想知道将任意大小的数字相乘需要多长时间，作为数字位数的函数。

paras.en: L, also known as LOGSPACE, is the complexity class of problems that can be answered with very little space—logarithmic in the size of the problem’s description. RL and BPL, meanwhile, are randomized versions of LOGSPACE in which the computer can harness randomness and only needs to be right most of the time. Proving that L = RL = BPL, as Problem 103 claims to do, shows that every problem of this type that can be done with randomness can also be done without it, known as derandomization.
paras.zh: L，也称为 LOGSPACE，是可以用非常小的空间（问题描述的大小的对数）来回答的问题的复杂性类别。与此同时，RL 和 BPL 是 LOGSPACE 的随机版本，其中计算机可以利用随机性，并且只需要在大多数时间都是正确的。正如问题 103 声称的那样，证明 L = RL = BPL 表明，可以使用随机性完成的此类问题也可以在没有随机性的情况下完成，称为去随机化。

paras.en: In practice, computer programs use randomness all the time, but many researchers think it probably doesn’t speed up algorithms. “We have strong reasons to believe that, but we don’t know how to prove it,” says Ran Raz, a complexity theorist at Princeton University. While there was evidence that L = RL was likely to be true, proving it directly has been elusive until now. “I didn’t see any directions that were promising [before],” Raz says.
paras.zh: 在实践中，计算机程序一直在使用随机性，但许多研究人员认为它可能不会加快算法速度。 “我们有充分的理由相信这一点，但我们不知道如何证明这一点，”普林斯顿大学复杂性理论家兰·拉兹说。虽然有证据表明 L = RL 可能是正确的，但迄今为止直接证明这一点还很难。 “（之前）我没有看到任何有希望的方向，”拉兹说。

paras.en: The unique games conjecture also falls under complexity theory. First pitched in 2002, it implicitly asks how hard it is, given a set of constraints, to satisfy some portion of them. Here the resource under the microscope is approximation—that is, instead of getting an exactly correct answer to a given problem, the computer only needs to get close to the answer. Although the unique games problem isn’t explicitly about approximation, showing that it’s difficult would imply that finding approximate answers to many problems is as hard as finding the answer directly.
paras.zh: 独特博弈猜想也属于复杂性理论的范畴。它于 2002 年首次提出，含蓄地询问了在给定一组约束的情况下满足其中某些约束有多难。这里显微镜下的资源是近似值——也就是说，计算机不需要得到给定问题的完全正确的答案，而只需接近答案即可。尽管独特的游戏问题没有明确地涉及近似，但表明它很困难意味着找到许多问题的近似答案与直接找到答案一样困难。

paras.en: Problem 102 claims to do just that, proving that the unique games problem is hard. This solution has been a bit controversial. Other researchers who had caught wind of OpenAI’s work on the problem rushed out their partial progress toward the answer in fear of being scooped by AI.
paras.zh: 问题 102 声称可以做到这一点，证明独特的博弈问题是困难的。这个解决方案引起了一些争议。其他听说了 OpenAI 在这个问题上的研究成果的研究人员担心被 AI 抢先，因此急忙拿出部分进展来寻找答案。

paras.en: Over in the land of quantum computing, meanwhile, Problem 283 could give a better picture at how difficult truly quantum problems are. Scientists understand how bits in a classical computer work and can be manipulated, but they have less of a handle on quantum computing’s analogue to the classical bit, the qubit.
paras.zh: 与此同时，在量子计算领域，问题 283 可以更好地说明真正的量子问题有多么困难。科学家们了解经典计算机中的位是如何工作和操作的，但他们对量子计算与经典位的类似物——量子位——的了解较少。

paras.en: The unitary synthesis problem was first posed by researchers Scott Aaronson and Greg Kuperberg in 2006. It tries to relate working with qubits to working with bits. In this case, OpenAI showed that for any manipulation of a quantum state of qubits—called a unitary—they can build a quantum circuit and a problem dealing with only classical bits such that the circuit and problem can be used to calculate these manipulations, i.e., it can “synthesize” that unitary. Importantly, this solution gives some evidence that hard quantum problems may not be that much harder than hard classical problems, a surprising result that was not clear to researchers in the field before now.
paras.zh: 酉合成问题最初由研究人员 Scott Aaronson 和 Greg Kuperberg 于 2006 年提出。它试图将量子比特的工作与比特的工作联系起来。在这种情况下，OpenAI 表明，对于量子位的量子态（称为酉）的任何操作，他们都可以构建一个量子电路和一个仅处理经典位的问题，这样电路和问题就可以用于计算这些操作，即它可以“合成”该酉。重要的是，这个解决方案提供了一些证据，表明硬量子问题可能并不比硬经典问题难多少，这是一个令人惊讶的结果，该领域的研究人员此前并不清楚。

paras.en: The Fast Fourier Transform, an algorithm whose discovery dates back to 1965, is crucial to the Internet and other forms of digital communications. In many applications, including the Web and medical scans, it converts information received from signals into actual machine-usable frequency data. The transform works by summing a bunch of signals and multiplying each by a special exponential factor. Although brute forcing these multiplications takes quadratic time (the time is proportional to the square of the number of signals), the “fast” protocol takes about n log n time(where n is the number of signals received), which is fast enough to use for things like the Internet.
paras.zh: 快速傅里叶变换是一种算法，其发现可以追溯到 1965 年，它对于互联网和其他形式的数字通信至关重要。在许多应用中，包括网络和医疗扫描，它将从信号接收到的信息转换为实际机器可用的频率数据。该变换的工作原理是对一堆信号求和并将每个信号乘以一个特殊的指数因子。虽然暴力破解这些乘法需要二次时间（时间与信号数量的平方成正比），但“快速”协议大约需要 n log n 时间（其中 n 是接收到的信号数量），这足够快，足以用于互联网等事物。

paras.en: Paper 130 claims to reduce this n log n time to ... n (log n)0.999....Specifically, the model got it down from a factor of log n to a factor of (log n)^1–10–13, a tiny improvement over the state of the art. On an objective level, this is so close to n log n that the distinction almost doesn’t matter. It does break a longstanding barrier to digital communications, however, and many researchers hope that by studying the proof techniques used, they could one day find a Faster Fourier Transform.
paras.zh: 第 130 篇论文声称将这个 n log n 时间减少到...n (log n)0.999...具体来说，该模型将其从 log n 因子降低到 (log n)^1–10–13 因子，这比现有技术有了微小的改进。从客观角度来看，这非常接近 n log n，以至于区别几乎不重要。然而，它确实打破了数字通信的长期障碍，许多研究人员希望通过研究所使用的证明技术，他们有一天可以找到一种更快的傅里叶变换。

articles.title: The world’s loudest bird could drown out a rock concert
articles.author: Elie Dolgin

paras.en: The bare-throated bellbird is loud. Very, very loud.
paras.zh: 裸喉钟鸟的声音很大。非常非常大声。

paras.en: The explosive, metallic mating call of the snow-white male — a stout bird with a broad bill and distinctive blue-green throat patch — can top 130 decibels, louder than a jackhammer or a front-row seat at a Counting Crows concert.
paras.zh: 雪白的雄鸟——一种粗壮的鸟，有着宽阔的喙和独特的蓝绿色喉咙斑——发出爆炸性的、金属般的求偶叫声，声音可达130分贝，比手提钻或数乌鸦音乐会前排座位的声音还要大。

paras.en: That makes this South American forest dweller a contender for the title of world’s loudest bird. And now researchers think they know how it and other avian loudmouths produce such eardrum-rattling vocalizations.
paras.zh: 这使得这种南美森林居民成为世界上声音最大的鸟类称号的有力竞争者。现在研究人员认为他们知道它和其他鸟类大嘴鸟是如何发出这种震耳欲聋的声音的。

paras.en: Bigger bodies and, especially, wider beaks help these feathered screamers belt it out, behavioral ecologists João Menezes and Jeff Podos of the University of Massachusetts Amherst report September 29 in Evolution.
paras.zh: 马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校的行为生态学家 João Menezes 和 Jeff Podos 于 9 月 29 日在《进化论》杂志上报道称，更大的身体，尤其是更宽的喙有助于这些长有羽毛的尖叫鸟将其表达出来。

paras.en: But what pushed some birds to evolve such volume in the first place remains a mystery. The researchers looked at mating behavior, habitat density and flight ability, but found no explanation that consistently held across species. “We weren’t able to find an overarching pattern that applies to birds in general,” Menezes says.
paras.zh: 但最初是什么促使一些鸟类进化出如此大的体积仍然是一个谜。研究人员观察了交配行为、栖息地密度和飞行能力，但没有发现在不同物种之间一致成立的解释。 “我们无法找到适用于一般鸟类的总体模式，”梅内塞斯说。

paras.en: The quest to understand these sonic extremes dates back to 2019. That is when Podos and a colleague crowned the white bellbird (Procnias albus), an Amazonian cousin of the bare-throated bellbird (P. nudicollis), as a record-setting vocal powerhouse. Its 125-decibel calls were the loudest bird calls ever measured at the time.
paras.zh: 对这些声音极端现象的探索可以追溯到 2019 年。当时，波多斯和一位同事将白钟鸟 (Procnias albus)（裸喉钟鸟 (P. nudicollis) 的亚马逊近亲）评为创纪录的声音强者。它的叫声高达 125 分贝，是当时测量到的最响亮的鸟叫声。

paras.en: Beyond the attention-grabbing number, the finding raised a broader question: What makes some birds so extraordinarily loud?
paras.zh: 除了引人注目的数字之外，这一发现还提出了一个更广泛的问题：是什么让一些鸟类的声音如此之大？

paras.en: The honk of a Canada goose, for example, can reach chainsaw volume (100 decibels), while the chatter of a starling rarely rises above a dishwasher-level hum (70 decibels) — and ornithologists have surprisingly little understanding of why. Although scientists have spent decades cataloging the timing and frequency of birdsong, hoping to decode what birds are saying, the sheer loudness of bird voices has gone largely unexplored.
paras.zh: 例如，加拿大鹅的叫声可以达到电锯音量（100 分贝），而椋鸟的叫声很少会超过洗碗机级别的嗡嗡声（70 分贝）——令人惊讶的是，鸟类学家对其中的原因知之甚少。尽管科学家们花了几十年的时间对鸟鸣的时间和频率进行分类，希望能够解码鸟类所说的内容，但鸟类声音的响度在很大程度上还没有被探索过。

paras.en: To get a read on the racket, Podos lugged a high-grade sound meter, the kind used to monitor noise levels in industrial workplaces, and a laser rangefinder into the woods, swamps and open fields around his home in western Massachusetts. He measured the calls of whatever birds he could find — warblers, sparrows, robins and more.
paras.zh: 为了了解球拍情况，波多斯将一台高级声级计（用于监测工业工作场所噪音水平的那种）和一台激光测距仪拖进了他位于马萨诸塞州西部的家周围的树林、沼泽和开阔的田野。他测量了他能找到的所有鸟类的叫声——莺、麻雀、知更鸟等等。

paras.en: After logging a few dozen species, he enlisted Menezes, a then-grad student who at the time had recently joined his lab, to help turn the collection into a broader evolutionary analysis. Menezes measured bird vocalizations across his home country of Brazil, from the Atlantic Forest near São Paulo to the mountains surrounding Rio de Janeiro and beyond. He captured everything from the soft chirps of the dusky-throated hermit hummingbird to the piercing yelps of the red-legged seriema, a shaggy type of grassland bird.
paras.zh: 在记录了几十个物种后，他聘请了当时刚加入他实验室的研究生梅内塞斯来帮助将这些收集品转化为更广泛的进化分析。梅内塞斯测量了他的祖国巴西各地的鸟类发声，从圣保罗附近的大西洋森林到里约热内卢周围的山脉及更远的地方。他捕捉到了一切，从暗喉隐士蜂鸟的柔和鸣叫到红腿鸫（一种毛茸茸的草原鸟类）的刺耳叫声。

paras.en: All told, he and Podos compiled vocal volume data on 123 species, creating what they say is the largest such dataset to date.
paras.zh: 总而言之，他和 Podos 收集了 123 个物种的发声量数据，创建了他们所说的迄今为止最大的此类数据集。

paras.en: The heftier the bird, the louder its call tended to be, and the same went for birds with broader beaks — a connection between anatomy and acoustic performance that biophysicist Gabriel Mindlin from the University of Buenos Aires in Argentina finds “sensible and plausible.”
paras.zh: 鸟越重，它的叫声往往越大，对于喙部较宽的鸟来说也是如此——阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯大学的生物物理学家加布里埃尔·明德林认为，解剖学和声学性能之间的联系“合理且合理”。

paras.en: “Larger birds have the potential to generate greater respiratory pressures and flows, while morphological features such as beak opening can affect how efficiently acoustic energy radiates,” says Mindlin, who studies birdsong but was not involved in the work.
paras.zh: “较大的鸟类有可能产生更大的呼吸压力和流量，而喙张开等形态特征会影响声能的辐射效率，”研究鸟鸣但未参与这项工作的明德林说。

paras.en: Why evolution cranked up the volume on these avian megaphones, though, is a puzzle that remains, for now, unhatched.
paras.zh: 然而，为什么进化会提高这些鸟类扩音器的音量，目前仍然是一个尚未解开的谜团。

articles.title: ‘A Mother’s Brain’ explores the neuroscience of motherhood
articles.author: Laura Sanders

paras.en: When it comes to new motherhood, the baby typically takes center stage, garnering most of people’s attention. But in a refreshing twist, neuroscientist Susana Carmona shifts the spotlight to the mom. In the opening pages of A Mother’s Brain, Carmona cheerfully tells us, “here, we’ll hardly discuss babies at all.” Mothers are her protagonists.
paras.zh: 当谈到新妈妈时，婴儿通常占据中心舞台，吸引大多数人的注意力。但令人耳目一新的是，神经科学家苏珊娜·卡莫纳将焦点转移到了母亲身上。在《母亲的大脑》的开头几页中，卡莫纳愉快地告诉我们，“在这里，我们几乎不会讨论婴儿。”母亲是她的主角。

paras.en: What follows is a captivating, passionate and well-grounded journey through the fascinating process of “matrescence.” A word coined to echo “adolescence,” another time of seismic changes, matrescence includes the intense reorganization a woman’s brain undergoes as she becomes a mom. So far, early studies have revealed a sculpting of brain circuits (and Carmona is quick to point out that less can be more), heightened social instincts and perhaps even a boost of resilience during old age.
paras.zh: 接下来是一段引人入胜、充满激情且基础扎实的旅程，穿越令人着迷的“成熟期”过程。这个词是为了呼应“青春期”，即另一个发生巨大变化的时期，女性期包括女性在成为母亲后大脑所经历的剧烈重组。到目前为止，早期研究已经揭示了大脑回路的塑造（卡莫纳很快指出，少即是多）、社交本能的增强，甚至可能会增强老年时的适应能力。

paras.en: This mom found the book to be a treasure trove of motherly delights. Scientific concepts are woven with social and cultural strands, from the poignant to the weird to the profound. Certain passages in the book allowed me the pleasure of relistening to the song “The Mother” by Brandi Carlile, in which she sings, “Welcome to the end of being alone inside your mind.” A Mother’s Brain also kindly pointed me to the viral video, “Mother Rat Saves Baby from Snake.”
paras.zh: 这位妈妈发现这本书是母爱的宝库。科学概念与社会和文化脉络交织在一起，从深刻到怪异到深刻。书中的某些段落让我有幸重听布兰迪·卡莱尔的歌曲《母亲》，她在歌中唱道：“欢迎来到你内心孤独的终结。” 《妈妈的大脑》还好心地向我推荐了一段火爆的视频：“鼠妈妈从蛇手中拯救了婴儿。”

paras.en: As one of the foremost scientists studying matrescence, Carmona is an authoritative guide through the latest research, of which there is a dismayingly small amount. Still, the book covers scientific ground including hormones, evolution and brain networks. History, social constructs and the pressures of modern life come into the story, too.
paras.zh: 作为研究基质形成的最重要的科学家之一，卡莫纳是最新研究的权威指南，但这些研究的数量少得令人沮丧。尽管如此，这本书涵盖了科学领域，包括激素、进化和大脑网络。历史、社会结构和现代生活的压力也出现在故事​​中。

paras.en: If you prefer a light read, Carmona will occasionally warn you when a section is scientifically dense. Then she will invite you along anyway. “But if you do like hormones — well, we’re going to have fun,” Carmona writes at the beginning of a chapter. And it was fun. I was shocked to learn, for instance, just how massive the hormonal upheaval during pregnancy is. The amount of estrogen that floods a woman’s body, including her brain, during the 40 weeks of pregnancy is more than that of the amount that would otherwise accumulate over her entire fertile life, which lasts 35 years on average.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢轻松阅读，卡莫纳偶尔会在某个部分的科学密度很高时向您发出警告。然后她无论如何都会邀请你一起去。 “但如果你确实喜欢荷尔蒙——好吧，我们会玩得很开心，”卡莫纳在章节开头写道。这很有趣。例如，当我得知怀孕期间荷尔蒙的变化有多大时，我感到震惊。在怀孕 40 周期间，女性体内（包括大脑）所分泌的雌激素数量，超过了她整个生育期（平均持续 35 年）所积累的雌激素量。

paras.en: Along the way, Carmona thoughtfully addresses scientific puzzlers such as this: Mothers often report feeling less mentally sharp, yet laboratory studies show almost no neurological decline. Attributed to “mommy brain” or “momnesia,” mental slips might be due to a lack of sleep, or a shifting of attention, or even just an expectation.
paras.zh: 在此过程中，卡莫纳深思熟虑地解决了诸如此类的科学难题：母亲们经常报告感觉精神不那么敏锐，但实验室研究显示几乎没有神经功能下降。被认为是“妈妈脑”或“记忆症”的精神失误可能是由于睡眠不足、注意力转移、甚至只是一种期望造成的。

paras.en: This pervasive, negative stereotype of “mommy brain” can then build on itself, getting stronger as women buy into the incorrect idea that motherhood leaves them dumber. If a woman expects her memory to get worse, she’ll see signs of it in even normal mistakes. “I have watched brilliant women grow so insecure about their intelligence on becoming mothers that they abandon the projects that were once vital to them,” Carmona writes. Assumptions about their diminished brainpower can lead women to pull back from valuable parts of their lives. “It matters — a lot — how we talk to ourselves about these things.”
paras.zh: 这种普遍存在的、消极的“妈妈脑”刻板印象会不断增强，随着女性接受“母性会让她们变得更笨”的错误观念，这种刻板印象会变得更加强烈。如果一个女人预计自己的记忆力会变差，那么即使是正常的错误，她也会看到这种迹象。卡莫纳写道：“我看到才华横溢的女性在成为母亲后对自己的智力变得如此不自信，以至于放弃了曾经对她们至关重要的项目。”对女性脑力下降的假设可能会导致女性放弃生活中有价值的部分。 “我们如何与自己谈论这些事情很重要。”

paras.en: As a mother herself, Carmona brings her experiences into the narrative. It couldn’t be any other way. “Motherhood is lived,” she writes. “It happens in your gut, your identity, your core.”
paras.zh: 作为一名母亲，卡莫纳将她的经历融入到叙述中。不可能有其他方式。 “母性是活生生的，”她写道。 “它发生在你的直觉、你的身份、你的核心。”

paras.en: At its heart, this book is a love letter to moms, who have been invisible to the scientific gaze for too long. It’s time to write a new tale of matrescence, Carmona argues. “A story that recognizes mothers as the essence of the human species, the carriers of knowledge about how we create bonds — and, through them, society and culture.”
paras.zh: 从本质上讲，这本书是一封写给妈妈们的情书，她们已经在科学的视线中消失太久了。卡莫纳认为，是时候写一个新的女性成长故事了。 “这个故事承认母亲是人类的本质，是我们如何建立联系的知识载体，并通过母亲建立社会和文化。”

paras.en: By putting the intense and wild changes of motherhood into words, Carmona offers us a powerful and necessary story.
paras.zh: 通过用语言表达母性的强烈而疯狂的变化，卡莫纳为我们提供了一个有力而必要的故事。

paras.zh: 从 Bookshop.org 购买《母亲的大脑》。 《科学新闻》是 Bookshop.org 的附属机构，通过本文中的链接进行购买将赚取佣金。

articles.title: An extinct crocodilian was found among rocks that built the Great Sphinx
articles.author: Jake Buehler

paras.en: The Great Sphinx of Giza isn’t the only ancient, stony visage in the area missing its nose.
paras.zh: 吉萨大狮身人面像并不是该地区唯一一座没有鼻子的古老石像。

paras.en: A fossil crocodilian discovered in the same 45-million-year-old limestone that ancient Egyptians used to build the Sphinx is also missing the tip of its snout. But the broken specimen is intact enough to be reclassified as a new branch of the gavial family tree, which may help uncover these mysterious animals’ evolutionary history, researchers report October 7 in Royal Society Open Science.
paras.zh: 在古埃及人用来建造狮身人面像的同一块 4500 万年前的石灰岩中发现的鳄鱼化石也缺失了鼻子。但研究人员 10 月 7 日在英国皇家学会开放科学杂志上报告称，破碎的标本足够完整，可以被重新分类为鳄类家族树的一个新分支，这可能有助于揭示这些神秘动物的进化历史。

paras.en: Most living crocodilians are in either the crocodile or alligator families. But there are also two species of gavial living in tropical Asia. These are huge, critically endangered, fish-eating crocodilians with long, slender snouts full of needlelike teeth. Fossils of extinct gavials have been found around the world. In 1927, German researchers reported a gavial skull fossil collected from hills near Cairo. The fossil was identified as an extinct species of Tomistoma, a genus found today only as a single species in Southeast Asia.
paras.zh: 大多数现存的鳄鱼属于鳄鱼科或短吻鳄科。但也有两种鳄鱼生活在热带亚洲。这些是巨大的、极度濒危的、以鱼为食的鳄鱼，它们的鼻子又长又细，长满了针状的牙齿。世界各地都发现了已灭绝的鳄鱼化石。 1927年，德国研究人员报道了从开罗附近的山上采集到的鳄类头骨化石。该化石被鉴定为已灭绝的 Tomistoma 物种，该属如今仅在东南亚作为单一物种发现。

paras.en: But more recent evolutionary studies including this fossil suggested this classification didn’t fit. In 2023, while working on a doctoral degree at University College London, paleontologist Paul Burke went to Germany to study the fossil in detail. Burke and his colleagues made careful measurements of the skull, using 3-D X-ray methods to measure the insides of the brain and nasal cavities.
paras.zh: 但最近的进化研究（包括这块化石）表明这种分类并不合适。 2023年，古生物学家保罗·伯克在伦敦大学学院攻读博士学位期间，前往德国详细研究这块化石。伯克和他的同事对头骨进行了仔细的测量，使用 3D X 射线方法测量大脑和鼻腔的内部。

paras.en: “As we’ve advanced in the last 100 years, we’ve got so many new methodologies we could implement to figure out what kind of species this fossil is,” says Burke, currently at the Sweden Museum of Natural History in Stockholm.
paras.zh: “随着我们在过去 100 年中取得的进步，我们已经有了很多新的方法可以用来弄清楚这块化石是什么物种，”目前在斯德哥尔摩瑞典自然历史博物馆工作的伯克说。

paras.en: The team compared the measurements to those taken of living and fossil gavials and found that this purported Egyptian Tomistoma was actually an undescribed gavial genus. The researchers named it Herugavialis cairensis, referencing the Egyptian god Heru (or Horus), who has been associated with the Great Sphinx. Coincidentally, the Herugavialis skull is missing the end of its snout — something it shares with the noseless statue.
paras.zh: 研究小组将测量结果与现存的和化石的鳄鱼进行了比较，发现这种所谓的埃及托米斯托马实际上是一种未被描述的鳄鱼属。研究人员将其命名为 Herugavialis cairensis，参考与大狮身人面像有关的埃及神赫鲁（或荷鲁斯）。巧合的是，Herugavialis 头骨缺少鼻子末端——这是它与无鼻子雕像共有的部分。

paras.en: “So many species are found from the same [geologic] formation,” Burke says, including fish, sharks and mammals. “But this is the first one with the name associated with the Sphinx.”
paras.zh: “在同一[地质]构造中发现了如此多的物种，”伯克说，包括鱼类、鲨鱼和哺乳动物。 “但这是第一个与狮身人面像相关的名字。”

paras.en: Today, gavials are only found in freshwater environments. But tens of millions of years ago, the reptiles also inhabited nearshore saltwater environments. Herugavialis appears to have been a coastal predator back when the ancient Tethys Ocean covered northern Egypt.
paras.zh: 如今，鳄鱼只生活在淡水环境中。但数千万年前，爬行动物也栖息在近岸咸水环境中。当古特提斯洋覆盖埃及北部时，Herugavialis 似乎是一种沿海掠食者。

paras.en: Khalafallah Salih, a paleontologist at Al Neelain University in Khartoum, Sudan, says the finding supports the idea that the evolution of gavials and their relatives in Africa was much more complex than researchers thought. Herugavialis doesn’t appear closely related to other known gavial-type crocodilians in Africa or the Mediterranean, he says. It appears to have branched off from the lineage early in its evolution.
paras.zh: 苏丹喀土穆阿尔尼兰大学的古生物学家 Khalafallah Salih 表示，这一发现支持了这样一种观点，即非洲的长吻鳄及其近亲的进化比研究人员想象的要复杂得多。他说，Herugavialis 似乎与非洲或地中海其他已知的鳄类鳄鱼没有密切关系。它似乎在进化的早期就从该谱系中分支出来。

paras.en: Burke notes that gavials barely breach the public consciousness compared to alligators and crocodiles.
paras.zh: 伯克指出，与短吻鳄和鳄鱼相比，长吻鳄几乎没有打破公众的意识。

paras.en: “They’re still alive today and they’re endangered,” he says. “So, we should know about them and their long history.”
paras.zh: “它们今天仍然活着，而且濒临灭绝，”他说。 “所以，我们应该了解它们以及它们悠久的历史。”

articles.title: Signs of Psychopathy Can Show Up in a Person's Writing
articles.author: Jess Cockerill

paras.en: Psychopathy is not listed in the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders, and it's not an official diagnosis any psychiatrist or psychologist will give.
paras.zh: 《精神疾病诊断和统计手册》中没有列出精神病，也不是任何精神病学家或心理学家都会给出的正式诊断。

paras.en: But the term is still widely used, especially in criminology, to describe a problematic cluster of personality traits.
paras.zh: 但这个词仍然被广泛使用，特别是在犯罪学中，用来描述一组有问题的人格特征。

paras.en: The triarchic model says psychopathic personalities have three key features: boldness, disinhibition, and meanness.
paras.zh: 三元模型认为，精神病态人格具有三个关键特征：大胆、去抑制和卑鄙。

paras.en: A new study from clinical psychology researchers Ky Bray and Laura Drislane, both of the University of Mississippi, shows these traits can show up in people's writing, in ways that don't always fit with our stereotype of a 'psychopath'.
paras.zh: 密西西比大学临床心理学研究人员凯·布雷和劳拉·德里斯兰的一项新研究表明，这些特征可以在人们的写作中表现出来，但其方式并不总是符合我们对“精神病患者”的刻板印象。

paras.en: Their results are published in the journal Personality and Individual Differences.
paras.zh: 他们的研究结果发表在《人格与个体差异》杂志上。

paras.en: "People tend to think of psychopathy as one thing, but it's actually multidimensional," Bray says.
paras.zh: “人们倾向于认为精神病是一回事，但实际上它是多维的，”布雷说。

paras.en: Everyone exhibits these traits to some degree. It's when they appear together, at high levels across the board, that things can get dark.
paras.zh: 每个人都在某种程度上表现出这些特征。当它们一起出现在各个领域的高层时，事情就会变得黑暗。

paras.en: "That's in part why there's a movement away from calling people 'psychopaths,' because we don't view psychopathy as a category," says Drislane.
paras.zh: “这就是为什么有人开始不再称人们为‘精神病患者’，因为我们并不将精神病患者视为一个类别，”德里斯兰说。

paras.en: "But psychopathic dimensions can predict important outcomes, things like crime, recidivism, or intimate partner violence.
paras.zh: “但精神病态维度可以预测重要的结果，例如犯罪、累犯或亲密伴侣暴力。

paras.en: "What our research, including this paper, suggests is that it's important to look beyond that label and into the different components or dimensions of psychopathy, because each of those dimensions actually has a unique set of outcomes or things that it can predict."
paras.zh: “我们的研究，包括这篇论文，表明重要的是要超越这个标签，深入研究精神病的不同组成部分或维度，因为每个维度实际上都有一组独特的结果或可以预测的事情。”

paras.en: Bray and Drislane recruited 307 undergraduate students and 144 former incarcerated people from the community, who each completed a questionnaire (the Triarchic Psychopathy Measure, a.k.a. TriPM) designed to assess levels of the three psychopathic personality traits.
paras.zh: 布雷和德里斯兰从社区招募了 307 名本科生和 144 名前囚犯，他们每人完成了一份问卷（三元精神病测量，又称 TriPM），旨在评估三种精神病人格特征的水平。

paras.en: They were also asked to write about their lives, describing a high point, a low point, and a turning point.
paras.zh: 他们还被要求写下自己的生活，描述高潮、低谷和转折点。

paras.en: The goal with this study, Bray emphasizes, is not to use writing to diagnose psychopathy (which, again, isn't a formal diagnosis anyway), but to demonstrate how psychopathic traits can show up in everyday behaviors, including language.
paras.zh: 布雷强调，这项研究的目标不是用写作来诊断精神病（这又不是正式的诊断），而是为了证明精神病特征如何在日常行为（包括语言）中显现出来。

paras.en: For instance, people who scored high on the 'boldness' spectrum in the TriPM tended to use fewer anxiety-related words (for instance: 'worry', 'fear', 'afraid', or 'nervous') in their writing overall.
paras.zh: 例如，在 TriPM 中“大胆”得分较高的人在写作中倾向于较少使用与焦虑相关的词语（例如：“担心”、“恐惧”、“害怕”或“紧张”）。

paras.en: A person with a high score on 'meanness' was less likely to use words associated with negative emotions – 'bad', 'hate', 'hurt', or 'tired', for example – when writing about their life's major turning point.
paras.zh: “卑鄙”得分高的人在写下人生的重大转折点时，不太可能使用与负面情绪相关的词语，例如“坏”、“恨”、“受伤”或“累”。

paras.en: Disinhibition had the greatest effect on language of all three personality traits. People who scored high on disinhibition tended to refer to positive outcomes far less across all three writing prompts.
paras.zh: 抑制解除对所有三种人格特征的语言影响最大。在抑制解除方面得分较高的人在所有三个写作提示中往往很少提到积极的结果。

paras.en: They used more negative language when describing high points and turning points than their peers, but not when writing about low points.
paras.zh: 与同龄人相比，他们在描述高潮和转折点时使用更多负面语言，但在写低潮时却很少使用。

paras.en: They also tended to refer to substance use (words like 'beer', 'wine', 'drunk', and 'cigar') more when talking about low points and turning points, but not high points.
paras.zh: 当谈论低点和转折点时，他们还倾向于更多地提及物质使用（诸如“啤酒”、“葡萄酒”、“醉酒”和“雪茄”等词），而不是高点。

paras.en: "Viewing [psychopathy] from a multidimensional perspective allows us to observe how those traits might manifest in non-forensic populations, in people who have not committed a crime," Bray says.
paras.zh: 布雷说：“从多维角度观察[精神病]使我们能够观察这些特征如何在非法医人群、没有犯罪的人中表现出来。”

paras.en: "That allows us to see how these traits affect college students, business professionals, or interpersonal relationships."
paras.zh: “这使我们能够了解这些特征如何影响大学生、商业专业人士或人际关系。”

paras.en: The results suggest the language used by people with psychopathic traits is not necessarily lacking in emotion or personal meaning, counter to the stereotype of a cold, callous criminal.
paras.zh: 结果表明，具有精神病特征的人使用的语言不一定缺乏情感或个人意义，这与冷酷无情的罪犯的刻板印象相反。

paras.en: But it may not always match what other people would consider appropriate for the context.
paras.zh: 但它可能并不总是符合其他人认为适合上下文的内容。

paras.en: "If we want to be able to treat or ideally even prevent psychopathy from developing, we need to understand the mechanisms at play," Drislane says.
paras.zh: “如果我们希望能够治疗甚至理想情况下预防精神病的发展，我们需要了解起作用的机制，”德里斯兰说。

paras.en: "That comes down to understanding the unique contributors for all three of these dimensions."
paras.zh: “这归结为了解所有这三个维度的独特贡献者。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Personality and Individual Differences.
paras.zh: 该研究发表在《人格与个体差异》杂志上。

articles.title: Scientists Trace How Cancer Passed Between Twins Before Birth
articles.author: Esra Öz

paras.en: A facial mass detected before birth prompted the early delivery of identical twin sisters. A fetal MRI at 33 weeks showed the mass on one baby's face. When the sisters were born a week later, tumors were found in both.
paras.zh: 出生前检测到的面部肿块促使同卵双胞胎姐妹提前分娩。 33 周时的胎儿 MRI 显示一名婴儿脸上有肿块。一周后，姐妹俩出生时，两人都发现了肿瘤。

paras.en: Two children had the same cancer, raising a question that their shared beginnings alone could not answer.
paras.zh: 两个孩子患有同样的癌症，提出了一个仅靠他们共同的起点无法回答的问题。

paras.en: Had the disease started separately in each sister, or had cancer cells crossed from one to the other before birth?
paras.zh: 这种疾病是在姐妹俩身上分别开始的，还是癌细胞在出生前就从一个姐妹传播到了另一个姐妹？

paras.en: Researchers turned to a record hidden within their cells. DNA changes, accumulated as their bodies developed, allowed the team to reconstruct events that had happened months before anyone saw a tumor.
paras.zh: 研究人员求助于隐藏在细胞内的记录。随着身体发育而积累的 DNA 变化使研究小组能够重建人们看到肿瘤之前几个月发生的事件。

paras.en: The study in Nature Communications shows that the cancer began in one sister and passed to the other in the womb, most likely through a single transfer late in the second trimester. The same investigation uncovered clues to how the sisters themselves had formed.
paras.zh: 《自然通讯》杂志上的这项研究表明，癌症始于一位姐妹，并在子宫内传播给另一位姐妹，很可能是在妊娠中期后期通过单次转移传播的。同一项调查还揭示了姐妹俩如何形成的线索。

paras.en: The two girls, Amelia and Amaya, died soon after birth. Their family consented to post-mortem examinations for research. The authors dedicate the study to the sisters, whose mother wanted them acknowledged by name.
paras.zh: 这两个女孩阿米莉亚和阿玛亚在出生后不久就去世了。他们的家人同意进行尸检以进行研究。作者将这项研究献给这对姐妹，她们的母亲希望她们能说出她们的名字。

paras.en: The team included researchers from the Wellcome Sanger Institute, Great Ormond Street Hospital and the University of Cambridge.
paras.zh: 该团队包括来自威康桑格研究所、大奥蒙德街医院和剑桥大学的研究人员。

paras.en: The baby with the facial mass is called twin A in the paper. At birth, she had tumor deposits in several organs. Her sister, twin B, initially had lesions in her skin; disease involving the membranes around the brain and spinal cord was detected later.
paras.zh: 论文中将该面部肿块的婴儿称为双胞胎A。她出生时，多个器官就有肿瘤沉积。她的妹妹，双胞胎 B，最初皮肤有损伤；后来发现了涉及大脑和脊髓周围膜的疾病。

paras.en: The tumors were reported as undifferentiated sarcomas. Soft tissue sarcomas arise in tissues such as muscle, fat and the body's supporting structures. All the twins' tumor samples carried the same fusion of two genes, MN1 and ZNF341.
paras.zh: 据报道，肿瘤为未分化肉瘤。软组织肉瘤出现在肌肉、脂肪和身体支撑结构等组织中。所有双胞胎的肿瘤样本都携带两种基因的相同融合：MN1 和 ZNF341。

paras.en: Matching tumors were only the beginning: the team needed to identify whose cells had started the cancer.
paras.zh: 匹配肿瘤只是一个开始：研究小组需要确定是谁的细胞引发了癌症。

paras.en: Here, an apparent contradiction proved useful: identical twins are not necessarily genetically identical.
paras.zh: 在这里，一个明显的矛盾被证明是有用的：同卵双胞胎的基因不一定相同。

paras.en: They begin with the same fertilized egg, but DNA changes can arise as their cells multiply. A change acquired by one cell can pass to its descendants, marking a particular branch of the developing body's cellular family tree.
paras.zh: 它们从同一个受精卵开始，但随着细胞的繁殖，DNA 会发生变化。一个细胞获得的变化可以传递给它的后代，标志着发育中的机体细胞谱系的一个特定分支。

paras.en: Comparing those marks across tissues reveals shared ancestors and distinguishes one twin's cells from her sister's.
paras.zh: 比较不同组织中的这些标记可以揭示共同的祖先，并将其中一个双胞胎的细胞与她姐姐的细胞区分开来。

paras.en: The team sequenced 10 tumor samples, 12 normal tissue samples from the twins and 11 placental samples. They also examined 12 placental samples enriched for cells involved in forming the placenta.
paras.zh: 研究小组对双胞胎的 10 个肿瘤样本、12 个正常组织样本和 11 个胎盘样本进行了测序。他们还检查了 12 个富含参与胎盘形成的细胞的胎盘样本。

paras.en: The researchers found that cancer began in twin A, then cancer cells passed to twin B before birth and formed tumors there too. The evidence was in the second baby's tumors: their cells carried genetic markers belonging to her sister.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，癌症始于双胞胎A，然后癌细胞在出生前传给了双胞胎B，并在那里形成了肿瘤。证据就在第二个婴儿的肿瘤中：它们的细胞携带属于她姐姐的遗传标记。

paras.en: The study points to spread across the placenta they shared. The genetic analysis establishes which sister the cancer came from, but does not directly show the cells crossing or the route they took.
paras.zh: 研究指出病毒会通过他们共用的胎盘传播。遗传分析确定了癌症来自哪一个姐妹，但并没有直接显示细胞的交叉或它们采取的路线。

paras.en: The most likely starting site was twin A's facial mass. The cancer diversified into different cell populations and spread within her body before reaching her sister. The pattern in twin B supported a relatively late, single transfer.
paras.zh: 最有可能的起始部位是双胞胎 A 的面部肿块。癌症分化成不同的细胞群，并在她的体内扩散，然后到达她的姐姐。双 B 中的模式支持相对较晚的单一转移。

paras.en: The researchers then used accumulated mutations to estimate when this happened. Assuming mutations built up at a constant rate, they placed the tumor's origin near the end of the first trimester and its transfer late in the second trimester.
paras.zh: 然后研究人员利用累积的突变来估计这种情况发生的时间。假设突变以恒定速率累积，他们将肿瘤的起源置于妊娠早期末期附近，并将其转移置于妊娠中期后期。

paras.en: Those dates are estimates that depend on the assumed mutation rate, rather than direct observations.
paras.zh: 这些日期是取决于假设的突变率的估计值，而不是直接观察结果。

paras.en: There was another surprise: normal cells had moved in the opposite direction. Genetic markers in a spleen sample from twin A suggested around 75 percent of the sampled cells originated in twin B, consistent with blood-cell mixing between the sisters.
paras.zh: 还有另一个惊喜：正常细胞向相反的方向移动。双胞胎 A 的脾脏样本中的遗传标记表明，大约 75% 的样本细胞起源于双胞胎 B，这与姐妹之间的血细胞混合一致。

paras.en: The twins' earliest cell lineages also contributed unevenly to their bodies and placenta. One branch contributed almost exclusively to twin A, another to both sisters and the placenta, and a third to twin B and the placenta. The pattern favored an earlier embryonic split than the classical model for this type of identical twinning predicts.
paras.zh: 这对双胞胎最早的细胞谱系对他们的身体和胎盘的贡献也不均匀。其中一根分支几乎只对双胞胎 A 起作用，另一根对姐妹俩和胎盘起作用，第三根对双胞胎 B 和胎盘起作用。与此类同卵双胞胎的经典模型预测相比，该模式有利于更早的胚胎分裂。

paras.en: However, this was one pair of twins, and the analysis could recover only lineages that survived in the tissues sampled.
paras.zh: 然而，这是一对双胞胎，分析只能恢复在采样组织中存活的谱系。

paras.en: Earlier research on twins with leukemia has also explored cancer's beginnings before birth. This case adds a detailed reconstruction of a soft tissue tumor's journey, without establishing how often such transfers occur.
paras.zh: 早期对患有白血病的双胞胎的研究也探索了癌症在出生前的起源。该病例增加了对软组织肿瘤旅程的详细重建，但没有确定这种转移发生的频率。

paras.en: Nor does the study show that a cancer in one twin must reach the other. The researchers interpret the transfer as a rare event, rather than an unavoidable consequence of the sisters sharing their prenatal environment.
paras.zh: 这项研究也没有表明双胞胎中一个人的癌症一定会传染给另一个人。研究人员将这种转移解释为罕见事件，而不是姐妹们共享产前环境的不可避免的结果。

paras.en: The approach offers a way to investigate the developmental origins of childhood tumors alongside normal growth.
paras.zh: 该方法提供了一种研究儿童肿瘤与正常生长的发育起源的方法。

paras.en: The research has been published in Nature Communications.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《自然通讯》上。

articles.title: GLP-1 Users Are Reporting Their Fingernails Detaching
articles.author: Esra Öz

paras.en: When you start a medication and notice something different about your body, a question can follow: Is the drug responsible?
paras.zh: 当您开始服药并注意到身体出现异常时，可能会出现一个问题：药物是否对此负责？

paras.en: Changes to your nails might prompt that question, too.
paras.zh: 指甲的变化也可能会引发这个问题。

paras.en: In a new study, researchers investigating GLP-1 drugs used to treat obesity and type 2 diabetes wanted to know whether nail problems were more common among people taking them.
paras.zh: 在一项新的研究中，研究人员调查了用于治疗肥胖和 2 型糖尿病的 GLP-1 药物，想知道服用这些药物的人中指甲问题是否更常见。

paras.en: As it turns out, their study of 1,904 people across four countries found a difference.
paras.zh: 事实证明，他们对四个国家 1,904 人的研究发现了差异。

paras.en: Nail detachment was reported by 39 percent of GLP-1 users, compared with 9 percent of people with type 2 diabetes or obesity who had never taken the drugs.
paras.zh: 39% 的 GLP-1 使用者报告出现指甲脱落，而从未服用过该药物的 2 型糖尿病或肥胖患者中这一比例为 9%。

paras.en: However, around half of the drug users reported nail problems before treatment began.
paras.zh: 然而，大约一半的吸毒者在治疗开始前报告了指甲问题。

paras.en: The findings were presented at the European Academy of Dermatology and Venereology (EADV) Congress 2026 in Vienna.
paras.zh: 研究结果在 2026 年维也纳欧洲皮肤病学和性病学会 (EADV) 大会上公布。

paras.en: Researchers compared 575 GLP-1 users with 1,329 people with type 2 diabetes or obesity who had never used the medications, recruited across France, the United States, Brazil, and Mexico.
paras.zh: 研究人员在法国、美国、巴西和墨西哥招募了 575 名 GLP-1 使用者与 1,329 名从未使用过该药物的 2 型糖尿病或肥胖患者进行了比较。

paras.en: According to an EADV press release, 66 percent of users reported at least one nail disorder, compared with 53 percent of controls. Nail discoloration was reported by 46 percent of GLP-1 users versus 17 percent of controls.
paras.zh: 根据 EADV 新闻稿，66% 的用户报告至少有一种指甲疾病，而对照组的这一比例为 53%。 46% 的 GLP-1 用户报告指甲变色，而对照组为 17%。

paras.en: "Our findings show a clear association, but they also underline an important point," says study author Charles Taïeb, the managing director of the European Market Maintenance Assessment.
paras.zh: “我们的研究结果显示出明显的关联，但它们也强调了一个重要的观点，”该研究的作者、欧洲市场维护评估常务董事查尔斯·塔伊布（Charles Taïeb）说。

paras.en: "Not everything that happens during GLP-1 treatment is necessarily caused by the treatment itself."
paras.zh: “并非 GLP-1 治疗期间发生的所有事情都一定是由治疗本身引起的。”

paras.en: The study relied on participants describing their symptoms. It was cross-sectional, capturing their experiences at one point rather than following them through treatment with standardized dermatological examinations. That means it cannot establish that the medications caused the changes.
paras.zh: 该研究依赖于参与者描述他们的症状。它是横断面的，记录了他们在某个时刻的经历，而不是通过标准化皮肤病学检查跟踪他们的治疗过程。这意味着它无法确定药物导致了这些变化。

paras.en: The extent of nail detachment described in the study is also unclear. The researchers have not specified whether it covers partial separation from the nail bed, complete nail loss, or both, and the information currently available does not distinguish between fingernails and toenails.
paras.zh: 研究中描述的指甲脱落的程度也不清楚。研究人员尚未具体说明它是否涵盖甲床部分分离、指甲完全脱落或两者兼而有之，而且目前可用的信息并未区分手指甲和脚趾甲。

paras.en: In general, separation of the nail plate from its bed is called onycholysis. DermNet explains that this can affect fingers or toes and can have several causes, including injury, skin disease, and infection. That background does not establish which conditions participants in this study experienced.
paras.zh: 一般来说，指甲板与其床分离称为甲剥离。 DermNet 解释说，这可能会影响手指或脚趾，并且可能有多种原因，包括受伤、皮肤病和感染。该背景并不能确定本研究的参与者经历了哪些条件。

paras.en: The 39 percent figure, therefore, should not be read as evidence that nearly four in ten users lost their nails completely. It also does not estimate a new patient's chance of developing the problem after starting medication.
paras.zh: 因此，39% 的数字不应被视为近十分之四的用户完全失去指甲的证据。它也没有估计新患者在开始用药后出现问题的机会。

paras.en: Researchers accounted for dermatological conditions and nutritional deficiencies when analyzing the results. Some associations weakened, but nail detachment and discoloration remained around two to three times more frequent among users, according to the release.
paras.zh: 研究人员在分析结果时考虑了皮肤病状况和营养缺乏。据新闻稿称，一些关联性减弱，但指甲脱落和变色的频率仍然是用户的两到三倍左右。

paras.en: The exact adjusted estimates and confidence intervals are not provided. Without them, the precision of those comparisons cannot be assessed from the announcement alone.
paras.zh: 未提供准确的调整估计值和置信区间。如果没有它们，就无法仅从公告中评估这些比较的准确性。

paras.en: The team also examined weight loss. Differences remained statistically significant when the analysis focused on participants who had lost weight, suggesting weight loss alone might not explain the findings. This still does not demonstrate a direct effect on nails.
paras.zh: 研究小组还检查了体重减轻情况。当分析重点关注体重减轻的参与者时，差异仍然具有统计学意义，这表明体重减轻本身可能无法解释研究结果。这仍然没有显示出对指甲的直接影响。

paras.en: A companion study involving the same participants examined hair and scalp symptoms, adding to interest in possible links between GLP-1 pathways and hair loss.
paras.zh: 一项由相同参与者参与的配套研究检查了头发和头皮症状，增加了人们对 GLP-1 通路与脱发之间可能联系的兴趣。

paras.en: Unusual hair loss was reported by 50 percent of users versus 34 percent of controls. Reduced hair volume or density affected 42 percent versus 19 percent.
paras.zh: 50% 的使用者报告有异常脱发，而对照者则为 34%。头发体积或密度减少影响了 42% 和 19%。

paras.en: Among users, hair loss was usually accompanied by scalp symptoms such as itching, redness or scaling.
paras.zh: 在使用者中，脱发通常伴有头皮症状，如瘙痒、发红或脱屑。

paras.en: Study author and dermatologist Bruno Halioua from the Société Française des Sciences Humaines sur la Peau (SFSHP) suggests that this pattern could go beyond the shedding typically seen after rapid weight loss and involve inflammation.
paras.zh: 研究作者、法国人体科学协会 (SFSHP) 的皮肤科医生 Bruno Halioua 认为，这种模式可能超出了快速减肥后常见的脱落现象，还涉及炎症。

paras.en: The hair findings came from the same group of people, so they do not independently replicate the nail results. Instead, they offer another view of symptoms reported within this sample.
paras.zh: 头发的研究结果来自同一组人，因此他们不能独立复制指甲的结果。相反，他们提供了该样本中报告的症状的另一种观点。

paras.en: Whether similar patterns appear in other populations, and how often problems begin after treatment starts, remain questions for research to resolve.
paras.zh: 类似的模式是否出现在其他人群中，以及治疗开始后出现问题的频率，仍然是有待研究解决的问题。

paras.en: The release does not identify which GLP-1 medications participants took or provide results for any specific drug. The findings therefore cannot establish a nail effect tied to any one drug.
paras.zh: 该新闻稿并未明确参与者服用了哪些 GLP-1 药物，也没有提供任何特定药物的结果。因此，研究结果不能确定指甲效应与任何一种药物有关。

paras.en: The release cites conference presentations as the sources for both studies; it does not reference a published paper reporting them.
paras.zh: 该新闻稿引用了会议演讲作为这两项研究的来源；它没有引用报道这些问题的已发表论文。

paras.en: The nail study was conducted with institutional support from DUCRAY Laboratories, part of the Pierre Fabre Group, which develops dermatological and hair care products.
paras.zh: 这项指甲研究是在 DUCRAY 实验室的机构支持下进行的，DUCRAY 实验室是皮尔法伯集团的一部分，专门开发皮肤科和护发产品。

paras.en: Researchers now plan to follow patients from the start of treatment. Standardized dermatological examinations and biological monitoring could help establish when changes develop, what contributes to them, and whether they are reversible.
paras.zh: 研究人员现在计划从治疗开始就跟踪患者。标准化的皮肤病学检查和生物监测可以帮助确定变化何时发生、造成变化的原因以及变化是否可逆。

paras.en: Halioua describes the changes as frequent and usually benign. For people noticing nail changes, hair loss or an itchy or red scalp, his advice is to discuss those symptoms with their doctor rather than stop treatment themselves.
paras.zh: Halioua 描述这些变化是频繁且通常是良性的。对于注意到指甲变化、脱发或头皮发痒或发红的人，他的建议是与医生讨论这些症状，而不是自行停止治疗。

articles.title: Einstein Probe reveals a hidden phase of neutron star collisions

paras.en: Einstein Probe reveals a hidden phase of neutron star collisions
paras.zh: 爱因斯坦探测器揭示了中子星碰撞的隐藏阶段

paras.en: - Einstein Probe revealed nearly 10 minutes of soft X-ray activity following a short gamma-ray burst, exposing a phase of neutron star mergers that previous missions may have missed. The prolonged emission could have been powered by a newly formed magnetar and may provide a valuable new counterpart to gravitational-wave signals.
paras.zh: - 爱因斯坦探测器在短暂的伽马射线爆发后揭示了近 10 分钟的软 X 射线活动，揭示了之前的任务可能错过的中子星合并阶段。长时间的发射可能由新形成的磁星提供动力，并可能为引力波信号提供有价值的新对应物。

paras.en: Short gamma-ray bursts, or short GRBs, are believed to occur when two compact objects, such as neutron stars, spiral toward one another before colliding and merging. These extraordinarily violent events produce gravitational waves and rank among the most powerful explosions in the Universe.
paras.zh: 据信，当两个致密天体（例如中子星）在碰撞和合并之前相互螺旋运动时，就会发生短伽马射线爆发或短伽马暴。这些异常剧烈的事件会产生引力波，是宇宙中最强大的爆炸之一。

paras.en: For decades, astronomers have mainly detected these events through their gamma-ray flashes. Their earliest soft X-ray emission has been far more difficult to observe because most narrow-field X-ray telescopes depend on gamma-ray alerts to locate a burst before turning toward it. Einstein Probe's wide-field soft X-ray monitoring has now exposed this previously unseen stage, giving astronomers a direct look at the opening moments of a short GRB.
paras.zh: 几十年来，天文学家主要通过伽马射线闪光探测到这些事件。它们最早的软 X 射线发射很难观测到，因为大多数窄视场 X 射线望远镜都依靠伽马射线警报来定位爆发，然后再转向它。爱因斯坦探测器的宽视场软X射线监测现在已经暴露了这个以前看不见的阶段，使天文学家能够直接观察短GRB的开始时刻。

paras.en: A Half-Second Flash With a Much Longer Aftermath
paras.zh: 半秒的闪光带来更长的余波

paras.en: The event, designated EP250704a/GRB 250704B, caught researchers by surprise on July 4, 2025. An Li, a PhD student at Beijing Normal University and the Transient Advocate for EP, was on duty when the signal appeared.
paras.zh: 2025 年 7 月 4 日，这一事件被指定为 EP250704a/GRB 250704B，令研究人员感到惊讶。信号出现时，北京师范大学博士生、EP 瞬态倡导者李安正在值班。

paras.en: "The event initially appeared to be an ordinary short GRB, producing a bright flash lasting less than half a second that was detected simultaneously in gamma rays by SVOM-GRM and Insight-HXMT and X-rays by EP-WXT," said Li.
paras.zh: “该事件最初似乎是一个普通的短伽马暴，产生持续时间不到半秒的明亮闪光，SVOM-GRM 和 Insight-HXMT 在伽马射线中同时检测到，EP-WXT 在 X 射线中同时检测到，”李说。

paras.en: After receiving the onboard alerts from EP, Li quickly began the initial analysis. What happened next was unexpected.
paras.zh: 收到EP的船上警报后，李很快就开始了初步分析。接下来发生的事情出乎意料。

paras.en: "However, instead of fading away, the source continued emitting episodes of soft X-rays for nearly ten minutes."
paras.zh: “然而，源头并没有消失，而是继续发射软 X 射线近十分钟。”

paras.en: The extended X-ray activity was energetic, but it occurred at wavelengths that conventional gamma-ray instruments would have struggled to detect.
paras.zh: 扩展的 X 射线活动充满活力，但其发生的波长是传统伽马射线仪器难以检测到的。

paras.en: "Although this long-lasting emission carried substantial energy, its spectrum was so soft that, for a burst at this typical cosmological distance, it would have remained below the detection threshold of conventional gamma-ray instruments, such as Swift's Burst Alert Telescope. As a result, previous missions would have recorded only the brief gamma-ray flash, missing the prolonged activity revealed by EP," said Professor Bin-Bin Zhang of Nanjing University, a co-corresponding author of the paper who initiated the in-depth study of the event. "Our observations show that what appears to be a typical short gamma-ray burst can actually conceal a much longer and richer episode of activity at soft X-ray energies."
paras.zh: “虽然这种持久的发射携带了大量的能量，但它的光谱非常柔和，对于这种典型宇宙学距离的爆发，它仍低于传统伽马射线仪器的检测阈值，例如斯威夫特的爆发警报望远镜。因此，以前的任务只能记录短暂的伽马射线闪光，而错过了 EP 揭示的长期活动，”该论文的共同通讯作者、南京大学的张斌斌教授说，他发起了对伽玛射线的深入研究。事件。 “我们的观察表明，看似典型的短伽马射线暴实际上可以掩盖软 X 射线能量下更长、更丰富的活动事件。”

paras.en: Tracking the Explosion Across the Spectrum
paras.zh: 全方位追踪爆炸

paras.en: To determine what had produced the unusual signal, researchers organized an extensive international follow-up campaign using observations ranging from X-ray and optical wavelengths to radio.
paras.zh: 为了确定是什么产生了这种异常信号，研究人员利用从 X 射线、光波长到无线电等各种观测结果组织了一次广泛的国际后续活动。

paras.en: "The coordinated observations across multiwavelengths were essential," said Professor Eleonora Troja of the University of Rome "Tor Vergata," a co-corresponding author of the paper, whose group obtained the key information of the redshift from spectroscopic analysis. "They not only allowed us to identify and study the burst's host galaxy and measure its distance, but also enabled us to rule out an accompanying supernova and provide strong evidence linking this extraordinary X-ray emission to a compact object merger."
paras.zh: 该论文的共同通讯作者、罗马大学“Tor Vergata”的埃莱奥诺拉·特罗哈（Eleonora Troja）教授说：“跨多波长的协调观测至关重要。”他的团队从光谱分析中获得了红移的关键信息。 “它们不仅使我们能够识别和研究爆发的宿主星系并测量其距离，而且使我们能够排除伴随的超新星，并提供强有力的证据将这种非凡的X射线发射与致密天体合并联系起来。”

paras.en: The combined observations helped establish that the unusual X-ray activity was connected to a compact object merger rather than another type of stellar explosion.
paras.zh: 综合观测结果有助于确定这种不寻常的 X 射线活动与致密天体合并有关，而不是与另一种类型的恒星爆炸有关。

paras.en: Evidence for a Long-Lived Central Engine
paras.zh: 长寿中央引擎的证据

paras.en: A closer examination showed that the prolonged X-ray emission was being powered directly by the remnant left behind by the merger, rather than by the outward-moving blast wave.
paras.zh: 更仔细的检查表明，长时间的X射线发射是由合并留下的残余物直接提供动力的，而不是由向外移动的冲击波提供的。

paras.en: Yi-Han Iris Yin, a PhD student in the Department of Physics and the Hong Kong Institute of Astronomy and Astrophysics at The University of Hong Kong, led the analysis of the high-energy emission. As a co-corresponding author, she found that EP250704a's rapidly changing brightness, evolving spectrum, and later X-ray and optical afterglows all pointed to continued activity from the central engine after the initial short GRB had already faded.
paras.zh: 香港大学物理系和香港天文及天体物理研究所的博士生殷一涵领导了对高能发射的分析。作为共同通讯作者，她发现 EP250704a 快速变化的亮度、不断变化的光谱以及后来的 X 射线和光学余辉都表明，在最初的短伽马射线暴消退后，中央引擎的持续活动。

paras.en: "One plausible explanation is that the merger produced a rapidly rotating, highly magnetized neutron star -- known as a magnetar -- that powered the extended X-ray emission and continued energy injection," said Yin.
paras.zh: 尹说：“一个合理的解释是，这次合并产生了一颗快速旋转、高度磁化的中子星——称为磁星——为延长的X射线发射和持续的能量注入提供动力。”

paras.en: Such a magnetar could provide a natural explanation for why the system remained active long after the brief gamma-ray flash had ended.
paras.zh: 这样的磁星可以自然地解释为什么该系统在短暂的伽马射线闪光结束后很长时间仍保持活跃。

paras.en: A New Tool for Multi-Messenger Astronomy
paras.zh: 多信使天文学的新工具

paras.en: The discovery could have important consequences for the study of neutron star mergers and the sources of gravitational waves.
paras.zh: 这一发现可能对中子星合并和引力波来源的研究产生重要影响。

paras.en: Since electromagnetic radiation and gravitational waves were jointly detected from merging neutron stars for the first time in 2017, astronomers have been searching for additional electromagnetic signals that can reveal what occurs during and after these extreme collisions.
paras.zh: 自 2017 年首次联合检测到合并中子星的电磁辐射和引力波以来，天文学家一直在寻找额外的电磁信号，以揭示这些极端碰撞期间和之后发生的情况。

paras.en: "The newly discovered soft X-ray component provides a new probe, indicating that the fast X-ray transients are also electromagnetic counterparts to gravitational-wave sources and may originate from compact object mergers," said Professor Troja.
paras.zh: 特罗哈教授说：“新发现的软X射线成分提供了一种新的探针，表明快速X射线瞬变也是引力波源的电磁对应物，并且可能源自致密天体合并。”

paras.en: The researchers also suggest that this type of extended soft X-ray activity may not be unusual. Similar signals could accompany other short GRBs but may have gone unnoticed because earlier missions were not able to capture prompt emission at energies below the gamma-ray range.
paras.zh: 研究人员还认为，这种延长的软 X 射线活动可能并不罕见。类似的信号可能伴随着其他短伽马暴，但可能没有被注意到，因为早期的任务无法捕获能量低于伽马射线范围的瞬时发射。

paras.en: "This discovery extends our view of neutron star mergers beyond the brief gamma-ray flash," said Yin. "By revealing this previously hidden soft X-ray phase, Einstein Probe opens a new window for studying neutron star merger remnants and may ultimately help constrain the neutron star equation-of-state."
paras.zh: 尹说：“这一发现扩展了我们对中子星合并的看法，超越了短暂的伽马射线闪光。” “通过揭示这个先前隐藏的软X射线相，爱因斯坦探测器为研究中子星合并残余物打开了一个新窗口，并可能最终帮助约束中子星状态方程。”

paras.en: By revealing activity that traditional gamma-ray observations can miss, Einstein Probe may give astronomers a new way to study both the immediate aftermath of neutron star mergers and their connection to gravitational-wave events.
paras.zh: 通过揭示传统伽马射线观测可能错过的活动，爱因斯坦探测器可能为天文学家提供一种新方法来研究中子星合并的直接后果及其与引力波事件的联系。

paras.en: "The findings also demonstrate Einstein Probe's unique capability to uncover new classes of transient phenomena and strengthen its role in the era of multi-messenger astronomy, in which gravitational waves and electromagnetic radiation are studied together to understand some of the most extreme events in the Universe," added Professor Zhang.
paras.zh: 张教授补充道：“这些发现还证明了爱因斯坦探测器具有发现新型瞬态现象的独特能力，并加强了其在多信使天文学时代的作用，在这个时代，引力波和电磁辐射被一起研究，以了解宇宙中一些最极端的事件。”

paras.en: Materials provided by Science China Press. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 资料由中国科学出版社提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。
