paras.en: This tight orbit, 25 times tighter than Earth's around the Sun, may have led to tidal locking so one side of the planet always faces the white dwarf while the other side basks in never-ending night.
paras.zh: 这种紧密的轨道比地球围绕太阳的轨道紧25倍，可能导致了潮汐锁定，因此地球的一侧总是面向白矮星，而另一侧则沐浴在永无休止的夜晚。

paras.en: Defying its designation as 'dead,' the white dwarf is incredibly hot, with an effective temperature of roughly 35,000 degrees Celsius (63,000 degrees Fahrenheit). At only 5 million years old, this youthful stellar cinder has not yet cooled.
paras.zh: 这颗白矮星违背了“死亡”的称号，它的温度非常高，有效温度约为 35,000 摄氏度（63,000 华氏度）。这颗年轻的恒星煤渣只有 500 万年的历史，尚未冷却。

paras.en: So it's basically blow-drying its companion, which may be losing around a billion kilograms of mass per second, perhaps as a comet-like tail that accretes onto the white dwarf.
paras.zh: 所以它基本上是在吹干它的伴星，它可能每秒失去大约十亿公斤的质量，也许是像彗星一样的尾巴，吸积到白矮星上。

paras.en: Of course, this is the same material that was created and cast off by the white dwarf's death throes, completing an astrophysical, Lion-King-like Circle of Life scenario.
paras.zh: 当然，这与白矮星临终前的痛苦所产生和抛弃的物质相同，完成了天体物理学中的狮子王般的生命循环场景。

paras.en: Though the system itself is unique, the process is not. As Sun-like stars fizzle, they may shred and engulf their planets, as per a gruesome mythological motif that may foretell the fate of Earth.
paras.zh: 尽管系统本身是独特的，但过程却并非如此。当类似太阳的恒星熄灭时，它们可能会撕碎并吞没它们的行星，就像一个可怕的神话主题一样，它可能预示着地球的命运。

paras.en: A white dwarf's atmosphere can thus preserve the chemical evidence of its pulverized planets, mirroring the meals found in the fossilized bellies of dinosaurs.
paras.zh: 因此，白矮星的大气层可以保存其粉碎行星的化学证据，反映在恐龙化石腹部中发现的食物。

paras.en: "What's remarkable about the planet around HS 0209+0832 is that this isn't a planet from somewhere else, or a survivor from the system's birth," explains Gänsicke.
paras.zh: “HS 0209+0832 周围行星的非凡之处在于，它不是来自其他地方的行星，也不是该系统诞生后的幸存者，”Gänsicke 解释道。

paras.en: "It looks like it was built from the very material its own star cast off as it died. In a sense, this system has given birth to a new world using the foundations of the old one."
paras.zh: “看起来它是用它自己的恒星死亡时抛弃的材料建造的。从某种意义上说，这个系统在旧世界的基础上诞生了一个新世界。”

paras.en: It may be considered classically poetic that the white dwarf is eating a planet built from its nuclear ashes. Especially since it may have previously consumed a companion star that helped the phoenix planet form in the first place.
paras.zh: 白矮星正在吞噬一颗由其核灰烬建造的行星，这可能被认为是古典诗意的。特别是因为它之前可能消耗了一颗最初帮助凤凰行星形成的伴星。

paras.en: In the perspective of the aforementioned mythological motif, even the power-mad, paranoiac Kronos only devoured the first generation of his children.
paras.zh: 从上述神话母题来看，即使是权力狂、偏执狂的克洛诺斯也只是吞噬了他的第一代孩子。

paras.en: "If the second-generation planet is there, I think it is likely to survive. Eventually the white dwarf will cool and then maintain a consistent temperature, with the planet in its stable habitable zone for millions of years," forecasts Jamie Williams, an astronomer at Warwick and the study's lead author.
paras.zh: “如果第二代行星在那里，我认为它很可能会幸存下来。最终，白矮星将冷却，然后保持恒定的温度，使该行星在稳定的宜居带中保持数百万年，”沃里克大学的天文学家、该研究的主要作者杰米·威廉姆斯预测。

paras.en: Finally, this work informs the search for future bodies that may share a secondary birth, suggesting that the death of a star presents a prologue rather than an epilogue – and placing our own solar mortality in reincarnate terms, as Gänsicke concludes:
paras.zh: 最后，这项工作为寻找可能有二次诞生的未来天体提供了信息，表明恒星的死亡是序幕而不是尾声——并将我们自己的太阳死亡率置于转世术语中，正如甘西克总结的那样：

paras.en: "Finding this one example raises the question of how many more might be out there and might our own Solar System host a second-generation planet formed from the ashes of our Sun."
paras.zh: “发现这个例子提出了一个问题：那里可能还有多少行星，我们的太阳系是否可能拥有一颗由太阳的灰烬形成的第二代行星。”

paras.en: The research has been published in Nature Astronomy.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《自然天文学》上。

articles.title: Higher Levels of 19 Potentially Toxic Chemicals Found in The Teeth of Children With Autism
articles.author: Peter Dockrill

paras.en: While scientists are still continually learning what causes autism, there's already considerable evidence linking environmental exposures to the condition, in addition to genetic factors.
paras.zh: 虽然科学家们仍在不断研究导致自闭症的原因，但除了遗传因素外，已经有大量证据表明环境暴露与自闭症有关。

paras.en: In recent years, a number of environmental risk factors have been identified, and while scientists have yet to demonstrate that any specific agents cause the condition, it's imperative we keep learning more about the potentially toxic substances that seem to be linked to the disorder.
paras.zh: 近年来，已经确定了许多环境风险因素，虽然科学家尚未证明任何特定因素会导致这种情况，但我们必须继续更多地了解似乎与这种疾病有关的潜在有毒物质。

paras.en: In this context, one challenge is that many studies measure chemical exposures by testing blood or urine samples, both of which only provide a short-term window – sometimes just hours – to identify chemicals in the sample before their signature vanishes.
paras.zh: 在这种情况下，一个挑战是许多研究通过测试血液或尿液样本来测量化学物质暴露，这两种方法都只提供了一个短期窗口（有时只有几个小时）来识别样本中的化学物质，然后它们的特征消失。

paras.en: In a new study published in Neurotoxicology and Teratology, scientists found a way around that: analyzing children's primary or 'baby' teeth as a long-term record of chemical exposures that build up as teeth form, which can preserve detectable chemical traces for decades.
paras.zh: 在《神经毒理学和畸胎学》上发表的一项新研究中，科学家们找到了解决这个问题的方法：分析儿童的乳牙或“乳牙”，将其作为牙齿形成过程中积累的化学物质暴露的长期记录，这样可以在数十年内保留可检测到的化学痕迹。

paras.en: "Teeth capture cumulative exposures over long periods of time, whereas blood or urine samples only show a specific window of time," says environmental scientist and first author Lynne Heilbrun from the University of Texas at San Antonio. "We need both."
paras.zh: 德克萨斯大学圣安东尼奥分校的环境科学家、第一作者林恩·海尔布伦 (Lynne Heilbrun) 表示：“牙齿记录了长时间内的累积暴露，而血液或尿液样本只能显示特定的时间窗口。” “我们两者都需要。”

paras.en: In their pilot study, the researchers analyzed shed baby teeth donated by the families of 38 children, 22 of whom had autism, with the other 16 serving as controls.
paras.zh: 在他们的试点研究中，研究人员分析了 38 名儿童家庭捐赠的脱落乳牙，其中 22 名儿童患有自闭症，另外 16 名儿童作为对照。

paras.en: Children's teeth, which are shed between approximately six to 12 years of age, primarily record chemical exposures from the fourth fetal month – when primary teeth start forming while in the uterus – up until about when a child turns three, at which point tooth formation completes.
paras.zh: 儿童的牙齿大约在 6 至 12 岁之间脱落，主要记录从胎儿第四个月（乳牙在子宫内开始形成）到孩子三岁左右（此时牙齿形成完成）的化学暴露。

paras.en: "There are several critical windows of exposure during pregnancy, especially in the first trimester, but it doesn't stop there," Heilbrun says. "The central nervous system continues to develop after birth until around age 25."
paras.zh: “怀孕期间有几个关键的暴露窗口，尤其是在妊娠的前三个月，但它并不止于此，”海尔布伦说。 “中枢神经系统在出生后持续发育直至 25 岁左右。”

paras.en: After cleaning and preparing the donated teeth, the researchers analyzed the teeth using two-dimensional gas chromatography and time-of-flight mass spectrometry, looking for signs of chemical compounds used in pesticides, plastics, fragrances, flame retardants, and sunscreen products, among others.
paras.zh: 在清洁和准备捐赠的牙齿后，研究人员使用二维气相色谱法和飞行时间质谱法对牙齿进行了分析，寻找农药、塑料、香料、阻燃剂和防晒产品等中使用的化合物的迹象。

paras.en: On average, the results showed over 300 toxicants in each tooth sample, but not every toxic substance was found in each child.
paras.zh: 平均而言，结果显示每个牙齿样本中含有超过 300 种有毒物质，但并非每个孩子身上都发现了所有有毒物质。

paras.en: Focusing their analysis on 60 compounds that were present in at least half of the children, the researchers found roughly two-thirds (39) were known substances classified by the EPA as developmental or reproductive toxicants or endocrine-disrupting compounds.
paras.zh: 研究人员重点分析了至少一半儿童体内存在的 60 种化合物，发现大约三分之二 (39) 种已知物质被 EPA 归类为发育或生殖毒物或内分泌干扰化合物。

paras.en: Of those 60 compounds, the vast majority (95 percent) were found in higher concentrations in the teeth from children with autism, although only 19 of the differences detected ultimately passed statistical significance.
paras.zh: 在这 60 种化合物中，绝大多数（95%）在自闭症儿童的牙齿中浓度较高，尽管检测到的差异中只有 19 种最终通过了统计显着性检验。

paras.en: Some of the differences observed were dramatic, however, with one chemical – benzyl benzoate, which is used in personal care products, as a food additive, and in lice and scabies treatments – appearing in the autism group at 722 percent higher concentration than in controls.
paras.zh: 然而，观察到的一些差异是巨大的，一种化学物质——苯甲酸苄酯，用于个人护理产品、食品添加剂以及虱子和疥疮治疗——在自闭症组中的浓度比对照组高 722%。

paras.en: "Compounds significantly higher in cases included OPEs, benzoic acids and esters, phenylpropanes, phthalates, salicylates, ethers, aromatic ketones, and caprolactam," the researchers explain.
paras.zh: 研究人员解释说：“在病例中含量显着升高的化合物包括OPE、苯甲酸和酯、苯丙烷、邻苯二甲酸盐、水杨酸盐、醚、芳香酮和己内酰胺。”

paras.en: "Remarkably, we detected 11 compounds in deciduous teeth that have been previously reported to migrate from baby bottle components… These toxicants, along with other chemicals migrating from numerous baby products, food contact materials, PEX tubing, and indoor furnishings, were among the most frequently detected compounds in cases and controls."
paras.zh: “值得注意的是，我们在乳牙中检测到了 11 种化合物，此前有报道称这些化合物是从婴儿奶瓶成分中迁移出来的……这些有毒物质以及从众多婴儿产品、食品接触材料、PEX 管和室内家具中迁移出来的其他化学物质，是病例和对照中最常检测到的化合物之一。”

paras.en: The findings don't demonstrate that any of these chemicals are causing autism, and the researchers acknowledge that this is only a small pilot study.
paras.zh: 研究结果并未证明这些化学物质会导致自闭症，研究人员承认这只是一项小型试点研究。

paras.en: Nonetheless, the evidence here is concerning, with the researchers noting that many of the toxicants they identified target the brain, liver, and mitochondria.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，这里的证据令人担忧，研究人员指出，他们确定的许多毒物针对的是大脑、肝脏和线粒体。

paras.en: "Our study suggests that children are being chronically and repeatedly exposed to a wider range of developmental toxicants than previously identified in short-term exposure studies," the researchers write.
paras.zh: 研究人员写道：“我们的研究表明，儿童长期且反复接触的发育毒物比之前短期接触研究中发现的毒物范围更广。”

paras.en: "Toxicants leaching from baby bottles, pacifiers, food packaging, and PEX water tubing expose infants through food preparation and daily use of plastic products. Given that pregnant and lactating women increase food and water intake, maternal exposure is likely substantial."
paras.zh: “婴儿奶瓶、奶嘴、食品包装和 PEX 水管中渗出的有毒物质会通过食物准备和日常使用塑料制品而使婴儿接触到有毒物质。鉴于孕妇和哺乳期妇女增加食物和水的摄入量，母亲接触的可能性可能很大。”

paras.en: The authors say future studies are warranted to investigate further – including more research using tooth samples, to help us understand more about how these chemicals might be shaping children's autism risk.
paras.zh: 作者表示，未来的研究有必要进行进一步调查，包括使用牙齿样本进行更多研究，以帮助我们更多地了解这些化学物质如何影响儿童自闭症风险。

paras.en: "Precautionary avoidance of these chemicals, especially among pregnant women and young children, should be a public health priority," the researchers conclude.
paras.zh: 研究人员总结道：“预防性避免使用这些化学物质，尤其是孕妇和幼儿，应该成为公共卫生的优先事项。”

paras.en: The findings are reported in Neurotoxicology and Teratology.
paras.zh: 研究结果发表在《神经毒理学和畸胎学》杂志上。

articles.title: This “golden tree” coral was too strange for any known family

paras.en: This âgolden treeâ coral was too strange for any known family
paras.zh: 对于任何已知的家族来说，这种“金树”珊瑚都太奇怪了

paras.en: - A brilliant yellow coral discovered off Costa Rica proved so unusual that scientists had to create an entirely new family to classify it. The meter-tall colonies rise from seafloors covered in brittle stars, inspiring the Tolkien-inspired name Laurinque elenya, or âgolden tree of the stars.â Advanced genetic analysis revealed that the coral belongs to a previously unknown evolutionary lineage.
paras.zh: - 哥斯达黎加附近发现的一种亮黄色珊瑚非常不寻常，科学家们不得不创建一个全新的科来对其进行分类。这些一米高的珊瑚群从布满海蛇尾的海底升起，托尔金的名字“Laurinque elenya”的灵感来源，即“星星的金树”。先进的基因分析显示，这种珊瑚属于一个以前未知的进化谱系。

paras.en: Scientists surveying underwater mountains off Costa Rica have identified a remarkable new coral that is unlike any known coral family. Its genetic makeup and physical features were so distinctive that researchers created an entirely new family to classify it. The bright yellow coral, which has a branching, tree-like appearance, was discovered between 360 and 529 meters below the Pacific Ocean's surface. The findings are reported in the open-access journal ZooKeys.
paras.zh: 科学家们在哥斯达黎加附近的水下山脉进行勘察时发现了一种非凡的新珊瑚，它与任何已知的珊瑚家族都不同。它的基因组成和身体特征是如此独特，以至于研究人员创建了一个全新的家族来对其进行分类。这种亮黄色的珊瑚具有分枝、树状的外观，是在太平洋海面以下 360 米至 529 米处发现的。研究结果发表在开放获取期刊 ZooKeys 上。

paras.en: Some colonies grow more than a meter tall. Researchers collected specimens using the remotely operated vehicle SuBastian during expeditions in 2019 and 2023 aboard the research vessels Falkor and Falkor (too), which are operated by the Schmidt Ocean Institute. The expeditions explored seamounts near Isla del Coco and along Costa Rica's Pacific margin.
paras.zh: 有些菌落长到一米多高。研究人员在 2019 年和 2023 年的探险期间，在施密特海洋研究所运营的 Falkor 和 Falkor 号科考船上使用遥控车辆 SuBastian 采集了标本。探险队探索了科科岛附近和哥斯达黎加太平洋边缘的海山。

paras.en: The coral was especially abundant on rocky outcrops where brittle stars covered nearly every available surface. Against this shimmering backdrop, the bright yellow branches appeared to rise from the seafloor like glowing trees surrounded by stars.
paras.zh: 岩石露头上的珊瑚尤其丰富，海蛇尾几乎覆盖了所有可用的表面。在这闪闪发光的背景下，亮黄色的树枝似乎从海底升起，就像被星星包围的发光树一样。

paras.en: That unusual scene helped inspire the scientific name. The new genus, Laurinque, is derived from "Laurinquë," which means "golden tree" in Quenya, the Elvish language created by J.R.R. Tolkien for The Lord of the Rings and The Silmarillion. Researchers selected the name because of the coral's vivid yellow color and tree-like shape.
paras.zh: 这个不寻常的场景激发了科学名称的灵感。新属 Laurinque 源自“Laurinquë”，在昆雅语（由 J.R.R. 创建的精灵语）中意为“金树”。托尔金的《指环王》和《精灵宝钻》。研究人员之所以选择这个名字，是因为这种珊瑚具有鲜艳的黄色和树状的形状。

paras.en: Its species name, elenya, means "stellar" or "of the stars" in Quenya. The name refers to the dense populations of brittle stars surrounding the coral colonies. Together, the genus and species names reflect what the researchers described as an almost mystical elvish landscape on the deep ocean floor.
paras.zh: 它的物种名称，elenya，在昆雅语中的意思是“恒星”或“星星的”。这个名字指的是珊瑚群周围密集的海蛇尾群。属名和种名共同反映了研究人员所描述的深海海底近乎神秘的精灵景观。

paras.en: Determining where the coral fit on the evolutionary family tree proved far more complicated than expected. Scientists initially sequenced three genes commonly used to identify and classify corals. Instead of pointing toward the same group, each gene suggested a different and unrelated family.
paras.zh: 事实证明，确定珊瑚在进化谱系中的位置比预期要复杂得多。科学家最初对常用于识别和分类珊瑚的三个基因进行了测序。每个基因并不是指向同一个群体，而是指向一个不同且不相关的家族。

paras.en: Because those results were unusually inconsistent, the researchers used phylogenomics, a method that compares hundreds of genes at the same time. The broader genetic analysis finally clarified the coral's evolutionary position.
paras.zh: 由于这些结果异常不一致，研究人员使用了系统基因组学，这是一种同时比较数百个基因的方法。更广泛的遗传分析最终阐明了珊瑚的进化地位。

paras.en: The results showed that the species does not belong to any previously recognized coral family. It represents a distinct evolutionary lineage that is most closely related to Eunicellidae, but its genetics and anatomy differ enough to justify the creation of a new family called Laurinqueidae. Researchers also established the new genus Laurinque specifically for the species.
paras.zh: 结果表明，该物种不属于任何先前公认的珊瑚科。它代表了与 Eunicellidae 最密切相关的独特进化谱系，但其遗传学和解剖学差异足以证明创建一个名为 Laurinqueidae 的新科是合理的。研究人员还专门为该物种建立了新属Laurinque。

paras.en: Dr. Odalisca Breedy of the Universidad de Costa Rica (lead researcher on the study) said:
paras.zh: 哥斯达黎加大学的 Odalisca Breedy 博士（该研究的首席研究员）表示：

paras.en: "I saw the octocoral garden for the first time in 2019 and I was impressed by the beauty of the landscape, which inspired, later the elvish name of the taxa. I thought the species could belong to a known family and genera, but after the preliminar morphological analysis I realised that it was something very different that I could not match with the known taxa.
paras.zh: “我在 2019 年第一次看到八珊瑚花园，美丽的风景给我留下了深刻的印象，这启发了后来该类群的精灵名称。我认为该物种可能属于一个已知的科和属，但经过初步的形态分析后，我意识到它是非常不同的东西，我无法与已知的类群匹配。

paras.en: "In 2023 we collected more samples and thanks to the exhaustive molecular analyses made by my colleagues, Cathy McFadden, Catalina Murillo and Andrea Quattrini, we were able to determine the taxonomic placement of the stunning species, in one of the most enigmatic sites."
paras.zh: “2023 年，我们收集了更多样本，得益于我的同事 Cathy McFadden、Catalina Murillo 和 Andrea Quattrini 所做的详尽分子分析，我们能够确定这个令人惊叹的物种在最神秘的地点之一的分类位置。”

paras.en: Costa Rica's Deep Sea Still Holds Surprises
paras.zh: 哥斯达黎加的深海仍然充满惊喜

paras.en: Dr. Breedy led the research with an international team of collaborators. The Schmidt Ocean Institute supported the expeditions, along with a National Geographic Society research grant.
paras.zh: 布里迪博士与国际合作者团队领导了这项研究。施密特海洋研究所支持了这些探险活动，并提供了国家地理学会的研究资助。

paras.en: The find joins a growing number of previously undocumented species discovered on Costa Rica's seamounts. It also highlights how much of the deep ocean remains poorly explored, even though it covers roughly two-thirds of Earth's surface.
paras.zh: 这一发现与在哥斯达黎加海山发现的越来越多以前未记录的物种一样。它还强调了尽管深海覆盖了地球表面约三分之二的面积，但仍有多少深海尚未得到充分勘探。

paras.en: Coral gardens like this one are considered vulnerable marine ecosystems. Their complex three-dimensional structures provide habitat for many other forms of deep-sea life, making them important centers of biodiversity in environments that scientists are only beginning to understand.
paras.zh: 像这样的珊瑚花园被认为是脆弱的海洋生态系统。它们复杂的三维结构为许多其他形式的深海生物提供了栖息地，使它们成为科学家刚刚开始了解的环境中重要的生物多样性中心。

paras.zh: 材料由 Pensoft Publishers 提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

articles.title: Scientists accidentally discover a genetic code that breaks the rules of life

paras.en: Scientists accidentally discover a genetic code that breaks the rules of life
paras.zh: 科学家意外发现了打破生命规则的遗传密码

paras.en: - Scientists accidentally discovered a microscopic organism with a genetic code that breaks a rule researchers thought was nearly universal. While testing a new DNA sequencing technique, they examined a previously unknown protist collected from a freshwater pond at Oxford University. To their surprise, the organism uses two genetic signals that normally mark the end of a gene to encode two entirely different amino acids instead. These signals were previously thought to evolve together, making the discovery particularly remarkable.
paras.zh: - 科学家们意外地发现了一种微生物，其遗传密码打破了研究人员认为几乎普遍存在的规则。在测试新的 DNA 测序技术时，他们检查了从牛津大学淡水池塘收集的以前未知的原生生物。令他们惊讶的是，该生物体使用通常标记基因末端的两个遗传信号来编码两个完全不同的氨基酸。此前人们认为这些信号是一起进化的，这使得这一发现尤为引人注目。

paras.en: A routine experiment involving a microscopic organism from a freshwater pond led scientists to an extraordinary genetic discovery. The tiny creature was found to interpret DNA instructions in a way researchers had never documented before, challenging a long held assumption about how the genetic code works.
paras.zh: 一项涉及淡水池塘微生物的常规实验使科学家们获得了非凡的基因发现。人们发现这种微小生物能够以研究人员以前从未记录过的方式解释 DNA 指令，这挑战了长期以来关于遗传密码如何运作的假设。

paras.en: The surprise came when scientists examined a previously unknown protist called Oligohymenophorea sp. PL0344. Two genetic signals that ordinarily tell cells to stop making proteins had taken on completely different functions. Even more remarkably, the signals had been reassigned to two different amino acids, breaking a pattern scientists believed was closely linked by evolution.
paras.zh: 当科学家们检查一种以前未知的原生生物（称为寡膜藻属 sp.）时，令人惊讶的事情发生了。 PL0344。通常告诉细胞停止制造蛋白质的两种遗传信号具有完全不同的功能。更值得注意的是，这些信号被重新分配给两种不同的氨基酸，打破了科学家认为与进化密切相关的模式。

paras.en: The discovery, published in PLOS Genetics in October 2023, revealed an unexpected level of flexibility in one of life's most fundamental biological systems. Subsequent research has uncovered additional genetic code variations in related microorganisms, suggesting that many more surprises could be waiting in the microscopic world.
paras.zh: 这一发现于 2023 年 10 月发表在《PLOS Genetics》上，揭示了生命最基本的生物系统之一具有意想不到的灵活性。随后的研究发现了相关微生物中额外的遗传密码变异，这表明微观世界可能有更多的惊喜等待着。

paras.en: An Accidental Genetic Discovery in a Freshwater Pond
paras.zh: 淡水池塘中的意外基因发现

paras.en: Dr. Jamie McGowan, who was a postdoctoral scientist at the Earlham Institute, made the discovery while studying a protist collected from a pond at Oxford University Parks in England.
paras.zh: 厄勒姆研究所的博士后科学家杰米·麦高恩博士在研究从英国牛津大学公园的一个池塘中收集的原生生物时发现了这一发现。

paras.en: The project had originally been designed to test a DNA sequencing method capable of analyzing extremely small quantities of genetic material, potentially from just one cell. McGowan worked alongside scientists at the Earlham Institute and a research group led by Professor Thomas Richards at the University of Oxford.
paras.zh: 该项目最初的目的是测试一种 DNA 测序方法，该方法能够分析极少量的遗传物质（可能仅来自一个细胞）。麦高恩与厄勒姆研究所的科学家以及牛津大学托马斯·理查兹教授领导的研究小组一起工作。

paras.en: Rather than investigating genetic code evolution, the researchers were trying to improve the tools available for studying organisms that are difficult to grow and analyze in laboratories.
paras.zh: 研究人员并没有研究遗传密码的进化，而是试图改进可用于研究难以在实验室中生长和分析的生物体的工具。

paras.en: But when they assembled and examined the organism's genome, they noticed something unexpected. The protist belonged to a previously unidentified species, and its genetic instructions appeared to operate according to an unusual set of rules.
paras.zh: 但当他们组装并检查该生物体的基因组时，他们注意到了一些意想不到的事情。这种原生生物属于一个以前未被识别的物种，它的遗传指令似乎按照一套不寻常的规则运作。

paras.en: Dr. McGowan said: "It's sheer luck we chose this protist to test our sequencing pipeline, and it just shows what's out there, highlighting just how little we know about the genetics of protists."
paras.zh: 麦高恩博士说：“我们选择这个原生生物来测试我们的测序流程真是太幸运了，它只是展示了那里的情况，凸显了我们对原生生物的遗传学知之甚少。”

paras.en: What Are Protists, and Why Are They So Unusual?
paras.zh: 什么是原生生物，为什么它们如此不寻常？

paras.en: Protists are among the most diverse and least understood groups of organisms on Earth. Many consist of just one cell and are too small to see without a microscope. Familiar examples include amoebas, various algae, and diatoms, which are microscopic organisms often found in aquatic environments.
paras.zh: 原生生物是地球上最多样化和最不为人所知的生物群体之一。许多细胞仅由一个细胞组成，而且太小，没有显微镜就无法看到。常见的例子包括变形虫、各种藻类和硅藻，它们是水生环境中常见的微生物。

paras.en: However, not all protists are tiny. The broad category also includes organisms such as kelp, slime molds, and red algae, some of which grow into large, complex structures.
paras.zh: 然而，并非所有原生生物都很小。这一大类还包括海带、粘菌和红藻等生物体，其中一些会长成大型复杂的结构。

paras.en: The group is so varied that scientists generally define its members by excluding other major branches of life.
paras.zh: 该群体的多样性如此之大，以至于科学家通常通过排除生命的其他主要分支来定义其成员。

paras.en: "The definition of a protist is loose -- essentially it is any eukaryotic organism which is not an animal, plant, or fungus," said Dr. McGowan. "This is obviously very general, and that's because protists are an extremely variable group.
paras.zh: “原生生物的定义很宽松——本质上它是除动物、植物或真菌之外的任何真核生物，”麦高恩博士说。 “这显然是非常普遍的，因为原生生物是一个极其可变的群体。

paras.en: "Some are more closely related to animals, some more closely related to plants. There are hunters and prey, parasites and hosts, swimmers and sitters, and there are those with varied diets while others photosynthesize. Basically, we can make very few generalizations."
paras.zh: “有些与动物关系更密切，有些与植物关系更密切。有猎人和猎物，有寄生虫和寄主，有游泳者和保姆，有的饮食不同，有的则进行光合作用。基本上，我们无法做出概括。”

paras.en: Eukaryotes are organisms whose cells contain a nucleus, a specialized compartment that houses most of their genetic material. Humans, other animals, plants, fungi, and protists all belong to this broad category.
paras.zh: 真核生物是细胞含有细胞核的生物体，细胞核是一个容纳其大部分遗传物质的特殊隔室。人类、其他动物、植物、真菌和原生生物都属于这个广泛的类别。

paras.en: The organism at the center of the discovery belongs to a group of protists called ciliates. These creatures typically swim using tiny hair-like structures known as cilia, which move in coordinated patterns to propel them through water.
paras.zh: 这一发现的核心生物体属于一群称为纤毛虫的原生生物。这些生物通常使用称为纤毛的微小毛发状结构游泳，纤毛以协调的方式移动以推动它们在水中前进。

paras.en: Ciliates are widespread in freshwater and marine environments. They are also particularly interesting to geneticists because some have evolved unusual ways of interpreting DNA instructions.
paras.zh: 纤毛虫广泛存在于淡水和海洋环境中。它们对遗传学家来说也特别有趣，因为其中一些进化出了解释 DNA 指令的不同寻常的方式。

paras.en: How the Genetic Code Tells Cells When to Stop
paras.zh: 遗传密码如何告诉细胞何时停止

paras.en: To understand why this discovery was so unexpected, it helps to know how cells turn genetic information into proteins.
paras.zh: 要理解为什么这一发现如此出人意料，需要了解细胞如何将遗传信息转化为蛋白质。

paras.en: DNA acts like an instruction manual, storing the information that cells need to build and maintain their structures. However, those instructions must be translated into physical molecules before they can carry out biological functions.
paras.zh: DNA 就像一本说明书，存储细胞构建和维持其结构所需的信息。然而，这些指令必须先转化为物理分子，然后才能执行生物学功能。

paras.en: The process begins when a section of DNA is copied into messenger RNA, a molecule that carries genetic instructions to the cell's protein-producing machinery.
paras.zh: 当一段 DNA 被复制到信使 RNA 中时，这个过程就开始了，信使 RNA 是一种向细胞的蛋白质生产机器携带遗传指令的分子。

paras.en: A structure called the ribosome then reads the RNA sequence three letters at a time. Each group of three letters is known as a codon, and most codons specify one of the amino acids that serve as the building blocks of proteins.
paras.zh: 然后，一种称为核糖体的结构一次读取 RNA 序列中的三个字母。每组三个字母称为一个密码子，大多数密码子指定作为蛋白质构建块的氨基酸之一。

paras.en: As amino acids are connected, they form a chain that can fold into a three-dimensional structure. The resulting protein may function as an enzyme, provide structural support, transport molecules, or perform countless other cellular tasks.
paras.zh: 当氨基酸连接时，它们形成一条可以折叠成三维结构的链。所得蛋白质可以充当酶、提供结构支持、运输分子或执行无数其他细胞任务。

paras.en: In DNA notation, a protein-coding sequence commonly begins with a start codon (ATG) and ends with a stop codon (normally TAA, TAG, or TGA).
paras.zh: 在 DNA 表示法中，蛋白质编码序列通常以起始密码子 (ATG) 开始，以终止密码子（通常为 TAA、TAG 或 TGA）结束。

paras.en: These stop codons work like punctuation marks. They tell the ribosome that it has reached the end of the instructions for a particular protein and should release the completed chain.
paras.zh: 这些终止密码子的作用类似于标点符号。他们告诉核糖体它已经到达特定蛋白质指令的末尾，应该释放完整的链。

paras.en: When the instructions are copied into RNA, the letter T is replaced by U. Consequently, the corresponding stop codons in RNA are written as UAA, UAG, and UGA.
paras.zh: 当指令被复制到RNA中时，字母T被U替换。因此，RNA中相应的终止密码子被写为UAA、UAG和UGA。

paras.en: Across most forms of life, these signals have maintained the same basic functions for an extraordinarily long period of evolutionary history.
paras.zh: 在大多数生命形式中，这些信号在极其漫长的进化史上都保持着相同的基本功能。

paras.en: But nature has occasionally found ways around the usual rules.
paras.zh: 但大自然有时会找到绕过通常规则的方法。

paras.en: Scientists Find Two Genetic Stop Signals With Different Meanings
paras.zh: 科学家发现两种具有不同含义的基因停止信号

paras.en: Researchers have known for decades that some organisms use modified versions of the genetic code. These variations are uncommon across life as a whole, but ciliates are particularly rich in examples.
paras.zh: 几十年来，研究人员已经知道一些生物体使用遗传密码的修改版本。这些变化在整个生命中并不常见，但纤毛虫的例子尤其丰富。

paras.en: In certain ciliates, stop codons have evolved to specify amino acids instead of terminating protein production.
paras.zh: 在某些纤毛虫中，终止密码子已经进化为指定氨基酸而不是终止蛋白质生产。

paras.en: Until relatively recently, one pattern appeared especially consistent. Two of the conventional stop codons, TAA and TAG, almost always retained the same meaning. When their functions changed, both generally came to specify the same amino acid.
paras.zh: 直到最近，一种模式显得特别一致。两个常规终止密码子 TAA 和 TAG 几乎总是保留相同的含义。当它们的功能发生变化时，两者通常都会指定相同的氨基酸。

paras.en: This suggested that the two signals were constrained to evolve together.
paras.zh: 这表明这两个信号被迫一起演化。

paras.en: "In almost every other case we know of, TAA and TAG change in tandem," explained Dr. McGowan. "When they aren't stop codons, they each specify the same amino acid."
paras.zh: “在我们所知的几乎所有其他案例中，TAA 和 TAG 都是同步变化的，”McGowan 博士解释道。 “当它们不是终止密码子时，它们各自指定相同的氨基酸。”

paras.en: The genome of Oligohymenophorea sp. PL0344 told a different story.
paras.zh: Oligohymenophorea sp. 的基因组。 PL0344 讲述了一个不同的故事。

paras.en: Instead of functioning as stop signals, TAA and TAG appeared to encode entirely different amino acids. TAA specified lysine, while TAG specified glutamic acid.
paras.zh: TAA 和 TAG 似乎编码完全不同的氨基酸，而不是充当终止信号。 TAA 指定赖氨酸，而 TAG 指定谷氨酸。

paras.en: Both amino acids are common components of proteins, but they have different chemical properties and biological roles.
paras.zh: 这两种氨基酸都是蛋白质的常见成分，但它们具有不同的化学性质和生物学作用。

paras.en: Meanwhile, TGA remained the organism's only conventional stop codon.
paras.zh: 与此同时，TGA 仍然是生物体唯一的常规终止密码子。

paras.en: The findings represented the first reported example of a genetic code in which both TAA and TAG had been reassigned to encode two different amino acids.
paras.zh: 这些发现代表了第一个报道的遗传密码的例子，其中TAA和TAG都被重新分配以编码两种不同的氨基酸。

paras.en: That distinction matters because it shows that the evolutionary relationship between the two codons is not as restrictive as scientists had assumed.
paras.zh: 这种区别很重要，因为它表明两个密码子之间的进化关系并不像科学家假设的那样具有限制性。

paras.en: "This is extremely unusual," Dr. McGowan said. "We're not aware of any other case where these stop codons are linked to two different amino acids. It breaks some of the rules we thought we knew about gene translation -- these two codons were thought to be coupled.
paras.zh: “这非常不寻常，”麦高恩博士说。 “我们不知道这些终止密码子与两个不同氨基酸相关的任何其他情况。它打破了我们认为我们了解的基因翻译的一些规则——这两个密码子被认为是耦合的。

paras.en: How This Microscopic Organism Makes the Unusual Code Work
paras.zh: 这种微生物如何使不寻常的代码发挥作用

paras.en: Further investigation revealed clues about how the protist manages to function with its unconventional genetic instructions.
paras.zh: 进一步的研究揭示了原生生物如何利用其非常规遗传指令发挥作用的线索。

paras.en: The researchers identified specialized transfer RNA genes associated with the reassigned codons. Transfer RNA molecules act as interpreters during protein production, helping match the instructions in messenger RNA with the correct amino acids.
paras.zh: 研究人员确定了与重新分配的密码子相关的专门转移 RNA 基因。转移 RNA 分子在蛋白质生产过程中充当解释器，帮助将信使 RNA 中的指令与正确的氨基酸相匹配。

paras.en: Their presence supported the conclusion that the unusual genetic code was a genuine feature of the organism rather than a sequencing error.
paras.zh: 它们的存在支持了这样的结论：不寻常的遗传密码是生物体的真正特征，而不是测序错误。

paras.en: The team also found an unexpectedly high number of TGA stop codons in DNA regions immediately following protein-coding sequences.
paras.zh: 研究小组还在紧随蛋白质编码序列的 DNA 区域中发现了数量出乎意料的大量 TGA 终止密码子。

paras.en: These additional stop signals could act as a backup system. If the ribosome accidentally continues reading beyond the intended end of a protein, a second stop codon may prevent it from extending the protein too far.
paras.zh: 这些额外的停止信号可以充当备用系统。如果核糖体意外地继续读取超出蛋白质的预期末端，第二个终止密码子可能会阻止其将蛋白质延伸得太远。

paras.en: That protection could be particularly valuable in an organism that relies on only one of the three conventional stop codons.
paras.zh: 这种保护对于仅依赖三个常规终止密码子之一的生物体可能特别有价值。

paras.en: Although the researchers could not establish exactly how the unusual code evolved, the findings demonstrated that the machinery responsible for translating genetic information can be far more adaptable than previously appreciated.
paras.zh: 尽管研究人员无法确切地确定这种不寻常的代码是如何进化的，但研究结果表明，负责翻译遗传信息的机器的适应性可能比以前想象的要强得多。

paras.en: Follow-Up Research Reveals More Genetic Code Surprises
paras.zh: 后续研究揭示了更多令人惊讶的遗传密码

paras.en: The original discovery also opened the door to a broader question: How many other microorganisms are using genetic codes that scientists have not yet recognized?
paras.zh: 最初的发现也为一个更广泛的问题打开了大门：有多少其他微生物正在使用科学家尚未识别的遗传密码？

paras.en: In December 2024, McGowan and colleagues published additional findings in PLOS Genetics showing that unusual genetic code changes had occurred independently in several other ciliate lineages.
paras.zh: 2024 年 12 月，McGowan 及其同事在 PLOS Genetics 上发表了更多发现，表明其他几个纤毛虫谱系独立发生了不寻常的遗传密码变化。

paras.en: The team investigated genetic information from a group of ciliates known as Phyllopharyngea, including genomic data gathered through the TARA Oceans project, an international effort to study marine life and its genetic diversity.
paras.zh: 该团队研究了一群被称为 Phyllopharyngea 的纤毛虫的遗传信息，包括通过 TARA 海洋项目收集的基因组数据，该项目是一项研究海洋生物及其遗传多样性的国际努力。

paras.en: Their analysis identified three previously uncultivated ciliate species in which UAG, normally a stop codon, appeared to specify leucine instead.
paras.zh: 他们的分析确定了三种以前未培养的纤毛虫物种，其中 UAG（通常是终止密码子）似乎指定了亮氨酸。

paras.en: These organisms came from samples associated with the Arctic and Southern Oceans.
paras.zh: 这些生物体来自与北冰洋和南大洋相关的样本。

paras.en: The researchers also examined existing genomic datasets and identified two additional ciliates, Hartmannula sinica and Trochilia petrani, in which UAG appeared to encode glutamine.
paras.zh: 研究人员还检查了现有的基因组数据集，并确定了另外两种纤毛虫：中华哈特曼努拉 (Hartmannula sinica) 和彼得拉尼 (Trochilia petrani)，其中 UAG 似乎编码谷氨酰胺。

paras.en: Evolutionary comparisons suggested that these changes arose independently on at least three occasions.
paras.zh: 进化比较表明这些变化至少在三个场合独立出现。

paras.en: Importantly, the genetic codes were not identical to the unusual system found in Oligohymenophorea sp. PL0344. In the five ciliates examined in the 2024 research, UAA remained a stop signal while UAG had acquired a different meaning.
paras.zh: 重要的是，遗传密码与寡膜藻属物种中发现的不寻常系统并不相同。 PL0344。在 2024 年研究中检查的五种纤毛虫中，UAA 仍然是停止信号，而 UAG 则具有不同的含义。

paras.en: Even so, the findings provided further evidence that these two genetic signals do not always have to evolve together.
paras.zh: 即便如此，这些发现提供了进一步的证据，表明这两种遗传信号并不总是必须一起进化。

paras.en: Rather than being an isolated curiosity, the original discovery had helped illuminate a much wider pattern of genetic code flexibility among ciliates.
paras.zh: 最初的发现并不是一个孤立的好奇心，而是帮助阐明了纤毛虫遗传密码灵活性的更广泛的模式。

paras.en: Scientists Are Still Uncovering Hidden Protist Diversity
paras.zh: 科学家仍在发现隐藏的原生生物多样性

paras.en: The search for unexpected biology in microscopic organisms has continued beyond the genetic code itself.
paras.zh: 对微生物中意想不到的生物学的探索已经超越了遗传密码本身。

paras.en: In March 2026, researchers from the Earlham Institute and the University of Oxford reported another discovery made possible by techniques designed to sequence individual cells.
paras.zh: 2026 年 3 月，厄勒姆研究所和牛津大学的研究人员报告了通过设计对单个细胞进行测序的技术而实现的另一项发现。

paras.en: Their study, published in Microbial Genomics, investigated Bodo, a group of common protists found in freshwater, brackish water, and soil.
paras.zh: 他们的研究发表在《微生物基因组学》上，研究了博多（Bodo），这是一种在淡水、咸水和土壤中发现的常见原生生物。

paras.en: By analyzing just seven uncultured cells, the scientists identified three previously unrecognized evolutionary lineages, each associated with its own distinct bacterial partner living inside the organism.
paras.zh: 通过分析七个未培养的细胞，科学家们确定了三个以前未被识别的进化谱系，每个谱系都与生活在生物体内部的独特细菌伙伴相关。

paras.en: The work did not demonstrate the same genetic code changes found in PL0344. Instead, it showed how much biological diversity can remain hidden when researchers rely primarily on organisms that are easy to cultivate in laboratories.
paras.zh: 这项工作没有证明 PL0344 中发现的相同遗传密码变化。相反，它表明，当研究人员主要依赖易于在实验室培养的生物体时，可以隐藏多少生物多样性。

paras.en: Together with the genetic code discoveries, these findings demonstrate the value of examining microorganisms that have received relatively little scientific attention.
paras.zh: 与遗传密码的发现一起，这些发现证明了研究相对较少受到科学关注的微生物的价值。

paras.en: Better sequencing technologies could reveal additional unconventional genetic codes, unexpected relationships between organisms, and previously unknown ways that cells function.
paras.zh: 更好的测序技术可以揭示额外的非常规遗传密码、生物体之间意想不到的关系以及以前未知的细胞功能方式。

paras.en: Nature May Have More Genetic Rules to Break
paras.zh: 大自然可能还有更多遗传规则需要打破

paras.en: For scientists, unusual genetic codes offer more than biological curiosities. They provide opportunities to investigate why the genetic code is so consistent across most forms of life and how evolutionary changes can sometimes alter its fundamental instructions.
paras.zh: 对于科学家来说，不寻常的遗传密码提供的不仅仅是生物学上的好奇心。它们提供了研究为什么遗传密码在大多数生命形式中如此一致以及进化变化有时如何改变其基本指令的机会。

paras.en: Understanding these natural variations could also inform efforts in synthetic biology, where researchers attempt to modify genetic codes to give cells new capabilities or enable them to produce proteins with unusual properties.
paras.zh: 了解这些自然变异也可以为合成生物学的研究提供信息，研究人员试图修改遗传密码以赋予细胞新的能力或使它们能够产生具有不寻常特性的蛋白质。

paras.en: However, the evolutionary forces responsible for the extraordinary diversity of genetic codes among ciliates remain incompletely understood.
paras.zh: 然而，导致纤毛虫遗传密码异常多样性的进化力量仍不完全清楚。

paras.en: What began as a routine sequencing experiment ultimately revealed that even some of biology's most familiar rules have remarkable exceptions.
paras.zh: 最初的常规测序实验最终表明，即使是一些最熟悉的生物学规则也有显着的例外。

paras.en: "Scientists attempt to engineer new genetic codes -- but they are also out there in nature. There are fascinating things we can find, if we look for them.
paras.zh: “科学家试图设计新的遗传密码——但它们也存在于自然界中。如果我们寻找它们，我们可以发现一些令人着迷的东西。

paras.en: "Or, in this case, when we are not looking for them."
paras.zh: “或者，在这种情况下，当我们不寻找他们时。”

paras.zh: 材料由厄勒姆研究所提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

articles.title: FDA-approved epilepsy drug may help reverse osteoarthritis damage

paras.en: FDA-approved epilepsy drug may help reverse osteoarthritis damage
paras.zh: FDA 批准的癫痫药物可能有助于逆转骨关节炎损伤

paras.en: - Researchers at Yale have identified a promising new approach to osteoarthritis that could do more than simply ease pain. The epilepsy drug lacosamide appears to block a protein involved in both pain signaling and cartilage destruction, helping damaged joints shift back toward repair in preclinical studies.
paras.zh: - 耶鲁大学的研究人员发现了一种有前景的治疗骨关节炎的新方法，它的作用不仅仅是缓解疼痛。在临床前研究中，癫痫药物拉科酰胺似乎可以阻断一种与疼痛信号传导和软骨破坏有关的蛋白质，帮助受损的关节恢复修复。

paras.en: For millions of people with osteoarthritis, pain and stiffness can make everyday activities increasingly difficult. Common treatments, including over-the-counter medications and steroid injections, may reduce symptoms for a time, but they do not prevent the underlying joint damage from progressing.
paras.zh: 对于数百万患有骨关节炎的人来说，疼痛和僵硬会使日常活动变得越来越困难。常见的治疗方法，包括非处方药和类固醇注射，可能会暂时减轻症状，但不能阻止潜在的关节损伤进一步发展。

paras.en: New research from Yale suggests a different approach. In a study published in Bioactive Materials, scientists found that the medication lacosamide can serve two purposes in osteoarthritis, reducing joint pain while also reversing cartilage damage. The effects were particularly strong when the drug was delivered directly into the joint using a specialized hydrogel.
paras.zh: 耶鲁大学的新研究提出了一种不同的方法。在《生物活性材料》杂志上发表的一项研究中，科学家发现拉科酰胺药物在治疗骨关节炎方面有两个作用，减轻关节疼痛，同时逆转软骨损伤。当使用特殊的水凝胶将药物直接输送到关节时，效果尤其强烈。

paras.en: Osteoarthritis is often called a condition caused by wear and tear, but that description leaves out much of the biology involved.
paras.zh: 骨关节炎通常被称为由磨损引起的病症，但这种描述忽略了所涉及的大部分生物学内容。

paras.en: Within a healthy joint, cells known as chondrocytes help maintain cartilage by continuously balancing the creation of new tissue with the removal of old material. Osteoarthritis disrupts that balance. Cartilage begins to break down faster than it can be replaced, eventually allowing bones to rub against one another. As the disease advances, some patients may ultimately require joint reconstruction procedures such as a total knee replacement.
paras.zh: 在健康的关节内，软骨细胞通过不断平衡新组织的产生与旧材料的去除来帮助维持软骨。骨关节炎破坏了这种平衡。软骨开始分解的速度快于其替换的速度，最终导致骨头相互摩擦。随着疾病的进展，一些患者最终可能需要进行关节重建手术，例如全膝关节置换术。

paras.en: "There is a major unmet need in osteoarthritis," says the study's principal investigator and Charles W. Ohse Professor of Orthopaedics & Rehabilitation, Chuan-Ju Liu, PhD. "We need therapies that don't just mask pain but actually change how the disease progresses."
paras.zh: “骨关节炎方面存在重大未满足的需求，”该研究的首席研究员、Charles W. Ohse 骨科与康复教授 Chuan-Ju Liu 博士说。 “我们需要的疗法不仅能掩盖疼痛，还能真正改变疾病的进展方式。”

paras.en: At present, no medicine approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration can both stop osteoarthritis pain and prevent the structural breakdown of cartilage. The work led by Liu suggests that it may be possible to address both problems with a single therapeutic strategy.
paras.zh: 目前，美国食品和药物管理局批准的药物还没有能够既止骨关节炎疼痛又防止软骨结构破坏。刘领导的工作表明，有可能用单一的治疗策略来解决这两个问题。

paras.en: The researchers repurposed an existing medication and paired it with an advanced gel designed to keep the drug inside the joint. The approach could potentially preserve joint tissue while delivering sustained pain relief without relying on addictive opioids.
paras.zh: 研究人员重新利用了现有药物，并将其与一种先进的凝胶配对，旨在将药物保留在关节内。该方法有可能保护关节组织，同时提供持续的疼痛缓解，而无需依赖成瘾的阿片类药物。

paras.en: A protein linked to pain and cartilage loss
paras.zh: 一种与疼痛和软骨损失有关的蛋白质

paras.en: The research focuses on Nav1.7, a protein that functions as a sodium channel. These channels act as microscopic gates in cell membranes and play an important role in electrical signaling.
paras.zh: 该研究的重点是 Nav1.7，一种充当钠通道的蛋白质。这些通道充当细胞膜中的微观大门，在电信号传导中发挥重要作用。

paras.en: Nav1.7 was long thought to operate primarily in specialized nerve cells that transmit pain signals to the brain. More recent work from Liu and his team, however, revealed that the protein is also highly active in chondrocytes, the cells responsible for maintaining cartilage.
paras.zh: 长期以来，人们认为 Nav1.7 主要在向大脑传输疼痛信号的特殊神经细胞中发挥作用。然而，刘和他的团队最近的工作表明，这种蛋白质在软骨细胞（负责维持软骨的细胞）中也高度活跃。

paras.en: Nav1.7 is relatively quiet in healthy joints. In osteoarthritis, however, its activity increases substantially. The researchers found that this heightened activity can intensify pain signaling while also pushing chondrocytes toward breaking down the cartilage they would normally help preserve.
paras.zh: Nav1.7 在健康的关节中相对安静。然而，在骨关节炎中，其活性显着增加。研究人员发现，这种活动的增强可以增强疼痛信号传导，同时也推动软骨细胞分解它们通常有助于保存的软骨。

paras.en: That makes Nav1.7 an unusual therapeutic target because it appears to influence both the sensation of pain and the physical deterioration of joint tissue.
paras.zh: 这使得 Nav1.7 成为一个不寻常的治疗靶点，因为它似乎会影响疼痛感和关节组织的物理恶化。

paras.en: "When Nav1.7 becomes dysregulated, it contributes to both joint degeneration and pain," Liu says. "Our findings suggest that Nav1.7 is a dual-acting target. By blocking this single protein, we can potentially quiet the pain nerves and tell the cartilage cells to not only stop breaking down but start repairing as well."
paras.zh: “当 Nav1.7 失调时，就会导致关节退化和疼痛，”Liu 说。 “我们的研究结果表明 Nav1.7 是一个双重作用靶点。通过阻断这种单一蛋白质，我们可以潜在地平息疼痛神经，并告诉软骨细胞不仅停止分解，而且开始修复。”

paras.en: Epilepsy drug shows potential for cartilage repair
paras.zh: 癫痫药物显示出软骨修复的潜力

paras.en: Instead of creating an entirely new medication, Liu's team tested drugs that already inhibit sodium channels. Among them, lacosamide produced strong biological effects at considerably lower concentrations and offered a better safety profile than older drugs in the same class.
paras.zh: 刘的团队没有创造一种全新的药物，而是测试了已经抑制钠通道的药物。其中，拉科酰胺在相当低的浓度下产生强烈的生物效应，并且比同类的老药物具有更好的安全性。

paras.en: Lacosamide is already used as a treatment for epilepsy, but the researchers found that its effects on cartilage depended heavily on the dose.
paras.zh: 拉科酰胺已被用于治疗癫痫，但研究人员发现其对软骨的影响在很大程度上取决于剂量。

paras.en: More was not necessarily better. At an ideal low concentration, lacosamide encouraged cells to produce proteins involved in building cartilage while also suppressing processes that break tissue down. When the concentration was either too high or too low, those benefits began to fade.
paras.zh: 更多并不一定更好。在理想的低浓度下，拉科酰胺可以促进细胞产生参与软骨构建的蛋白质，同时抑制组织分解的过程。当浓度太高或太低时，这些好处就开始消失。

paras.en: "This tells us the system is finely tuned," Liu notes. "There is an optimal range where the drug helps restore balance without overcorrecting. What stood out was not just its effectiveness, but how little of a dose was needed."
paras.zh: “这告诉我们这个系统经过了精心调整，”刘指出。 “药物有一个最佳范围，可以帮助恢复平衡而不会过度纠正。最突出的不仅仅是它的有效性，而是只需要很少的剂量。”

paras.en: Further investigation revealed that lacosamide also changes the way cells communicate. The drug stimulated the release of two beneficial signaling proteins, HSP70 and midkine.
paras.zh: 进一步的研究表明，拉科酰胺还改变了细胞通讯的方式。该药物刺激了两种有益信号蛋白 HSP70 和 midkine 的释放。

paras.en: HSP70 helps cells respond to stress and supports tissue repair, while midkine helps regulate inflammation and protect joint tissue from degeneration. Together, the proteins appear to create conditions that are more favorable for maintaining cartilage.
paras.zh: HSP70 帮助细胞应对压力并支持组织修复，而中期因子有助于调节炎症并保护关节组织免于退化。这些蛋白质似乎共同创造了更有利于维持软骨的条件。

paras.en: "These proteins create a supportive environment for cartilage maintenance," Liu explains. "They allow the effects of the drug to extend beyond individual cells and influence the entire tissue."
paras.zh: “这些蛋白质为软骨维护创造了一个支持性环境，”刘解释道。 “它们使药物的作用超越单个细胞并影响整个组织。”

paras.en: Smart hydrogel keeps the drug inside the joint
paras.zh: 智能水凝胶将药物保留在关节内

paras.en: Oral treatment with lacosamide was effective in preclinical testing, but drugs taken by mouth circulate throughout the body, increasing the potential for unwanted effects elsewhere.
paras.zh: 在临床前测试中，口服拉科酰胺治疗是有效的，但口服药物在全身循环，增加了在其他地方产生不良影响的可能性。

paras.en: The researchers therefore investigated intra-articular injection, which allows the medication to be placed directly inside the affected joint.
paras.zh: 因此，研究人员研究了关节内注射，这种注射可以将药物直接放置在受影响的关节内。

paras.en: There was still a significant problem to overcome. "The knee joint, which is also the most common location for osteoarthritis, naturally acts like a leaky bucket," Liu says. "The body's drainage system can clear out liquids injected into the knee within hours."
paras.zh: 还有一个重大问题需要克服。 “膝关节也是骨关节炎最常见的部位，自然就像一个漏水的桶，”刘说。 “身体的排水系统可以在数小时内清除注入膝盖的液体。”

paras.en: To keep the medication in place longer, the team created a specialized hydrogel made from Collagen II. The material responds to temperature. It remains liquid while inside a cool syringe, then becomes a firm, jelly-like material after reaching body temperature.
paras.zh: 为了使药物保持更长时间，该团队创建了一种由 II 型胶原蛋白制成的特殊水凝胶。该材料对温度有反应。它在冷注射器内保持液态，然后在达到体温后变成坚硬的果冻状材料。

paras.en: Once inside the joint, the gel acts as a storage site for lacosamide, keeping the medication concentrated in the affected area while gradually releasing it over several weeks.
paras.zh: 一旦进入关节，凝胶就会充当拉科酰胺的储存位点，使药物集中在受影响的区域，同时在几周内逐渐释放药物。

paras.en: "The hydrogel acts as a local reservoir," Liu says. "It holds the drug in place in the location it is needed most and releases it slowly over time. It transforms a daily pill into a long-lasting, local treatment that stays active for a month or longer."
paras.zh: “水凝胶充当当地的水库，”刘说。 “它将药物固定在最需要的位置，并随着时间的推移缓慢释放。它将每日服用的药物转变为持久的局部治疗方法，可以保持一个月或更长时间的活性。”

paras.en: In the same preclinical studies, one injection of the lacosamide-containing gel every four weeks prevented cartilage loss more effectively than taking an oral dose every day.
paras.zh: 在相同的临床前研究中，每四个星期注射一次含有拉科酰胺的凝胶比每天口服剂量更能有效地防止软骨损失。

paras.en: Existing drug could speed clinical testing
paras.zh: 现有药物可以加速临床测试

paras.en: One important advantage of lacosamide is that the medication is already approved for use in people. That could make it possible to move toward clinical studies in osteoarthritis patients more quickly than would be possible with a completely new drug.
paras.zh: 拉科酰胺的一个重要优点是该药物已被批准用于人类。与全新药物相比，这可能使骨关节炎患者更快地进行临床研究。

paras.en: Lacosamide has also been tested in humans with certain nerve-related pain conditions caused by Nav1.7 mutations. Those results give the researchers greater confidence that the effects seen in laboratory studies could eventually translate into meaningful pain relief for patients.
paras.zh: 拉科酰胺还在患有由 Nav1.7 突变引起的某些神经相关疼痛的人类身上进行了测试。这些结果让研究人员更有信心，实验室研究中看到的效果最终可以转化为对患者有意义的疼痛缓解。

paras.en: The work also reflects a broader direction in medicine that combines drugs with advanced biomaterials to control exactly where and how treatments are delivered. If the approach proves successful in people, it could eventually reduce the number of procedures patients need, limit unwanted side effects, and provide longer-lasting protection against structural joint damage.
paras.zh: 这项工作还反映了更广泛的医学方向，即将药物与先进的生物材料相结合，以准确控制治疗的地点和方式。如果这种方法在人类身上证明是成功的，它最终可以减少患者所需的手术数量，限制不必要的副作用，并提供更持久的保护，防止结构性关节损伤。

paras.en: "We are not just developing a treatment," Liu concludes. "We are developing a system that allows the medicine to work more effectively where it matters most. Our goal is to move beyond symptom control and towards true disease modification. This effort brings us closer to that reality."
paras.zh: “我们不仅仅是在开发一种治疗方法，”刘总结道。 “我们正在开发一个系统，使药物能够在最重要的地方更有效地发挥作用。我们的目标是超越症状控制，走向真正的疾病改变。这项努力使我们更接近这一现实。”

paras.en: Materials provided by Yale School of Medicine. Original written by John Ready, MS. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由耶鲁大学医学院提供。原文作者：John Ready, MS。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

Collagen II hydrogel-mediated sustained delivery of lacosamide attenuates cartilage degeneration and pain in osteoarthritis. Bioactive Materials, 2026; 61: 640 DOI: 10.1016/j.bioactmat.2026.02.045
paras.zh: - 何超鹏、黄贵武、Lida Moradi、毕经伟、杨新宇、刘新、崔旭东、Arya Varthi、Daniel H. Wiznia、Stephen G. Waxman、Wenyu Fu、Chuan-Ju Liu。 II 型胶原蛋白水凝胶介导的拉科酰胺持续递送可减轻骨关节炎中的软骨退化和疼痛。生物活性材料，2026； 61：640 DOI：10.1016/j.bioactmat.2026.02.045

articles.title: China launches Guowang, Yaogan-40 satellites, sets up busy Q4 manifest
articles.author: Andrew Jones

paras.en: HELSINKI — China completed its ninth and tenth launches of September, sending Guowang and Yaogan satellites into orbit, ahead of an intense finish to the year.
paras.zh: 赫尔辛基——中国在 9 月份完成了第九次和第十次发射，将“国王”号和“遥感”卫星送入轨道，为今年的紧张收官做好准备。

paras.en: A Long March 8A lifted off at 9:32 a.m. Eastern (1332 UTC) Sept. 23 from the Hainan commercial spacecraft launch site, carrying the 26th group of satellites for China’s Guowang national low Earth orbit satellite internet project. Less than a day later, a Long March 6A lifted off at 4:46 a.m. Eastern (0846 UTC) Sept. 24 from Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center with the fourth group of Yaogan-40 satellites.
paras.zh: 9月23日东部时间1332年上午9时32分，长征八号A运载火箭从海南商业航天发射场升空，搭载着中国国网国家低轨卫星互联网工程第26组卫星。不到一天后，长征六号甲运载火箭于9月24日东部时间凌晨4时46分（世界标准时间0846）从太原卫星发射中心升空，搭载第四组遥感四十号卫星。

paras.en: The pair of launches capped a September in which Chinese launchers flew at a pace that frequently saw multiple orbital missions within days, including four different rockets launching from three sites within 48 hours Sept. 15–16.
paras.zh: 这两次发射为9月份画上了圆满的句号，中国运载火箭的飞行速度经常在几天内执行多次轨道任务，其中包括9月15日至16日48小时内从三个地点发射的四枚不同的火箭。

paras.en: China Aerospace Science and Technology Corp. (CASC) stated the Guowang satellites had entered their planned orbits. The satellites were later tracked by U.S. Space Force in roughly circular 1,100-kilometer-altitude orbits inclined by 50 degrees. The batch was developed under the overall leadership of the China Academy of Space Technology (CAST), CASC’s main spacecraft maker, according to the corporation.
paras.zh: 中国航天科技集团公司（CASC）表示，国王卫星已进入预定轨道。这些卫星随后被美国太空军在大约 1,100 公里高、倾斜 50 度的圆形轨道上进行跟踪。据该公司称，这批产品是在中国航天科技集团公司主要航天器制造商中国空间技术研究院（CAST）的全面领导下研制的。

paras.en: Guowang is run by China SatNet, a state-owned enterprise established in 2021, and is planned to comprise around 13,000 satellites. The constellation uses satellites from multiple manufacturers and is launched on a range of Long March vehicles, with the Long March 8A, which debuted in February 2025, now launching regularly from Hainan’s commercial pads.
paras.zh: 国网由成立于 2021 年的国有企业中国卫星网运营，计划包含约 13,000 颗卫星。该星座使用多个制造商的卫星，并在一系列长征运载火箭上发射，其中长征八号甲于 2025 年 2 月首次亮相，现在定期从海南的商业发射场发射。

paras.en: The three Yaogan-40 (04) satellites will mainly be used for electromagnetic environment detection and related technology experiments, Xinhua reported, using boilerplate language typical of Yaogan launches. The satellites were also developed under CAST’s leadership.
paras.zh: 据新华社报道，三颗遥感四十（04）卫星将主要用于电磁环境探测和相关技术实验，使用遥感发射典型的样板语言。这些卫星也是在中国科协的领导下研制的。

paras.en: The satellites entered near polar orbits with altitudes of around 800 km, joining three earlier batches in similar orbits. Analysis by Integrity ISR indicates that the Yaogan-40 groups are placed into orbital planes separated by 72 degrees in right ascension of the ascending node, suggesting a fifth group will be needed to complete the constellation.
paras.zh: 这些卫星进入了高度约 800 公里的近极轨道，加入了类似轨道上的三批早期卫星。 Integrity ISR 的分析表明，Yaogan-40 群被放置在升交点赤经中相距 72 度的轨道平面中，这表明需要第五个群来完成该星座。

paras.en: The Long March 6A, a kerosene-liquid oxygen core with solid boosters, is one of CASC’s main vehicles for both Yaogan and megaconstellation missions from Taiyuan. The rocket has now flown 27 times since its debut in March 2022, with all flights successfully reaching orbit, though the upper stage has experienced a number of breakup events after payload deployment.
paras.zh: 长征六号甲运载火箭是带有固体助推器的煤油液氧核心，是中国航天科技集团公司在太原执行遥感和巨型星座任务的主要运载工具之一。自 2022 年 3 月首次亮相以来，该火箭现已飞行 27 次，所有飞行均成功进入轨道，尽管上级在有效载荷部署后经历了多次解体事件。

paras.en: The pair of launches take China to 70 orbital launch attempts for 2026. With the country aiming to surpass 100 launches in a calendar year for the first time, the final quarter will see heavy activity. China launched 26 times in Q3, following 26 in Q2 and 18 in Q1, and would need to conduct at least 31 launches in Q4. The country’s annual launch schedule is typically backloaded with a greater number of launches later in the year.
paras.zh: 这两次发射使中国在 2026 年进行了 70 次轨道发射尝试。由于该国的目标是在一个日历年内首次超过 100 次发射，因此最后一个季度将出现大量活动。中国在第三季度发射了 26 次，继第二季度 26 次和第一季度 18 次之后，第四季度需要至少进行 31 次发射。该国的年度发射计划通常会在今年晚些时候进行更多的发射。

paras.en: One major mission will be Shenzhou-24. China’s next crewed mission now appears likely to launch around November, using a Long March 2F from Jiuquan. The crew is expected, though not officially confirmed, to include a Pakistani payload specialist, chosen from one of two Pakistan Air Force pilots in training at the Astronaut Center of China. The selected astronaut would become the first foreign astronaut to visit Tiangong.
paras.zh: 神舟二十四号将是一项重大任务。中国的下一次载人任务现在看来可能会在 11 月左右发射，使用的是酒泉的长征二号F。尽管尚未正式确认，机组人员预计将包括一名巴基斯坦有效载荷专家，他是从在中国宇航员中心接受训练的两名巴基斯坦空军飞行员中挑选的。入选的宇航员将成为第一位访问天宫的外国宇航员。

paras.en: A press conference a day ahead of the Shenzhou-24 launch may also provide updates or insights into the schedule for the first launch of the Mengzhou new generation spacecraft and the Long March 10A, both of which are related to China’s crewed lunar plans.
paras.zh: 神舟二十四号发射前一天的新闻发布会还可能提供孟州新一代飞船和长征十号甲首次发射时间表的最新情况或见解，这两者都与中国的载人登月计划有关。

paras.en: Possible debut launches include Orienspace’s Gravity-2, iSpace’s Hyperbola-3 with a first stage recovery attempt, and Zhihang-1 from Zenk Space, which earlier aimed for a launch in June. These would add to 2026 debuts including Tianlong-3 (April), Kinetica-2 (March), the Long March 12B (June), Long March 10B (July) and Pallas-1 (Sept. 1).
paras.zh: 可能的首次发射包括Orienspace的Gravity-2、iSpace的Hyperbola-3（进行第一阶段回收尝试）以及Zenk Space的Zhihang-1（其早些时候计划于6月发射）。这些将在 2026 年首次亮相的基础上增加，包括天龙三号（4 月）、动能二号（3 月）、长征十二号乙（六月）、长征十号乙（七月）和帕拉斯一号（九月 1 日）。

paras.en: Numerous launches for the Guowang and Qianfan constellations are expected. Other notable possible payloads in the coming months include Fengxing-1 on a Gravity-1 solid rocket, which could be China’s first commercial orbital transfer vehicle, from Future Space. Also expected are space computing payloads. The schedule for the planned debut flight of the Haolong reusable spaceplane for cargo to Tiangong from AVIC on a Zhuque-3 rocket from Landspace is currently unknown.
paras.zh: 国望星座和千帆星座预计将进行多次发射。未来几个月其他值得注意的可能有效载荷包括来自未来空间的重力一号固体火箭上的风行一号，这可能是中国第一个商业轨道转移飞行器。预计还有太空计算有效载荷。昊龙可重复使用航天飞机计划通过蓝箭朱雀三号火箭从中航工业飞往天宫的首次飞行时间表目前尚不清楚。

articles.title: Deposition Sciences, Inc. Expands Sunshade® Tape Offering with New 12″ × 30″ Format
articles.author: Deposition Sciences, Inc

paras.en: Santa Rosa, CA — October 2026 — Deposition Sciences, Inc. (DSI), a leader in advanced thin film coatings, proudly announces the introduction of a new 12″ × 30″ format for its Sunshade® Tape thermal control material. This expanded size provides engineers and designers with greater flexibility for integrating thermal protection into larger aerospace and industrial systems.
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州圣罗莎 — 2026 年 10 月 — 先进薄膜涂层领域的领导者 Deposition Sciences, Inc. (DSI) 自豪地宣布为其 Sunshade® Tape 热控制材料推出新的 12" × 30" 格式。这种扩大的尺寸为工程师和设计人员提供了更大的灵活性，可以将热保护集成到更大的航空航天和工业系统中。

paras.en: Sunshade® Tape is engineered for solar reflectance, thermal stability, and durability in extreme environments. Its lightweight, flexible design reduces energy demands while safeguarding sensitive components from heat exposure. The new format ensures easier application across broader surfaces, enhancing mission reliability and equipment performance.
paras.zh: Sunshade® 胶带专为极端环境下的太阳反射率、热稳定性和耐用性而设计。其轻质、灵活的设计降低了能源需求，同时保护敏感部件免受热暴露。新格式确保更轻松地在更广泛的表面上应用，从而提高任务可靠性和设备性能。

paras.en: “Our customers asked for more versatility, and we delivered,” said Justin Mosier, Sr. Mgr Space Materials at DSI. “The new 12″ × 30″ format makes Sunshade® Tape even more adaptable to complex thermal control challenges.”
paras.zh: “我们的客户要求更多的多功能性，我们满足了，”DSI 空间材料高级经理 Justin Mosier 说道。 “新的 12 英寸 × 30 英寸规格使 Sunshade® 胶带更能适应复杂的热控制挑战。”

paras.en: For more information about Sunshade® Tape and its applications, visit Deposition Sciences, Inc. at https://www.depsci.com.
paras.zh: 有关 Sunshade® Tape 及其应用的更多信息，请访问 Deposition Sciences, Inc.，网址为 https://www.depsci.com。

articles.title: What will it take to build a moon base?
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: In this episode, a panel of industry experts discuss what’s needed to build a moon base. During a live event at the Johns Hopkins University Bloomberg Center, leaders Astrolab, Firefly Space and APL share what a lunar future could look like and what has to happen in the next couple of years to make it a reality.
paras.zh: 在本集中，行业专家小组讨论了建造月球基地所需的条件。在约翰·霍普金斯大学彭博中心举行的现场活动中，Astrolab、Firefly Space 和 APL 的领导者分享了月球的未来可能是什么样子，以及未来几年必须发生什么才能使其成为现实。

paras.en: Space Minds is a new audio and video podcast from SpaceNews that focuses on the inspiring leaders, technologies and exciting opportunities in space.

articles.title: Webb Measures Distance to Farthest Fast Radio Burst, Suggesting Origin

paras.en: First discovered in 2007, fast radio bursts are enigmatic, millisecond-long flashes of radio emission from the distant universe. Their origin remains uncertain, particularly since most are seen once and never again. Astronomers using NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope have pinpointed the host galaxy of the most distant fast radio burst (FRB) seen to date. Their finding has implications for what kind of energetic event creates these bursts.
paras.zh: 快速射电爆发于 2007 年首次被发现，是来自遥远宇宙的神秘的、长达毫秒的射电发射闪光。它们的起源仍然不确定，特别是因为大多数只见过一次，就再也没有见过。天文学家使用美国宇航局詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜精确定位了迄今为止所见最遥远的快速射电暴（FRB）的宿主星系。他们的发现对于什么样的能量事件产生这些爆发具有影响。

paras.en: “What makes fast radio bursts interesting is that we don't know what generates them. We have theories for what objects produce them, but we don't have conclusive proof,” said Manisha Caleb of the University of Sydney, lead author on the study published Thursday in the journal Science.
paras.zh: “快速射电爆发之所以有趣，是因为我们不知道是什么产生了它们。我们有关于什么物体产生它们的理论，但我们没有确凿的证据，”周四发表在《科学》杂志上的这项研究的主要作者、悉尼大学的马尼沙·卡莱布(Manisha Caleb)说。

paras.en: The MeerTRAP team used the MeerKAT telescope to detect the burst on March 4, 2024, leading to its designation as FRB 20240304B. The radio data from this burst suggested that it was extremely distant, possibly the most distant one seen to date. To confirm that distance, though, astronomers would need to study its host galaxy. Although they knew the location of the FRB very precisely, the world’s largest ground-based telescopes could not see any galaxy at that spot in the sky. As a result, the team turned to the Webb telescope.
paras.zh: MeerTRAP 团队于 2024 年 3 月 4 日使用 MeerKAT 望远镜探测到了此次爆发，并将其命名为 FRB 20240304B。这次爆发的无线电数据表明它非常遥远，可能是迄今为止看到的最遥远的一次。然而，为了确认这个距离，天文学家需要研究它的宿主星系。尽管他们非常精确地知道快速射电暴的位置，但世界上最大的地面望远镜无法在天空中的那个位置看到任何星系。因此，研究小组转向韦伯望远镜。

paras.en: Webb’s NIRCam (Near-Infrared Camera) instrument detected a galaxy in the right location, and its NIRSpec (Near-Infrared Spectrograph) instrument provided a precise measurement of the galaxy’s redshift: 2.148, corresponding to a time just 3 billion years after the big bang. The vast majority of FRBs detected to date occurred billions of years later in cosmic history.
paras.zh: 韦伯的 NIRCam（近红外相机）仪器在正确的位置检测到了一个星系，其 NIRSpec（近红外光谱仪）仪器提供了对该星系红移的精确测量：2.148，对应于大爆炸后仅 30 亿年的时间。迄今为止检测到的绝大多数快速射电暴发生在宇宙历史数十亿年后。

paras.en: The team discovered that the host galaxy of FRB 20240304B was not typical of other galaxies with FRBs. Most FRB galaxies are massive star-forming galaxies, but the galaxy they found was 1,000 times less massive than they expected.
paras.zh: 研究小组发现，FRB 20240304B 的宿主星系与其他具有 FRB 的星系并不典型。大多数 FRB 星系都是大质量恒星形成星系，但他们发现的星系质量比他们预期的小 1000 倍。

paras.en: “We thought it would be a big, nicely formed galaxy with lots of stars, and instead it was a little dwarf galaxy, although it was actively forming stars,” said Caleb.
paras.zh: “我们认为这将是一个巨大的、结构良好的星系，拥有大量恒星，但实际上它是一个小矮星系，尽管它正在积极形成恒星，”迦勒说。

paras.en: “The host sticks out in the whole galaxy sample that we have. And it definitely was not what we were expecting,” said Ben Stappers of the University of Manchester, United Kingdom, a co-author on the paper. “This combination of using the MeerTRAP project on the MeerKAT telescope to discover and localize these distant bursts and Webb to study their hosts is very exciting.”
paras.zh: “宿主在我们拥有的整个星系样本中很突出。这绝对不是我们所期望的，”该论文的合著者、英国曼彻斯特大学的本·斯塔珀斯（Ben Stappers）说。 “使用 MeerKAT 望远镜上的 MeerTRAP 项目来发现和定位这些遥远的爆发，并使用韦伯来研究它们的宿主，这种组合非常令人兴奋。”

paras.en: The galaxy existed at the height of “cosmic noon” – a period in the history of the universe when star formation was at its peak. The galaxy’s rate of star formation suggested that the majority of its stars may have formed within just 30 million years.
paras.zh: 该星系存在于“宇宙正午”的高度——宇宙历史上的一个时期，恒星形成处于鼎盛时期。该星系的恒星形成速度表明，其大多数恒星可能在短短 3000 万年内形成。

paras.en: This has important implications for the origin of fast radio bursts. One theory suggests that FRBs may originate from the merger of two neutron stars. However, the process of orbiting neutron stars gradually approaching closer and closer until they collide is expected to take billions of years. As a result, FRBs would be expected to be associated with older galaxies containing more evolved stellar populations.
paras.zh: 这对于快速射电暴的起源具有重要意义。一种理论认为，快速射电暴可能起源于两颗中子星的合并。然而，绕轨道运行的中子星逐渐靠近直至碰撞的过程预计需要数十亿年的时间。因此，快速射电暴预计与包含更多演化恒星群的较古老星系有关。

paras.en: A second theory proposes that an FRB can originate from a single, young, highly magnetic neutron star known as a magnetar through a mechanism like starquakes. In that case, once a massive star explodes as a supernova and leaves behind a magnetar, an FRB might occur relatively quickly with no large time delay. As a result, FRBs would also be expected to be found in younger galaxies like the host of FRB 20240304B.
paras.zh: 第二种理论认为，快速射电暴可以通过星震等机制起源于一颗年轻的高磁性中子星（称为磁星）。在这种情况下，一旦一颗大质量恒星爆炸为超新星并留下磁星，快速射电暴可能会相对较快地发生，而不会出现大的时间延迟。因此，预计也会在较年轻的星系（例如 FRB 20240304B 的宿主）中发现 FRB。

paras.en: “Our work suggests that it’s very unlikely that this FRB was produced by a merger,” said Caleb.
paras.zh: “我们的研究表明，这个快速射电暴不太可能是由合并产生的，”卡莱布说。

paras.en: "Our results further show the amazing capability of Webb where we can push boundaries beyond what was previously possible," said co-author Themiya Nanayakkara of the University of Sydney, Australia.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚悉尼大学的合著者 Themiya Nanayakkara 表示：“我们的结果进一步显示了 Webb 的惊人能力，我们可以超越以前的极限。”

paras.en: In addition to being a record-holder, the new FRB enabled the team to learn more about the billions of light-years of apparently empty space between the burst and Earth.
paras.zh: 除了成为纪录保持者之外，新的快速射电暴还使团队能够更多地了解爆发与地球之间数十亿光年的明显真空空间。

paras.en: “A fast radio burst is almost like a cosmic flashlight. It lights up everything along the path. It carries an imprint of everything that it travels through, so you can use it to trace the ‘cosmic web’ – the otherwise invisible matter and structures that it encounters along the way,” said co-author J. Xavier Prochaska of the University of California, Santa Cruz.
paras.zh: “快速射电爆发几乎就像宇宙手电筒。它照亮了沿途的一切。它带有它所经过的一切的印记，所以你可以用它来追踪‘宇宙网’——它沿途遇到的其他看不见的物质和结构，”合著者、加州大学圣克鲁斯分校的 J. Xavier Prochaska 说。

paras.en: The team found the imprint of two cosmic structures on the FRB’s signal – one previously unknown galaxy cluster at a redshift of 0.3 (about 3.5 billion light-years from Earth), and the nearby Virgo Cluster, which is located about 54 million light-years from Earth.
paras.zh: 研究小组在 FRB 信号上发现了两个宇宙结构的印记——一个之前未知的红移为 0.3 的星系团（距离地球约 35 亿光年），以及附近的室女座星系团，距离地球约 5400 万光年。

paras.en: Image: Farthest Fast Radio Burst Host Galaxy Spectrum
paras.zh: 图片：最远快速射电爆发主机 Galaxy Spectrum

paras.en: In the future, the team is excited about the potential to discover more distant FRBs. They estimate that the MeerKAT telescope may be able to detect and localize several FRBs per year at a redshift greater than 1.0, meaning they existed more than halfway back to the start of the universe. As other new radio telescope facilities and instruments come online, that discovery pace may grow. The Webb telescope will be essential for characterizing those distant host galaxies.
paras.zh: 未来，该团队对发现更遥远的快速射电暴的潜力感到兴奋。他们估计，MeerKAT 望远镜每年可能能够探测并定位几个红移大于 1.0 的快速射电暴，这意味着它们早在宇宙诞生之初就已经存在了一半以上。随着其他新的射电望远镜设施和仪器投入使用，发现速度可能会加快。韦伯望远镜对于描述那些遥远的主星系的特征至关重要。

paras.en: The James Webb Space Telescope is the world’s premier space science observatory. Webb is solving mysteries in our solar system, looking beyond to distant worlds around other stars, and probing the mysterious structures and origins of our universe and our place in it. Webb is an international program led by NASA with its partners, ESA (European Space Agency) and CSA (Canadian Space Agency).
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜是世界上首屈一指的太空科学天文台。韦伯正在解开太阳系中的谜团，展望其他恒星周围的遥远世界，并探索宇宙的神秘结构和起源以及我们在其中的位置。韦伯是由 NASA 及其合作伙伴 ESA（欧洲航天局）和 CSA（加拿大航天局）领导的一项国际计划。
