articles.title: NASA’s SPHEREx Telescope Sees Menagerie of Brown Dwarfs
articles.author: albarne1

paras.en: NASA’s SPHEREx (Spectro-Photometer for the History of the Universe, Epoch of Reionization, and Ices Explorer) space telescope is shedding light on brown dwarfs, celestial objects that blur the line between stars and exoplanets. New findings published in The Astrophysical Journal show that these dark and cloudy worlds have chemically rich atmospheres not unlike the giant planets in our own solar system.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局的 SPHEREx（宇宙历史分光光度计、再电离时代和冰探索者）太空望远镜正在研究褐矮星，这些天体模糊了恒星和系外行星之间的界限。 《天体物理学杂志》上发表的新发现表明，这些黑暗多云的世界拥有富含化学物质的大气层，与我们太阳系中的巨型行星没有什么不同。

paras.en: First discovered in the 1990s, brown dwarfs form from collapsing clouds of gas, like stars do, but they aren’t hefty enough to sustain hydrogen fusion in their cores. These dimly glowing balls of warm gas also share characteristics with Jupiter and Saturn. In contrast to most planets, however, brown dwarfs drift in darkness, ungoverned by a host star and heated entirely from within.
paras.zh: 褐矮星于 20 世纪 90 年代首次被发现，它是由气体云塌缩形成的，就像恒星一样，但它们的质量不足以维持其核心的氢聚变。这些发出微弱光芒的温暖气体球也与木星和土星有共同的特征。然而，与大多数行星不同的是，褐矮星在黑暗中漂移，不受主恒星的控制，完全由内部加热。

paras.en: “They’re kind of goth,” said Zafar Rustamkulov, lead author of the new study and a scientist at IPAC, Caltech’s science and data center in Pasadena, California. “Unlike exoplanets, free-floating brown dwarfs are completely independent celestial objects that will fade into eternity alone. We’re still learning how complex they are.”
paras.zh: “他们有点哥特，”这项新研究的主要作者、加州理工学院位于加利福尼亚州帕萨迪纳的科学和数据中心 IPAC 的科学家扎法尔·鲁斯塔姆库洛夫 (Zafar Rustamkulov) 说。 “与系外行星不同，自由漂浮的棕矮星是完全独立的天体，将独自消失在永恒中。我们仍在了解它们有多么复杂。”

paras.en: Only a few dozen of these “dark wanderers” have been studied in detail with space-based telescopes. Astronomers want to observe more of them in the wild because much of our understanding of their makeup, storminess, and evolution comes from theoretical models.
paras.zh: 只有几十个这样的“黑暗流浪者”被天基望远镜详细研究过。天文学家希望在野外观察更多它们，因为我们对它们的构成、风暴和演化的大部分了解都来自理论模型。

paras.en: Enter NASA’s SPHEREx, an infrared space telescope launched in March 2025 and managed by the agency’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory in Southern California.
paras.zh: NASA 的 SPHEREx 是一架红外太空望远镜，于 2025 年 3 月发射，由该机构位于南加州的喷气推进实验室管理。

paras.en: The study authors analyzed SPHEREx observations of 37 nearby brown dwarfs spanning the full brown dwarf temperature range, from about 4,000 to minus 10 degrees Fahrenheit (2,200 to minus 20 degrees Celsius). The telescope measures their brightness in 102 different colors, from the deepest red our eyes can see, to the invisible heat of infrared light, creating a spectrum. These spectra revealed to the study authors chemically rich atmospheres harboring water, carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide, and methane.
paras.zh: 该研究的作者分析了 SPHEREx 对附近 37 个褐矮星的观测结果，涵盖了整个褐矮星温度范围，从大约 4,000 到负 10 华氏度（2,200 到负 20 摄氏度）。该望远镜以 102 种不同颜色测量它们的亮度，从我们眼睛能看到的最深的红色，到不可见的红外光热量，从而创建一个光谱。这些光谱向研究作者揭示了化学丰富的大气中含有水、二氧化碳、一氧化碳和甲烷。

paras.en: “We’re seeing the signatures of these molecules and how they change from object to object across the entire temperature regime,” said study coauthor J. Davy Kirkpatrick, a scientist at Caltech’s IPAC. “Our paper concentrated on just three dozen, but we have thousands more that we are in the process of analyzing. I really want to see what bounds the universe places on the variety of brown dwarfs.”
paras.zh: 研究合著者、加州理工学院 IPAC 科学家 J. Davy Kirkpatrick 表示：“我们正在观察这些分子的特征，以及它们在整个温度范围内如何从一个物体到另一个物体发生变化。” “我们的论文只集中了三打，但我们还有数千个正在分析。我真的很想看看宇宙对褐矮星种类的限制。”

paras.en: “From orbit, SPHEREx sees wavelengths of light that are basically impossible to see with telescopes on the ground because water in Earth’s atmosphere absorbs them,” Rustamkulov said. “We are picking up light from the deep, red clouds of brown dwarfs all over the sky.”
paras.zh: 鲁斯塔姆库洛夫说：“SPHEREx 从轨道上看到的光波长基本上是用地面望远镜无法看到的，因为地球大气中的水会吸收它们。” “我们正在从遍布天空的深红色褐矮星云中接收到光线。”

paras.en: Spotting brown dwarfs is something of a side project for SPHEREx. The space telescope takes about 3,600 unique images per day to stitch into maps of the entire sky. Knowing where hundreds of millions of galaxies are distributed across the cosmos will help scientists reconstruct what happened in the first billionth of a trillionth of a trillionth of a second after the big bang. As it scans the sky, the telescope also is searching for the chemical ingredients of life and finding interstellar ice that could one day seed oceans on distant worlds.
paras.zh: 发现褐矮星是 SPHEREx 的一个副业项目。太空望远镜每天拍摄约 3,600 张独特的图像，将其拼接成整个天空的地图。了解数亿个星系在宇宙中的分布位置将有助于科学家重建大爆炸后的第一个十亿分之一万亿分之一秒内发生的情况。在扫描天空的同时，望远镜也在寻找生命的化学成分，并寻找星际冰，有一天可能会在遥远的世界上播下海洋。

paras.en: For years, brown dwarfs have been spotted by other observatories, including NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope and retired Spitzer Space Telescope. But thanks to its spectral coverage, SPHEREx is now imaging thousands of them for the first time in a fruitful region of the electromagnetic spectrum that spans deep red and infrared wavelengths of light.
paras.zh: 多年来，其他天文台也发现了褐矮星，包括美国宇航局的詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜和退役的斯皮策太空望远镜。但由于其光谱覆盖范围，SPHEREx 现在首次在跨越深红光和红外光波长的电磁频谱丰富区域中对数千个这样的粒子进行成像。

paras.en: At those wavelengths, molecules carve out distinct absorption patterns in the light shining out to space. The patterns change as brown dwarfs grow older and colder. Some of the brown dwarfs observed by SPHEREx are in a dynamic stage of life when their exotic clouds thin out, giving way to methane-rich atmospheres.
paras.zh: 在这些波长下，分子在照射到太空的光线中刻画出独特的吸收模式。随着褐矮星变老、变冷，这些模式也会发生变化。 SPHEREx 观测到的一些褐矮星正处于生命的动态阶段，此时它们奇异的云层逐渐变薄，取而代之的是富含甲烷的大气层。

paras.en: “The state-of-the-art models are capturing the general chemical trend, but when it comes to these cloudy transitions, the models are struggling to match the data,” said Rustamkulov. “No two brown dwarfs are alike. Even at the same temperature, their spectra look quite distinct.”
paras.zh: “最先进的模型正在捕捉总体化学趋势，但当涉及到这些多云转变时，模型很难与数据匹配，”鲁斯塔姆库洛夫说。 “没有两颗褐矮星是相似的。即使在相同的温度下，它们的光谱看起来也截然不同。”

paras.en: “The findings are a call to action to explore even more of these dark worlds,” said Kirkpatrick. “This journey has turned many of us into accidental meteorologists. We know how hard it is to predict weather on our own planet, and we realize it’s going to be just as challenging to explain the phenomena we see in these bizarre, cold objects.”
paras.zh: 柯克帕特里克说：“这些发现呼吁人们采取行动，探索更多的黑暗世界。” “这段旅程让我们中的许多人意外地成为了气象学家。我们知道预测我们星球上的天气有多么困难，而且我们意识到解释我们在这些奇异、寒冷的物体中看到的现象也同样具有挑战性。”

paras.en: The mission is managed by JPL for NASA’s Astrophysics Division within the Science Mission Directorate in Washington. The telescope and the spacecraft bus were built by BAE Systems. The science analysis of the SPHEREx data is being conducted by a team of scientists at 13 institutions across the United States and in South Korea and Taiwan, led by Jamie Bock, principal investigator, who is based at Caltech with a joint JPL appointment, and by JPL’s Olivier Doré, the project scientist. Data is processed and archived at IPAC at Caltech in Pasadena. Caltech manages JPL for NASA. The SPHEREx dataset is freely available to scientists and the public.
paras.zh: 该任务由位于华盛顿的美国宇航局科学任务理事会天体物理部门的喷气推进实验室负责管理。望远镜和航天器总线由 BAE Systems 制造。 SPHEREx 数据的科学分析由来自美国、韩国和台湾 13 个机构的科学家团队进行，该团队由加州理工学院首席研究员杰米·博克 (Jamie Bock) 和喷气推进实验室的项目科学家奥利维尔·多雷 (Olivier Doré) 领导，博克在加州理工学院工作，并与喷气推进实验室联合任命。数据在帕萨迪纳加州理工学院的 IPAC 进行处理和存档。加州理工学院为 NASA 管理喷气推进实验室。 SPHEREx 数据集免费向科学家和公众开放。

paras.en: For more information about the SPHEREx mission visit:
paras.zh: 有关 SPHEREx 任务的更多信息，请访问：

paras.en: Jet Propulsion Laboratory, Pasadena, Calif.
paras.zh: 喷气推进实验室，加利福尼亚州帕萨迪纳

articles.title: NASA’s SSPICY Mission to Demonstrate In-Space Inspection Technologies
articles.author: Tara Friesen

paras.en: A new NASA-supported spacecraft will get up close to satellites that are no longer in service, demonstrating technologies that could support future in-space repairs and reduce orbital debris.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局支持的新型航天器将接近不再服役的卫星，展示可以支持未来太空修复和减少轨道碎片的技术。

paras.en: The Small Spacecraft Propulsion and Inspection Capability (SSPICY) mission launched Oct. 1 from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California. The mission is a technology demonstration where an Otter spacecraft will approach up to four inoperable space objects of U.S. origin in low Earth orbit, such as satellites and rocket bodies.
paras.zh: 小型航天器推进和检查能力 (SSPICY) 任务于 10 月 1 日从加利福尼亚州范登堡太空部队基地发射。该任务是一次技术演示，水獭航天器将接近近地轨道上多达四个来自美国的无法运行的太空物体，例如卫星和火箭体。

paras.en: In early 2027, the Otter spacecraft, built by Starfish Space, will begin to navigate within hundreds of yards of each object to perform inspections, using autonomous guidance and control software with minimal input from ground controllers. Computer vision and sensors enable software to make real-time navigation decisions as the spacecraft approaches each target.
paras.zh: 2027 年初，由 Starfish Space 建造的 Otter 航天器将开始在每个物体数百码范围内导航以执行检查，使用自主引导和控制软件，地面控制器的输入最少。当航天器接近每个目标时，计算机视觉和传感器使软件能够做出实时导航决策。

paras.en: During inspection, the Otter spacecraft will gather critical information about each object, such as spin rate, orientation, and surface condition. An electric propulsion system will enable SSPICY to travel between objects, and an articulating robotic boom will test pointing the spacecraft’s thrusters for precise maneuvering between different orbits.
paras.zh: 在检查过程中，水獭航天器将收集每个物体的关键信息，例如旋转速率、方向和表面状况。电力推进系统将使 SSPICY 能够在物体之间旅行，铰接式机器人吊杆将测试航天器推进器的指向，以便在不同轨道之间进行精确操纵。

paras.en: This mission is the first time these technologies will be tested together as an integrated system, paving the way for future autonomous servicing and orbital debris inspection.
paras.zh: 此次任务是这些技术首次作为一个集成系统进行测试，为未来的自主服务和轨道碎片检查铺平了道路。

paras.en: During the SSPICY mission, the Otter spacecraft won’t touch or dock with any satellites, but will test the technologies needed to one day enable missions to service or repair objects in orbit, or to safely remove them by pulling them into Earth’s atmosphere for disposal.
paras.zh: 在 SSPICY 任务期间，水獭航天器不会接触或对接任何卫星，但将测试有一天使任务能够服务或修复轨道上的物体所需的技术，或者通过将它们拉入地球大气层进行处置来安全地移除它们。

paras.en: Space objects like rocket bodies and satellites that are experiencing issues or no longer in service can break apart or collide with one another, creating varying forms of orbital debris from large fragments to small particles. With thousands of satellites launched each year to provide communications, weather forecasting, navigation, and other services that people rely on daily, keeping the space near Earth safe for operations is increasingly critical.
paras.zh: 遇到问题或不再使用的火箭体和卫星等空间物体可能会分裂或相互碰撞，产生从大碎片到小颗粒等各种形式的轨道碎片。每年发射数千颗卫星来提供人们日常依赖的通信、天气预报、导航和其他服务，保持地球附近空间的安全运行变得越来越重要。

paras.en: Starfish Space developed and operates the Otter 24C spacecraft, which is performing the SSPICY mission. NASA’s Small Spacecraft and Distributed Systems program within the agency’s Research and Technology Mission Directorate funds and manages the technology demonstration.
paras.zh: 海星航天公司开发并运营了 Otter 24C 航天器，该航天器正在执行 SSPICY 任务。美国宇航局研究和技术任务理事会内的小型航天器和分布式系统项目资助并管理技术演示。

paras.en: NASA’s Small Business Innovation Research / Small Business Technology Transfer program funded awards to Starfish Space to support early development of the spacecraft’s key technologies and capabilities.
paras.zh: NASA 的小企业创新研究/小企业技术转让计划向 Starfish Space 提供资助，以支持航天器关键技术和功能的早期开发。

articles.title: Myanmar: Poverty deepens as families face multiple shocks with limited resources

paras.en: Myanmar: Poverty deepens as families face multiple shocks with limited resources
paras.zh: 缅甸：家庭资源有限，面临多重冲击，贫困加剧

paras.en: Years of conflict, displacement, economic disruption and climate shocks in Myanmar have led to the “simultaneous collapse” of shelter, healthcare, schooling and livelihoods affecting millions of people, the UN Development Programme (UNDP) said in a report issued on Thursday.
paras.zh: 联合国开发计划署（UNDP）在周四发布的一份报告中表示，缅甸多年的冲突、流离失所、经济混乱和气候冲击导致住房、医疗保健、学校教育和生计“同时崩溃”，影响了数百万人。

paras.en: The report reveals that more than two in three people now endure “multidimensional poverty” or are at risk of falling into it, with over 37 million people – 68 per cent of the population – experiencing overlapping crises.
paras.zh: 报告显示，目前超过三分之二的人正在忍受“多维贫困”或面临陷入“多维贫困”的风险，超过 3700 万人（占总人口的 68%）正在经历重叠的危机。

paras.en: “Myanmar may no longer dominate international headlines, but the hardships facing millions of people continue to deepen,” said Kanni Wignaraja, UNDP Regional Director for Asia and the Pacific.
paras.zh: 联合国开发计划署亚太区域主任坎尼·维格纳拉贾 (Kanni Wignaraja) 表示：“缅甸可能不再占据国际头条新闻，但数百万人面临的困难继续加深。”

paras.en: The UN continues to highlight multiple problems facing the people of Myanmar, which has been engulfed in civil war since the military seized power in February 2021. The country also faces macroeconomic instability, recurrent disasters and the additional impact of the devastating March 2025 earthquake.
paras.zh: 联合国继续强调缅甸人民面临的多重问题，自 2021 年 2 月军方夺权以来，缅甸一直陷入内战。该国还面临宏观经济不稳定、灾害频发以及 2025 年 3 月毁灭性地震的额外影响。

paras.en: “We are seeing a depth of poverty in Myanmar that is eroding human development itself. This is a no-win war. Everyone is losing. The core muscle of the country is being systematically eroded,” Mr. Wignaraja explained.
paras.zh: “我们看到缅甸的深度贫困正在侵蚀人类发展本身。这是一场没有赢家的战争。每个人都在失败。国家的核心力量正在被系统性地侵蚀，”维格纳拉贾先生解释道。

paras.en: The report - Layers of Deprivation: Multidimensional Poverty in Myanmar, - suggests that country is confronting more than an income crisis as many buffers that helped families to absorb shocks – such as savings, stable livelihoods, access to services and social support networks – are steadily disappearing.
paras.zh: 这份名为《层层剥夺：缅甸的多维贫困》的报告表明，该国面临的不仅仅是收入危机，因为许多帮助家庭吸收冲击的缓冲措施——例如储蓄、稳定的生计、获得服务的机会和社会支持网络——正在稳步消失。

paras.en: Deficits in health and living standards account for more than 80 per cent of multidimensional poverty. They include challenges in accessing healthcare, adequate housing, clean water, sanitation and other essential services, particularly in conflict-affected areas.
paras.zh: 健康和生活水平方面的缺陷占多维贫困的 80% 以上。其中包括获得医疗保健、适足住房、清洁水、卫生设施和其他基本服务方面的挑战，特别是在受冲突影响的地区。

paras.en: Poverty also varies across Myanmar, according to the report. In some areas, conflict, displacement and restricted access to services are the main drivers, while long-standing gaps in livelihoods, education, infrastructure and public services are the chief challenges in others.
paras.zh: 报告称，缅甸各地的贫困状况也各不相同。在一些地区，冲突、流离失所和获得服务受到限制是主要驱动因素，而在其他地区，生计、教育、基础设施和公共服务方面长期存在的差距则是主要挑战。

paras.en: Rakhine state in western Myanmar is among the most severe multidimensional poverty hotspots. More than two-thirds of the population are multidimensionally poor and nearly a third are severely poor.
paras.zh: 缅甸西部若开邦是最严重的多维贫困热点地区之一。超过三分之二的人口处于多维贫困，近三分之一的人口处于严重贫困。

paras.en: Deprivation among some stateless and displaced populations there may be understated because of limitations with collecting data by phone. This includes ethnic Rohingya communities who have faced decades of repression by the military that then UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Zeid Ra’ad Al Hussein likened to “textbook” ethnic cleansing in 2017.
paras.zh: 由于电话收集数据的限制，一些无国籍和流离失所者的贫困状况可能被低估。其中包括几十年来一直面临军方镇压的罗辛亚族社区，时任联合国人权事务高级专员扎伊德·拉阿德·侯赛因将 2017 年发生的“教科书式”种族清洗比作“教科书式”种族清洗。

paras.en: The findings also challenge assumptions that poverty is primarily rural. While the Yangon region has lower poverty rates than many conflict-affected states, it is also home to one of the largest concentrations of multidimensionally poor people, reflecting deepening vulnerabilities among urban and peri-urban households.
paras.zh: 研究结果还挑战了贫困主要发生在农村的假设。虽然仰光地区的贫困率低于许多受冲突影响的国家，但它也是多维贫困人口最集中的地区之一，反映出城市和城郊家庭的脆弱性日益加深。

paras.en: The report was released at a time when roughly one in five households in Myanmar faces climate-related risks such as floods, cyclones, droughts and landslides. These shocks are expected to intensify with the coming El Niño weather pattern.
paras.zh: 该报告发布之际，缅甸大约五分之一的家庭面临洪水、飓风、干旱和山体滑坡等气候相关风险。随着即将到来的厄尔尼诺天气模式，这些冲击预计将加剧。

paras.en: The report noted that by the end of August, roughly 600,000 people had been affected by flooding.
paras.zh: 报告指出，截至8月底，约有60万人受到洪水影响。

paras.en: Communities are also feeling the strain from “external economic shocks” such as rising fuel prices linked to the Gulf crisis, inflation and increasing food costs.
paras.zh: 社区还感受到“外部经济冲击”带来的压力，例如海湾危机导致的燃料价格上涨、通货膨胀和食品成本上涨。

paras.en: The report also highlights the situation of young people who are growing up amid conflict, insecurity and deep economic and social stresses. It warned that as opportunities shrink, many face limited options with regard to education, jobs, mobility and their futures.
paras.zh: 报告还强调了在冲突、不安全以及严重的经济和社会压力中成长的年轻人的处境。报告警告说，随着机会减少，许多人在教育、就业、流动性和未来方面面临有限的选择。

paras.en: At least one million young people may have left Myanmar since 2021, which UNDP called one of the largest losses of human capital in the country's recent history – and at a time when the population is ageing.
paras.zh: 自 2021 年以来，至少有 100 万年轻人可能离开缅甸，开发计划署称这是该国近代史上最大的人力资本流失之一，而且当时正值人口老龄化。

paras.en: Meanwhile, nearly half of households that depend on casual labour are multidimensionally poor. These families, migrants and households in conflict areas face the highest poverty levels, underscoring the need for greater investment in decent livelihoods, education and essential services.
paras.zh: 与此同时，近一半依赖临时工的家庭属于多维贫困。这些家庭、移民和冲突地区的家庭面临着最高的贫困水平，这凸显出需要加大对体面生计、教育和基本服务的投资。

paras.en: “The greatest risk facing Myanmar is not only the deepening of poverty today, but the narrowing of opportunities tomorrow,” said Mr. Wignaraja.
paras.zh: “缅甸面临的最大风险不仅是今天贫困的加深，而且是明天机会的减少，”维格纳拉贾先生说。

paras.en: “Societal recovery cannot wait for a conflict to end. Investing in livelihoods, education, healthcare, local markets and basic services remains essential to preserving the fundamental human capabilities the country will need to heal and move forward”.
paras.zh: “社会复苏不能等到冲突结束。投资于生计、教育、医疗保健、当地市场和基本服务对于维护国家治愈和前进所需的基本人力能力仍然至关重要”。

articles.title: Afghanistan: Women face fresh dress code arrests amid record refugee returns

paras.en: Afghanistan: Women face fresh dress code arrests amid record refugee returns
paras.zh: 阿富汗：难民返回创纪录，女性面临新着装规定逮捕

paras.en: Afghan women and girls are being arrested, detained and threatened with arrest by Taliban authorities, the UN warned on Thursday as record numbers of returnees struggle to rebuild their lives back home.
paras.zh: 联合国周四警告说，阿富汗妇女和女孩正在被塔利班当局逮捕、拘留和威胁，因为创纪录的返回者人数正在努力重建家园。

paras.en: The UN Assistance Mission in Afghanistan (UNAMA) verified that at least 52 women and one girl were arrested or detained in Herat and Kabul between July and September, while other women were threatened with arrest.
paras.zh: 联合国阿富汗援助团（联阿援助团）证实，7 月至 9 月期间，至少有 52 名妇女和一名女孩在赫拉特和喀布尔被捕或拘留，其他妇女也受到逮捕威胁。

paras.en: The true number could be far higher, the mission said in a statement, because fear and stigma stop many cases from being reported.
paras.zh: 该代表团在一份声明中表示，真实数字可能要高得多，因为恐惧和耻辱阻止了许多病例的报道。

paras.en: Since the Taliban seized power in 2021, women and girls’ rights have been severely restricted, keeping them from secondary education, jobs and out of the public eye.
paras.zh: 自塔利班 2021 年掌权以来，妇女和女童的权利受到严格限制，导致她们无法接受中等教育、就业并远离公众视线。

paras.en: Recent arrests were related to alleged violations of the de facto authorities’ dress code requirements, according to UNAMA.
paras.zh: 据联阿援助团称，最近的逮捕与涉嫌违反事实上当局的着装要求有关。

paras.en: Many of the women were detained for not wearing a chador, having visible hair, wearing colourful scarves or makeup – or being in public without a mahram (male guardian).
paras.zh: 许多女性因不戴罩袍、头发暴露、戴着彩色围巾或化妆——或者在没有男性监护人陪同的情况下出现在公共场合而被拘留。

paras.en: “The women were released after spending several hours in detention,” the mission reported.
paras.zh: “这些妇女在被拘留几个小时后被释放，”调查团报告说。

paras.en: Alarmed by incidents involving verbal abuse, beatings and threats against women – including female shopkeepers – UNAMA reiterated that these acts violate women and girls’ rights to freedom of movement, expression and autonomy.
paras.zh: 联阿援助团对针对妇女（包括女店主）的辱骂、殴打和威胁事件感到震惊，重申这些行为侵犯了妇女和女孩的行动自由权、言论自由权和自主权。

paras.en: Arrests and detentions also expose women and girls to severe social stigma and further marginalisation, UNAMA said.
paras.zh: 联阿援助团表示，逮捕和拘留还使妇女和女童面临严重的社会耻辱和进一步边缘化。

paras.en: The Mission urged the de facto authorities to cease discriminatory enforcement practices targeting women and girls, ensure respect for the human rights and dignity of all Afghans and uphold Afghanistan’s obligations under international human rights law.
paras.zh: 访问团敦促事实上的当局停止针对妇女和女童的歧视性执法做法，确保尊重所有阿富汗人的人权和尊严，并维护阿富汗根据国际人权法承担的义务。

paras.en: At the same time, the International Organization for Migration (IOM) just released new findings on critical needs and reintegration barriers for nearly 6.5 million Afghans who have returned from Iran and Pakistan since 2023.
paras.zh: 与此同时，国际移民组织（IOM）刚刚发布了关于自 2023 年以来从伊朗和巴基斯坦返回的近 650 万阿富汗人的关键需求和重返社会障碍的新调查结果。

paras.en: “Afghanistan is receiving returnees at a scale and pace that requires sustained support beyond the point of arrival,” said Mihyung Park, IOM chief of mission in the country.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织驻阿富汗代表团团长朴美亨 (Mihyung Park) 表示：“阿富汗正在以规模和速度接收回返者，需要在抵达后持续提供支持。”

paras.en: “The findings show that many returnees intend to stay and rebuild their lives, but their ability to do so depends on access to livelihoods, safe shelter, documentation and essential services alongside support for the communities receiving them.”
paras.zh: “调查结果显示，许多回返者打算留下来并重建生活，但他们这样做的能力取决于获得生计、安全住所、文件和基本服务以及对接收他们的社区的支持。”

paras.en: The Returnee Resilience Overview also examines the situation of undocumented returnee households and individual returnees who had been in Afghanistan for at least eight months since arrival.
paras.zh: 《回返者复原力概览》还审查了无证回返者家庭和自抵达阿富汗以来已在阿富汗居住至少八个月的个人回返者的情况。

paras.en: - Among those aged 14 and above, 53 per cent had no completed education, half had no specialised experience and 69 per cent had not been employed in the 30 days before the interview
paras.zh: - 在14岁及以上的人中，53%的人没有完成学业，一半的人没有专业经验，69%的人在面试前30天内没有工作

paras.en: - 82 per cent returned as households, with an average size of 6.1 members
paras.zh: - 82%以家庭形式返回，平均人数为 6.1 名成员

paras.en: - 77 per cent lived in transitional shelters while 51 per cent lacked sufficient living space.
paras.zh: - 77%的人住在过渡性庇护所，而51%的人缺乏足够的居住空间。

paras.en: - 21 per cent of household respondents reported that all household members had documentation, while 43 per cent lacked the documentation needed to access relevant services
paras.zh: - 21% 的家庭受访者表示所有家庭成员都有证件，而 43% 的家庭受访者缺乏获得相关服务所需的证件

paras.en: These findings underscore that support to returnees must extend beyond the point of arrival, IOM said, calling for sustained investment in durable solutions,
paras.zh: 国际移民组织表示，这些调查结果强调，对返回者的支持必须超出抵达地点，并呼吁对持久解决方案进行持续投资，

paras.en: The UN migration agency also called for area-based reintegration approaches that strengthen livelihoods, shelter, documentation support and access to basic services for returnees and host communities, helping build the conditions needed for long-term stability, resilience and social cohesion.
paras.zh: 联合国移民机构还呼吁采取基于地区的重返社会方法，加强回返者和收容社区的生计、住房、文件支持和基本服务的获取，帮助创造长期稳定、复原力和社会凝聚力所需的条件。

articles.title: ‘Age must never diminish rights,’ UN independent expert warns

paras.en: ‘Age must never diminish rights,’ UN independent expert warns
paras.zh: 联合国独立专家警告：“年龄绝不能削弱权利”

paras.en: Older women around the world face violence, exploitation and neglect, yet remain largely invisible in the laws, policies, data and services designed to protect women overall, a UN independent human rights expert said on Thursday.
paras.zh: 联合国独立人权专家周四表示，世界各地的老年妇女面临暴力、剥削和忽视，但在旨在保护妇女整体的法律、政策、数据和服务中仍然基本上被忽视。

paras.en: - An estimated 664 million women were aged 60 or older in 2025, a number projected to reach 1.13 billion by 2050
paras.zh: - 到 2025 年，估计有 6.64 亿女性年龄在 60 岁或以上，预计到 2050 年这一数字将达到 11.3 亿

paras.en: - A new report examines violence against older women as a distinct and intersectional issue rooted in discrimination, ageism and inequality
paras.zh: - 一份新报告将针对老年妇女的暴力行为视为植根于歧视、年龄歧视和不平等的独特交叉问题

paras.en: Reem Alsalem, Special Rapporteur on the causes and consequences of violence against women and girls, called for urgent action by States to ensure that a woman’s right to live free from violence does not diminish with age.
paras.zh: 暴力侵害妇女和女童行为因果问题特别报告员雷姆·阿尔萨勒姆呼吁各国采取紧急行动，确保妇女免受暴力侵害的权利不会随着年龄的增长而减弱。

paras.en: “Women should not lose their right to live free from violence because they grow older,” Ms. Alsalem said in her latest report to the General Assembly.
paras.zh: “妇女不应因为年龄增长而失去免受暴力侵害的权利，”阿尔萨勒姆女士在向大会提交的最新报告中表示。

paras.en: “Too often, ageism and sexism combine to make violence against older women invisible, tolerated or treated as an inevitable part of ageing.”
paras.zh: “很多时候，年龄歧视和性别歧视结合在一起，使得针对老年妇女的暴力行为变得不可见、被容忍或被视为老龄化不可避免的一部分。”

paras.en: She said older women are rights holders, knowledge bearers and active members of society, adding that their age “must never be used to diminish their dignity, autonomy or protection”.
paras.zh: 她说，老年妇女是权利持有者、知识承载者和社会积极成员，并补充说，她们的年龄“绝不能被用来削弱她们的尊严、自主权或保护”。

paras.en: The report identifies physical, psychological, sexual and economic violence as well as coercive control, neglect, abandonment and technology-facilitated violence.
paras.zh: 该报告指出了身体、心理、性和经济暴力以及强制控制、忽视、遗弃和技术促成的暴力。

paras.en: It also outlines that older women may face exploitation when it comes to their pensions and property, digital exclusion, denial of healthcare or assistive devices and barriers to reporting and justice.
paras.zh: 它还概述了老年妇女在养老金和财产方面可能面临剥削、数字排斥、拒绝获得医疗保健或辅助设备以及报告和司法障碍。

paras.en: She said violence can occur in homes, communities, care institutions, prisons and crisis and conflict settings.
paras.zh: 她说，暴力可能发生在家庭、社区、护理机构、监狱以及危机和冲突环境中。

paras.en: In addition, the report emphasises that older women may be excluded from services and data, while sexual violence against them remains under-recognised.
paras.zh: 此外，报告强调，老年妇女可能被排除在服务和数据之外，而针对她们的性暴力仍然没有得到充分认识。

paras.en: Ms. Alsalem found that widows, migrant and stateless women, rural women, women with disabilities, women in institutional care and women affected by conflict and humanitarian crises are particularly at risk.
paras.zh: 阿尔萨勒姆女士发现，寡妇、移民和无国籍妇女、农村妇女、残疾妇女、接受机构照料的妇女以及受冲突和人道主义危机影响的妇女面临的风险尤其大。

paras.en: “Where an older woman is living with poverty, disability, isolation or dependence on others for care, we must be attentive to the pressures that can shape the choices available to her,” she said.
paras.zh: “当老年妇女生活在贫困、残疾、孤立或依赖他人照顾的情况下，我们必须关注可能影响她做出选择的压力，”她说。

paras.en: “No woman should be made to feel that her continued life is a burden simply because she has reached an advanced age or requires support.”
paras.zh: “不应让任何女性仅仅因为年事已高或需要支持而感到自己的持续生活是一种负担。”

paras.en: - Explicitly recognise and address violence against older women in laws, national strategies and violence prevention and response programmes
paras.zh: - 在法律、国家战略以及暴力预防和应对方案中明确承认并解决暴力侵害老年妇女的问题

paras.en: - Collect age and sex-disaggregated data
paras.zh: - 收集按年龄和性别分类的数据

paras.en: - Strengthen accessible reporting, protection, justice and redress
paras.zh: - 加强无障碍报告、保护、正义和补救

paras.en: - Ensure training for law enforcement, judicial, health and social service professionals
paras.zh: - 确保对执法、司法、卫生和社会服务专业人员进行培训

paras.en: Independent experts are appointed by the Human Rights Council in Geneva. They are not UN staff and do not receive any salary for their work.
paras.zh: 独立专家由日内瓦人权理事会任命。他们不是联合国工作人员，不领取任何工资。

articles.title: Hunter Bell celebrates in Team GB's 'glam' female track success

paras.en: Georgia Hunter Bell: British 800m and 1500m runner celebrates team's female track success
paras.zh: 乔治亚·亨特·贝尔：英国 800 米和 1500 米赛跑运动员庆祝女子田径队的胜利

paras.en: Georgia Hunter Bell, Keely Hodgkinson, Amy Hunt and Dina Asher-Smith are standout members of a strong British female core delivering medals on the track; Hunter Bell: "We're locked into everyone's goals... someone winning or bringing home a medal, it makes you even more keen to do well"
paras.zh: 乔治亚·亨特·贝尔 (Georgia Hunter Bell)、基莉·霍奇金森 (Keely Hodgkinson)、艾米·亨特 (Amy Hunt) 和迪娜·阿舍·史密斯 (Dina Asher-Smith) 是英国女性核心队伍中的杰出成员，她们在田径赛场上夺得奖牌；亨特·贝尔：“我们锁定了每个人的目标……有人赢得或带回奖牌，这会让你更加渴望取得好成绩”

paras.en: Georgia Hunter Bell has enjoyed quite the year, winning a hat-trick of gold medals at the World Indoor Championships, for England at the Commonwealth Games, and again for Team GB at the European Championships.
paras.zh: 乔治亚·亨特·贝尔 (Georgia Hunter Bell) 度过了相当愉快的一年，她在世界室内锦标赛上完成了帽子戏法，在英联邦运动会上为英格兰队赢得了金牌，并在欧洲锦标赛上再次为英国队赢得了金牌。

paras.en: But British female track success in 2025 certainly didn't stop there. Sprinter Amy Hunt made headlines with a record four-gold display in the Europeans in Birmingham, while Dina Asher-Smith now tops the all-time medal table at the championships after winning her 11th, eight of which are gold.
paras.zh: 但 2025 年英国女子田径赛的成功肯定不止于此。短跑运动员艾米·亨特 (Amy Hunt) 在伯明翰举行的欧洲锦标赛中以创纪录的四枚金牌成为头条新闻，而迪娜·阿舍·史密斯 (Dina Asher-Smith) 在赢得第 11 枚金牌（其中 8 枚是金牌）后，目前位居锦标赛奖牌榜历史榜首。

paras.en: Among other successes, Keely Hodgkinson claimed World Indoor gold in the 800m in March - in the second-fastest indoor time in history - and set a new British record at that distance in the summer, though she'd be pipped to gold at the Europeans after sitting out the Commonwealth Games due to muscle tightness.
paras.zh: 除其他成就外，基利·霍奇金森 (Keely Hodgkinson) 在 3 月份获得了 800 米世界室内赛金牌，这是历史上第二快的室内成绩，并在夏天创下了该距离的英国新纪录，尽管她因肌肉紧张而缺席英联邦运动会，但在欧洲赛上却被击败，夺得金牌。

paras.en: - Sky Sports on WhatsApp: Breaking news, videos and analysis
paras.zh: - WhatsApp 上的天空体育：突发新闻、视频和分析

paras.en: - Download the Sky Sports app for expert analysis, best video & more
paras.zh: - 下载天空体育应用程序以获得专家分析、最佳视频等

paras.en: - Latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract on NOW
paras.zh: - NOW 最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播

paras.en: "It's really cool. just being part of this era. It's really fun," Hunter Bell told Sky Sports.
paras.zh: “这真的很酷。成为这个时代的一部分。这真的很有趣，”亨特贝尔告诉天空体育。

paras.en: "We all know each other very well. We all travel together, see each other a lot throughout the year, so it's fun to tune in and be like, 'Oh, Amy's racing tonight'.
paras.zh: “我们彼此都很了解。我们都一起旅行，一年中经常见面，所以收听节目并说‘哦，艾米今晚要比赛’很有趣。”

paras.en: "We're locked into everyone's goals and what they're trying to do. And when you're on a team together, someone winning or bringing home a medal, it makes you even more keen to do well because you want to contribute."
paras.zh: “我们被锁定在每个人的目标和他们想要做的事情上。当你在一个团队中，有人赢得或带回奖牌时，你会更加渴望做得好，因为你想做出贡献。”

paras.en: In addition to her statement performances on the track during her record-breaking Europeans, Hunt earned attention for her curated nail art that gave nod to landmarks within Birmingham, like the Bull Ring.
paras.zh: 除了在打破欧洲纪录的赛道上的出色表现外，亨特还因其精心设计的美甲艺术而受到关注，这些美甲艺术向伯明翰的地标建筑（如斗牛场）致敬。

paras.en: "Everyone knows I love a bit of glam and I love my nails," Hunt told the BBC at the time.
paras.zh: “每个人都知道我喜欢一点华丽，我喜欢我的指甲，”亨特当时告诉英国广播公司。

paras.en: Hunter Bell says it's something the GB squad share, as feeling your best self on the start line can provide "that extra one or two per cent" to make you "feel like you can do anything".
paras.zh: 亨特·贝尔表示，这是英国队共有的东西，因为在起跑线上感觉最好的自己可以提供“额外的百分之一或百分之二”，让你“感觉自己可以做任何事情”。

paras.en: "I enjoy the whole process of getting ready. We get ready like we're going to a club, we're quite glammed up," Hunter Bell said.
paras.zh: “我喜欢准备的整个过程。我们像去俱乐部一样做好准备，我们非常高兴，”亨特贝尔说。

paras.en: "We definitely put effort into it, for sure. We want to look nice.
paras.zh: “我们肯定会付出努力，这是肯定的。我们希望看起来很漂亮。

paras.en: "It's about doing whatever you need to feel confident on the start line - and I just think it makes you race better if you're feeling good about yourself.
paras.zh: “这是关于做任何你需要做的事情，让你在起跑线上感到自信——我只是认为，如果你自我感觉良好，这会让你比赛得更好。

paras.en: "So much of that comes from the training and the lead up, of course. But it's that extra one or two per cent that makes you stand on the start line and feel like you can do anything, feel like you're a winner."
paras.zh: “当然，其中很大一部分来自训练和准备工作。但正是那额外的百分之一或百分之二让你站在起跑线上，感觉自己可以做任何事情，感觉自己是胜利者。”

paras.en: In terms of eye-catching track looks, Hodgkinson dominated the final race of her 2026 season by winning the 800m at Athlos in London last month as she debuted a new full-length, hooded speed suit.
paras.zh: 在引人注目的赛道造型方面，霍奇金森在上个月伦敦 Athlos 的 800m 比赛中夺得冠军，她在 2026 年赛季的最后一场比赛中首次亮相，她推出了全新的连帽连帽速度服。

paras.en: Hodgkinson's outfit reminded people of Australian Cathy Freeman's which she won the women's 400m in at the 2000 Sydney Olympics, and it could be a feature for athletes at the next Olympics in Los Angeles in 2028.
paras.zh: 霍奇金森的这套服装让人想起澳大利亚选手凯西·弗里曼(Cathy Freeman)，她在2000年悉尼奥运会上赢得了女子400米比赛，这可能会成为2028年洛杉矶奥运会运动员的一大亮点。

paras.en: Hunter Bell didn't rule out being one of them to don the suit.
paras.zh: 亨特·贝尔不排除成为穿上这套衣服的人之一。

paras.en: "The first time you see it, it's like, 'Whoa! Haven't seen that before'," she said. "It will be interesting to see whether it becomes the norm.
paras.zh: “当你第一次看到它时，就像是，‘哇！以前没见过’，”她说。 “看看它是否成为常态将会很有趣。

paras.en: "They do say it's quicker, so I'm definitely not ruling it out."
paras.zh: “他们确实说这样更快，所以我绝对不排除这种可能性。”

articles.title: PL Predictions: Spurs to condemn Man Utd to their worst start in 40 years

paras.en: Premier League predictions & Jones Knows' best bets: Liverpool vs Manchester City, Manchester United vs Tottenham and more
paras.zh: 英超联赛预测和琼斯知道的最佳投注：利物浦 vs 曼城、曼联 vs 托特纳姆热刺等

paras.en: Our football betting expert Lewis Jones provides his analysis as the Premier League returns; Watch Manchester United vs Tottenham, Crystal Palace vs Nottingham Forest, Hull vs Everton, Liverpool vs Manchester City & Coventry vs Newcastle live on Sky Sports; Play Super 6 to win £1m!
paras.zh: 我们的足球博彩专家刘易斯·琼斯在英超联赛回归后提供了他的分析；在天空体育观看曼联对阵托特纳姆热刺、水晶宫对阵诺丁汉森林、赫尔城对阵埃弗顿、利物浦对阵曼城、考文垂对阵纽卡斯尔的直播；玩 Super 6 赢取 100 万英镑！

paras.en: Our top tipster Lewis Jones, aka Jones Knows, provides his analysis and betting insight across the Premier League weekend.
paras.zh: 我们的顶级情报员刘易斯·琼斯（又名“琼斯知道”）提供了他对整个英超联赛周末的分析和投注见解。

paras.en: Arsenal vs Leeds United, Saturday 12.30pm
paras.zh: 阿森纳 vs 利兹联，周六 12 点 30 分

paras.en: Three weeks. That's a long time in football.
paras.zh: 三个星期。这在足球界已经是很长一段时间了。

paras.en: This international break with nations playing up to four matches rather than the usual two has the potential to have a huge effect on this Premier League return. Fatigue, injuries, travel and late returns mixed in with teams still developing tactical identity so early in the season is going to influence matters more than the betting markets portray.
paras.zh: 此次国际比赛日期间，各国将进行最多四场比赛，而不是通常的两场比赛，这可能会对英超联赛的回归产生巨大影响。疲劳、伤病、旅行和迟到的回归，加上球队在赛季初仍在发展战术特征，对事情的影响将比博彩市场所描绘的更大。

paras.en: The key is that the first half is the period most vulnerable to disruption after this break which I'm betting will be even more of a factor with the added time away on international duty in this unique break.
paras.zh: 关键是上半场是这次休息后最容易受到干扰的时期，我敢打赌，随着这次独特的休息中国际比赛时间的增加，这将成为一个更大的因素。

paras.en: - How does Mikel Arteta turn champions into serial winners?
paras.zh: - 米克尔·阿尔特塔如何将冠军变成连续赢家？

paras.en: - ARSENAL PODCAST: Listen to an Arteta new contract special!
paras.zh: - 阿森纳播客：收听阿尔特塔新合同特别节目！

paras.en: When looking across the last five seasons in the Championship and Premier League in the matchday after the first international break, the numbers show that first-half goals per game go down by 0.3 of a goal. First-half goal averages have come in at 1.22 across that period in the Championship and Premier League but fall to 0.92 in the first matchday after the first international break.
paras.zh: 回顾过去五个赛季的英冠和英超联赛，在第一次国际比赛日后的比赛日，数据显示上半场场均进球数减少了 0.3 个球。在此期间，英冠和英超联赛上半场的平均进球数为 1.22，但在第一次国际比赛日后的第一个比赛日下降至 0.92。

paras.en: The numbers become even more interesting when just assessing the Premier League during that period where the average is just 0.82 goals per first half. During that period the chances of a half-time 0-0 have increased too, with 50 per cent of the matches in that five-year sample size seeing no goals scored before the break. That is a huge spike on the long-term numbers across five years of Premier League games which tell us that the normal average strike-rate for a 0-0 at half-time is just 27 per cent.
paras.zh: 当仅仅评估这段时期的英超联赛时，这个数字就变得更加有趣，因为上半场的平均进球数仅为 0.82 个。在此期间，半场0-0的可能性也有所增加，五年样本量中有50%的比赛在中场休息前没有进球。这与五年英超比赛的长期数据相比是一个巨大的增长，这告诉我们半场 0-0 的正常平均进球率仅为 27%。

paras.en: Remarkably, Leeds have only conceded two first-half goals in their last 20 matches across all competitions with 11 of those games seeing a 0-0 come in at the break. It's a big runner here at 9/4 with Sky Bet.
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，利兹联在过去 20 场各项赛事中仅在上半场丢了 2 个球，其中 11 场比赛中场休息时比分是 0-0。这是 Sky Bet 的 9/4 的大赢家。

paras.en: SCORE PREDICTION: 1-0 | JONES KNOWS' BEST BET: 0-0 at half-time (9/4 with Sky Bet)
paras.zh: 比分预测：1-0 |琼斯知道最佳投注：半场0-0（Sky Bet 为 9/4）

paras.en: Aston Villa vs Brentford, Saturday 3pm - PLAY SUPER 6!
paras.zh: 阿斯顿维拉 vs 布伦特福德，周六下午 3 点 - PLAY SUPER 6！

paras.en: The Premier League has become such a congested - and at times bonkers - league that we've reached the stage where Brentford are almost being priced as favourites to beat Aston Villa at Villa Park. I get the love for Brentford - but ranking them above an Unai Emery side on home soil feels like a dangerous game to play.
paras.zh: 英超联赛已经变得如此拥挤，有时甚至是疯狂的联赛，以至于布伦特福德几乎被认为是在维拉公园击败阿斯顿维拉的热门球队。我很喜欢布伦特福德，但将他们排在主场乌奈·埃梅里队之上感觉像是一场危险的比赛。

paras.en: The market still looks cold on Villa, but I think their rebuild is quietly coming together. Johan Manzambi, Zion Suzuki and Nicolas Jackson all shone in the win at Tottenham and, despite so many new faces, there was an encouraging cohesion to Villa's performance.
paras.zh: 市场对维拉的看法仍然冷淡，但我认为他们的重建正在悄然进行。约翰·曼赞比、锡安·铃木和尼古拉斯·杰克逊在对阵托特纳姆热刺的比赛中都表现出色，尽管有这么多新面孔，但维拉的表现仍然令人鼓舞。

paras.en: That shouldn't necessarily come as a surprise.
paras.zh: 这并不一定令人意外。

paras.en: These players are working under a manager who knows exactly what he is doing, especially after an international break where Emery is unbeaten across his last 10 matches with Villa, winning six of them.
paras.zh: 这些球员在一位清楚知道自己在做什么的教练手下工作，尤其是在国际比赛日之后，埃梅里在过去10场与维拉的比赛中保持不败，并赢得了其中的6场比赛。

paras.en: With home advantage, a manager I trust implicitly and a price of 13/8 with Sky Bet, I'm happy to take on the market forces when it comes to Brentford. Home win.
paras.zh: 凭借主场优势、一位我绝对信任的主帅以及 Sky Bet 13/8 的赔率，我很乐意在布伦特福德方面与市场力量抗衡。主场获胜。

paras.en: Chelsea vs Bournemouth, Saturday 3pm - PLAY SUPER 6!
paras.zh: 切尔西对阵伯恩茅斯，周六下午 3 点 - PLAY SUPER 6！

paras.en: The loss of Alex Scott will make Bournemouth a less effective team - our job is to work out whether the market has reacted sufficiently enough to the news of his unavailability for six weeks with a tendon issue.
paras.zh: 亚历克斯·斯科特的离去将使伯恩茅斯成为一支效率较低的球队——我们的工作是弄清楚市场是否对他因肌腱问题缺席六周的消息做出了足够的反应。

paras.en: The Cherries have played four times without Scott in the Premier League since the start of last season and failed to win all four, including a disappointing 1-1 draw with Burnley at home - a small sample size of course but certainly relevant.
paras.zh: 自上赛季开始以来，樱桃队在没有斯科特的情况下在英超联赛中进行了四次比赛，但未能赢得全部四场比赛，其中包括令人失望的主场1-1战平伯恩利——当然样本量很小，但肯定具有相关性。

paras.en: Chelsea are 7/10 with Sky Bet for victory which is bordering on tempting but the best way in is to add goals to the mix. All five of Chelsea's games have gone over 2.5 goals with the average coming in at 4.4 per game whilst both teams to score has landed in 13 of Bournemouth's last 17 away games.
paras.zh: 切尔西在 Sky Bet 中的胜利赔率为 7/10，这近乎诱人，但最好的方法就是增加进球数。切尔西所有 5 场比赛的进球数均超过 2.5 个，场均进球数为 4.4 个，而伯恩茅斯过去 17 个客场比赛中有 13 场都有进球。

paras.en: Goals look guaranteed, so combining Chelsea to win, both teams to score and over 2.5 goals at 6/4 with Sky Bet rates as a savvy way to attack this game.
paras.zh: 进球看起来是有保证的，所以结合切尔西获胜，两支球队都进球并且进球数超过 2.5 个，赔率为 6/4，Sky Bet 的赔率是这场比赛的明智进攻方式。

paras.en: Time to roll the Leif Davis dice again whilst the prices remain inflated.
paras.zh: 是时候在价格仍然上涨的情况下再次掷骰子了。

paras.en: Davis is playing as an aggressive left-back in Gary O'Neil's 4-2-3-1 and has become one of Ipswich's principal attacking outlets. His attacking position means he's effectively functioning as another winger when Ipswich have sustained possession. This role is bringing the best out of Davis, who in his last four starts has had six shots, three of those hitting the target and scoring twice. Ipswich should find space to work with in this winnable fixture so the 11/4 on Davis to score or assist makes significant appeal.

articles.title: How England snub could boost Toone’s World Cup chances

paras.en: Greece vs England: How Ella Toone’s Lionesses snub could boost her World Cup chances
paras.zh: 希腊 vs 英格兰：埃拉·图恩 (Ella Toone) 的母狮冷落如何增加她参加世界杯的机会

paras.en: Ella Toone was left out of England’s squad for the Greece play-offs after a difficult start to the season; she has responded positively; Sarina Wiegman has been impressed as midfield competition intensifies.
paras.zh: 在经历了艰难的赛季开局后，埃拉·图恩被排除在英格兰队参加希腊附加赛的阵容之外。她做出了积极的回应；随着中场竞争的加剧，萨琳娜·维格曼（Sarina Wiegman）印象深刻。

paras.en: Ella Toone may have started this international break on the outside looking in, but she looks set to emerge from it with her chances of making it to Brazil next summer strengthened.
paras.zh: 艾拉·图恩（Ella Toone）可能是从局外人角度开始这次国际比赛的，但她看起来将会从中脱颖而出，明年夏天参加巴西比赛的机会将会增强。

paras.en: Toone was dropped for the World Cup play-off games against Greece after struggling for form at the start of the season with Manchester United.
paras.zh: 图恩在赛季初与曼联的比赛中表现不佳，因此缺席了对阵希腊的世界杯附加赛。

paras.en: England head coach Sarina Wiegman admitted Toone's performances had not been up to the expected standard and laid down a challenge for the two-time Euros winner.
paras.zh: 英格兰队主教练萨琳娜·维格曼承认图恩的表现没有达到预期标准，并对这位两届欧洲杯冠军提出了挑战。

paras.en: - Why England have to prove themselves against Greece
paras.zh: - 为什么英格兰必须在对阵希腊的比赛中证明自己

paras.en: - Got Sky? Watch WSL games on your phone
paras.zh: - 有天空吗？在手机上观看 WSL 比赛

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Stream WSL games with no contract
paras.zh: - 没有天空？无需签订合同即可直播 WSL 比赛

paras.en: The experienced head coach wanted to see how Toone would respond, both on and off the field. The results have impressed the usually stoic Wiegman.
paras.zh: 这位经验丰富的主教练想看看图恩在场内和场外会如何反应。结果给一向坚忍的韦格曼留下了深刻的印象。

paras.en: A disappointed Toone accepted she would be watching the Greece games on TV and admitted to reporters after her last WSL game that she would use being dropped as "fuel to come back even better".
paras.zh: 失望的图恩承认她将在电视上观看希腊比赛，并在上一场 WSL 比赛结束后向记者承认，她将利用被淘汰作为“更好地回归的动力”。

paras.en: She then went to Spain to reset mentally and physically.
paras.zh: 随后她前往西班牙进行精神和身体上的调整。

paras.en: Instead of chilling out by the pool in Marbella, Toone put in the work to make sure she returned to her club in peak condition.
paras.zh: 图恩并没有在马贝拉的泳池边放松，而是努力确保她以最佳状态回到俱乐部。

paras.en: Then came the call from Wiegman - one gratefully received by the midfielder, even if she is likely to sit on the bench for the next two matches.
paras.zh: 然后是维格曼的电话——这位中场球员感激地接到了电话，尽管她很可能在接下来的两场比赛中坐在替补席上。

paras.en: Toone does not care. She just wants to be part of things again, even if that means a last-minute scramble across Europe.
paras.zh: 图恩不在乎。她只是想再次参与其中，即使这意味着要在最后一刻争夺整个欧洲。

paras.en: All of this has made Wiegman smile. She wanted a professional and motivated reaction from one of her go-to players, and she has got it.
paras.zh: 这一切都让韦格曼笑了。她希望她的首选球员能够做出专业而积极的反应，而她已经做到了。

paras.en: Wiegman wants to take all her trusted lieutenants to Brazil, giving them the chance to go into battle together one last time before she calls time on her England tenure.
paras.zh: 维格曼希望将她所有信任的副官带到巴西，让他们有机会在她结束英格兰任期之前最后一次并肩作战。

paras.en: Toone is in that select group. It appears overcoming this setback has made her even more respected by her coach.
paras.zh: 图恩就属于那个精选组。看来克服这次挫折让她更加受到教练的尊重。

paras.en: England have lacked depth in midfield in recent years. Since Fran Kirby's retirement, Toone, Keira Walsh and Georgia Stanway have largely been the first-choice trio.
paras.zh: 英格兰队近年来中场深度不足。自从弗兰·柯比退休以来，图恩、凯拉·沃尔什和乔治亚·斯坦威基本上是首选三人组。

paras.en: Twenty-year-old Lexi Potter's form at Chelsea cannot be ignored, while Erica Meg Parkinson, who is just 18, is a regular starter in the National Women's Soccer League (NWSL).
paras.zh: 20 岁的莱克西·波特 (Lexi Potter) 在切尔西的表现不容忽视，而年仅 18 岁的埃里卡·梅格·帕金森 (Erica Meg Parkinson) 则是全国女子足球联盟 (NWSL) 的常规首发球员。

paras.en: Then there is Lucia Kendall, who is well-liked by Wiegman, while Laura Blinkilde Brown and Grace Clinton have just won the Women's Super League (WSL) with Manchester City.
paras.zh: 然后是深受韦格曼喜爱的露西娅·肯德尔（Lucia Kendall），而劳拉·布林基德·布朗（Laura Blinkilde Brown）和格蕾丝·克林顿（Grace Clinton）刚刚随曼城赢得了女子超级联赛（WSL）。

paras.en: Despite the increased competition, Wiegman admits big games "aren't the time for rotation".
paras.zh: 尽管竞争加剧，维格曼承认大型比赛“不是轮换的时候”。

paras.en: That is another positive Toone can take from this situation.
paras.zh: 这是图恩可以从这种情况中获得的另一个积极成果。

paras.en: If she can rediscover her best form for Manchester United, Toone can once again become the player Wiegman turns to when the stakes are highest.
paras.zh: 如果图恩能够在曼联重新找回自己的最佳状态，她就能再次成为维格曼在最危险的时候求助的球员。

paras.en: England are planning for plenty of those occasions this season, and Toone appears determined to make sure she is there for as many of them as possible.
paras.zh: 英格兰队本赛季计划举办很多这样的场合，图恩似乎决心确保她尽可能多地参加这些场合。

articles.title: Flydubai pilot planned a 9/11-style attack on Tel Aviv airport, source says
articles.author: Keir Simmons

paras.en: TEL AVIV — The pilot accused of trying to bring down an Israel-bound flight had been planning a 9/11-style attack by crashing into the country’s main airport in Tel Aviv, a Middle Eastern official has told NBC News.
paras.zh: 特拉维夫——一名中东官员告诉 NBC 新闻，被指控试图击落一架飞往以色列的航班的飞行员一直在策划一场 9/11 式的袭击，撞向特拉维夫的该国主要机场。

paras.en: The pilot, identified by NBC News as Hamman al-Hamammi, told investigators Monday that he wanted to evade Israel’s defenses and crash into the Ben Gurion Airport or another building, said the official, who spoke on condition of anonymity because the person was not authorized to speak publicly.
paras.zh: 这位被 NBC 新闻确认为哈曼·哈马米 (Hamman al-Hamammi) 的飞行员周一告诉调查人员，他想躲避以色列的防御并撞向本古里安机场或另一座建筑，该官员表示，由于未获授权公开发言，该官员要求匿名。

paras.en: Multiple sources from three agencies briefed on the investigation and a diplomat in the Middle East identified al-Hammami, an Omani citizen. Authorities have not officially released the identity.
paras.zh: 来自三个机构的多个消息来源通报了调查情况，一名中东外交官确认了阿曼公民哈马米的身份。当局尚未正式公布该身份。

paras.en: He is currently being questioned by investigators in the United Arab Emirates after he was transferred from Saudi Arabia. The flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv was diverted to an airport in Saudi Arabia, where it landed safely, after last week’s dramatic midair incident.
paras.zh: 他从沙特阿拉伯被转移后，目前正在阿拉伯联合酋长国接受调查人员的讯问。在上周发生戏剧性的空中事件后，这架从迪拜飞往特拉维夫的航班被转移到沙特阿拉伯的一个机场并安全降落。

paras.en: Emirati authorities said Saturday that the pilot attacked his fellow pilot, Capt. Smit Machchhar, with a crash ax and tried to take control of the aircraft’s flight controls.
paras.zh: 阿联酋当局周六表示，这名飞行员用一把坠毁斧袭击了他的飞行员同伴斯密特·马赫恰尔机长，并试图控制飞机的飞行控制装置。

paras.en: The jet, which was carrying 174 passengers, most of them Israeli, then plummeted 14,000 feet in just 29 seconds, according to data from the aviation tracking service Flightradar24, causing panic onboard.
paras.zh: 根据航空跟踪服务 Flightradar24 的数据，这架飞机载有 174 名乘客，其中大多数是以色列人，然后在短短 29 秒内从 14,000 英尺的高度坠落，引起机上恐慌。

paras.en: Machchhar, an Indian national and a veteran pilot of 17 years, said in a call Friday with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu that his fellow pilot told him he was going to pray, something he didn’t consider unusual as observant Muslims pray five times a day.
paras.zh: 马赫哈尔是一名印度公民，也是一名拥有 17 年飞行经验的资深飞行员。他周五在与以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的通话中表示，他的飞行员同伴告诉他，他要祈祷，他认为这并不罕见，因为虔诚的穆斯林每天祈祷五次。

paras.en: A few minutes later, he said he felt a strong blow to the head. “Because of his initial blows, my vision was almost like nothing, and I was completely blurred out,” he added. “The next feeling that I had was that the aircraft was sharply going down.”
paras.zh: 几分钟后，他说他感到头部受到重击。 “由于他最初的打击，我的视力几乎为零，我完全模糊了，”他补充道。 “我的下一个感觉是飞机正在急剧下降。”

paras.en: A video of the call was released by Netanyahu’s office.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡办公室发布了通话视频。

paras.en: Initially, Machchhar said, he thought there was “catastrophic damage to the aircraft,” but once the blows kept coming, he “realized that it’s not the aircraft, it’s the other guy who was in the cockpit with me.”
paras.zh: 马赫恰尔说，最初，他认为“飞机遭受了灾难性损坏”，但当撞击不断发生时，他“意识到问题不是飞机，而是和我一起在驾驶舱里的另一个人。”

paras.en: In a separate call with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, also Friday, Machchhar said he managed to open the cockpit’s door on the second attempt, despite the blows raining down.
paras.zh: 同样在周五与印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪的另一次通话中，马赫恰尔表示，尽管猛烈的攻击，他在第二次尝试中成功打开了驾驶舱的门。

paras.en: “I gave everything that I had and just went for the door and opened the door. And thankfully, people were waiting to pounce back,” he said.
paras.zh: “我倾尽全力，走到门口，打开了门。值得庆幸的是，人们正在等待着反击，”他说。

paras.en: Focus has shifted onto the missed security signals ahead of the flight.
paras.zh: 焦点已转移到飞行前错过的安全信号上。

paras.en: Citing sources familiar with the matter, The Wall Street Journal reported Saturday that al-Hammami had “previously been banned from flying by Oman over concerns he had adopted radical ideological views.”
paras.zh: 《华尔街日报》周六援引知情人士的话报道称，哈马米“此前曾因担心他采取激进的意识形态观点而被阿曼禁止乘坐飞机”。

paras.en: It is unclear how a citizen of Oman, an Arab country with no diplomatic relations with Israel, was allowed to fly the plane carrying Israelis to Tel Aviv.
paras.zh: 目前还不清楚与以色列没有外交关系的阿拉伯国家阿曼的公民如何被允许驾驶载有以色列人的飞机飞往特拉维夫。

paras.en: According to Israeli law, airlines must provide information about passengers and crew members, including their names and nationalities, up to 48 hours before a flight.
paras.zh: 根据以色列法律，航空公司必须在航班起飞前 48 小时内提供乘客和机组人员的信息，包括姓名和国籍。

paras.en: Israeli investigators are leaning toward the assessment that the pilot was acting as a lone wolf, according to an Israeli official and a source familiar with the matter, although they said there is still more to learn about what led to his radicalization.
paras.zh: 据一名以色列官员和一位知情人士透露，以色列调查人员倾向于认为这名飞行员是“独狼”，不过他们表示，关于导致他变得激进的原因，还有更多信息需要了解。

paras.en: In the meantime, Netanyahu has called on the head of the National Security Council to appoint an examiner to review “all security aspects” of Israel’s civil aviation in the aftermath of the incident.
paras.zh: 与此同时，内塔尼亚胡呼吁国家安全委员会主席任命一名审查员，对事件发生后以色列民航的“所有安全方面”进行审查。

paras.en: Elsewhere, Vice President JD Vance underlined the concerns about potential security failures.
paras.zh: 在其他地方，副总裁 JD Vance 强调了对潜在安全故障的担忧。

paras.en: “That person should not have been flying an airline, and so we’re certainly looking at our procedures within the United States to make sure that people who are obviously flight risks are not getting behind the wheel of an airplane,” he told a reporter at Joint Base Andrews, Maryland, on Monday.
paras.zh: 他周一在马里兰州安德鲁斯联合基地对记者表示：“那个人不应该乘坐航空公司的航班，因此我们肯定会审查美国境内的程序，以确保明显有飞行风险的人不会驾驶飞机。”

articles.title: Russia says no plague found in contacts of Siberian lab worker who died
articles.author: Yuliya Talmazan

paras.en: Plague had not been detected among close contacts of a worker in an anti-plague laboratory in Siberia who died last week, with 60% of the identified group tested so far, officials in Russia said Tuesday.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯官员周二表示，西伯利亚一家抗鼠疫实验室上周死亡的一名工作人员的密切接触者中尚未发现鼠疫，目前已对已确定人群中的 60% 进行了检测。

paras.en: News from Russia’s consumer and health watchdog Sunday that a female staffer at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia and the Far East had died from a “pneumonia of undetermined” origin last week has raised public health fears worldwide.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯消费者和健康监管机构周日发布消息称，西伯利亚和远东伊尔库茨克抗鼠疫研究所的一名女工作人员上周死于“不明原因肺炎”，这一消息引发了全世界的公共卫生担忧。

paras.en: “Laboratory testing identified two cases of Covid-19 and two cases of rhinovirus infection,” watchdog Rospotrebnadzor said in a statement, referring to the virus that causes the common cold. “No other infectious disease pathogens were detected among the contacts,” the statement said, without mentioning the word “plague.”
paras.zh: 监管机构 Rospotrebnadzor 在一份声明中表示，“实验室检测发现了两例 Covid-19 病例和两例鼻病毒感染病例”，指的是引起普通感冒的病毒。声明称，“在接触者中未发现其他传染病病原体”，但没有提及“鼠疫”一词。

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump said Tuesday he had a call scheduled with Russian President Vladimir Putin to discuss the matter.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周二表示，他计划与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京通话，讨论此事。

paras.en: Darya Shipilova, 28, was identified by her mother and Russian media outlets as the lab worker who died.
paras.zh: 28 岁的达莉亚·希皮洛娃 (Darya Shipilova) 被她的母亲和俄罗斯媒体确认为死亡的实验室工作人员。

paras.en: Regional and national Russian authorities have not confirmed that plague was involved in her death. However, a State Department spokesperson said Monday there had been “reports of a fatal case of suspected pneumonic plague” in Irkutsk oblast.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯地区和国家当局尚未证实她的死亡与瘟疫有关。然而，美国国务院发言人周一表示，伊尔库茨克州有“疑似肺鼠疫死亡病例的报告”。

paras.en: Separately, a State Department official told NBC News on Tuesday that the U.S. had been in contact with the Russian government as early as Friday. Health experts at the State Department had taken part in the contact along with the Russian Foreign Affairs Ministry, the official said.
paras.zh: 另外，美国国务院一名官员周二对 NBC 新闻表示，美国早在周五就已与俄罗斯政府进行了接触。这位官员说，国务院的卫生专家与俄罗斯外交部一起参与了接触。

paras.en: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention also said on X that it was “working across the U.S. government to assess developments as additional information becomes available.”
paras.zh: 美国疾病控制与预防中心也在 X 上表示，它“正在与美国政府合作，在获得更多信息时评估事态发展”。

paras.en: “At this time, there is no indication of a broader threat to the United States, but CDC and our interagency partners are prepared and will continue to monitor the situation closely,” it added.
paras.zh: 声明补充说：“目前没有迹象表明美国面临更广泛的威胁，但疾病预防控制中心和我们的跨机构合作伙伴已做好准备，并将继续密切监视局势。”

paras.en: The World Health Organization, which oversees global public health matters, said Tuesday that Russian health officials had informed it in response to its request about the lab worker’s death that no case of plague has been recorded in Irkutsk.
paras.zh: 负责监督全球公共卫生事务的世界卫生组织周二表示，俄罗斯卫生官员已根据其有关实验室工作人员死亡的要求告知其，伊尔库茨克尚未记录到鼠疫病例。

paras.en: “According to the authorities, the woman’s illness initially presented as a typical acute respiratory viral infection,” it said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“据当局称，该妇女的病情最初表现为典型的急性呼吸道病毒感染。”

paras.en: No case of plague or other high-threat pathogen has reportedly been found among the woman’s close contacts, the WHO said, quoting the response from the Russian officials, adding that it’s awaiting confirmation from the Russian side about “what pneumonia-causing pathogen had led to the individual’s death.”
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织援引俄罗斯官员的回应称，据报道在该妇女的密切接触者中尚未发现鼠疫或其他高威胁病原体病例，并补充说，正在等待俄罗斯方面确认“哪种肺炎病原体导致了该人的死亡”。

paras.en: On Friday, Maksim Modin, mayor of the Shelekhov municipal district near the border with Mongolia, said that the inpatient facility where the worker is said to have been treated had been closed for quarantine. Russian media cited officials saying that nearly 200 people who had been in contact with the woman had been placed under precautionary medical observation.
paras.zh: 周五，靠近蒙古边境的谢列霍夫市市长马克西姆·莫丁表示，据称这名工人接受治疗的住院设施已关闭进行隔离。俄罗斯媒体援引官员的话称，近200名与该女子有过接触的人已接受预防性医学观察。

paras.en: Russian media outlets have named the woman and identified her as being 28 years old. These details have not been announced by officials.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯媒体已公布这名女子的姓名，确认她今年 28 岁。这些细节尚未由官方公布。

paras.en: Irkutsk’s governor, Igor Kobsev, said Monday that no “microorganisms linked to the employee’s professional activities were detected” in her body.
paras.zh: 伊尔库茨克州州长伊戈尔·科布采夫周一表示，在她的体内“未检测到与该员工职业活动相关的微生物”。

paras.en: The Irkutsk regional branch of Rospotrebnadzor on Tuesday denied what it called “fake” reports circulating online that an “enhanced sanitary-epidemiological regime” and strict restrictions have been imposed in the region.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯联邦运输局伊尔库茨克地区分公司周二否认了网上流传的“虚假”报道，称该地区已实施“加强卫生流行病学制度”和严格限制。

paras.en: “No such decisions have been made at this time,” it said in a statement, saying the situation in the region remains stable.
paras.zh: 它在一份声明中表示，“目前尚未做出此类决定”，并称该地区局势保持稳定。

paras.en: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Monday that even though there is “very limited travel between the U.S. and Russia,” if “something like that gets out, it could quickly spread.”
paras.zh: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥周一表示，尽管“美国和俄罗斯之间的旅行非常有限”，但如果“类似的事情传出去，它可能会迅速蔓延。”

paras.en: Rospotrebnadzor, the health watchdog, said Tuesday its probe found “no incidents involving the handling of pathogenic microorganisms.”
paras.zh: 卫生监督机构 Rospotrebnadzor 周二表示，其调查发现“没有涉及处理病原微生物的事件”。

paras.en: Trump told reporters Monday the United States would do what it could to help Russia.
paras.zh: 特朗普周一告诉记者，美国将尽其所能帮助俄罗斯。

paras.en: “I hate to see them having it,” Trump said. “It’s a rough disease.”
paras.zh: “我讨厌看到他们拥有它，”特朗普说。 “这是一种很严重的疾病。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, some of Russia’s neighbors have been stepping up preventive measures and quarantine controls at border crossings.
paras.zh: 与此同时，俄罗斯的一些邻国一直在加强边境口岸的预防措施和检疫控制。

paras.en: The Kremlin has called for those concerned to heed official statements.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫呼吁有关人士留意官方声明。

paras.en: “Rospotrebnadzor provides comprehensive information,” Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said when reporters pressed him about rumors spreading amid sparse official statements.
paras.zh: 当记者追问克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫（Dmitry Peskov）称，“俄罗斯联邦通讯社”提供了全面的信息。

paras.en: Peskov also deferred to Rospotrebnadzor when asked if the worker’s lab results would be released or if an autopsy has been conducted.
paras.zh: 当被问及是否会公布该工人的实验室结果或是否已进行尸检时，佩斯科夫也听取了俄罗斯联邦俄罗斯局的意见。

paras.en: On its website, the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia and the Far East says it was founded in 1934 “as a scientific and operational body for combating plague,” but over the years, its scope of responsibility expanded to include “other highly dangerous diseases,” including cholera and anthrax.
paras.zh: 西伯利亚和远东伊尔库茨克抗鼠疫研究所在其网站上表示，它成立于 1934 年，“是一个抗击鼠疫的科学和业务机构”，但多年来，其责任范围扩大到包括“其他高度危险的疾病”，包括霍乱和炭疽。

paras.en: The institute says it’s a “multidisciplinary research and anti-epidemic facility” that helps ensure epidemic safety in the region.
paras.zh: 该研究所表示，这是一个“多学科研究和抗疫设施”，有助于确保该地区的疫情安全。

articles.title: At least 30 people killed after Russia bombs two buses in Ukraine
articles.author: Yuliya Talmazan

paras.en: At least 30 people were killed when a Russian bomb struck two buses in the Ukrainian front-line city of Kramatorsk on Thursday, local officials said, as Moscow’s intensifying attacks grow ever more deadly.
paras.zh: 当地官员称，周四，乌克兰前线城市克拉马托尔斯克的两辆公共汽车遭到俄罗斯炸弹袭击，造成至少 30 人死亡，莫斯科愈演愈烈的袭击变得越来越致命。

paras.en: Another 18 people were wounded when the bomb hit a street in the city at 10 a.m. local time (3 a.m. ET), Ukraine’s National Police said in a statement.
paras.zh: 乌克兰国家警察在一份声明中称，当地时间上午 10 点（美国东部时间凌晨 3 点），炸弹袭击该市街道，另有 18 人受伤。

paras.en: Kramatorsk’s regional governor, Vadym Filashkin, accused Russia of deliberately targeting civilians, sharing images of a charred bus wreckage and bodies and body parts on the road next to it. Filashkin said he was shutting down public transport in the city and neighboring Sloviansk in light of “the sharp deterioration of the security situation.”
paras.zh: 克拉马托尔斯克地区州长瓦迪姆·菲拉什金 (Vadym Filashkin) 指责俄罗斯故意针对平民，并分享了烧焦的巴士残骸以及旁边道路上的尸体和身体部位的图像。菲拉什金表示，鉴于“安全局势急剧恶化”，他将关闭该市和邻近斯洛维斯克的公共交通。

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said in a statement on his social media channels that Russia struck “an ordinary public transport stop” in Kramatorsk with an aerial bomb.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基在其社交媒体频道上发表声明称，俄罗斯用航空炸弹袭击了克拉马托尔斯克的“一个普通公共交通站点”。

paras.en: In a later post, he said doctors were fighting to save the lives of those injured and “some of those killed have still not been identified because of the severity of their injuries.”
paras.zh: 在后来的帖子中，他表示医生正在努力挽救伤者的生命，“由于伤势严重，一些遇难者的身份仍未确定。”

paras.en: Kramatorsk is close to the active front line and part of Ukraine’s industrial Donbass region, which has been central to Russian President Vladimir Putin war plans.
paras.zh: 克拉马托尔斯克靠近活跃的前线，也是乌克兰工业顿巴斯地区的一部分，该地区一直是俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京战争计划的核心。

paras.en: Civilian casualties have surged as Russia intensifies attacks across Ukraine, which is running low on air defense munitions.
paras.zh: 随着俄罗斯加强对乌克兰境内的袭击，平民伤亡人数激增，而乌克兰的防空弹药已经不足。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said in a social media post that it was important the country received “new packages for Ukraine’s defense” promised by its allies. “Supplies of anti-ballistic capabilities, ammunition for our combat aircraft and investments in interceptors — all of this is directly helping save lives every day,” he added.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基在社交媒体帖子中表示，该国收到其盟友承诺的“乌克兰国防新方案”非常重要。他补充说：“反弹道能力的供应、战斗机的弹药以及拦截器的投资——所有这些都在直接帮助每天拯救生命。”

paras.en: Russian bombs hit Ukrainian public buses
paras.zh: 俄罗斯炸弹袭击乌克兰公共汽车

paras.en: His comments came as Ukraine has suffered from an uptick in daytime attacks in recent weeks, creating a round-the-clock threat to civilians.
paras.zh: 他发表此番言论之际，乌克兰最近几周白天的袭击事件有所增加，对平民造成了全天候的威胁。

paras.en: Thursday’s strike came a day after a missile strike on a residential building in the north of the country killed 22 people, including five children.
paras.zh: 周四的袭击发生前一天，该国北部一栋住宅楼遭到导弹袭击，造成 22 人死亡，其中包括 5 名儿童。

paras.en: Zelenskyy visited the site of that attack Thursday, saying in a Telegram post: “Over a hundred residential buildings were damaged, as well as educational institutions, kindergartens, shops, enterprises, and infrastructure that supports normal life in the city.”
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基周四视察了袭击现场，并在一份电报中表示：“一百多栋住宅楼以及支持城市正常生活的教育机构、幼儿园、商店、企业和基础设施遭到破坏。”

paras.en: Moscow has repeatedly denied that it deliberately targets civilians in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 莫斯科一再否认其故意针对乌克兰平民。

paras.en: Elsewhere, Reuters reported Zelenskyy as saying that Ukrainian negotiators will visit the United States for talks Friday and Saturday.
paras.zh: 其他地方，路透社报道泽伦斯基表示，乌克兰谈判代表将于周五和周六访问美国进行会谈。

paras.en: Urging President Donald Trump to step up pressure on Russia, he said: “One cannot, on the one hand, negotiate with the Russians about future economic projects, whilst on the other hand say that we find ourselves in some sort of... diplomatic stalemate.”
paras.zh: 他敦促唐纳德·特朗普总统加大对俄罗斯的压力，他说：“我们不能一方面与俄罗斯就未来的经济项目进行谈判，另一方面又说我们发现自己陷入了某种……外交僵局。”

articles.title: Car burnt in driveway in Melbourne's south-east 14th this week

paras.en: Police are investigating another car fire in Melbourne after a week of arson attacks across the city.
paras.zh: 在全市发生一周纵火袭击后，警方正在调查墨尔本的另一起汽车火灾。

paras.en: The vehicle was parked in the driveway of a home on Horizon Boulevard in Hampton Park when it was engulfed in flames just after 4am.
paras.zh: 这辆车停在汉普顿公园地平线大道上一户人家的车道上，凌晨 4 点刚过就被大火吞没。

paras.en: It is the 14th vehicle destroyed by fire in the past five days.
paras.zh: 这是过去五天里第14辆被火灾烧毁的车辆。

paras.en: Arson Squad detectives will examine the scene as investigations continue into the spate of firebombings that have happened outside homes in Taylors Hill, Keilor, Balwyn North, Maidstone, Reservoir and Oakleigh East.
paras.zh: 纵火队侦探将检查现场，继续对泰勒山、凯勒、博文北、梅德斯通、水库和奥克利东的房屋外发生的一系列燃烧弹事件进行调查。

paras.en: Acting Commander Troy Papworth yesterday said police believed the rise in arson attacks was linked to organised crime and appeared to be an intimidation tactic.
paras.zh: 代理指挥官特洛伊·帕普沃斯昨天表示，警方认为纵火袭击事件的增加与有组织犯罪有关，似乎是一种恐吓策略。

paras.en: He said the practice posed a major danger to both victims and culprits, with several of the fires spreading to homes this week and a 13-year-old boy clinging to life with burns to 90 per cent of his body after the Taylors Hill blaze.
paras.zh: 他表示，这种做法对受害者和肇事者都构成了重大危险，泰勒山大火本周有多起火灾蔓延至民宅，一名 13 岁男孩全身 90% 被烧伤，仍幸存。

articles.title: Katie Lynch wants to see AFL 'harness the momentum' of Pride Round
articles.author: Marnie Vinall

paras.en: The Gold Coast Suns' Katie Lynch says Pride Round comes at exactly the moment needed every season.
paras.zh: 黄金海岸太阳队的凯蒂·林奇表示，骄傲回合的到来正是每个赛季所需的时刻。

paras.en: Two weeks out from the men's season finishing and a month before the women start finals, it provides an injection of enthusiasm, celebration and joy.
paras.zh: 距离男子赛季结束还有两周，距离女子决赛开始还有一个月，这一天充满了热情、庆祝和欢乐。

paras.en: "A different energy comes into the competition on Pride Round," Lynch told ABC Sport.
paras.zh: “骄傲回合比赛中注入了不同的能量，”林奇告诉美国广播公司体育频道。

paras.en: "Because so many of our players connect with the movement and understand the power of the round for the community and who we represent," Lynch told ABC Sport.
paras.zh: 林奇告诉美国广播公司体育频道：“因为我们有很多球员都参与了这项运动，并且了解这项运动对社区的力量以及我们所代表的人。”

paras.en: However, Lynch would like to see that movement grow beyond the AFLW competition and across the whole AFL, to include not just the men's teams but all club staff and fans of the game.
paras.zh: 然而，林奇希望看到这种运动超越 AFLW 比赛并扩展到整个 AFL，不仅包括男子球队，还包括所有俱乐部工作人员和比赛的球迷。

paras.en: The dedicated league-wide Pride Round was introduced annually in 2021.
paras.zh: 专门的全联盟骄傲回合比赛于 2021 年推出。

paras.en: It celebrates inclusion and diversity over two weeks, while honouring the contributions of the LGBTQ+ community to the game and providing a platform for education on queer issues, particularly those entwined with the game.
paras.zh: 它在两周内庆祝包容性和多样性，同时表彰 LGBTQ+ 社区对游戏的贡献，并提供一个关于酷儿问题（尤其是与游戏相关的问题）的教育平台。

paras.en: "I think that can be perhaps transferred across more of the whole code essentially," Lynch said.
paras.zh: “我认为这或许可以本质上转移到整个代码的更多部分，”林奇说。

paras.en: "A pride round in the men's would be awesome to see, and I know from my experience, it's nothing but a positive experience, and so I can see that going enormously well and being enormously helpful for the entire code."
paras.zh: “男子骄傲赛真是太棒了，从我的经验来看，这只是一次积极的经历，所以我可以看到这一切进展得非常顺利，并且对整个代码有极大的帮助。”

paras.en: Some LGBTQ+ Australian Rules fans and community members have felt the pang of exclusion from the sport in recent years.
paras.zh: 近年来，一些 LGBTQ+ 澳大利亚规则粉丝和社区成员感受到了被排除在这项运动之外的痛苦。

paras.en: In the past three years, there have been 10 cases of AFL-listed players or coaches sanctioned for homophobic language, including Suns players Max Knobel this year and star defender Wil Powell in 2024.
paras.zh: 过去三年，已有10起AFL球员或教练因恐同言论受到制裁的案例，其中包括今年的太阳队球员马克斯·诺贝尔和2024年的明星后卫威尔·鲍威尔。

paras.en: When put to Lynch whether an extended Pride Round would help in this regard, she said the game of Aussie Rules had always been excellent at creating a space for people to connect, converse and interact, and that Pride Round was an incredible vehicle to do that around LGBTQ+ issues and experiences.
paras.zh: 当被问及林奇延长“骄傲回合”是否会在这方面有所帮助时，她表示，澳大利亚规则游戏在为人们创造联系、交谈和互动的空间方面一直表现出色，而“骄傲回合”是围绕 LGBTQ+ 问题和体验做到这一点的令人难以置信的工具。

paras.en: "We know that the players and the code have significant ability to influence, of course, and we've seen that probably have a negative effect on our fans more recently," she said.
paras.zh: “当然，我们知道玩家和代码具有显着的影响力，而且我们最近发现这可能会对我们的粉丝产生负面影响，”她说。

paras.en: "So I think for me, it's how do we shift that dial to come back the other way?
paras.zh: “所以我认为对我来说，问题是我们如何转动旋钮以其他方式返回？

paras.en: "And that's why I talk about things like visibility and representation."
paras.zh: “这就是为什么我谈论可见性和代表性等问题。”

paras.en: She said it was also a great opportunity to connect more fans to the game, and have them feel seen within it.
paras.zh: 她表示，这也是一个很好的机会，让更多粉丝参与到游戏中，让他们感受到自己在游戏中被看到。

paras.en: This year Lynch helped design the club's Pride guernsey alongside her teammate Lily Mithen and good friend and tattoo artist Mady Peters.
paras.zh: 今年，林奇与她的队友莉莉·米森（Lily Mithen）以及好朋友兼纹身艺术家玛迪·彼得斯（Mady Peters）一起帮助设计了俱乐部的骄傲根西岛。

paras.en: It resembles patchwork tattoos and stickers, including a tramp stamp on the back, which Lynch says is proof they had a lot of fun putting it together.
paras.zh: 它类似于拼凑而成的纹身和贴纸，包括背面的流浪汉印记，林奇说这证明他们把它们组合在一起很有趣。

paras.en: But more than that, Lynch said it felt special to have her friend Peters "who doesn't even know what a drop punt is" now have an attachment to the game of AFLW through the Pride movement, where she is represented as a queer person.
paras.zh: 但更重要的是，林奇表示，让她的朋友彼得斯“甚至不知道什么是弃踢”现在通过骄傲运动对 AFLW 比赛产生了依恋，这感觉很特别，在骄傲运动中，她被描绘成一个酷儿。

paras.en: Lynch said she noticed the boost in attendance during Pride Round, including within her own friend group.
paras.zh: 林奇说，她注意到骄傲回合的出席人数有所增加，其中包括她自己的朋友团体。

paras.en: "My friends are great, very supportive of me … but if they're going to come to a game, it's Pride Round," she said.
paras.zh: “我的朋友们都很棒，非常支持我……但如果他们要来看一场比赛，那就是骄傲回合，”她说。

paras.en: "Pride Round has the power to bring people, even loose fans of AFL, to the game … and not only to experience the joy of it but they're there because they feel like they belong there."
paras.zh: “骄傲回合有能力让人们，甚至是 AFL 的铁杆球迷，参与到比赛中……不仅是为了体验比赛的乐趣，而且是因为他们觉得自己属于那里。”

paras.en: She wants that "special feeling" to reach even further.
paras.zh: 她希望这种“特殊的感觉”能够延伸得更远。

paras.en: "That's what I've felt, particularly this year, is the support for us and this Pride Round has been enormous, and it's growing," she said.
paras.zh: “这就是我所感受到的，特别是今年，对我们的支持，这次骄傲回合的支持是巨大的，而且还在不断增长，”她说。

paras.en: "The opportunity now is to harness the momentum we've got and use it in a growth capacity.
paras.zh: “现在的机会是利用我们现有的动力并将其用于增长能力。

paras.en: "We'll probably never know the enormity of pride and visibility, particularly as players … I feel there's so much impact that I don't see, but I know is there."
paras.zh: “我们可能永远不会知道自豪感和知名度的巨大性，特别是作为球员……我觉得有很多我看不到的影响，但我知道它就在那里。”

articles.title: South Africa vs Australia Test series, everything you need to know
articles.author: Simon Smale

paras.en: Australia is back in South Africa for one of the most eagerly anticipated Test series in recent history.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚回到南非，参加近代历史上最受期待的系列测试之一。

paras.en: It has been eight long years since Australia last toured South Africa in red-ball cricket, in a series that will forever be remembered for its ignominy.
paras.zh: 距离澳大利亚上一次在南非进行红球板球巡回赛已经过去八年了，这场系列赛因其耻辱而将永远被人们铭记。

paras.en: Sandpapergate is what that contest will be remembered for, but even before that, it was crossing a red line in despicable behaviour unbecoming of the sport.
paras.zh: 沙纸门是那场比赛将被铭记的地方，但即使在此之前，它的卑鄙行为也已经跨越了红线，与这项运动不相称。

paras.en: Here's everything you need to know ahead of the three-Test series.
paras.zh: 以下是您在三项测试系列之前需要了解的所有信息。

paras.en: The first is at Kingsmead in Durban from October 9 to 13.
paras.zh: 第一个活动将于 10 月 9 日至 13 日在德班 Kingsmead 举行。

paras.en: The second is at St George's Park in Gqeberha from October 18 to 22.
paras.zh: 第二场比赛将于 10 月 18 日至 22 日在 Gqeberha 的圣乔治公园举行。

paras.en: And Newlands in Cape Town will host the third from October 27 to 31.
paras.zh: 第三届比赛将于 10 月 27 日至 31 日在开普敦纽兰兹举办。

paras.en: The Durban Test starts at 6:30pm AEDT and will likely run through to 2am AEDT.
paras.zh: 德班测试于澳大利亚东部时间下午 6:30 开始，并可能持续到澳大利亚东部时间凌晨 2 点。

paras.en: That AEDT time relates to New South Wales, the ACT, Victoria and Tasmania.
paras.zh: 该 AEDT 时间适用于新南威尔士州、首都领地、维多利亚州和塔斯马尼亚州。

paras.en: In Queensland, the action begins at 5:30pm.
paras.zh: 在昆士兰州，活动于下午 5:30 开始。

paras.en: And the first ball will be bowled at 3:30pm in Western Australia.
paras.zh: 第一个球将于下午 3:30 在西澳大利亚举行。

paras.en: The entire series is live on Fox Sports and Kayo.
paras.zh: 整个系列赛均由福克斯体育频道和 Kayo 直播。

paras.en: ABC Sport will also have live radio commentary on the ABC Listen App or online.
paras.zh: ABC Sport 还将在 ABC Listen 应用程序或在线上提供现场广播评论。

paras.en: You can also follow every ball in our live blog on the ABC Sport website.
paras.zh: 您还可以在 ABC Sport 网站上的实时博客中关注每一个球。

paras.en: Australia's squad: Pat Cummins (c), Scott Boland, Alex Carey (wk), Cooper Connolly, Cameron Green, Sam Harper (wk), Josh Hazlewood, Travis Head, Matthew Kuhnemann, Marnus Labuschagne, Nathan Lyon, Nic Maddinson, Michael Neser, Matt Renshaw, Steven Smith, Mitchell Starc, Beau Webster.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚队：帕特·康明斯（中）、斯科特·博兰、亚历克斯·凯里（周）、库珀·康诺利、卡梅伦·格林、萨姆·哈珀（周）、乔什·黑兹尔伍德、特拉维斯·海德、马修·库尼曼、马努斯·拉布沙涅、内森·里昂、尼克·麦丁森、迈克尔·内瑟、马特·伦肖、史蒂文·史密斯、米切尔·斯塔克、博·韦伯斯特。

paras.en: South Africa's squad: Temba Bavuma (c), Marques Ackerman, David Bedingham, Corbin Bosch, Gerald Coetzee, Tony de Zorzi, Simon Harmer, Marco Jansen, Keshav Maharaj, Aiden Markram, Wiaan Mulder, Senuran Muthusamy, Anrich Nortje, Dane Paterson, Kagiso Rabada, Ryan Rickelton (wk), Tristan Stubbs (wk), Kyle Verreynne (wk).
paras.zh: 南非队：Temba Bavuma（中）、Marques Ackerman、David Bedingham、Corbin Bosch、Gerald Coetzee、Tony de Zorzi、Simon Harmer、Marco Jansen、Keshav Maharaj、Aiden Markram、Wiaan Mulder、Senuran Muthusamy、Anrich Nortje、Dane Paterson、Kagiso Rabada、Ryan Rickelton（wk）、Tristan Stubbs （周），凯尔·维雷恩（周）。

paras.en: Australia has won 54 of the 102 Test matches between the two teams, with 21 draws and 27 defeats since their first meeting in 1902.
paras.zh: 自1902年首次交手以来，澳大利亚队在两队之间的102场测试赛中赢了54场，其中21平27负。

paras.en: On South African soil, Australia also has a winning record, with 29 victories against 16 defeats and nine draws.
paras.zh: 在南非的土地上，澳大利亚也有29胜16负9平的胜利记录。

paras.en: Australia has won six of the 11 Tests played at St George's in Durban, including winning each of the last three Tests it has played there, while South Africa has won three with two draws.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚在德班圣乔治举行的 11 场测试赛中赢得了 6 场，包括在过去的 3 场测试赛中全部获胜，而南非则以 2 场平局赢得了 3 场比赛。

paras.en: The two teams also drew a Test at the city's old Lord's ground in 1921, before the venue's demolition in 1922.
paras.zh: 1921 年，两支球队还在这座城市的老勋爵球场进行了一场测试赛，随后该球场于 1922 年被拆除。

paras.en: South Africa has a much better record at St George's Park in Gqeberha though, winning four of the seven matches played there, including the last two.
paras.zh: 不过，南非在格凯贝哈圣乔治公园的战绩要好得多，在那里举行的七场比赛中赢了四场，包括最后两场。

paras.en: Before 2021, Gqeberha was Port Elizabeth, but is now known by its Xhosa name, and this is the first time Australia will play in the city under its new name.
paras.zh: 2021 年之前，格克贝哈是伊丽莎白港，但现在以科萨语名称为人所知，这是澳大利亚第一次以新名称在这座城市进行比赛。

paras.en: Australia has a great record at Newlands though, winning 10 of the 14 Tests played in the shadow of Table Mountain. However, it has only won one of its last four Tests at the ground considered one of the most beautiful in the world.
paras.zh: 不过，澳大利亚在纽兰兹的记录非常出色，在桌山下举行的 14 场测试赛中赢得了 10 场。然而，它在被认为是世界上最美丽的场地之一的最近四次测试中只赢得了其中一次。

paras.en: The two teams last played a Test in June 2025, when South Africa shocked Australia at Lord's to win the World Test Championship.
paras.zh: 两队上一次进行测试赛是在 2025 年 6 月，当时南非队在洛德赛上震惊澳大利亚，赢得了世界测试赛冠军。

paras.en: In the 2022/23 summer of cricket, Australia claimed a 2-0 Test series victory over South Africa on home soil.
paras.zh: 在 2022/23 年夏季板球比赛中，澳大利亚在主场以 2-0 战胜南非。

paras.en: The last time Australia played a Test series in South Africa was 2018, and it's safe to say things were … complicated.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚上次在南非参加测试系列赛是在 2018 年，可以肯定地说事情非常……复杂。

paras.en: It is fair to say the 2018 series was combative, fiery, febrile and chaotic.
paras.zh: 可以说，2018 年的系列赛充满了战斗性、火热性、狂热性和混乱性。

paras.en: Australia won the first Test at Kingsmead in Durban, but not before David Warner and Quinton de Kock almost came to blows in a stairwell at the end of the fourth day.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚队在德班 Kingsmead 举行的首场测试中获胜，但在第四天结束时，大卫·华纳 (David Warner) 和昆顿·德科克 (Quinton de Kock) 差点在楼梯间里打起来。

paras.en: South Africa won the second Test in Gqeberha, but man of the match Kagiso Rabada, who took 5/96 and 6/54, was subsequently banned for barging into Steve Smith after dismissing him in the first innings.
paras.zh: 南非队在格克贝哈赢得了第二场测试赛，但本场比赛的最佳球员卡吉索·拉巴达（Kagiso Rabada）以5/96和6/54的成绩，在第一局将史蒂夫·史密斯驱逐出局后，因闯入史蒂夫·史密斯而被禁赛。

paras.en: Rabada was then handed a reprieve after an appeal involving one of South Africa's highest-profile lawyers, freeing him to play the next two matches.
paras.zh: 在南非最著名的律师之一提起上诉后，拉巴达获得缓刑，从而可以参加接下来的两场比赛。

paras.en: The third Test was in Cape Town where, in the shadows of Table Mountain, Australia's descent into the dark arts was exposed.
paras.zh: 第三次测试在开普敦举行，桌山的阴影下，澳大利亚的黑暗艺术堕落暴露无遗。

paras.en: On the third day, host broadcaster Supersport captured Cameron Bancroft rubbing the ball with a square of sandpaper to help encourage the prodigious reverse swing that had featured throughout the series thus far.
paras.zh: 第三天，主播 Supersport 捕捉到卡梅伦·班克罗夫特 (Cameron Bancroft) 用一块方形砂纸摩擦球，以帮助鼓励迄今为止整个系列赛中的惊人反向挥杆。

paras.en: While South Africa romped to a 322-run win and a series lead, the full extent of Australia's cheating was exposed, leading to a moral reckoning about the team's approach back home, with then-prime minister Malcolm Turnbull leading the criticism of the offending players.
paras.zh: 当南非队以 322 分获胜并取得系列赛领先时，澳大利亚作弊行为的全部暴露，导致人们对球队在国内的做法进行道德反思，时任总理马尔科姆·特恩布尔带头批评了违规球员。

paras.en: Smith, Bancroft and Warner were all sent home in disgrace, and an under-manned Australian team was thumped by 492 runs at the Wanderers in Johannesburg.
paras.zh: 史密斯、班克罗夫特和华纳都耻辱地被送回家，一支人手不足的澳大利亚队在约翰内斯堡以 492 分的成绩惨败于流浪者队。

paras.en: Australia has toured South Africa twice since the 2018 Test series, in 2020 and 2023 for limited-overs matches, with Smith and Warner both involved.
paras.zh: 自 2018 年测试系列赛以来，澳大利亚已两次前往南非，分别在 2020 年和 2023 年进行有限轮比赛，史密斯和华纳都参加了比赛。

articles.title: Ousted Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro, wife Celia Flores charged with torture in new indictment

paras.en: Ousted Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro, wife Celia Flores charged with torture in new indictment
paras.zh: 被罢黜的委内瑞拉总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗及其妻子西莉亚·弗洛雷斯在新起诉书中被控酷刑

paras.en: - The U.S. charged former Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro and his wife Cilia Flores with conspiracy to commit torture in a new indictment today.
paras.zh: - 美国今天在一份新起诉书中指控委内瑞拉前总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗和他的妻子西莉亚·弗洛雷斯合谋实施酷刑。

paras.en: - Maduro and Flores are accused of torturing political opponents with beatings, electric shocks and other methods. Prosecutors alleged the Maduro government tortured and killed thousands of Venezuelans.
paras.zh: - 马杜罗和弗洛雷斯被指控以殴打、电击和其他方式折磨政治对手。检察官指控马杜罗政府折磨并杀害了数千名委内瑞拉人。

paras.en: - Maduro and Flores were captured by the United States in a special military operation in January and brought to New York to face drug trafficking charges. They have pleaded not guilty and are set to go on trial next year.
paras.zh: - 马杜罗和弗洛雷斯在一月份的一次特别军事行动中被美国抓获，并被带到纽约接受贩毒指控。他们已不认罪，并将于明年接受审判。

paras.en: - Flores appeared in court today seeking release from her Brooklyn jail for health reasons, but her request was denied.
paras.zh: - 弗洛雷斯今天出庭，因健康原因寻求从布鲁克林监狱获释，但她的请求被拒绝。

paras.en: - October 8 Graphic allegations of torture in new charges against ousted Venezuelan leader Mark Gollom The U.S. government announced today it was adding torture related charges to those already faced by former Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro and his wife Cilia Flores. The details in the indictment about the alleged torture of prisoners, filed in a U.S. court, were graphic, including accusations of "electric shock, asphyxiation, starvation, beatings and rape." Prosecutors alleged the Maduro government tortured and killed thousands of Venezuelans. The indictment also included the stories of three U.S. victims, who prosecutors allege were tortured while held in custody. Maduro and Flores have been behind bars in New York since early January when U.S. military forces seized them from their Caracas home in a nighttime raid. They already face potential life prison sentences if convicted on their January charges of being part of a conspiracy to send cocaine into the U.S. Separately today, a U.S. judge denied a request by Flores to be released on bail for medical reasons. Flores' lawyers had said their client needs a cardiac procedure and want her released to recover in a New York City residence with round-the-clock private security.
paras.zh: - 10 月 8 日 针对被驱逐的委内瑞拉领导人马克·戈洛姆 (Mark Gollom) 的新指控中的酷刑指控 美国政府今天宣布，将在委内瑞拉前总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗 (Nicolás Maduro) 及其妻子西莉亚·弗洛雷斯 (Cilia Flores) 已经面临的指控中增加与酷刑相关的指控。向美国法院提交的关于涉嫌酷刑囚犯的起诉书中的细节非常生动，包括对“电击、窒息、饥饿、殴打和强奸”的指控。检察官指控马杜罗政府折磨并杀害了数千名委内瑞拉人。起诉书还包括三名美国受害者的故事，检察官称他们在被拘留期间遭受酷刑。自一月初美国军队在夜间突袭中将马杜罗和弗洛雷斯从加拉加斯的家中抓获以来，他们一直被关在纽约的监狱里。如果一月份被指控共谋向美国运送可卡因，他们可能面临终身监禁。今天，一名美国法官拒绝了弗洛雷斯因医疗原因保释的请求。弗洛雷斯的律师曾表示，他们的当事人需要接受心脏手术，并希望她被释放，在纽约市一处有全天候私人保安的住所中康复。

paras.en: - 'Truly unthinkable' conduct: U.S. attorney Mark Gollom Speaking to reporters outside a New York courthouse today, U.S. Attorney James M. McDonald said the indictment lays out allegations of conduct that was "truly unthinkable."
