paras.en: This slots into the bottom of your iPhone via the rotating USB-C connector and provides enough power to charge it up at least once. It’s a good alternative to a MagSafe power bank if you want something faster and more efficient than wireless charging.
paras.zh: 它通过旋转 USB-C 连接器插入 iPhone 底部，并提供足够的电量至少充电一次。如果您想要比无线充电更快、更高效的充电方式，那么它是 MagSafe 移动电源的不错替代品。

paras.en: The best MagSafe power bank has a built-in kickstand and can charge your phone wirelessly or via the included USB-C cable. The capacity isn’t massive, but it’ll still fully charge most phones at least once. The display lets you know how much juice is left at a quick glance.
paras.zh: 最好的 MagSafe 移动电源配有内置支架，可以为您的手机无线充电或通过随附的 USB-C 线缆充电。容量虽然不大，但仍然可以为大多数手机至少充满一次。显示屏让您一目了然地知道还剩多少果汁。

paras.en: Top pick in our guide to the best Apple 3-in-1 wireless chargers, this classy-looking tree has a lovely weighted base and spots to charge your iPhone (with support for StandBy mode), Apple Watch, and any AirPods with a wireless charging case.
paras.zh: 这棵看起来优雅的树是我们最佳 Apple 三合一无线充电器指南中的首选，它有一个可爱的加重底座和充电点，可以为您的 iPhone（支持待机模式）、Apple Watch 和任何带有无线充电盒的 AirPods 充电。

paras.en: This is the best Apple 3-in-1 travel charger because it is so compact when folded. It can charge your iPhone or Qi2-certified phone at up to 15 watts on a magnetic pad that can adjust to your preferred angle. A second pad charges AirPods or other wireless earbuds, and there is a fold-out Apple Watch charger.
paras.zh: 这是最好的苹果三合一旅行充电器，因为它折叠后非常紧凑。它可以通过磁性垫以高达 15 瓦的功率为您的 iPhone 或 Qi2 认证的手机充电，并可根据您喜欢的角度进行调整。第二个充电板可为 AirPods 或其他无线耳机充电，还有一个折叠式 Apple Watch 充电器。

paras.en: This hard-wearing, fast-charging pick from the best USB-C cables can deliver 240 watts to charge any Apple gadget. It also has a tough, braided nylon exterior made from 100 percent recycled plastic, and comes with a lifetime warranty.
paras.zh: 这款耐用、快速充电的产品采用最好的 USB-C 线缆，可提供 240 瓦的功率，为任何 Apple 设备充电。它还具有坚韧的编织尼龙外部，由 100% 再生塑料制成，并提供终身保修。

paras.en: This neat little Apple 3-in-1 charger has space for your Apple Watch, AirPods, and iPhone (in any orientation, including StandBy mode). It also comes with a wall adapter, travel adapters, and a cable, all of which are unfortunately rare inclusions in this product space.
paras.zh: 这款小巧的 Apple 三合一充电器可为您的 Apple Watch、AirPods 和 iPhone（任何方向，包括待机模式）提供空间。它还配备了壁式适配器、旅行适配器和电缆，不幸的是，所有这些在该产品空间中都是罕见的。

paras.en: One of our favorite MagSafe wallets, the stylish Smartish Side Hustle clings to your iPhone magnetically and has a cutaway to make it easy to pop out your cards, saving time at the register. This price is the lowest we’ve seen.
paras.zh: 时尚的 Smartish Side Hustle 是我们最喜欢的 MagSafe 钱包之一，它可以磁性地吸附在您的 iPhone 上，并有一个切口，可以轻松弹出您的卡片，从而节省收银时间。这个价格是我们见过的最低价格了。

paras.en: I especially like the version of this MagSafe wallet that has Find My compatibility, but the basic version is good as well. Nearly every iteration is on sale. The wallet has space for two cards comfortably and can double as a kickstand or tripod for your daily fit checks.
paras.zh: 我特别喜欢这个 MagSafe 钱包的版本，它具有 Find My 兼容性，但基本版本也不错。几乎每一款迭代产品都在打折。钱包可轻松容纳两张卡片，还可用作支架或三脚架，方便您日常检查是否合身。

paras.en: Bandolier’s elegant, classy products feel a lot more luxurious than most iPhone accessories. This case turns your iPhone 17 into a crossbody device, and I especially like it for dinner or shows when I don’t want to set my phone down, or my outfit doesn’t have pockets. My Bandolier accessories show no sign of wear after three months of continuous use.
paras.zh: Bandolier 的产品优雅、优雅，比大多数 iPhone 配件感觉更加奢华。这款保护壳可将您的 iPhone 17 变成斜挎设备，当我不想放下手机或我的衣服没有口袋时，我特别喜欢在晚餐或演出时使用它。我的 Bandolier 配件在连续使用三个月后没有任何磨损迹象。

paras.en: Our favorite silicone Apple Watch band has a pebbled leather look, but it’s softer, and it’s waterproof. Durable enough for workouts and water sports, but also smart enough for the office, the two-tone design is reversible.
paras.zh: 我们最喜欢的 Apple Watch 硅胶表带具有荔枝纹皮革外观，但更柔软且防水。双色设计可双面使用，足够耐用，适合锻炼和水上运动，也足够智能，适合办公室使用。

articles.title: USS Abraham Lincoln due home after controversy-plagued deployment

paras.en: Oct. 8 (UPI) -- The controversy-plagued USS Abraham Lincoln aircraft carrier is set to return to the United States, bringing an end to its nearly 11-month deployment marked by suicide attempts among personnel in its strike group and reports of deteriorating conditions aboard the vessel.
paras.zh: 10 月 8 日（合众社）——饱受争议的亚伯拉罕·林肯号航空母舰即将返回美国，结束其近 11 个月的部署，其特点是打击群人员自杀未遂，而且有报道称船上状况不断恶化。

paras.en: The vessel is expected to make port in San Diego on Thursday. On Wednesday, Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth boarded the vessel to recognize and honor its roughly 5,000 crew.
paras.zh: 该船预计将于周四在圣地亚哥靠港。周三，国防部长皮特·赫格斯 (Pete Hegseth) 登上这艘船，向约 5,000 名船员表示认可和敬意。

paras.en: "What the USS Abraham Lincoln strike group did no other carrier strike group has ever done: 10,000 sorties, 23,000 combat flight hours, almost 4,000 combat sorties, 1.5 million pounds of ordnance dropped on the enemy -- and let me tell you, you did it without an aircraft mishap. I honestly have no idea how that's possible," he said during a ceremony on the carrier.
paras.zh: “亚伯拉罕·林肯号航空母舰打击群所做的事情是其他航母打击群从未做过的：10,000架次，23,000个战斗飞行小时，近4,000架次战斗，向敌人投掷了150万磅弹药——让我告诉你，你做到了，没有发生飞机事故。老实说，我不知道这怎么可能，”他在航母上的仪式上说道。

paras.en: The carrier deployed Nov. 21 and was later redirected to the Middle East amid growing tensions with Iran, tensions that devolved into war in February, a conflict the USS Abraham Lincoln participated in.
paras.zh: 这艘航母于 11 月 21 日部署，后来由于与伊朗的紧张关系日益加剧，又转向中东，紧张局势在 2 月份演变成战争，亚伯拉罕·林肯号航空母舰也参与了这场冲突。

paras.en: Hegseth extended its deployment twice, but the Pentagon came under criticism following late-summer reporting of subpar conditions aboard the vessel and suicide attempts.
paras.zh: 赫格赛斯两次延长了部署时间，但五角大楼在夏末报道船上状况不佳和自杀企图后受到批评。

paras.en: The Trump administration attempted to brush off the allegations, with President Donald Trump calling such reports "fake news," and when asked about the length of the deployment said it was "not nearly long enough."
paras.zh: 特朗普政府试图否认这些指控，唐纳德·特朗普总统称此类报道为“假新闻”，当被问及部署时间时，他表示“还不够长”。

paras.en: Amid the mounting criticism, the Nimitz-class carrier made port in Thailand, its first in 264 days. It departed Thailand on Sept. 7 for home.
paras.zh: 在越来越多的批评声中，尼米兹级航母 264 天以来首次在泰国靠港。它于9月7日从泰国出发回国。

paras.en: Late last month, acting Navy Secretary Hung Cao admitted that eight personnel serving in the strike group serving attempted suicide.
paras.zh: 上个月末，代理海军部长曹洪承认，在该打击群服役的八名人员曾试图自杀。

paras.en: Hegseth also blamed the media for the criticism, claiming the news organizations attempted to make the carrier a "symbol of dysfunction or a symbol of low morale or a symbol of a failed mission."
paras.zh: 赫格斯还指责媒体的批评，声称新闻机构试图使航母成为“功能失调的象征、士气低落的象征或任务失败的象征”。

paras.en: "Instead, what makes the U.S. military and the U.S. Navy and all these sailors different is that you adapt and that you're resilient and you overcome. You finish the mission nonetheless," he said.
paras.zh: “相反，美国军方、美国海军以及所有这些水手的不同之处在于，你能够适应，你有弹性，你能够克服。尽管如此，你还是完成了任务，”他说。

paras.en: "Yes, it's hard. That's why you're here -- to do difficult, hard things. But you believe in your heart in that mission."
paras.zh: “是的，这很难。这就是你来这里的原因——去做困难、艰难的事情。但你内心相信这个使命。”

paras.en: in response to Hegseth's speech and visit of the carrier, Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand, D-Md., accused the defense secretary, a former Fox News host, of using the sailors for publicity.
paras.zh: 为了回应赫格斯的演讲和对航母的访问，马里兰州民主党参议员克尔斯滕·吉利布兰德指责前福克斯新闻主持人、国防部长利用这些水兵进行宣传。

paras.en: "Pete Hegseth dismissed the USS Lincoln crew's suffering and disrespected their service," she said online.
paras.zh: “皮特·赫格斯对林肯号航空母舰船员的痛苦不屑一顾，也不尊重他们的服务，”她在网上说。

paras.en: "Our service members deserve better than a photo op. They deserve real accountability for this administration's failures."
paras.zh: “我们的军人应该得到比拍照更好的东西。他们应该对本届政府的失败承担真正的责任。”

paras.en: The USS Abraham Lincoln's deployment was the second-longest by a U.S. aircraft carrier since the Cold War, five days shorter than the 326-day deployment of the USS Gerald R. Ford, which ended in May. However, the Abraham Lincoln's record 264 consecutive days at sea without a port call eclipsed the previous 206-day record set by the USS Dwight D. Eisenhower in 2020.
paras.zh: 亚伯拉罕·林肯号航空母舰的部署时间是冷战以来美国航空母舰第二长的部署时间，比 5 月份结束的杰拉尔德·R·福特号航空母舰的 326 天部署时间短了 5 天。然而，亚伯拉罕·林肯号在海上连续264天不停靠港口的纪录超过了艾森豪威尔号航空母舰在2020年创下的206天纪录。

articles.title: U.S. sanctions Fiji businessman over alleged China-linked corruption

paras.en: Oct. 8 (UPI) -- The United States has sanctioned a Fiji-based businessman with ties to the Chinese Communist Party over his alleged involvement in "significant corruption on behalf of China-based actors."
paras.zh: 10 月 8 日（UPI）——美国对一名与中国共产党有联系的斐济商人实施制裁，原因是他涉嫌“代表中国行为者参与重大腐败行为”。

paras.en: State Department spokesman Tommy Pigott said in a statement Wednesday that Zhao Fugang, director of the Beijing-sponsored Overseas Chinese Service Center in Fiji, was being publicly designated for abusing his position "by paying bribes to Fijian citizens to advance China-based government, business and criminal interests."
paras.zh: 美国国务院发言人汤米·皮戈特周三在一份声明中表示，北京资助的斐济华侨服务中心主任赵富刚因滥用职权“向斐济公民行贿，以促进中国政府、商业和犯罪利益”而被公开指认。

paras.en: "His actions constituted significant corruption and adversely affected U.S. interests in Fiji," he said.
paras.zh: “他的行为构成了严重的腐败，并对美国在斐济的利益产生了不利影响，”他说。

paras.en: The sanctions render him and his immediate family generally ineligible for entry to the United States.
paras.zh: 制裁使他和他的直系亲属普遍没有资格进入美国。

paras.en: The Organized Crime and Corruption Reporting Project, a global nonprofit investigative journalism organization, reported that Australian law enforcement and intelligence agencies suspect Zhao of being a senior member of a criminal syndicate involved in drug smuggling, money laundering and human trafficking. Zhao was designated an Australian Priority Organization Target in 2023, according to the report.
paras.zh: 全球非营利调查新闻组织有组织犯罪和腐败报道项目报道称，澳大利亚执法和情报机构怀疑赵是参与毒品走私、洗钱和人口贩运的犯罪集团的高级成员。据报道，赵于 2023 年被指定为澳大利亚优先组织目标。

paras.en: The OCCRP states that the Chinese Communist Party uses diaspora members like Zhao to advance its interests through a strategy known as the United Front, which, according to the U.S.-China Economic and Security Review Commission, is a political strategy implemented through a network of organizations seeking to advance the party's objectives by co-opting and neutralizing sources of potential opposition.
paras.zh: OCCRP 指出，中国共产党利用赵这样的侨民成员通过一种被称为“统一战线”的战略来推进其利益。根据美中经济与安全审查委员会的说法，该战略是通过一个组织网络实施的政治战略，旨在通过拉拢和压制潜在反对派来推进党的目标。

paras.en: Zhao has denied the previous allegations of criminal wrongdoing.
paras.zh: 赵否认了之前的刑事不当行为指控。

paras.en: The U.S. Embassy in Suva, the capital of Fiji, alleged that Zhao's alleged activities "have left Fiji vulnerable to malign foreign influence facilitated by Chinese government, business and criminal actors inside and outside of Fiji."
paras.zh: 美国驻斐济首都苏瓦大使馆声称，赵的所谓活动“使斐济容易受到中国政府、斐济境内外的企业和犯罪分子的恶意外国影响”。

paras.en: "Corruption stunts opportunities for foreign investment and foreign assistance, facilitates organized crime, offers a permissive environment for malign actors, drives illegal migration and undermines citizens' faith in government," the embassy said online.
paras.zh: 大使馆在网上表示：“腐败阻碍了外国投资和外国援助的机会，助长了有组织犯罪，为恶意行为者提供了宽松的环境，推动了非法移民，并损害了公民对政府的信心。”

paras.en: "This directly impacts U.S. national security, economic and foreign policy interests and those of our partner nations and is why the department is taking these actions."
paras.zh: “这直接影响美国以及我们伙伴国家的国家安全、经济和外交政策利益，也是商务部采取这些行动的原因。”

paras.en: Andrew Harding, policy analyst for national security and Indo-Pacific affairs at the conservative The Heritage Foundation think tank, said the State Department's public designation of Zhao should serve to deter others from engaging in similar conduct.
paras.zh: 保守派传统基金会智库国家安全和印度太平洋事务政策分析师安德鲁·哈丁表示，国务院公开指定赵紫阳应该有助于阻止其他人从事类似行为。

paras.en: "Zhao's actions directly harm shared U.S.-Pacific interests, and no freedom-loving country should tolerate this corruption," Harding said on social media.
paras.zh: 哈丁在社交媒体上表示：“赵的行为直接损害了美国太平洋地区的共同利益，任何热爱自由的国家都不应容忍这种腐败行为。”

paras.en: "This should only be the beginning of exposing malign Chinese influence operations in the Pacific."
paras.zh: “这应该只是揭露中国在太平洋地区恶意影响力行动的开始。”

paras.en: Zhao's lawyers told Australia's ABC News that they were unaware of U.S. investigation and would ask the U.S. government for clarity over the allegations.
paras.zh: 赵的律师告诉澳大利亚广播公司新闻，他们不知道美国的调查，并将要求美国政府澄清这些指控。

articles.title: Isaias becomes hurricane, heads for U.S. Gulf Coast

paras.en: Oct. 8 (UPI) -- Isaias gained hurricane strength late Wednesday in the Gulf of Mexico, as it moved toward making landfall in the United States early this weekend, forecasters said.
paras.zh: 10 月 8 日（UPI）——预报员称，周三晚间，伊萨亚斯飓风在墨西哥湾增强，预计本​​周末早些时候登陆美国。

paras.en: The storm was located about 180 miles northwest of Progreso, Mexico, and 445 miles south-southwest of the mouth of the Mississippi, the National Hurricane Center said in its 1 a.m. CDT update.
paras.zh: 美国国家飓风中心在凌晨 1 点的 CDT 更新中表示，这场风暴位于墨西哥普罗格雷索西北约 180 英里、密西西比河河口西南偏南 445 英里处。

paras.en: It had maximum sustained winds of 75 mph, making it a Category 1 hurricane, and was moving east-northeast at 9 mph. Isaias is the first hurricane of the year in the Atlantic basin, despit a strong El Niño.
paras.zh: 它的最大持续风速为 75 英里/小时，为 1 级飓风，并以 9 英里/小时的速度向东北偏东移动。尽管有强烈的厄尔尼诺现象，但伊萨亚斯还是今年大西洋盆地的第一场飓风。

paras.en: A hurricane warning was in effect for Ocean Springs, Miss., to the Bay/Gulf County Line in Florida.
paras.zh: 密西西比州海泉市至佛罗里达州海湾/海湾县线的飓风警报已生效。

paras.en: A tropical storm warning was in effect for the Jefferson/Plaquemines Parish Line, La., to west of Ocean Springs and east of the Bay/Gulf County Line to Aucilla River, Fla.
paras.zh: 热带风暴警报已对路易斯安那州杰斐逊/普拉克明斯教区线、海泉市以西以及佛罗里达州海湾/海湾县线以东至奥西拉河以东生效。

paras.en: A storm surge warning was in effect for the mouth of the Mississippi River to the Steinhatchee River, Fla., and a storm surge watch was in effect for the Steinhatchee River to Yankeetown, Fla.
paras.zh: 密西西比河河口至佛罗里达州斯坦哈奇河的风暴潮警报已生效，风暴潮监视针对佛罗里达州斯坦哈奇河至扬基敦的河流也已生效。

paras.en: Isaias was expected to continue on its east-northeast path overnight, followed by a turn toward the northeast and north later Thursday and Friday.
paras.zh: 预计伊萨亚斯将在夜间继续沿东北偏东方向移动，然后在周四和周五晚些时候转向东北和北部。

paras.en: "On the forecast track, Isaias is expected to pass to the north of the Yucatan Peninsula later today and make landfall along the U.S. northern Gulf Coast within the warning area late Friday oe early Saturday," the forecasters said.
paras.zh: 预报员表示：“根据预测，伊萨亚斯预计将于今天晚些时候经过尤卡坦半岛北部，并在周五晚间或周六早些时候在美国墨西哥湾北部海岸的预警区域内登陆。”

paras.en: Through the weekend, Isaias is expected to bring 3 to 7 inches of rainfall, with local totals up to 10 inches, across the central U.S. Gulf Coast extending from far southeastern Louisiana to the Florida Panhandle.
paras.zh: 整个周末，伊萨亚斯预计将带来 3 至 7 英寸的降雨量，局部降雨量将达到 10 英寸，横跨美国墨西哥湾沿岸中部，从路易斯安那州东南部远至佛罗里达州狭长地带。

paras.en: Rainfall amounts of 1 to 3 inches, with localized amounts up to 5 inches, are possible across much of the Southeast as far north as the Tennessee and Ohio valleys and the Carolinas. Flash and urban flooding, along with some river flooding, are possible.
paras.zh: 东南部大部分地区，最北至田纳西州和俄亥俄河谷以及卡罗来纳州，降雨量可能达到 1 至 3 英寸，局部降雨量可达 5 英寸。山洪和城市洪水以及一些河流洪水是可能的。

paras.en: Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis declared a state of emergency for 25 counties Tuesday, telling residents to prepare their disaster plans and stock hurricane supply kits, CNN reported. State emergency teams are preparing generators, fuel, food, water and flood barriers in Tallahassee, Santa Rosa and surrounding areas.
paras.zh: 据美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 报道，佛罗里达州州长罗恩·德桑蒂斯周二宣布 25 个县进入紧急状态，要求居民准备灾难计划并储备飓风补给包。州应急小组正在塔拉哈西、圣罗莎及周边地区准备发电机、燃料、食物、水和防洪屏障。

paras.en: In the Gulf of Mexico, oil companies are preparing for the storm. Shell and BP are evacuating nonessential personnel from offshore platforms, CNN reported.
paras.zh: 在墨西哥湾，石油公司正在为风暴做准备。据美国有线电视新闻网报道，壳牌和英国石油公司正在从海上平台撤离非必要人员。

paras.en: Heavy rain could also move into the Ohio Valley as far north as Kentucky and West Virginia before moving into the Carolinas and southern Virginia, USA Today said.
paras.zh: 据《今日美国》报道，大雨还可能进入俄亥俄河谷，远至肯塔基州和西弗吉尼亚州，然后进入卡罗来纳州和弗吉尼亚州南部。

paras.en: Wind shear in the Atlantic has kept hurricanes at bay so far this season, but low wind shear in the Gulf is benefiting Isaias. However, there is higher wind shear closer to the Gulf states, which could weaken the storm.
paras.zh: 本季到目前为止，大西洋的风切变阻止了飓风，但海湾的低风切变使伊萨亚斯受益。然而，靠近海湾国家的风切变较高，这可能会削弱风暴。

articles.title: Ella Langley Wonders Onstage If She Can Have Both ‘The Man & The Dream’ Amid Tucker Wetmore Dating Rumors
articles.author: Alicia Urrea

paras.en: Ella Langley has spent the past few years chasing her country music dreams, and she’s been simultaneously thinking about what she wants outside of her glamorous, record-breaking career.
paras.zh: 艾拉·兰利（Ella Langley）在过去的几年里一直在追逐她的乡村音乐梦想，同时她也一直在思考在她迷人的、破纪录的职业生涯之外她想要什么。

paras.en: During her SiriusXM Small Stage performance on Tuesday at Denver’s The Grizzly Rose, the singer/songwriter prefaced one of her simpler tracks with a reflection on how different her life looks now compared with her small-town upbringing. Langley grew up in Hope Hull, Alabama, just south of Montgomery, where, as she put it, there wasn’t much to do besides “listen to music and ride dirt roads.”
paras.zh: 周二，在丹佛 The Grizzly Rose 举行的 SiriusXM 小舞台表演中，这位歌手/词曲作者为她一首简单的歌曲作了序言，反思了她现在的生活与她在小镇的成长相比有多么不同。兰利在阿拉巴马州的霍普赫尔长大，位于蒙哥马利以南，正如她所说，那里除了“听音乐和骑土路”之外没什么可做的。

paras.en: “My life moves so fast now,” Langley said in the clip, captured by Billboard. “I’m constantly going somewhere. I mean, for me to spend longer than five days in one place is a miracle.”
paras.zh: “我的生活现在节奏太快了，”兰利在广告牌捕捉到的视频中说道。 “我经常去某个地方。我的意思是，对我来说，在一个地方呆超过五天就是一个奇迹。”

paras.en: That pace has apparently gotten Langley thinking about whether she can make room for something a little more settled too. “I turned 27 this year, so I’m kinda thinking like, wait, can she have both?” she said. “Like, can she have the man and can she have the dream at the same time?”
paras.zh: 这种节奏显然让兰利开始思考她是否也可以为一些更稳定的事情腾出空间。 “我今年 27 岁了，所以我有点想，等等，她能两者兼得吗？”她说。 “比如，她能同时拥有男人和梦想吗？”

paras.en: The timing of this comment is notable considering the rumors swirling around a potential relationship with fellow country star Tucker Wetmore. The pair have been the subject of romance speculation, and People reported in September that sources confirmed the two are dating. Neither Langley nor Wetmore has publicly discussed their relationship status. (When Wetmore was asked about the rumors this week by a fan, he simply waved it off by saying, “Next question.”)
paras.zh: 考虑到围绕与同胞明星塔克·韦特莫尔潜在关系的谣言，这一评论的时机值得注意。两人一直是浪漫传闻的对象，《人物》杂志九月份报道称，消息人士证实两人正在约会。兰利和韦特莫尔都没有公开讨论过他们的关系状况。 （当韦特莫尔本周被一名粉丝问及这些谣言时，他只是简单地表示：“下一个问题。”）

paras.en: Still, Langley didn’t mention Wetmore in the clip. Instead, she described herself as “daydreaming a little bit” before introducing “Somethin’ Simple,” a song that captures the quieter life she’s imagining. The track, which appears on Langley’s sophomore album Dandelion, is about trading the nonstop pace of her current career for something much more domestic and simple: a life involving a home, a dog, a guitar and a hardworking man.
paras.zh: 不过，兰利在视频中没有提到韦特莫尔。相反，在推出《Somethin’ Simple》之前，她形容自己“有点做白日梦”，这首歌捕捉了她想象中的安静生活。这首歌曲出现在兰利的第二张专辑《蒲公英》中，讲述的是她要放弃目前职业生涯的不间断节奏，转向更加家庭和简单的生活：有家、狗、吉他和勤劳的男人的生活。

paras.en: Dandelion debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 and Top Country Albums back in April, giving Langley her first leader on both charts. Her breakout hit “Choosin’ Texas” also made its presence known on the charts, to say the very least, breaking the record for most weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100 since Mariah Carey’s “All I Want for Christmas Is You,” establishing Langley as one of music’s biggest rising stars.
paras.zh: 蒲公英 (Dandelion) 于 4 月份首次亮相，就在 Billboard 200 和顶级乡村专辑排行榜上排名第一，为兰利 (Langley) 带来了她在这两个排行榜上的第一个领先者。她的突破性单曲《Choosin’ Texas》也在排行榜上崭露头角，至少可以说，打破了自玛丽亚·凯莉 (Mariah Carey) 的《圣诞节我想要的就是你》(All I Want for Christmas Is You)以来连续几周在告示牌百强单曲榜上排名第一的记录，使兰利成为音乐界最耀眼的新星之一。

articles.title: Powderfinger Is Teasing ‘Something Extraordinary’
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: It’s coming around round again. At least, that’s what Powderfinger fans are hoping for.
paras.zh: 它又回来了。至少，这是《Powderfinger》粉丝所希望的。

paras.en: The Australian rock favorites have been dormant since 2010, when the Brisbane five-piece put a lid on their career with a farewell tour, one that shifted more than 200,000 tickets.
paras.zh: 自 2010 年以来，这支澳大利亚摇滚乐坛的宠儿就一直处于休眠状态，当时布里斯班五人乐队以一场告别巡演结束了他们的职业生涯，这场巡演售出了超过 20 万张门票。

paras.en: Something is stirring. Earlier in the week, a cryptic Instagram account popped up with the handle @thereturnoftheelectrichorsemen, a reference to “(The Return of) The Electric Horseman,” the closing track on the band’s 1996 album Double Allergic.
paras.zh: 有什么东西在搅动。本周早些时候，出现了一个神秘的 Instagram 帐户，其账号为@thereturnoftheelectrichorsemen，指的是乐队 1996 年专辑《Double Allergic》的片尾曲“(The Return of) The Electric Horseman”。

paras.en: There, the admin shared proof of billboards in Sydney, Melbourne and Brisbane, emblazoned with a code and Powderfinger lyrics. Eagle-eyed observers noted the account has five horse emojis in its bio, one for each of its band members.
paras.zh: 在那里，管理员分享了悉尼、墨尔本和布里斯班的广告牌证据，上面印有代码和 Powderfinger 歌词。目光敏锐的观察家注意到，该帐户的简介中有五个马表情符号，每个乐队成员都有一个。

paras.en: The plot thickened on Thursday (Oct. 8), with an email from the band’s HQ featuring the same cipher, written in white over a striking red background, along with a perplexing free verse (see in full below). It’s the same story on Powderfinger’s official Website and social accounts, which have been scrubbed – save for the one, mysterious red letter.
paras.zh: 周四（10 月 8 日），乐队总部发来一封电子邮件，其中包含相同的密码，以白色写在醒目的红色背景上，并附有令人费解的自由诗句（全文见下文），情节变得更加复杂。 Powderfinger 的官方网站和社交账户上也出现了同样的情况，除了那一个神秘的红色字母外，这些账户都已被删除。

paras.en: Whether it’s a new Powderfinger release, a reissue campaign for the 30th anniversary release of Double Allergic, or a reunion proper, time will tell. The answer might be found in the final sentence of the text “Everything else is a variable. Add enough time to enough variables and something extraordinary happens…”
paras.zh: 无论是新的 Powderfinger 版本、Double Allergic 发行 30 周年的重新发行活动，还是真正的重聚，时间会证明一切。答案可能会在文本的最后一句中找到：“其他一切都是变量。为足够的变量添加足够的时间，就会发生一些非凡的事情......”

paras.en: Hailing from Brisbane, the ‘Finger, as they’re affectionately known in these parts, was one of the elite bands of their era, earning the distinction 18 total ARIA Awards, and closing out their career with five successive No. 1 albums, a run that started with 1998’s Internationalist.
paras.zh: 来自布里斯班的“Finger”（在这些地区被人们亲切地称为“Finger”）是那个时代的精英乐队之一，总共获得了 18 项 ARIA 大奖，并以 1998 年的《Internationalist》开始的五张连续第一张专辑结束了他们的职业生涯。

paras.en: The last of those leaders was 2009’s Golden Rule, the band’s seventh and last studio album. The five ex-bandmates — Bernard Fanning, Ian Haug, Darren Middleton, John “JC” Collins and Jon Coghill — remain good friends, and briefly reunited in 2020 for “One Night Lonely,” a special virtual concert which raised more than A$500,000 for music industry charity Support Act and mental wellbeing support service Beyond Blue. The musicians recorded their spots independently, due to the social distancing rules of the time.
paras.zh: 最后一位领导者是 2009 年的《Golden Rule》，这是乐队的第七张也是最后一张录音室专辑。伯纳德·范宁 (Bernard Fanning)、伊恩·豪格 (Ian Haug)、达伦·米德尔顿 (Darren Middleton)、约翰·“JC”·柯林斯 (John “JC” Collins) 和乔恩·科吉尔 (Jon Coghill) 等五位前乐队成员仍然是好朋友，并于 2020 年在“One Night Lonely”上短暂重聚，这是一场特殊的虚拟音乐会，为音乐行业慈善机构 Support Act 和心理健康支持服务 Beyond Blue 筹集了超过 50 万澳元。由于当时的社交距离规则，音乐家们独立录制了自己的曲目。

paras.en: In August 2023, the lads gathered in their hometown for a fan-event and Q&A celebrating the 20th anniversary of their fifth album Vulture Street. The Vulture Street reissue was a smash, as it returned to No. 1 on the ARIA Albums Chart, creating a record for the longest stretch of time for a homegrown album to march back to the top of the leaderboard.
paras.zh: 2023 年 8 月，小伙子们聚集在家乡参加粉丝活动和问答活动，庆祝他们的第五张专辑《Vulture Street》发行 20 周年。 《Vulture Street》的重新发行引起了轰动，它在 ARIA 专辑榜上重回第一名，创造了本土专辑重回排行榜榜首的最长记录。

paras.en: Unreleased, the band’s compilation of studio tracks unearthed from sessions recorded between 1998 and 2010, peaked at No. 2 on the ARIA Chart in 2020.
paras.zh: 该乐队从 1998 年至 2010 年间录制的录音室曲目合辑尚未发行，在 2020 年 ARIA 排行榜上排名第二。

paras.en: There’s still a lot of love in these parts for Powderfinger. When triple j’s first-ever hottest 100 of Australian songs was counted down in July 2025, the rockers nabbed the highest overall entry count with three songs — four, including Fanning’s solo effort “Wish You Well,” which came in at No. 57.
paras.zh: 《粉指》的这些部分仍然受到人们的喜爱。 2025 年 7 月，当 Triple j 首个最热门的 100 首澳大利亚歌曲倒计时时，摇滚乐队以三首歌曲（四首）夺得了总条目数最高的歌曲，其中包括范宁的独唱作品《Wish You Well》，该歌曲排在第 57 位。

paras.en: To date, the band’s biggest international hit was “My Happiness,” which in 2001 crashed Billboard’s Alternative Airplay chart, peaking at No. 23.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，该乐队在国际上最热门的单曲是“My Happiness”，它在 2001 年冲垮了 Billboard 的另类音乐播放榜，最高排名第 23 位。

paras.en: Read Powderfinger’s cryptic message in full:
paras.zh: 完整阅读 Powderfinger 的神秘信息：

paras.en: Every rehearsal. Kilometre. Flight. Soundcheck. Stage. Encore. Album. Failure. Accolade. Conflict. Audience.
paras.zh: 每次排练。公里。航班。声音检查。阶段。安可。专辑。失败。荣誉。冲突。观众。

paras.en: Everything else is a variable. Add enough time to enough variables and something extraordinary happens…
paras.zh: 其他一切都是变量。为足够的变量添加足够的时间，一些非凡的事情就会发生……

articles.title: ARIA Warns Lawmakers That Australia Could Be Used as ‘Trojan Horse for Big AI’
articles.author: Lars Brandle

paras.en: SYDNEY, Australia — Weaken Australia’s copyright laws, ruin the future of the global music community and make the land down under an outcast.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚悉尼——削弱澳大利亚的版权法，毁掉全球音乐界的未来，让这片土地陷入被排斥的境地。

paras.en: That was the message from ARIA and PPCA CEO Annabelle Herd, who joined executives from trade associations representing writers and voice actors to address a parliamentary inquiry into AI.
paras.zh: 这是 ARIA 和 PPCA 首席执行官 Annabelle Herd 传达的信息，她与代表作家和配音演员的行业协会高管一起在议会对人工智能的调查中发表了讲话。

paras.en: Any changes to Australia’s Copyright Act to accommodate OpenAI and Anthropic “could make Australia the Trojan horse for Big AI – the global safe haven for industrial-scale copyright exploitation,” reads a statement from ARIA.
paras.zh: ARIA 的一份声明称，为适应 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 而对澳大利亚版权法进行的任何修改“都可能使澳大利亚成为大人工智能的特洛伊木马——工业规模版权利用的全球避风港”。

paras.en: Australia has a trust issue with OpenAI and its rivals.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚与 OpenAI 及其竞争对手存在信任问题。

paras.en: In June of this year, an autonomous OpenAI agent breached several government platforms, including Australia’s universal healthcare system, Medicare, a hack that security-experts are now saying was the first of its kind. Adding insult to injury, OpenAI only responded in September with a mea culpa that, many observers say, falls well short.
paras.zh: 今年 6 月，一个自主的 OpenAI 代理入侵了多个政府平台，包括澳大利亚的全民医疗保健系统 Medicare，安全专家现在称这是此类黑客攻击中的首例。雪上加霜的是，OpenAI 在 9 月份才做出了回应，做出了道歉，许多观察家表示，这远远不够。

paras.en: Speaking at the parliamentary hearing on Tuesday (Oct. 6) in Sydney, OpenAI’s chief strategy officer Jason Kwon admitted the breach “should not have happened” and the tech company “should have handled our response better.” Three months passed before the hack was brought to light, which the business did by way of a five-paragraph email.
paras.zh: 周二（10 月 6 日）在悉尼举行的议会听证会上，OpenAI 首席战略官 Jason Kwon 承认此次违规行为“不应该发生”，这家科技公司“应该更好地处理我们的应对措施”。三个月后，黑客事件才被曝光，该公司通过一封五段电子邮件的方式揭露了这一事件。

paras.en: “We are sorry and we know we have work to do to rebuild trust with the Australian people,” Kwon remarked. Reps from Anthropic, Microsoft and Google also attended the Joint Select Committee on Artificial Intelligence.
paras.zh: 权表示：“我们很抱歉，我们知道我们需要努力重建与澳大利亚人民的信任。” Anthropic、微软和谷歌的代表也出席了人工智能联合专责委员会。

paras.en: The time for talk on trust has passed, reckons Herd.
paras.zh: 赫德认为，谈论信任的时代已经过去了。

paras.en: For what outcome? “The world’s richest and most advanced companies say it would be too costly and complex to work with rights holders,” Herd continued.
paras.zh: 为了什么结果？ “世界上最富有和最先进的公司表示，与权利持有者合作成本太高、太复杂，”赫德继续说道。

paras.en: “This concept that the status quo isn’t working is being used as an argument by AI companies to change our copyright law. You don’t address a systemic problem of mass piracy by changing the law to legalize that piracy on an ongoing basis.
paras.zh: “人工智能公司正在利用现状不起作用这一概念作为改变版权法的论据。通过改变法律使盗版持续合法化并不能解决大规模盗版的系统性问题。

paras.en: Australia operates with a “very clear system where, if you can’t rely on a fair dealing exception, you can’t copy. The law is very certain,” Herd noted. The solution, the creative community insists with a unified voice, comes down to content licensing.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚有一个“非常明确的制度，如果你不能依赖公平交易例外，你就不能复制。法律是非常确定的，”赫德指出。创意社区坚持以统一的声音提出解决方案，归结为内容许可。

paras.en: “They should come to the negotiating table, not to the Prime Minister’s office,” Herd continued.
paras.zh: “他们应该来到谈判桌，而不是总理办公室，”赫德继续说道。

paras.en: OpenAI is said to be in talks with the Australian government about hosting and training AI models in these parts.
paras.zh: 据说 OpenAI 正在与澳大利亚政府就在这些地区托管和训练人工智能模型进行谈判。

paras.en: ARIA and PPCA “are not against these companies doing their frontier training in Australia. We understand why that is beneficial, but it should happen on our terms, not theirs. There is nothing less sovereign than rewriting our laws to suit foreign company commercial interests,” warns Herd.
paras.zh: ARIA 和 PPCA “并不反对这些公司在澳大利亚进行前沿培训。我们理解为什么这样做是有益的，但这应该按照我们的条件进行，而不是他们的。没有什么比重写我们的法律以适应外国公司商业利益更不主权的了，”赫德警告说。

paras.en: “Done the way that Big AI is proposing, it would devastate the music industry and make Australia a pariah for rights holders globally.”
paras.zh: “按照大人工智能提议的方式去做，它将摧毁音乐产业，并使澳大利亚成为全球权利持有者的贱民。”

paras.en: OpenAI’s Kwon told the hearing CEO Sam Altman had not known about the breach when he met the nation’s deputy prime minister Richard Marles on Sept. 1, according to the Australian Broadcasting Corporation, even though staff were aware of the situation weeks before. When asked to comment on why some polls reveal that most Australians don’t trust the technology, he remarked: “I can’t explain the current sentiment. All we can do is continue to get better.”
paras.zh: 据澳大利亚广播公司报道，OpenAI 的 Kwon 告诉听证会，首席执行官 Sam Altman 在 9 月 1 日会见该国副总理理查德·马勒斯时并不知道这一违规行为，尽管工作人员几周前就知道了这一情况。当被问及为什么一些民意调查显示大多数澳大利亚人不信任这项技术时，他表示：“我无法解释目前的情绪。我们所能做的就是继续变得更好。”

articles.title: Marilyn Monroe and Sydney Sweeney Are Related
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: Marilyn Monroe and Sydney Sweeney are related, according to a new study by MyHeritage.
paras.zh: MyHeritage 的一项新研究显示，玛丽莲·梦露和西德尼·斯威尼有亲戚关系。

paras.en: The actresses are ninth cousins, once removed. They share a mutual ancestor, Ezra Perry (c. 1625–1689), who was an early English settler in Sandwich, Massachusetts.
paras.zh: 女演员们是第九代堂兄弟姐妹，曾经是远房亲戚。他们有一个共同的祖先，埃兹拉·佩里（Ezra Perry，约 1625-1689 年），他是马萨诸塞州桑威奇的早期英国定居者。

paras.en: The Hollywood icon has been previously compared to the Euphoria star, notably when the latter actress wore a white dress at The Housemaid premiere in December 2025 that resembled Monroe’s iconic white skirt blowing look in The Seven Year Itch.
paras.zh: 这位好莱坞偶像此前曾被拿来与这位《幸福感》明星进行比较，特别是后者在 2025 年 12 月的《女仆》首映式上穿着白色连衣裙，类似于梦露在《七年之痒》中标志性的白裙飘扬造型。

paras.en: At the 2026 Santa Barbara Film Festival, Sweeney also wore a vintage Ceil Chapman gown that resembled that of the look Monroe sported on the cover of LIFE magazine in April 1952, furthering tendencies to point out their likeness.
paras.zh: 在 2026 年圣巴巴拉电影节上，斯威尼还穿着一件 Ceil Chapman 复古礼服，与 1952 年 4 月梦露登上《生活》杂志封面的造型相似，进一步引发了人们指出他们相似的倾向。

paras.en: “People have always drawn parallels between Sydney Sweeney and Marilyn Monroe, but seeing their paths align on a deeper level inspired us to look for a real bond in the MyHeritage archives,” said Roi Mandel, director of research at MyHeritage, in a statement. “Uncovering their shared branch was incredible, it’s a powerful reminder that humanity is one vast family tree, and when we dig deep, we uncover how remarkably interconnected we all are.”
paras.zh: MyHeritage 研究总监罗伊·曼德尔 (Roi Mandel) 在一份声明中表示：“人们总是将西德尼·斯威尼 (Sydney Sweeney) 和玛丽莲·梦露 (Marilyn Monroe) 相提并论，但看到她们的道路在更深层次上保持一致，激励我们在 MyHeritage 档案中寻找真正的联系。” “发现他们共同的分支是令人难以置信的，它有力地提醒我们，人类是一个巨大的家谱，当我们深入挖掘时，我们会发现我们所有人之间的相互联系是多么惊人。”

paras.en: The Emmy nominee has never portrayed Monroe onscreen, though many actresses have. Among those are Ana de Armas in Blonde and Michelle Williams for My Week with Marilyn, whom both earned Oscar nominations for their respective performances.
paras.zh: 这位艾美奖提名者从未在银幕上扮演过梦露，尽管许多女演员都曾在银幕上扮演过梦露。其中包括《金发女郎》中的安娜·德·阿玛斯和《我与梦露的一周》中的米歇尔·威廉姆斯，两人都因其各自的表演获得了奥斯卡提名。

paras.en: Most recently, Dakota Johnson and Ellen Burstyn portrayed versions of the Hollywood legend in Maggie Gyllenhaal’s short film Flesh Impact. Surprisingly, MyHeritage also revealed in new research that the Verity actress was also related to Monroe; she is Johnson’s ninth cousin, three times removed.
paras.zh: 最近，达科塔·约翰逊和艾伦·伯斯汀在玛吉·吉伦哈尔的短片《肉体冲击》中描绘了这位好莱坞传奇人物的不同版本。令人惊讶的是，MyHeritage 在新的研究中还透露，这位 Verity 女演员也与梦露有亲戚关系；她是约翰逊的第九个表弟，有过三次远亲。

paras.en: “With a new film bringing Marilyn Monroe back into the spotlight, our research team wanted to see whether there was a deeper family connection. Discovering that Dakota Johnson and Marilyn Monroe are related turns the casting into a real-life family story,” Naama Lanski, researcher at MyHeritage, said in a statement.
paras.zh: MyHeritage 研究员纳马·兰斯基 (Naama Lanski) 在一份声明中表示：“随着一部新电影让玛丽莲·梦露重新成为人们关注的焦点，我们的研究团队希望了解是否存在更深层次的家庭联系。发现达科塔·约翰逊和玛丽莲·梦露有关联，这使得选角变成了一个现实生活中的家庭故事。”

articles.title: Alexander Skarsgard’s ‘Wicker’ Gets Immersive With 4DX Screening Event
articles.author: Carly Thomas

paras.en: Looking to immerse yourself in the wicker husband? Now you can.
paras.zh: 想要沉浸在柳条丈夫的怀抱中吗？现在你可以了。

paras.en: Black Bear, the production company behind Eleanor Wilson and Alex Huston Fischer’s Wicker, revealed Wednesday that the romantic fantasy will be screening in 4DX for a one-night-only event on Oct. 28.
paras.zh: 埃莉诺·威尔逊 (Eleanor Wilson) 和亚历克斯·休斯顿·费舍尔 (Alex Huston Fischer) 执导的《柳条》(Wicker) 的制作公司黑熊 (Black Bear) 周三透露，这部浪漫奇幻作品将于 10 月 28 日在 4DX 上放映，为期一晚。

paras.en: This came after the film became a viral sensation with fans who believe it will be a raunchy experience and campaigned for it to play in the immersive format that incorporates synchronized environmental and physical effects, including motion, vibration, water and scents.
paras.zh: 在此之前，这部电影在粉丝中引起了轰动，他们认为这将是一次不雅的体验，并呼吁以沉浸式格式播放，融合同步的环境和物理效果，包括运动、振动、水和气味。

paras.en: “From the moment the trailer landed, audiences understood that Wicker could be something different, and they started asking to experience it in 4DX,” David Spitz, head of U.S. theatrical distribution for Black Bear, wrote in a statement. “What’s particularly exciting is seeing this wholly original film connect with audiences who might not ordinarily see themselves in the audience for a film like this. 4DX gives us a chance to lean into everything that makes it special, while giving audiences exactly what they asked for.”
paras.zh: “从预告片落地的那一刻起，观众就明白《威克》可能会有所不同，他们开始要求在 4DX 中体验它，”《黑熊》美国影院发行主管大卫·斯皮茨 (David Spitz) 在一份声明中写道。 “特别令人兴奋的是，看到这部完全原创的电影与那些通常不会在这样的电影中看到自己的观众建立联系。4DX 让我们有机会深入了解使它与众不同的一切，同时满足观众的需求。”

paras.en: Wicker, based on Ursula Wills’ short story The Wicker Husband, follows a fisherwoman (Olivia Colman) who commissions the local basketmaker (Peter Dinklage) to weave her a husband (Alexander Skarsgård). However, when the quiet village realizes he’s the man of any woman’s dreams, his presence sparks jealousy and chaos.
paras.zh: 《柳条》改编自乌苏拉·威尔斯的短篇小说《柳条丈夫》，讲述了一位渔妇（奥利维亚·科尔曼饰）委托当地制篮工人（彼特·丁拉基饰）为她编织一个丈夫（亚历山大·斯卡斯加德饰）的故事。然而，当这个安静的村庄意识到他是所有女人的梦想男人时，他的出现引发了嫉妒和混乱。

paras.en: Following Wednesday’s announcement, fans are already getting excited about the 4DX experience, with some trying to predict just how much they’re going to get experience of Skarsgård’s wicker husband. “wdym 4dx is there a wicker dildo on the seat,” one person wrote on X. Another person added, “4DX? Are they handing out wicker vibrators before the screening or what.”
paras.zh: 周三宣布这一消息后，粉丝们已经对 4DX 体验感到兴奋，有些人试图预测他们会对斯卡斯加德的柳条丈夫有多少体验。一位网友在 X 上写道：“wdym 4dx 的座位上有一个柳条假阳具吗？”另一个人补充道，“4DX？他们在放映前分发柳条振动器还是什么。”

articles.title: An Emotional Andrew Scott and ‘Elsinore’ Kick Off a Starry 2026 London Film Festival
articles.author: Lily Ford

paras.en: Andrew Scott, Olivia Colman and the cast of Elsinore have officially kicked off the 2026 BFI London Film Festival, and the opener couldn’t have been more fitting.
paras.zh: 安德鲁·斯科特 (Andrew Scott)、奥利维亚·科尔曼 (Olivia Colman) 和《埃尔西诺》(Elsinore) 的演员们正式拉开了 2026 年 BFI 伦敦电影节的序幕，开幕式再合适不过了。

paras.en: Scott — already garnering immense awards buzz for his “shattering” performance — was joined by co-stars Colman, Billie Piper, Johnny Flynn, Luke Thompson, Peter Mullan and Joe Locke for the showing, and became visibly emotional on stage as he welcomed out the real-life people who inspired particular Elsinore characters, including Colman’s Professor Margaret Johnson, a pioneer of HIV/AIDS treatment in the late ’80s, as well as the National Theatre’s stage door keeper of 46 years Linda Tolhurst, and Ian Charleson’s sister, Lizzie.
paras.zh: 斯科特已经因其“震撼”的表演而获得了巨大的奖项，他与联合主演科尔曼、比莉·派珀、约翰尼·弗林、卢克·汤普森、彼得·穆兰和乔·洛克一起演出，当他在舞台上欢迎那些启发了埃尔西诺特定角色的现实生活中的人们时，包括科尔曼饰演的玛格丽特·约翰逊教授，她是上世纪 80 年代末艾滋病毒/艾滋病治疗的先驱，以及国家剧院的舞台，他在舞台上显得非常激动。 46 年的看门人琳达·托尔赫斯特 (Linda Tolhurst) 和伊恩·查尔斯森 (Ian Charleson) 的妹妹莉齐 (Lizzie)。

paras.en: Described by Thompson as “a real love letter to theater,” the film is based on the life of Ian Charleson. It follows the actor’s final weeks before his death from AIDS playing Hamlet at London’s National Theatre in the 1990s. The glitzy gala at this year’s London Film Fest was especially poignant for audiences, with the Royal Festival Hall just a stone’s throw from the NT.
paras.zh: 这部电影根据伊恩·查尔斯森的一生改编，被汤普森描述为“一封写给戏剧的真正情书”。这部剧发生在这位演员于 20 世纪 90 年代在伦敦国家剧院扮演哈姆雷特时因艾滋病去世前的最后几周。今年伦敦电影节上的精彩盛会尤其让观众心酸，皇家节日音乐厅距离北领地仅一箭之遥。

paras.en: “I can’t tell you how extraordinary this feels for us to be here,” began Scott — also a producer on the film — on stage. “[And] how grateful I feel to play this extraordinary person. […] It was an extraordinary honor to play this person who was so wickedly funny and joyful and talented and charming and beautiful,” he continued. “It was the honor of a lifetime.”
paras.zh: “我无法告诉你我们来到这里感觉有多么不同寻常，”斯科特（也是该电影的制片人）在舞台上说道。 “[并且]我非常感激能够扮演这个非凡的人。[...]能够扮演这个非常有趣、快乐、才华横溢、迷人且美丽的人是一种非凡的荣幸，”他继续说道。 “这是一生的荣幸。”

paras.en: Following the film screening, which earned a raucous applause from attendees (and a standing ovation for its lead actor), Scott encouraged the audience to dance their way out to a song by the late Ethel Merman. “Ian did an extraordinary Ethel Merman impression,” he said. “We want you to be able to remember not just Ian, but how extraordinarily he lived — with such flair and zest and warmth and charm and passion and talent.”
paras.zh: 电影放映后赢得了与会者的热烈掌声（并为主演起立鼓掌），斯科特鼓励观众随着已故埃塞尔·默曼的歌曲跳舞。 “伊恩给埃塞尔·默曼留下了非凡的印象，”他说。 “我们希望你不仅能记住伊恩，还能记住他的非凡生活——充满天赋、热情、温暖、魅力、激情和才华。”

paras.en: Monica Dolan, Juliet Stevenson, Adeel Akhtar, Matthew Beard, David Dawson, Kadiff Kirwan, and Dickie Beau also star in Elsinore, from The Dig director Simon Stone and Pride writer Stephen Beresford.
paras.zh: 莫妮卡·多兰、朱丽叶·史蒂文森、阿迪尔·阿赫塔尔、马修·比尔德、大卫·道森、卡迪夫·基万和迪基·博也主演了《埃尔西诺》，该片由 The Dig 导演西蒙·斯通和《骄傲》编剧斯蒂芬·贝雷斯福德执导。

paras.en: Heartstopper alum Locke confessed to THR that his first read of the script was emotional. “I was flying home for Christmas last year and I was reading it and couldn’t stop crying,” he said on the carpet ahead of the premiere. “The flight attendant was like, ‘Are you okay?'” he laughed. “I was fully sobbing. But it’s a gorgeous piece of writing and Andrew gives the most incredible performance. I feel like Andrew is the best actor working, and it’s really nice he’s getting his recognition.”
paras.zh: 《心跳停止》演员洛克向《好莱坞报道》坦言，他第一次读到剧本时很激动。 “去年圣诞节我飞回家的时候读到了这本书，忍不住哭了，”他在首映前的地毯上说道。 “空姐问，‘你还好吗？’”他笑着说。 “我完全哭了。但这是一篇精彩的文章，安德鲁的表演是最令人难以置信的。我觉得安德鲁是最好的演员，他得到认可真是太好了。”

paras.en: Filmmaker Stone concurred with Locke’s assessment of Scott’s performance, also hailed by THR‘s chief film critic David Rooney in his review. “Andrew has spent most of his life on stage. He’s a stage animal,” the Aussie said to THR. “It’s rare to know someone who can be as magnetic on stage as they are on film, and [who] can really move between those two modes effortlessly, and you see him doing that in this film. It’s really exciting.”
paras.zh: 电影制片人斯通同意洛克对斯科特表演的评价，《好莱坞报道》的首席影评人大卫·鲁尼在评论中也对此表示赞赏。 “安德鲁一生的大部分时间都在舞台上度过。他是舞台动物，”澳大利亚人对《好莱坞报道》说道。 “很少有人能在舞台上像在电影中一样具有吸引力，并且能够毫不费力地在这两种模式之间切换，而你在这部电影中看到他做到了这一点。这真的很令人兴奋。”

paras.en: As the National Theatre’s shadow loomed over the carpet, you couldn’t help but feel the evocativeness of the setting. “It’s amazing to have been chosen to open the London Film Festival, the story takes place 100 meters away from here,” continued Stone. “I’m that we made a not-bad film enough to be allowed to do this very quintessentially London experience. But the London theater and film community is so incredibly strong; it’s a mecca, and we’re all here tonight to celebrate this joyful tribute to why we’re all in this business.”
paras.zh: 当国家大剧院的影子笼罩在地毯上时，你会情不自禁地感受到这个场景的令人回味。 “能够被选为伦敦电影节开幕真是太棒了，故事就发生在距离这里 100 米之外，”斯通继续说道。 “我认为我们制作了一部不错的电影，足以让我们获得这种典型的伦敦体验。但伦敦戏剧和电影界的实力非常强大；它是一个圣地，今晚我们都在这里庆祝这一欢乐的致敬，向我们所有人投身于这个行业的原因致敬。”

paras.en: The artistic director of the BFI London Film Festival, Kristy Matheson, explained that the selection committee “fell so deeply in love” with Elsinore. She added: “It has such an array of incredible British talent. But I think what makes the film so wonderful is it’s really looking at what radical care can be. You have all these people in this film; they’re creating work together, they’re creating community together. So I think it’s a film that’s steeped in activism and it’s also steeped in the triumph of art. And they feel like really wonderful themes to be putting out in the world.”
paras.zh: BFI 伦敦电影节艺术总监克里斯蒂·马西森 (Kristy Matheson) 解释说，评选委员会“深深地爱上了”埃尔西诺。她补充道：“这部电影拥有如此多令人难以置信的英国人才。但我认为这部电影之所以如此精彩，是因为它真正探讨了激进的关怀可以是什么。这部电影里有所有这些人；他们一起创造工作，他们一起创建社区。所以我认为这是一部充满激进主义的电影，也充满了艺术的胜利。他们感觉像是向世界展示的非常精彩的主题。”

paras.en: THR broke the news of Scott and Colman’s Fleabag reunion on Elsinore earlier this year. The Irishman is also a producer on the film, alongside Andrea Occhipinti of Lucky Red with Gabrielle Tana of Magnolia Mae Films, Pete Shilaimon and Mickey Liddell of LD Entertainment, and Stefano Massenzi and Carolyn Marks Blackwood.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，《THR》报道了斯科特和科尔曼在埃尔西诺的 Fleabag 重聚的消息。这位爱尔兰人也是这部电影的制片人，其他制片人包括 Lucky Red 的 Andrea Occhipinti、Magnolia Mae Films 的 Gabrielle Tana、LD Entertainment 的 Pete Shilaimon 和 Mickey Liddell、Stefano Massenzi 和 Carolyn Marks Blackwood。

paras.en: It marks the beginning of 10 star-spangled days of galas for the British capital, with films such as Artificial, Bunker, Behemoth!, Ink, Club Kid, A Long Winter, Wild Horse Nine, Ray Gunn and Paper Tiger all premiering at London Southbank’s Royal Festival Hall.
paras.zh: 这标志着英国首都为期 10 天的星光璀璨的盛会拉开序幕，电影《Artificial》、《Bunker》、《Behemoth!》、《Ink》、《Club Kid》、《A Long Winter》、《Wild Horse Nine》、《Ray Gunn》和《Paper Tiger》均在伦敦南岸皇家节日音乐厅首映。

articles.title: Stock futures move lower after S&P 500 retreats from record: Live updates

paras.en: U.S. stock futures were lower early Thursday, after the S&P 500 retreated from its record as yields spiked to multidecade highs.
paras.zh: 随着收益率飙升至数十年高点，标准普尔 500 指数从历史纪录回落，美国股指期货周四早些时候走低。

paras.en: Dow Jones Industrial Average futures fell 132 basis points, or 0.26%. S&P 500 futures dipped 0.15%, and Nasdaq-100 futures were 0.21% lower.
paras.zh: 道琼斯工业平均指数期货下跌 132 个基点，跌幅 0.26%。标准普尔 500 指数期货下跌 0.15%，纳斯达克 100 指数期货下跌 0.21%。

paras.en: Levi Strauss shares dipped almost 2% in extended trading after the denim retailer lowered its revenue growth guidance for the full year, though it also raised its profit outlook.
paras.zh: 在牛仔布零售商李维斯 (Levi Strauss) 下调全年收入增长预期后，该公司股价在盘后交易中下跌近 2%，但也上调了利润预期。

paras.en: Wall Street is coming off a losing session. The S&P 500 dipped 0.2%, pulling back from an all-time high it reached just one day prior. The Dow fell more than 340 points, or 0.7%. The Nasdaq Composite slid 0.2%.
paras.zh: 华尔街正在经历亏损。标准普尔 500 指数下跌 0.2%，从一天前创下的历史高点回落。道指跌逾 340 点，跌幅 0.7%。纳斯达克综合指数下跌 0.2%。

paras.en: The Treasury on Wednesday sold $39 billion of 10-year notes, drawing solid demand with indirect bidders — including global central banks — taking more than 80% of the auction, above a 10-auction average of 72.4%. The sale helped the 10-year Treasury note yield ease off its 24-year high during Wednesday's session. The Treasury is set to sell $22 billion of 30-year bonds later Thursday.
paras.zh: 美国财政部周三出售了 390 亿美元的 10 年期国债，吸引了强劲的需求，包括全球央行在内的间接竞标者获得了超过 80% 的拍卖份额，高于 10 次拍卖的平均水平 72.4%。此次出售帮助 10 年期国债收益率在周三盘中回落至 24 年高点。财政部定于周四晚些时候出售 220 亿美元的 30 年期债券。

paras.en: The 10-year Treasury note yield was last seen 4 basis points higher at 5.3178%, with the 30-year Treasury note yield up 4 basis points at 5.7064%.
paras.zh: 10年期国债收益率上次上涨4个基点至5.3178%，30年期国债收益率上涨4个基点至5.7064%。

paras.en: In Asia, Japan's Nikkei 225 was down 1.12% while South Korea's Kospi lost 2.04%. Australia's S&P/ASX 200 was 0.64% lower. Mainland China's CSI 300 declined 0.43%, while Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index dropped 0.69%.
paras.zh: 在亚洲，日本日经 225 指数下跌 1.12%，韩国综合指数下跌 2.04%。澳大利亚 S&P/ASX 200 指数下跌 0.64%。中国内地沪深300指数下跌0.43%，香港恒生指数下跌0.69%。

paras.en: Higher yields have curbed investor appetite for equities in recent weeks, especially those parts of the market most hurt by higher borrowing costs. Industrials, for example, is the worst performing sector week to date.
paras.zh: 最近几周，收益率上升抑制了投资者对股票的兴趣，尤其是那些受借贷成本上升影响最严重的市场领域。例如，工业股是迄今为止本周表现最差的板块。

paras.en: Many investors are maintaining an optimistic view of the stock market, however. They expect that the start of earnings season could give the market the fuel it needs for the next leg higher.
paras.zh: 然而，许多投资者对股市仍保持乐观看法。他们预计，财报季的开始可能会给市场提供下一波上涨所需的动力。

paras.en: In the third quarter, the S&P 500 is expected post a blended earnings growth rate of roughly 30%, which would be a third straight quarter of above-25% earnings growth, according to FactSet.
paras.zh: 根据 FactSet 的数据，标准普尔 500 指数第三季度的综合盈利增长率预计约为 30%，这将是连续第三个季度盈利增长超过 25%。

paras.en: "If earnings remain strong, and the idea is that they probably will, if expectations are met and/or higher, that is going to sustain this rally — despite the fact that rates are higher," Courtney Garcia, senior wealth advisor at Payne Capital Management, told CNBC's "Closing Bell." "It's not going to derail the market."
paras.zh: 佩恩资本管理公司(Payne Capital Management)高级财富顾问考特尼·加西亚(Courtney Garcia)在接受CNBC“收盘钟”节目采访时表示：“如果盈利保持强劲，而且如果预期达到和/或更高，盈利可能会保持强劲，这将维持这一涨势——尽管事实上利率更高。” “这不会破坏市场。”

paras.en: On Thursday, investors will await results from PepsiCo before the open. Traders will also watch for weekly jobless claims data.
paras.zh: 周四，投资者将在开盘前等待百事公司的业绩。交易员还将关注每周失业救济金申请数据。

articles.title: TSMC's September sales jump more than 50% year over year

paras.en: The world's largest contract chipmaker Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co posted revenue of $511.86 billion New Taiwan dollars ($16.03 billion) for September, up 54.6% on the year prior, but down 0.6% on August.
paras.zh: 全球最大的代工芯片制造商台积电公布 9 月份营收为 5118.6 亿新台币（约合 160.3 亿美元），同比增长 54.6%，但较 8 月份下降 0.6%。

paras.en: Its third quarter revenue came around $NT1.49 trillion.
paras.zh: 第三季度营收约为新台币1.49万亿美元。

paras.en: The company closed 1.35% lower ahead of releasing monthly figures.
paras.zh: 该公司在公布月度数据之前收盘下跌 1.35%。

paras.en: TSMC, which counts Nvidia and Apple among its customers, has been a major beneficiary of surging demand for advanced AI chips.
paras.zh: 台积电的客户包括英伟达和苹果，该公司是先进人工智能芯片需求激增的主要受益者。

paras.en: In September, TSMC committed to using ASML's High NA extreme ultraviolet lithography machines, a key technology for producing more advanced chips, joining Samsung Electronics among customers adopting the technology.
paras.zh: 9月，台积电承诺使用ASML的高NA极紫外光刻机，这是生产更先进芯片的关键技术，与三星电子一起采用该技术。

paras.en: It is scheduled to report its third-quarter earnings next week.
paras.zh: 该公司定于下周公布第三季度收益。

paras.en: Correction: The story has been updated to reflect that sales did not hit a record high in September.
paras.zh: 更正：该报道已更新，以反映 9 月份的销售额并未创下历史新高。

articles.title: AI startup Manus raises $500 million in first funding round since Meta breakup

paras.en: AI agent startup Manus has raised more than $500 million in its first funding round since Meta was forced to abandon its acquisition of the company.
paras.zh: 自 Meta 被迫放弃收购该公司以来，人工智能代理初创公司 Manus 在第一轮融资中筹集了超过 5 亿美元。

paras.en: Butterfly Effect, Manus' parent company, said Thursday that the round was led by private equity firm Boyu Capital and venture investor IDG Capital, with follow-on investment from existing shareholders Tencent, HSG and ZhenFund.
paras.zh: Manus母公司蝴蝶效应周四表示，本轮融资由私募股权公司博裕资本和风险投资者IDG资本领投，现有股东腾讯、HSG和真格基金跟投。

paras.en: The company did not disclose its post-funding valuation. Bloomberg reported last month that Manus was set to double its valuation to $4 billion in this financing round, making it the country's most valuable AI agent maker.
paras.zh: 该公司没有透露其融资后估值。彭博社上个月报道称，Manus 在本轮融资中估值将翻一番，达到 40 亿美元，成为美国最有价值的人工智能代理制造商。

paras.en: The raise suggests investors aren't deterred by Beijing's unprecedented order to block Meta's short-lived $2 billion acquisition. Meta was working to integrate Manus' team and technology into its system when authorities blocked the deal. It also shows that appetite for AI-agent startups has held up, even as the underlying foundation models improve quickly and price competition intensifies.
paras.zh: 此次融资表明，北京方面史无前例地下令阻止 Meta 的 20 亿美元短暂收购，投资者并未因此而却步。当当局阻止这笔交易时，Meta 正在努力将 Manus 的团队和技术整合到其系统中。它还表明，尽管底层基础模型迅速改进且价格竞争加剧，但对人工智能代理初创公司的兴趣依然存在。

paras.en: "The fundraising shows that the short-term fallout of the Meta case has been contained and investors are willing to back Manus as an independent company," said Dan Wang, China director at Eurasia Group, also noting the renewed confidence in the commercial potential of AI agents.
paras.zh: 欧亚集团中国区总监王丹表示：“此次融资表明 Meta 案的短期影响已得到遏制，投资者愿意支持 Manus 作为一家独立公司。”他还指出，人们对人工智能代理的商业潜力重新充满信心。

paras.en: Earlier this month, Manus said it had resumed independent operations after its split from Meta and that its founding team would continue to push forward generative AI agents for users globally.
paras.zh: 本月早些时候，Manus 表示，从 Meta 分拆后已恢复独立运营，其创始团队将继续为全球用户推动生成式 AI 代理。

paras.en: Once seen as a blueprint for Chinese startups seeking global reach, Manus has become a cautionary tale for companies squeezed between regulators in Beijing and Washington.
paras.zh: 马努斯曾被视为中国初创企业寻求全球影响力的蓝图，但它已成为夹在北京和华盛顿监管机构之间的公司的警示故事。

paras.en: The company launched in early 2025 in China, then moved its staff to Singapore after winning backing from U.S. venture firm Benchmark. Meta announced the acquisition in December. Chinese regulators later blocked it. The National Development and Reform Commission said it had decided to "prohibit foreign investment in the Manus project." By then, Meta had begun integrating Manus's team and technology into its own.
paras.zh: 该公司于 2025 年初在中国成立，在获得美国风险投资公司 Benchmark 的支持后，将员工迁至新加坡。 Meta于12月宣布了此次收购。中国监管机构后来予以阻止。国家发改委表示，已决定“禁止外商投资马努斯项目”。那时，Meta 已经开始将 Manus 的团队和技术整合到自己的团队和技术中。

paras.en: Since the split, the AI startup has unveiled Manus 2.0, built on a new in-house execution system called Cascade. It also launched Cue, a standalone personal-agent app in which each agent has its own email address, phone number, and mobile wallet.
paras.zh: 自分拆以来，这家人工智能初创公司推出了 Manus 2.0，它建立在名为 Cascade 的新内部执行系统之上。它还推出了 Cue，这是一款独立的个人代理应用程序，其中每个代理都有自己的电子邮件地址、电话号码和移动钱包。

paras.en: Meta has pressed ahead with its own personal AI agent, launching its Muse agent in early September, modeled on the open-source AI agent OpenClaw.
paras.zh: Meta 继续推进自己的个人 AI 代理，于 9 月初推出了 Muse 代理，该代理以开源 AI 代理 OpenClaw 为蓝本。

articles.title: Rogue AI or human error? The real story behind the OpenAI-Hugging Face incident

paras.en: Rachel Feltman: For Scientific American’s Science Quickly, I’m Rachel Feltman.
paras.zh: 雷切尔·费尔特曼：《科学美国人》的《科学快报》，我是雷切尔·费尔特曼。

paras.en: Have you heard about the OpenAI-Hugging Face incident? (Sidenote: Does that string of words also make you think of something Timothy Olyphant’s character might get up to on the show Alien: Earth? You know ‘cause he is AI, the aliens hug faces. Anyway.)
paras.zh: 你听说过OpenAI抱脸事件吗？ （旁注：这串词是否也让你想起蒂莫西·奥利芬特（Timothy Olyphant）的角色在《异形：地球》节目中可能会做的事情？你知道，因为他是人工智能，外星人拥抱着脸。无论如何。）

paras.en: The incident in question went down a few months ago, when OpenAI agents messed with an artificial intelligence platform called Hugging Face. This definitely wasn’t supposed to happen, and it freaked a lot of people out. But what actually happened? According to many headlines and lots of online chatter, more than a thousand “rogue” AI agents collaborated to conduct an unsanctioned attack. While all of that could technically be considered true, some of the words I just used imply a sort of intentionality and dare I say impishness that simply wasn’t involved. The truth is a lot less science-fiction-y: The human beings who designed these models and gave them their prompts made some missteps. But while that might sound less apocalyptic than the headlines did, it doesn’t mean we shouldn’t find this incident deeply troubling.
paras.zh: 该事件发生在几个月前，当时 OpenAI 特工搞乱了一个名为 Hugging Face 的人工智能平台。这绝对是不应该发生的，它吓坏了很多人。但到底发生了什么？根据许多头条新闻和大量的网上讨论，一千多个“流氓”人工智能特工联手发起了一次未经批准的攻击。虽然从技术上讲，所有这些都可以被认为是真实的，但我刚才使用的一些词暗示了某种意图，而且我敢说根本不涉及的顽皮。事实远没有那么科幻：设计这些模型并给予它们提示的人类犯了一些错误。虽然这听起来不像头条新闻那么末日，但这并不意味着我们不应该对这一事件深感不安。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: My guest today is an artist and AI researcher who’s thought a lot about the way we talk about this and other AI mishaps. His name is Eryk Salvaggio, and he’s a Gates scholar at the University of Cambridge working at Cambridge Digital Humanities.
paras.zh: 今天我的客人是一位艺术家和人工智能研究员，他对我们谈论这一事件和其他人工智能事故的方式进行了很多思考。他的名字叫 Eryk Salvaggio，是剑桥大学的盖茨学者，在剑桥数字人文部门工作。

paras.en: Thank you so much for coming on to chat with us today.
paras.zh: 非常感谢您今天接受我们的采访。

paras.en: Eryk Salvaggio: Thank you for having me.
paras.zh: 埃里克·萨尔瓦乔：谢谢你邀请我。

paras.en: Feltman: So I brought you on because I read a piece of yours about AI and how we are talking about it, and I’m really excited to get into that with you. But to give a little context for our listeners, could you tell us a little bit about the work you do and your professional relationship with AI?
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：所以我邀请你加入是因为我读了你关于人工智能以及我们如何谈论它的文章，我很高兴能和你一起讨论这个问题。但为了向我们的听众提供一些背景信息，您能否告诉我们一些您所做的工作以及您与人工智能的专业关系？

paras.en: Salvaggio: Yeah, certainly. So I’ve been working with technology and thinking about technology and ethics since I was a teenager. Basically, I’ve worked in and around policy spaces around technology, and I came to it through a kind of cultural background. I worked as an artist, and I was working with this technology to make work, and that exposed me over time to some of the ethical questions, some of the questions around technology and power and the way that technology is changing our social lives, our political lives and culture in general.
paras.zh: 萨尔瓦乔：是的，当然。所以我从十几岁起就一直在研究技术并思考技术和道德。基本上，我在技术政策领域及其周围工作过，我是通过某种文化背景来到这个领域的。我是一名艺术家，我正在使用这项技术来创作作品，随着时间的推移，这让我接触到一些道德问题，一些关于技术和权力的问题，以及技术改变我们的社会生活、政治生活和文化的方式。

paras.en: So I come at it from that lens, trying to think differently about the stories that technology is telling us about itself, in a way, and trying to think about how I can look at that from a different angle, a different perspective.
paras.zh: 所以我从这个角度来看待这个问题，试图以不同的方式思考技术在某种程度上告诉我们的关于它自己的故事，并试图思考如何从不同的角度、不同的视角来看待它。

paras.en: Feltman: Well, so the piece I referenced earlier was about the [Hugging Face] incident. Could you just briefly summarize, for our listeners, what happened there and, sort of, what the prevailing narrative around it was? And then we can get into, a little bit, the ways in which you disagree with that narrative.
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：嗯，所以我之前提到的那篇文章是关于[抱脸]事件的。您能否为我们的听众简要总结一下那里发生的事情以及围绕它的流行叙述是什么？然后我们可以稍微讨论一下你不同意这种说法的方式。

paras.en: Salvaggio: Yeah, sure. So the prevailing narrative of what happened comes from OpenAI. They released [an] alert. Basically, this company Hugging Face announced that they had been hacked by an agent of some sort of large language model or AI system had hacked them. And then OpenAI said, “Oh, sorry, that was us. Looks like we did that, and we understand kind of what happened, and we’re gonna do a full report.”
paras.zh: 萨尔瓦乔：是的，当然。因此，关于所发生事件的流行叙述来自 OpenAI。他们发布了警报。基本上，Hugging Face 公司宣布他们被某种大型语言模型或人工智能系统的代理黑客攻击了。然后 OpenAI 说：“哦，抱歉，是我们。看来我们做到了，我们了解发生了什么，我们会做一份完整的报告。”

paras.en: A couple weeks after that, we get this report, and there was, kind of, pandemonium, right? A lot of the way that people understood what happened was filtered through this lens of going rogue. The artificial intelligence had kind of learned to coordinate with other instances of itself and had identified a target and had gone after Hugging Face in order to basically do this kind of weird exam for AI models called ExploitGym. And so it “broke containments”—this is another phrase that we heard in some of the headlines—and got online and went to the Hugging Face website and did what it did there.
paras.zh: 几周后，我们收到了这份报告，然后就出现了混乱，对吧？人们理解发生的事情的很多方式都是通过流氓的镜头过滤的。人工智能已经学会了与自身的其他实例进行协调，并确定了一个目标，并追踪“Hugging Face”，以便基本上为名为 ExploitGym 的人工智能模型进行这种奇怪的检查。因此，它“打破了遏制”——这是我们在一些头条新闻中听到的另一个短语——并上网并访问了 Hugging Face 网站，并做了它在那里所做的事情。

paras.en: And so this created a lot of concern about these AI agents and what they were becoming capable of doing and their coordination and their persistence, right, their perseverance. They weren’t giving up until they got in and this kind of stuff. And so you really had a lot of, I think, fear, a lot of mystery, and a lot of, kind of, talking about the agents and the AI system as if it was its own thing that acted on its own volition.
paras.zh: 因此，这引起了人们对这些人工智能代理、他们的能力、他们的协调和他们的坚持不懈的担忧。他们不会放弃，直到他们进入诸如此类的事情。所以我认为，你确实有很多恐惧，很多神秘，还有很多谈论代理和人工智能系统，就好像它是按照自己的意愿行事的自己的东西一样。

paras.en: And sometimes I refer to this as, like, a system from nowhere. Like, no one built this thing. No one knows how it works. It just happens to everybody. And I take some umbrage to that frame. I think there is something to look at and say that there’s some real accountability that we can see when we look closer at this incident.
paras.zh: 有时我将其称为“不知从何而来的系统”。就像，没有人建造这个东西。没有人知道它是如何运作的。每个人都会遇到这种情况。我对那个框架有些不满。我认为有一些事情值得关注，并且当我们仔细观察这一事件时，我们可以看到一些真正的责任。

paras.en: Feltman: Yeah. Well, and I think for a lot of people, this idea that the agents were communicating with each other on a message board, and it really evoked the idea of these distinct individuals, you know, collaborating—which, correct me if I’m wrong, but that’s not really what we’re talking about with an AI model, right?
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：是的。嗯，我认为对于很多人来说，代理在留言板上相互交流的想法，它确实唤起了这些不同的个体的想法，你知道，合作——如果我错了，请纠正我，但这并不是我们真正谈论的人工智能模型，对吧？

paras.en: Salvaggio: Right. What we’re talking about these days is something called an agentic system, which really is multiple versions of the same model, for the most part, being spun up and run with a kind of subroutine, you could call it, or a side task of some kind. And so ultimately—and it’s interesting, Anthropic had this interesting diagram where they showed Claude pointing an arrow at another box that said Claude, and that had an arrow pointing to another box that said Claude, and then both of those converged, right? And it was just Claude all the way down. And this is pretty much how they’re running.
paras.zh: 萨尔瓦乔：对。我们现在谈论的是一种称为代理系统的东西，它实际上是同一模型的多个版本，在大多数情况下，通过一种子程序（你可以称之为子程序）或某种副任务来启动和运行。所以最终 - 很有趣的是，Anthropic 有一个有趣的图表，其中他们显示克劳德将箭头指向另一个写着“克劳德”的盒子，而另一个盒子上也有一个箭头指向另一个写着“克劳德”的盒子，然后两个都聚合了，对吗？一路下来就只有克劳德了。这几乎就是他们的运行方式。

paras.en: And so, when we talk about these agents, what we’re really talking about is a kind of narrow slice of a bigger model, but it’s all optimized toward the same goals. It is trained on the same training data. It is basically the same model being run multiple times. Now, with the Hugging Face incident, OpenAI had two models, and they were kind of collaborating, but most of the stuff that we’re talking about actually happened within the single model, which is their internal model that only they have access to right now.
paras.zh: 因此，当我们谈论这些代理时，我们真正谈论的是更大模型的一小部分，但它们都是为了相同的目标而优化的。它是在相同的训练数据上进行训练的。它基本上是多次运行相同的模型。现在，随着“抱脸”事件，OpenAI 有两个模型，他们有点合作，但我们谈论的大部分内容实际上都发生在单个模型中，这是他们目前只有他们有权访问的内部模型。

paras.en: Feltman: Well, and one thing I really appreciated about the way you wrote about this is that you weren’t denying that there is reason for concern here but rather that we might be missing the actual areas of concern by, you know, focusing on this sort of like, Skynet scenario. Could you tell us a little bit more about, you know, what you think we should actually be learning from this incident?
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：嗯，我真正欣赏你写这篇文章的方式的一件事是，你并没有否认这里有值得关注的理由，而是我们可能会因为关注这种天网场景而错过实际的关注领域。您能否告诉我们更多有关您认为我们应该从这起事件中学到什么的信息？

paras.en: Salvaggio: So a lot of the way this has been talked about has been using intentional language, right? This is this idea that the model wanted something, the model believed something, the model was trying to do something. And this can be a really, kind of, straightforward way of getting the basics down of what exactly happened.
paras.zh: 萨尔瓦乔：所以很多讨论这个问题的方式都是使用有意的语言，对吗？这就是模型想要某事、模型相信某事、模型试图做某事的想法。这可能是一种真正、某种、直接的方式来了解到底发生了什么。

paras.en: But if you stop there, you basically kind of say that the model did all of this on its own, and you stop looking at the human decisions about how this model was designed and how it was deployed, how the testing environment was built and deployed, right? So we know, for example, OpenAI says this is a persistent model. It didn’t give up. It kept trying. And what that, kind of, moves you away from is asking the question, “Well, why?” And there’s a real answer to that, and it’s a human decision about how we train these models. And what it turns out: they trained it not to stop. Most of the time, these language models have something called a stop token. It comes up, and it looks like it’s the end of something that someone would say, and so it finishes. This didn’t really have that. It was designed to keep trying. If it failed, it would just, kind of, step back and repivot and try and try and try again. So there’s one aspect of this that, I think, is that we lose sight of when we look at just the model’s behavior and instead start saying, “Well, how was it designed?” and we’re constantly optimizing models, training models. We’re involved in making decisions about pre-training, what we do to the data, in other words, what we do to the models once they’re trained, and what we kinda ask them to do.
paras.zh: 但如果你停在那里，你基本上可以说模型自己完成了所有这一切，并且你不再关注关于该模型如何设计、如何部署、如何构建和部署测试环境的人类决策，对吧？所以我们知道，例如，OpenAI 说这是一个持久模型。它没有放弃。它一直在努力。而这会让你远离这个问题：“嗯，为什么？”这个问题有一个真正的答案，这是我们如何训练这些模型的人类决定。结果是：他们训练它不要停下来。大多数时候，这些语言模型都有一个称为停止标记的东西。它出现了，看起来像是某人会说的某件事的结束，所以它结束了。这确实没有那个。它旨在不断尝试。如果失败了，它只会后退一步，重新调整，尝试再尝试。因此，我认为，其中一个方面是，当我们只关注模型的行为时，我们会忽略了这一点，而是开始说：“那么，它是如何设计的？”我们不断优化模型、训练模型。我们参与制定关于预训练的决策，我们对数据做什么，换句话说，我们在模型训练完成后对模型做什么，以及我们要求他们做什么。

paras.en: All of this stuff is human decisions happening inside the organizations, and we can ask for accountability by looking at those decisions. Whereas if we look only at what the model did and attribute all of this to its desires, or wants, we kind of lose sight of exactly how those desires and wants came to be.
paras.zh: 所有这些都是组织内部发生的人类决策，我们可以通过查看这些决策来要求问责。然而，如果我们只看模型做了什么，并将所有这些都归因于它的欲望或想要，我们有点忽视了这些欲望和想要到底是如何产生的。

paras.en: Feltman: Yeah, and it seems like a company that’s creating this kind of AI product would have a lot of incentive to make people believe that it’s becoming super smart and autonomous and not a lot of incentive to admit that they need better guardrails internally.
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：是的，创造这种人工智能产品的公司似乎有很大的动力让人们相信它正在变得超级智能和自主，但没有太多的动力承认他们内部需要更好的护栏。

paras.en: Salvaggio: Yeah. A lot of this language is doing that work of saying, “We actually don’t understand this, and we don’t have control over it.” And when you are a company that is building models, and you’re saying that we’re not in control of what we’re building, there’s something going on there, and I think we can ask some real questions about what purpose that serves.
paras.zh: 萨尔瓦乔：是的。很多这种语言都在说：“我们实际上不理解这一点，而且我们无法控制它。”当你是一家正在构建模型的公司，并且你说我们无法控制我们正在构建的东西时，那里正在发生一些事情，我认为我们可以就其服务的目的提出一些真正的问题。

paras.en: And so the way I approach it is: What exactly is this language doing? And how can we look through the language that the model’s producing, how it generates that language? And all of that is human optimization, it’s someone’s decision about the type of language these models are gonna produce, how it gets there, what it’s rewarded for producing and saying and doing. So I would like to look at more—less at thinking about these as artificial intelligence and try to focus it at more on artificial language, the idea that this language is doing something to us to influence us but also to act in the world. So how do we understand that, and how do we understand the—how these are being steered through this language?
paras.zh: 所以我的方法是：这种语言到底在做什么？我们如何查看模型生成的语言，它是如何生成该语言的？所有这些都是人类的优化，这是某人对这些模型将产生的语言类型、它如何到达那里、它因产生、说和做而获得什么奖励的决定。因此，我想更多地关注——更少地将这些视为人工智能，并尝试将其更多地集中在人工语言上，即这种语言正在对我们做一些事情，影响我们，但也在世界上发挥作用。那么我们如何理解这一点，以及如何理解如何通过这种语言来引导这些内容？

paras.en: Feltman: Could you tell us a little bit more about that, you know, in terms of what you would like to see from these technology companies in the future to steward good AI?
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：您能告诉我们更多有关这一点的信息吗？您希望这些科技公司未来能够提供哪些服务来管理良好的人工智能？

paras.en: Salvaggio: I would say probably the most important thing for thinking about the way this particular technology is developed is really to think through where accountability can be found. When we are talking about models as if they are happening to the companies that are building them, and we hear this a lot in the rhetoric, we hear that they are grown, not built, which really kind of only refers to, sort of, the scaling of the training data. Getting more and more training data makes them bigger. But there is a building side of this, too, which is to say that they are making decisions about what exactly these things are doing. Whether they stop was a classic example of OpenAI and this incident, right? Whether they coordinate, that’s a human decision.
paras.zh: Salvaggio：我想说，思考这种特定技术的开发方式最重要的事情可能是真正思考在哪里可以找到问责制。当我们谈论模型时，就好像它们正在构建它们的公司身上一样，我们在言辞中经常听到这样的说法，我们听说它们是成长的，而不是构建的，这实际上只是指训练数据的扩展。获得越来越多的训练数据会让它们变得更大。但这也有建设的一面，也就是说，他们正在就这些东西到底在做什么做出决定。他们是否停止是OpenAI和这次事件的一个经典例子，对吗？它们是否协调，这是人类的决定。

paras.en: When you have so much that is unpredictable—and so, as you say, I’m not dismissing that there are real concerns about the unpredictability here. But when you know that something is unpredictable, I think we have, still, a responsibility to manage the kind of scope and the boundaries of where that unpredictability might lead.
paras.zh: 当你有这么多不可预测的事情时——所以，正如你所说，我并不否认人们对这里的不可预测性存在真正的担忧。但是，当你知道某些事情是不可预测的时，我认为我们仍然有责任管理这种不可预测性可能导致的范围和边界。

paras.en: And so what I wanna see is more accountability, saying, “Well, if you design a model that does something that you should’ve anticipated that it could be unpredictable,” and I know from my experience that these models are unpredictable. I work with very tiny versions of them, all the time, and they’re doing weird stuff, and I know that, so clearly these companies know that, and they can build better safeguards, guardrails, whatever you wanna call them, to make sure that unpredictability doesn’t have real-world consequences.
paras.zh: 所以我想看到的是更多的责任感，说，“好吧，如果你设计的模型做了一些你应该预料到的事情，它可能是不可预测的，”从我的经验中我知道这些模型是不可预测的。我一直在和他们的非常小的版本一起工作，他们在做奇怪的事情，我知道，这些公司很清楚地知道这一点，他们可以建立更好的保障措施、护栏，无论你怎么称呼它们，以确保不可预测性不会对现实世界产生影响。

paras.en: Feltman: Absolutely. Well, thank you so much for coming on to chat about this. It’s been super interesting.
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：当然。嗯，非常感谢您抽空来讨论这个问题。这非常有趣。

paras.en: Feltman: That’s all for today’s episode. We’ll be back on Friday to talk to a doctor who’s developed and tested a new pain-relief method for an infamously uncomfy procedure: IUD insertion.
paras.zh: 费尔特曼：这就是今天这一集的全部内容。我们将于周五回来与一位医生交谈，他开发并测试了一种新的止痛方法，用于治疗一种臭名昭著的不舒服的手术：宫内节育器插入。

paras.en: For Scientific American, this is Rachel Feltman. See you next time!
paras.zh: 《科学美国人》的这位人物是雷切尔·费尔特曼 (Rachel Feltman)。下次见！

articles.title: Scientists unlock the longevity secrets of 194-year-old Jonathan the giant tortoise

paras.en: Jonathan, an Aldabra giant tortoise on the South Atlantic island of Saint Helena, appears fully grown in a photograph researchers say was taken around 1882. That means he’s survived to at least 194 years old, about a century past his species’ usual upper limit. In a new Science Advances study, scientists read his DNA to try and figure out why.
paras.zh: 乔纳森是南大西洋圣赫勒拿岛上的一只亚达伯拉巨龟，研究人员称其拍摄于 1882 年左右，照片中的它看起来已经完全长大了。这意味着它至少活到了 194 岁，比该物种通常的上限高了大约一个世纪。在一项新的《科学进展》研究中，科学家们读取了他的 DNA，试图找出原因。

paras.en: To get the tortoise’s DNA material, Jonathan’s veterinarian Joe Hollins pretended to feed him, wedged his mouth open with a hard glove and scraped cells from inside his cheek. “It was quite tricky and dangerous,” says study co-author Stephen Clark, a researcher at the Kallel Foundation, a longevity nonprofit in Nashville.
paras.zh: 为了获取乌龟的 DNA 材料，乔纳森的兽医乔·霍林斯 (Joe Hollins) 假装喂它，用硬手套撬开它的嘴，刮掉它脸颊内部的细胞。 “这是相当棘手和危险的，”该研究的合著者、纳什维尔长寿非营利组织卡勒尔基金会的研究员斯蒂芬·克拉克说。

paras.en: But it was worth the maneuver: the researchers found that, compared with other Aldabra tortoises, Jonathan has unique variants in 287 genes, some involved in DNA repair. The surprise finding, Clark explains, came from chemical tags on DNA called methyl groups that help switch genes on and off. With age and without constant maintenance, these tags drift. Young organisms tend to have consistent tags from cell to cell, so the switch will flip reliably. Over time, the tags fall off or attach chaotically, meaning tags are inconsistent between cells and genes start turning on unpredictably. Scientists measure this disorder as entropy. “If I had to define what aging is, it’s increasing entropy,” Clark says. The overall entropy in Jonathan’s tags was higher than in tortoises aged 12 and 90, as expected. But they were not higher everywhere.
paras.zh: 但这是值得的：研究人员发现，与其他亚达伯拉象龟相比，乔纳森有 287 个基因的独特变异，其中一些与 DNA 修复有关。克拉克解释说，这一令人惊讶的发现来自于 DNA 上称为甲基的化学标签，这些标签有助于打开和关闭基因。随着时间的推移，如果没有持续维护，这些标签就会发生漂移。年轻的生物体往往在细胞之间具有一致的标签，因此开关会可靠地翻转。随着时间的推移，标签脱落或混乱地附着，这意味着细胞之间的标签不一致，基因开始不可预测地开启。科学家用熵来衡量这种紊乱。 “如果我必须定义什么是衰老，那就是熵增加，”克拉克说。正如预期的那样，乔纳森标签中的整体熵高于 12 岁和 90 岁的乌龟。但并不是所有地方的水平都更高。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: In 272 of Jonathan’s genes, many tied to the cells’ power-generating mitochondria, the switches’ chemical tags stayed as orderly as in a youngster. Because keeping order takes energy, which mitochondria supply, Clark suspects part of Jonathan’s longevity secret might be a feedback loop. “Mitochondria that make energy are being kept pristine, so they keep making energy that keeps them pristine,” he says.
paras.zh: 乔纳森的 272 个基因（其中许多与细胞的发电线粒体有关）中的开关化学标签保持着与年轻人一样的有序。由于维持秩序需要能量，而能量由线粒体提供，因此克拉克怀疑乔纳森的长寿秘诀部分可能是反馈循环。 “产生能量的线粒体保持着原始状态，因此它们不断产生能量，保持原始状态，”他说。

paras.en: “The authors identify new candidate genes associated with longevity,” says João Pedro de Magalhães, a comparative genomics researcher at the University of Birmingham in England, who was not involved in the study. “In the long term, perhaps we may find ways in which this knowledge could be applied to improve human health.” First, though, Clark and his colleagues have to make sure they’ve got their candidate genes right.
paras.zh: “作者确定了与长寿相关的新候选基因，”英国伯明翰大学比较基因组学研究员 João Pedro de Magalhães 说，他没有参与这项研究。 “从长远来看，也许我们可以找到应用这些知识来改善人类健康的方法。”不过，克拉克和他的同事首先必须确保他们的候选基因是正确的。

paras.en: Cheek cells yield shorter, bacteria-contaminated genetic material, so gaps in Jonathan’s genome had to be filled in using a younger tortoise’s DNA. “The result is a Frankenstein sequence, roughly 95 percent Jonathan,” Clark says. If any of Jonathan’s unique variants were hiding in the borrowed stretches, he explains, they would have been missed. This problem, Clark argues, could have been solved by instead drawing a blood sample from the tortoise, but Saint Helena’s officials forbade it.
paras.zh: 颊细胞产生较短的、被细菌污染的遗传物质，因此乔纳森的基因组中的空白必须使用年轻乌龟的 DNA 来填补。 “结果是一个弗兰肯斯坦序列，大约 95% 是乔纳森，”克拉克说。他解释说，如果乔纳森的任何独特变体隐藏在借来的延伸中，它们就会被错过。克拉克认为，这个问题本来可以通过从乌龟身上抽取血样来解决，但圣赫勒拿岛的官员禁止这样做。

paras.en: “Drawing blood from a tortoise may be tricky and in itself dangerous for an elderly individual,” says Joanna Bagniewska, a zoologist at the University of Oxford, who was not involved in the study. “Considering Jonathan’s iconic status on Saint Helena, were anything to happen to the tortoise, it could lead to resentment toward researchers in general.”
paras.zh: 牛津大学动物学家乔安娜·巴格涅夫斯卡（Joanna Bagniewska）没有参与这项研究，她说：“从乌龟身上抽血可能很棘手，而且对于老年人来说本身就是危险的。” “考虑到乔纳森在圣赫勒拿岛的标志性地位，如果这只乌龟发生任何事情，可能会导致一般研究人员的不满。”

paras.en: Clark notes that researchers can’t yet say whether unusual tidiness in Jonathan’s genes keeps him alive or is a by-product of something else entirely. “We can’t really put a flagpole in something and say, ‘Oh, this is why he lived this long,’” he says. “This work is just the first step.”
paras.zh: 克拉克指出，研究人员还不能确定乔纳森基因中异常的整齐性是否让他得以生存，或者完全是其他原因的副产品。 “我们不能真的把旗杆放在某物上并说，‘哦，这就是他活这么久的原因，’”他说。 “这项工作只是第一步。”

articles.title: A suspected case of pneumonic plague is raising fears of an outbreak. Should you be worried?

paras.en: World health experts are closely following a potential case of pneumonic plague—the most deadly form of the disease. Earlier this week Russian officials reported that an employee at a laboratory at an infectious disease research institute in Irkutsk Oblast in Siberia, had contracted pneumonia and died. The World Health Organization (WHO) is now working closely with the country’s health authorities to monitor and track the incident. But fears over whether the disease could spread are proliferating as officials move to isolate the woman’s contacts and bolster outbreak prevention efforts at local hospitals.
paras.zh: 世界卫生专家正在密切关注一例潜在的肺鼠疫病例——这种疾病最致命的形式。本周早些时候，俄罗斯官员报告称，西伯利亚伊尔库茨克州一家传染病研究所实验室的一名员工感染肺炎并死亡。世界卫生组织（WHO）目前正在与该国卫生当局密切合作，以监测和追踪这一事件。但随着官员们采取行动隔离该妇女的接触者并加强当地医院的疫情预防工作，人们对这种疾病是否会传播的担忧正在加剧。

paras.en: At a press conference on Tuesday, WHO spokesperson Christian Lindmeier said that the woman’s cause of death was still unconfirmed and that lab testing was in progress. But “according to the test results, no pathogens of dangerous infectious diseases were detected among any of the contacts” of the woman, Lindmeier told reporters.
paras.zh: 世卫组织发言人克里斯蒂安·林德梅尔在周二的新闻发布会上表示，该妇女的死因尚未得到证实，实验室检测正在进行中。但林德迈尔告诉记者，“根据检测结果，在该女子的任何接触者中均未检测到危险传染病的病原体”。

paras.en: Here’s what you need to know about the potential outbreak and what it means.
paras.zh: 以下是您需要了解的有关潜在爆发及其含义的信息。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: What people commonly refer to as “plague” is an infectious disease caused by the bacterium Yersinia pestis. It is best known for causing the Black Death, which killed tens of millions of people across Europe, as well as Asia and North Africa, in the 1300s.
paras.zh: 人们通常所说的“鼠疫”是由鼠疫杆菌引起的传染病。它因引发黑死病而闻名，黑死病在 1300 年代导致欧洲、亚洲和北非数千万人死亡。

paras.en: There are three main forms of plague—bubonic plague, septicemic plague and pneumonic plague. They are all caused by the same bacterium but differ in how the pathogen enters the body and where the infection manifests. Bubonic plague, which is the most common form, is usually spread by the bites of infected fleas or direct contact with infected animals. It affects the lymph nodes, where it causes swollen and painful blue-black sores, called buboes. Septicemic plague is spread in similar ways, but it affects the bloodstream and can lead to a systemic infection. Finally, pneumonic plague occurs when the bacterium infects the lungs—typically through inhalation of infectious droplets rather than flea bites.
paras.zh: 鼠疫有三种主要形式：腺鼠疫、败血性鼠疫和肺鼠疫。它们都是由同一种细菌引起的，但病原体进入体内的方式和感染表现的部位有所不同。腺鼠疫是最常见的形式，通常通过受感染跳蚤叮咬或直接接触受感染动物传播。它影响淋巴结，导致肿胀、疼痛的蓝黑色疮，称为腹股沟淋巴结炎。败血性鼠疫以类似的方式传播，但它会影响血液并可能导致全身感染。最后，当细菌感染肺部时，就会发生肺鼠疫——通常是通过吸入传染性飞沫而不是跳蚤叮咬。

paras.en: The level of danger depends on what kind of plague is encountered and whether antibiotics are available. The 14th-century Black Death was particularly deadly because there were no antibiotics at the time and people lived in crowded cities, often with poor sanitation.
paras.zh: 危险程度取决于遇到的鼠疫类型以及是否有抗生素可用。 14 世纪的黑死病尤其致命，因为当时没有抗生素，而且人们生活在拥挤的城市，而且卫生条件往往很差。

paras.en: Today antibiotics are very effective against plague when they are used early in the infection. But even so, Y. pestis is still deadly. Once the disease reaches the bloodstream or lungs, which seems to be potentially what happened in the Russian case, it can quickly turn fatal.
paras.zh: 如今，在感染早期使用抗生素对于对抗鼠疫非常有效。但即便如此，鼠疫耶尔森氏菌仍然是致命的。一旦疾病到达血液或肺部（俄罗斯病例似乎可能发生这种情况），它可能很快就会致命。

paras.en: “What we do worry about the most is pneumonic plague,” says Richard Martinello, a professor of infectious disease and pediatrics at the Yale School of Medicine. “People who are sick with pneumonia due to Y. pestis can produce droplets that contain the bacteria, and we know that they could be highly contagious and readily spread the Y. pestis to other people.”
paras.zh: “我们最担心的是肺鼠疫，”耶鲁大学医学院传染病和儿科教授理查德·马蒂内洛说。 “患有鼠疫耶尔森氏菌肺炎的人会产生含有细菌的飞沫，我们知道它们可能具有高度传染性，很容易将鼠疫耶尔森氏菌传播给其他人。”

paras.en: In the case of pneumonic plague, antibiotics have to be given very early on in the infection for them to do any good, Martinello says. If they are given too late, they won’t stop the infection. Pneumonic plague’s mortality rate is almost 100 percent if untreated, but chances of survival are higher with rapid treatment.
paras.zh: 马蒂内洛说，就肺鼠疫而言，必须在感染早期就给予抗生素才能发挥作用。如果注射得太晚，就无法阻止感染。如果不治疗，肺鼠疫的死亡率几乎是 100%，但如果快速治疗，生存机会会更高。

paras.en: Pneumonic plague can spread between people through respiratory droplets, and it can occur anywhere the plague bacteria exist. Martinello notes a recent report from the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention from earlier this month that describes a fatal case of pneumonic plague that occurred in Coconino County, Arizona, in July 2025. It was Arizona’s first pneumonic plague death since 2007.
paras.zh: 肺鼠疫可以通过呼吸道飞沫在人与人之间传播，并且可以发生在鼠疫细菌存在的任何地方。马蒂内洛指出，美国疾病控制和预防中心本月早些时候发布的一份最新报告描述了 2025 年 7 月在亚利桑那州科科尼诺县发生的一例肺鼠疫死亡病例。这是亚利桑那州自 2007 年以来首例肺鼠疫死亡病例。

paras.en: But based on the information that is available right now about a single suspected case in Russia, Martinello is less concerned about global spread.
paras.zh: 但根据目前掌握的有关俄罗斯一例疑似病例的信息，马蒂内洛不太担心全球传播。

paras.en: “It’s a concerning time because people are more indoors and they’re exposed to more people and thus exposed to their infectious respiratory droplets,” Martinello says. Still, he adds, “I don’t think we are going to see a great deal of spread by this.”
paras.zh: 马蒂内洛说：“这是一个令人担忧的时期，因为人们更多地呆在室内，接触到更多的人，从而接触到传染性呼吸道飞沫。”不过，他补充道，“我认为我们不会看到这种病毒大量传播。”
