paras.en: “If there was substantial and rapid growth, that would make me worried that there may be something else involved or something special about this strain of Yersinia pestis causing the infection—if it is, in fact, Yersinia pestis,” Martinello notes.
paras.zh: “如果出现大量且快速的增长，那会让我担心这种鼠疫耶尔森氏菌菌株可能有其他原因或某些特殊因素导致感染——如果它实际上是鼠疫耶尔森氏菌的话，”马蒂内洛指出。

paras.en: The WHO has been closely tracking the incident, and the White House is also monitoring the situation, according to Axios.
paras.zh: 据Axios称，世界卫生组织一直在密切跟踪这一事件，白宫也在监测事态发展。

paras.en: “Because this is so contagious and so deadly..., it really relies on that effective public health effort in a timely manner,” Martinello says.
paras.zh: “因为这种病毒具有传染性和致命性......，它确实依赖于及时有效的公共卫生努力，”马蒂内洛说。

articles.title: A ‘phoenix’ planet was born from the ashes of its dead star
articles.author: Lisa Grossman

paras.en: A dead star’s wreckage may be the birthplace of a new planet.
paras.zh: 一颗死亡恒星的残骸可能是一颗新行星的诞生地。

paras.en: The existence of second-generation planets was predicted theoretically more than 15 years ago. But this “phoenix” world, if confirmed, would be the first actually spotted, scientists report October 5 in Nature Astronomy.
paras.zh: 15 多年前，理论上就预测了第二代行星的存在。但科学家 10 月 5 日在《自然天文学》杂志上报道称，这个“凤凰”世界如果得到证实，将是第一个真正被发现的世界。

paras.en: “A phoenix is reborn from the ashes of its predecessor, and this planet is formed from the ashes of the star,” says astronomer Jamie Williams, of the University of Warwick in Coventry, England.
paras.zh: 英国考文垂华威大学的天文学家杰米·威廉姆斯说：“凤凰从其前身的灰烬中重生，而这颗行星是由恒星的灰烬形成的。”

paras.en: The finding suggests planetary systems can have a second life even after their stars die.
paras.zh: 这一发现表明，即使恒星死亡后，行星系统也可以拥有第二次生命。

paras.en: Before this discovery, this planet formation process has been “more like a hypothesis, more like speculation,” says planetary scientist Zifan Lin of Washington University in St. Louis, who was not involved in the new work. “This is the first time we’ve seen evidence for that process.”
paras.zh: 没有参与这项新工作的圣路易斯华盛顿大学行星科学家林子凡说，在这一发现之前，这个行星的形成过程“更像是一个假设，更像是猜测”。 “这是我们第一次看到该过程的证据。”

paras.en: Williams and colleagues found signs of the planet in the atmosphere of a white dwarf called HS 0209+0832. White dwarfs are the small, dense cores left behind after low-mass stars — like our sun — puff up into red giant stars at the end of their lives, ultimately blowing all the outer material away.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯和同事在一颗名为 HS 0209+0832 的白矮星的大气层中发现了这颗行星的迹象。白矮星是低质量恒星（比如我们的太阳）在生命结束时膨胀成红巨星后留下的小而致密的核心，最终将所有外部物质吹走。

paras.en: These stellar corpses are so dense that most chemical elements sink into their centers, leaving them with pristine atmospheres composed of almost entirely hydrogen and helium. But astronomers have found that between a quarter and half of these stars are “polluted” with elements like silicon and iron, which are found in rock.
paras.zh: 这些恒星尸体的密度如此之大，以至于大多数化学元素都会沉入它们的中心，从而使它们拥有几乎完全由氢和氦组成的原始大气。但天文学家发现，这些恒星中有四分之一到一半受到岩石中硅和铁等元素的“污染”。

paras.en: These elements probably come from shattered planets that the star devoured as it expanded. “They can be probes into the interiors of planets,” Lin says. Astronomers have also found whole planets that seem to have survived their stars’ demise and still orbit the remaining white dwarf. Ironically, some astronomers think these dead stars could be prime hunting grounds for signs of extraterrestrial life.
paras.zh: 这些元素可能来自恒星膨胀时吞噬的破碎行星。 “它们可以探测行星的内部，”林说。天文学家还发现了整颗行星似乎在恒星消亡后幸存下来，并且仍然绕着剩余的白矮星运行。具有讽刺意味的是，一些天文学家认为这些死亡恒星可能是寻找外星生命迹象的主要狩猎场。

paras.en: HS 0209+0832 was a known weirdo. When the Hubble Space Telescope observed it in 1999, astronomers could tell that the white dwarf contained a mysterious mix of chemicals, but they couldn’t identify them. Since then, there have been more detailed studies of how certain atoms would show up in stellar atmospheres, Williams says.
paras.zh: HS 0209+0832 是一个众所周知的怪人。当哈勃太空望远镜在 1999 年观测它时，天文学家可以看出这颗白矮星含有一种神秘的化学物质混合物，但他们无法识别它们。威廉姆斯说，从那时起，人们对某些原子如何在恒星大气中出现进行了更详细的研究。

paras.en: Reanalyzing those observations showed that the white dwarf contains only trace amounts of silicon and almost no iron, Williams and colleagues found. But it does include a ridiculous amount of niobium. This hard, silvery metal, used in jewelry, rocket systems and superconductors, is rare on Earth and had never been seen in a white dwarf.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯和同事发现，重新分析这些观测结果表明，白矮星仅含有微量的硅，几乎不含铁。但它确实含有大量的铌。这种坚硬的银色金属用于珠宝、火箭系统和超导体，在地球上很罕见，而且从未在白矮星中见过。

paras.en: “We’ve never observed anything in the universe that’s this niobium-rich before,” Williams says. “We were quite confused at first.”
paras.zh: “我们以前从未在宇宙中观察到任何富含铌的物质，”威廉姆斯说。 “一开始我们很困惑。”

paras.en: A clue to how it got there came from the element’s origins. Niobium forms in the slow neutron-capture process, or s-process, which mostly occurs in certain red giant stars as they shed their atmospheres and die. Iron nuclei transform into heavier elements in a series of accretion and decay that can take thousands of years.
paras.zh: 关于它是如何到达那里的线索来自该元素的起源。铌是在缓慢的中子俘获过程（即 s 过程）中形成的，该过程主要发生在某些红巨星脱离大气层并死亡时。铁核通过一系列吸积和衰变转变为较重的元素，这可能需要数千年的时间。

paras.en: Material ejected from a dying star could have coalesced into a new planet full of s-process elements, Williams says. Then the resulting white dwarf could slowly sip on the new planet’s atmosphere, leaving a fresh coat of niobium and other s-process elements on the white dwarf’s face.
paras.zh: 威廉姆斯说，从垂死恒星中喷出的物质可能会凝聚成一颗充满s过程元素的新行星。然后产生的白矮星可以慢慢地吸收新行星的大气层，在白矮星的表面留下一层新鲜的铌和其他s过程元素。

paras.en: To support this idea, the team looked at observations of HS 0209+0832 taken with the TESS space telescope, which hunts exoplanets by observing small changes in the light of their stars as planets orbit. The white dwarf’s brightness changes with a period of about 4.4 days, the team found. That’s too slow to be related to the white dwarf’s own rotation.
paras.zh: 为了支持这个想法，研究小组研究了 TESS 太空望远镜对 HS 0209+0832 的观测结果，该望远镜通过观察行星绕轨道运行时恒星光线的微小变化来寻找系外行星。研究小组发现，这颗白矮星的亮度会以大约 4.4 天的周期发生变化。这太慢了，与白矮星自身的自转无关。

paras.en: But it could be explained by a gas giant planet orbiting very close to the star, about 4 percent the distance from the Earth to the sun or 6 million kilometers. Williams imagines it as a silvery version of Jupiter.
paras.zh: 但这可以用一颗气态巨行星的轨道距离恒星非常近来解释，大约是地球到太阳距离的 4%，即 600 万公里。威廉姆斯将其想象为银色版本的木星。

paras.en: “We’re not really sure, if it’s not a planet, what it is,” he says. “A planet is the most reasonable explanation.”
paras.zh: “我们不太确定，如果它不是行星，那么它是什么，”他说。 “行星是最合理的解释。”

paras.en: Our sun will one day meet the same fate as HS 0209+0832’s predecessor. We don’t know enough about second-generation planets yet to say whether our solar system could end up with one after the sun dies, Williams says. “But I think it’s definitely possible.”
paras.zh: 我们的太阳总有一天会遭遇与 HS 0209+0832 的前身相同的命运。威廉姆斯说，我们对第二代行星的了解还不够，还无法确定太阳系是否会在太阳死亡后出现一颗行星。 “但我认为这绝对是可能的。”

articles.title: Scientists may have seen dark matter. If they did, what exactly is it?
articles.author: Emily Conover

paras.en: If a recent hint of dark matter is real, it would rewrite physics. Scientists are already trying to read the outline of that new story’s plot. And that’s reignited interest in certain theories, including a long-beloved but increasingly sidelined concept called supersymmetry.
paras.zh: 如果最近关于暗物质的暗示是真实的，它将改写物理学。科学家们已经在尝试解读这个新故事情节的轮廓。这重新点燃了人们对某些理论的兴趣，其中包括一个长期受人们喜爱但日益被边缘化的概念，即超对称性。

paras.en: Dark matter is imperceptibly everywhere, an unidentified type of particle pervading the universe but evident based only on its gravitational effects on galaxies and other cosmic entities. On September 1, scientists with the LUX-ZEPLIN, or LZ, collaboration announced they’d seen a signal in their detector that could have been caused by a single particle of dark matter — though it could still be just a blip caused by known physics processes.
paras.zh: 暗物质无处不在，是一种无法识别的粒子，遍布宇宙，但仅根据其对星系和其他宇宙实体的引力效应而显而易见。 9 月 1 日，LUX-ZEPLIN（或 LZ）合作的科学家们宣布，他们在探测器中看到了一个信号，该信号可能是由单个暗物质粒子引起的，尽管它仍然可能只是由已知物理过程引起的一个信号。

paras.en: In the weeks since the detection, dozens of papers have been posted on arXiv.org purporting to explain what LZ saw. Much interest has focused on a theorized type of particle called a higgsino. If the idea is correct, it would be big. “If we discover it, it would be the first discovery of supersymmetry,” says theoretical physicist Harikrishnan Ramani of the University of Delaware in Newark.
paras.zh: 自检测以来的几周内，arXiv.org 上已发布数十篇论文，旨在解释 LZ 所看到的情况。许多兴趣集中在一种称为希格斯诺的理论粒子类型上。如果这个想法是正确的，那就很大了。 “如果我们发现它，这将是超对称性的首次发现，”纽瓦克特拉华大学的理论物理学家哈里克里希南·拉马尼 (Harikrishnan Ramani) 说。

paras.en: Supersymmetry proposes that for each known particle, there exists a heavier counterpart called a superpartner. It’s an idea that could solve multiple physics puzzles at once, so it has attracted a devoted following of physicists.
paras.zh: 超对称性提出，对于每个已知粒子，都存在一个更重的对应粒子，称为超级伙伴。这是一个可以同时解决多个物理难题的想法，因此吸引了物理学家的忠实追随者。

paras.en: One of these hypothetical superpartners, such as the higgsino, could be dark matter. The higgsino is the superpartner of the Higgs boson — a particle discovered in 2012 that explains the origin of mass. “If you asked people in the year 2000, ‘What’s your favorite dark matter candidate?’ probably a lot of people would already have said the higgsino then,” says theoretical physicist Tracy Slatyer of MIT.
paras.zh: 这些假设的超级伙伴之一，例如希格斯诺，可能是暗物质。希格斯核子是希格斯玻色子的超级伙伴，希格斯玻色子是 2012 年发现的一种粒子，可以解释质量的起源。 “如果你在 2000 年问人们，‘你最喜欢的暗物质候选者是什么？’当时可能很多人都会说希格斯诺，”麻省理工学院的理论物理学家 Tracy Slatyer 说道。

paras.en: In recent years, supersymmetry’s popularity has waned, as particle colliders failed to find evidence for it. But as an explanation for LZ’s dark matter hint, a higgsino seems plausible — at least at first glance. “It comes pretty close to working,” Slatyer says.
paras.zh: 近年来，超对称性的受欢迎程度有所下降，因为粒子对撞机未能找到它的证据。但作为对 LZ 暗物质暗示的解释，希格斯诺似乎是合理的——至少乍一看是这样。 “这已经非常接近工作了，”斯拉蒂尔说。

paras.en: The LZ detector, located at the Sanford Underground Research Facility in Lead, S.D., consists of a large tank of liquid xenon. The detector searches for dark matter speeding through the xenon, crashing into it and sending a xenon atomic nucleus zinging away. That’s expected to be a rare event, since dark matter interacts very weakly with normal matter. In the event LZ found, the nucleus recoiled with particularly high energy. Most types of dark matter would produce low-energy recoils in addition to high-energy ones. But LZ didn’t see any low-energy recoils.
paras.zh: LZ 探测器位于南达科他州利德市的桑福德地下研究设施，由一个大型液氙罐组成。探测器寻找快速穿过氙气的暗物质，撞击氙气原子核并发出轰鸣声。预计这将是一个罕见的事件，因为暗物质与正常物质的相互作用非常微弱。 LZ发现的事件中，原子核以特别高的能量反冲。大多数类型的暗物质除了高能反冲之外还会产生低能反冲。但LZ没有看到任何低能后坐力。

paras.en: If dark matter were a higgsino, that could explain the absence of low-energy events. The higgsino differs from typical dark matter candidates in that it would have two different masses. A collision would happen only if there’s enough energy to bump the higgsino from the lighter to the heavier mass state. That means lower-energy nuclear recoils wouldn’t happen.
paras.zh: 如果暗物质是希格西诺，那就可以解释低能事件的缺失。希格斯诺与典型暗物质候选者的不同之处在于它有两个不同的质量。只有当有足够的能量将希格西诺从较轻的质量状态碰撞到较重的质量状态时，才会发生碰撞。这意味着低能核反冲不会发生。

paras.en: Within a day of LZ’s announcement, several papers on the arXiv put forth the higgsino possibility. “I got pretty excited,” says theoretical physicist Katherine Freese of the University of Texas at Austin, a coauthor of one such paper, which was submitted September 1. “First paper I ever wrote in 24 hours.”
paras.zh: LZ 宣布这一消息的一天之内，arXiv 上的几篇论文就提出了 higgsino 的可能性。 “我非常兴奋，”德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校的理论物理学家凯瑟琳·弗里斯 (Katherine Freese) 说道，她是一篇此类论文的合著者，该论文于 9 月 1 日提交。“这是我在 24 小时内写出的第一篇论文。”

paras.en: But further investigation made the higgsino explanation seem less plausible. For example, if higgsinos exist, they would interact in the sun and get trapped there due to its gravitational pull. There, according to the concepts of supersymmetry, they would annihilate one another and produce high-energy particles called neutrinos. Those neutrinos should have been observed by a neutrino detector located at the South Pole, called IceCube, Ramani and a colleague reported September 2 at arXiv.org. But no such neutrinos have been seen.
paras.zh: 但进一步的调查使 higgsino 的解释似乎不太可信。例如，如果希格斯诺子存在，它们会在太阳中相互作用，并由于太阳的引力而被困在那里。在那里，根据超对称的概念，它们会相互湮灭并产生称为中微子的高能粒子。拉马尼和一位同事于 9 月 2 日在 arXiv.org 上报道称，这些中微子应该是由位于南极的中微子探测器 IceCube 观测到的。但还没有看到这样的中微子。

paras.en: And there’s another potential issue. Slatyer and colleagues noticed a plot in an appendix to LZ’s paper that looks at even higher energies. If LZ saw one higgsino at the energy they reported, they’d expect to see even more at these higher energies, the team reported September 3. But LZ didn’t report anything that looked like dark matter at those energies. The LZ detector wasn’t calibrated for those energies, says LZ spokesperson Rick Gaitskell, a physicist at Brown University in Providence, R.I. “We didn’t make any formal claims about detection or even nondetection in that event region,” Gaitskell wrote in a text message. But, if the data are taken seriously, that makes LZ’s event even more difficult to explain with a higgsino.
paras.zh: 还有另一个潜在的问题。 Slatyer 和同事注意到 LZ 论文附录中的一个图表研究了更高的能量。该团队于 9 月 3 日报道称，如果 LZ 在他们报告的能量下看到了一个希格斯诺，他们预计会在这些更高的能量下看到更多的希格斯诺。但 LZ 没有报告任何在这些能量下看起来像暗物质的东西。 LZ 发言人、罗德岛州普罗维登斯布朗大学物理学家 Rick Gaitskell 表示，LZ 探测器并未针对这些能量进行校准。“我们没有就该事件区域的探测甚至未探测到做出任何正式声明，”Gaitskell 在一条短信中写道。但是，如果认真对待这些数据，那么 LZ 的事件就更难用 higgsino 来解释了。

paras.en: Considering all these factors makes the higgsino idea a bit of a stretch. But there’s still a little wiggle room. One possibility is that the higgsino’s mass differs from what theoretical physicists expect it to be, about 1,000 times a proton’s mass. That large mass is chosen to allow higgsinos to explain the amount of dark matter seen in the universe today. So changing it complicates the picture, but could make it align better with what LZ saw.
paras.zh: 考虑到所有这些因素，higgsino 的想法有点牵强。但仍有一点回旋余地。一种可能性是希格斯诺的质量与理论物理学家的预期不同，约为质子质量的 1000 倍。选择如此大的质量是为了让希格西诺能够解释当今宇宙中所看到的暗物质的数量。所以改变它会让图片变得复杂，但可以让它更好地符合LZ所看到的。

paras.en: Additional wiggle room comes from the possible speeds of the dark matter particles in the Milky Way. The particles might reach higher velocities than typically assumed, and that could make the data easier to explain. For a faster higgsino to have shown up in LZ, it would require a larger difference in the two masses of the particle. The resulting bigger energy difference means higgsinos have fewer opportunities to produce neutrinos in the sun, explaining why neutrino experiments haven’t seen those particles.
paras.zh: 额外的回旋空间来自银河系中暗物质粒子的可能速度。粒子可能达到比通常假设的更高的速度，这可以使数据更容易解释。为了在 LZ 中出现更快的希格斯诺，粒子的两个质量之间需要有更大的差异。由此产生的更大的能量差异意味着希格斯中子在太阳中产生中微子的机会更少，这解释了为什么中微子实验没有看到这些粒子。

paras.en: By playing around with those factors, it’s still possible to make the higgsino explanation work, Freese says. Higgsinos with around 2,000 times a proton’s mass could do the trick, Freese and a coauthor report in an October 2 arXiv paper. “Big picture: We love [the] higgsino, and what we’re doing now is putting in the details that we think are important,” she says.
paras.zh: 弗里斯说，通过研究这些因素，希格斯诺的解释仍然有可能成立。 Freese 和一位合著者在 10 月 2 日的 arXiv 论文中报告称，质量约为质子 2,000 倍的希格斯诺子可以做到这一点。 “大局观：我们喜欢 higgsino，我们现在正在做的是加入我们认为重要的细节，”她说。

paras.en: But, if it’s not the higgsino, “maybe it’s some other particle with the same basic features,” says theoretical physicist Dan Hooper of the University of Wisconsin–Madison. Such particles wouldn’t be subject to the constraints supersymmetry imposes. For example, if the particles collect in the sun, they wouldn’t necessarily create neutrinos, so it doesn’t matter that IceCube doesn’t see them. Hooper and colleagues investigated the possibilities in a paper submitted September 10 to arXiv.org. And in a September 22 arXiv paper, Hooper and colleagues proposed a version of a different class of dark matter particle that could explain two puzzles in one: LZ’s result and mysterious gamma rays, high-energy light, seen coming from the center of the Milky Way.
paras.zh: 但是，如果它不是希格斯诺，“也许它是具有相同基本特征的其他粒子，”威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校的理论物理学家丹·胡珀说。这样的粒子不会受到超对称性施加的约束。例如，如果粒子在阳光下聚集，它们不一定会产生中微子，所以 IceCube 看不见它们并不重要。 Hooper 和同事在 9 月 10 日提交给 arXiv.org 的一篇论文中研究了这种可能性。在 9 月 22 日的 arXiv 论文中，胡珀和同事提出了一种不同类别的暗物质粒子的版本，它可以同时解释两个谜题：LZ 的结果和神秘的伽马射线，即来自银河系中心的高能光。

paras.en: Other physicists are looking at entirely different ideas, involving hypothesized types of particles such as dark photons. Meanwhile, scientists are eagerly awaiting new results from LZ, to see if additional data hide similar events.
paras.zh: 其他物理学家正在研究完全不同的想法，涉及假设的粒子类型，例如暗光子。与此同时，科学家们正在热切地等待 LZ 的新结果，看看更多的数据是否隐藏了类似的事件。

paras.en: Other dark matter experiments, such as XENONnT at Gran Sasso National Laboratory in Italy, are also taking a look, combing through their existing data to check for high-energy events. LZ’s result “clearly requires a cross-check,” says XENONnT spokesperson Elena Aprile, a physicist at Columbia University.
paras.zh: 其他暗物质实验，例如意大利格兰萨索国家实验室的 XENONnT 实验，也在进行研究，梳理现有数据以检查高能事件。 XENONnT 发言人、哥伦比亚大学物理学家 Elena Aprile 表示，LZ 的结果“显然需要交叉检查”。

paras.en: Even if the result isn’t a slam-dunk for the higgsino — and even though this might not be dark matter at all — scientists are enjoying exploring the possibilities. “I think it’s wrong to throw tantrums over the fact that it’s not the higgsino the way we want it to be,” Ramani says. “Nature might not give us everything we want in one go.”
paras.zh: 即使结果并不是希格西诺的成功——即使这可能根本不是暗物质——科学家们也正在享受探索这种可能性的乐趣。 “我认为，因为希格斯诺不是我们想要的样子而发脾气是错误的，”拉马尼说。 “大自然可能不会一次性给我们想要的一切。”

articles.title: Gene therapy and special goggles give some blind people limited sight
articles.author: Nora Bradford

paras.en: Some blind people can now find a doorway or spot an object with the help of an experimental treatment and custom goggles.
paras.zh: 一些盲人现在可以借助实验治疗和定制护目镜找到门口或发现物体。

paras.en: Participants in a new study had blindness caused by a genetic disease called retinitis pigmentosa, which progressively kills off light-sensing cells in the retina. The treatment improved seven of 10 people’s light sensitivity, researchers report October 7 in New England Journal of Medicine. The findings build on a 2021 report that the same approach helped one blind man see and count objects.
paras.zh: 一项新研究的参与者因一种名为视网膜色素变性的遗传性疾病导致失明，这种疾病会逐渐杀死视网膜中的感光细胞。研究人员 10 月 7 日在《新英格兰医学杂志》上报告称，这种治疗改善了十分之七的人的光敏感度。这些发现建立在 2021 年的一份报告的基础上，该报告称同样的方法帮助一名盲人看到并计算物体。

paras.en: The treatment is based on optogenetics, a technique that uses genetic instructions to make cells respond to light. Rather than repair the retina’s damaged light detectors, it gives that ability to retinal ganglion cells that normally relay visual signals to the brain.
paras.zh: 该治疗基于光遗传学，这是一种利用遗传指令使细胞对光做出反应的技术。它不是修复视网膜受损的光探测器，而是赋予通常将视觉信号传递给大脑的视网膜神经节细胞这种能力。

paras.en: “This is a proof of concept that optogenetics can bring back some visual activity [and] object sensitivity,” says Botond Roska, neuroscientist at the Institute of Molecular and Clinical Ophthalmology Basel in Switzerland.
paras.zh: “这是光遗传学可以恢复一些视觉活动和物体敏感性的概念证明，”瑞士巴塞尔分子与临床眼科研究所的神经科学家 Botond Roska 说。

paras.en: Pioneering work on optogenetics snagged the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine on October 5.
paras.zh: 光遗传学的开创性工作于 10 月 5 日荣获 2026 年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖。

paras.en: Scientists have been experimenting with optogenetic therapies to rewire the eye and restore vision to people with degenerative eye diseases for more than a decade. Just as in the 2021 study, in the new work Roska and his colleagues injected genetic instructions for ChrimsonR, a light-sensitive protein derived from algae, into participants’ worse-seeing eye. The treatment made retinal ganglion cells in that eye sensitive to amber light. A camera in the custom goggles detected changes in brightness in what was in front of a study participant, and the goggles projected those changes onto the retina as pulses of amber light, activating the treated cells.
paras.zh: 十多年来，科学家们一直在试验光遗传学疗法，以重塑眼睛并恢复患有退行性眼病的人的视力。正如 2021 年的研究一样，Roska 和他的同事在新研究中将 ChrimsonR（一种源自藻类的光敏蛋白）的基因指令注入参与者视力较差的眼睛中。这种治疗使那只眼睛的视网膜神经节细胞对琥珀色的光敏感。定制护目镜中的摄像头检测到研究参与者面前的亮度变化，护目镜将这些变化以琥珀色光脉冲的形式投射到视网膜上，从而激活经过处理的细胞。

paras.en: Four of the eight study participants who completed behavioral testing after treatment were able to find a doorway or follow a line while wearing the goggles. No patient gained the ability to read visual words or see faces, but Roska and his colleagues hope to tackle that next.
paras.zh: 治疗后完成行为测试的八名研究参与者中有四人能够在戴着护目镜时找到门口或沿着路线走。没有患者获得阅读视觉文字或看到面孔的能力，但罗斯卡和他的同事希望下一步解决这个问题。

paras.en: But there’s a limitation to this work. The approach requires a working optic nerve to carry signals to the brain, says study coauthor José-Alain Sahel, an ophthalmologist at the University of Pittsburgh. It relies on cells in the retina communicating to the brain, so it cannot restore vision when that connection is damaged.
paras.zh: 但这项工作有一个局限性。该研究的合著者、匹兹堡大学眼科医生何塞·阿兰·萨赫尔 (José-Alain Sahel) 表示，这种方法需要有效的视神经将信号传递到大脑。它依赖于视网膜中的细胞与大脑进行通信，因此当该连接受损时，它无法恢复视力。

articles.title: DNA From a Human Brain Gene Has Turned Up In a Virus
articles.author: Esra Öz

paras.en: Some pieces of our DNA can copy themselves into new locations. Copies derived from one gene active in human brain cells appear to have taken that journey further: into a virus.
paras.zh: 我们 DNA 的某些片段可以将自身复制到新的位置。来自人类脑细胞中活跃的一个基因的副本似乎更进一步：进入病毒。

paras.en: Researchers found two such sequences, derived from a gene called BC200, inside molluscum contagiosum virus, which infects our skin and causes small, raised lesions.
paras.zh: 研究人员在传染性软疣病毒内发现了两个这样的序列，它们源自一种名为 BC200 的基因，这种病毒会感染我们的皮肤并引起小的、凸起的病变。

paras.en: The discovery reveals an unusual genetic double life. BC200 acquired a cellular role millions of years ago, yet retained the ability to produce copies that insert themselves elsewhere.
paras.zh: 这一发现揭示了一种不寻常的基因双重生命。 BC200 在数百万年前获得了细胞角色，但保留了产生将自身插入其他地方的副本的能力。

paras.en: A study published in Science suggests this movement has continued throughout primate evolution, contributed to differences among human genomes, and carried BC200-derived sequences across the boundary between humans and a virus.
paras.zh: 《科学》杂志上发表的一项研究表明，这种运动在整个灵长类动物的进化过程中一直持续，导致了人类基因组之间的差异，并携带 BC200 衍生的序列跨越了人类和病毒之间的界限。

paras.en: But the virus didn't simply take a gene from a brain cell, and nothing suggests it gained anything resembling brain function. What these sequences actually do inside the virus is still unknown.
paras.zh: 但这种病毒并不是简单地从脑细胞中获取基因，也没有任何迹象表明它获得了任何类似于大脑功能的东西。这些序列在病毒内部的实际作用仍然未知。

paras.en: BC200 works differently from most genes: it skips the step of coding for a protein altogether, producing a short RNA molecule instead – one that's especially abundant in neurons.
paras.zh: BC200 的工作原理与大多数基因不同：它完全跳过编码蛋白质的步骤，而是产生短 RNA 分子——这种分子在神经元中特别丰富。

paras.en: Laboratory experiments suggest this RNA helps regulate protein production. Its precise physiological role, however, remains poorly understood.
paras.zh: 实验室实验表明这种 RNA 有助于调节蛋白质的产生。然而，其确切的生理作用仍然知之甚少。

paras.en: A gene being especially active in one tissue does not mean its DNA exists only there. Most cells with a nucleus carry essentially the same genetic information. What differs is which genes they use, and how much.
paras.zh: 一个基因在一个组织中特别活跃并不意味着它的 DNA 只存在于该组织中。大多数有细胞核的细胞基本上携带相同的遗传信息。不同之处在于他们使用哪些基因以及多少。

paras.en: Calling BC200 a "brain gene" describes its activity in neurons.
paras.zh: 将 BC200 称为“脑基因”描述了它在神经元中的活动。

paras.en: Its origins lie in a transposable element, one of the mobile DNA sequences often called "jumping genes". Some make copies of themselves that enter new locations while the original stays put.
paras.zh: 它的起源在于转座元件，即通常称为“跳跃基因”的移动 DNA 序列之一。有些人会复制自己并进入新的位置，而原件则留在原地。

paras.en: A predecessor of BC200 became established in a common ancestor of monkeys and apes roughly 35 to 55 million years ago. Around 40 million years ago, it was recruited for a cellular role, apparently in regulating protein production in neurons.
paras.zh: BC200 的前身在大约 35 至 5500 万年前在猴子和猿的共同祖先中建立。大约 4000 万年前，它被招募来发挥细胞作用，显然是调节神经元中蛋白质的产生。

paras.en: Such recruitment typically accompanies a loss of mobility. BC200 appears to have retained both abilities.
paras.zh: 这种招募通常伴随着流动性的丧失。 BC200 似乎保留了这两种能力。

paras.en: "Somehow evolution hasn't been able to untangle these two things," Cedric Feschotte, in Cornell University's Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics, says in a university statement.
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学分子生物学和遗传学系的塞德里克·费肖特（Cedric Feschotte）在一份大学声明中表示：“不知何故，进化论未能理清这两件事。”

paras.en: The team, including researchers at Capital Normal University in China and the University of Texas at Arlington, screened available poxvirus genomes for sequences resembling mobile genetic elements.
paras.zh: 该团队包括中国首都师范大学和德克萨斯大学阿灵顿分校的研究人员，筛选了可用的痘病毒基因组，以寻找类似于移动遗传元件的序列。

paras.en: Two BC200-derived sequences stood out in molluscum contagiosum virus. One covered the human gene's entire Alu-derived domain, a region inherited from its mobile ancestor. The other was shorter and incomplete at both ends.
paras.zh: 传染性软疣病毒中有两个源自 BC200 的序列很突出。其中一个覆盖了人类基因的整个 Alu 衍生结构域，该区域是从其移动祖先遗传而来的。另一个则较短且两端不完整。

paras.en: So what turned up in the virus are fragments derived from BC200 – not a complete, intact copy of the gene itself.
paras.zh: 因此，病毒中出现的是来自 BC200 的片段，而不是基因本身的完整、完整的副本。

paras.en: Several clues pointed to a human origin. BC200 occurs in humans and related primates, while molluscum contagiosum virus is only known to infect humans in nature.
paras.zh: 一些线索指向人类起源。 BC200 存在于人类和相关灵长类动物中，而传染性软疣病毒仅在自然界中感染人类。

paras.en: The researchers found no corresponding elements in other poxvirus genomes they examined, including a closely related virus infecting horses.
paras.zh: 研究人员在他们检查的其他痘病毒基因组中没有发现相应的元素，包括一种密切相关的感染马的病毒。

paras.en: The analysis pointed to two separate transfer events, not a single insertion that later duplicated itself inside the virus.
paras.zh: 分析指出了两个独立的转移事件，而不是后来在病毒内部复制的单个插入。

paras.en: The likely mechanism involves LINE-1, another mobile genetic element capable of producing the molecular machinery to copy RNA into DNA and insert it into a genome.
paras.zh: 可能的机制涉及 LINE-1，这是另一种可移动遗传元件，能够产生将 RNA 复制到 DNA 并将其插入基因组的分子机制。

paras.en: BC200 has no transport machinery of its own, so it hitches a ride on LINE-1's – borrowing another element's equipment to make the jump.
paras.zh: BC200没有自己的运输机械，因此它搭上了LINE-1的便车——借用另一个元件的设备来进行跳跃。

paras.en: Genetic signatures surrounding the viral insertion supported this explanation. However, the team reconstructed the transfer from DNA evidence, rather than watching it happen.
paras.zh: 病毒插入周围的遗传特征支持了这一解释。然而，该团队根据 DNA 证据重建了转移过程，而不是观察它的发生。

paras.en: Although BC200 RNA is abundant in neurons, it is also expressed at low levels in skin. The researchers found increased BC200 expression in cultured human fibroblasts infected with the virus.
paras.zh: 尽管 BC200 RNA 在神经元中含量丰富，但它在皮肤中的表达水平也较低。研究人员发现，在培养的感染该病毒的人类成纤维细胞中，BC200 表达增加。

paras.en: That suggests infection might help create conditions for transfer, without directly establishing where the historical events occurred.
paras.zh: 这表明感染可能有助于为转移创造条件，而无需直接确定历史事件发生的地点。

paras.en: The team then examined sequencing data from 908 people, identifying eight BC200-derived insertions that varied among individuals.
paras.zh: 随后，研究小组检查了 908 人的测序数据，确定了 8 个源自 BC200 的插入，这些插入在个体之间存在差异。

paras.en: Two were widespread across five continental population groups, suggesting ancient origins. Another was largely restricted to African individuals. The remaining five were rarer: one occurred in just two people, while four were each detected in a single individual.
paras.zh: 其中两种广泛分布于五个大陆人口群体中，表明其起源古老。另一种主要限于非洲人。其余五种情况较为罕见：一种仅发生在两个人身上，而四种则在一个人身上各检测到。

paras.en: These rare insertions suggest very recent activity. Being detected in one person, however, does not establish that an insertion arose during that person's lifetime.
paras.zh: 这些罕见的插入表明最近的活动。然而，在一个人身上检测到并不能证明该插入是在该人的一生中发生的。

paras.en: Across anthropoid primates, the researchers also identified hundreds of lineage-specific insertions, placing the viral discovery within millions of years of continued movement.
paras.zh: 在类人灵长类动物中，研究人员还发现了数百个谱系特异性插入，将病毒的发现置于数百万年的持续运动中。

paras.en: Whether the virus benefits remains uncertain. The team found evidence that its BC200-derived sequences are transcribed into RNA. Such RNA might help manipulate protein production in infected cells, but that possibility still needs testing.
paras.zh: 该病毒是否有益仍不确定。研究小组发现证据表明其 BC200 衍生序列被转录成 RNA。这种RNA可能有助于操纵受感染细胞中蛋白质的产生，但这种可能性仍需要测试。

paras.en: The study does not demonstrate that the virus has become more dangerous. Instead, it shows that acquiring a cellular function need not end a genetic element's mobility.
paras.zh: 该研究并未表明该病毒已变得更加危险。相反，它表明获得细胞功能并不需要终止遗传元件的流动性。

paras.en: BC200's combination of function and movement makes the boundary between genes and jumping DNA appear more flexible than expected.
paras.zh: BC200将功能与运动结合起来，使得基因与跳跃DNA之间的界限显得比预想的更加灵活。

paras.en: The research has been published in Science.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《科学》杂志上。

articles.title: One Everyday Habit Is Linked to 49% Higher Risk of Eating Disorder Symptoms in Teens
articles.author: Carly Cassella

paras.en: Giving a child a smartphone before age 13 could be risky for some aspects of their mental health.
paras.zh: 在 13 岁之前给孩子一部智能手机可能会对他们的心理健康的某些方面带来风险。

paras.en: In a new study of nearly 9,000 adolescents in the US, researchers found that owning a smartphone at age 12 was associated with a 36 percent higher chance of reporting any symptom of an eating disorder.
paras.zh: 在一项针对美国近 9,000 名青少年的新研究中，研究人员发现，12 岁时拥有智能手机的人出现饮食失调症状的几率会增加 36%。

paras.en: At this age, smartphone users reported a 61 percent higher prevalence of binge-eating symptoms than non-users.
paras.zh: 在这个年龄段，智能手机用户的暴食症状发生率比不使用智能手机的用户高 61%。

paras.en: Nearly 70 percent of 12-year-olds in the study owned a smartphone.
paras.zh: 研究中近 70% 的 12 岁儿童拥有智能手机。

paras.en: The findings were published in JAMA Network Open and support growing preliminary evidence that early and unsupervised smartphone ownership may be associated with downsides for mental health.
paras.zh: 研究结果发表在《美国医学会杂志》网络公开版上，并支持越来越多的初步证据，即早期和无人监督的智能手机拥有可能与心理健康的负面影响有关。

paras.en: The research, led by scientists at the University of California, San Francisco (UCSF), suggests that delaying smartphone access among children may be worth considering, given its links to disordered eating habits.
paras.zh: 这项由加州大学旧金山分校 (UCSF) 科学家领导的研究表明，鉴于智能手机与饮食习惯紊乱有关，推迟儿童使用智能手机可能值得考虑。

paras.en: The results can't prove that smartphones are causing eating disorder symptoms, but it's possible that early and unsupervised access to social media could exacerbate body dissatisfaction in puberty.
paras.zh: 结果不能证明智能手机会导致饮食失调症状，但过早且不受监督地访问社交媒体可能会加剧青春期的身体不满。

paras.en: That's something parents should be aware of, the authors argue, and clinicians may want to consider screening for smartphone ownership and social media use when assessing eating disorder risks in teens.
paras.zh: 作者认为，这是父母应该意识到的事情，临床医生在评估青少年饮食失调风险时可能需要考虑筛查智能手机拥有情况和社交媒体使用情况。

paras.en: "Eating disorders are serious, potentially life-threatening conditions that are nonetheless often preventable and responsive to early interventions," write the authors, led by pediatrician Jason Nagata at UCSF.
paras.zh: 加州大学旧金山分校儿科医生杰森·永田（Jason Nagata）领导的作者写道：“饮食失调是一种严重的、可能危及生命的疾病，但通常是可以预防的，并且可以通过早期干预做出反应。”

paras.en: "While major social media platforms enforce a minimum age of 13 years, this threshold can be easily circumvented, raising concerns about the feasibility of age-based protections."
paras.zh: “虽然主要社交媒体平台强制规定最低年龄为 13 岁，但这一门槛很容易被规避，引发了人们对基于年龄的保护的可行性的担忧。”

paras.en: The analysis included health data from an ongoing longitudinal study of adolescents in the US.
paras.zh: 该分析包括来自一项正在进行的美国青少年纵向研究的健康数据。

paras.en: At age 12, smartphone ownership was already linked to a variety of eating disorder symptoms.
paras.zh: 12 岁时，拥有智能手机就已经与多种饮食失调症状相关。

paras.en: Some of these associations were still apparent two years later.
paras.zh: 其中一些关联在两年后仍然显而易见。

paras.en: By age 14, nearly a quarter of kids who had had a smartphone since age 12 reported at least one eating disorder symptom.
paras.zh: 到 14 岁时，近四分之一自 12 岁起就拥有智能手机的孩子报告称至少有一种饮食失调症状。

paras.en: Compared to kids who didn't have a smartphone at age 12, those who did were 103 percent more likely to report tying their self-worth to their weight.
paras.zh: 与 12 岁时还没有智能手机的孩子相比，那些拥有智能手机的孩子将自我价值与体重联系起来的可能性要高出 103%。

paras.en: They also faced 49 percent greater risk of reporting any eating disorder symptom by age 14.
paras.zh: 到 14 岁时，他们报告任何饮食失调症状的风险也增加了 49%。

paras.en: "Owning a personal smartphone during early adolescence may be particularly consequential, given its potential to increase unsupervised and individualized exposure to digital environments during a sensitive developmental period," write the study authors.
paras.zh: 研究作者写道：“在青春期早期拥有个人智能手机可能特别重要，因为它有可能在敏感的发育时期增加无人监督和个性化的数字环境暴露。”

paras.en: "These influences may also accumulate over time and be shaped by developmental timing."
paras.zh: “这些影响也可能随着时间的推移而积累，并受到发育时间的影响。”

paras.en: Just because a teen reports a symptom of an eating disorder doesn't mean they necessarily have one.
paras.zh: 仅仅因为青少年报告有饮食失调的症状并不意味着他们一定有这种症状。

paras.en: This analysis only measured the self-reported symptoms of teens. It did not analyze how smartphone use impacts an actual clinical diagnosis.
paras.zh: 该分析仅测量了青少年自我报告的症状。它没有分析智能手机的使用如何影响实际的临床诊断。

paras.en: An eating disorder is defined by the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders (DSM-5) as a persistent disturbance of eating or eating-related behavior that significantly impairs physical health or psychosocial functioning.
paras.zh: 《精神疾病诊断与统计手册》(DSM-5) 将饮食失调定义为持续的饮食失调或饮食相关行为，严重损害身体健康或心理社会功能。

paras.en: Among young people, eating disorders are relatively common, impacting between 5.5 to 18 percent of young women, and up to 2.4 percent of young men by the time they reach early adulthood.
paras.zh: 在年轻人中，饮食失调相对常见，在成年早期，影响 5.5% 至 18% 的年轻女性，高达 2.4% 的年轻男性。

paras.en: Recent increases in prevalence have been reported mainly among females aged 15 to 19.
paras.zh: 据报告，最近患病率增加主要发生在 15 至 19 岁的女性中。

paras.en: Social media use allows for greater peer pressure than ever before, and idealized body content on social media is associated with an increased risk of body dissatisfaction and disordered eating.
paras.zh: 社交媒体的使用比以往任何时候都带来更大的同伴压力，社交媒体上理想化的身体内容与身体不满意和饮食失调的风险增加有关。

paras.en: It's possible that influencers and online 'fitspiration' content are exacerbating feelings of body dissatisfaction in young people and teaching them unhealthy eating habits.
paras.zh: 有影响力的人和在线“健身”内容可能会加剧年轻人对身体的不满情绪，并教会他们不健康的饮食习惯。

paras.en: One study, for instance, has shown that among adolescents, each additional hour of total screen time and social media use is associated with higher odds of behaviors to prevent weight gain and binge-eating symptoms.
paras.zh: 例如，一项研究表明，在青少年中，屏幕总使用时间和社交媒体使用时间每增加一小时，预防体重增加和暴饮暴食症状的行为几率就会增加。

paras.en: "Our findings are notable given that early adolescence, when self-regulation is still maturing and sensitivity to social evaluation is heightened, coincides with puberty, which is a time of increased eating disorder risk," explain the authors of the recent study.
paras.zh: 这项研究的作者解释说：“我们的研究结果值得注意，因为青春期早期，自我调节能力尚在成熟，对社会评价的敏感度也较高，而青春期恰好是饮食失调风险增加的时期。”

paras.en: Of course, the use of social media and smartphones doesn't have to be harmful. Some research suggests it could even have mental health benefits for some teens, lsuch as lower levels of depression among those who text more.
paras.zh: 当然，使用社交媒体和智能手机不一定有害。一些研究表明，它甚至可能对某些青少年的心理健康有益，例如发短信较多的人的抑郁程度较低。

paras.en: How teens use digital devices may matter more for their mental health than how much time they spend on them.
paras.zh: 青少年如何使用数字设备对他们的心理健康可能比他们在数字设备上花费的时间更重要。

paras.en: The digital world we live in isn't likely to go away any time soon, and it's important to know at what age it is safe to give a child a smartphone and how to regulate their usage.
paras.zh: 我们生活的数字世界不太可能很快消失，重要的是要知道在什么年龄给孩子提供智能手机是安全的，以及如何规范其使用。

paras.en: Studies like these get us closer to understanding the risks behind smartphone use. Only then can we figure out how to best protect the next generation.
paras.zh: 此类研究让我们更进一步了解智能手机使用背后的风险。只有这样我们才能弄清楚如何最好地保护下一代。

paras.en: The research has been published in JAMA Network Open.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《JAMA Network Open》上。

articles.title: Scientists Identify a Small Village in Italy Where Women Live Exceptionally Long Lives
articles.author: Peter Dockrill

paras.en: In a mountain village in the heart of Sardinia, Italy, something very special appears to be happening.
paras.zh: 在意大利撒丁岛中心的一个山村里，似乎正在发生一些非常特别的事情。

paras.en: On the same island, roughly 20 years ago, scientists identified the world's first so-called 'Blue Zone' – a geographical cluster in Sardinia where people demonstrated "extreme longevity".
paras.zh: 大约 20 年前，在同一个岛上，科学家们发现了世界上第一个所谓的“蓝色区域”——撒丁岛的一个地理集群，那里的人们表现出“极其长寿”。

paras.en: Now, in the small town of Bolotana, approximately 110 kilometers to the west of the original Blue Zone, researchers may have found another such site of exceptional longevity.
paras.zh: 现在，在原始蓝区以西约 110 公里处的博洛塔纳小镇，研究人员可能发现了另一个如此长寿的地点。

paras.en: In a new study published in Frontiers in Aging, scientists found evidence that women in particular in Bolotana tend to live extremely long lives.
paras.zh: 在《老龄化前沿》杂志上发表的一项新研究中，科学家发现证据表明，尤其是博洛塔纳的女性往往寿命极长。

paras.en: Based on their analysis, which used demographic data from 2021–2025, an average 70-year-old woman in Bolotana has a remaining life expectancy of 20.85 years, compared with 18.61 years for Nuoro Province (in which Bolotana is located), 18.4 years for Sardinia overall, and 18.06 years across Italy.
paras.zh: 根据他们使用 2021 年至 2025 年人口数据的分析，博洛塔纳 70 岁女性的平均剩余预期寿命为 20.85 岁，而努奥罗省（博洛塔纳所在）为 18.61 岁，撒丁岛整体为 18.4 岁，意大利各地为 18.06 岁。

paras.en: Even more strikingly, though, the estimated probability of a 70-year-old woman in Bolotana living to 100 years of age is 13.83 percent, versus much lower chances elsewhere: 4.33 percent in Nuoro Province, 4.43 percent in Sardinia, and 3.54 percent for Italy as a whole.
paras.zh: 然而，更引人注目的是，博洛塔纳 70 岁女性活到 100 岁的概率估计为 13.83%，而其他地方的概率要低得多：努奥罗省为 4.33%，撒丁岛为 4.43%，整个意大利为 3.54%。

paras.en: "We think this is the longest-lived female population in the world, or close to it." – epidemiologist S. Jay Olshansky
paras.zh: “我们认为这是世界上最长寿的女性人口，或者接近它。” ——流行病学家 S. Jay Olshansky

paras.en: To put that into an international context, the researchers say the probability of a 70-year-old Bolotana woman surviving to 100 is more than three times the corresponding value seen in US women.
paras.zh: 考虑到国际背景，研究人员表示，一名 70 岁的博洛塔纳女性活到 100 岁的概率是美国女性相应数值的三倍多。

paras.en: The overall life-expectancy-at–70 and survival-to–100 patterns for Bolotana women rank their longevity prospects as exceptionally high worldwide, second only to Hong Kong.
paras.zh: 博洛塔纳女性 70 岁的总体预期寿命和 100 岁的生存模式表明，她们的长寿前景在全球范围内非常高，仅次于香港。

paras.en: "We think this is the longest-lived female population in the world, or close to it," says epidemiologist and study co-author S. Jay Olshansky from the University of Illinois Chicago.
paras.zh: 伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校的流行病学家兼研究合著者 S. Jay Olshansky 表示：“我们认为这是世界上最长寿的女性群体，或者接近这一水平。”

paras.en: "If we can identify the characteristics behind this longevity and help people adopt them, the rest of the world can benefit from understanding the values practiced by these communities."
paras.zh: “如果我们能够找出这种长寿背后的特征并帮助人们采用它们，世界其他地方就可以从了解这些社区所践行的价值观中受益。”

paras.en: By contrast, men in Bolotana, while still long-lived, don't demonstrate such an extreme pattern of longevity.
paras.zh: 相比之下，博洛塔纳的男性虽然仍然很长寿，但并没有表现出如此极端的长寿模式。

paras.en: A 70-year-old man in Bolotana has "modestly higher" life expectancy (16.02 years), compared to the national Italian average (15.48 years), the researchers say.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，与意大利全国平均寿命（15.48 岁）相比，博洛塔纳一名 70 岁男子的预期寿命“略高”（16.02 岁）。

paras.en: Still, their chances of surviving from 70 to 100 are markedly better than those of their countrymen, with an estimated probability of 4.92 percent, more than three times higher than the national average of 1.41 percent.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，他们在 70 岁到 100 岁之间的生存机会明显高于同胞，估计概率为 4.92%，比全国平均水平 1.41% 高出三倍多。

paras.en: An important caveat worth mentioning with the research is that, due to the small size of Bolotana's population, the results of the analysis are highly sensitive to the years studied.
paras.zh: 该研究中值得一提的一个重要警告是，由于博洛塔纳人口规模较小，分析结果对研究年份高度敏感。

paras.en: When the team shifted their focus to the years 2015–2019, the survival-to–100 estimate was just 1.46 percent for women, which is much lower than the 13.83 percent for the years 2021–2025. Life expectancy at 70, at 18.3 years, remained higher than the national average.
paras.zh: 当团队将注意力转移到 2015-2019 年时，女性的百岁生存率估计仅为 1.46%，远低于 2021-2025 年的 13.83%。 70岁的预期寿命为18.3岁，仍然高于全国平均水平。

paras.en: What initially drew the researchers' attention to Bolotana (population: 2,266 during the study period) was the unusually high number of centenarians living in the small community – a group honored by a local website – but it's not just the townsfolk's longevity that is remarkable.
paras.zh: 最初吸引研究人员注意博洛塔纳（研究期间人口：2,266 人）的原因是这个小社区中居住着异常多的百岁老人（当地网站对这一群体进行了表彰），但令人瞩目的不仅仅是该镇居民的长寿。

paras.en: "What makes Bolotana extraordinary is that it has an incredible historical record that allows us to definitively evaluate ages at birth and death," says Olshansky.
paras.zh: “博洛塔纳的非凡之处在于它拥有令人难以置信的历史记录，使我们能够明确评估出生和死亡的年龄，”奥尔尚斯基说。

paras.en: "The municipal and baptismal records date back centuries and allowed us to independently verify ages. Every single person that has made it past 100, we can validate. There is no ambiguity."
paras.zh: “市政和洗礼记录可以追溯到几个世纪前，这让我们能够独立核实年龄。我们可以验证每一个超过 100 岁的人。没有任何含糊之处。”

paras.en: As for what gives the women of Bolotana such long lives, it remains unknown, and the researchers acknowledge it was beyond the scope of their demographic analysis, but they suggest further individual-level studies could explore the potential biological, behavioral, and social contributors.
paras.zh: 至于是什么让博洛塔纳的女性如此长寿，目前仍不得而知，研究人员承认这超出了他们的人口分析范围，但他们建议进一步的个人层面研究可以探索潜在的生物学、行为和社会因素。

paras.en: "Several mechanisms could plausibly contribute to the pronounced female survival advantage," the researchers write in their paper, "including genetic background, dietary patterns, physical activity, family support, social cohesion, continuity of residence, and access to care."
paras.zh: 研究人员在论文中写道：“有几种机制可能有助于女性明显的生存优势，包括遗传背景、饮食模式、体力活动、家庭支持、社会凝聚力、居住连续性和获得护理的机会。”

paras.en: The town's environment could also play a role. Olshansky notes that residents live in a steep, hilly landscape, where most food is grown locally, and social isolation is rare.
paras.zh: 该镇的环境也可能发挥作用。奥尔尚斯基指出，居民生活在陡峭的丘陵地区，大部分食物都是在当地种植的，社会隔离很少见。

paras.en: "You've got this close-knit community where people take care of each other," Olshansky says. "Movement is largely done by walking, not by driving."
paras.zh: “这里有一个联系紧密的社区，人们互相照顾，”奥尔尚斯基说。 “运动主要是步行，而不是开车。”

paras.en: How much any of these factors contribute will have to be verified by future research, but now that Bolotana has been identified, there's a good chance scientists will pay attention, especially since the study's findings nominate Bolotana for consideration as a "candidate longevity Blue Zone".
paras.zh: 这些因素的贡献有多大，还需要通过未来的研究来验证，但既然博洛塔纳已经被确定，科学家们很有可能会关注，特别是因为该研究的结果提名博洛塔纳为“候选长寿蓝区”。

paras.en: "We now know something extraordinary is happening in Bolotana," says co-author and longevity researcher Dan Buettner, the founder of Blue Zones, Inc., a company that promotes and commercializes the Blue Zones longevity concept.
paras.zh: “我们现在知道博洛塔纳正在发生一些非凡的事情，”共同作者、长寿研究员 Dan Buettner 说道，他是 Blue Zones, Inc. 的创始人，该公司致力于推广 Blue Zones 长寿概念并将其商业化。

paras.en: "The next step is to understand why and whether the lessons can help people elsewhere live longer, healthier lives."
paras.zh: “下一步是了解为什么以及这些课程是否可以帮助其他地方的人们活得更长久、更健康。”

paras.en: The findings are reported in Frontiers in Aging.
paras.zh: 研究结果发表在《老龄化前沿》杂志上。

articles.title: Dads are dying after their kids are born, and almost no one is tracking it

paras.en: Dads are dying after their kids are born, and almost no one is tracking it
paras.zh: 孩子出生后，爸爸们纷纷去世，但几乎没有人关注这一事件

paras.en: Most deaths among fathers in the first years after a childâs birth may be preventable, even as fatherhood itself appears linked to a lower overall risk of dying.
paras.zh: 大多数父亲在孩子出生后头几年内的死亡可能是可以预防的，尽管父亲本身似乎与较低的总体死亡风险有关。

paras.en: - A study of more than 130,000 babies born in Georgia found that hundreds of fathers died within the first five years of their childâs life, and about 60% of those deaths were potentially preventable. Homicide, accidental injuries, suicide, and drug overdoses accounted for most of the preventable deaths, highlighting what researchers call a major blind spot in public health.
paras.zh: - 一项针对佐治亚州出生的 130,000 多名婴儿的研究发现，数百名父亲在孩子出生后的头五年内死亡，其中约 60% 的死亡是可以避免的。凶杀、意外伤害、自杀和吸毒过量是可预防死亡的主要原因，这凸显了研究人员所说的公共卫生中的一个主要盲点。

paras.en: Maternal mortality has become widely recognized as an urgent public health problem in the United States, although it took decades for the issue to receive sustained attention. The deaths of fathers, however, have attracted far less scrutiny.
paras.zh: 在美国，孕产妇死亡率已被广泛认为是一个紧迫的公共卫生问题，尽管这个问题花了几十年才受到持续关注。然而，父亲的去世引起的关注要少得多。

paras.en: Research has shown that fathers, especially men in their 20s through early 40s, are disproportionately affected by preventable causes of death including suicide, overdose, homicide and accidental injury. Yet researchers have rarely studied these deaths specifically in the context of becoming a parent.
paras.zh: 研究表明，父亲，尤其是 20 多岁到 40 岁出头的男性，尤其容易受到可预防死亡原因的影响，包括自杀、吸毒过量、他杀和意外伤害。然而，研究人员很少专门在成为父母的背景下研究这些死亡。

paras.en: Scientists at Northwestern University are working to bring more attention to that gap.
paras.zh: 西北大学的科学家们正在努力引起人们对这一差距的更多关注。

paras.en: Most Deaths Among Fathers Were Preventable
paras.zh: 大多数父亲的死亡是可以预防的

paras.en: In a new study, Northwestern researchers examined all 130,267 babies born in Georgia in 2017 and followed their fathers for the next five years, through 2022. During that period, 796 fathers died.
paras.zh: 在一项新的研究中，西北大学的研究人员检查了 2017 年在佐治亚州出生的所有 130,267 名婴儿，并在接下来的五年（直至 2022 年）追踪他们的父亲。在此期间，有 796 名父亲去世。

paras.en: Of those fathers who died within five years (796), 60% died from causes considered preventable, a finding the researchers described as a "huge, missed opportunity."
paras.zh: 在五年内去世的父亲（796 名）中，60% 死于被认为可以预防的原因，研究人员将这一发现描述为“错失的巨大机会”。

paras.en: The deaths included homicide (143), accidental injury (142), suicide (102) and overdose (93). Another 296 fathers died from natural causes.
paras.zh: 死亡包括他杀（143人）、意外伤害（142人）、自杀（102人）和吸毒过量（93人）。另有 296 名父亲因自然原因死亡。

paras.en: The study was published in JAMA Pediatrics.
paras.zh: 该研究发表在《美国医学会儿科杂志》上。

paras.en: While maternal mortality review committees closely examine the deaths of mothers during the first year of a child's life, the researchers say paternal mortality has received little comparable attention. To their knowledge, this is the first study published in a major medical journal to examine the deaths of fathers during the years following the birth of a child.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，虽然孕产妇死亡率审查委员会仔细审查了母亲在婴儿出生后第一年的死亡情况，但父亲的死亡率却很少受到类似的关注。据他们所知，这是在主要医学期刊上发表的第一项研究，调查孩子出生后几年父亲的死亡情况。

paras.en: "Our data show that fathers die frequently in the first years of their child's life, and we have no systems in place to understand how we might prevent it," said corresponding author Dr. Craig Garfield, professor of pediatrics and medical social sciences at Northwestern University Feinberg School of Medicine. "That's a huge blind spot."
paras.zh: 西北大学范伯格医学院儿科和医学社会科学教授、通讯作者克雷格·加菲尔德博士说：“我们的数据显示，父亲在孩子出生后的头几年经常死亡，而我们没有适当的系统来了解如何预防这种情况。” “这是一个巨大的盲点。”

paras.en: The results resemble a pattern already documented in maternal mortality research. Deaths surrounding the transition to parenthood often have more to do with social vulnerability than biology, and many of them can be prevented. Yet deaths among fathers remain largely uncounted and unaddressed.
paras.zh: 结果类似于孕产妇死亡率研究中已经记录的模式。为人父母过程中的死亡往往更多地与社会脆弱性有关，而不是与生物学有关，而且其中许多死亡是可以预防的。然而，父亲的死亡人数在很大程度上仍然没有被统计和解决。

paras.en: Previous research has also connected a father's involvement with better health outcomes for children and families. The absence of a father, meanwhile, has been associated with a variety of negative outcomes for children.
paras.zh: 先前的研究也将父亲的参与与儿童和家庭更好的健康结果联系起来。与此同时，父亲的缺席会给孩子带来各种负面后果。

paras.en: Although many fathers in the study died from preventable causes, researchers also uncovered a seemingly contradictory finding. Being a father was associated with lower overall death rates among men in Georgia between 2017 and 2022.
paras.zh: 尽管研究中的许多父亲死于可预防的原因，但研究人员还发现了一个看似矛盾的发现。 2017 年至 2022 年间，成为父亲与乔治亚州男性总体死亡率较低有关。

paras.en: Among men older than 20, fathers consistently had lower mortality rates than men who were not fathers.
paras.zh: 在 20 岁以上的男性中，父亲的死亡率始终低于非父亲男性。

paras.en: For example, among those aged 30 to 34, the death rate for Georgia fathers was 120 deaths per 100,000 men compared with 231 deaths per 100,000 among Georgia men who were not fathers.
paras.zh: 例如，在30至34岁的人群中，乔治亚州父亲的死亡率为每10万名男性中有120人死亡，而乔治亚州非父亲男性的死亡率为每10万名男性中有231人死亡。

paras.en: "Being a father appears to be protective in this particular group of men," Garfield said. "We were surprised to see reduced mortality among men who are fathers. Whether that is due to changes in lifestyle or a new purpose or new roles and responsibilities, we don't know, but it is certainly worth further study."
paras.zh: 加菲尔德说：“对于这一特殊的男性群体来说，成为一名父亲似乎具有保护作用。” “我们惊讶地发现，身为父亲的男性死亡率有所下降。这是否是由于生活方式的改变、新的目的或新的角色和责任所致，我们不知道，但肯定值得进一步研究。”

paras.en: For the analysis, scientists examined births throughout Georgia between 2017 and 2022 and connected those records with death records for fathers named on birth certificates. They investigated causes of death, overall mortality rates and whether becoming a father appeared to influence a man's risk of dying.
paras.zh: 为了进行分析，科学家检查了 2017 年至 2022 年间佐治亚州各地的出生情况，并将这些记录与出生证明上记载的父亲的死亡记录联系起来。他们调查了死亡原因、总体死亡率以及成为父亲是否会影响男性的死亡风险。

paras.en: Deaths from non-natural causes were more common among younger fathers.
paras.zh: 非自然原因死亡在年轻父亲中更为常见。

paras.en: Births paid for by Medicaid and unmarried status were associated with a greater risk of homicide. Fathers who died were also more likely to have been older, non-Hispanic Black, unmarried, living in rural areas and connected with Medicaid-paid births.
paras.zh: 由医疗补助支付的生育费用和未婚状况与更高的凶杀风险有关。死亡的父亲也更有可能是年龄较大、非西班牙裔黑人、未婚、生活在农村地区并与医疗补助付费生育有关的人。

paras.en: Higher levels of education, Hispanic ethnicity and Tricare-paid births were associated with fewer deaths.
paras.zh: 较高的教育水平、西班牙裔种族和三保付费分娩与较少的死亡人数有关。

paras.en: Hospital Experiences Inspired the Research
paras.zh: 医院经历启发了这项研究

paras.en: Garfield, a pediatrician at Ann & Robert H. Lurie Children's Hospital of Chicago, said his experiences with families in the neonatal intensive care unit helped motivate the research.
paras.zh: 加菲尔德是芝加哥安与罗伯特 H.卢里儿童医院的儿科医生，他表示，他在新生儿重症监护室与家人相处的经历有助于推动这项研究。

paras.en: He has encountered numerous mothers coping with the sudden death of their partner from causes such as shootings, car accidents and other unexpected events.
paras.zh: 他遇到过许多母亲因伴侣因枪击、车祸和其他意外事件而突然死亡的情况。

paras.en: "In my experience, that happens more often than mothers dying," Garfield said. "The death of any parent has enormous consequences for a child, and as a pediatrician, I care most about how a parent's death impacts the child, especially in the early years."
paras.zh: 加菲尔德说：“根据我的经验，这种情况比母亲死亡更常见。” “任何父母的死亡都会对孩子产生巨大的影响，作为一名儿科医生，我最关心父母的死亡对孩子的影响，尤其是在孩子的幼年时期。”

paras.en: Garfield has published dozens of studies examining fathers' physical and mental health. Even so, he said he found very little research focused specifically on fathers who die during the first several years after the birth of a child.
paras.zh: 加菲猫发表了数十项研究父亲的身心健康状况。即便如此，他说他发现很少有专门针对在孩子出生后头几年去世的父亲的研究。

paras.en: A similar nationwide analysis of paternal mortality is not currently possible because of limitations in how birth and death data are handled.
paras.zh: 由于出生和死亡数据处理方式的限制，目前不可能对全国范围内的父亲死亡率进行类似的分析。

paras.en: States collect detailed birth and death records, but when those records are compiled nationally, personally identifiable information is removed. That makes it impossible to connect individual fathers with specific causes of death and other important information needed for this type of analysis.
paras.zh: 各州收集详细的出生和死亡记录，但当这些记录在全国范围内编制时，个人身份信息将被删除。这使得不可能将个别父亲与具体的死亡原因以及此类分析所需的其他重要信息联系起来。

paras.en: Garfield and his colleagues were able to study Georgia because they already had access to the state's data through an existing project called the Pregnancy Risk Assessment Monitoring System for Dads (PRAMS for Dads survey), which the team developed and first piloted in Georgia in 2018.
paras.zh: 加菲尔德和他的同事之所以能够研究佐治亚州，是因为他们已经可以通过一个名为“爸爸怀孕风险评估监测系统”（PRAMS for Dads Survey）的现有项目访问该州的数据，该团队于 2018 年开发并首次在佐治亚州进行试点。

paras.en: Garfield hopes other states will conduct similar analyses of their own records. Combining those efforts could eventually help researchers better understand paternal mortality across the United States and develop a system for tracking the problem nationally.
paras.zh: 加菲尔德希望其他州也能对自己的记录进行类似的分析。将这些努力结合起来，最终可以帮助研究人员更好地了解美国各地的父亲死亡率，并开发一个在全国范围内跟踪该问题的系统。

paras.en: "If we don't measure it, we can't change it," Garfield said. "That affects thousands of children."
paras.zh: “如果我们不衡量它，我们就无法改变它，”加菲尔德说。 “这影响了数千名儿童。”

paras.en: Other Northwestern co-authors include Clarissa D. Simon and Katy Bedjeti.
paras.zh: 西北大学的其他合著者包括克拉丽莎·D·西蒙 (Clarissa D. Simon) 和凯蒂·贝杰蒂 (Katy Bedjeti)。

paras.en: Materials provided by Northwestern University. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由西北大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Craig F. Garfield, Clarissa D. Simon, Chris Harrison, Michael Woods, Katy Bedjeti, John T. Carter. Paternal Mortality During Early Childhood. JAMA Pediatrics, 2026; 180 (7): 795 DOI: 10.1001/jamapediatrics.2026.1217
paras.zh: - 克雷格·F·加菲尔德、克拉丽莎·D·西蒙、克里斯·哈里森、迈克尔·伍兹、凯蒂·贝杰蒂、约翰·T·卡特。幼儿时期父亲的死亡率。 《美国医学会儿科杂志》，2026； 180 (7): 795 DOI: 10.1001/jamapediatrics.2026.1217

articles.title: Not all trans fats are bad, major review finds

paras.en: Not all trans fats are bad, major review finds
paras.zh: 主要审查发现，并非所有反式脂肪都是有害的

paras.en: - A large analysis of 22 studies found that the trans fats naturally present in dairy foods such as milk, butter, yogurt, and cheese do not appear to raise the risk of heart disease or type 2 diabetes. Unlike industrial trans fats from partially hydrogenated oils, dairy trans fats showed no meaningful harmful effects on blood fats in controlled trials and were not linked to higher rates of heart disease, stroke, cardiovascular death, or diabetes in long-term studies.
paras.zh: - 对 22 项研究的大型分析发现，牛奶、黄油、酸奶和奶酪等乳制品中天然存在的反式脂肪似乎不会增加患心脏病或 2 型糖尿病的风险。与来自部分氢化油的工业反式脂肪不同，在对照试验中，乳制品反式脂肪对血脂没有显示出有意义的有害影响，并且在长期研究中与心脏病、中风、心血管死亡或糖尿病的较高发病率无关。

paras.en: A new study suggests that the trans fats naturally present in dairy foods, including milk, butter, and cheese, do not increase the risk of heart disease or type 2 diabetes.
paras.zh: 一项新的研究表明，乳制品（包括牛奶、黄油和奶酪）中天然存在的反式脂肪不会增加患心脏病或 2 型糖尿病的风险。

paras.en: Researchers reviewed evidence from 22 studies involving thousands of participants in Europe, Canada and the United States. Their findings indicate that naturally occurring dairy trans fats act differently in the body from industrial trans fats. While industrial trans fats are strongly associated with heart disease, the naturally occurring forms found in dairy did not appear to carry the same risk.
paras.zh: 研究人员审查了 22 项研究的证据，涉及欧洲、加拿大和美国的数千名参与者。他们的研究结果表明，天然乳制品反式脂肪在体内的作用与工业反式脂肪不同。虽然工业反式脂肪与心脏病密切相关，但乳制品中天然存在的反式脂肪似乎并不具有相同的风险。

paras.en: The first-of-its-kind research, published in the journal Nutrition Research, could also help consumers better understand the distinction between different types of trans fats and provide greater clarity around labeling policies that may contribute to confusion.
paras.zh: 这项首次发表在《营养研究》杂志上的研究还可以帮助消费者更好地理解不同类型反式脂肪之间的区别，并为可能导致混乱的标签政策提供更清晰的信息。

paras.en: Professor Ian Givens, one of the lead authors from the University of Reading, said: "People hear the words 'trans fats' and assume the worst, but the trans fats in your morning milk, yogurt, butter or cheese are not the same as the ones from industrial partially hydrogenated fats. This research should give people reassurance that dairy, eaten as part of a balanced diet, is not something to worry about for your heart."
paras.zh: 雷丁大学的主要作者之一伊恩·吉文斯教授表示：“人们听到‘反式脂肪’这个词，就会想到最坏的情况，但早晨牛奶、酸奶、黄油或奶酪中的反式脂肪与工业部分氢化脂肪中的反式脂肪并不相同。这项研究应该让人们放心，作为均衡饮食的一部分食用乳制品，并不需要为心脏担心。”

paras.en: Natural and Industrial Trans Fats Have Different Effects
paras.zh: 天然反式脂肪和工业反式脂肪有不同的作用

paras.en: Trans fats are a type of unsaturated fat. They occur naturally in the milk of animals such as cows, sheep, and goats, but they can also be produced artificially during the manufacture of partially hydrogenated fats.
paras.zh: 反式脂肪是不饱和脂肪的一种。它们天然存在于牛、绵羊和山羊等动物的奶中，但也可以在部分氢化脂肪的制造过程中人工产生。

paras.en: Industrial trans fats, which can be present in some processed and fried foods, have been strongly linked to an increased risk of heart disease. The researchers wanted to determine whether the trans fats naturally found in dairy foods should be viewed in the same way.
paras.zh: 工业反式脂肪可能存在于一些加工食品和油炸食品中，与心脏病风险增加密切相关。研究人员想要确定是否应该以同样的方式看待乳制品中天然存在的反式脂肪。

paras.en: Controlled Trials Find No Meaningful Change in Blood Lipids
paras.zh: 对照试验发现血脂没有显着变化

paras.en: The researchers examined two main types of evidence. The first came from ten controlled dietary trials in which participants consumed dairy foods containing naturally enhanced levels of trans fats and were compared with people consuming regular dairy products.
paras.zh: 研究人员检查了两种主要类型的证据。第一个来自十项对照饮食试验，在这些试验中，参与者食用了天然含有较高水平反式脂肪的乳制品，并与食用普通乳制品的人进行了比较。

paras.en: Scientists then measured blood lipid biomarkers that are commonly used to assess heart disease risk. Across all ten trials, participants consumed between 1.3 and 13.2 grams of trans fat per day.
paras.zh: 然后，科学家测量了常用于评估心脏病风险的血脂生物标志物。在所有十项试验中，参与者每天消耗 1.3 至 13.2 克反式脂肪。

paras.en: The results showed no meaningful differences in blood lipid levels between those consuming dairy foods with higher levels of natural trans fats and those consuming regular dairy products.
paras.zh: 结果显示，食用天然反式脂肪含量较高的乳制品的人与食用普通乳制品的人的血脂水平没有显着差异。

paras.en: Long-Term Studies Show No Higher Heart or Diabetes Risk
paras.zh: 长期研究表明心脏或糖尿病风险不会更高

paras.en: The second group of evidence came from twelve long-term cohort studies that followed thousands of people over many years, with some studies lasting more than two decades.
paras.zh: 第二组证据来自十二项长期队列研究，这些研究对数千人进行了多年跟踪，其中一些研究持续了二十多年。

paras.en: Researchers measured levels of dairy trans fats in participants' blood and compared them with later health outcomes. Across these studies, higher levels of dairy trans fats were not associated with an increased risk of heart disease, stroke or cardiovascular death.
paras.zh: 研究人员测量了参与者血液中乳制品反式脂肪的水平，并将其与后来的健康结果进行比较。在这些研究中，较高水平的乳制品反式脂肪与心脏病、中风或心血管死亡风险增加无关。

paras.en: Higher blood levels of dairy trans fats were also not associated with a greater risk of developing type 2 diabetes.
paras.zh: 血液中较高的乳制品反式脂肪水平也与患 2 型糖尿病的较高风险无关。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Reading. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.

articles.title: Scientists warn a popular vitamin D supplement may have a hidden downside

paras.en: Scientists warn a popular vitamin D supplement may have a hidden downside
paras.zh: 科学家警告说，流行的维生素 D 补充剂可能存在隐藏的缺点

paras.en: - Not all vitamin D supplements are created equal, and new research suggests that one popular form may have an unexpected downside. Scientists found that taking vitamin D2 can actually lower the body's levels of vitamin D3, the form naturally produced by sunlight and more effective at boosting overall vitamin D. Previous studies also suggest that vitamin D3 may provide stronger immune protection against viruses and bacteria.
paras.zh: - 并非所有维生素 D 补充剂都是一样的，新的研究表明，一种流行的形式可能有一个意想不到的缺点。科学家发现，服用维生素 D2 实际上可以降低体内维生素 D3 的水平，维生素 D3 是阳光自然产生的形式，可以更有效地提高维生素 D 的整体水平。之前的研究还表明，维生素 D3 可以提供更强的针对病毒和细菌的免疫保护。

paras.en: A common vitamin D supplement may have an unexpected effect inside the body. Research published in 2025 found that taking vitamin D2 can reduce levels of vitamin D3, the form humans naturally make when skin is exposed to sunlight.
paras.zh: 普通的维生素 D 补充剂可能会在体内产生意想不到的效果。 2025 年发表的研究发现，服用维生素 D2 可以降低维生素 D3 的水平，维生素 D3 是人体皮肤暴露在阳光下时自然产生的形式。

paras.en: That distinction matters because vitamin D2 and vitamin D3 are often treated as interchangeable sources of the same nutrient. Both can increase overall vitamin D status, but a growing body of evidence indicates that D3 is generally more effective at raising and maintaining the main form of vitamin D measured in the blood. Current guidance from the U.S. National Institutes of Health reflects that evidence, noting that D3 tends to raise vitamin D levels more and keep them elevated for longer than D2.
paras.zh: 这种区别很重要，因为维生素 D2 和维生素 D3 通常被视为同一营养素的可互换来源。两者都可以提高维生素 D 的整体状况，但越来越多的证据表明，D3 在提高和维持血液中维生素 D 的主要形式方面通常更有效。美国国立卫生研究院目前的指导意见反映了这一证据，指出 D3 往往比 D2 更能提高维生素 D 水平，并使其保持在较高水平的时间更长。

paras.en: Vitamin D is essential for helping the body absorb calcium and maintain healthy bones. It also plays roles in muscle, nerve, and immune function. In the UK, people are advised to consider taking 10 micrograms (µg) of vitamin D each day during the darker months, when sunlight is generally too weak for the skin to make enough of the vitamin.
paras.zh: 维生素 D 对于帮助身体吸收钙和维持骨骼健康至关重要。它还在肌肉、神经和免疫功能中发挥作用。在英国，建议人们考虑在天色较暗的月份每天服用 10 微克 (μg) 维生素 D，此时阳光通常太弱，皮肤无法生成足够的维生素。

paras.en: Vitamin D2 and D3 Are Not Quite the Same
paras.zh: 维生素 D2 和 D3 并不完全相同

paras.en: Vitamin D supplements generally contain one of two forms. Vitamin D2, also called ergocalciferol, is commonly produced from fungi or yeast exposed to ultraviolet light. Vitamin D3, or cholecalciferol, is the same form produced in human skin after exposure to ultraviolet B radiation from sunlight.
paras.zh: 维生素 D 补充剂通常包含两种形式之一。维生素 D2，也称为麦角钙化醇，通常由暴露于紫外线的真菌或酵母产生。维生素 D3（或称胆钙化醇）与人体皮肤在暴露于阳光中的紫外线 B 辐射后产生的形式相同。

paras.en: Traditionally, vitamin D3 in supplements has often come from lanolin obtained from sheep's wool. However, animal-free D3 made from sources such as lichen is also available, an important consideration for people following vegan or plant-based diets.
paras.zh: 传统上，补充剂中的维生素 D3 通常来自从羊毛中提取的羊毛脂。然而，也可以使用由地衣等来源制成的非动物源 D3，这对于遵循纯素或植物性饮食的人们来说是一个重要的考虑因素。

paras.en: Once vitamin D enters the body, it goes through several processing steps. The liver converts it into 25-hydroxyvitamin D, the form doctors commonly measure in blood tests to estimate a person's vitamin D status. Vitamin D2 produces 25-hydroxyvitamin D2, while vitamin D3 produces 25-hydroxyvitamin D3.
paras.zh: 维生素 D 进入体内后，会经历几个加工步骤。肝脏将其转化为 25-羟基维生素 D，医生通常在血液检查中测量这种形式，以估计一个人的维生素 D 状况。维生素D2产生25-羟基维生素D2，而维生素D3产生25-羟基维生素D3。

paras.en: It is this D3-derived form that researchers found could fall after people took vitamin D2.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，人们服用维生素 D2 后，这种 D3 衍生形式可能会下降。

paras.en: Vitamin D2 Was Linked to a Drop in Vitamin D3
paras.zh: 维生素 D2 与维生素 D3 下降有关

paras.en: The 2025 study, published in Nutrition Reviews by researchers from the University of Surrey, John Innes Centre and Quadram Institute Bioscience, brought together evidence from randomized controlled trials to examine this effect more closely.
paras.zh: 萨里大学、约翰·英尼斯中心和 Quadram 生物科学研究所的研究人员在《营养评论》上发表了 2025 年的研究，该研究汇集了随机对照试验的证据，以更仔细地检验这种效应。

paras.en: Researchers reviewed 20 studies, with 11 providing data suitable for the main meta-analysis. Compared with people who did not receive vitamin D2, those taking D2 had significantly lower concentrations of 25-hydroxyvitamin D3. Depending on how the results were analyzed, the average reduction was roughly 9 to 18 nanomoles per liter.
paras.zh: 研究人员回顾了 20 项研究，其中 11 项提供了适合主要荟萃分析的数据。与未服用维生素 D2 的人相比，服用 D2 的人的 25-羟基维生素 D3 浓度显着降低。根据结果​​分析方式，平均减少量约为每升 9 至 18 纳摩尔。

paras.en: Importantly, that does not mean vitamin D2 simply removes vitamin D from the body or that taking it is necessarily harmful. Vitamin D2 itself raises 25-hydroxyvitamin D2 and can contribute to total vitamin D status. Instead, the surprising finding is that increasing one form appears to coincide with a reduction in the other.
paras.zh: 重要的是，这并不意味着维生素 D2 只会将维生素 D 从体内清除，也不意味着服用它一定有害。维生素 D2 本身可提高 25-羟基维生素 D2，有助于提高维生素 D 总量。相反，令人惊讶的发现是，一种形式的增加似乎与另一种形式的减少同时发生。

paras.en: Emily Brown, PhD Research Fellow and Lead Researcher of the study from the University of Surrey's Nutrition, Exercise, Chronobiology & Sleep Discipline, said:
paras.zh: 萨里大学营养、运动、时间生物学和睡眠学科的博士研究员兼首席研究员 Emily Brown 表示：

paras.en: "Vitamin D supplements are important, especially between October and March, when our bodies cannot make vitamin D from sunlight in the UK. However, we discovered that vitamin D2 supplements can actually decrease levels of vitamin D3 in the body, which is a previously unknown effect of taking these supplements. This study suggests that subject to personal considerations, vitamin D3 supplements may be more beneficial for most individuals over vitamin D2."
paras.zh: “维生素 D 补充剂很重要，特别是在 10 月到 3 月期间，在英国，我们的身体无法从阳光中制造维生素 D。然而，我们发现维生素 D2 补充剂实际上可以降低体内维生素 D3 的水平，这是服用这些补充剂之前未知的效果。这项研究表明，根据个人考虑，维生素 D3 补充剂对大多数人来说可能比维生素 D2 更有益。”

paras.en: Scientists do not yet have a definitive explanation.
paras.zh: 科学家们还没有一个明确的解释。

paras.en: One possibility involves the body's mechanisms for regulating vitamin D. When concentrations of vitamin D metabolites rise, the body may accelerate the breakdown and removal of these compounds to keep levels under control. Researchers have proposed that increasing vitamin D2 could therefore increase the disposal of existing 25-hydroxyvitamin D3.
paras.zh: 一种可能性涉及人体调节维生素 D 的机制。当维生素 D 代谢物浓度升高时，人体可能会加速这些化合物的分解和清除，以控制水平。研究人员提出，增加维生素 D2 可能会增加现有 25-羟基维生素 D3 的消耗。

paras.en: Earlier experiments have also suggested that the relationship may work in both directions, with D3 supplementation sometimes reducing D2-derived metabolites. Exactly how important this balancing effect is for health remains unresolved.
paras.zh: 早期的实验还表明，这种关系可能是双向的，补充 D3 有时会减少 D2 衍生的代谢物。这种平衡效应对健康到底有多重要仍然悬而未决。

paras.en: Professor Cathie Martin, Group Leader at the John Innes Centre, said:
paras.zh: 约翰·英尼斯中心小组组长凯西·马丁教授说：

paras.en: "This meta-analysis highlights the importance of ensuring plant-based vitamin D3 is accessible in the UK."
paras.zh: “这项荟萃分析强调了确保英国可以获得植物性维生素 D3 的重要性。”

paras.en: That goal has become increasingly practical because plant-based and animal-free sources of vitamin D3 are now available, including D3 derived from lichen.
paras.zh: 这一目标变得越来越实际，因为现在可以使用植物性和非动物性维生素 D3 来源，包括从地衣中提取的 D3。

paras.en: D3 May Affect the Immune System Differently
paras.zh: D3 可能对免疫系统产生不同的影响

paras.en: The findings also fit with earlier work suggesting that D2 and D3 may not have identical effects beyond their ability to raise vitamin D levels.
paras.zh: 这些发现也符合早期的研究结果，表明 D2 和 D3 除了提高维生素 D 水平的能力之外，可能没有相同的作用。

paras.en: A study published in Frontiers in Immunology and led by Professor Colin Smith from the University of Surrey examined how supplementation affected gene activity in the blood. The researchers found substantial differences between the responses to D2 and D3, including changes involving the immune system. In particular, vitamin D3 appeared to stimulate activity associated with type I interferon signaling, while vitamin D2 did not.
paras.zh: 由萨里大学科林·史密斯教授领导的一项发表在《免疫学前沿》上的研究研究了补充剂如何影响血液中的基因活性。研究人员发现 D2 和 D3 的反应存在显着差异，包括涉及免疫系统的变化。特别是，维生素 D3 似乎可以刺激与 I 型干扰素信号传导相关的活性，而维生素 D2 则不然。

paras.en: Type I interferons are signaling proteins that help alert cells when an infection is developing and form an important part of the body's early defenses against viruses and other pathogens.
paras.zh: I 型干扰素是信号蛋白，有助于在感染发生时向细胞发出警报，并构成人体针对病毒和其他病原体的早期防御的重要组成部分。

paras.en: "We have shown that vitamin D3, but not vitamin D2, appears to stimulate the type I interferon signaling system in the body -- a key part of the immune system that provides a first line of defense against bacteria and viruses. Thus, a healthy vitamin D3 status may help prevent viruses and bacteria from gaining a foothold in the body."
paras.zh: “我们已经证明，维生素 D3 而不是维生素 D2 似乎可以刺激体内的 I 型干扰素信号系统，这是免疫系统的关键部分，提供抵御细菌和病毒的第一道防线。因此，健康的维生素 D3 状态可能有助于防止病毒和细菌在体内立足。”

paras.en: The immune findings are intriguing, but they should not be interpreted as proof that taking D3 will prevent a particular infection. Changes in gene activity and immune signaling do not necessarily translate directly into fewer illnesses, and larger clinical studies are needed to establish what the differences mean for everyday health.
paras.zh: 免疫研究结果很有趣，但它们不应被解释为服用 D3 可以预防特定感染的证据。基因活性和免疫信号的变化并不一定会直接转化为更少的疾病，需要更大规模的临床研究来确定这些差异对日常健康意味着什么。

paras.en: Research published since the 2025 analysis makes the picture more nuanced.
paras.zh: 自 2025 年分析以来发布的研究使情况变得更加微妙。

paras.en: A separate 2026 systematic review and meta-analysis examined 26 randomized trials involving vitamin D2. It found that D2 supplementation significantly reduced parathyroid hormone levels and produced a small increase in blood calcium, demonstrating that D2 continues to have meaningful biological effects even though it may reduce circulating D3.
paras.zh: 2026 年的一项单独系统回顾和荟萃分析检查了 26 项涉及维生素 D2 的随机试验。研究发现，补充 D2 显着降低了甲状旁腺激素水平，并使血钙略有增加，这表明 D2 仍然具有有意义的生物效应，尽管它可能会减少循环 D3。

paras.en: That finding is important because the reduction in D3 should not be confused with evidence that D2 is ineffective. Current NIH information continues to state that both D2 and D3 can increase overall blood levels of vitamin D. The difference is that the accumulated evidence favors D3 for producing a larger increase and maintaining that increase for longer.
paras.zh: 这一发现很重要，因为 D3 的减少不应与 D2 无效的证据相混淆。目前 NIH 的信息继续表明，D2 和 D3 都可以提高血液中维生素 D 的总体水平。不同之处在于，积累的证据有利于 D3 产生更大的增加并维持更长时间。

paras.en: This is also consistent with previous meta-analyses comparing the two forms directly. One analysis of 24 studies found D3 was more effective than D2 at improving overall vitamin D status, while another focused on frequent dosing reached a similar conclusion.
paras.zh: 这也与之前直接比较两种形式的荟萃分析一致。一项对 24 项研究的分析发现，D3 在改善整体维生素 D 状态方面比 D2 更有效，而另一项针对频繁服用的研究也得出了类似的结论。

paras.en: Scientists Still Need to Know What the Difference Means
paras.zh: 科学家仍然需要知道差异意味着什么

paras.en: The central unanswered question is not whether D2 can reduce circulating D3. The randomized trial evidence strongly suggests that it can. What remains uncertain is whether that reduction produces meaningful differences in health outcomes.
paras.zh: 未解答的核心问题不是 D2 是否可以减少循环 D3。随机试验证据强烈表明它可以。目前尚不确定的是，这种减少是否会对健康结果产生有意义的差异。

paras.en: Researchers say additional studies are needed to determine how D2 and D3 are metabolized, whether their effects on immune function meaningfully differ, and whether D3 should become the preferred form for routine supplementation when there is no individual reason to use D2.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，需要进行更多研究来确定 D2 和 D3 的代谢方式、它们对免疫功能的影响是否存在显着差异，以及当没有个人理由使用 D2 时，D3 是否应该成为常规补充剂的首选形式。

paras.en: Professor Martin Warren, Chief Scientific Officer at the Quadram Institute, said:
paras.zh: Quadram 研究所首席科学官 Martin Warren 教授表示：

paras.en: "Vitamin D deficiency represents a significant public health concern, especially during the winter months with significant deficiency across the UK population. This collaborative research effort aligns well with the Quadram Institute's mission to deliver healthier lives through food innovation to enhance the nutrient density of the food we eat. Tackling this with the most effective form of vitamin D supplementation or fortification is of the utmost importance to the health of the nation."
paras.zh: “维生素 D 缺乏是一个重大的公共卫生问题，特别是在英国人口严重缺乏的冬季。这项合作研究工作与 Quadram Institute 的使命非常契合，即通过食品创新提高我们所吃食物的营养密度，从而提供更健康的生活。通过最有效的维生素 D 补充剂或强化形式来解决这一问题对于国家的健康至关重要。”

paras.en: For now, the evidence increasingly suggests that the label on a vitamin D supplement matters. D2 and D3 can both contribute to vitamin D status, but they are not necessarily metabolically interchangeable, and D3 appears to have an advantage when the goal is raising and sustaining vitamin D levels. What scientists still need to establish is whether those biochemical differences translate into important differences in long-term health.
paras.zh: 目前，越来越多的证据表明维生素 D 补充剂的标签很重要。 D2 和 D3 都有助于维持维生素 D 状态，但它们在代谢上不一定可以互换，当目标是提高和维持维生素 D 水平时，D3 似乎更有优势。科学家们仍需要确定的是，这些生化差异是否会转化为长期健康的重要差异。
