paras.zh: - 没有天空？现在就立即访问📺

paras.en: Speaking on his own stream, Van Gerwen said he was "annoyed" at his recent Grand Prix result that he believes he should have won.
paras.zh: 范格文在自己的直播中表示，他对最近的大奖赛结果感到“恼火”，他认为自己应该获胜。

paras.en: However, speaking on the Love the Darts podcast, Colin Lloyd admitted he was worried that the Dutchman no longer had the "fire" and if he took a break, he may not return.
paras.zh: 然而，科林·劳埃德在《Love the Darts》播客上发表讲话时承认，他担心荷兰人不再有“火力”，如果他休息一下，他可能不会回来。

paras.en: "It was a free hit. I don't want to say he wasn't ready for it, but he didn't look comfortable," Lloyd said.
paras.zh: “这是一次免费的打击。我不想说他还没有准备好，但他看起来不太舒服，”劳埃德说。

paras.en: "There has been some odd results throughout the last six to eight months where you think everything seems to be going well.
paras.zh: “过去六到八个月出现了一些奇怪的结果，你认为一切似乎都进展顺利。

paras.en: "Michael has had a lot going on in his private life. He loves spending time with his kids and whatever. Perhaps just that little bit of hunger's gone. That little bit of hunger's gone.
paras.zh: “迈克尔的私生活发生了很多事情。他喜欢与孩子们共度时光等等。也许只是一点点饥饿消失了。那一点点饥饿消失了。

paras.en: "There's no question that Michael's still a class player but it is just a case of - when you start losing that little bit of hunger and you lose that little bit of fire in you.
paras.zh: “毫无疑问，迈克尔仍然是一名一流的球员，但这只是一个例子——当你开始失去一点点饥饿感，你就会失去一点点内心的热情。

paras.en: "I don't personally believe that if Michael van Gerwen steps away, you won't see Michael van Gerwen come back.
paras.zh: “我个人并不认为如果迈克尔·范格文离开，你就不会看到迈克尔·范格文回来。

paras.en: "He won't come back because financially he's set. He can spend so much more time with the kids and he can put in the odd exhibitions here and there, the odd appearances here and there.
paras.zh: “他不会回来，因为在经济上他已经准备好了。他可以花更多的时间和孩子们在一起，他可以到处举办奇怪的展览，到处奇怪的亮相。

paras.en: "He has been doing it since he was 17. He won the World Masters at 17 years old, which is 20 years ago or whatever it is.
paras.zh: “他从 17 岁起就开始这么做了。他在 17 岁时就赢得了世界大师赛，那已经是 20 年前的事情了。

paras.en: "People will say he is still young enough but he has got battle scars. He has got battle scars from that 17-year-old kid all the way up to now.
paras.zh: “人们会说他还年轻，但他有战斗的伤痕。他从那个17岁的孩子身上一直留下了战斗的伤痕。”

paras.en: "At some point or another, mentally and physically, you think to yourself, do I really need to go through this anymore?"
paras.zh: “在某个时刻，无论是精神上还是身体上，你都会想，我真的需要再经历这一切吗？”

paras.en: It is almost an opposite story for James Wade who has been hitting heights of old over the past year or so.
paras.zh: 对于詹姆斯·韦德来说，这几乎是一个相反的故事，他在过去一年左右的时间里一直在达到以前的高度。

paras.en: He reached the semi-finals of the World Grand Prix for the first time since 2014, picked up his first World Series title at the Australian Darts Masters in August, and won the Flanders Darts Trophy in September which marked his first Euro Tour title in a decade.
paras.zh: 他自2014年以来首次进入世界大奖赛半决赛，8月在澳大利亚飞镖大师赛上获得了他的第一个世界系列赛冠军，并于9月赢得了佛兰德斯飞镖杯，这是他十年来的第一个欧洲巡回赛冠军。

paras.en: Not only that, he has won 14 of his last 16 matches as he continues to show true consistency.
paras.zh: 不仅如此，他在过去 16 场比赛中赢得了 14 场，因为他继续表现出真正的稳定性。

paras.en: That is why, for Matt Edgar, Wade is an almost certainty for the Premier League in 2027. Indeed, a dead cert if there is an increase to 10 players from eight.
paras.zh: 这就是为什么，对于马特·埃德加来说，韦德几乎肯定会参加 2027 年的英超联赛。事实上，如果球员数量从 8 名增加到 10 名，这是板上钉钉的事情。

paras.en: "I was going to say Premier League, but it seems every time I mention it in the moment people want say it is too early," Edgar said on the Love the Darts podcast.
paras.zh: “我本来想说英超联赛，但似乎每次我在人们想说的时候提到它还为时过早，”埃德加在“爱飞镖”播客中说道。

paras.en: "I was kind of surprised he wasn't in it this year or at least in the conversation because it was sort of Stephen Bunting and Danny Noppert wasn't in that split decision for the eighth position.
paras.zh: “我有点惊讶他今年没有参加，或者至少没有参加谈话，因为这有点像斯蒂芬·邦廷（Stephen Bunting），而丹尼·诺珀特（Danny Nopert）没有参与第八位的分歧决定。

paras.en: "I was surprised James Wade wasn't in the consideration then. He has to be, he has to be now.
paras.zh: “我很惊讶詹姆斯·韦德当时没有被纳入考虑范围。他必须是，现在也必须是。

paras.en: "There are rumours about the potential growth to 10 players. If that is the case, I think he is a certainty. I think it's a tough argument right now to say he's not.
paras.zh: “有传言说他可能会增加到 10 名球员。如果是这样的话，我认为他是确定的。我认为现在很难说他不是。”

paras.en: "We know the short term and the recency bias kicks in. If he has a poor World Championship, if the back end of the year doesn't go well, people can forget what happens through the rest of the season very quickly."
paras.zh: “我们知道短期内会出现新近偏差。如果他的世界冠军成绩不佳，如果今年年底进展不顺利，人们很快就会忘记本赛季剩余时间会发生什么。”

paras.en: Sky Sports remains the home of darts with the Grand Slam of Darts (November 14-22) and World Darts Championship (December 11-January 3) all live. Stream darts and more through NOW with no contract.

articles.title: An average of 17 older Australians died each day last year waiting for home care
articles.author: Stephanie Dalzell and Paige Cockburn

paras.en: An average of 17 older Australians died every day waiting for home care last year, new figures reveal
paras.zh: 新数据显示，去年平均每天有 17 名澳大利亚老年人在等待家庭护理时死亡

paras.en: More than 6,400 older Australians died while waiting to receive home care last year, an increase of more than a third on the previous year.
paras.zh: 去年，超过 6,400 名澳大利亚老年人在等待接受家庭护理时死亡，比前一年增加了三分之一以上。

paras.en: Advocates have described the figures as an "absolute tragedy".
paras.zh: 支持者将这些数字描述为“绝对的悲剧”。

paras.en: The federal government has been accused by political opponents of trying to hide the figures.
paras.zh: 政治对手指责联邦政府试图隐瞒这些数字。

paras.en: An average of 17 older Australians died while waiting to receive necessary home care each day last year, according to the latest official figures — an increase of more than a third on the previous year.
paras.zh: 根据最新的官方数据，去年平均每天有 17 名澳大利亚老年人在等待接受必要的家庭护理时死亡，比前一年增加了三分之一以上。

paras.en: New data published by the health department revealed 6,436 older Australians approved for Support at Home, but in the queue for funding, died in 2025-26.
paras.zh: 卫生部门公布的新数据显示，2025-26 年，有 6,436 名澳大利亚老年人获准获得家庭支持，但在等待资金的过程中死亡。

paras.en: The figure is an almost 34 per cent increase from the 4,812 people who died while waiting under the former National Priority System for home care packages in the previous year.
paras.zh: 这一数字比去年在前国家优先制度下等待家庭护理包期间死亡的 4,812 人增加了近 34%。

paras.en: However, the figures are not directly comparable, because of the transition from the older system to the current one.
paras.zh: 然而，由于从旧系统到当前系统的过渡，这些数字不能直接比较。

paras.en: "Everybody on the wait list is a person; they're not a statistic or a number,"
paras.zh: “等待名单上的每个人都是一个人；他们不是统计数据或数字，”

paras.en: Shadow Health Minister Anne Ruston said.
paras.zh: 影子卫生部长安妮·鲁斯顿说。

paras.en: The Opposition said the data emerged after the federal government failed to comply with two Senate orders to produce the figures.
paras.zh: 反对党表示，这些数据是在联邦政府未能遵守参议院的两项命令来提供数据后出现的。

paras.en: "Rather than fixing the system, Labor has put its energy into avoiding scrutiny. And it is older Australians and their families who are paying the price," she said.
paras.zh: “工党并没有修复这个制度，而是把精力放在避免审查上。而付出代价的是澳大利亚老年人和他们的家人，”她说。

paras.en: "The extent to which the government tried to hide this information from the public is appalling. The prime minister and his ministers clearly just didn't want older Australians and their families to know the truth."
paras.zh: “政府试图向公众隐瞒这一信息的程度令人震惊。总理和他的部长们显然只是不想让澳大利亚老年人及其家人知道真相。”

paras.en: CEO of the Council on the Ageing Australia, Patricia Sparrow, described the figures as "an absolute tragedy", which demonstrated just how badly the system was keeping up with demand.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚老龄化委员会首席执行官帕特里夏·斯帕罗（Patricia Sparrow）将这些数字描述为“绝对的悲剧”，这表明该系统在满足需求方面有多糟糕。

paras.en: "This shouldn't be happening … there aren't enough packages in the system [and] we need to make sure people can get the package they need within about 30 days of being assessed," she said.
paras.zh: “这种情况不应该发生……系统中没有足够的包裹，我们需要确保人们能够在评估后大约 30 天内获得他们需要的包裹，”她说。

paras.en: Ms Sparrow said when people did not get support at home for basic needs like showering or eating they could end up in hospital or be forced to move into residential aged care sooner.
paras.zh: 斯帕罗女士说，当人们在家中无法获得淋浴或吃饭等基本需求的支持时，他们可能最终会住院或被迫提前进入住宅老年护理中心。

paras.en: "We need to make sure older people are respected … they don't put their hand up for assistance until they really need it," she said.
paras.zh: “我们需要确保老年人受到尊重……除非他们真正需要帮助，否则他们不会伸手寻求帮助，”她说。

paras.en: More than 106,000 Australians were on the official waiting list for a Support at Home place as of June 30.
paras.zh: 截至 6 月 30 日，超过 106,000 名澳大利亚人在家庭支持席位的官方等待名单上。

paras.en: The waitlist, known as the Support At Home priority system, determines how older people are prioritised for funding, and also includes people who are already receiving funding for a lower level of care, and are waiting for a higher level to be allocated.
paras.zh: 等候名单被称为“在家支持优先系统”，它决定了老年人如何优先获得资金，还包括已经获得较低级别护理资金并正在等待分配较高级别护理的人。

paras.en: In August, Four Corners revealed the true number of people waiting for full aged care funding at home was almost 154,000.
paras.zh: 八月份，《四角》透露，在家等待全额老年护理资金的真实人数接近 154,000 人。

paras.en: In May, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese conceded the state of aged care in Australia was "not good enough", after a report revealed patients were waiting an average of a year for services.
paras.zh: 今年五月，在一份报告显示患者平均等待服务一年的时间后，总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯承认澳大利亚的老年护理状况“不够好”。

paras.en: The federal government was also accused of burying that report by its political opponents, quietly dropping it during budget-lock up.
paras.zh: 联邦政府还被政治对手指责埋葬该报告，并在预算锁定期间悄悄放弃该报告。

paras.en: Last year, a Senate inquiry into aged care services heard from the families of people who died while waiting for support, including one Hobart man with Parkinson's and cancer who waited over 12 months for a home care package.
paras.zh: 去年，参议院对老年护理服务进行了一项调查，听取了在等待支持过程中去世的人的家属的意见，其中包括一名患有帕金森氏症和癌症的霍巴特男子，他等待家庭护理包已超过 12 个月。

paras.en: His package was approved three days before his death.
paras.zh: 他的方案在他去世前三天获得批准。

paras.en: Independent Senator David Pocock said the data was "shocking but sadly not surprising".
paras.zh: 独立参议员戴维·波科克表示，这些数据“令人震惊，但遗憾的是并不令人惊讶”。

paras.en: "The Senate has been pushing the government hard for years to improve the care we're providing to older Australians. Time and again the aged care minister has dismissed and deflected and ultimately failed these older Australians and their families. It is unacceptable," he said.
paras.zh: “参议院多年来一直在努力敦促政府改善我们为澳大利亚老年人提供的护理。老年护理部长一次又一次地忽视和转移注意力，最终让这些澳大利亚老年人及其家人失望。这是不可接受的，”他说。

paras.en: "I am also dismayed that this data is released quietly and in a way that is hard to find. Even though it tells a grim story, older Australians and their family still deserve transparency from the government on the state of affairs."
paras.zh: “我也感到沮丧的是，这些数据是以一种很难找到的方式悄悄发布的。尽管它讲述了一个严峻的故事，澳大利亚老年人及其家人仍然应该获得政府对事态的透明度。”

paras.en: Aged Care Minister Sam Rae said the rate of people who died waiting for Support at Home was "significantly lower than the rate of death for older Australians in the broader population".
paras.zh: 老年护理部长 Sam Rae 表示，等待在家中获得支持的死亡人数“明显低于广大人口中澳大利亚老年人的死亡率”。

paras.en: "Every single death of someone who is waiting for care is a tragedy. My thoughts and condolences are with every family who has lost a loved one," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“每一个等待护理的人的死亡都是一场悲剧。我对每一个失去亲人的家庭表示哀悼和哀悼。”

paras.en: Mr Rae said while there was "more work to do" the government had delivered an additional 83,000 home care places in 2025-26, with a further 32,000 rolling out this year.
paras.zh: Rae 先生表示，虽然“还有更多工作要做”，但政府已在 2025-26 年额外提供 83,000 个家庭护理名额，今年还将再提供 32,000 个。

articles.title: Breaking: Sam Wood denied bail on DV charges after allegedly choking wife
articles.author: Josh Dye and Madeline Grace

paras.en: Sam Wood was charged with the domestic violence offence of assault occasioning bodily harm and strangulation in a domestic setting in Noosa on Saturday.
paras.zh: 周六，萨姆·伍德在努萨的家庭环境中被指控犯有家庭暴力罪，即在家庭环境中袭击造成身体伤害和勒死。

paras.en: He appeared in Maroochydore Magistrates Court via video link on Thursday.
paras.zh: 周四，他通过视频链接出现在马卢奇郡地方法院。

paras.en: Mr Woods has been remanded in custody until November 23.
paras.zh: 伍兹先生已被还押至 11 月 23 日。

paras.en: Prominent fitness influencer and reality TV personality Sam Wood has been denied bail on domestic violence charges.
paras.zh: 著名健身影响者和真人秀名人萨姆·伍德因家庭暴力指控被拒绝保释。

paras.en: His lawyer told the Maroochydore Magistrates Court today Mr Wood "may be entitled to the self defence argument".
paras.zh: 他的律师今天告诉马卢奇郡地方法院，伍德先生“可能有权进行自卫论证”。

paras.en: "Mr Wood's depression is regarded as extremely severe," Mathew Cuskelly told the court, citing an affidavit by Professor Ian Coyle, a forensic psychologist.
paras.zh: “伍德先生的抑郁症被认为极其严重，”马修·卡凯利在法庭上援引法医心理学家伊恩·科伊尔教授的证词说道。

paras.en: "He ought to be given the chance to engage with mental health professionals to try to salvage something of his professional reputation and career, which is taking a hell of a beating at the moment."
paras.zh: “他应该有机会与心理健康专家接触，以试图挽救他目前遭受重创的职业声誉和职业生涯。”

paras.en: Police allege Mr Wood became involved in a family argument in Noosa on Saturday night before he assaulted and choked his wife.
paras.zh: 警方称，伍德先生周六晚上在努萨卷入了一场家庭争吵，然后袭击并掐死了他的妻子。

paras.en: "The victim refers to she thought she was going to die, and she was in fear of her safety," prosecutor Sergeant Jeanette Grigoris told the court on Thursday afternoon.
paras.zh: 检察官珍妮特·格里戈里斯警长周四下午在法庭上表示：“受害者表示，她以为自己快要死了，她担心自己的安全。”

paras.en: Sergeant Grigoris told the court the complainant's video recorded statement was "strong evidence".
paras.zh: 格里戈里斯警长告诉法庭，申诉人的视频记录陈述是“有力的证据”。

paras.en: "She does articulate there's choking … banging of her head on the floor, she couldn't breathe. The defendant only stopped when one of the children called out," Sergeant Grigoris said.
paras.zh: 格里戈里斯警官说：“她确实明确表示感到窒息……她的头撞在地板上，她无法呼吸。直到其中一个孩子大声喊叫，被告才停下来。”

paras.en: Mr Wood's adult stepdaughter made a Triple Zero call to police to report the alleged incident, the prosecution told the court.
paras.zh: 检方告诉法庭，伍德先生的成年继女向警方拨打了“三个零”电话，报告了这起事件。

paras.en: "He essentially agrees with the prosecution's case but minimises the offending … He's essentially victim-blamed."
paras.zh: “他基本上同意检方的观点，但将冒犯行为最小化……他本质上是受害人的指责。”

paras.en: In opposing bail, the prosecution tended photographs of the victim's injuries as evidence, as well as a statement from a responding paramedic.
paras.zh: 在反对保释的过程中，检方出示了受害人受伤的照片作为证据，以及一名护理人员的陈述。

paras.en: Sergeant Grigoris said the complainant is "in support of the criminal charges".
paras.zh: 格里戈里斯警官表示，申诉人“支持刑事指控”。

paras.en: "[Mr Wood] was here on holidays … there is that risk he will not return to face the charges before the court," she told the court.
paras.zh: “[伍德先生]来这里度假……他有可能不会回来接受法庭指控，”她告诉法庭。

paras.en: "He does have the resources to essentially flee the jurisdiction."
paras.zh: “他确实有足够的资源逃离司法管辖区。”

paras.en: Mr Cuskelly said his client has "no prior criminal offending".
paras.zh: 卡凯利先生表示，他的当事人“没有犯罪记录”。

paras.en: "At 46 years old, this is his first interaction with the criminal justice system."
paras.zh: “46 岁了，这是他第一次接触刑事司法系统。”

paras.en: Mr Wood appeared via video link from custody.
paras.zh: 伍德先生通过视频链接从拘留所出庭。

paras.en: He was unshaven and wearing a dark green long sleeve shirt with his sleeves rolled up.
paras.zh: 他胡子拉碴，身穿深绿色长袖衬衫，袖子挽起。

paras.en: He sat quietly with a neutral expression throughout the hearing, before sitting with his head bowed while the magistrate spoke.
paras.zh: 在整个听证过程中，他一直保持着中立的表情，安静地坐着，然后在法官发言时低着头坐着。

paras.en: When the decision was delivered, Mr Wood put his head in his hands.
paras.zh: 当决定作出时，伍德先生双手抱头。

paras.en: He was remanded in custody until November 23.
paras.zh: 他被还押候审至11月23日。

articles.title: Charges dropped against 12yo after alleged bashing of Sunshine shopkeeper
articles.author: Kristian Silva

paras.en: Assault charges against a 12-year-old boy, laid after an alleged fatal bashing in Sunshine, have been dropped by prosecutors.
paras.zh: 检方撤销了对一名 12 岁男孩的袭击指控，该男孩涉嫌在 Sunshine 被殴打致死。

paras.en: Prosecutors conceded they could not prove the boy was criminally liable in the alleged assault due to his young age.
paras.zh: 检察官承认，由于男孩年龄较小，他们无法证明该男孩在涉嫌袭击事件中负有刑事责任。

paras.en: Three other teenagers still face charges over the alleged attack in August.
paras.zh: 另外三名青少年仍因八月份的袭击事件而面临指控。

paras.en: Prosecutors have dropped the case against a 12-year-old boy who was charged after the alleged fatal bashing of Sunshine shopkeeper Van Viet Truong.
paras.zh: 检察官撤销了对一名 12 岁男孩的起诉，该男孩因涉嫌殴打 Sunshine 店主 Van Viet Truong 致人死亡而受到指控。

paras.en: Mr Truong, 60, was allegedly attacked by a group of youths on August 2 after coming to the aid of a fellow retail worker. He died in hospital days later.
paras.zh: 据称，60 岁的 Truong 先生于 8 月 2 日在帮助一名零售同事后遭到一群年轻人的袭击。几天后他在医院去世。

paras.en: Mr Truong ran the Hong Hung Asian Grocery for nearly three decades, and was a well-known figure in his local business community.
paras.zh: Truong 先生经营 Hong Hung 亚洲杂货店近三十年，是当地商界的知名人物。

paras.en: Five children were initially arrested, however charges only remain against three.
paras.zh: 五名儿童最初被捕，但仅对三名儿童提出指控。

paras.en: Today, prosecutors withdrew charges of violent disorder, affray and two assault-related charges against the 12-year-old boy, conceding they could not prove he was criminally liable.
paras.zh: 今天，检察官撤回了对这名 12 岁男孩的暴力骚乱、斗殴和两项与袭击相关的指控，承认他们无法证明他负有刑事责任。

paras.en: The doli incapax legal principles presumes children younger than 14 are incapable of criminal intent.
paras.zh: 无犯罪能力法律原则假定 14 岁以下的儿童没有犯罪意图。

paras.en: In order for the case to have continued, prosecutors would have needed to prove the boy knew his alleged actions were morally wrong.
paras.zh: 为了让案件继续审理，检察官需要证明男孩知道他所指控的行为在道德上是错误的。

paras.en: A prosecutor told the Children's Court that the case had been reviewed and the Crown would not be able to successfully rebut the Doli Incapax presumption.
paras.zh: 一名检察官告诉儿童法院，该案已经过审查，检方无法成功反驳多利无能力的推定。

paras.en: "The prosecution will have to withdraw the charges," she said.
paras.zh: “检方将不得不撤回指控，”她说。

paras.en: In a statement, Victoria Police said advice from the Director of Public Prosecutions confirmed there were "no reasonable prospects of conviction" in relation to the boy due to the presumption at law that a child who is 12 or 13 is not criminally responsible for their actions.
paras.zh: 维多利亚警方在一份声明中表示，检察长的建议证实，由于法律推定 12 岁或 13 岁的儿童不对其行为承担刑事责任，因此该男孩“没有合理的定罪前景”。

paras.en: "The family of the victim has been notified and we will continue to support them throughout this process. Our thoughts are with them today," a Victoria Police spokesperson said.
paras.zh: 维多利亚警方发言人表示：“受害者家属已收到通知，我们将在整个过程中继续支持他们。今天我们的心与他们同在。”

paras.en: Three other teenagers to face court over alleged assault
paras.zh: 另外三名青少年因涉嫌袭击而出庭受审

paras.en: The case against the other teenagers will continue.
paras.zh: 针对其他青少年的案件将继续进行。

paras.en: A 15-year-old is accused of manslaughter, while two 14-year-old girls are charged with violent disorder, affray and assault-related offences.
paras.zh: 一名 15 岁的青少年被指控犯有过失杀人罪，而两名 14 岁的女孩则被指控犯有暴力骚乱、斗殴和袭击相关罪行。

paras.en: Last month, a police officer told the court the alleged attack on Mr Troung was captured on security cameras.
paras.zh: 上个月，一名警官告诉法庭，安全摄像头拍下了对特龙先生的所谓袭击。

paras.en: "The entire incident goes for approximately one minute so it's quite chaotic," she said.
paras.zh: “整个事件持续了大约一分钟，所以非常混乱，”她说。

paras.en: The lawyer for the 12-year-old said his involvement was "secondary".
paras.zh: 这名 12 岁男孩的律师表示，他的参与是“次要的”。

paras.en: He said the education department had blocked the Year 6 student from returning to school while the case was before the courts.
paras.zh: 他说，在案件提交法庭审理期间，教育部门阻止了这名六年级学生返回学校。

paras.en: "It is having an enormous impact on him," he said.
paras.zh: “这对他产生了巨大的影响，”他说。

paras.en: The 15-year-old charged with manslaughter is due to face court next on October 21.
paras.zh: 这名被控过失杀人罪的 15 岁男子将于 10 月 21 日出庭。

paras.en: The 14-year-old girls remain on bail after being released in August.
paras.zh: 这两名 14 岁女孩于 8 月获释后仍处于保释状态。

articles.title: Isaias expected to become hurricane before hitting U.S. Gulf Coast, forecasters say

paras.en: Isaias expected to become hurricane before hitting U.S. Gulf Coast, forecasters say
paras.zh: 预报员称，伊萨亚斯预计将在袭击美国墨西哥湾沿岸之前成为飓风

paras.en: Landfall forecast as soon as Friday evening
paras.zh: 预计周五晚上将有登陆

paras.en: Tropical Storm Isaias formed Wednesday in the warm waters off eastern Mexico and forecasters predicted it will quickly strengthen into the first hurricane of the Atlantic season before striking the U.S. Gulf Coast later in the week.
paras.zh: 热带风暴伊萨亚斯周三在墨西哥东部温暖的水域形成，预报员预测它将迅速增强为大西洋季节的第一场飓风，然后在本周晚些时候袭击美国墨西哥湾沿岸。

paras.en: Communities in the potential path of Isaias moved quickly to prepare, with landfall forecast as soon as Friday evening. Some Gulf oil wells paused production and an Alabama beach city cancelled a weekend festival known to draw thousands of tourists. Governors in Florida and Alabama declared a state of emergency for dozens of counties.
paras.zh: 伊萨亚斯潜在路径上的社区迅速采取行动做好准备，预计周五晚上就会登陆。一些海湾油井暂停生产，阿拉巴马州的一座海滨城市取消了吸引数千游客的周末节日。佛罗里达州和阿拉巴马州州长宣布数十个县进入紧急状态。

paras.en: As it moves inland, Isaias might also disrupt Saturday's college football showdown between rivals Georgia and Alabama, which U.S. President Donald Trump has planned to attend.
paras.zh: 随着它向内陆移动，伊萨亚斯还可能扰乱周六乔治亚州和阿拉巴马州之间的大学橄榄球对决，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普计划参加这场比赛。

paras.en: Isaias could become a major Category 3 hurricane, with winds of 178 km/h or stronger, before it strikes land, said Michael Brennan, director of the U.S. National Hurricane Center.
paras.zh: 美国国家飓风中心主任迈克尔·布伦南 (Michael Brennan) 表示，伊萨亚斯在登陆之前可能会成为 3 级飓风，风速可达每小时 178 公里或更强。

paras.en: "We're expecting multiple dangerous, life-threatening impacts along portions of the northern Gulf Coast beginning Friday and continuing into the weekend," Brennan said in a video briefing Wednesday.
paras.zh: 布伦南在周三的视频简报中说：“我们预计从周五开始，墨西哥湾北部海岸部分地区将出现多次危险的、危及生命的影响，并持续到周末。”

paras.en: The storm was on track to tie or break a 121-year-old record as the latest arriving initial hurricane of the Atlantic season. According to the U.S. National Weather Service, the record dates to 1905, when the year's first Atlantic hurricane formed on Oct. 8.
paras.zh: 这场风暴有望追平或打破 121 年的记录，成为大西洋季节最晚抵达的初飓风。据美国国家气象局称，这一记录可以追溯到 1905 年，当年的第一场大西洋飓风于 10 月 8 日形成。

paras.en: The Atlantic hurricane season has been unusually quiet this year due to a strong El Niño, which disrupts storm formation over that ocean. Storm activity in the Pacific has been above average, where Tropical Storm Simon also formed Wednesday off Mexico.
paras.zh: 由于强烈的厄尔尼诺现象扰乱了大西洋上空的风暴形成，今年大西洋飓风季节异常平静。太平洋的风暴活动高于平均水平，周三热带风暴西蒙也在墨西哥附近形成。

paras.en: The Miami-based hurricane centre on Wednesday issued a hurricane watch for the northern Gulf Coast from Bay St. Louis, Mississippi, to Indian Pass on the Florida Panhandle. The watch means hurricane conditions are possible within 48 hours.
paras.zh: 总部位于迈阿密的飓风中心周三对从密西西比州圣路易斯湾到佛罗里达狭长地带印第安山口的墨西哥湾北部海岸发布了飓风警报。该手表意味着 48 小时内可能出现飓风。

paras.en: - Polo makes 2nd landfall on Mexico's Pacific coast
paras.zh: - 波罗在墨西哥太平洋海岸第二次登陆

paras.en: - Southwestern Mexico braces for arrival of 'extremely dangerous' Hurricane Polo
paras.zh: - 墨西哥西南部准备迎接“极其危险”的飓风波罗的到来

paras.en: Brennan says dangerous storm surge could affect an even wider area, from southeast Louisiana to Florida's Big Bend. Heavy rains of seven to 15 centimetres could trigger flash flooding near the coast, with accumulations of three to eight centimetres as far inland as Tennessee and the western Carolinas.
paras.zh: 布伦南说，危险的风暴潮可能会影响更广泛的地区，从路易斯安那州东南部到佛罗里达州大本德。 7至15厘米的大雨可能会在海岸附近引发山洪，田纳西州和卡罗莱纳州西部的内陆地区积水量可达3至8厘米。

paras.en: Isaias was centred about 365 kilometres northwest of Progreso, Mexico, and about 805 kilometres south-southwest of the mouth of the Mississippi River, according to the hurricane centre. It had maximum sustained winds of 100 km/h and was moving east-northeast at 13 km/h.
paras.zh: 据飓风中心称，伊萨亚斯的中心位于墨西哥普罗格雷索西北约 365 公里处，密西西比河河口西南偏南约 805 公里处。最大持续风速为 100 公里/小时，并以 13 公里/小时的速度向东北偏东移动。

paras.en: Forecasters predict Isaias will become a hurricane by Thursday as it turns north toward the U.S. Gulf Coast. Though its path and timing could shift, the storm is expected to make landfall late Friday or early Saturday.
paras.zh: 预报员预测，伊萨亚斯将在周四向北转向美国墨西哥湾沿岸，成为飓风。尽管其路径和时间可能会发生变化，但预计风暴将于周五晚些时候或周六早些时候登陆。

paras.en: Isaias is expected to strike along a wide swath of coastline that's no stranger to major hurricanes. One of the 20th century's worst storms, Hurricane Camille, killed more than 250 people after hitting land near Waveland, Miss., in 1969.
paras.zh: 预计伊萨亚斯将袭击大片海岸线，而这些海岸线对大型飓风来说并不陌生。 20 世纪最严重的风暴之一卡米尔飓风于 1969 年袭击密西西比州韦夫兰附近的陆地，造成 250 多人死亡。

paras.en: Hurricane Katrina in 2005 razed neighbourhoods in Mississippi, flooded New Orleans and killed nearly 1,400 people. And Hurricane Michael levelled homes and buildings near Panama City, Fla., in 2018.
paras.zh: 2005 年卡特里娜飓风摧毁了密西西比州的街区，淹没了新奥尔良，造成近 1,400 人死亡。 2018 年，迈克尔飓风摧毁了佛罗里达州巴拿马城附近的房屋和建筑物。

paras.en: Gulf oil production, tourism already affected
paras.zh: 海湾石油生产、旅游业已受到影响

paras.en: Ahead of the storm, oil and gas producers shut down a significant share of offshore production in the Gulf, which accounts for almost 15 per cent of crude pumped annually in the U.S.
paras.zh: 风暴来临之前，石油和天然气生产商关闭了海湾地区很大一部分海上生产设施，该地区的原油产量几乎占美国每年开采原油量的 15%。

paras.en: As of Wednesday, producers had temporarily halted about 25 per cent of the oil produced in the region, taking about 511,000 barrels a day off the market, according to the Marine Minerals Administration. It said eight of the Gulf's 371 manned oil platforms had been evacuated.
paras.zh: 据海洋矿产管理局称，截至周三，生产商已暂时停止该地区约 25% 的石油生产，每天从市场上减少约 511,000 桶石油。据称，海湾地区 371 个载人石油平台中的 8 个已被疏散。

paras.en: With oil prices already high, the production cuts are steep enough to affect oil markets, though other Gulf hurricanes have caused larger disruptions, said Jim Burkhard, global head of crude oil market research for S&P Global Energy. More concerning, he said, is whether Isaias strikes as a powerful storm near refineries.
paras.zh: 标准普尔全球能源原油市场研究全球主管吉姆·伯克哈德表示，由于油价已经很高，减产幅度足以影响石油市场，尽管其他海湾飓风造成了更大的破坏。他说，更令人担忧的是，伊萨亚斯是否会像一场强大的风暴一样袭击炼油厂。

paras.en: "I would characterize the oil market risk as moderate, but rising," Burkhard said in an email.
paras.zh: 伯克哈德在一封电子邮件中表示：“我将石油市场风险描述为温和，但正在上升。”

paras.en: In Gulf Shores, Ala., the storm threat caused organizers to cancel the National Shrimp Festival scheduled for Thursday through the weekend. The event drew an estimated 325,000 people last year.
paras.zh: 在阿拉巴马州格尔夫海岸，风暴威胁导致组织者取消了原定于周四至周末举行的全国虾节。去年该活动估计吸引了 325,000 人。

paras.en: Alabama Gov. Kay Ivey issued a state of emergency for 40 counties, saying in a post on X, "While I hope for minimal impacts, we must take preparations seriously."
paras.zh: 阿拉巴马州州长凯·艾维 (Kay Ivey) 宣布 40 个县进入紧急状态，他在 X 上发帖称，“虽然我希望影响最小，但我们必须认真做好准备工作。”

paras.en: Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis declared a state of emergency for 25 counties in the Panhandle and Big Bend regions. The declaration activates the state's emergency management plan for hurricanes, allowing officials to deploy disaster responders and equipment. The state is also planning to deploy a Miami-based urban search and rescue task force.
paras.zh: 佛罗里达州州长 Ron DeSantis 宣布 Panhandle 和 Big Bend 地区 25 个县进入紧急状态。该声明启动了该州的飓风应急管理计划，允许官员部署救灾人员和设备。该州还计划在迈阿密部署一支城市搜救工作队。

paras.en: In Pensacola, on the Panhandle, electric utilities were readying crews to quickly repair any power outages. City officials provided sand for residents to fill sandbags to protect their homes against flooding.
paras.zh: 在狭长地带的彭萨科拉，电力公司正在准备工作人员以快速修复停电。市政府官员为居民提供沙子来填充沙袋，以保护他们的房屋免受洪水侵袭。

articles.title: U.S. army moves to execute man convicted in 2009 deadly Fort Hood rampage by firing squad

paras.en: U.S. army moves to execute man convicted in 2009 deadly Fort Hood rampage by firing squad
paras.zh: 美国军队采取行刑队处决因 2009 年胡德堡致命事件而被定罪的男子

paras.en: Few details have been released about who would be part of the firing squad or what procedure they would use
paras.zh: 关于谁将成为行刑队的一部分或他们将使用什么程序的细节尚未公布

paras.en: The former U.S. army officer convicted of killing 13 people in the 2009 shooting rampage at Fort Hood, Texas, is scheduled to be executed by firing squad in December in what would be the first U.S. military execution in more than 65 years.
paras.zh: 这名前美国军官因在 2009 年得克萨斯州胡德堡枪击事件中杀害 13 人而被定罪，计划于 12 月由行刑队处决，这将是美国 65 年来的首次军事处决。

paras.en: Acting secretary of the U.S. army Adam Telle said in a social media post that army Maj. Nidal Malik Hasan will be executed by firing squad on Dec. 3 at Fort Hood. This followed news from the Pentagon that U.S. President Donald Trump had approved the execution.
paras.zh: 美国陆军代理部长亚当·泰勒在社交媒体上发帖称，陆军少校尼达尔·马利克·哈桑将于 12 月 3 日在胡德堡被行刑队处决。此前，五角大楼有消息称，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普已批准执行死刑。

paras.en: The announcement stunned an attorney who had represented Hasan in a civil case, and raised concerns among experts on military law about whether the army followed its mandated process for setting an execution and notifying a prisoner they've been condemned to death.
paras.zh: 这一消息令一名在民事案件中代表哈桑的律师感到震惊，并引起了军事法专家的担忧，他们担心军队是否遵循规定的程序来执行死刑并通知囚犯他们已被判处死刑。

paras.en: It also sparked questions about how a firing squad would be assembled and what procedure it would use. The last time the military executed someone by firing squad was shortly after the Second World War.
paras.zh: 它还引发了关于如何组建行刑队以及将使用什么程序的问题。军队上一次用行刑队处决某人是在第二次世界大战后不久。

paras.en: Here's a look at the military execution process and how experts say this case may proceed.
paras.zh: 以下是军事处决过程以及专家所说的此案可能如何进行的情况。

paras.en: A man and child lay flowers and a balloon outside the front gate of the Fort Hood Army Post in Fort Hood, Texas following the shooting rampage which left 13 people dead in 2009. (Jessica Rinaldi/Reuters)
paras.zh: 2009 年导致 13 人死亡的枪击事件发生后，一名男子和一名儿童在得克萨斯州胡德堡胡德堡陆军哨所的前门外献上鲜花和气球。（杰西卡·里纳尔迪/路透社）

paras.en: Telle confirmed in his post on X that Trump had approved the execution on Oct. 2, starting the clock in army regulations that requires an execution date to be set no sooner than 60 days and no later than 150 days after that approval.
paras.zh: 泰勒在 X 上的帖子中证实，特朗普已于 10 月 2 日批准执行死刑，这是军队规定中规定执行日期不得早于批准后 60 天、不晚于 150 天的规定。

paras.en: Telle also noted that the execution would be carried out by firing squad, but did not offer details of where on base the execution would take place, what personnel would be a part of that squad or what procedure they would follow.
paras.zh: 泰勒还指出，行刑将由行刑队执行，但没有提供行刑将在基地何处进行、行刑队将有哪些人员或他们将遵循什么程序的详细信息。

paras.en: The Associated Press asked both Pentagon officials and the army for more details, but those requests were declined. A message to the army seeking comment on the potential procedural issues was sent Wednesday.
paras.zh: 美联社向五角大楼官员和军方询问更多细节，但遭到拒绝。周三向军方发送了一条信息，寻求对潜在程序问题发表评论。

paras.en: The procedures for execution in army regulations do not contain specific protocols for particular methods of execution. Experts said in previous iterations of the firing squad — nearly 80 years ago — one shooter would be given a blank so they all could plausibly believe they had not fired the fatal shot.
paras.zh: 军队法规中的执行程序不包含特定执行方法的具体协议。专家表示，在近 80 年前的行刑队历次迭代中，一名枪手会被给予空白，这样他们就可以合理地相信自己没有开出致命一枪。

paras.en: Hasan, an army psychiatrist who held the rank of major, walked into a medical building where soldiers were getting checkups, shouted Allahu akbar — Arabic for "God is greater" — and opened fire with a laser-sighted handgun.
paras.zh: 哈桑是一名陆军少校军衔的精神病医生，他走进一栋士兵正在接受检查的医疗大楼，高喊“Allahu akbar”（阿拉伯语，意思是“上帝更伟大”），然后用激光瞄准手枪开枪。

paras.en: He said it was an effort to stop them from going to Afghanistan and killing his fellow Muslims — a defence a military judge barred him from presenting during his trial. Hasan made almost no effort to defend himself in court, telling jurors when he acted as his own counsel that evidence would show he was the shooter and describing himself as a soldier who had "switched sides."
paras.zh: 他说，这是为了阻止他们前往阿富汗杀害他的穆斯林同胞——军事法官禁止他在审判期间提出这一辩护。哈桑在法庭上几乎没有为自己辩护，当他作为自己的律师时告诉陪审员，证据表明他就是枪手，并将自己描述为一名“改变立场”的士兵。

paras.en: "What happens now, is if Dr. Hasan decides he wants to resist execution, he can go to federal civilian court for a Habeas Corpus petition … and that can last years," said Eugene R. Fidell, a visiting lecturer at Yale Law School specializing in military law.
paras.zh: “现在的情况是，如果哈桑博士决定拒绝执行死刑，他可以向联邦民事法院提出人身保护令请愿书……这种情况可以持续数年，”耶鲁大学法学院专门研究军事法的客座讲师尤金·R·菲德尔(Eugene R. Fidell)说。

paras.en: Habeas Corpus is a legal procedure whereby an incarcerated person can challenge the lawfulness of their imprisonment.
paras.zh: 人身保护令是一种法律程序，被监禁者可以通过该程序质疑其监禁的合法性。

paras.en: "It frankly might outlast the current administration, and who knows if the next one will have the same penchant for executions," Fidell said.
paras.zh: 菲德尔说：“坦率地说，它可能比现任政府更长久，谁知道下一届政府是否也会有同样的处决倾向。”

paras.en: Trump resumed the federal death penalty after an informal moratorium during previous administrations. The federal government executed 13 people between 2020 and early 2021, contributing to making Trump the most prolific execution president in over 130 years.
paras.zh: 在历届政府非正式暂停执行死刑后，特朗普恢复了联邦死刑。 2020 年至 2021 年初，联邦政府处决了 13 人，使特朗普成为 130 多年来执行死刑最多的总统。

paras.en: Death sentences are extremely rare in the military justice system and executions even rarer. Four men, including Hasan, are currently on the military's death row at Fort Leavenworth, Kan., and the last execution that took place there was a hanging in 1961.
paras.zh: 军事司法系统中死刑判决极为罕见，处决则更为罕见。包括哈桑在内的四名男子目前被关押在堪萨斯州莱文沃斯堡的军方死囚牢房中，最后一次处决是在 1961 年执行的绞刑。

paras.en: John Galligan, a retired colonel and a former military judge, represented Hasan in civil matters. The attorney said Wednesday that he's limited on what he can talk about, but called the rush to conduct the execution "horrific."
paras.zh: 退役上校、前军事法官约翰·加利根 (John Galligan) 在民事事务中代表哈桑。这位律师周三表示，他能谈论的内容有限，但称匆忙执行死刑是“可怕的”。

paras.en: Galligan, who spoke with Hasan on Wednesday, said he believes the army regulation to have the facility's army commandant notify Hasan, accompanied by a chaplain and a Trial Defence Service attorney or civilian counsel if possible, was not followed. Galligan said that, according to Hasan, there was no legal counsel present.
paras.zh: 加利根周三与哈桑交谈，他认为军队没有遵守规定，要求该设施的陆军指挥官通知哈桑，并由一名牧师和一名审判辩护服务律师或民事律师（如果可能）陪同。加利根说，据哈桑称，当时没有法律顾问在场。

paras.en: "For the life of me, I don't know what they are trying to accomplish in such a rush fashion … and by trying to conduct this execution at Fort Hood, when he has such medical issues," Galligan said, raising questions about how Hasan, who is paralyzed from the waist down and uses a wheelchair, would be transported to Fort Hood.
paras.zh: 加利根说：“我一生都不知道他们如此匆忙地想要完成什么……当他有这样的健康问题时，他们试图在胡德堡进行处决。”他对腰部以下瘫痪并使用轮椅的哈桑将如何被运送到胡德堡提出了疑问。

paras.en: How South Carolina conducts firing squads
paras.zh: 南卡罗来纳州如何执行行刑队

paras.en: Before Hasan's execution was set for Fort Hood, there was speculation the army might reach out to one of the handful of states that have recently reinstated the firing squad for use in executions — particularly South Carolina or Utah, where they've renovated facilities and established protocols.
paras.zh: 在胡德堡处决哈桑之前，有人猜测军队可能会联系最近恢复行刑队执行死刑的少数几个州之一——特别是南卡罗来纳州和犹他州，他们在那里翻新了设施并制定了程序。

paras.en: South Carolina has killed three prisoners by firing squad in the past 18 months, the only such executions in the U.S. in the past 16 years.
paras.zh: 南卡罗来纳州在过去 18 个月内用行刑队处决了三名囚犯，这是美国过去 16 年来唯一一次执行此类处决。

paras.en: It's unclear if the army will borrow from the state's protocol, but it sets out for three volunteer shooters to stand 4.6 metres from the condemned prisoner, who is strapped to a chair. A medical professional uses an X-ray to find the prisoner's heart and place a target over it. A hood is placed over the prisoner's head after his final words, and a shade is lifted so the shooters can see their target.
paras.zh: 目前还不清楚军队是否会借鉴该州的规定，但规定三名志愿射手站在距离被绑在椅子上的死刑犯 4.6 米处。医疗专业人员使用 X 射线找到囚犯的心脏，并在其上放置一个目标。囚犯说完最后一句话后，头罩会戴在他的头上，并拉起一个阴影，以便射手可以看到他们的目标。

paras.en: All three shooters have live ammunition and fire at the same time with no verbal warning for the condemned prisoner.
paras.zh: 三名枪手均持有实弹，同时开枪，且没有对死刑犯发出任何口头警告。

paras.en: South Carolina spent about $54,000 US to renovate its death chamber for the firing squad.
paras.zh: 南卡罗来纳州花费约 54,000 美元为行刑队翻修死刑室。

articles.title: Woman at centre of Cornell gang-rape case was 'misled' about investigation, lawyer says

paras.en: Woman at centre of Cornell gang-rape case was 'misled' about investigation, lawyer says
paras.zh: 律师称康奈尔轮奸案中心妇女在调查中被“误导”

paras.en: Criminal inquiry ended almost as soon as it began, but Jane Doe was given impression it was ongoing: lawyer
paras.zh: 刑事调查几乎一开始就结束了，但无名氏给人的印象是调查仍在继续：律师

paras.en: The woman who says several men raped her at a Cornell University fraternity party was "misled" about the status of the criminal investigation in the weeks after she went to police, her lawyer said Wednesday.
paras.zh: 周三，这名女子的律师表示，这名女子声称自己在康奈尔大学兄弟会的一次聚会上被几名男子强奸，但她在报警后几周内就被“误导”了刑事调查的进展情况。

paras.en: Even as she took her allegations about a 2024 gang rape at the Chi Phi fraternity house through Cornell's internal disciplinary process, the university's police department gave her the impression that a criminal investigation was continuing, lawyer Thomas Giuffra told The Associated Press.
paras.zh: 律师托马斯·朱夫拉 (Thomas Giuffra) 告诉美联社，尽管她通过康奈尔大学内部纪律程序接受了 2024 年奇皮兄弟会所发生的轮奸案，但该大学警察局给她的印象是刑事调查仍在继续。

paras.en: In fact, the criminal inquiry ended almost as soon as it began.
paras.zh: 事实上，刑事调查几乎一开始就结束了。

paras.en: Tompkins County district attorney Matthew Van Houten, the local prosecutor, made the decision not to go forward with a criminal case within days of the woman giving her first substantial interviews to police.
paras.zh: 汤普金斯县地区检察官、当地检察官马修·范·豪顿 (Matthew Van Houten) 在该女子首次接受警方实质性讯问后几天内就决定不再提起刑事案件。

paras.en: Van Houten has said he asked Cornell's police department to convey the decision to the woman, who is referred to in court documents as Jane Doe, but never spoke personally to her or her lawyer.
paras.zh: 范豪顿表示，他要求康奈尔警察局将这一决定转达给这名女子（法庭文件中称她为无名氏），但他从未亲自与她或她的律师交谈过。

paras.en: Giuffra said the woman was told the criminal investigation was ongoing.
paras.zh: 朱弗拉说，这名女子被告知刑事调查正在进行中。

paras.en: "I think she was misled," he said. "I was involved with this case early on. I thought they were still investigating. It was news to me that they weren't doing anything."
paras.zh: “我认为她被误导了，”他说。 “我很早就参与了这起案件。我以为他们仍在调查。对我来说，他们没有采取任何行动，这对我来说是个新闻。”

paras.en: At the time, Giuffra added, he assumed investigators just needed more time to speak with witnesses and build a case.
paras.zh: 朱夫拉补充说，当时他认为调查人员只是需要更多时间与证人交谈并立案。

paras.en: "But nothing was being done, and we didn't know that," he said.
paras.zh: “但是什么也没做，我们也不知道，”他说。

paras.en: A messages seeking comment was left for Van Houten. Cornell's media relations office, citing pending litigation, declined to comment on behalf of the university's police department.
paras.zh: 已向 Van Houten 留下寻求评论的消息。康奈尔大学媒体关系办公室以未决诉讼为由，拒绝代表大学警察局发表评论。

paras.en: The district attorney said in a statement last week that he was confident no further investigation was necessary after prosecutors and criminal investigators from his office reviewed a six-page summary of the woman's account, written by a police officer.
paras.zh: 地区检察官在上周的一份声明中表示，在检察官和他办公室的刑事调查人员审查了一名警官撰写的该女子的六页叙述摘要后，他相信没有必要进行进一步的调查。

paras.en: Based on that summary, Van Houten said he believed no crime had been committed, and that the woman's participation in drug use and sex was "voluntary, conscious and consensual."
paras.zh: 根据这份总结，范豪顿表示，他认为没有犯罪，该女子吸毒和性行为是“自愿、有意识和双方同意的”。

paras.en: That description differs sharply with what the woman told police and university investigators, and with what she alleged in a lawsuit filed against seven Chi Phi fraternity members, Cornell and others last month.
paras.zh: 这一描述与该女子对警方和大学调查人员的说法，以及她上个月在对七名 Chi Phi 兄弟会成员、康奈尔大学和其他人提起的诉讼中所指控的内容有很大不同。

paras.en: Among other things, Giuffra said, the six-page report omitted the woman telling investigators, "I can say with 100 per cent confidence I was raped," that she was subjected to physical violence, and that a fraternity brother had sent a message to a group chat using a vulgar term to advertise that a woman's body was freely available.
paras.zh: 朱夫拉说，除其他外，这份六页的报告省略了该女子告诉调查人员的信息，“我可以百分百确信地说我被强奸了”，她受到了身体暴力，并且一位兄弟会的兄弟使用粗俗的术语向群聊发送了一条消息，宣传女性的身体是可以自由使用的。

paras.en: Last week, citing investigative records it obtained, the New York Times reported that a Cornell police investigator tried to get Van Houten's office to consider additional evidence in the weeks after the alleged rape, but was rebuffed.
paras.zh: 上周，《纽约时报》援引其获得的调查记录报道称，康奈尔警方调查员试图让范豪顿办公室在涉嫌强奸事件发生后的几周内考虑更多证据，但遭到拒绝。

paras.en: "At first I thought these police were incompetent," Giuffra said. "It sounds like they were doing the right thing. And they just got shut down."
paras.zh: “起初我认为这些警察无能，”朱弗拉说。 “听起来他们正在做正确的事情。但他们却被关闭了。”

paras.en: Giuffra said while he and Jane Doe have received death threats, he has been heartened by an outpouring of support — including rallies and protests on the Cornell campus and more than 1,000 women who have emailed him to share anger, frustration, solidarity and stories of their own assaults.
paras.zh: 朱夫拉说，虽然他和无名氏收到了死亡威胁，但大量的支持让他感到鼓舞——包括康奈尔大学校园的集会和抗议活动，以及 1000 多名女性给他发电子邮件，分享愤怒、沮丧、团结和她们自己遭受袭击的故事。

paras.en: Jane Doe, who was a student in 2024, alleges that Chi Phi members plied her with alcohol and drugs and several of them sexually assaulted her. One man sent others a message inviting them to participate, according to a lawsuit she filed last month.
paras.zh: Jane Doe 是 2024 年的一名学生，她声称 Chi Phi 成员不断向她酗酒和吸毒，其中几人对她进行了性侵犯。根据她上个月提起的诉讼，一名男子向其他人发送了邀请他们参加的信息。

paras.en: Lawyers for two of the men have denied they participated in a sexual assault. Attempts by The Associated Press to reach the others or their representatives have been unsuccessful. Some of the men who underwent a university disciplinary hearing in 2024 told investigators that the sexual activity was consensual or said they were not involved.
paras.zh: 其中两名男子的律师否认他们参与了性侵犯。美联社试图联系其他人或其代表，但没有成功。一些在 2024 年接受大学纪律听证会的男性告诉调查人员，性行为是双方自愿的，或者表示他们没有参与。

paras.en: The woman went to Cornell police in November 2024, though no criminal charges resulted. In the wake of her lawsuit, Van Houten said he was reopening the investigation. Days later, Gov. Kathy Hochul took the case away from him and appointed the state's attorney general, Letitia James, as a special prosecutor.
paras.zh: 该女子于 2024 年 11 月向康奈尔警方报案，但没有受到刑事指控。在她提起诉讼后，范豪顿表示他正在重新展开调查。几天后，州长凯西·霍赫尔 (Kathy Hochul) 接手了此案，并任命该州总检察长利蒂西亚·詹姆斯 (Letitia James) 为特别检察官。

paras.en: - Jane Doe at centre of Cornell rape case targeted with threats, her lawyer says
paras.zh: - 简·多伊 (Jane Doe) 是康奈尔大学强奸案的中心人物，她的律师称她受到威胁

paras.en: - Cornell taps ex-Justice Department official Sally Yates to review school's handling of sexual assault cases
paras.zh: - 康奈尔大学聘请前司法部官员萨莉·耶茨 (Sally Yates) 审查学校对性侵犯案件的处理情况

paras.en: Giuffra applauded the move, saying he was troubled by Van Houten's plan for conducting the reopened investigation and "didn't think he was up to the task."
paras.zh: 朱弗拉对此举表示赞赏，称他对范豪顿重新展开调查的计划感到不安，“认为他无法胜任这项任务”。

paras.en: Giuffra said the district attorney wanted to take the case to a grand jury and have Jane Doe testify before the panel within two weeks.
paras.zh: 朱弗拉说，地方检察官希望将此案提交大陪审团，并让无名氏在两周内在陪审团面前作证。

paras.en: That timeline, leaving little time to review evidence or interview witnesses, suggested Van Houten may have been trying "to go take a dive and not really give it his best effort and not do any investigation," Giuffra said.
paras.zh: 朱弗拉说，这个时间表几乎没有时间审查证据或采访证人，这表明范豪顿可能一直在试图“潜水，并没有真正尽最大努力，也没有进行任何调查”。

paras.en: James hasn't said how long her investigation might take, but suggested it could be months.
paras.zh: 詹姆斯没有透露她的调查可能需要多长时间，但表示可能需要几个月的时间。

paras.en: On Wednesday, one of the men named in Jane Doe's lawsuit filed a court petition seeking James's removal from the case, arguing she showed bias by posting on social media a few days before her appointment: "What this young woman has been forced to endure is horrific and unacceptable."
paras.zh: 周三，无名氏诉讼中提到的一名男子向法院提交了一份请愿书，要求将詹姆斯从该案中除名，称她在任命前几天在社交媒体上发帖表现出了偏见：“这位年轻女子被迫忍受的事情是可怕且不可接受的。”

paras.en: A spokesperson for James declined to comment.
paras.zh: 詹姆斯的发言人拒绝发表评论。

paras.en: Cornell closed down the Chi Phi campus chapter in 2024 and says it expelled some students and suspended others after an investigation under the federal Title IX law.
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学于 2024 年关闭了奇皮岛校区分会，并表示在根据联邦第九条法律进行调查后，开除了一些学生，并停课了其他学生。

paras.en: This week Cornell trustees brought in former U.S. deputy attorney general Sally Yates to review how the school investigates sexual assault and sexual harassment, how the disciplinary process works, the campus police response and more.
paras.zh: 本周，康奈尔大学董事会聘请了美国前副检察长莎莉·耶茨 (Sally Yates)，对学校如何调查性侵犯和性骚扰、纪律程序如何运作、校园警察的反应等进行审查。

articles.title: As US midterm elections loom, Trump's campaign tactics are becoming increasingly unusual, and expensive

paras.en: "The radical Left is upset with the fact that I am taking ads, which I consider to be a positive promotion for our great USA, and paying for them with USA money," Trump wrote on his platform Truth Social.
paras.zh: 特朗普在他的真相社交平台上写道：“激进左派对我拍摄广告感到不安，我认为这是对我们伟大美国的积极宣传，并用美国的钱来支付广告费用。”

paras.en: He went on to claim that funding partisan ads with public money was a "rather standard thing to do," before adding that future ads would be paid with money raised from donations.
paras.zh: 他接着声称，用公共资金资助党派广告是“相当标准的事情”，然后补充说未来的广告将用捐款筹集的资金支付。

paras.en: The ads themselves have caused some controversy in the United States. They ran in September between popular shows such as Saturday Night Live and football games, marked with the line: "paid for by the US government" — that is, paid with tax dollars.
paras.zh: 这些广告本身在美国引起了一些争议。 9月份，它们在《周六夜现场》和足球比赛等热门节目之间播出，并标有一行字：“由美国政府支付”——也就是说，用税款支付。

paras.en: The commercials showed scenes such as when US troops captured Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro earlier this year but they mostly consisted of images and videos of Trump himself, along with combative messages that he would "expel the warmongers" or "throw off the sick political class," and ensure that the US did not become a communist state.
paras.zh: 这些广告展示了美国军队今年早些时候抓获委内瑞拉总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗等场景，但其中大部分是特朗普本人的图像和视频，以及他将“驱逐战争贩子”或“摆脱病态政治阶层”并确保美国不会成为共产主义国家的好斗信息。

paras.en: On Tuesday, the US broadcasting network CBS reported that, according to contracting records, the US Department of Homeland Security had paid an agency $20 million (€17.9 million) for a "national media campaign."
paras.zh: 周二，美国哥伦比亚广播公司 (CBS) 报道称，根据合同记录，美国国土安全部已向一家机构支付了 2000 万美元（1790 万欧元）用于“全国媒体宣传活动”。

paras.en: The "rather standard" practice that Trump referred to actually applies to public service announcements, but this is not what the campaign ads are, argued the US non-profit consumer advocacy group Public Citizen.
paras.zh: 美国非营利消费者权益倡导组织公共公民认为，特朗普提到的“相当标准”的做法实际上适用于公共服务公告，但这不是竞选广告的内容。

paras.en: "Federal law explicitly prohibits using appropriated public funds for government propaganda, self-aggrandizement, or partisan political advertising," the organization wrote in a public complaint to the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) ."Yet, that is exactly the nature of Trump's recent campaign ads."
paras.zh: 该组织在向联邦通信委员会（FCC）提交的公开投诉中写道：“联邦法律明确禁止使用拨款的公共资金进行政府宣传、自我扩张或党派政治广告。然而，这正是特朗普最近竞选广告的本质。”

paras.en: Independent experts have also voiced concerns. Patrick Malone, a professor in the department of Public Administration and Policy at American University in Washington DC, said the timing of the videos was problematic.
paras.zh: 独立专家也表达了担忧。华盛顿特区美利坚大学公共管理与政策系教授帕特里克·马龙表示，这些视频的发布时间有问题。

paras.en: "You're not supposed to use taxpayer dollars to pay for anything that's campaign-related," he told DW. "Technically, [Trump] is not campaigning. He's not saying 'Vote for me!' The thing that's created the challenge here is the timing. Weeks before the midterms, this is a real big issue."
paras.zh: 他告诉德国之声：“你不应该用纳税人的钱来支付任何与竞选相关的费用。” “从技术上讲，[特朗普]并不是在竞选。他并没有说‘投票给我！’这里带来挑战的是时机。中期选举前几周，这是一个真正的大问题。”

paras.en: Will the Republicans keep their majority after midterms?
paras.zh: 中期选举后共和党会保住多数席位吗？

paras.en: Voters do not choose presidents in the midterm elections but members of Congres, which comprises the Senate and the House of Representatives and is the legislative branch of the federal government. On November 3, those eligible to vote will cast their ballots for all the seats in the House of Representatives, and roughly a third of the seats in the Senate. Some states will also be choosing governors.
paras.zh: 选民在中期选举中不选举总统，而是选举国会议员，国会由参议院和众议院组成，是联邦政府的立法部门。 11月3日，有资格投票的人将投票选举众议院所有席位以及参议院大约三分之一的席位。一些州也将选举州长。

paras.en: Republicans have not been faring well in recent polls, which may be why Trump has been trying to promote his party's achievements. The Republicans currently hold a majority in both houses, with 53 of 100 seats in the Senate, and 219 of 435 seats in the House of Representatives. This has enabled Trump to pass a large number of his proposals fairly easily.
paras.zh: 共和党在最近的民意调查中表现不佳，这可能就是特朗普一直试图宣传共和党成就的原因。共和党目前在参众两院均占多数席位，在参议院100个席位中占据53个席位，在众议院435个席位中占据219个席位。这使得特朗普能够相当轻松地通过他的大量提案。

paras.en: But a Reuters/Ipsos poll released on Monday indicates that this could soon change. "Voters age 50 or older preferred Trump's party over the Democratic Party by just 2 percentage points — 44% to 42% — compared to an 8-point Republican advantage in December," it found. This age bracket "is particularly important for midterm elections, when older Americans historically have made up large shares of the electorate."
paras.zh: 但周一公布的路透社/益普索民意调查显示，这种情况可能很快就会改变。报告发现，“50 岁或以上的选民对特朗普所在政党的支持度仅比民主党高出 2 个百分点，分别为 44% 和 42%，而 12 月份共和党的优势为 8 个百分点。”这个年龄段“对于中期选举尤其重要，因为历史上美国老年人在选民中占很大比例。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, among voters under the age of 50, "Democrats led by 18 points," the survey showed.
paras.zh: 与此同时，调查显示，在 50 岁以下的选民中，“民主党领先 18 个百分点”。

paras.en: The poll also found that opinions on Trump himself were low, with "32% of Americans giving a thumbs up to Trump's presidency." This level of approval, the study highlighted, was unchanged from an earlier poll "that saw the leader's rating at the lowest of his political career."
paras.zh: 民意调查还发现，人们对特朗普本人的评价很低，“32%的美国人对特朗普的总统任期竖起大拇指”。研究强调，这一支持率与之前的民意调查相比没有变化，“该民意调查显示这位领导人的支持率处于其政治生涯中的最低水平”。

paras.en: Republicans shy away from Trump's support
paras.zh: 共和党人回避特朗普的支持

paras.en: This could also be one of the reasons why Republican candidates do not seem so keen on making public appearances with the president, usually a highlight of a campaign trail.
paras.zh: 这也可能是共和党候选人似乎不太热衷于与总统一起公开露面的原因之一，而公开露面通常是竞选活动的亮点。

paras.en: Many US citizens associate Trump with high living costs, or the war with Iran, which has dragged on for over half a year now.
paras.zh: 许多美国民众将特朗普与高昂的生活成本联系起来，或者与已经拖了半年多的伊朗战争联系在一起。

paras.en: One Republican operative told the news website Politico on condition of anonymity that if the the president were to visit a battleground state — where Democratic and Republican support is fairly equal among voters — to campaign for his party, they suspected their "candidates would come down with COVID" to avoid having to attend.
paras.zh: 一位不愿透露姓名的共和党工作人员告诉新闻网站 Politico，如果总统要访问一个摇摆州——民主党和共和党在选民中的支持相当平等——为自己的政党竞选，他们怀疑“候选人会感染新冠病毒”，以避免出席。

paras.en: In September, a number of Republicans skipped Trump's big party convention — typically reserved for presidential, not midterm elections — even though the event could have offered them a platform for their campaign.
paras.zh: 9月，一些共和党人跳过了特朗普的大型党代会——通常是为总统而非中期选举保留的——尽管这次活动本可以为他们的竞选活动提供一个平台。

paras.en: Susan Collins from Maine and Dan Sullivan from Alaska, are just two examples of Republican senators whose seats are on the line and who did not attend. Neither did candidates for the House of Representatives from the swing states Arizona, Iowa and Michigan.
paras.zh: 来自缅因州的苏珊·柯林斯和来自阿拉斯加州的丹·沙利文只是席位悬而未决的共和党参议员的两个例子。来自摇摆州亚利桑那州、爱荷华州和密歇根州的众议院候选人也没有这样做。

paras.en: Trump promises $5,000 payout if Republicans win
paras.zh: 特朗普承诺如果共和党获胜，将支付 5000 美元

paras.en: Those who skipped the event missed the president repeating an unusual campaign message: To encourage more people to vote, Trump urged supporters to "pretend" he was on the ballot.
paras.zh: 那些跳过这次活动的人错过了总统重复的不寻常的竞选信息：为了鼓励更多人投票，特朗普敦促支持者“假装”他在投票中。

paras.en: And if that wasn't enough, he also promised each US citizen eligible to vote a $5,000 payout if Republicans maintained their majority in both houses of Congress.
paras.zh: 如果这还不够的话，他还承诺，如果共和党在国会参众两院保持多数席位，每位有资格投票的美国公民将获得 5,000 美元的奖励。

paras.en: Keeping that pledge could cost the federal government over $1.2 trillion, but observers doubt it would ever come to that.
paras.zh: 履行这一承诺可能会让联邦政府花费超过 1.2 万亿美元，但观察家怀疑它是否会实现这一目标。

paras.en: "He has no money to do that with. It would have to be authorized and appropriated by Congress," Mallone explained. "I think the likelihood is very slim," he added. "It's one of those things like 'Mexico is going to pay for the wall.'"
paras.zh: “他没有钱来做这件事。这必须得到国会的授权和拨款，”马龙解释道。 “我认为可能性非常小，”他补充道。 “这就是‘墨西哥将为隔离墙买单’之类的事情之一。”

paras.en: Whether Trump's commercials or promised payouts will be enough to rally majority Republican support remains to be seen.
paras.zh: 特朗普的广告或承诺的支出是否足以赢得大多数共和党人的支持还有待观察。

paras.en: This article was originally published in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初以德文发表。

articles.title: South Sudan's road to elections remains uncertain

paras.en: South Sudan has scheduled a general election for December 22, the first since the country gained independence from Sudan in 2011.
paras.zh: 南苏丹定于12月22日举行大选，这是该国自2011年脱离苏丹独立以来的首次大选。

paras.en: But, as preparations lag, political tensions are high and the debate has intensified since President Salva Kiir dissolved the transitional unity government on September 22 to form a caretaker administration.
paras.zh: 但由于准备工作滞后，政治局势高度紧张，自萨尔瓦·基尔总统于 9 月 22 日解散过渡联合政府、组建看守政府以来，争论也愈演愈烈。

paras.en: Denis Logonyi, a journalist based in the capital of South Sudan Juba, said that many in the country, which has seen violent power struggles and political instability, were not only concerned about the logistics of the polls.
paras.zh: 南苏丹首都朱巴的记者丹尼斯·洛戈尼表示，该国经历了暴力权力斗争和政治不稳定，许多人不仅担心投票的后勤工作。

paras.en: "People have different views on these elections," he told DW. "You hear discussions in political circles and on social media, but ordinary people are not talking much about them."
paras.zh: “人们对这些选举有不同的看法，”他告诉德国之声。 “你会在政界和社交媒体上听到讨论，但普通人对此谈论得不多。”

paras.en: One voter complained that "there has been no voter education, no voter registration, and only a few months remain." Another told DW that while South Sudanese citizens were eager for a credible election process, the country was not adequately prepared.
paras.zh: 一名选民抱怨说，“没有选民教育，没有选民登记，只剩下几个月了”。另一位人士告诉德国之声，虽然南苏丹公民渴望有可信的选举进程，但该国尚未做好充分准备。

paras.en: Food prices are rising, civil servants are not being paid, and displaced people are struggling, they said.
paras.zh: 他们说，食品价格上涨，公务员拿不到工资，流离失所者陷入困境。

paras.en: Politicians admit to 'obstacles' but agree to adhere to election timeline
paras.zh: 政客们承认存在“障碍”，但同意遵守选举时间表

paras.en: Political parties have until October 22 to present their manifestos and register.
paras.zh: 政党必须在 10 月 22 日之前提交宣言并进行登记。

paras.en: On October 7, South Sudan concluded a two-week Inter-Party Dialogue, in which 39 parties participated, discussing key issues ahead of the election.
paras.zh: 10月7日，南苏丹结束了为期两周的党际对话，39个政党参加，讨论选举前的关键问题。

paras.en: Logonyi said that some civil society groups had been left out of the dialogue, which was initiated by President Kiir.
paras.zh: 洛戈尼表示，一些民间社会团体被排除在基尔总统发起的对话之外。

paras.en: Minister of Cabinet Affairs Martin Elia Lomuro outlined a few of the challenges: "Delayed funding could severely affect civic education and election infrastructure. There is a need for a clear legal framework to govern the participation of the country's administrative areas. The three administrative areas are not clearly reflected in the National Election Act, which is necessary for the election outcomes to be accepted."
paras.zh: 内阁事务部长马丁·埃利亚·洛穆罗概述了一些挑战：“延迟提供资金可能会严重影响公民教育和选举基础设施。需要有一个明确的法律框架来管理国家行政区域的参与。这三个行政区域没有明确反映在《国家选举法》中，而这是选举结果被接受所必需的。”

paras.en: He added that "a credible election requires security readiness throughout the entire cycle — including campaign rallies, polling stations, voting, counting, and results transmission. The unified security forces have not yet been fully deployed."
paras.zh: 他补充说，“一场可信的选举需要整个周期的安全准备——包括竞选集会、投票站、投票、计票和结果传输。统一的安全部队尚未全面部署。”

paras.en: According to Albino Akol Atak, the deputy rapporteur of the Inter-Party Dialogue and minister of humanitarian affairs and disaster management, the parties unanimously agreed to adhere to the election timeline. "The election train has left the station, and it has no reverse gear," he said. "We are trying to smooth the pathway for this train to arrive on December 22, 2026, without obstacles."
paras.zh: 党际对话副报告员兼人道主义事务和灾害管理部长阿尔比诺·阿科尔·阿塔克表示，各方一致同意遵守选举时间表。 “选举列车已经离开车站，而且没有倒档，”他说。 “我们正在努力为这趟列车铺平道路，使其顺利于 2026 年 12 月 22 日抵达。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, Changkuoth Bichok Reath, the secretary general of the South Sudan Opposition Alliance (SSOA), said he strongly believed "that successfully conducting the election on December 22 requires coordinated, inclusive action from all national institutions, political parties, security actors, civil society, and other stakeholders."
paras.zh: 与此同时，南苏丹反对派联盟（SSOA）秘书长昌库斯·比乔克·雷斯（Changkuoth Bichok Reath）表示，他坚信“要成功举行 12 月 22 日的选举，需要所有国家机构、政党、安全参与者、民间社会和其他利益相关者采取协调一致、包容性的行动。”

paras.en: He added that "given the limited time remaining, priority should be placed on resolving outstanding legal issues and ensuring constructive dialogue among political actors. Furthermore, political parties must be funded to meet key requirements, because a lack of funding will only draw us backward."
paras.zh: 他补充说，“鉴于剩下的时间有限，应优先考虑解决悬而未决的法律问题并确保政治行为体之间的建设性对话。此外，政党必须获得资金来满足关键要求，因为缺乏资金只会让我们倒退。”

paras.en: South Sudan's checkered election history
paras.zh: 南苏丹曲折的选举历史

paras.en: South Sudan has endured decades of conflict, from long wars that preceded independence to a devastating civil war that erupted just two years after it became a sovereign state.
paras.zh: 南苏丹经历了数十年的冲突，从独立前的长期战争到成为主权国家仅两年后爆发的毁灭性内战。

paras.en: Power-sharing transitional governments have been in place under fragile peace deals, including the Revitalized Peace Agreement of September 2018. Elections have repeatedly been planned then put off.
paras.zh: 权力分享的过渡政府已经根据脆弱的和平协议成立，包括 2018 年 9 月的《重振和平协议》。选举一再计划然后推迟。

paras.en: Armed opposition groups remain active, and many citizens fear political tensions could trigger renewed violence.
paras.zh: 武装反对派团体仍然活跃，许多公民担心政治紧张局势可能引发新的暴力事件。

paras.en: "The absence of [former Vice President] Riek Machar from the political process is a major concern," Logonyi said. "If there is to be an election or a meaningful political dialogue, many believe he has to be part of it."
paras.zh: “[前副总统]里克·马查尔缺席政治进程是一个主要问题，”洛戈尼说。 “如果要举行选举或有意义的政治对话，许多人认为他必须参与其中。”

paras.en: In 2018, a power-sharing deal that saw Kiir become president and Machar — his long-time rival and main opposition leader — vice president briefly stabilized the country.
paras.zh: 2018年，一项权力分享协议使基尔成为总统，而马查尔——他的长期竞争对手和主要反对党领袖——成为副总统，短暂地稳定了国家的局势。

paras.en: However, tensions between the two men persisted and in March 2025, Machar was placed under house arrest. He was later put on trial for offences that include treason and murder.
paras.zh: 然而，两人之间的紧张关系持续存在，2025 年 3 月，马查尔被软禁。他后来因叛国罪和谋杀罪等罪名受审。

paras.en: Key conditions for elections not fulfilled yet
paras.zh: 选举的关键条件尚未满足

paras.en: "The government has demonstrated that it is keen for the election to happen," said Wambui Njehu Nzigo, an analyst with Control Risks, a global consulting firm. "But there are important processes that have not yet taken place."
paras.zh: 全球咨询公司 Control Risks 的分析师 Wambui Njehu Nzigo 表示：“政府已经表明，它渴望举行选举。” “但还有一些重要的进程尚未发生。”

paras.en: The lack of voter registration is among the biggest concerns. "If elections are to take place soon, you would expect there already to be a voter register," Nzigo said. "There is very little time for that to happen."
paras.zh: 缺乏选民登记是最大的问题之一。恩齐戈说：“如果选举即将举行，你会期望已经有了选民登记册。” “发生这种情况的时间很少了。”

paras.en: Security reforms required under the 2018 peace deal have not yet been finished. These include the unification of armed groups to create the conditions for a stable transition.
paras.zh: 2018 年和平协议要求的安全改革尚未完成。其中包括统一武装团体，为稳定过渡创造条件。

paras.en: Analysts have long warned that if these key issues are not addressed the legitimacy of any election would be undermined.
paras.zh: 分析人士长期以来一直警告说，如果这些关键问题得不到解决，任何选举的合法性都将受到损害。

paras.en: "The elections would be taking place in an environment where there is still active fighting in some parts of the country," Nzigo said. "The fact that the main opposition leader is under house arrest raises questions about whether this will be a true competition."
paras.zh: 恩齐戈说：“选举将在该国某些地区仍在激烈战斗的环境中进行。” “主要反对派领导人被软禁的事实引发了人们的疑问：这是否会是一场真正的竞争。”

paras.en: According to Logonyi, civil society groups are calling for greater dialogue, political inclusion and protections for journalists and activists before the vote is held.
paras.zh: 洛戈尼表示，民间社会团体呼吁在投票前加强对话、政治包容以及对记者和活动人士的保护。

paras.en: Ongoing flooding could interfere with the vote
paras.zh: 持续的洪水可能会干扰投票

paras.en: Futhermore, South Sudan faces severe flooding, a displacement crisis and food insecurity. This could make it difficult for some citizens to reach polling stations, Nzigo said.
paras.zh: 此外，南苏丹还面临严重的洪水、流离失所危机和粮食不安全。恩齐戈说，这可能会使一些公民难以到达投票站。

paras.en: For those displaced by conflict, there's uncertainty over how they can register and cast their ballots.
paras.zh: 对于那些因冲突而流离失所的人来说，他们如何登记和投票存在不确定性。

paras.en: Experts warn that a vote without broad participation could lead to a disputed outcome and instensify conflict.
paras.zh: 专家警告说，没有广泛参与的投票可能会导致有争议的结果并加剧冲突。

paras.en: Regional organizations such as the African Union and international partners are expected to continue encouraging an inclusive political process.
paras.zh: 非洲联盟等区域组织和国际伙伴预计将继续鼓励包容性政治进程。

paras.en: Analysts argue that the focus should be not only on ensuring elections take place, but also on creating conditions that make them credible.
paras.zh: 分析人士认为，重点不仅应该放在确保选举的举行上，还应该创造使选举具有可信度的条件。

paras.en: For many South Sudanese, the choice is clear: elections alone won't guarantee stability.
paras.zh: 对于许多南苏丹人来说，选择很明确：仅靠选举并不能保证稳定。

paras.en: This article contains material generated by artificial intelligence (AI) from the AfricaLink podcast.
paras.zh: 本文包含由 AfricaLink 播客中的人工智能 (AI) 生成的材料。

articles.title: Why music in Iran is more than just entertainment

paras.en: After spending 47 years abroad, Iranian musician Bijan Mortazavi returned to his homeland at the end of September.
paras.zh: 在国外度过了 47 年之后，伊朗音乐家 Bijan Mortazavi 于 9 月底回到了祖国。

paras.en: Mortazavi is one of Iran's most renowned violinists, singers, and composers.
paras.zh: 莫尔塔扎维是伊朗最著名的小提琴家、歌手和作曲家之一。

paras.en: In July 2026, he performed with his famous white violin at the closing ceremony of the FIFA World Cup alongside the New York Philharmonic Orchestra.
paras.zh: 2026年7月，他与纽约爱乐乐团一起在FIFA世界杯闭幕式上用著名的白色小提琴演奏。

paras.en: In the videos that he and his wife have now posted on social media, the couple can be seen taking walks through the city of the Iranian capital, Tehran, while passersby greet the musician warmly and welcome him.
paras.zh: 在他和妻子在社交媒体上发布的视频中，可以看到这对夫妇在伊朗首都德黑兰市散步，路人热情地向这位音乐家打招呼并欢迎他。

paras.en: Singer Mohsen Namjoo also recently returned to Iran after about 20 years in exile.
paras.zh: 歌手 Mohsen Namjoo 在流亡约 20 年后最近也回到了伊朗。

paras.en: Internationally renowned for his experimental Persian music, he blends traditional Persian singing and poetic lyrics with elements of blues, rock, jazz, and folk.
paras.zh: 他以其实验性波斯音乐而闻名于世，他将传统的波斯歌唱和诗意歌词与蓝调、摇滚、爵士乐和民谣元素融为一体。

paras.en: In 2009, Namjoo was sentenced in absentia by a court in Tehran to five years in prison.
paras.zh: 2009年，南珠被德黑兰一家法院缺席判处五年监禁。

paras.en: He was accused of insulting holy sites and mocking verses from the Quran, among other things.
paras.zh: 他被指控侮辱圣地和嘲笑《古兰经》的经文等。

paras.en: In a video posted online after his return to Iran, Namjoo said he had returned to the country to spend more time with his family and friends.
paras.zh: 南珠在返回伊朗后在网上发布的一段视频中表示，他返回伊朗是为了花更多时间与家人和朋友在一起。

paras.en: On August 27, Abbas Salehi, Iran's minister of culture and Islamic guidance, said in an interview with the prominent Iranian media outlet Farhikhtegan that his ministry had compiled a list containing the names of more than 100 distinguished Iranians living abroad.
paras.zh: 8月27日，伊朗文化和伊斯兰指导部部长阿巴斯·萨利希在接受伊朗知名媒体Farhikhtegan采访时表示，该部已经编制了一份名单，其中包含100多名居住在国外的伊朗杰出人士的名字。

paras.en: The goal, he said, was to remove obstacles to their travel or return to Iran.
paras.zh: 他说，目标是消除他们旅行或返回伊朗的障碍。

paras.en: Salehi stressed that even "critics of the Islamic Republic" could return at any time. He added, however, that the return of artists does not necessarily mean they would perform in Iran. Instead, they could simply visit the country, the minister said.
paras.zh: 萨利希强调，即使是“伊斯兰共和国的批评者”也可能随时卷土重来。不过他补充说，艺术家的回归并不一定意味着他们会在伊朗​​演出。部长说，相反，他们可以简单地访问该国。

paras.en: Sina Yousefi, a human rights lawyer, pointed to international law, specifically Article 12 of the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights, to which Iran is also a signatory.
paras.zh: 人权律师西娜·优素菲(Sina Yousefi)提到了国际法，特别是伊朗也是该公约签署国的《公民权利和政治权利国际公约》第12条。

paras.en: According to this provision, no one may be arbitrarily prevented from entering their own country. This right cannot be made contingent on a citizen's level of loyalty to the government, he told DW.
paras.zh: 根据这一规定，不得任意阻止任何人进入自己的国家。他告诉德国之声，这项权利不能取决于公民对政府的忠诚度。

paras.en: "The idea of seeking out certain well-known figures — who the reformists, in particular, believe are less likely to cross the red lines — and winning them over to collaborate or bringing them back to the country is not new," said Sepideh Raissadat, an ethnomusicologist who has been studying the history and development of Persian music for years.
paras.zh: 多年来一直研究波斯音乐历史和发展的民族音乐学家塞皮德·赖萨达特 (Sepideh Raissadat) 表示：“寻找某些知名人士——尤其是改革派认为他们不太可能跨越红线——并赢得他们合作或将他们带回国内的想法并不新鲜。”

paras.en: As an internationally renowned performer of classical Persian music, she combines her artistic work with scholarly research, with her dissertation focusing on the lives of Iranian female singers since the 1979 Islamic Revolution.
paras.zh: 作为国际知名的波斯古典音乐表演者，她将艺术作品与学术研究相结合，其论文重点关注 1979 年伊斯兰革命以来伊朗女歌手的生活。

paras.en: "The 1979 revolution in Iran was a revolution against music. Music was one of the red lines," said Raissadat, referring to statements by the leader of the revolution, Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini, who as early as July 1979 had publicly described music as harmful to society and called for its complete abolition.
paras.zh: “1979 年伊朗革命是一场反对音乐的革命。音乐是红线之一，”赖萨达特说，他指的是革命领袖阿亚图拉鲁霍拉·霍梅尼的声明，霍梅尼早在 1979 年 7 月就公开称音乐对社会有害，并呼吁彻底废除音乐。

paras.en: In a speech to employees of Radio Darya on July 21, 1979, Khomeini is said to have described music as "a betrayal of the country" and "a betrayal of the youth." A few days later, the Iranian newspaper Keyhan quoted him as saying that music was "like a drug” and must be completely eradicated.
paras.zh: 1979 年 7 月 21 日，霍梅尼在对达里亚广播电台员工的一次演讲中，据说将音乐描述为“对国家的背叛”和“对年轻人的背叛”。几天后，伊朗报纸《Keyhan》援引他的话说，音乐“就像毒品”，必须彻底根除。

paras.en: During the Iran-Iraq War from 1980 to 1988, however, music made a comeback in the form of revolutionary and religious songs. It was also used to stir up feelings of national pride and a sense of belonging.
paras.zh: 然而，在1980年至1988年的两伊战争期间，音乐以革命歌曲和宗教歌曲的形式卷土重来。它还被用来激发民族自豪感和归属感。

paras.en: The regime also failed to completely banish the female voice from the public sphere. "They couldn't completely eliminate the voice of women. The female voice returned through choral singing," said Raissadat.
paras.zh: 该政权也未能将女性声音从公共领域彻底消除。 “他们无法完全消除女性的声音。女性的声音通过合唱重新出现，”赖萨达特说。

paras.en: But the conflict between the state and music continued.
paras.zh: 但国家与音乐之间的冲突仍在继续。

paras.en: For years, musical instruments were not allowed to be shown on Iranian television. Instruments were confiscated or destroyed on the streets. Fearing repercussions, musicians did not carry their instruments in public, while some hid them in their cars.
paras.zh: 多年来，伊朗电视台不允许播放乐器。仪器在街上被没收或销毁。由于担心产生不良后果，音乐家们不会在公共场合携带乐器，有些人甚至将乐器藏在车里。

paras.en: "Listening to banned music at home was a political act. And when women began to sing, that, too, became a political act," Raissadat noted. The development of Iranian pop music was also part of this political and cultural tension, she underscored. "People began producing new domestic pop music to compete with music from Los Angeles."
paras.zh: “在家听违禁音乐是一种政治行为。当女性开始唱歌时，这也成为一种政治行为，”赖萨达特指出。她强调，伊朗流行音乐的发展也是这种政治和文化紧张局势的一部分。 “人们开始创作新的国内流行音乐，以与洛杉矶的音乐竞争。”

paras.en: Over the past ten years, social media — which is not entirely under government control — has become increasingly important and now wields considerable influence.
paras.zh: 在过去的十年里，不完全受政府控制的社交媒体变得越来越重要，现在拥有相当大的影响力。

paras.en: This change is particularly evident among young people, with young women now even playing the guitar without headscarves and performing in public.
paras.zh: 这种变化在年轻人中尤为明显，年轻女性甚至不戴头巾弹吉他并在公共场合表演。

paras.en: Raissadat observes a particular trend among the families of the young people who were killed during the nationwide mass protests in late December 2025 and January 2026.
paras.zh: Raissadat 观察到，在 2025 年 12 月下旬和 2026 年 1 月的全国大规模抗议活动中被杀的年轻人的家人中存在一种特殊趋势。

paras.en: The demonstrations began on December 28, 2025, and were violently suppressed by security forces.
paras.zh: 示威活动于2025年12月28日开始，遭到安全部队的暴力镇压。

paras.en: Human rights organizations report that thousands of protesters were killed, but the exact figures are unknown due to the extensive information blackout imposed by the regime.
paras.zh: 人权组织报告称，数千名抗议者被杀，但由于该政权实行广泛的信息封锁，确切数字不得而知。

paras.en: "The most important thing we've seen in recent years has been the use of music by the bereaved families of those killed in the protests. This stands in complete contrast to Shiite tradition and our history," said Raissadat.
paras.zh: “近年来我们看到的最重要的事情是抗议活动中遇难者的家属使用音乐。这与什叶派传统和我们的历史完全相反，”赖萨达特说。

paras.en: At some funerals, families turned the memorial service for their loved ones into a new form of protest.
paras.zh: 在一些葬礼上，家人将为亲人举行的追悼会变成了一种新的抗议形式。

paras.en: Instead of religious hymns, music played, and the mourners sang and danced along to it. In doing so, they created a deliberate contrast to traditional religious mourning rituals, the musician said.
paras.zh: 音乐代替了宗教赞美诗，哀悼者们跟着音乐唱歌跳舞。这位音乐家说，他们这样做是故意与传统的宗教哀悼仪式形成对比。

paras.en: "Music became a weapon. Those who were mourning were able to connect with it on their own, and at the same time, it stood in opposition to what the political system stands for," Raissadat pointed out, adding, "Dancing in white clothing also became an expression of this resistance."
paras.zh: “音乐成为一种武器，那些哀悼的人能够自己与它联系起来，同时它也与政治制度所代表的东西相对立，”赖萨达特指出，并补充道，“穿着白衣跳舞也成为了这种抵抗的一种表达。”

paras.en: This article was originally written in German.
paras.zh: 本文最初是用德语写的。

articles.title: Signage at UK consulate in East Jerusalem removed as Israel’s deadline over

paras.en: Workers at the UK consulate in occupied East Jerusalem have removed its signage as the Israeli shutdown deadline arrives, further damaging strained ties between allies.
paras.zh: 随着以色列关闭最后期限的到来，英国驻被占领的东耶路撒冷领事馆的工作人员拆除了其标牌，进一步损害了盟友之间紧张的关系。

paras.en: Journalists from the Reuters news agency saw workers remove a plaque reading “British Consulate General” from the building on Thursday, as well as another sign for its consular section. The UK flag was still flying over the building.
paras.zh: 路透社记者周四看到，工人们从大楼上拆除了一块写着“英国总领事馆”的牌匾，以及领事部的另一个标志。英国国旗仍然飘扬在大楼上空。

paras.en: Thursday marks 30 days since Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Saar ordered the closure of the consulate in occupied East Jerusalem. The move was in response to the UK’s wave of sanctions on illegal Israeli settlements, including a ban on importing goods made there.
paras.zh: 周四是以色列外交部长吉迪恩·萨尔下令关闭驻被占领的东耶路撒冷领事馆以来的 30 天。此举是为了回应英国对以色列非法定居点的制裁浪潮，包括禁止进口在那里制造的商品。

paras.en: The United Nations and most countries consider the settlements illegal under international law. Israel disputes this.
paras.zh: 联合国和大多数国家都认为这些定居点根据国际法是非法的。以色列对此提出异议。

paras.en: The United Kingdom threatened to expel 27 Israeli diplomats if Israel proceeded to close the consulate in occupied East Jerusalem, according to unverified Israeli media reports.
paras.zh: 据未经证实的以色列媒体报道，英国威胁称，如果以色列继续关闭位于被占领东耶路撒冷的领事馆，英国将驱逐 27 名以色列外交官。

paras.en: The consulate has not responded to an immediate request for comment.
paras.zh: 领事馆尚未立即回应置评请求。

paras.en: Israel has been adamant the consulate will close even as the UK has sought to keep it open, including sending the country’s top national security adviser to Israel last week for talks.
paras.zh: 以色列一直坚称领事馆将关闭，尽管英国一直试图保持领事馆开放，包括上周派遣该国最高国家安全顾问前往以色列进行会谈。

paras.en: The UK’s presence in the city dates back almost 200 years, long before the state of Israel was established in 1948. The closure order does not affect the UK’s embassy in Tel Aviv, which handles diplomatic relations with Israel’s government.
paras.zh: 英国在特拉维夫的存在可以追溯到近 200 年前，早在 1948 年以色列建国之前。关闭令并不影响英国驻特拉维夫大使馆，该大使馆负责处理与以色列政府的外交关系。

paras.en: The consulate, in the Sheikh Jarrah neighbourhood of occupied East Jerusalem, handles the UK’s relations with Palestinians in Jerusalem, as well as in the occupied West Bank and Gaza. It also provides consular services to Palestinians.
paras.zh: 该领事馆位于被占领的东耶路撒冷谢赫贾拉附近，负责处理英国与耶路撒冷以及被占领的约旦河西岸和加沙地带的巴勒斯坦人的关系。它还为巴勒斯坦人提供领事服务。

paras.en: The UK Foreign Office on Wednesday declined to comment when asked whether the consulate was still operating or if diplomats working there had returned to the UK.
paras.zh: 周三，当被问及领事馆是否仍在运作或在那里工作的外交官是否已返回英国时，英国外交部拒绝发表评论。

paras.en: Despite the current strains, the UK and Israel are close economic, security and intelligence partners.
paras.zh: 尽管目前面临压力，英国和以色列仍然是密切的经济、安全和情报伙伴。

articles.title: Protesters in Colombia rally against ties with Israel

paras.en: Protesters have rallied in Colombia’s capital opposing the new far-right government’s policy towards Israel.
paras.zh: 抗议者在哥伦比亚首都集会，反对新的极右翼政府对以色列的政策。

paras.en: Hundreds took to the streets of Bogota on Wednesday to protest against the ongoing genocide in Gaza and the Colombian government’s decision to restore diplomatic and economic relations with Israel.
paras.zh: 周三，数百人走上波哥大街头，抗议加沙正在进行的种族灭绝以及哥伦比亚政府决定恢复与以色列的外交和经济关系。

paras.en: The protesters, who began their rally in front of the Israeli embassy in Bogota, criticised President Abelardo de la Espriella’s decision to open a new Colombian embassy in Jerusalem.
paras.zh: 抗议者在以色列驻波哥大大使馆前开始集会，批评总统阿韦拉多·德拉埃斯普里埃拉在耶路撒冷开设新的哥伦比亚大使馆的决定。

paras.en: The rally marked three years since the Hamas-led attacks of October 7, 2023, which were followed by Israel launching a genocidal war on Gaza.
paras.zh: 此次集会标志着自2023年10月7日哈马斯领导的袭击事件发生三周年，随后以色列对加沙发动了种族灭绝战争。

paras.en: “When diplomatic relations with Israel were broken off, the message was that we would not be a nation complicit in their atrocities,” Nicolas Isaza, who took part in the protest, told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: “当与以色列断绝外交关系时，传达的信息是我们不会成为他们暴行的同谋，”参加抗议活动的尼古拉斯·伊萨萨告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: “Today our government is no longer drawing a line against the atrocities being committed in Palestine,” he added.
paras.zh: “今天，我们的政府不再对巴勒斯坦发生的暴行划定界限，”他补充道。

paras.en: De la Espriella, who was sworn in as president in August, promised close relations with the US and Israel during his election campaign as a way to combat armed groups in his country.
paras.zh: 德拉埃斯普里埃拉于八月宣誓就任总统，他在竞选期间承诺与美国和以色列保持密切关系，以此作为打击该国武装团体的一种方式。

paras.en: Colombia’s government has since restored relations with Israel after former President Gustavo Petro, who criticised Israel’s genocidal war on Gaza, severed diplomatic relations and halted Israeli arms imports.
paras.zh: 在前总统古斯塔沃·佩特罗批评以色列对加沙的种族灭绝战争、断绝外交关系并停止以色列武器进口后，哥伦比亚政府与以色列恢复了关系。

paras.en: The Colombian government also recognised Israel’s claim of sovereignty over the occupied Syrian Golan Heights, just days after the new president took power.
paras.zh: 在新总统上台几天后，哥伦比亚政府还承认以色列对被占领的叙利亚戈兰高地拥有主权。

articles.title: Why single Ebola death in Kenya has sparked fears of wider African spread

paras.en: Kenya reported its first death from a deadly strain of Ebola virus which had spread widely, starting in the Democratic Republic of Congo earlier this year.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚报告了首例致命埃博拉病毒株死亡病例，该病毒株今年早些时候在刚果民主共和国开始广泛传播。

paras.en: The Bundibugyo (BDBV) strain of Ebola was first detected in Uganda in 2007, according to the WHO. The ongoing outbreak in the DRC has killed at least 4,148 people out of 8,300 reported cases. It also spread across the border to Uganda, which had about 20 cases before being declared Ebola-free in July.
paras.zh: 据世界卫生组织称，埃博拉病毒本迪布焦 (BDBV) 毒株于 2007 年首次在乌干达发现。刚果民主共和国正在爆发的疫情已导致 8,300 例报告病例中至少 4,148 人死亡。它还跨越边​​境传播到乌干达，乌干达在 7 月份被宣布消除埃博拉病毒之前已有约 20 例病例。

paras.en: However, the person who died in Kenya from the disease had travelled from the DRC to Uganda over land before taking a flight to Nairobi, raising questions about Uganda’s status as “Ebola-free”, concerns about the rigidity of Kenya’s screening processes for people coming into the country and fears it may have spread further than previously thought.
paras.zh: 然而，在肯尼亚死于该疾病的人从刚果民主共和国经陆路前往乌干达，然后乘飞机飞往内罗毕，这引发了人们对乌干达“无埃博拉病毒”地位的质疑，对肯尼亚对进入该国的人的严格筛查程序的担忧，并担心该病毒的传播可能比之前想象的更严重。

paras.en: On Tuesday, the World Health Organization said the Kenyan government is now enhancing its disease surveillance with more targeted screening at high-risk points of entry.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织周二表示，肯尼亚政府目前正在加强疾病监测，在高风险入境点进行更有针对性的筛查。

paras.en: But Wolfgang Preiser, a professor and head of medical virology at Stellenbosch University in South Africa, explained that while efforts are being made to bring the outbreak under control, it has grown so much that “sheer numbers and the speed of spread are overwhelming for many systems.”
paras.zh: 但南非斯泰伦博斯大学医学病毒学教授兼负责人沃尔夫冈·普雷泽解释说，虽然我们正在努力控制疫情，但疫情已经发展得如此之快，“数量和传播速度对许多系统来说是难以承受的”。

paras.en: “I am not surprised that cases have reached other provinces in DRC and neighbouring countries. I expect that this will continue to happen until such time that the trajectory has been reversed and case numbers are in decline,” he told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: 他告诉半岛电视台：“我对病例蔓延到刚果民主共和国其他省份和邻国并不感到惊讶。我预计这种情况将继续发生，直到轨迹发生逆转并且病例数量下降。”

paras.en: It is a serious, potentially deadly viral infection which can be caught when a person comes into contact with the bodily fluids of an infected person or wild animal, including fluid lingering on surfaces. People have also been known to contract the disease through eating contaminated meat.
paras.zh: 这是一种严重的、可能致命的病毒感染，当人接触感染者或野生动物的体液（包括残留在表面的液体）时，就会感染这种病毒。人们还知道，人们会通过食用受污染的肉类而感染这种疾病。

paras.en: There have been many outbreaks in Central, West and East Africa.
paras.zh: 中非、西非和东非多地爆发疫情。

paras.en: A West African outbreak from 2014 to 2016 killed at least 11,300 people of a reported 28,600 cases and accelerated the push to develop a vaccine. That was a different strain of the Ebola virus, known as Zaire, for which there is now a vaccine.
paras.zh: 2014 年至 2016 年西非爆发的疫情导致 28,600 例病例中至少 11,300 人死亡，并加速了疫苗研发的进程。那是埃博拉病毒的另一种毒株，称为扎伊尔，现在已经有了疫苗。

paras.en: The strain behind the latest outbreak is Bundibugyo virus (BDBV), which is believed to have been caused by a new transmission from animals to humans, before then spreading between humans, rather than by variants linked to earlier outbreaks. There is no vaccine for Bundibugyo.
paras.zh: 最近一次爆发的病毒株是本迪布焦病毒（BDBV），据信该病毒是由从动物到人类的新传播引起的，然后在人类之间传播，而不是由与早期爆发有关的变种引起的。目前尚无针对本迪布焦的疫苗。

paras.en: Symptoms can appear between two and 21 days after infection and can start suddenly with flu-like symptoms, including a high temperature, fatigue, and a headache. It can lead to internal and external bleeding, impaired liver and kidney function and organ failure.
paras.zh: 症状可能在感染后 2 至 21 天之间出现，并且可能突然出现类似流感的症状，包括高烧、疲劳和头痛。它可导致内部和外部出血、肝肾功能受损和器官衰竭。
