paras.en: Kenyan Health Minister Aden Duale told reporters that the Kenyan patient, who has not been named, first became sick one month ago in the DRC, where they had been living for several years, and was treated there.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚卫生部长阿丁·杜阿勒告诉记者，这名未透露姓名的肯尼亚患者一个月前在刚果民主共和国首次发病，并在那里接受治疗，他们已经在那里生活了几年。

paras.en: On October 2, the patient travelled by road to the Ugandan capital, Kampala, via Beni, then flew to Nairobi, arriving the next day.
paras.zh: 10月2日，患者经陆路经贝尼前往乌干达首都坎帕拉，随后飞往内罗毕，并于次日抵达。

paras.en: After he arrived at the airport in Kenya, a relative and a friend took him to a hospital, where he was quickly isolated, and tests showed he had the virus, Duale said. Despite receiving care, the patient died from the virus on Monday and was buried on Tuesday in line with the country’s Ebola protocol.
paras.zh: 杜阿勒说，他抵达肯尼亚机场后，一名亲戚和一名朋友将他送往医院，他很快就被隔离，测试显示他感染了病毒。尽管接受了护理，该患者还是于周一死于该病毒，并于周二根据该国的埃博拉协议进行了埋葬。

paras.en: So far, health authorities in Kenya have identified 28 potential contacts, including family members and health workers who cared for the infected patient. Authorities are also separately tracking 23 passengers and four crew members from his flight, “with arrangements underway for appropriate follow-up and quarantine of people assessed to be at risk”, the WHO reported.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，肯尼亚卫生当局已确定了 28 名潜在接触者，包括家庭成员和照顾受感染患者的卫生工作者。世界卫生组织报告称，当局还在单独追踪该航班上的 23 名乘客和 4 名机组人员，“正在安排对评估为高危人群进行适当的后续行动和隔离”。

paras.en: Jean Bisimwa Nachenga, a professor in infectious diseases at Stellenbosch University, emphasised that the virus does not “respect national borders.”
paras.zh: 斯泰伦博斯大学传​​染病学教授让·比西姆瓦·纳成加强调，该病毒“不尊重国界”。

paras.en: “Population mobility, displacement, cross-border trade, and fragile healthcare systems make containment particularly challenging. In eastern DRC, ongoing insecurity further complicates surveillance, contact tracing, and access to affected communities,” he told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: “人口流动、流离失所、跨境贸易和脆弱的医疗保健系统使遏制变得特别具有挑战性。在刚果民主共和国东部，持续的不安全局势使监测、接触者追踪和进入受影响社区变得更加复杂，”他告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: “Regional cooperation is therefore essential.”
paras.zh: “因此，区域合作至关重要。”

paras.en: How did a sick patient get past screening in both Uganda and Kenya?
paras.zh: 在乌干达和肯尼亚，病人是如何通过筛查的？

paras.en: Passengers travelling to, from or through Uganda and Kenya have to pass multiple airport temperature checks and complete at least two digital forms intended to flag any potential exposure to the virus in the DRC. Somehow, the infected person in this case was missed by these checks.
paras.zh: 往返或途经乌干达和肯尼亚的乘客必须通过多次机场体温检查，并填写至少两份数字表格，以标记在刚果民主共和国是否可能接触过该病毒。不知何故，这些检查漏掉了本例中的感染者。

paras.en: Ugandan government spokesperson Alan Kasujja said Kampala was not to blame for the Kenyan man catching the virus and wrote on X, “Leave Uganda out of this conversation. We don’t have Ebola here.”
paras.zh: 乌干达政府发言人艾伦·卡苏贾 (Alan Kasujja) 表示，坎帕拉不应为肯尼亚男子感染病毒负责，并在 X 上写道：“让乌干达远离这场对话。我们这里没有埃博拉病毒。”

paras.en: In a statement issued on Tuesday, the Ugandan Ministry of Health said the man had a “normal temperature” when he was screened at the Entebbe airport before his departure.
paras.zh: 乌干达卫生部在周二发表的一份声明中表示，该男子出发前在恩德培机场接受检查时体温“正常”。

paras.en: Kenyan authorities say he may have taken medication to mask his symptoms when he was later screened at Nairobi airport. Investigations are continuing, however.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚当局表示，当他后来在内罗毕机场接受检查时，他可能服用了药物来掩盖症状。不过，调查仍在继续。

paras.en: “We are trying to retrieve the digital form he would have filled out at Entebbe airport when he went through the thermal scanning process to see what he declared in that form. The form includes questions about recent health problems but also whether a traveller was recently in DRC,” Richard Mugahi, a senior Ugandan health official, told the Reuters news agency.
paras.zh: 乌干达高级卫生官员理查德·穆加希（Richard Mugahi）告诉路透社：“我们正在尝试检索他在恩德培机场进行热扫描过程时填写的数字表格，以了解他在该表格中申报的内容。该表格包括有关近期健康问题的问题，以及旅行者最近是否去过刚果民主共和国。”

paras.en: “We are also going through airport security camera footage to see if we can identify the driver who dropped him at the airport so we can trace any contacts here.”
paras.zh: “我们还在检查机场安全摄像头的录像，看看是否能识别把他送到机场的司机的身份，这样我们就可以追踪这里的任何接触者。”

paras.en: Preiser also said the tracking system “seems to work as it did in Uganda,” with a diagnosis made rapidly as soon as the patient sought care in Kenya.
paras.zh: 普雷瑟还表示，追踪系统“似乎和在乌干达一样有效”，患者在肯尼亚寻求治疗后就迅速做出了诊断。

paras.en: “It will be instructive to try and trace back what happened at the various stops during his travels, and lessons should be heeded by all countries,” he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“尝试追溯他旅行期间各个站点发生的事情将具有启发性，所有国家都应该吸取教训。”

paras.en: He cited an example from a previous Ebola outbreak in West Africa, when a “British nurse fell sick during her return trip to the UK and reported to the medical check in Heathrow, only to be sent onwards to her destination where she was diagnosed with Ebola”.
paras.zh: 他引用了西非之前埃博拉疫情爆发的一个例子，当时“一名英国护士在返回英国期间生病了，并向希思罗机场进行了体检，结果被送往目的地，在那里她被诊断出患有埃博拉病毒”。

paras.en: The lesson, he said was that “even cooperative travellers and good systems may fall through the net”.
paras.zh: 他说，教训是“即使是合作的旅行者和良好的系统也可能会漏网”。

paras.en: Since it began in the DRC’s northeastern Ituri province, the latest outbreak has spread this year to seven provinces in the country’s north and east. It was officially declared an outbreak in the DRC in May.
paras.zh: 自刚果民主共和国东北部伊图里省爆发以来，最新疫情今年已蔓延至该国北部和东部的七个省。五月份，刚果民主共和国正式宣布疫情暴发。

paras.en: Weak infrastructure, the remoteness of the region in eastern DRC, and ongoing conflict with armed groups near the borders with South Sudan, Uganda, and Rwanda have hindered efforts to respond to cases quickly and effectively.
paras.zh: 刚果民主共和国东部地区基础设施薄弱、地处偏远，以及南苏丹、乌干达和卢旺达边境附近与武装团体持续发生的冲突，阻碍了快速有效地应对案件的努力。

paras.en: The response to the outbreak has been further complicated by several factors, including strikes by unpaid health workers, misinformation and cultural traditions. These have included open-casket family burials of some of those killed by the virus earlier on during the outbreak, potentially increasing the risk of further transmission.
paras.zh: 由于多种因素，包括无薪卫生工作者的罢工、错误信息和文化传统，对疫情的应对变得更加复杂。其中包括对一些在疫情爆发早期死于该病毒的人进行开棺家庭埋葬，这可能会增加进一步传播的风险。

paras.en: The United Nations reported on Friday last week that an Ebola-hit camp housing a transit centre for infected patients was burned by soldiers earlier this week when they were looking for weapons on the outskirts of Bunia, the capital city of Ituri province, which is at the epicentre of the outbreak.
paras.zh: 联合国上周五报告称，本周早些时候，士兵们在伊图里省省会布尼亚郊区寻找武器时烧毁了一个埃博拉疫情营地，该营地设有感染患者转运中心，该省是疫情的中心。

paras.en: The incident forced 19,000 people to flee the camp.
paras.zh: 这一事件迫使19,000人逃离难民营。

paras.en: The disease also spread to Uganda, where 20 people who had travelled from DRC were treated before the country declared it was free of Ebola in July.
paras.zh: 这种疾病还传播到了乌干达，在该国 7 月份宣布埃博拉疫情消失之前，有 20 名从刚果民主共和国旅行过来的人在那里接受了治疗。

paras.en: Recently, it has become increasingly hard to contain within DRC.
paras.zh: 最近，刚果民主共和国内部的遏制变得越来越困难。

paras.en: On Monday, Doctors Without Borders, known by its French initials MSF, warned that there had been an “alarming surge” of cases in eastern North Kivu province, which borders Uganda, and where 40 percent of all new cases are currently being recorded.
paras.zh: 周一，无国界医生组织（法语缩写为 MSF）警告称，与乌干达接壤的北基伍省东部的病例出现“令人震惊的激增”，目前该省记录的新增病例占所有新增病例的 40%。

paras.en: “It is like fighting a megafire,” Stephanie Hoffmann, coordinator at MSF’s Ebola treatment centre in the city of Butembo, said. “Multiple outbreaks are developing at the same time, with varying intensity and in different locations.”
paras.zh: “这就像扑灭一场大火，”无国界医生组织位于布滕博市埃博拉治疗中心的协调员斯蒂芬妮霍夫曼说。 “多起疫情同时发生，强度不同，地点不同。”

paras.en: Some 2 million people live in North Kivu’s city of Butembo and surrounding areas, but it has only four Ebola treatment centres, two of which opened recently, MSF told the media. Patients often have to be transferred elsewhere, increasing the risk of infection to others, Hoffman said.
paras.zh: 无国界医生告诉媒体，北基伍省布滕博市及周边地区约有200万人居住，但只有四个埃博拉治疗中心，其中两个是最近开业的。霍夫曼说，患者常常必须转移到其他地方，这增加了感染他人的风险。

paras.en: The WHO is working with Kenyan authorities to trace contacts and to strengthen checks for travellers coming into the country.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织正在与肯尼亚当局合作追踪接触者并加强对进入该国的旅行者的检查。

paras.en: Mohamed Janabi, WHO regional director for Africa, said on Tuesday that “health emergency preparedness gives us a head start”.
paras.zh: 世卫组织非洲区域主任穆罕默德·贾纳比周二表示，“卫生应急准备工作让我们领先一步”。

paras.en: “Kenya has put important outbreak control measures in place. The priority now is to move swiftly to detect any further cases before the virus has an opportunity to spread. We’re supporting the ongoing efforts to strengthen the response, and with rapid and coordinated action, we can prevent the virus from gaining a foothold and stop a potential larger outbreak,” Janabi said.
paras.zh: 贾纳比说：“肯尼亚已经采取了重要的疫情控制措施。现在的首要任务是在病毒有机会传播之前迅速采取行动，发现任何进一步的病例。我们支持正在进行的加强应对工作，通过迅速和协调的行动，我们可以防止病毒站稳脚跟，阻止潜在的更大规模的疫情爆发。”

paras.en: The agency also said it has delivered about 1,000 Ebola tests and “1,000 personal protective equipment kits to high-risk counties in Kenya”.
paras.zh: 该机构还表示，已向肯尼亚高风险县交付了约 1,000 份埃博拉病毒检测试剂盒和“1,000 份个人防护装备包”。

paras.en: In June, the Kenyan government granted the United States permission to set up an Ebola quarantine facility at the Laikipia airbase, 120 miles (193km) from the capital, Nairobi, to treat infected Americans travelling from African nations before they arrived in the US. The scheme generated uproar from locals who feared transmission of the disease, and Kenyan courts halted the plan.
paras.zh: 6月，肯尼亚政府批准美国在距离首都内罗毕120英里（193公里）的莱基皮亚空军基地设立埃博拉检疫设施，以便在从非洲国家抵达美国之前治疗受感染的美国人。该计划引起了当地人的轩然大波，他们担心疾病传播，肯尼亚法院叫停了该计划。

paras.en: Overall, Nachenga said that merely strengthening border screening wasn’t enough. It was also important to “reinforce the entire public health response”.
paras.zh: 总体而言，纳琴加表示，仅仅加强边境检查是不够的。 “加强整个公共卫生应对措施”也很重要。

paras.en: “This means training frontline healthcare workers, ensuring rapid laboratory diagnosis, promptly isolating suspected cases, and tracing and monitoring contacts. Kenya’s ability to identify this case provides an important opportunity to strengthen preparedness,” he added.
paras.zh: “这意味着培训一线医护人员，确保快速实验室诊断，及时隔离疑似病例，并追踪和监测接触者。肯尼亚识别此病例的能力为加强准备提供了重要机会，”他补充道。

articles.title: U.S. moves long-range bombers from U.K. And, Israel allegedly warned before Oct. 7
articles.author: Brittney Melton

paras.en: U.S. moves long-range bombers from U.K. And, Israel allegedly warned before Oct. 7
paras.zh: 美国从英国撤走远程轰炸机，据称以色列在 10 月 7 日之前发出警告

paras.en: New information reveals that, over the weekend, the U.S. removed all long-range bombers from the British air base near where five men were arrested last week in a suspected terror plot. A U.S. official who is not authorized to speak publicly told NPR that the decision to abruptly send home a dozen B-1 bombers from Royal Air Force base Fairford was due to a "credible threat" from Iran, which potentially involved a drone attack.
paras.zh: 新信息显示，周末，美国从英国空军基地附近撤走了所有远程轰炸机，上周有五名男子因涉嫌恐怖阴谋被捕。一位未获授权公开发言的美国官员告诉 NPR，突然决定从皇家空军费尔福德基地遣返十几架 B-1 轰炸机是由于来自伊朗的“可信威胁”，其中可能涉及无人机袭击。

paras.en: - 🎧 The war with Iran has shown that U.S. military bases, both at home and abroad, are now seen as more vulnerable, NPR's Greg Myre tells Up First. Iranian drones and missiles have targeted U.S. bases across the Middle East since the start of the conflict. For the past three decades, the U.S. has established these bases to protect its allies, but the rise of drone threats has changed this perspective. Now, the U.S. must defend a network of military bases — a task that is complicated and costly, Myre says.
paras.zh: - 🎧 与伊朗的战争表明，美国国内外的军事基地现在被认为更加脆弱，NPR 的格雷格·迈尔 (Greg Myre) 告诉 Up First。自冲突爆发以来，伊朗无人机和导弹一直以美国在中东的基地为目标。过去三十年来，美国建立这些基地是为了保护其盟友，但无人机威胁的兴起改变了这一观点。迈雷说，现在，美国必须保卫军事基地网络，这是一项复杂且成本高昂的任务。

paras.en: High school students in France are blocking schools today, after hundreds of thousands of them marched across the country yesterday. They are joined by teachers, parents and labor union members. The movement, which began in a particularly run-down high school facing teacher absenteeism, aims to improve learning conditions and address inequalities in the French education system.
paras.zh: 继昨天数十万法国高中生在全国各地游行后，今天法国高中生封锁了学校。教师、家长和工会成员也加入了他们的行列。该运动始于一所面临教师缺勤的特别破旧的高中，旨在改善学习条件并解决法国教育体系中的不平等问题。

paras.en: - 🎧 The French school system plays a crucial role in shaping the national identity, promoting the idea that anyone can achieve their goals if they apply themselves in l'école de la Republique, or the school of the republic, NPR's Eleanor Beardsley says. She adds that this concept is at the heart of France's democracy and vision of itself as a meritocracy and egalitarian society. Even elite public schools in Paris are joining the movement. French news reports show clashes between youth and police and cars, trash cans and schools burning. Initially, the far-right condemned delinquency, but many also saw police aggression. Critics argue that the government responded too late and then framed the issue as urban violence instead of addressing the students' demands.
paras.zh: - NPR 的埃莉诺·比尔兹利 (Eleanor Beardsley) 表示，法国的学校系统在塑造国家认同方面发挥着至关重要的作用，它宣扬了这样一种理念，即任何人只要在共和学校 (l'école de la Republique) 或共和国学校中努力，就可以实现自己的目标。她补充说，这一概念是法国民主及其作为精英政治和平等社会的愿景的核心。甚至巴黎的精英公立学校也加入了这一运动。法国新闻报道显示青年与警察之间发生冲突，汽车、垃圾桶和学校被焚烧。最初，极右翼谴责犯罪行为，但许多人也看到了警察的侵略行为。批评者认为，政府反应太晚，然后将问题归结为城市暴力，而不是解决学生的诉求。

paras.en: A former head of Germany's foreign intelligence agency will appear before a federal judge today to face charges of espionage and attempted treason. Federal prosecutors accuse August Hanning of using classified information to brief a foreign intelligence agency. He served as the head of Germany's CIA equivalent for seven years from 1998 to 2005. Prosecutors allege he shared sensitive political information for 12 years after leaving office. They have not yet disclosed who Hanning's alleged clients were.
paras.zh: 德国外国情报机构前负责人今天将出庭接受联邦法官的审判，面临间谍和叛国未遂指控。联邦检察官指控奥古斯特·汉宁使用机密信息向外国情报机构通报情况。从 1998 年到 2005 年，他担任德国中央情报局的负责人长达七年。检察官指控他在卸任后的 12 年内分享了敏感的政治信息。他们尚未透露汉宁的所谓客户是谁。

paras.en: - 🎧 NPR's Esme Nicholson says that categorizing Hanning's alleged actions as a major setback to Germany's security apparatus is putting it mildly. Prosecutors allege that a former aide to Hanning leaked documents intended for high-level briefings, raising concerns among Germany's western allies about the credibility of its intelligence agencies and whether their own agents have been compromised. This arrest coincides with a warning from Martin Jaeger, Germany's new foreign intelligence chief, that Russia is waging a "shadow war" in Germany through sabotage, cyber attacks, and disinformation campaigns. Nicholson says the consequences of this conflict are not only humiliating but also potentially dangerous.
paras.zh: - 🎧 NPR 的埃斯梅·尼科尔森 (Esme Nicholson) 表示，将汉宁涉嫌的行为归为德国安全机构的重大挫折是温和的说法。检察官指控汉宁的一名前助手泄露了用于高层简报的文件，引起了德国西方盟友对其情报机构可信度以及其特工是否受到损害的担忧。这次逮捕恰逢德国新任外交情报负责人马丁·耶格发出警告，称俄罗斯正在通过破坏、网络攻击和虚假信息活动在德国发动“影子战争”。尼科尔森表示，这场冲突的后果不仅是令人羞辱的，而且还具有潜在的危险。

paras.en: As Israel marks three years since Hamas' surprise Oct. 7 attacks, new reports in Israeli and U.S. media say regional allies warned Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu that Hamas was planning to attack. Four people in the Middle East with direct knowledge of the warnings told NPR that Netanyahu was personally informed about the potential attacks and his security agencies were notified multiple times in the weeks and days leading up to Oct. 7, 2023. Netanyahu has denied this, labeling the reports "fake news" and recently filing a defamation lawsuit against the news outlets that first published the information. He and his defense minister now warn that Hamas might attempt to attack again on this Oct. 7 memorial day and leading up to Israel's national elections later this month.
paras.zh: 在以色列纪念哈马斯 10 月 7 日突然发动袭击三周年之际，以色列和美国媒体的新报道称，地区盟友警告总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡，哈马斯正计划发动袭击。四名直接了解这些警告的中东人士告诉 NPR，内塔尼亚胡亲自获悉了潜在的攻击，并且在 2023 年 10 月 7 日之前的几周和几天内多次收到通知。内塔尼亚胡否认了这一点，将这些报道贴上“假新闻”的标签，并于最近对首先发布该信息的新闻媒体提起诽谤诉讼。他和国防部长现在警告说，哈马斯可能会在 10 月 7 日阵亡将士纪念日以及本月晚些时候以色列全国大选之前再次发动袭击。

paras.en: Living Better is a special series about what it takes to stay healthy in America.
paras.zh: 《生活得更好》是一个关于如何在美国保持健康的特别系列。

paras.en: Parental monitoring plays a key role in shielding kids from the dangers of social media and excessive screen time. Parents can empower their children to navigate the digital world confidently and safely by establishing clear boundaries early and having open conversations about online habits. Here are some ways guardians can help their kids use their devices more safely:
paras.zh: 家长监控在保护孩子免受社交媒体和过度屏幕时间的危险方面发挥着关键作用。父母可以通过尽早建立明确的界限并就网络习惯进行公开对话，帮助孩子自信、安全地畅游数字世界。监护人可以通过以下一些方式帮助孩子更安全地使用设备：

paras.en: - 📱 Put the phone away during meals and bedtime. This will help protect sleep and reduce the risk of eating disorders.
paras.zh: - 📱 吃饭和睡觉时把手机收起来。这将有助于保护睡眠并降低饮食失调的风险。

paras.en: - 📱 Apply rules around screen time to the whole family, including parents and guardians.
paras.zh: - 📱 将有关屏幕时间的规则应用于整个家庭，包括父母和监护人。

paras.en: - 📱 Ask children open-minded questions about what they are doing online. Open communication helps kids feel comfortable sharing what they experience online.
paras.zh: - 📱 开诚布公地向孩子们询问他们在网上做什么。开放式沟通可以帮助孩子们轻松地分享他们在网上的经历。

paras.en: - 📱 Establish early communication with children about cyberbullying, online scams, Instagram filters and privacy issues for their awareness.
paras.zh: - 📱 尽早与儿童就网络欺凌、网络诈骗、Instagram 过滤器和隐私问题进行沟通，以提高他们的认识。

paras.en: The results of the 2026 midterm elections will shape the final two years of President Trump's second term and serve as a precursor to the 2028 general election. This month, Morning Edition is reporting from six states that could change the balance of power in Washington.
paras.zh: 2026年中期选举的结果将决定特朗普总统第二任期的最后两年，并成为2028年大选的前兆。本月，《晨报》报道了六个可能改变华盛顿权力平衡的州。

paras.en: Morning Edition's Leila Fadel traveled to the battleground state of Maine to discover what issues are energizing voters. Maine residents could play a crucial role in deciding which political party controls the Senate. One of the most significant U.S. Senate races features Republican incumbent Susan Collins, who is seeking re-election against Democrat Troy Jackson. The race has been closely watched, especially after Jackson was nominated by the Maine Democratic Party after Graham Platner withdrew because of a sexual assault allegation. Listen to what has been happening in that contest.
paras.zh: 早间版的莱拉·法德尔前往战场州缅因州，了解哪些问题正在激励选民。缅因州居民可以在决定哪个政党控制参议院方面发挥关键作用。美国最重要的参议院竞选之一是共和党现任参议员苏珊·柯林斯(Susan Collins)，她正在寻求连任，对手是民主党人特洛伊·杰克逊(Troy Jackson)。这场竞选受到密切关注，特别是在格雷厄姆·普拉特纳因性侵犯指控退出后，杰克逊被缅因州民主党提名。听听那场比赛发生了什么。

paras.en: Fadel was also on the ground with residents, figuring out what they cared about. Hear more about:
paras.zh: 法德尔还与居民一起到现场，了解他们关心的是什么。了解更多有关：

paras.en: - 🎧 How the Trump administration's immigration enforcement has divided residents.
paras.zh: - 🎧 特朗普政府的移民执法如何使居民产生分歧。

paras.en: - 🎧 Whether Democratic policies and candidates are resonating, and why so many men voted for Trump in 2024.
paras.zh: - 🎧 民主党政策和候选人是否产生共鸣，以及为什么这么多男性在 2024 年投票支持特朗普。

paras.en: - 🎧 How the economy and other key issues are influencing voters' decisions in the midterm elections.
paras.zh: - 🎧 经济和其他关键问题如何影响选民在中期选举中的决定。

paras.en: - The 2026 National Book Awards finalists are here, showcasing a diverse range of literary works, from nonfiction on the prison system to a novel about a patient navigator at a gender-affirming care center.
paras.zh: - 2026 年国家图书奖决赛入围者在这里展示了各种各样的文学作品，从有关监狱系统的纪实作品到关于性别肯定护理中心的病人导航员的小说。

paras.en: - Avengers: Endgame has reclaimed the number one position on Hollywood's all-time worldwide box office chart following its recent re-release in cinemas. It first became the highest-grossing film in history in 2019.
paras.zh: - 《复仇者联盟：终局之战》最近在电影院重新上映后，重新夺回了好莱坞全球票房榜上的第一名。它于 2019 年首次成为历史上票房最高的电影。

paras.en: - Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel have earned the 2026 Nobel Prize for Physiology or Medicine for their contributions to optogenetics, a field of neuroscience that examines the links between neuron activity and specific behaviors. Soon after learning of his win, Deisseroth spoke with Here & Now. (via WBUR)
paras.zh: - Karl Deisseroth、Peter Hegemann 和 Georg Nagel 因其对光遗传学的贡献而获得 2026 年诺贝尔生理学或医学奖，光遗传学是一个研究神经元活动与特定行为之间联系的神经科学领域。得知自己获奖后不久，戴瑟罗斯接受了《Here & Now》采访。 （通过 WBUR）

articles.title: What is the pneumonic plague?
articles.author: Michaeleen Doucleff

paras.en: The ancient word "plague" is back in the headlines.
paras.zh: “瘟疫”这个古老的词又重新出现在头条新闻中。

paras.en: NPR's Russia correspondent Charles Maynes reported this week on what we know about a Russian researcher working in a lab studying the plague who died from pneumonia of an unknown origin last week.
paras.zh: 美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 俄罗斯记者查尔斯·梅恩斯 (Charles Maynes) 本周报道了我们所知的一名在实验室研究鼠疫的俄罗斯研究人员上周死于不明原因肺炎的情况。

paras.en: Maynes reports that the employee was a 28-year-old woman who worked in a lab in Siberia, some 2,500 miles from Moscow. An investigation by Russia's consumer health watchdog concluded that no pathogens in her body were connected to her work with infectious disease.
paras.zh: 梅恩斯报道称，这名员工是一名 28 岁女性，在西伯利亚的一家实验室工作，距离莫斯科约 2,500 英里。俄罗斯消费者健康监督机构的一项调查得出结论，她体内没有病原体与她从事传染病工作有关。

paras.en: But local media have raised concerns about the spread of pneumonic plague, which NPR has not independently confirmed.
paras.zh: 但当地媒体对肺鼠疫的传播表示担忧，但 NPR 尚未独立证实这一点。

paras.en: It's one of the diseases studied at the lab in Siberia. It's airborne and can be fatal.
paras.zh: 这是西伯利亚实验室研究的疾病之一。它通过空气传播，可能致命。

paras.en: While noting that 200 "contacts" were in quarantine, Russia has denied that there are cases of plague in the area. But questions loom. In a press conference Wednesday, the head of the World Health Organization, Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said these Russian assurances were — at the very least — incomplete: "We don't yet have the full picture of this event and we're not able to conduct a full risk assessment."
paras.zh: 俄罗斯虽然指出 200 名“接触者”正在接受隔离，但否认该地区存在鼠疫病例。但问题也随之而来。在周三的新闻发布会上，世界卫生组织总干事谭德塞表示，俄罗斯的这些保证至少是不完整的：“我们还没有全面了解这一事件，也无法进行全面的风险评估。”

paras.en: In the meantime, here's what we do know about the bacterial disease of plague — and the variant known as pneumonic plague.
paras.zh: 与此同时，以下是我们对鼠疫细菌性疾病及其变种肺鼠疫的了解。

paras.en: The plague comes in several versions, depending on which body part the bacteria invade. When a flea bites a person, the individual typically develops what's called bubonic plague. In this case, the telltale sign is one or more swollen and painful lymph nodes, known as buboes. (The word "bubonic" comes from the Greek boubon, which means groin, because some people have swollen lymph nodes in their groin.) Doctors can diagnose the disease by taking a sample from the person's blood or lymph nodes and then submitting the sample to a lab for testing.
paras.zh: 鼠疫有多种版本，具体取决于细菌侵入的身体部位。当跳蚤叮咬一个人时，该人通常会患上所谓的黑死病。在这种情况下，明显的迹象是一个或多个肿胀且疼痛的淋巴结，称为腹股沟淋巴结炎。 （“bubonic”这个词来自希腊语 boubon，意思是腹股沟，因为有些人的腹股沟淋巴结肿大。）医生可以通过从人的血液或淋巴结中采集样本，然后将样本提交给实验室进行检测来诊断这种疾病。

paras.en: But when the bacteria spread to the lungs, this can cause what's called pneumonic plague. In this case, there's often no telltale sign of the plague, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.
paras.zh: 但当细菌扩散到肺部时，就会引起所谓的肺鼠疫。据美国疾病控制与预防中心称，在这种情况下，通常没有鼠疫的明显迹象。

paras.en: This version is much more dangerous, says medical entomologist Adelaide Miarinjara at Emory University. "It transmits pretty easily between people because it spreads through droplets, almost like COVID spreads."
paras.zh: 埃默里大学医学昆虫学家阿德莱德·米亚林贾拉 (Adelaide Miarinjara) 表示，这个版本要危险得多。 “它很容易在人与人之间传播，因为它通过飞沫传播，就像新冠病毒传播一样。”

paras.en: And people can die more quickly with pneumonic plague than other forms, she adds, because the disease progresses more rapidly. "The key here is early diagnosis. If people aren't expecting it or don't seek treatment, they can die."
paras.zh: 她补充说，与其他形式的鼠疫相比，人们死于肺鼠疫的速度更快，因为这种疾病的进展速度更快。 “这里的关键是早期诊断。如果人们没有预料到或不寻求治疗，他们可能会死亡。”

paras.en: Treatment involves antibiotics, often administered by IV infusion.
paras.zh: 治疗涉及抗生素，通常通过静脉输注给药。

paras.en: In 2017, Madagascar suffered a large outbreak of pneumonic plague when a person from a rural part of the country brought the disease to the coastal city of Toamasina. That city hadn't seen a case of the plague in nearly a century, says Miarinjara, who was in Madagascar at the time. "A person transmitted the disease on public transportation," she says.
paras.zh: 2017年，马达加斯加爆发了大规模的肺鼠疫，一名来自该国农村地区的人将这种疾病带到了沿海城市图阿马西纳。当时在马达加斯加的米亚林贾拉说，那个城市已经有近一个世纪没有出现过鼠疫病例了。 “一个人在公共交通工具上传播了这种疾病，”她说。

paras.en: The country recorded more than 2,400 suspected cases, including nearly 1,900 cases of pneumonic plague. One study estimated that about 25% of people with confirmed cases died in this outbreak.
paras.zh: 该国记录了2400多例疑似病例，其中近1900例肺鼠疫病例。一项研究估计，大约 25% 的确诊病例在这次疫情中死亡。

paras.en: As for the reports of Russian "contacts" of the lab worker under quarantine — that reflects a long-standing response to sicknesses like the plague.
paras.zh: 至于俄罗斯“接触”被隔离的实验室工作人员的报道，这反映了对鼠疫等疾病的长期反应。

paras.en: The idea of isolating, or quarantining, sick people dates back at least 3,000 years. The Book of Leviticus in the Bible mentions how to isolate people with leprosy.
paras.zh: 隔离病人的想法至少可以追溯到 3000 年前。圣经中的利未记提到了如何隔离麻风病患者。

paras.en: The word "quarantine" itself arose during the Black Death, when the city-state of Dubrovnik, now part of the country of Croatia, enacted what is likely the first state-imposed isolation.
paras.zh: “隔离”一词本身是在黑死病期间出现的，当时杜布罗夫尼克城邦（现在是克罗地亚的一部分）颁布了可能是第一个国家强制隔离的政策。

paras.en: At the time, Dubrovnik was a wealthy merchant city along the coast of the Adriatic Sea. City leaders wanted to keep the bubonic plague out. So they began to force visitors to wait for 40 days on a remote island outside the city before coming ashore.
paras.zh: 当时，杜布罗夫尼克是亚得里亚海沿岸一座富裕的商业城市。市领导希望阻止鼠疫蔓延。于是他们开始强迫游客在城外的一个偏远小岛上等待40天才能上岸。

paras.en: They called the wait quarantino, from the Italian word for "40."
paras.zh: 他们将等待称为“quarantino”，源自意大利语，意思是“40”。

paras.en: "The first quarantine was pretty much improvised," Ivana Marinavić, the head of educational programs at the Lazarettos of Dubrovnik, told NPR in 2021. The Lazarettos were the first buildings ever constructed for the sole purpose of quarantining.
paras.zh: 杜布罗夫尼克 Lazarettos 教育项目负责人伊万娜·马里纳维奇 (Ivana Marinavić) 于 2021 年对 NPR 表示：“第一次隔离几乎是临时安排的。”Lazarettos 是有史以来第一座专门用于隔离目的的建筑。

paras.en: If you broke the quarantine during the plague, the consequences were severe. "Torture, or cutting your nose or your ears off," Marinavić told NPR.
paras.zh: 如果在瘟疫期间违反隔离措施，后果很严重。 “酷刑，或者割掉你的鼻子或耳朵，”马里纳维奇告诉美国国家公共广播电台。

articles.title: Maricarmen, the 87-year-old woman whose eviction shook Spain, has died
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Maricarmen, the 87-year-old woman whose eviction shook Spain, has died
paras.zh: 震惊西班牙的 87 岁妇女马里卡门去世

paras.en: MADRID — María del Carmen Abascal, the 87-year-old woman whose eviction from her longtime Madrid home sparked nationwide protests across Spain and unleashed a political crisis, died on Wednesday while hospitalized.
paras.zh: 马德里——87岁的玛丽亚·德尔·卡门·阿巴斯卡(María del Carmen Abascal)女士周三在住院期间去世，她被从马德里长期居住的家中驱逐，引发了西班牙全国范围的抗议活动，并引发了一场政治危机。

paras.en: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez led the way on social media offering his condolences after housing activists and Abascal's lawyer announced her death. Known widely as "Maricarmen," she had become a symbol for renters struggling with Spain's housing affordability crisis.
paras.zh: 在住房活动人士和阿巴斯卡尔的律师宣布她去世后，西班牙首相佩德罗·桑切斯在社交媒体上率先表示哀悼。她被广泛称为“Maricarmen”，已成为与西班牙住房负担能力危机作斗争的租房者的象征。

paras.en: "All my love to Maricarmen's family and loved ones," Sánchez said in a post on X. "A hug as well to all of us who feel this loss as our own today. Rest in peace."
paras.zh: 桑切斯在 X 上的一篇帖子中说：“我向马里卡门的家人和亲人致以我的全部爱。同时也向我们所有今天感受到这种损失的人拥抱一下。安息吧。”

paras.en: The emotions ran into anger on the street among the protesters gathered near Spain's Parliament who chanted "Maricarmen lives, the fight goes on!"
paras.zh: 聚集在西班牙议会附近的抗议者在街上高呼“马里卡门生命，战斗继续！”，愤怒的情绪在街上蔓延。

paras.en: Iciar López, a 32-year-old psychologist, shared her feelings with The Associated Press at the protest in Madrid.
paras.zh: 32 岁的心理学家伊西亚尔·洛佩斯 (Iciar López) 向美联社分享了她在马德里抗议活动中的感受。

paras.en: "A great deal of sorrow. And above all, the thought that she is the cause, the head of this whole revolution that has happened, and that she can't see it," she said. "It makes me very sad that she can't see if anything comes of it ... That's what angers me the most, honestly."
paras.zh: “非常悲伤。最重要的是，想到她是整个革命的起因、领导者，而她却看不到它，”她说。 “她看不到这件事会带来什么结果，这让我非常难过……说实话，这才是最让我愤怒的地方。”

paras.en: A case that captured media attention and traveled around the world
paras.zh: 一个引起媒体关注并传遍世界各地的案例

paras.en: Spaniards increasingly frustrated by housing costs periodically march in major cities demanding action from lawmakers. But a fresh wave of indignation has swept Spain since Sept. 23, when Maricarmen, who used a wheelchair, was carried on a stretcher from her home of seven decades after police cordoned off the street and removed protesters. She was taken to a hospital because of her fragile health.
paras.zh: 西班牙人对住房成本越来越感到沮丧，定期在大城市举行游行，要求立法者采取行动。但自9月23日以来，新一波的愤慨席卷了西班牙，当时警察封锁了街道并驱散了抗议者，使用轮椅的马里卡门被担架从她居住了七年的家中抬了出来。由于身体虚弱，她被送往医院。

paras.en: Televised images of the eviction prompted thousands of people to protest in Madrid and other cities across the country.
paras.zh: 电视上播放的驱逐画面促使数千人在马德里和全国其他城市举行抗议活动。

paras.en: Maricarmen's lawyer, Beatriz Duro, did not disclose the cause of death when she confirmed it to Cadena Ser radio. Duro said that she and the activists were all devastated.
paras.zh: 马里卡门的律师 Beatriz Duro 在向 Cadena Ser 广播电台确认死因时没有透露。杜罗说，她和活动人士都悲痛欲绝。

paras.en: "Maricarmen's case, which captured media attention and traveled around the world, leaves us the image of the shameful violence of these types of evictions and the impact they can have on people's health," Duro said.
paras.zh: 杜罗说：“马里卡门的案件引起了媒体的关注并传遍了世界各地，让我们看到了此类驱逐的可耻暴力行为及其对人们健康可能产生的影响。”

paras.en: She had been expected to return home after leaving the hospital. The real estate company that evicted her in order to rent the property at a much higher price eventually caved in under immense public pressure and agreed to let her return to the apartment.
paras.zh: 她原本预计出院后就可以回家。为了以更高的价格出租房产而驱逐她的房地产公司最终在巨大的公众压力下屈服并同意让她回到公寓。

paras.en: "Although a historic agreement was reached that would have allowed her to return home, this solution came too late," the Madrid Tenants' Union said in a statement Wednesday. "It was an entirely avoidable situation following a harrowing ordeal."
paras.zh: 马德里租户联盟周三在一份声明中表示：“尽管达成了一项历史性协议，允许她回家，但这个解决方案来得太晚了。” “在经历了痛苦的磨难之后，这是完全可以避免的情况。”

paras.en: Maricarmen's plight galvanized a social movement
paras.zh: 马里卡门的困境引发了一场社会运动

paras.en: The average rent for Spain has almost doubled in the last 10 years, according to the real estate website Idealista. Spain's government said that 26% of Spaniards who rent housing spend an average of 40% of their income on rent and utilities, compared with the European Union average of 18% of renters who do so.
paras.zh: 根据房地产网站 Idealista 的数据，过去 10 年西班牙的平均租金几乎翻了一番。西班牙政府表示，26% 的西班牙租房者平均将收入的 40% 用于租金和水电费，而欧盟租房者的平均比例为 18%。

paras.en: Protesters camped in Madrid's central Puerta del Sol square held a minute of silence after learning of her death.
paras.zh: 得知她的死讯后，在马德里市中心太阳门广场扎营的抗议者默哀一分钟。

paras.en: Maricarmen spent almost her entire life in her apartment, where she first lived with her parents and brother. She later worked as a secretary for the board of a pharmaceutical company, Spanish daily El País reported. She said both her parents died in the apartment.
paras.zh: 马里卡门几乎一生都在她的公寓里度过，她最初与父母和兄弟住在那里。据西班牙日报《国家报》报道，她后来担任一家制药公司的董事会秘书。她说她的父母都死在公寓里。

paras.en: After retiring in 1998, she spent her days walking around the neighborhood, doing errands and taking care of the precious items in her home. The paper reported that black-and-white family photographs were among the only things she had brought with her to the hospital.
paras.zh: 1998年退休后，她每天都在附近走来走去，办事并保管家里的贵重物品。该报报道称，黑白家庭照片是她带到医院的唯一物品之一。

paras.en: "Maricarmen only wanted to die in her home. She wasn't asking for anything else," Eugenio Melchor, 22, said at the protest in Madrid. "She was dying in her home and she almost did. They have killed her. I mean, there's no other word for it, and I hope those responsible for this pay and go to trial."
paras.zh: 22 岁的尤金尼奥·梅尔乔 (Eugenio Melchor) 在马德里的抗议活动中说：“马里卡曼只想死在家里。她没有要求任何其他东西。” “她在家里快要死了，她差一点就死了。他们杀了她。我的意思是，没有其他说法可以形容，我希望那些对此负责的人付出代价并接受审判。”

paras.en: Maricarmen's plight galvanized a social movement, prompted Spain's unions to announce a general strike next month and intensified pressure on political leaders. Sánchez called an early election Monday after his government failed last week to push emergency housing measures through Parliament. He now hopes the issue will reinvigorate his Socialist Party and help him form a new government after the Nov. 29 election.
paras.zh: 马里卡门的困境引发了一场社会运动，促使西班牙工会宣布下个月举行大罢工，并加大了对政治领导人的压力。桑切斯周一呼吁提前举行选举，因为他的政府上周未能在议会推动紧急住房措施。他现在希望这一问题能够重振他的社会党，并帮助他在 11 月 29 日选举后组建新政府。

paras.en: Housing Minister Isabel Rodríguez also expressed condolences, writing on X: "I deeply lament the death of Maricarmen. My condolences to those who accompanied her and fought by her side until the end."
paras.zh: 住房部长伊莎贝尔·罗德里格斯也在X上写道：“我对马里卡门的去世深感哀悼。我向那些陪伴她并与她并肩作战直到最后的人们表示哀悼。”

paras.en: Conservative opposition leader Alberto Núñez Feijóo, who hopes to unseat Sánchez and his left-wing coalition, also offered condolences.
paras.zh: 希望推翻桑切斯及其左翼联盟的保守反对党领袖阿尔贝托·努涅斯·费霍也表示哀悼。

paras.en: "I want to express my condolences to Maricarmen's family and loved ones. No campaign, no party, no use for political advantage," the Popular Party leader wrote. "When faced with the death of a person, we must only show respect."
paras.zh: 这位人民党领导人写道：“我想向马里卡门的家人和亲人表示哀悼。没有竞选活动，没有政党，没有政治优势。” “面对一个人的死亡，我们只能表现出尊重。”

articles.title: Texas executes Jamaal Howard despite concerns over lethal injection drug used in failed Tennessee execution

paras.en: A Texas man convicted of killing a convenience store clerk during a robbery was executed Wednesday evening after the Supreme Court declined to halt the execution, despite his attorneys raising concerns about the lethal injection drug used in a failed execution attempt in Tennessee last week.
paras.zh: 一名得克萨斯州男子因在抢劫中杀死一名便利店店员而被定罪，周三晚上在最高法院拒绝停止执行死刑后被处决，尽管他的律师对上周田纳西州执行死刑失败时使用的致命注射药物表示担忧。

paras.en: Jamaal Howard, 46, was pronounced dead at 8:03 p.m. He was sentenced to death for the 2000 killing of 42-year-old Vickie Swartout in Silsbee, Texas.
paras.zh: 贾马尔·霍华德 (Jamaal Howard)，46 岁，于晚上 8 点 03 分被宣布死亡。他因 2000 年在德克萨斯州锡尔斯比杀害 42 岁的维琪·斯瓦特特 (Vickie Swartout) 而被判处死刑。

paras.en: Prior to Howard's execution, his attorneys pointed to the failed execution of Tennessee death row inmate Christa Pike, who survived two doses of pentobarbital on Sept. 30, arguing that the same drug Texas planned to use could pose similar risks.
paras.zh: 在霍华德被处决之前，他的律师指出，田纳西州死囚克里斯塔·派克(Christa Pike)在9月30日注射了两剂戊巴比妥后幸免于难，他的律师指出，德克萨斯州计划使用的同一种药物可能会带来类似的风险。

paras.en: "Texas should not be eager to follow in Tennessee’s footsteps; a stay would keep that from happening," Howard's attorneys argued in their filing.
paras.zh: 霍华德的律师在文件中辩称：“德克萨斯州不应该急于追随田纳西州的脚步；暂停将阻止这种情况发生。”

paras.en: The Supreme Court rejected Howard's emergency appeal without explanation. Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson was the only justice to publicly dissent, Fox News reported.
paras.zh: 最高法院驳回了霍华德的紧急上诉，没有做出任何解释。据福克斯新闻报道，科坦吉·布朗·杰克逊法官是唯一公开提出异议的法官。

paras.en: The Texas Court of Criminal Appeals had previously rejected two requests to stop the execution based on concerns about the drug's use.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯州刑事上诉法院此前因担心该药物的使用而拒绝了两项停止执行死刑的请求。

paras.en: According to The Associated Press, as the pentobarbital began taking effect Wednesday evening, Howard took a couple of breaths and gasped.
paras.zh: 据美联社报道，当戊巴比妥周三晚上开始生效时，霍华德吸了几口气。

paras.en: Howard then began making snoring sounds, coughed and resumed the snoring sounds, which grew progressively quieter. His movements reportedly stopped entirely after around 30 seconds, and he was pronounced dead 19 minutes later.
paras.zh: 然后霍华德开始发出鼾声，咳嗽了一声，又恢复了鼾声，而且鼾声逐渐变小。据报道，他的动作在大约 30 秒后完全停止，19 分钟后被宣布死亡。

paras.en: Howard's attorneys also said in court filings that they had requested information about the dose of pentobarbital the Texas Department of Criminal Justice planned to use to carry out the execution.
paras.zh: 霍华德的律师还在法庭文件中表示，他们已要求提供有关德克萨斯州刑事司法部计划用于执行死刑的戊巴比妥剂量的信息。

paras.en: The concerns stemmed in part from Pike's execution attempt, during which she reportedly survived two doses of pentobarbital.
paras.zh: 这种担忧部分源于派克的处决企图，据报道，派克在执行死刑期间注射了两剂戊巴比妥，幸免于难。

paras.en: Howard's execution took place the same day a Tennessee judge granted a request from Pike's attorneys to order the Tennessee Department of Correction to preserve evidence connected to the failed execution attempt.
paras.zh: 霍华德被处决的同一天，田纳西州一名法官批准了派克律师的请求，要求田纳西州惩教部保存与失败的处决尝试有关的证据。

paras.en: According to the Death Penalty Information Center, Pike is the first person to survive a lethal injection in the modern era.
paras.zh: 据死刑信息中心称，派克是现代注射死刑第一人。

paras.en: Howard's attorneys also argued before the Supreme Court that his execution should be halted because he was intellectually disabled. However, the state said his attorneys had not presented evidence establishing that he met the legal criteria for intellectual disability.
paras.zh: 霍华德的律师还在最高法院辩称，应停止对他的处决，因为他患有智力障碍。然而，该州表示，他的律师没有提供证据证明他符合智力障碍的法律标准。

paras.en: Howard was convicted of capital murder in the killing of Swartout, who was shot once in the chest during a convenience store robbery.
paras.zh: 霍华德因杀害斯瓦特特而被判犯有死刑谋杀罪，斯瓦特特在一次便利店抢劫中胸部中弹。

paras.en: Howard, who was 20 years old at the time, also took $114 from the cash register during the robbery.
paras.zh: 当时20岁的霍华德在抢劫过程中还从收银机中拿走了114美元。

paras.en: Fox News Digital's Michael Ruiz and The Associated Press contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻数字频道的迈克尔·鲁伊斯和美联社对此报道做出了贡献。

articles.title: Anti-Israel protesters label Mamdani a 'traitor,' accuse him of 'genocide' outside Oct 7 vigil

paras.en: A group of anti-Israel protesters on Wednesday targeted New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani, calling him a "traitor," accusing him of "genocide" and claiming he "cannot weaponize being brown anymore."
paras.zh: 周三，一群反以色列抗议者将纽约市市长佐赫兰·马姆达尼(Zohran Mamdani)作为目标，称他为“叛徒”，指责他“种族灭绝”，并声称他“不能再把棕色人种当作武器”。

paras.en: The crowd of more than 100 demonstrators marched from City Hall to Union Square, where a vigil was held to mark the anniversary of the Oct. 7, 2023, Hamas terror attacks in Israel. The vigil was organized as an evening of mourning for those killed in the Oct. 7 attacks and the bloodshed that followed, including Israelis and Palestinians.
paras.zh: 100 多名示威者从市政厅游行到联合广场，在那里举行守夜活动，纪念 2023 年 10 月 7 日以色列哈马斯恐怖袭击周年。这次守夜活动是为了哀悼在 10 月 7 日袭击和随后的流血事件中丧生的人，其中包括以色列人和巴勒斯坦人。

paras.en: The anti-Israel crowd was just outside the barricades of the Israelis for Peace Vigil, beating on drums and attempting to drown out the speakers, according to City & State New York.
paras.zh: 据纽约州政府报道，反以色列人群就在以色列和平守夜活动的路障外，敲着鼓，试图盖过扬声器的声音。

paras.en: Mamdani was at the vigil and held a candle as protesters threw various insults at him, including accusations of genocide and "selling all your people out."
paras.zh: 马姆达尼参加了守夜活动，并举着蜡烛，抗议者对他进行了各种侮辱，包括种族灭绝和“出卖所有人民”的指控。

paras.en: "Zohran, what do you say? How many kids did you kill today?" the protesters shouted, according to the outlet.
paras.zh: “佐兰，你说什么？你今天杀了多少孩子？”据该媒体报道，抗议者大声喊叫。

paras.en: "700,000 dead. Mamdani, your hands are red!" they also chanted.
paras.zh: “70万人死亡。马姆达尼，你的手都红了！”他们也高呼。

paras.en: "Traitor, traitor, come on out! You sold all your people out!" the group was also heard chanting.
paras.zh: “叛徒，叛徒，出来吧！你把你的人都出卖了！”还听到这群人高喊口号。

paras.en: The crowd also shouted: "Zohran, you can’t hide. We charge you with genocide!"
paras.zh: 人群还喊道：“佐赫兰，你躲不掉。我们指控你种族灭绝！”

paras.en: "We don’t care about where you’re from. You cannot talk about being Muslim anymore. You cannot weaponize being brown anymore. Identity politics can only get you so far," they said.
paras.zh: “我们不在乎你来自哪里。你不能再谈论自己是穆斯林。你不能再把棕色人种当作武器。身份政治只能让你走这么远，”他们说。

paras.en: One protester also claimed to be a former intern for Mamdani, saying the mayor "was never working for the people."
paras.zh: 一名抗议者还自称是马姆达尼的前实习生，称市长“从来没有为人民工作过”。

paras.en: Protesters also demanded that Mamdani take action against New York real-estate events that have marketed properties in Israeli settlements in the West Bank, which the demonstrators characterize as "stolen" Palestinian land, according to City & State New York.
paras.zh: 据纽约州政府报道，抗议者还要求马姆达尼对纽约房地产活动采取行动，这些活动在约旦河西岸的以色列定居点推销房产，示威者将其描述为“窃取”的巴勒斯坦土地。

paras.en: "Mayor Mamdani, take a stand. Stop the sale of stolen land," the group chanted.
paras.zh: “马姆达尼市长，表明立场。停止出售被盗土地，”该团体高呼口号。

paras.en: The protesters also called for abolishing the City University of New York's Board of Trustees, whose members are largely appointed by the mayor and governor. Protesters have previously accused the board of ignoring demands to divest investments linked to Israel and criticized its handling of anti-Israel demonstrations on campus.
paras.zh: 抗议者还呼吁废除纽约城市大学董事会，该董事会成员主要由市长和州长任命。抗议者此前曾指责董事会无视撤资与以色列相关投资的要求，并批评其对校园反以色列示威的处理方式。

paras.en: Despite the protesters' accusations of genocide on Wednesday, Mamdani is a longtime critic of the Israeli government's actions in Gaza and has denounced its treatment of Palestinians in the aftermath of the 2023 attack.
paras.zh: 尽管抗议者周三指控种族灭绝，但马姆达尼长期以来一直批评以色列政府在加沙的行动，并谴责以色列政府在 2023 年袭击后对待巴勒斯坦人的方式。

paras.en: In a statement on Wednesday, Mamdani condemned Hamas’ attack as a "horrific war crime" while also characterizing Israel’s subsequent military operation as a genocide.
paras.zh: 马姆达尼在周三的一份声明中谴责哈马斯的袭击是“可怕的战争罪行”，同时还将以色列随后的军事行动描述为种族灭绝。

paras.en: "The suffering did not begin nor end that day," he wrote. "It instead continued through the Israeli government’s devastating, ongoing genocide in Gaza in which it has killed more than 74,000 Palestinians — including more than 21,000 children."
paras.zh: “痛苦并没有从那天开始，也没有结束，”他写道。 “相反，以色列政府在加沙继续实施毁灭性的、持续的种族灭绝，造成超过 74,000 名巴勒斯坦人死亡，其中包括超过 21,000 名儿童。”

paras.en: Israel has rejected accusations that it is committing genocide in Gaza, saying its military targets Hamas and other terrorist groups while seeking to minimize civilian casualties.
paras.zh: 以色列否认了有关其在加沙实施种族灭绝的指控，称其军事目标是哈马斯和其他恐怖组织，同时寻求尽量减少平民伤亡。

paras.en: The mayor's statement sparked bipartisan backlash, with Rep. Dan Goldman, D-N.Y., calling it "egregious and insulting."
paras.zh: 市长的声明引发了两党的强烈反对，纽约州民主党众议员丹·戈德曼称其“令人震惊且具有侮辱性”。

paras.en: "There are 364 days of the year to focus on that. This is a day that should just be focused on what was by all agreement a horrific terror attack," Goldman, who is Jewish, told Politico. "What the mayor’s statement did today was to blame Israelis for the attack that they suffered three years ago. Regardless of what you actually think of the conflict and what’s happened either since or before, there’s no excuse for victim blaming."
paras.zh: “一年中有 364 天都需要关注这一事件。这一天应该只关注大家一致认为的一场可怕的恐怖袭击，”犹太人戈德曼告诉 Politico。 “市长今天的声明是将三年前遭受的袭击归咎于以色列人。无论你对这场冲突的实际看法以及之后或之前发生的事情，都没有理由指责受害者。”

articles.title: San Diego Padres season ends in disaster after offense completely collapses against Milwaukee Brewers

paras.en: San Diego’s season came to a crashing halt Wednesday night as the Milwaukee Brewers slammed the door shut at Petco Park. Game 3 offered a brief pulse, but the Padres' offense flatlined when it mattered most in a season-ending 3-1 Game 4 defeat.
paras.zh: 周三晚上，随着密尔沃基酿酒人队在佩科球场关门，圣地亚哥的赛季戛然而止。第三场比赛给了球队短暂的喘息机会，但在赛季结束的第四场比赛中，教士队以 1-3 的比分落败，而在最关键的时刻，教士队的进攻却陷入了停滞。

paras.en: Milwaukee moves on to face the Dodgers in the NLCS after LA eliminated the Braves earlier Wednesday, while the Padres get sent straight to the couch.
paras.zh: 周三早些时候，洛杉矶队淘汰了勇士队，密尔沃基队将在 NLCS 中迎战道奇队，而教士队则直接坐在沙发上。

paras.en: The Padres loaded the bases with two outs in the first, but Xander Bogaerts popped out to leave everyone stranded. That squandered chance bit San Diego two innings later when Garrett Mitchell ripped an RBI single off Walker Buehler to put Milwaukee ahead.
paras.zh: 教士队在第一场比赛中便有两名出局者上垒，但桑德斯·博加茨突然出现，让所有人陷入困境。两局后，当加勒特·米切尔（Garrett Mitchell）从沃克·比勒（Walker Buehler）手中夺下打点单打，使密尔沃基队领先时，圣地亚哥队浪费了机会。

paras.en: Fernando Tatis Jr. provided the lone spark in the third, crushing a solo home run off Robert Gasser to tie it 1-1.
paras.zh: 小费尔南多·塔蒂斯 (Fernando Tatis Jr.) 在第三局中发挥了唯一的火花，击败了罗伯特·加塞尔 (Robert Gasser) 的单打全垒打，将比分扳成 1-1。

paras.en: Remarkably, that swing was the final hit of the night for San Diego’s miserable offense. The bats went completely cold for the remaining six innings.
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，这一击是圣地亚哥队当晚糟糕的进攻的最后一击。在剩下的六局比赛中，蝙蝠完全变冷了。

paras.en: Jackson Chourio lined a two-out RBI single in the fifth, and Sal Frelick added a sac fly in the sixth to make it 3-1.
paras.zh: 杰克逊·乔里奥 (Jackson Chourio) 在第五局打出一记二打点单打，萨尔·弗里利克 (Sal Frelick) 在第六局打出一记飞球，将比分改写为 3-1。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Brewers reliever Aaron Ashby carved through three hitless innings to keep San Diego completely suffocated.
paras.zh: 与此同时，酿酒人队的中继投手亚伦·阿什比（Aaron Ashby）连续三局保持无安打，让圣地亚哥彻底窒息。

paras.en: With a runner on, Manny Machado launched a 107-mph missile to deep center field that sent Petco Park into a frenzy.
paras.zh: 曼尼·马查多（Manny Machado）在一名跑步者上场后，向中场深处发射了一枚时速 107 英里的导弹，让佩科公园陷入了疯狂。

paras.en: It looked like a game-tying two-run bomb.
paras.zh: 它看起来像是一个扳平比分的两分炸弹。

paras.en: But Garrett Mitchell tracked it down, leaped at the wall, and robbed Machado on the warning track.
paras.zh: 但加勒特·米切尔追踪到了它，跳到墙上，在警戒跑道上抢劫了马查多。

paras.en: Trevor Megill slammed the door in the ninth, striking out the side to seal the 3-1 victory and send Milwaukee to the NLCS.
paras.zh: 特雷弗·梅吉尔 (Trevor Megill) 在第九局关上大门，三振出局，以 3-1 锁定胜局，并将密尔沃基队送入 NLCS。

paras.en: Send us your thoughts: alejandro.avila@outkick.com / Follow along on X: @alejandroaveela
paras.zh: 将您的想法发送给我们：alejandro.avila@outkick.com / 关注 X：@alejandroaveela

articles.title: NSW police commissioner made last-minute bid to hold closed-door hearings into Sydney anti-Herzog protest
articles.author: Penry Buckley and Jordyn Beazley

paras.en: The New South Wales police commissioner made a last-minute bid to hold hearings into Sydney’s anti-Herzog protest behind closed doors, delaying the inquiry, the police watchdog has revealed.
paras.zh: 警方监管机构透露，新南威尔士州警察局长在最后一刻要求就悉尼反赫尔佐格抗议活动举行闭门听证会，从而推迟了调查。

paras.en: The Law Enforcement Conduct Commission (Lecc) has said that its inquiry into the February protest at Sydney’s town hall, launched after widespread allegations of police brutality, would go ahead this month with a mix of public and private examinations, saying the timing of issues raised by police commissioner, Mal Lanyon, was “regrettable”.
paras.zh: 执法行为委员会（Lecc）表示，在广泛指控警察暴行后，对悉尼市政厅二月抗议活动进行的调查将于本月继续进行，包括公开和私人调查，并称警察局长马尔·兰尼恩（Mal Lanyon）提出问题的时机“令人遗憾”。

paras.en: Lecc launched an investigation after the protest on 9 February, during which numerous protesters – and 10 officers – were injured, including demonstrators in their 70s and 80s. Viral video footage showed police punching multiple protesters, and grabbing Muslim worshippers while they undertook their sunset prayers.
paras.zh: Lecc 在 2 月 9 日的抗议活动后展开调查，此次抗议活动导致多名抗议者和 10 名警察受伤，其中包括 70 多岁和 80 多岁的示威者。病毒视频显示，警察殴打了多名抗议者，并在穆斯林信徒进行日落祈祷时逮捕了他们。

paras.en: Thirty people were charged in the months after the protest, but four have since had their charges dropped. More than 20 of those charged are due to face a joint hearing next July.
paras.zh: 抗议后的几个月内，有 30 人受到指控，但此后有 4 人的指控被撤销。其中 20 多名被指控者将于明年 7 月面临联合听证会。

paras.en: In a decision made public on Thursday, the Lecc chief commissioner, Peter Johnson SC, revealed that legal representatives for Lanyon had indicated for the “first time” on 9 September that he wished to be heard on the issue of public and private examinations. The bid was made less than two weeks before the public hearings between September and November were due to start. Some hearings were also expected to be heard in private.
paras.zh: 在周四公布的一项决定中，Lecc 首席专员 Peter Johnson SC 透露，Lanyon 的法律代表已于 9 月 9 日“首次”表示，他希望就公开和私人考试问题发表意见。该投标是在 9 月至 11 月的公开听证会开始前不到两周提出的。预计一些听证会也将私下举行。

paras.en: “The timing of these issues being raised by the Commissioner of Police is more than regrettable given its impact on the orderly progress of the investigation, the preparation for examinations and the efficient and effective use of public resources by both the Commission and the NSWPF and the associated cost and disruption flowing from the delay,” Johnson said.
paras.zh: 约翰逊说：“考虑到这对调查的有序进展、考试准备以及委员会和新州警察局有效利用公共资源的影响，以及因延误而产生的相关成本和干扰，警察局长提出这些问题的时机非常令人遗憾。”

paras.en: Johnson said the start date of public hearings, 21 September, was subsequently delayed to “a date to be fixed” to allow a private hearing for submissions on the issue.
paras.zh: 约翰逊表示，公开听证会的开始日期（9 月 21 日）随后被推迟到“待确定的日期”，以便就该问题举行非公开听证会。

paras.en: Lawyers acting on behalf of Lanyon submitted that Lecc’s opening address and the examination of witnesses should occur in private and not be livestreamed. They argued that the Lecc Act does not have the power to hear “broad ranging open submissions” and said Lecc should not take the “unconventional approach of hearing opening submissions in public part way through an investigation that is already underway”.
paras.zh: Lanyon 的代表律师表示，Lecc 的开庭致辞和对证人的询问应该私下进行，而不是进行直播。他们认为，Lecc 法案没有权力听取“广泛的公开意见”，并表示 Lecc 不应采取“在已经进行的调查过程中公开听取公开意见的非常规做法”。

paras.en: But Lecc argued that it does have the power to decide when public examinations are appropriate. The counsel assisting submitted that public examinations were necessary because “there was already significant information concerning the events of 9 February 2026 in the public domain, including footage of use of force by police” and that senior police officers had advanced in public an “official narrative of what took place”.
paras.zh: 但 Lecc 辩称，它确实有权决定何时进行公开考试。协助律师表示，公开检查是必要的，因为“公共领域已经有关于 2026 年 2 月 9 日事件的重要信息，包括警察使用武力的镜头”，而且高级警官已公开提出“对所发生事件的官方叙述”。

paras.en: “Public comments made by senior police increase the need for independent scrutiny,” the commissioner wrote.
paras.zh: “高级警察发表的公开评论增加了独立审查的必要性，”专员写道。

paras.en: The counsel assisting had pointed to specific features of the investigation as reason for why only private examinations were not appropriate. This included the “significant public concern” after the protest, including in parts of the Islamic community in Western Sydney.
paras.zh: 协助律师指出了调查的具体特点，作为仅进行私人检查不合适的理由。这包括抗议后“公众的强烈关注”，包括西悉尼部分伊斯兰社区的关注。

paras.en: On Thursday, the watchdog said its inquiry into the protest would begin with a public address by counsel assisting on 19 October, followed by five weeks of private hearings. Lecc expects senior officers will then appear at public examinations.
paras.zh: 周四，该监管机构表示，对抗议活动的调查将首先由协助律师于 10 月 19 日发表公开讲话，随后举行五周的私人听证会。 Lecc预计高级官员随后将参加公开考试。

paras.en: It said its Operation Makalu inquiry would analyse the use of OC spray, as well as the “improper use of arrest powers and the police use of force” at the protest. It will consider police planning ahead of the protest and “any opportunities for improvement in the policing of protests”.
paras.zh: 它表示，其马卡鲁行动调查将分析抗议活动中使用OC喷雾剂的情况，以及“不当使用逮捕权和警察使用武力”的情况。它将考虑警察在抗议前的计划以及“改善抗议治安的任何机会”。

paras.en: In his decision, the commissioner determined that private examinations would be held on “issues of fact” while public examinations would be held to deal with systemic issues, but only after the private examinations have been held.
paras.zh: 在他的决定中，专员确定私人考试将针对“事实问题”举行，而公开考试将针对系统性问题举行，但只有在私人考试举行之后才进行。

paras.en: In September, Palestinian Australian Eyad Shadid launched a civil case in the NSW district court, alleging he was assaulted, battered and falsely imprisoned by police near Sydney’s town hall. He alleged in his statement of claim that NSW police committed misfeasance in public office and subjected him to a malicious prosecution.
paras.zh: 9月，巴勒斯坦裔澳大利亚人埃亚德·沙迪德（Eyad Shadid）向新南威尔士州地方法院提起民事诉讼，指控他在悉尼市政厅附近遭到警察袭击、殴打和非法监禁。他在索赔声明中声称，新南威尔士州警方在公职中犯有不当行为，并对他进行了恶意起诉。

paras.en: In a statement, NSW Greens justice spokesperson, Sue Higginson, described the push to hold hearings in private as “an extraordinary attempt by the police to suppress the public examination of allegations of serious misconduct by uniformed police officers, and to prevent public scrutiny of the political decisions and command structures that led to police violence against protesters”.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州绿党司法发言人苏·希金森(Sue Higginson)在一份声明中将推动举行非公开听证会描述为“警方的一次非同寻常的尝试，目的是压制对穿制服警察严重不当行为指控的公开审查，并阻止公众对导致警察对抗议者使用暴力的政治决策和指挥结构进行审查”。

paras.en: At a NSW parliamentary inquiry in May, Johnson said police had become “overly defensive” in response to requests for information in its investigations, describing the relationship between the agencies as “difficult”. He said the Lecc had received a record number of complaints, more than 800, as part of its investigation into the Herzog protest.
paras.zh: 在五月的新南威尔士州议会调查中，约翰逊表示，警方在回应调查中提供信息的要求时变得“过度防御”，并称各机构之间的关系“困难”。他表示，作为对赫尔佐格抗议活动调查的一部分，Lecc 已收到创纪录数量的投诉，超过 800 起。

paras.en: In a statement following Johnson’s comments, NSW police said it “complied with the requirements of the LECC Act in a cooperative manner”.
paras.zh: 在约翰逊发表评论后的一份声明中，新南威尔士州警方表示，他们“以合作的方式遵守了 LECC 法案的要求”。

paras.en: NSW police said in a statement it acknowledged the decision to hold private hearings and awaited the findings.
paras.zh: 新南威尔士州警方在一份声明中表示，他们承认举行私人听证会的决定，并等待调查结果。

articles.title: Thursday briefing: Why young people are taking to the streets across France
articles.author: Libby Brooks

paras.en: Good morning. In my experience, at any protest, the most memorable and encapsulating slogans are always the ones written by hand with marker pen on cardboard placards.
paras.zh: 早上好。根据我的经验，在任何抗议活动中，最令人难忘和最具概括性的口号总是那些用记号笔在纸板标语牌上手写的口号。

paras.en: “School is a right, not a privilege,” read one such sign held aloft by a student in Paris, where huge youth protests over the state of high school education have brought tens of thousands of young people and adults on to the streets, with further strikes planned today.
paras.zh: “上学是一种权利，而不是一种特权，”巴黎一名学生高举着这样的标语，巴黎青年对高中教育状况的大规模抗议已导致数以万计的年轻人和成年人走上街头，今天还计划进一步罢工。

paras.en: “A state that gasses high school students is a weak state,” another sign said, referencing growing public anger at alleged police brutality towards young protesters.
paras.zh: 另一个标牌上写着：“一个向高中生投放毒气的州是一个软弱的州。”指的是公众对警察对年轻抗议者施暴的指控日益愤怒。

paras.en: Tens of thousands of young people have also taken to Spanish streets in recent weeks to protest against the country’s deepening housing crisis. And outside the Labour conference in Liverpool last week, a crowd of jobless young people protested against what they saw as their bleak employment prospects. From Paris to the north of England, a similar thread runs through it all: a generation who feel betrayed by the absence of basic economic security and the erosion of public services that older generations took for granted.
paras.zh: 最近几周，数万名年轻人也走上西班牙街头，抗议该国日益严重的住房危机。上周在利物浦举行的工党会议外，一群失业的年轻人对他们认为暗淡的就业前景进行了抗议。从巴黎到英格兰北部，一条相似的线索贯穿了这一切：这一代人因基本经济安全的缺乏和老一辈人视为理所当然的公共服务的侵蚀而感到被背叛。

paras.en: I spoke to our Paris correspondent Angelique Chrisafis who has been reporting from the centre of the French protests. But first, the headlines.
paras.zh: 我采访了我们的巴黎记者安吉丽克·克里斯萨菲斯（Angelique Chrisafis），她一直在法国抗议活动的中心进行报道。但首先，头条新闻。

paras.en: - UK politics | Kemi Badenoch has announced that the Conservatives would abolish inheritance tax on family homes if elected, prompting criticism that she is prioritising cutting taxes for the rich.
paras.zh: - 英国政治|凯米·巴德诺克 (Kemi Badenoch) 宣布，如果保守党当选，将废除家庭住宅遗产税，这引发了批评她优先考虑为富人减税的批评。

paras.en: - Education | Labour’s flagship changes to special education in England are at risk of unravelling because parents are rushing to secure support for their children before the system changes, new analysis has found.
paras.zh: - 教育|新的分析发现，工党对英国特殊教育的旗舰改革面临着瓦解的风险，因为家长们急于在制度改变之前为孩子争取支持。

paras.en: - Spain | María del Carmen Abascal, the 87-year-old whose eviction set off a nationwide wave of protests against Spain’s housing crisis, has died.
paras.zh: - 西班牙 | 家企业87 岁的玛丽亚·德尔·卡门·阿巴斯卡 (María del Carmen Abascal) 去世，她的驱逐引发了全国范围内针对西班牙住房危机的抗议浪潮。

paras.en: - Science | A type of gene therapy based on Nobel prize-winning science is safe and can partly restore sight in blind people, researchers have revealed.
paras.zh: - 科学|研究人员透露，一种基于诺贝尔奖获奖科学的基因疗法是安全的，并且可以部分恢复盲人的视力。

paras.en: - Epstein | British billionaire Sir James Goldsmith warned that Jeffrey Epstein was a “sexual deviant” decades before the FBI closed in on the abuser, a Guardian investigation has found.
paras.zh: - 爱泼斯坦 | 《卫报》的一项调查发现，英国亿万富翁詹姆斯·戈德史密斯爵士在联邦调查局对施虐者进行调查之前几十年就警告说，杰弗里·爱泼斯坦是一名“性变态者”。

paras.en: In depth: Why have young people taken to the streets?
paras.zh: 深度：年轻人为何走上街头？

paras.en: The most significant youth movement to emerge across France in recent decades started on 17 September. Pupils returning to the Lycée Saint-Exupéry in Créteil, southwest of Paris, after the summer holidays, discovered they couldn’t continue their studies because of the extent of staff absences. The 15- to 18-year-olds blockaded their high school in protest.
paras.zh: 法国近几十年来最重要的青年运动于 9 月 17 日开始。暑假结束后，学生们回到巴黎西南部克雷泰伊的圣埃克苏佩里中学，发现由于教职人员缺勤，他们无法继续学业。 15 至 18 岁的青少年封锁了他们的高中以示抗议。

paras.en: After negotiations with the education ministry, those staffing gaps were filled, but the impassioned complaints about crumbling buildings, overcrowded classrooms, and long school days – alongside a wider sense of inequality in the education system – resonated in the suburbs. “This movement grew from the ground up, from teenagers speaking to others outside their lycées. And over a couple of weeks, it has spread to hundreds of schools across France,” Angelique tells me.
paras.zh: 在与教育部谈判后，这些人员缺口得到了填补，但对摇摇欲坠的建筑物、拥挤的教室和漫长的上课时间以及教育系统中更广泛的不平等感的强烈抱怨在郊区引起了共鸣。 “这场运动从头开始，从青少年在中学之外向其他人讲话开始。几周后，它已经蔓延到法国数百所学校，”安吉丽克告诉我。

paras.en: There’s a tendency to mythologise youth protest, especially in France – my uncle Joss was in Paris in 1968, and I lapped up his tales of pulling up cobblestones with his bare hands to build barricades. But youth activism is often diminished. When I reported on the schoolchildren who protested against the war in Iraq in 2003, and those who took part in climate strikes more than a decade later, adults repeatedly questioned whether they were swayed by older provocateurs or just wanted an excuse to dodge school and indulge in petty vandalism. (In my experience: no, no and no.)
paras.zh: 人们有一种将青年抗议神话化的倾向，尤其是在法国——我叔叔乔斯 1968 年在巴黎，我对他徒手拔起鹅卵石搭建路障的故事欣喜若狂。但青年的积极性往往会减弱。当我报道2003年抗议伊拉克战争的学童，以及十多年后参加气候罢工的学童时，成年人不断质疑他们是否受到了年长煽动者的影响，或者只是想找借口逃避学校并沉迷于小规模的破坏行为。 （根据我的经验：不，不，不。）

paras.en: So it is in France this past month. “This is very much a youth movement,” says Angelique, comparing it to similar protests in 2006 over an unpopular youth employment contract, which were organised by students’ unions. “High schoolers are organising themselves without a centralised system or even spokesperson. That’s historic, and it’s taken the government by surprise.”
paras.zh: 上个月在法国也是如此。 “这在很大程度上是一场青年运动，”安吉丽克说道，她将其与 2006 年由学生会组织的针对不受欢迎的青年就业合同的类似抗议活动进行了比较。 “高中生在没有集中系统甚至发言人的情况下组织起来。这是历史性的，这让政府感到惊讶。”

paras.en: This week, the sociologist Fabien Truong, who has written widely on youth protest culture, praised the “maturity and coherence” of the protesters. He pointed to a “social media effect” whereby teenagers in wealthier areas were sharing videos of scurrying rats, gaping ceilings and leaking toilets in poorer schools. “It’s beautiful, this solidarity with students from more privileged backgrounds fighting for others and more equality.”
paras.zh: 本周，撰写了大量有关青年抗议文化的文章的社会学家法比安·特隆（Fabien Truong）赞扬了抗议者的“成熟性和一致性”。他指出了一种“社交媒体效应”，富裕地区的青少年会分享贫困学校老鼠乱窜、天花板裂开和厕所漏水的视频。 “这种与来自更优越背景的学生团结起来为他人和更多平等而奋斗的感觉真是太美好了。”

paras.en: This is precisely what Angelique has witnessed on the streets of Paris in recent days, where some of the most elite state schools have also been barricaded. She spoke to one teacher outside a school in a richer inner-city area, who was proud of her pupils. “She said there was a feeling of solidarity and generosity between teenagers, and how it flies in the face of the idea that they’re part of a social media generation who are selfish and narcissistic.”
paras.zh: 这正是安吉丽克最近几天在巴黎街头目睹的情况，一些最精英的公立学校也被封锁。她在较富裕的市中心地区一所学校外与一位老师交谈，这位老师为她的学生感到自豪。 “她说青少年之间有一种团结和慷慨的感觉，这与他们属于自私自恋的社交媒体一代的想法背道而驰。”

paras.en: “I spent a long time speaking to teenage girls at one of the barricades in the centre of the city,” Angelique says,“who were sitting on top of a pile of bins and shopping trolleys. They told me: ‘We’re told in France that state education is a great leveller, but that’s not the case. We are being taught our lessons, but we’re getting out on to the street because we can’t bear to know that other students in poorer areas are in buildings that are crumbling’.”
paras.zh: “我花了很长时间在市中心的一个路障上与十几岁的女孩交谈，”安吉丽克说，“她们坐在一堆垃圾箱和购物车上。她们告诉我：‘在法国，我们被告知国家教育是一个很好的平等者，但事实并非如此。我们正在接受教训，但我们却走上街头，因为我们无法忍受知道贫困地区的其他学生住在那些崩溃了”。

paras.en: As Angelique sets out in this helpful explainer, the pupils’ grievances are backed up by evidence – and the prime minister himself has described them as “legitimate”. Thousands of French schools at all levels, both primary and secondary, are in need of repair. Class sizes are bigger on average, and school days are longer, than in other comparable countries, while about 10% of teaching hours across the year are not delivered because of absent teachers.
paras.zh: 正如安吉丽克在这篇有用的解释中所阐述的那样，学生们的不满是有证据支持的——总理本人也称他们的不满是“合法的”。数以千计的法国各级学校，无论是小学还是中学，都需要维修。与其他可比国家相比，平均班级规模更大，上课时间更长，而全年约有 10% 的教学时间因教师缺勤而无法交付。

paras.en: And yet France’s expenditure on high schools is 28% higher than the OECD average. What’s going on? The high spend can be explained in various ways, Angelique tells me. France has a lot more high school buildings to maintain than other countries, and many more vocational courses that cost more to teach.
paras.zh: 然而法国的高中支出比经合组织平均水平高出 28%。这是怎么回事？安吉丽克告诉我，高额支出可以用多种方式来解释。与其他国家相比，法国有更多的高中建筑需要维护，还有更多的职业课程，教学成本更高。

paras.en: At the same time, more spending is desperately needed on staff. Teacher shortages are linked to very low pay progression through the profession, while there are severe difficulties in finding teachers to work in deprived areas. There’s also a shortfall in other crucial roles, including school nurses and support staff for pupils with disabilities.
paras.zh: 与此同时，迫切需要在员工方面增加支出。教师短缺与该行业的薪资晋升水平极低有关，而在贫困地区寻找教师工作也存在严重困难。其他关键角色也存在短缺，包括学校护士和残疾学生的支持人员。

paras.en: Angelique tells me that what has defined how adults are responding to this burgeoning movement is the behaviour of politicians and police. Initially, the French government “had its head in the sand”, she says, distracted by public anger at rising fuel costs and a difficult budget process. “And when it suddenly woke up, the reaction was not a political one, it was a police crackdown.”
paras.zh: 安吉丽克告诉我，决定成年人如何应对这一新兴运动的是政客和警察的行为。她说，最初，法国政府“把头埋在沙子里”，因为公众对燃料成本上涨和预算流程困难的愤怒而分心。 “当它突然醒来时，反应不是政治反应，而是警方的镇压。”

paras.en: Eighteen investigations into possible police brutality are already under way after injuries allegedly involving the use of police weapons, including a 15-year-old who lost his hand after contact with a stun grenade and a 14-year-old whose jaw was shattered after police allegedly beat him and fired a form of rubber-bullet launcher.
paras.zh: 在涉嫌使用警察武器造成伤害后，针对可能的警察暴力行为的调查已经展开，其中包括一名 15 岁少年在接触眩晕手榴弹后失去了手，以及一名 14 岁少年，据称在警察殴打他并发射橡皮子弹发射器后下巴被打碎。

paras.en: Yesterday, the French interior minister suspended the use of stun grenades but rejected accusations of police brutality, saying riot officers only intervened when protesters turned violent. Dozens of teachers have also been injured in clashes, and a small number of schools burned or ransacked, but Angelique tells me that most protests have been peaceful.
paras.zh: 昨天，法国内政部长暂停使用眩晕手榴弹，但否认了对警察暴行的指控，称防暴警察只有在抗议者变得暴力时才会进行干预。数十名教师也在冲突中受伤，少数学校被烧毁或洗劫，但安吉丽克告诉我，大多数抗议活动都是和平的。

paras.en: The injuries, however, have prompted outrage, with parents and teachers angry at the “disproportionate police response” now joining young people at the barricades. An Elabe poll for BFMTV, published on Wednesday, found that 72% of French people thought the student’s demands were legitimate – although 55% of of those surveyed also thought the protests should come to an end.
paras.zh: 然而，这些伤害引发了愤怒，家长和老师对现在加入路障的年轻人的“警方反应过度”感到愤怒。周三公布的 BFMTV 埃拉布民意调查发现，72% 的法国人认为学生的要求是合法的，尽管 55% 的受访者也认为抗议活动应该结束。

paras.en: The movement has also brought to the fore a debate about the wider state of public services ahead of next year’s presidential election. The radical left leader Jean-Luc Mélenchon, backed for president by 47% of voters under 35, is loudly supporting the protesters, while far-right candidate Marine Le Pen has blamed the current government for chaos and called for an anti-riot law.
paras.zh: 该运动还引发了关于明年总统选举之前更广泛的公共服务状况的辩论。得到 47% 35 岁以下选民支持的激进左翼领导人让-吕克·梅朗雄 (Jean-Luc Mélenchon) 大声支持抗议者，而极右翼候选人马琳·勒庞 (Marine Le Pen) 则指责现任政府造成混乱，并呼吁制定防暴法。

paras.en: The sheer scale of the marches in cities across France this week was unexpected, Angelique says. “There were hundreds of thousands of parents, grandparents and teachers. There is a lot of support for these young people’s demands and an understanding that the problems they are raising reflect wider worries about public services.”
paras.zh: 安吉丽克说，本周法国各地城市游行的规模之大出人意料。 “有数十万家长、祖父母和老师。这些年轻人的要求得到了很多支持，并且理解他们提出的问题反映了对公共服务的更广泛担忧。”

paras.en: - If you’re one for forbidden experiments, you’ll be fascinated by this article on the second world war generation who grew up on sugar rations, and saw lower rates of type 2 diabetes, high blood pressure and even anxiety in later life. Micha
paras.zh: - 如果您热衷于禁止实验，那么您一定会对这篇关于二战一代的文章着迷，他们是靠配给糖长大的，他们在晚年患 2 型糖尿病、高血压甚至焦虑症的几率较低。米夏

paras.en: - I really enjoyed Chibuzo Emmanuel’s much-needed piece on the damage that is being done by flattening of the wide variety of music genres across Africa into the simple bucket “Afrobeats”. Dipo
paras.zh: - 我真的很喜欢 Chibuzo Emmanuel 的这篇急需的作品，它讲述了将非洲各种各样的音乐流派扁平化为简单的“非洲节奏”所造成的损害。迪波

paras.en: - This piece on the US’ first public nature library expanded my understanding of what a library can achieve – parents, children and other members of the local Colorado community can borrow hammocks, night vision binoculars and cameras for wildlife photography. Micha
paras.zh: - 这篇关于美国第一个公共自然图书馆的文章扩展了我对图书馆所能实现的目标的理解——父母、孩子和科罗拉多当地社区的其他成员可以借用吊床、夜视双筒望远镜和相机进行野生动物摄影。米夏

paras.en: Football | Southampton’s manager, Tonda Eckert, has been given a six-week suspended ban by the Football Association for his part in the Spygate scandal that landed the club with a four-point penalty and expulsion from last season’s Championship playoffs.
paras.zh: 足球 |南安普顿队主教练通达·埃克特因参与间谍门丑闻而被英足总处以六周禁赛处罚，该丑闻导致俱乐部被处以四分处罚，并被逐出上赛季英冠附加赛。

paras.en: Golf | Confirmation that Jon Rahm will play no part in LIV Golf in its post-Saudi Arabian form is likely to be only the start of a mass exodus from the breakaway circuit.
paras.zh: 高尔夫 |乔恩·拉姆 (Jon Rahm) 确认将不再参加 LIV Golf 后沙特阿拉伯赛场的比赛，这可能只是大规模退出赛道的开始。

paras.en: Football | The Women’s Super League will face major disruption next season due to the Club World Cup, with Arsenal and Chelsea likely to be absent from domestic competition for up to a month.
paras.zh: 足球 |由于世俱杯的影响，女超联赛下赛季将面临重大干扰，阿森纳和切尔西可能缺席国内比赛长达一个月。

paras.en: The Guardian splashes with “Special education overhaul under threat amid surge in applications”. Reporting on Kemi Badenoch’s party conference speech, the Mail leads with “Kemi’s family home pledge”, the Times says “Tories ‘will make you better off’”, and the Telegraph goes with “We’re ready for the fight”. The top story for the Financial Times is “Iran war blows £12bn hole in Healey’s room for manoeuvre”, while the Sun has “Dinghy pervert given free home” and the Mirror runs with “Reform not dodgy, says Reform”. The i Paper leads with “Young people should get ADHD help even without diagnosis, major report will say”.
paras.zh: 《卫报》大肆渲染“特殊教育改革因申请激增而受到威胁”。在报道凯米·巴德诺克的党内会议演讲时，《每日邮报》以“凯米的家庭家园承诺”为标题，《泰晤士报》称“保守党‘会让你过得更好’”，而《电讯报》则以“我们已准备好战斗”为标题。英国《金融时报》的头条新闻是“伊朗战争给希利的回旋余地造成了120亿英镑的缺口”，而《太阳报》则“给了小艇变态者自由的家”，而《镜报》则以“改革说改革并不狡猾”为题。 i Paper 的开头是“主要报告会说，即使没有诊断，年轻人也应该获得多动症帮助”。

paras.en: Christa Pike awake and speaking after botched execution: what happens now?
paras.zh: 克里斯塔·派克在执行失败后醒来并讲话：现在发生了什么？

paras.en: Christa Pike, a death row inmate who survived the state of Tennessee’s attempt to execute her last week, is conscious and speaking. The 50-year-old is recovering in hospital after surviving two lethal injections in a case that has shocked many in the US and prompted a debate about the death penalty. She was due to be the first woman executed in Tennessee in more than 200 years. Michael Safi speaks to the chief reporter for Guardian US, Ed Pilkington.
paras.zh: 克里斯塔·派克 (Christa Pike) 是一名死囚，她在上周田纳西州试图处决她的事件中幸存下来，目前意识清醒并能说话。这名 50 岁的男子在两次注射死刑后幸存下来，目前正在医院康复，这起案件震惊了美国许多人，并引发了关于死刑的辩论。她本应成为田纳西州 200 多年来第一位被处决的女性。迈克尔·萨菲 (Michael Safi) 接受《卫报》美国版首席记者埃德·皮尔金顿 (Ed Pilkington) 的采访。

paras.en: A bit of good news to remind you that the world’s not all bad
paras.zh: 一个好消息提醒您世界并不全是坏事

paras.en: At 65 years old, Luis Gómez was still hawking vegetables at the market he had worked at since the age of eight. Now at 80, Gomes, or JM as he is popularly known, has become a musical sensation, selling out venues across Chile, as well as in Mexico, the UK, Argentina and France. He is the frontman of Los Crack del Puerto, who in May released their fourth record, Lo Mucho Que Nos Queda (So Much Yet to Come), as a cassette – to great acclaim.
paras.zh: 65 岁的路易斯·戈麦斯 (Luis Gómez) 仍在他从 8 岁就开始工作的市场里叫卖蔬菜。现年 80 岁的戈麦斯（俗称 JM）已成为音乐界的轰动人物，在智利、墨西哥、英国、阿根廷和法国的演出场场门票全部售罄。他是 Los Crack del Puerto 乐队的主唱，该乐队于 5 月发行了他们的第四张唱片《Lo Mucho Que Nos Queda》（So Much Yet to Come）录音带，并广受好评。

paras.en: It’s a long way from his early life in the city of Valparaíso; the youngest of five children, he was three when his father died, and 10 when he lost his mother. For a time, he slept on the street between parked cars. JM would eventually form a musical double act with his cousin, Juan Navarro, and the two entertained crowds in Valparaíso’s bars. The pair would find fame well into their 70s after forming the band in 2017. “I never planned any of this, and I’d be happy still working at the market,” JM says. “But I suppose it’s never too late to give something a try.”
paras.zh: 这与他早年在瓦尔帕莱索市的生活相去甚远。他是五个孩子中最小的一个，父亲去世时他三岁，母亲去世时他十岁。有一段时间，他睡在街上停着的汽车之间。 JM 最终与他的表弟胡安·纳瓦罗组成了音乐双人表演，两人在瓦尔帕莱索的酒吧招待了观众。两人在 2017 年组建乐队后，一直到 70 多岁才成名。“我从来没有计划过这一切，而且我很高兴仍然在市场上工作，”JM 说。 “但我想尝试一下永远不会太晚。”

paras.en: And finally, the Guardian’s puzzles are here to keep you entertained throughout the day. Until tomorrow.
paras.zh: 最后，《卫报》的谜题可以让您全天享受乐趣。直到明天。

articles.title: UK’s military needs to focus spending on domestic defence, not overseas missions – report
articles.author: Peter Walker Senior political correspondent

paras.en: The UK’s military is too focused on global commitments at the expense of domestic defence, meaning the government’s planned increase in defence spending is likely to result in even greater waste, a thinktank report has warned.
paras.zh: 智库报告警告称，英国军方过于注重全球承诺，而忽视了国内防务，这意味着政府计划增加的国防开支可能会导致更大的浪费。

paras.en: According to an analysis by researchers at the Transition Security Project, Britain has the most overseas-oriented military among European nations, with almost a quarter of the defence budget spent on commitments across five continents.
paras.zh: 根据过渡安全项目研究人员的分析，英国是欧洲国家中军事海外化程度最高的国家，近四分之一的国防预算用于五大洲的承诺。

paras.en: Calling this a symptom of a “destructive, outdated foreign policy” centred on overseas missions which have often made the globe less safe, the report says the imminent uptick in spending should be accompanied by a change of stance, with a much bigger focus on domestic defence.
paras.zh: 报告称这是一种以海外任务为中心的“破坏性的、过时的外交政策”的症状，这种政策往往使全球变得不那么安全。报告称，支出即将增加应该伴随着立场的改变，更加关注国内防务。

paras.en: The government is committed to spending 3.5% of GDP on defence by 2035 amid a defence investment plan (Dip) unveiled in July at the tail end of Keir Starmer’s premiership.
paras.zh: 凯尔·斯塔默 (Keir Starmer) 总理任期结束时 7 月公布了一项国防投资计划 (Dip)，政府承诺到 2035 年将 GDP 的 3.5% 用于国防。

paras.en: Starmer’s then defence secretary, John Healey, resigned over a refusal to commit to reaching 3% by 2030, but now that he is chancellor that target has been shelved for now.
paras.zh: 斯塔默的时任国防部长约翰·希利因拒绝承诺到 2030 年达到 3% 而辞职，但现在他担任总理，这一目标暂时被搁置。

paras.en: It would involve a doubling of the defence budget in nominal terms from £70bn in 2026 to £151bn in 2035, according to the Transition Security Project, a research centre which was spun out of Common Wealth, a thinktank with close links to Andy Burnham.
paras.zh: 根据过渡安全项目（Transition Security Project）的说法，名义上的国防预算将增加一倍，从 2026 年的 700 亿英镑增加到 2035 年的 1510 亿英镑。该项目是一个从 Common Wealth 分拆出来的研究中心，Common Wealth 是一家与安迪·伯纳姆（Andy Burnham）关系密切的智库。

paras.en: Using figures from 2024/25, the study estimated that about 23% of the military budget for that year was spent on overseas commitments, costing just over £14bn, with the real figure likely to be higher. About £2.8bn was spent outside Europe, including bases in places like Cyprus, Kenya and Oman and elsewhere as “strategic hubs” for projecting UK military power.
paras.zh: 该研究利用2024/25年度的数据估计，当年约23%的军事预算用于海外承诺，成本略高于140亿英镑，实际数字可能更高。大约28亿英镑花费在欧洲以外的地方，包括塞浦路斯、肯尼亚和阿曼等地的基地以及其他作为投射英国军事力量的“战略中心”的基地。

paras.en: The report says this makes the UK the most overseas-committed military among European Nato members, even if France has more personnel posted abroad. The Dip seems unlikely to reverse this, talking about ongoing commitments in a series of continents.
paras.zh: 报告称，这使得英国成为欧洲北约成员国中海外投入最多的军队，尽管法国在海外派驻了更多人员。考虑到一系列大陆的持续承诺，经济衰退似乎不太可能扭转这一局面。

paras.en: It questions whether more of the new money should be used for domestic defence, and whether the focus on overseas missions has even made the UK safer.
paras.zh: 它质疑是否应该将更多的新资金用于国内国防，以及对海外任务的关注是否会让英国变得更安全。

paras.en: Since 2001, the study said, the UK has spent more than £51bn in modern terms on military interventions in Iraq, Afghanistan, Libya and elsewhere.
paras.zh: 研究称，自2001年以来，英国在伊拉克、阿富汗、利比亚和其他地方的军事干预上花费了超过510亿英镑（按现代标准计算）。

paras.en: “Britain’s decision to maintain a global network of military bases and force projection capabilities, combined with high levels of waste in the military procurement system, raise serious questions about how it is allocating public investment,” it says, urging the government to “review its military posture, prioritising defence over the global projection of military force”.
paras.zh: 报告称：“英国决定维持全球军事基地网络和兵力投送能力，加上军事采购系统中的大量浪费，引发了人们对其如何分配公共投资的严重质疑。”并敦促政府“审查其军事态势，将防御置于全球军事力量投送之上”。

paras.en: Kevin Cashman, a researcher at Transition Security Project, who co-authored the report, said: “Britain should not pour more money into a bloated military sector geared towards alignment with the United States while Washington starts wars around the world that drive up our bills.”
paras.zh: 该报告的合著者、过渡安全项目研究员凯文·卡什曼表示：“英国不应该向臃肿的军事部门投入更多资金，以与美国结盟，而华盛顿却在世界各地发动战争，增加我们的开支。”

paras.en: Khem Rogaly, the co-director of the organisation, and also a co-author, said: “The billions of pounds Britain wastes on global military deployments every year symbolise its destructive, outdated foreign policy.
paras.zh: 该组织联合主任兼合著者坎·罗加利表示：“英国每年在全球军事部署上浪费数十亿英镑，这象征着其破坏性的、过时的外交政策。

paras.en: “Britain should end its support for these attempts at global policing. Instead, it should focus its military resources on defence and its public investment on health, housing and the climate emergency.”
paras.zh: “英国应该停止对这些全球警务尝试的支持。相反，它应该将军事资源集中在国防上，将公共投资集中在健康、住房和气候紧急情况上。”

paras.en: There is an awareness of the importance of avoiding waste among defence officials, including the risk that an arbitrary focus on reaching a certain level of spending could exacerbate this.
paras.zh: 国防官员已经认识到避免浪费的重要性，包括武断地关注达到一定支出水平可能会加剧这种浪费的风险。

paras.en: The intention is to focus instead on what is necessary – primarily on preparing the UK for a possible war in Europe.
paras.zh: 其目的是把重点放在必要的事情上 — — 主要是让英国为可能发生的欧洲战争做好准备。

articles.title: Veteran Indian actor Nana Patekar dies at 75

paras.en: Veteran Indian actor Nana Patekar, known for his intense performances and distinct dialogue delivery, has died at the age of 75 in Goa, his son Malhar told BBC Marathi.
paras.zh: 印度资深演员纳纳·帕特卡 (Nana Patekar) 以其激烈的表演和独特的对白而闻名，他的儿子马尔哈 (Malhar) 告诉 BBC Marathi，他在果阿去世，享年 75 岁。

paras.en: One of the most recognisable faces of Indian cinema, Patekar won three National Film Awards and became known for playing complex, often volatile characters. He was also a prominent figure in Marathi language cinema and theatre.
paras.zh: 帕特卡是印度电影界最知名的面孔之一，曾获得三项国家电影奖，并因扮演复杂且反复无常的角色而闻名。他也是马拉地语电影和戏剧领域的杰出人物。

paras.en: He was rushed to hospital after being found unconscious at his home in Goa in the early hours of Thursday.
paras.zh: 周四凌晨，他在果阿的家中被发现昏迷不醒，被送往医院。

paras.en: "Despite 45 minutes of continuous CPR, he could not be revived," Dr Shekhar Salkar of Manipal Hospital in Goa told ANI news agency.
paras.zh: 果阿马尼帕尔医院的谢卡尔·萨尔卡医生告诉 ANI 通讯社：“尽管进行了 45 分钟的连续心肺复苏，他还是无法苏醒。”

paras.en: On Thursday, Prime Minister Narendra Modi led tributes to the actor, praising Patekar's versatility and outspoken personality.
paras.zh: 周四，印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪向这位演员致敬，称赞帕特卡的多才多艺和直言不讳的个性。

paras.en: Patekar portrayed characters that would "remain etched in the memory of generations", Modi wrote on X, adding that his death had left "a vast void in the artistic world".
paras.zh: 莫迪在 X 上写道，帕特卡描绘的人物将“铭刻在几代人的记忆中”，并补充说他的去世给“艺术世界留下了巨大的空白”。

paras.en: Bollywood star Akshay Kumar, who appeared alongside Patekar in the comedy film Welcome, remembered him as a rare performer whose voice, intensity and honesty could command an audience's attention.
paras.zh: 与帕特卡一起出演喜剧电影《欢迎》的宝莱坞明星阿克谢·库马尔 (Akshay Kumar) 回忆道，帕特卡是一位罕见的表演者，他的声音、强度和诚实可以吸引观众的注意力。

paras.en: Patekar made his debut with the film Gaman in 1978 and continued to play smaller roles in several films. But the intensity that he brought on the screen was hard to miss and soon he landed a role in Parinda in 1989, making him a household name across India. His portrayal of the volatile, gritty gangster Anna won him his first National Film Award and the Filmfare Award.
paras.zh: 帕特卡于 1978 年凭借电影《Gaman》首次亮相，并继续在多部电影中扮演小角色。但他在银幕上带来的激情不容忽视，很快他于 1989 年在《Parinda》中获得了一个角色，使他成为全印度家喻户晓的人物。他对反复无常、坚韧不拔的黑帮安娜的刻画为他赢得了第一个国家电影奖和 Filmfare 奖。

paras.en: He didn't look back after this and played many memorable characters in several films through the 1990s. The range of the characters he played showcased the depth of his acting talent and mastery over his craft.
paras.zh: 此后他并没有回头，在 20 世纪 90 年代的多部电影中扮演了许多令人难忘的角色。他扮演的角色范围广泛，展示了他深厚的表演天赋和对技艺的掌握。

paras.en: His portrayal of Major Chauhan in Prahaar â a film he also directed â won him praise. Then there was the villainous character of Majid Khan in Angaar, the patriotic firebrand of Tirangaa, and, most notably, Pratap Narayan Tilak in Krantiveer, for which he won the national award for best actor.
paras.zh: 他在自己执导的电影《普拉哈尔》中饰演的乔汉少校赢得了赞誉。然后是《安加尔》中的反派角色马吉德·汗，蒂兰加的爱国煽动者，以及最著名的《克兰蒂维尔》中的普拉塔普·纳拉扬·蒂拉克，他因此获得了国家最佳男主角奖。

paras.en: Just when critics thought that playing loud characters was his mainstay, he proved them wrong by delivering a mesmerising performance in Khamoshi as a person who could not hear or speak.
paras.zh: 就在评论家们认为他的主要角色是扮演响亮的角色时，他在《卡莫什》中饰演一个听不见或说不出话的人，用令人着迷的表演证明了他们的错误。

paras.en: Director Prakash Jha's Rajneeti in 2010 added another dimension to his acting as his portrayal of an astute politician was delivered with perfection.
paras.zh: 2010 年，导演普拉卡什·贾 (Prakash Jha) 饰演的《拉吉尼蒂》(Rajneeti) 为他的表演增添了另一个维度，完美地诠释了一位精明的政治家。

paras.en: The breadth of Patekar's career showcases the wide range of his work.
