articles.title: French police pause use of stun grenades after student loses hand

paras.en: Oct. 7 (UPI) -- France suspended the use of stun grenades by police Wednesday at student protests sweeping the nation after a 15-year-old high school student lost a hand earlier this week.
paras.zh: 10 月 7 日（UPI）——本周早些时候，一名 15 岁高中生失去一只手，法国警方周三在席卷全国的学生抗议活动中暂停使用眩晕手榴弹。

paras.en: Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said he asked for the halt to grenade use "in the context of the high school students' movement" after the incident, which took place Monday in Lens in northern France. Protesters and police have given different accounts of the incident, which Nuñez said needed to be clarified.
paras.zh: 内政部长洛朗·努涅斯表示，周一在法国北部朗斯发生的事件发生后，他要求“在高中学生运动的背景下”停止使用手榴弹。抗议者和警方对这一事件给出了不同的说法，努涅斯表示需要澄清这一点。

paras.en: However, Nuñez also rejected accusations of police brutality and disproportionate force, calling the claims "excessive." Officers "are not intervening if the protests are peaceful," he said.
paras.zh: 然而，努涅斯也否认了对警察暴行和过度使用武力的指控，称这些指控“过分”。他说，如果抗议活动是和平的，警察就不会进行干预。

paras.en: Thousands of people have taken part in the protests across France this week, with at least 250,000 protesting Tuesday. Most remained peaceful, but some protests included violence from police and protesters and destruction of bus shelters and school buildings.
paras.zh: 本周，法国各地有数千人参加了抗议活动，周二至少有 25 万人参加抗议。大多数抗议活动保持和平，但一些抗议活动包括警察和抗议者的暴力以及对公交车候车亭和学校建筑的破坏。

paras.en: More than 6,600 protesters have been arrested, most of them minors. The justice ministry said more than 1,800 will be prosecuted, with the majority also under 18.
paras.zh: 超过 6,600 名抗议者被捕，其中大多数是未成年人。司法部表示，超过 1,800 人将被起诉，其中大多数还不到 18 岁。

paras.en: The protests continued Wednesday, with 400 to 500 schools fully or partially closed. Education Minister Édouard Geffray said 24 schools were so damaged that they will need to be closed for several weeks.
paras.zh: 周三抗议活动仍在继续，400 至 500 所学校全部或部分关闭。教育部长 Édouard Geffray 表示，24 所学校受损严重，需要关闭数周。

paras.en: French Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu was expected to address the country Wednesday night about the protests, in which students and others have called for better school and education conditions. High school students have complained of chronic teacher shortages, crowded classes and neglected buildings, and the protests have spread to their parents, university students and union leaders.
paras.zh: 法国总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努预计将于周三晚上就抗议活动向全国发表讲话，学生和其他人在抗议活动中呼吁改善学校和教育条件。高中生抱怨长期师资短缺、班级拥挤和建筑物被忽视，抗议活动已蔓延到他们的家长、大学生和工会领导人。

paras.en: Nuñez said police watchdog IGPN has launched 18 investigations to determine if the police response was proportionate. One student also lost the use of an eye in a protest-related incident and another lost several teeth.
paras.zh: 努涅斯表示，警方监管机构 IGPN 已启动 18 项调查，以确定警方的反应是否相称。一名学生在与抗议相关的事件中还失去了一只眼睛，另一名学生失去了几颗牙齿。

paras.en: Police have used batons, tear gas and water cannons against the protesters as well as stun grenades, which spray small rubber pellets when they explode. Authorities have said the student who lost a hand picked up a grenade before it detonated, but other witnesses said he was hit directly by the grenade.
paras.zh: 警方对抗议者使用了警棍、催泪瓦斯和高压水枪，还使用了眩晕手榴弹，这些手榴弹爆炸时会喷射出小橡胶颗粒。当局表示，失去一只手的学生在爆炸前捡起了一枚手榴弹，但其他目击者称，他是直接被手榴弹击中的。

articles.title: Baltimore Ravens trade for Philadelphia Eagles center Cam Jurgens

paras.en: Oct. 7 (UPI) -- The Baltimore Ravens agreed to acquire Pro Bowl center Cam Jurgens through a trade with the Philadelphia Eagles, the teams announced Wednesday.
paras.zh: 10 月 7 日（UPI）——巴尔的摩乌鸦队周三宣布，球队同意通过与费城老鹰队的交易获得职业碗中锋卡姆·尤尔根斯。

paras.en: The Ravens will send the Eagles a fifth-round pick in the 2027 NFL Draft and a second-round pick in the 2028 NFL Draft in exchange for Jurgens and a seventh-round pick in 2027.
paras.zh: 乌鸦队将向老鹰队送去一个2027年NFL选秀的第五轮选秀权和一个2028年NFL选秀的第二轮选秀权，以换取尤尔根斯和一个2027年的第七轮选秀权。

paras.en: "Cam is a player we have long admired going all the way back to the draft process," Ravens general manager Eric DeCosta said in a statement.
paras.zh: 乌鸦队总经理埃里克·德科斯塔在一份声明中表示：“卡姆是我们长期以来一直钦佩的一名球员，从选秀开始就一直如此。”

paras.en: "He's a young foundational piece along our offensive line -- a great scheme and cultural fit who will contribute quickly in Baltimore. We are confident that Cam will significantly impact our team and community."
paras.zh: “他是我们进攻线上的年轻基石——一个伟大的计划和文化契合者，他将在巴尔的摩迅速做出贡献。我们相信卡姆将对我们的团队和社区产生重大影响。”

paras.en: Jurgens' departure comes just a day after Eagles All-Pro right tackle Lane Johnson announced his immediate retirement from the NFL.
paras.zh: 就在尤根斯离开的前一天，老鹰队全职业右截锋莱恩·约翰逊宣布立即从 NFL 退役。

paras.en: Jurgens started alongside left tackle Jordan Mailata, left guard Landon Dickerson, right guard Tyler Steen and Johnson in Week 1. Since then, the Eagles have shuffled their offensive line.
paras.zh: 尤尔根斯在第一周与左截锋乔丹·麦拉塔、左后卫兰登·迪克森、右后卫泰勒·斯蒂恩和约翰逊一起首发。从那时起，老鹰队就重新调整了他们的进攻线。

paras.en: Dickerson landed on injured reserve after Week 1. The Eagles then moved Jurgens to left guard, a position he has never played during his NFL career, and brought in Drew Kendall to start at center. Markel Bell started at right tackle in Week 4 in place of Johnson, who sat out due to personal reasons.
paras.zh: 第一周后，迪克森进入伤病预备队。随后，老鹰队将尤尔根斯移至左后卫，这是他在 NFL 职业生涯中从未担任过的位置，并引进德鲁·肯德尔 (Drew Kendall) 担任首发中锋。马克尔·贝尔在第四周开始担任右截锋，代替因个人原因缺席的约翰逊。

paras.en: Willie Lampkin is the Eagles' backup left guard. Backup right guard Micah Morris and tackle Fred Johnson are the only other offensive linemen on the Eagles' roster. Johnson sat out last week with a knee injury.
paras.zh: 威利·兰普金是老鹰队的替补左后卫。替补右后卫米卡·莫里斯和截锋弗雷德·约翰逊是老鹰队名单上仅有的其他进攻锋线球员。约翰逊上周因膝伤缺席比赛。

paras.en: Jurgens -- who is in the concussion protocol -- is expected to slide back to his natural position for the Ravens, who lost Pro Bowl center Tyler Linderbaum in free agency last off-season. They started Jovaughn Gwyn at center through their first three games, but slid rookie guard Vega Ione to the position in Week 4 after Gwyn sustained a fractured fibula.
paras.zh: 正在接受脑震荡治疗的尤尔根斯预计将回到乌鸦队的自然位置，乌鸦队在上个休赛期失去了职业碗中锋泰勒·林德鲍姆。在前三场比赛中，他们让约沃恩·格温 (Jovaughn Gwyn) 担任中锋，但在第四周，格温腓骨骨折后，新秀后卫维加·伊奥尼 (Vega Ione) 就被安排担任中锋。

paras.en: Left tackle Ronnie Stanley, left guard Johnson Simpson and right tackle Roger Rosengarten are expected to start alongside Jurgens and Ione on the Ravens' revamped offensive line.
paras.zh: 左截锋罗尼·斯坦利、左后卫约翰逊·辛普森和右截锋罗杰·罗森加滕预计将与尤尔根斯和艾奥尼一起在乌鸦队改造后的进攻线上首发。

paras.en: Simpson battled a groin injury, while Stanley dealt with toe issues to start the season. Carson Vinson, Andrew Vorhees and Emery Jones Jr. are among the Ravens' reserve offensive linemen.
paras.zh: 辛普森与腹股沟伤势作斗争，而斯坦利则在赛季开始时处理脚趾问题。卡森·文森、安德鲁·沃希斯和小埃默里·琼斯都是乌鸦队的替补进攻锋线球员。

paras.en: The Ravens (3-1) will face the Atlanta Falcons (2-2) at 8:20 p.m. EDT Sunday in Atlanta. The Eagles (2-2) will meet the Jacksonville Jaguars (3-1) at 9:30 a.m. Sunday in London.
paras.zh: 乌鸦队 (3-1) 将在晚上 8:20 迎战亚特兰大猎鹰队 (2-2)。美国东部时间周日在亚特兰大。老鹰队 (2-2) 将于周日上午 9:30 在伦敦迎战杰克逊维尔美洲虎队 (3-1)。

articles.title: Taylor Swift Scores Her 12th Streaming Songs No. 1 With ‘Patient Zero’
articles.author: Kevin Rutherford

paras.en: Taylor Swift earns her 12th No. 1 on Billboard’s Streaming Songs chart via “Patient Zero,” which bows atop the Oct. 10-dated survey.
paras.zh: 泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift) 凭借《零号病人》在公告牌流媒体歌曲排行榜上第 12 次排名第一，该歌曲在 10 月 10 日的调查中名列前茅。

paras.en: In the week ending Oct. 1, the song, one of four bonus tracks released Sept. 25 from her 2025 album The Life of a Showgirl, earned 34.5 million chart-eligible streams in the United States, according to Luminate.
paras.zh: 根据 Luminate 的数据，截至 10 月 1 日的一周内，这首歌是她 2025 年专辑《The Life of a Showgirl》中于 9 月 25 日发行的四首附赠曲目之一，在美国获得了 3,450 万次上榜播放量。

paras.en: That single-week sum is the biggest in the U.S. since a pair of Drake songs, “Janice STFU” (40.7 million) and “Ran to Atlanta” (38.5 million), accumulated more toward the May 30 Billboard charts upon their debut week.
paras.zh: 这一单周销售额是自 Drake 的两首歌曲《Janice STFU》（4070 万美元）和《Ran to Atlantic》（3850 万美元）在首周就在 5 月 30 日公告牌排行榜上累积更多收入以来的最高单周收入。

paras.en: “Patient Zero” marks Swift’s second newcomer to No. 1 on Streaming Songs in 2026 and third overall. “The Fate of Ophelia,” which reigned for seven weeks between October and December 2025, returned to the top spot for one week in January (Jan. 10, following the fall of holiday songs on the ranking), while “I Knew It, I Knew You” led for a week in June.
paras.zh: 《零号病人》标志着斯威夫特在 2026 年流媒体歌曲排行榜上第二位新人，也是第三位。 《The Fate of Ophelia》在 2025 年 10 月至 12 月期间统治了七周，并在 1 月重回榜首一周（1 月 10 日，节日歌曲排名下降），而《I Knew It, I Knew You》在 6 月连续一周领先。

paras.en: Swift, who first topped Streaming Songs in November 2014 with “Shake It Off,” is one of only two acts to boasts 10 or more No. 1s in the ranking’s 13-year history, alongside Drake with 22.
paras.zh: 斯威夫特于 2014 年 11 月凭借《Shake It Off》首次登上流媒体歌曲榜首，她是该排名 13 年历史上仅有的两位拥有 10 次或以上第一名的艺人之一，德雷克 (Drake) 则有 22 次。

paras.en: Swift occupies four of Streaming Songs’ top five on the Oct. 10 chart, with Ella Langley’s “Choosin’ Texas” (No. 2, 22.4 million streams) breaking up the streak. “Cleveland!” follows at No. 3 (19.3 million), with “Babylon” (No. 4, 19 million) and “Pink Clouding” (No. 5, 18.4 million) rounding out the top five.
paras.zh: 在 10 月 10 日的流媒体歌曲排行榜上，斯威夫特占据了前五名中的四席，艾拉·兰利 (Ella Langley) 的《Choosin’ Texas》（第二名，2240 万次播放）打破了这一记录。 “克利夫兰！”位列第三（1,930 万），《巴比伦》（第 4，1,900 万）和《粉红云》（第 5，1,840 万）也跻身前五。

paras.en: As a result, Swift now has 41 top fives on Streaming Songs (second all time behind Drake’s 70) and 73 top 10s (also second, also behind Drake, who has 114).
paras.zh: 结果，斯威夫特现在拥有 41 首流媒体歌曲前五名（历史第二，仅次于 Drake 的 70 首）和 73 首前十名（同样排名第二，也落后于 Drake 的 114 首）。

paras.en: Below the top five, Swift appears on Streaming Songs multiple times; “The Fate of Ophelia” is the ranking’s Greatest Gainer (No. 12; 10.2 million streams, up 51%), while “Opalite” re-enters at No. 22 (7.7 million streams, up 53%) and “I Knew It, I Knew You” remains on the list at No. 39 (6.3 million). The former two were featured on the original release of The Life of a Showgirl, while the latter is on the Toy Story 5 soundtrack.
paras.zh: 在前五名之下，斯威夫特多次出现在流媒体歌曲中； 《奥菲莉亚的命运》是排名中涨幅最大的影片（第 12 位；1,020 万次播放量，增长 51%），而《Opalite》重新进入第 22 位（770 万次播放量，增长 53%），《我知道，我知道你》仍然位列第 39 位（630 万次）。前两者出现在《歌舞女郎的一生》的原始版本中，而后者则出现在《玩具总动员 5》的原声带中。

paras.en: Concurrently, as previously reported, “Patient Zero” debuts at No. 1 on the multimetric Billboard Hot 100, her 16th ruler, and parent album The Life of a Showgirl returns to the top of the Billboard 200.
paras.zh: 与此同时，正如之前报道的那样，《零号病人》首次登上公告牌百强单曲榜第一名，这是她的第 16 个统治者，而母专辑《歌舞女郎的生活》则重返公告牌 200 强榜首。

articles.title: RIAA CEO Talks Midterms, AI Deepfakes and Trump: ‘Music Is a Very Bipartisan Issue’
articles.author: Kristin Robinson

paras.en: There is a lot going on in Washington D.C. Between conflicts in the Middle East, rising inflation and other hot button issues, it could be understandable if music industry issues fall lower on the priority list for politicians these days.
paras.zh: 华盛顿特区发生了很多事情。在中东冲突、通货膨胀上升和其他热点问题之间，如果现在音乐产业问题在政客的优先事项列表中下降，这是可以理解的。

paras.en: However, no matter what is going on in the nation’s capitol, it’s the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA) and its chairman/CEO Mitch Glazier‘s mission to get the D.C. power players to pay attention to causes related to the recorded music industry, and he tells Billboard it’s actually not as hard as one might believe. “Everyone loves music,” Glazier says with a smile and a shrug.
paras.zh: 然而，无论美国国会大厦发生什么，美国唱片工业协会 (RIAA) 及其主席兼首席执行官米奇·格拉齐尔 (Mitch Glazier) 的使命就是让华盛顿特区的权力人物关注与录制音乐行业相关的事业，他告诉 Billboard，这实际上并不像人们想象的那么难。 “每个人都喜欢音乐，”格拉泽微笑着耸耸肩说道。

paras.en: To build rapport, Glazier is known to ask members of Congress about the song they danced to at their weddings, tugging on the emotional heartstrings of both Republicans and Democrats alike, before launching into RIAA talking points about strengthening copyright protection and safeguarding against AI deepfake impersonation.
paras.zh: 为了建立融洽的关系，格雷泽会向国会议员询问他们在婚礼上跳舞的歌曲，拉动共和党人和民主党人的情感心弦，然后向 RIAA 提出有关加强版权保护和防范人工智能 Deepfake 冒充的谈话要点。

paras.en: His biggest push right now is the NO FAKES Act, a bill guarding against unauthorized deepfakes, that’s been reintroduced to the House and Senate for several years in the row, each time adding in new supporters, ranging from Google and OpenAI to SAG-AFTRA and the Motion Picture Association.
paras.zh: 他目前最大的推动力是《NO FAKES Act》，这是一项防止未经授权的深度伪造的法案，该法案已连续几年被重新提交给众议院和参议院，每次都会增加新的支持者，从谷歌和 OpenAI 到 SAG-AFTRA 和电影协会。

paras.en: Last week, Sen. Marsha Blackburn (R-TN) took the bill to the senate floor for a vote, and while it received nearly universal support, it was thwarted by one dissenter, Sen. Ted Cruz (R-TX), who expressed concern that the bill did not have sufficient exceptions for the use of one’s image in satire or political commentary.
paras.zh: 上周，田纳西州共和党参议员玛莎·布莱克本 (Marsha Blackburn) 将该法案提交参议院进行投票，虽然该法案几乎获得了普遍支持，但遭到了一位反对者参议员特德·克鲁兹 (Ted Cruz) 的阻挠，克鲁兹表示担心该法案对于在讽刺或政治评论中使用个人形象没有足够的例外情况。

paras.en: With the midterm election — and the holidays — fast approaching, it is looking like the bill may need to go through another round of reintroduction in 2027. Still, as Glazier puts it, he’s “an optimistic person,” and he believes there’s still a possibility that the bill could get unanimous support during the lame duck period and slip through in the final moments of 2026. “This is one that has such broad support, both from a coalition basis and from members of Congress — House, Senate, Republican, Democrat — that if we can work out a couple of these last issues, I think it has a real shot at what we call unanimous consent,” he says.
paras.zh: 随着中期选举和假期的临近，看起来该法案可能需要在 2027 年进行另一轮重新推出。不过，正如 Glazier 所说，他是“一个乐观的人”，他认为该法案仍有可能在跛脚鸭时期获得一致支持，并在 2026 年的最后时刻获得通过。“这是一项获得如此广泛支持的法案，无论是来自联盟基础还是国会议员——众议院、参议院、共和党、民主党——如果我们能够解决最后几个问题，我认为它确实有机会获得我们所谓的一致同意，”他说。

paras.en: To talk through the upcoming election, Trump’s second term and coalition building for music rights on Capitol Hill, Glazier joins the latest episode of Billboard On the Record.
paras.zh: 为了谈论即将到来的选举、特朗普的第二任期以及国会山音乐版权联盟的建设，格拉泽加入了最新一期的《Billboard On the Record》节目。

paras.en: To watch this episode of Billboard On the Record, check out the YouTube video below or click here for more viewing and listening options. An edited and condensed excerpt of the conversation can also be found below.
paras.zh: 要观看 Billboard On the Record 的这一集，请查看下面的 YouTube 视频或单击此处获取更多观看和收听选项。下面还提供了经过编辑和浓缩的对话摘录。

paras.en: Since you have your feet in both words, how would you compare D.C. and Hollywood?
paras.zh: 既然你对这两个词都很熟悉，你会如何比较华盛顿和好莱坞？

paras.en: There are a lot of similarities. D.C. is all about a brand around a person, right? And an artist is all about a brand around a person. They all have teams, and it’s not like you’re working for, you know, Coca-Cola, the corporation. You’re working for this senator. You’re working for this congressman. It’s about them, their views — what they want to put out to the world. And your job is to make sure that what they want to get out there, they get out there successfully, and then you try to help with the reaction to what they put out there. Also, the fact that politics and entertainment and music are dinner table topics — everybody is interested in that. Families fight over these two subjects at Thanksgiving.
paras.zh: 有很多相似之处。 D.C. 就是一个以人为中心的品牌，对吗？艺术家就是一个围绕着一个人的品牌。他们都有团队，而且你不是在为可口可乐公司工作。你正在为这位参议员工作。你正在为这位国会议员工作。这是关于他们、他们的观点——他们想向世界展示什么。你的工作是确保他们想要发布的内容能够成功发布，然后你尝试帮助他们做出反应。此外，事实上政治、娱乐和音乐是餐桌上的话题——每个人都对此感兴趣。感恩节，家人会为这两个问题争论不休。

paras.en: The stakes are a little bit different, I will say.
paras.zh: 我会说，赌注有点不同。

paras.en: With everything going on in D.C., there are a ton of hot-button issues that are very important right now. Is it difficult to get people to pay attention to music-related issues?
paras.zh: 随着华盛顿特区发生的一切，目前存在大量非常重要的热点问题。让人们关注与音乐相关的问题很难吗？

paras.en: It’s not, because we’re music and everybody loves music. I mean, the first thing I ask any person who’s elected to Congress is, “What was the song that you danced to at your wedding?” Only music can bring you back immediately to something in your life that’s incredibly important. And when they think about it and they answer, you’re like, “Music’s important, and it needs to be protected.” Then, I run into how the Constitution actually gives them the job to do, and that they’re bound to do it under law, and that they have to secure rights, and I go through the whole thing. But we always start with music. That is our secret weapon because this industry is small with a huge impact on American culture. We don’t have the revenues that AI companies have, tech companies have, even that other entertainment industries have. Still, I would argue that we are the most impactful industry with the least amount of revenue.
paras.zh: 不是的，因为我们是音乐，每个人都喜欢音乐。我的意思是，我问任何当选国会议员的第一件事是，“你在婚礼上跳舞的歌曲是什么？”只有音乐才能让您立即回到生活中非常重要的事情。当他们思考这个问题并回答时，你会想，“音乐很重要，它需要受到保护。”然后，我遇到了宪法实际上如何赋予他们工作要做的问题，他们有义务根据法律去做，他们必须确保权利，然后我经历了整个事情。但我们总是从音乐开始。这是我们的秘密武器，因为这个行业规模虽小，但对美国文化的影响却很大。我们没有人工智能公司、科技公司、甚至其他娱乐行业所拥有的收入。尽管如此，我仍认为我们是最具影响力但收入最少的行业。

paras.en: Do you find that you guys have more success advocating for these issues with folks who consider themselves to be Republicans or Democrats?
paras.zh: 您是否发现你们在向自认为是共和党人或民主党人的人们倡导这些问题时更成功？

paras.en: Unlike many other industries, it does not break down by party. Music is a very bipartisan issue. I would say that there are arguments that you might lean on more or less, depending on the audience. So, for example, a lot of Republicans support the music industry because they believe in property rights, and they want to make sure that this constitutionally given property right is protected. It’s also individual freedom and the ability to sort of negotiate freely with property that you have, and free speech issues. And then on the Democratic side, although they also very much care about those issues, they also care about workers’ issues, and now the Republican side also cares about those issues, so it’s very bipartisan. We might emphasize one thing more than another, but for the most part, it breaks down a little bit more by geography than it does by party.
paras.zh: 与许多其他行业不同，它不会因政党而崩溃。音乐是一个两党共同参与的问题。我想说的是，有些论点你可能会或多或少地依赖，这取决于观众。例如，许多共和党人支持音乐产业，因为他们相信财产权，并且他们希望确保宪法赋予的财产权受到保护。这也是个人自由和与你拥有的财产进行自由谈判的能力，以及言论自由问题。然后在民主党方面，虽然他们也非常关心这些问题，但他们也关心工人的问题，现在共和党方面也关心这些​​问题，所以这是非常两党合作的。我们可能会比另一件事更强调一件事，但在大多数情况下，它按地理位置的划分比按党派的划分要多一些。

paras.en: As politics has gotten more divided and more extreme, how has that affected the way that you have to go after and convince these politicians to pay attention to these issues.
paras.zh: 随着政治变得更加分裂和更加极端，这如何影响你必须追求并说服这些政客关注这些问题的方式。

paras.en: So weirdly, it brings them together. At the end of the day, they are human beings. They actually do crave working together, even though it’s seemingly more impossible these days. So when we have a hearing on music, it’s almost like this big sigh of relief. The members come; they’re nice to each other. They care about it. They defer to each other. It’s almost like they’ve been dying to actually be normal and nice to each other, and we present that opportunity for them. Also, almost every event that we do is bipartisan. So we bring them together with music and help them get to know each other and their families and their friends. Music brings out the humanity in people
paras.zh: 奇怪的是，它将他们聚集在一起。归根结底，他们都是人。他们确实渴望一起工作，尽管如今这似乎更加不可能。所以当我们听到音乐时，几乎就像松了一口气。会员来了；他们对彼此很好。他们关心它。他们互相尊重。就好像他们一直渴望真正成为正常人并善待彼此，而我们为他们提供了这个机会。此外，我们举办的几乎所有活动都是两党合作的。因此，我们用音乐将他们聚集在一起，帮助他们相互了解以及他们的家人和朋友。音乐展现人性

paras.en: How would you compare working with the Trump administration in his second term versus his first?
paras.zh: 您如何比较在第二任期和第一任期内与特朗普政府的合作？

paras.en: I would say that generally, this administration stems from the top. It’s unlike the George W. Bush administration, which was sort of more bottom-up. Also, the president loves music — absolutely loves music.
paras.zh: 我想说，一般来说，本届政府是自上而下的。这与乔治·W·布什政府不同，后者更加自下而上。此外，总统热爱音乐——绝对热爱音乐。

paras.en: He takes out his Spotify playlist. He shows people: “What do you think?” He listens, but they don’t publish his playlist. [Former President] Obama published his playlist, so we got to see more from him, but anecdotally, from folks who have been with [Trump], he’s like showing people songs a lot of times. I think it’s something that was pushed to him in an algorithm he listened to. He’s like, “Hey, have you heard this?“ It’s more like a discovery thing.
paras.zh: 他拿出他的 Spotify 播放列表。他向人们展示：“你觉得怎么样？”他听，但他们不发布他的播放列表。 [前总统]奥巴马发布了他的播放列表，因此我们可以从他那里看到更多内容，但有趣的是，从曾经与[特朗普]在一起的人那里，他喜欢多次向人们展示歌曲。我认为这是通过他听到的算法推给他的东西。他就像，“嘿，你听到这个了吗？”这更像是一个发现的事情。

paras.en: I mean, I know everyone loves music. It’s just odd to think of Trump having a personal life.
paras.zh: 我的意思是，我知道每个人都喜欢音乐。想到特朗普有自己的私生活就觉得很奇怪。

paras.en: I love the fact that [former President] Biden and Trump and Obama have nothing in common, really…but all three of them love music.
paras.zh: 我喜欢这样一个事实：[前总统]拜登、特朗普和奥巴马确实没有任何共同点……但他们三个都热爱音乐。

paras.en: When I talk to people about generative AI, sometimes they’ll say, “Generative AI is music’s next Napster moment.” I’m wondering how you think about that comparison? Is that a fair assessment?
paras.zh: 当我与人们谈论生成式人工智能时，有时他们会说，“生成式人工智能是音乐的下一个 Napster 时刻。”我想知道你如何看待这种比较？这是一个公平的评价吗？

paras.en: I don’t. I think it’s the opposite. First of all, I would say with Napster, we were fighting against the people. For fans it was like, you know, “Oh, this is so great. I’m receiving this free stuff.” When we were unable to act against the companies, it kind of forced to act against the people. I think that we were put in this terrible situation where it was the industry versus fans. That’s not where you want to be.
paras.zh: 我不知道。我认为恰恰相反。首先，我想说，对于 Napster，我们是在与人民作斗争。对于粉丝来说，就像，你知道，“哦，这太棒了。我收到了这些免费的东西。”当我们无法对公司采取行动时，就被迫对人民采取行动。我认为我们陷入了行业与粉丝对抗的可怕境地。那不是你想去的地方。

paras.en: AI’s the complete opposite. The fans, the people, they’re with us. They are very hesitant about and leery of AI replacing the human element that makes music what it is, that gives music its soul. That’s the magic that comes from life experiences. People don’t want to lose that. This idea of music generators sort of taking human works and then running them through a machine and popping something out — it’s like popping out a body without a soul inside. I know people don’t want that, because we’ve done the focus groups and we’ve done the polls, and the numbers are, like, 92%.
paras.zh: 人工智能则完全相反。球迷、人民，他们和我们在一起。他们对人工智能取代人类元素非常犹豫和怀疑，人类元素使音乐成为现实，赋予音乐灵魂。这就是来自生活经历的魔力。人们不想失去它。音乐发生器的想法有点像是获取人类的作品，然后通过机器运行它们并弹出一些东西——就像弹出一个没有灵魂的身体一样。我知道人们不希望这样，因为我们已经完成了焦点小组和民意调查，数字大约是 92%。

paras.en: Looking back at that time period with Napster, the RIAA was super active. As you alluded to, the RIAA did go after music fans using Napster as a way to try to quell digital piracy. Now that we’re over 20 years post-Napster, I often hear music executives wanting to distance themselves from that period. As you’ve reflected on that time period, do you feel like the RIAA handled Napster the way they should have?
paras.zh: 回顾那段 Napster 时期，RIAA 非常活跃。正如您提到的，RIAA 确实利用 Napster 来追捕音乐迷，以此作为平息数字盗版的一种方式。如今，Napster 时代已经过去 20 多年了，我经常听到音乐高管希望与那个时期保持距离。正如您对那段时期的反思，您认为 RIAA 是否以应有的方式处理 Napster？

paras.en: We were sort of forced into it in a succession of lawsuits. But originally there was no suing of consumers. It was what we called a pre-litigation settlement letter, and we basically sent a letter saying, “Hey, you’re stealing a bunch of stuff. It’s not legal. We won’t sue you if you want to settle this. And how about we settle it for —“ And it was a fairly nominal amount. Enough to basically say this is wrong and to create a deterrent, but not to get to the level of lawsuits. But the [internet service providers] decided that they wanted to stop giving us the names of people before lawsuits could be filed.
paras.zh: 我们是在一系列诉讼中被迫陷入困境的。但最初并没有消费者提起诉讼。这就是我们所说的诉讼前和解信，我们基本上寄了一封信，说：“嘿，你偷了一堆东西。这是不合法的。如果你想和解，我们不会起诉你。我们以——”来和解怎么样？这是一个相当象征性的金额。基本上足以说这是错误的并形成威慑，但还不足以达到诉讼的程度。但[互联网服务提供商]决定在提起诉讼之前停止向我们提供人员姓名。

paras.en: So, we had to go to court, and we said, “Look, we think that we should get the names ahead of time.” The court said, “Nope, you can’t get the names ahead of time. The only way to enforce your right is going to be to file a lawsuit against John Doe.” Instead of sending a letter and trying to work it out ahead of time, you start walking down this path, and now you’re forced to sue John Doe. Well, John Doe could be a 12-year-old kid who happened to have their name on the account, or a dead person… And so you end up in all these embarrassing situations, and they all become stories.
paras.zh: 所以，我们不得不上法庭，我们说，“听着，我们认为我们应该提前得到名字。”法院说：“不，你无法提前获得姓名。行使你权利的唯一方法就是对约翰·多伊提起诉讼。”你不再写信并试图提前解决问题，而是开始走这条路，现在你被迫起诉无名氏。好吧，无名氏可能是一个 12 岁的孩子，他的名字碰巧出现在账户上，或者是一个死人……所以你最终会陷入所有这些尴尬的境地，而它们都成为了故事。

paras.en: We were a little bit forced into it…I try to forget this part myself, but [people must remember that] we lost half the industry. We went from six majors to three majors. We lost 50% of our revenue. I think, at the time, desperate times called for desperate measures, and people were desperately trying to create the record that this was illegal, knowing one day we probably would end up in the Supreme Court. So it ended up well in the Supreme Court.
paras.zh: 我们有点被迫……我自己试图忘记这一部分，但是[人们必须记住]我们失去了一半的行业。我们从六个专业变成了三个专业。我们损失了 50% 的收入。我认为，当时，绝望的时代需要绝望的措施，人们拼命地试图创造这种行为是非法的记录，因为他们知道有一天我们可能最终会被送上最高法院。所以这件事在最高法院得到了很好的结果。

paras.en: I hope that the industry never gets into a shape again where it ever sues users, but it was also true in Washington that the big line for all these trade associations that represent tech companies is, “You should go after the wrongdoer, not the provider.” In other words, don’t go after the company that has tons of capital investment; you should go after the kid who uploaded it.
paras.zh: 我希望这个行业永远不会再陷入起诉用户的境地，但在华盛顿，所有代表科技公司的行业协会的大纲都是，“你应该追究不法行为者，而不是提供商。”换句话说，不要追求拥有大量资本投资的公司；你应该去找那个上传它的孩子。

paras.en: Can you just tell me a little bit more about NO FAKES? The bill refers to “digital replicas” which I think many listeners might not understand.
paras.zh: 您能告诉我更多有关 NO FAKES 的信息吗？该法案提到了“数字复制品”，我想很多听众可能不理解。

paras.en: So the definition is pretty narrow, actually, but the definition is a highly realistic, computer-generated replica of your voice or your likeness. In other words, a clone, right? So it’s — I’m cloning your voice or I’m cloning your likeness to use it in a way that you didn’t consent. It’s not a meme. It’s not, like, The Onion. It’s not a picture. It’s not something on Saturday Night Live. It is really about AI cloning.
paras.zh: 因此，实际上，这个定义相当狭窄，但它的定义是高度真实的、计算机生成的你的声音或你的肖像的复制品。换句话说，克隆人，对吗？所以，我正在克隆你的声音，或者我正在克隆你的肖像，以一种你不同意的方式使用它。这不是模因。它不像洋葱。这不是一张图片。这不是周六夜现场的节目。这实际上是关于人工智能克隆。

paras.en: The RIAA has been working on NO FAKES Act for a while now. It was first introduced as a draft bill in 2023, then it was formally introduced in 2024, reintroduced in 2025…
paras.zh: RIAA 致力于《无假货法案》已经有一段时间了。它于 2023 年首次作为法案草案提出，然后于 2024 年正式提出，并于 2025 年重新提出......

paras.en: Now, we’re in 2026, and we’re close to the midterms now, and then the holidays, and then we’re into 2027, when you’d have to reintroduce it again. I’m wondering what you think the timeline is, realistically, for this getting passed?
paras.zh: 现在，我们已经到了 2026 年，我们已经接近中期选举，然后是假期，然后我们进入 2027 年，那时你必须再次重新引入它。我想知道您认为这件事实际上要通过的时间表是什么？

paras.en: We have a shot in the lame duck [period], a real shot. Nobody knows what’s going to happen in the election, obviously, and nobody knows what’s going to happen in that time period between the election and the new Congress. But this is one that has such broad support, both from a coalition basis and from members of Congress — House, Senate, Republican, Democrat — that if we can work out a couple of these last issues, I think it has a real shot at what we call unanimous consent. And that is somebody literally saying, “Hey, if nobody opposes this, I think we should just pass it.” And if nobody objects, then it can pass. So whether there’s, like, a vehicle that it could be attached to, we really don’t know. But I do think that we’ve got a shot in this Congress to get this done, just based on the support. But I’m an optimistic person.
paras.zh: 我们有一个跛脚鸭的镜头，一个真实的镜头。显然，没有人知道选举中会发生什么，也没有人知道选举和新国会之间的这段时间会发生什么。但这得到了如此广泛的支持，无论是来自联盟基础还是国会议员——众议院、参议院、共和党、民主党——如果我们能够解决最后几个问题，我认为它确实有机会获得我们所谓的一致同意。那就是有人说，“嘿，如果没有人反对，我认为我们应该通过它。”如果没有人反对，那么它就可以通过。因此，我们真的不知道是否有可以连接它的车辆。但我确实认为，仅仅基于支持，我们就有机会在本届国会中完成这项工作。但我是一个乐观的人。

paras.en: More likely, it goes into the next Congress. It’ll have to be reintroduced in both the House and the Senate. But this is where we are so fortunate that our issues are completely bipartisan. It doesn’t matter if the House changes or the Senate changes, or they both stay the same, or they both change; this bill will be on a trajectory for quick introduction and quick movement, because it’s not the process.
paras.zh: 更有可能的是，它会进入下一届国会。它必须在众议院和参议院重新引入。但这正是我们如此幸运的地方，因为我们的问题完全是两党共同的。众议院或参议院是否发生变化，或者两者都保持不变，或者两者都发生变化，这并不重要；该法案将走上快速出台和快速行动的轨道，因为这不是一个过程。

paras.en: Why do you think it’s taken so long for NO FAKES to get through so far?
paras.zh: 您认为为什么 NO FAKES 花了这么长时间才获得通过？

paras.en: Coalition building. We started out with us and the unions and the artist groups together, and then we broadened out to the motion picture industry, which is hard because they use a lot of AI in a lot of different ways for making motion pictures. Then, we broadened it out to YouTube and the streaming platforms, which took a long time, because the obligation is on them to take these digital replicas down when they get a notice that says, “Hey, that’s my face and that’s my voice, and I didn’t say that that was OK.” We had to make sure that it could be practical, that it wasn’t too laborious… Then, we had to broaden that out to the AI companies. We basically went to OpenAI and said, “You know, this is one bill that you should be for”… And to their credit, on this bill, they agreed.
paras.zh: 联盟建设。我们从我们、工会和艺术家团体一起开始，然后我们扩展到电影行业，这很困难，因为他们以很多不同的方式使用大量人工智能来制作电影。然后，我们将其扩展到 YouTube 和流媒体平台，这花了很长时间，因为当他们收到通知说“嘿，那是我的脸，那是我的声音，我并没有说那没关系”时，他们有义务将这些数字复制品撤下。我们必须确保它实用，并且不太费力……然后，我们必须将其扩展到人工智能公司。我们基本上去找 OpenAI 并说，“你知道，这是一项你应该支持的法案”……值得赞扬的是，他们同意了这项法案。

paras.en: Then, we went to the Trump administration, and we talked to all [of his people] about it, and the Trump administration ended up supporting it, and they put in a national legislative policy framework their support for the NO FAKES Act. You just have to keep building your coalition over time until you get to the point where you might have a single issue or one objector, and you’re never going to get anybody. It takes years to accomplish this.
paras.zh: 然后，我们去了特朗普政府，与所有[他的人民]讨论了这个问题，特朗普政府最终支持了它，他们把对《无假货法案》的支持纳入了国家立法政策框架。你只需要随着时间的推移不断建立你的联盟，直到你可能遇到一个问题或一个反对者，而你永远不会得到任何人。实现这一目标需要数年时间。

paras.en: What elections do you think are critical for music this November?
paras.zh: 您认为今年 11 月哪些选举对音乐至关重要？

paras.en: So we’re losing Sen. Marsha Blackburn from Tennessee, because she’s running for governor, and she’s likely to become governor in Tennessee. So if she becomes governor, she will name her replacement, who then will have to run for that seat later. That’s a very important one. We obviously pay great attention to what’s happening in what we call our “home states.” What’s happening in Florida and Texas and New York, California, Tennessee? But for us, we also have to pay attention to who’s going to be in charge of the committees that handle all of our topics.
paras.zh: 因此，我们将失去田纳西州参议员玛莎·布莱克本，因为她正在竞选州长，而且她很可能成为田纳西州州长。因此，如果她成为州长，她将任命她的继任者，然后她必须稍后竞选该席位。这是非常重要的一点。显然，我们非常关注我们所谓的“家乡”发生的事情。佛罗里达州、德克萨斯州、纽约州、加利福尼亚州、田纳西州发生了什么？但对我们来说，我们还必须注意谁将负责处理我们所有主题的委员会。

articles.title: 10 Billboard Hot 100 Hits Named After Movie Stars, From ADÉLA’s ‘Nicole Kidman’ to Taylor Swift’s ‘Elizabeth Taylor’
articles.author: Hannah Dailey

paras.en: One of the buzziest songs to emerge from the latter half of 2026 was a song that borrowed its title from a major A-list actress: Nicole Kidman.
paras.zh: 2026 年下半年最热门的歌曲之一是一首借用了一线女演员妮可·基德曼 (Nicole Kidman) 的歌名的歌曲。

paras.en: After entering the Billboard Hot 100 in September and climbing to No. 11 the following month, ADÉLA’s homage-turned-hit united pop music lovers and cinephiles alike. Even Kidman is a fan. “I can’t believe it,” the Hollywood icon gushed to Jimmy Fallon. “She wrote a song called ‘Nicole Kidman,’ [and] I’m like, ‘Who is that person?’ She’s so talented.”
paras.zh: ADÉLA 于 9 月份进入 Billboard Hot 100 并在次月攀升至第 11 位，之后，ADÉLA 的致敬之作变成了热门歌曲，将流行音乐爱好者和影迷团结在一起。就连基德曼也是它的粉丝。 “我简直不敢相信，”这位好莱坞偶像滔滔不绝地对吉米·法伦说道。 “她写了一首名为‘妮可·基德曼’的歌曲，[和]我想，‘那个人是谁？’她太有才华了。”

paras.en: “It’s just wild watching [her] movies, being like, ‘This person, for some reason, is doing charity work and supporting me,'” ADÉLA later joked in an interview with Billboard. “The fact that she embraces me is such an honor — I have trouble processing it still.”
paras.zh: “看她的电影真是太疯狂了，就像，‘这个人，出于某种原因，正在做慈善工作并支持我，’”阿黛拉后来在接受《公告牌》采访时开玩笑说。 “她拥抱我真是一种荣幸——我仍然难以接受。”

paras.en: But “Nicole Kidman” is just one of many hits in a long history of musical odes to stars of the screen, penned by stars of the stage. SZA famously named one of her most beloved Ctrl songs after one Drew Barrymore — albeit one that never reached the Hot 100 (though a similarly titled hit from Bryce Vine did around the same time) — while Taylor Swift paid tribute to Elizabeth Taylor in a track on The Life of a Showgirl. “She and my mom do seem like kindred spirits,” the late legend’s son Christopher told People of Swift after the song dropped. “The way she has deftly captured the similarities and parallel tracks in their careers and personal lives is delightful.”
paras.zh: 但《妮可·基德曼》只是由舞台明星创作的银幕明星音乐颂歌的悠久历史中众多热门歌曲之一。 SZA 以德鲁·巴里摩尔 (Drew Barrymore) 的名字命名了她最喜爱的 Ctrl 歌曲之一，尽管这首歌从未进入热门 100 名（尽管布莱斯·瓦恩 (Bryce Vine) 的一首类似标题的热门歌曲大约在同一时间进入），而泰勒·斯威夫特 (Taylor Swift) 在《歌舞女郎的一生》(The Life of a Showgirl) 中的一首曲目中向伊丽莎白·泰勒 (Elizabeth Taylor) 致敬。 “她和我妈妈看起来确实志趣相投，”歌曲发行后，这位已故传奇人物的儿子克里斯托弗告诉《斯威夫特人》。 “她巧妙地捕捉到了他们职业生涯和个人生活中的相似之处和平行轨迹，这真是令人愉快。”

paras.en: Fall Out Boy, Gorillaz and Logic have also named songs after an assortment of famous actors and actresses, and we’d be remiss not to give a special shoutout to Kim Carnes’ enduring 1981 classic “Bette Davis Eyes.” Below, check out Billboard‘s list of 10 Hot 100 hits named after movie stars.
paras.zh: Fall Out Boy、Gorillaz 和 Logic 也以各种著名男女演员的名字命名了歌曲，如果我们不特别赞扬 Kim Carnes 1981 年的经久不衰的经典歌曲《Bette Davis Eyes》，那就太失职了。下面，请查看 Billboard 列出的以电影明星命名的 10 首热门 100 首热门歌曲。

paras.en: Hot 100 Peak: No. 11 (as of Oct. 3, 2026)

articles.title: Frank Mancuso Sr., Former Chairman of Paramount and MGM, Dies at 93
articles.author: Mike Barnes

paras.en: Frank Mancuso Sr., who rose from jobs as a theater usher and film buyer in Buffalo, New York, to become the chairman and CEO of Paramount Pictures and then MGM, has died. He was 93.
paras.zh: 老弗兰克·曼库索 (Frank Mancuso Sr.) 去世，他曾在纽约州布法罗担任剧院引座员和电影采购员，后来成为派拉蒙影业公司和米高梅公司的董事长兼首席执行官。他93岁了。

paras.en: Mancuso died Thursday at his home in Los Angeles of complications from cancer, his family announced.
paras.zh: 曼库索的家人宣布，曼库索周四在洛杉矶的家中因癌症并发症去世。

paras.en: Survivors include his son, Frank Mancuso Jr., who, while often working for his father, produced five Friday the 13th films as well as Species (1995), John Frankenheimer’s Ronin (1998) and Stigmata (1999).
paras.zh: 幸存者包括他的儿子小弗兰克·曼库索（Frank Mancuso Jr.），他虽然经常为父亲工作，但制作了五部《十三号星期五》电影以及《物种》（1995）、约翰·弗兰肯海默的《浪人》（1998）和《圣痕》（1999）。

paras.en: The elder Mancuso, who spent nearly three decades with Paramount, was the rare studio chieftain to have come from the ranks of marketers.
paras.zh: 老曼库索在派拉蒙工作了近三十年，是少有的来自营销人员队伍的制片厂负责人。

paras.en: He was serving a 20-month stint as president of Paramount’s motion picture group when Martin Davis, chairman and CEO of parent conglomerate Gulf & Western, selected him over Michael Eisner to take over the flagging studio in September 1984.
paras.zh: 1984 年 9 月，他在派拉蒙电影集团担任总裁 20 个月，母公司海湾西部公司 (Gulf & Western) 的董事长兼首席执行官马丁·戴维斯 (Martin Davis) 选择他取代迈克尔·艾斯纳 (Michael Eisner) 接管这家萎靡不振的工作室。

paras.en: Mancuso replaced Barry Diller, who had abruptly left to assume control of 20th Century Fox. Eisner, Diller’s second in command, departed for Disney when he didn’t get promoted, and he was soon followed out the door by another rising young executive, Jeffrey Katzenberg.
paras.zh: 曼库索接替了突然离职的巴里·迪勒，接管了二十世纪福克斯公司的控制权。迪勒的副手艾斯纳在没有升职的情况下前往迪士尼，很快另一位冉冉升起的年轻高管杰弗里·卡森伯格也跟着他离开了迪士尼。

paras.en: Mancuso, however, hired former Universal exec Ned Tanen to serve as president of production, re-signed Eddie Murphy to a lucrative contract and struck a long-term deal with producers Don Simpson and Jerry Bruckheimer.
paras.zh: 然而，曼库索聘请了环球影业前高管内德·塔宁担任制作总裁，与艾迪·墨菲续签了一份利润丰厚的合同，并与制片人唐·辛普森和杰里·布鲁克海默达成了长期协议。

paras.en: Paramount adopted a tentpole philosophy and finished first at the box office in 1986 and ’87, finding success with Top Gun, Crocodile Dundee, Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home, The Golden Child, Ferris Bueller’s Day Off and Children of a Lesser God in 1986 — when it had a 22 percent domestic market share — and Fatal Attraction, Beverly Hills Cop II, The Untouchables and Eddie Murphy Raw in 1987. (Other hits like 1988’s Coming to America, 1989’s Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade and 1990’s Ghost followed.)
paras.zh: 派拉蒙采取了主打理念，并在 1986 年和 87 年取得了票房冠军，并在 1986 年凭借《壮志凌云》、《鳄鱼邓迪》、《星际迷航 IV：归家之旅》、《金童》、《费里斯·布勒的休息日》和《小神的孩子》取得了成功，当时派拉蒙的国内市场份额为 22%，以及《致命诱惑》、《贝弗利山超级警探 II》、《铁面无私》和艾迪·墨菲1987 年的 Raw。（随后还有 1988 年的《来到美国》、1989 年的《印第安纳琼斯与最后的十字军》和 1990 年的《幽灵》等热门影片。）

paras.en: On the television side, the studio launched The Arsenio Hall Show, Entertainment Tonight, Cheers, Family Ties and Star Trek: The Next Generation under his watch.
paras.zh: 在电视方面，工作室在他的监督下推出了《阿森尼奥霍尔秀》、《今夜娱乐》、《干杯》、《家庭纽带》和《星际迷航：下一代》。

paras.en: In the wake of the expensive 1990 sequel misfires as The Two Jakes and The Godfather Part III, Davis gave Mancuso a new boss, producer Stanley R. Jaffe, who was installed as COO of Paramount Communications. Mancuso exited in March 1991 and filed a $45 million breach of contract lawsuit, eventually receiving a reported $20 million in a settlement.
paras.zh: 1990 年耗资巨大的续集《两个杰克》和《教父 III》惨遭失败后，戴维斯给曼库索任命了一位新老板，即制片人斯坦利·R·贾菲 (Stanley R. Jaffe)，他被任命为派拉蒙通讯公司 (Paramount Communications) 的首席运营官。曼库索于 1991 年 3 月退出，并提起了 4500 万美元的违约诉讼，据报道最终获得了 2000 万美元的和解金。

paras.en: After a couple years away, Mancuso returned to Hollywood in July 1993 when, in a deal orchestrated by CAA’s Michael Ovitz, he was named by Credit Lyonnais-owned MGM to replace Alan Ladd Jr. as chairman and CEO.
paras.zh: 离开几年后，曼库索于 1993 年 7 月重返好莱坞，在 CAA 的迈克尔·奥维茨 (Michael Ovitz) 精心策划的一项交易中，里昂信贷银行 (Credit Lyonnais) 旗下的米高梅 (MGM) 任命他接替小艾伦·拉德 (Alan Ladd Jr.) 担任董事长兼首席执行官。

paras.en: During his tenure, he restarted United Artists (it hadn’t released a film since Rocky Vin 1990) and hired former Warner Bros. exec John Calley to run it; acquired Orion Pictures, The Samuel Goldwyn Co. and assets from PolyGram Filmed Entertainment; and saw the release of such films as Stargate (1994), Get Shorty (1995), The Birdcage (1996) and three James Bond movies.
paras.zh: 在他任职期间，他重新启动了联合艺术家公司（自 1​​990 年《洛基·文》以来，该公司再没有发行过任何电影），并聘请了前华纳兄弟高管约翰·卡利来运营该公司；收购 Orion Pictures、The Samuel Goldwyn Co. 以及宝丽金电影娱乐公司的资产；并见证了《星际之门》（1994）、《矮个子》（1995）、《鸟笼》（1996）和三部詹姆斯·邦德电影的上映。

paras.en: Mancuso lasted until April 1999, when MGM owner Kirk Kerkorian replaced him with Alex Yemenidjian as chairman and Chris McGurk as vice chairman.
paras.zh: 曼库索一直任职到 1999 年 4 月，米高梅老板柯克·科科里安 (Kirk Kerkorian) 接替了他，亚历克斯·叶门尼吉安 (Alex Yemenidjian) 担任董事长，克里斯·麦格克 (Chris McGurk) 担任副董事长。

paras.en: He was born on July 25, 1933, in Buffalo. His father, George, worked for the post office for more than four decades, and his mother, Mary, was a homemaker.
paras.zh: 1933 年 7 月 25 日出生于布法罗。他的父亲乔治在邮局工作了四十多年，他的母亲玛丽是一名家庭主妇。

paras.en: Mancuso started out as a part-time usher at the 3,500-seat Lafayette Theatre, then was named assistant manager while still a student at the State University of New York at Buffalo. After college, he was hired in 1958 to buy films for the Basil Circuit, which owned the Lafayette and 49 other theaters in Western New York and Pennsylvania.
paras.zh: 曼库索一开始是在拥有 3,500 个座位的拉斐特剧院担任兼职引座员，后来在纽约州立大学布法罗分校就读时被任命为助理经理。大学毕业后，他于 1958 年受聘为巴兹尔电影院购买电影，该电影院拥有拉斐特剧院以及纽约西部和宾夕法尼亚州的其他 49 家剧院。

paras.en: In 1962, Mancuso joined Paramount as a film booker in its Buffalo office, and he rose through the ranks, becoming the Toronto-based vice president and general sales manager for Paramount Canada in 1970; manager of Paramount’s Western Division, based in Los Angeles, in 1976; and executive vice president of marketing and distribution for the entire company in 1979.
paras.zh: 1962 年，曼库索加入派拉蒙，在布法罗办事处担任电影预订员，随后晋升，于 1970 年成为派拉蒙加拿大公司驻多伦多的副总裁兼销售总经理； 1976 年，担任位于洛杉矶的派拉蒙西部部门经理； 1979 年担任整个公司的营销和分销执行副总裁。

paras.en: He was named president of the motion picture group in January 1983 — that was his first job being involved in the production of movies — and distinguished himself by using music videos to promote Flashdance and giving eventual best-picture winner Terms of Endearment a release during the then-sleepy Thanksgiving weekend.
paras.zh: 1983 年 1 月，他被任命为电影集团总裁——这是他第一份参与电影制作的工作——并通过利用音乐视频宣传 Flashdance 以及在当时沉睡的感恩节周末发行最终最佳影片奖得主《Terms of Endearment》而脱颖而出。

paras.en: In recent years, Mancuso held chairman posts at the Motion Picture & Television Fund and at the Geffen Playhouse.
paras.zh: 近年来，曼库索在电影电视基金会和格芬剧院担任主席职务。

paras.en: He also is survived by his wife, Fay, a fellow Buffalo native whom he married in 1957 (they first met when they were 12); their daughter Maria Mancuso, a fashion designer; daughter-in-law Kimberly Mancuso; grandchildren Noah Gersh, Emma Louise Ray, Giovanni Mancuso, Greta Harlan Gersh, Mila Rae Mancuso and James Lily Frances Gersh; grandson-in-law Eric David Ray; and great-granddaughter Lucca Frances Ray.
paras.zh: 他身后还有他的妻子费伊 (Fay)，她是布法罗人，两人于 1957 年结婚（他们第一次见面是在 12 岁时）。他们的女儿玛丽亚·曼库索 (Maria Mancuso) 是一名时装设计师；儿媳金伯利·曼库索；孙子诺亚·格什、艾玛·路易丝·雷、乔瓦尼·曼库索、格蕾塔·哈兰·格什、米拉·雷·曼库索和詹姆斯·莉莉·弗朗西斯·格什；孙女婿埃里克·大卫·雷；和曾孙女卢卡·弗朗西斯·雷。

paras.en: “When God created Frank Mancuso Sr., he broke the mold,” actor Andy Garcia said in a statement. “This is not just a saying but the absolute truth. Mr. Mancuso will forever be a beacon of class in our industry, the greatest example of warmth, integrity and generosity. I had the blessing of his friendship, support and guidance. I will miss him deeply and will continue to be inspired by his example. Rest in peace, ‘Pops.’”
paras.zh: “当上帝创造老弗兰克·曼库索时，他打破了模式，”演员安迪·加西亚在一份声明中说。 “这不仅仅是一句空话，而是绝对的真理。曼库索先生将永远成为我们行业的灯塔，是热情、正直和慷慨的最伟大典范。我得到了他的友谊、支持和指导的祝福。我将深深怀念他，并将继续受到他的榜样的启发。安息吧，‘爸爸’。”

articles.title: CBS News Sets Town Hall With J.D. Vance Ahead of Midterm Elections
articles.author: Kimberly Nordyke

paras.en: CBS News has scheduled a town hall with Vice President J.D. Vance ahead of the upcoming midterm elections.
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚广播公司新闻 (CBS News) 已安排在即将到来的中期选举之前与副总统 J.D. 万斯 (J.D. Vance) 举行市政厅会议。

paras.en: CBS Evening News anchor Tony Dokoupil will moderate the event in Michigan, where elections for key seats in the Senate and House are taking place. Michigan voters, who also will be electing their first new governor in eight years, will be in attendance from across the political spectrum. They will be able to ask questions and share their thoughts.
paras.zh: 哥伦比亚广播公司晚间新闻主播托尼·多库皮尔将主持这场在密歇根州举行的活动，那里正在举行参议院和众议院关键席位的选举。密歇根州选民也将选举八年来的第一位新州长，来自各个政治派别的选民都将出席。他们将能够提出问题并分享他们的想法。

paras.en: According to CBS, issues discussed during the “Things That Matter” town hall will include the Congressional elections, affordability, tariffs, immigration, healthcare, artificial intelligence, the war with Iran and the state of our democracy.
paras.zh: 据哥伦比亚广播公司报道，“重要的事情”市政厅讨论的问题将包括国会选举、负担能力、关税、移民、医疗保健、人工智能、与伊朗的战争以及我们的民主状况。

paras.en: The one-hour special will air at 8 p.m. ET/PT on CBS and stream on Paramount+.
paras.zh: 一小时特别节目将于晚上 8 点播出。 ET/PT 在 CBS 上播出并在 Paramount+ 上播出。

paras.en: The special is a big push for Dokoupil, given the primetime timeslot and the big get with Vance. it also continues CBS editor-in-chief Bari Weiss’ desire to hold more town halls and buzzy events that include newsmakers.
paras.zh: 鉴于黄金时段和万斯的巨大收获，这部特别节目对多库皮尔来说是一个巨大的推动。它还延续了哥伦比亚广播公司 (CBS) 主编巴里·韦斯 (Bari Weiss) 的愿望，即举办更多包括新闻人物在内的市政厅和热闹活动。

paras.en: Previous CBS News town halls have featured the Artemis astronauts, former U.S. Sen. Ben Sasse (April 26) and Maryland Gov. Wes Moore.
paras.zh: 此前，CBS 新闻市政厅曾以阿耳忒弥斯号宇航员、前美国参议员本·萨斯 (Ben Sasse)（4 月 26 日）和马里兰州州长韦斯·摩尔 (Wes Moore) 为主角。

paras.en: Alexander Weprin contributed to this report.
paras.zh: 亚历山大·韦普林 (Alexander Weprin) 对本报告做出了贡献。

articles.title: Glen Powell Says He Doesn’t Want to Talk Politics, Blames Paramount Marketing Cuts for ‘The Running Man’ Box Office Performance
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: Glen Powell isn’t interested in discussing politics.
paras.zh: 格伦·鲍威尔对讨论政治不感兴趣。

paras.en: In a new Esquire cover story, The Running Man actor said that despite his mother Cyndy Powell’s work in the U. S. Treasury Department under the Reagan administration, current events never made its way into his family’s dinner-table conversations. “Thank God,” he said.
paras.zh: 在《时尚先生》的新封面故事中，《奔跑吧兄弟》演员表示，尽管他的母亲辛迪·鲍威尔在里根政府时期的美国财政部工作，但时事从未进入他家人的餐桌谈话。 “感谢上帝，”他说。

paras.en: The actor said “over time” he has “realized that politics divide people. People trying to prove their point — for me, it’s the worst version of a conversation. I genuinely do not like the discourse. It’s not as healthy as it once was.”
paras.zh: 这位演员说，“随着时间的推移”，他“意识到政治分裂了人们。人们试图证明自己的观点——对我来说，这是最糟糕的对话版本。我真的不喜欢这种对话。它不像以前那么健康了。”

paras.en: Powell said that engaging in political conversations was “not presently possible.” He added, “I applaud people for jumping into those things and fighting for what they believe in. If I were a political person, I would be talking about it. For me, my calling is elsewhere.”
paras.zh: 鲍威尔表示，参与政治对话“目前不可能”。他补充道，“我赞扬人们投入这些事情并为他们的信仰而奋斗。如果我是一名政治人物，我会谈论它。对我来说，我的使命在别处。”

paras.en: The Top Gun: Maverick is not the only celebrity asserting their disinterest in speaking about politics. Powell’s Anyone But You co-star Sydney Sweeney said she has “never been here to talk about politics” in a cover interview with Cosmopolitan in January following the fallout from her viral American Eagle jeans ad.
paras.zh: 《壮志凌云：特立独行者》并不是唯一一个声称对谈论政治不感兴趣的名人。鲍威尔在《除你之外的任何人》中的联合主演西德尼·斯威尼 (Sydney Sweeney) 在 1 月份接受 Cosmopolitan 封面采访时表示，在她的 American Eagle 牛仔裤广告走红后，她“从来没有来这里谈论过政治”。

paras.en: Sweeney also said she doesn’t anticipate she will confirm her political beliefs: “I’m not a political person. I’m in the arts. I’m not here to speak on politics. That’s not an area I’ve ever even imagined getting into. It’s not why I became who I am. I became an actor because I like to tell stories, but I don’t believe in hate in any form. I believe we should all love each other and have respect and understanding for one another.”
paras.zh: 斯威尼还表示，她并不认为自己会证实自己的政治信仰：“我不是一个政治人物。我从事艺术工作。我不是来谈论政治的。这不是我曾经想象过的领域。这不是我成为现在的样子的原因。我成为一名演员是因为我喜欢讲故事，但我不相信任何形式的仇恨。我相信我们都应该彼此相爱，互相尊重和理解。”

paras.en: Last November, Jennifer Lawrence questioned if she should speak out against Trump after being vocal about her political stance during his first term.
paras.zh: 去年11月，詹妮弗·劳伦斯在特朗普第一个任期内直言不讳地表达了自己的政治立场后，质疑她是否应该公开反对特朗普。

paras.en: “I don’t really know if I should,” Lawrence told The New York Times on its The Interview podcast about speaking out against Trump and politics. “During the first Trump administration, I felt like I was running around like a chicken with my head cut off. But as we’ve learned, election after election, celebrities do not make a difference whatsoever on who people vote for. So then what am I doing? I’m just sharing my opinion on something that’s going to add fuel to a fire that’s ripping the country apart. We are so divided.”
paras.zh: “我真的不知道我是否应该这样做，”劳伦斯在《纽约时报》采访播客中谈到公开反对特朗普和政治时说道。 “在特朗普第一届政府期间，我感觉自己像一只被砍掉头的鸡一样到处乱跑。但正如我们所知，一次又一次的选举，名人对人们投票给谁没有任何影响。那么我在做什么呢？我只是在分享我的观点，这会火上浇油，导致国家分裂。我们的分歧很大。”

paras.en: Elsewhere in the profile, Powell addressed The Running Man‘s weak box office performance. “They let go of an entire marketing department a month before our movie came out in the middle of a merger,” he said of Paramount, the studio behind the film.
paras.zh: 在简介的其他地方，鲍威尔谈到了《奔跑吧兄弟》票房表现不佳的问题。 “在我们的电影上映前一个月，他们在合并过程中解雇了整个营销部门，”他谈到电影背后的派拉蒙工作室时说道。

paras.en: The Running Man released on Nov. 14, 2025; on Oct. 29, The Hollywood Reporter reported that Paramount began series of staff cuts, resulting in about 1,000 jobs being impacted.
paras.zh: 《跑男》于 2025 年 11 月 14 日上映； 10月29日，《好莱坞报道》报道称，派拉蒙开始进行一系列裁员，导致约1000个工作岗位受到影响。

paras.en: THR reached out to Paramount for comment, but did not hear back by the time of publication.
paras.zh: 《好莱坞报道》联系派拉蒙请其置评，但截至发稿时尚未收到回复。

articles.title: Supertanker chartered from Gulf Coast to China for $76 million, 10 times higher than pre-war level

paras.en: A supertanker was recently chartered to sail from the U.S. Gulf Coast to China for $76 million, a source familiar told CNBC, as shipping costs soar globally due to the crisis in the Middle East.
paras.zh: 一位知情人士向 CNBC 透露，由于中东危机导致全球航运成本飙升，最近一艘超级油轮以 7600 万美元的价格租用，从美国墨西哥湾沿岸驶往中国。

paras.en: The Alexandros was chartered by the trading firm Trafigura and is expected to load around Nov. 19, the source said. A normal rate for the route based on pre-war levels would be $7 million to $10 million.
paras.zh: 消息人士称，“Alexandros”号由贸易公司托克 (Trafigura) 租用，预计将于 11 月 19 日左右装船。根据战前水平，该路线的正常费率为 700 万至 1000 万美元。

paras.en: The cost of the journey comes to $38 per barrel of oil assuming the tanker holds 2 million barrels. Shipping costs have exploded as the war in the Persian Gulf has led to a shortage of available tankers.
paras.zh: 假设油轮载有 200 万桶石油，这一旅程的成本为每桶石油 38 美元。由于波斯湾战争导致可用油轮短缺，运输成本激增。

paras.en: The Middle East producers are using a shuttle system to export oil through the Strait of Hormuz. A loaded tanker crosses the strait and then loads the oil onto another ship in the Gulf of Oman that takes the cargo to Asia.
paras.zh: 中东生产商正在使用航天飞机系统通过霍尔木兹海峡出口石油。一艘满载的油轮穿过海峡，然后将石油装载到阿曼湾的另一艘船上，将货物运往亚洲。

paras.en: This system reduces the exposure to Iranian attack and has led to a rebound of crude exports through Hormuz. But it also requires a lot more ships to get the oil out of the Gulf.
paras.zh: 该系统减少了遭受伊朗袭击的风险，并导致霍尔木兹原油出口反弹。但也需要更多的船只将石油运出海湾。

articles.title: Microsoft to sell $2,599 Surface Laptop Ultra containing Nvidia AI chip

paras.en: Microsoft said its new laptop containing an Nvidia AI chip will start at $2,599, as the software maker tries to bring more artificial intelligence capabilities to its consumer devices.
paras.zh: 微软表示，其搭载 Nvidia AI 芯片的新款笔记本电脑起价为 2,599 美元，该软件制造商试图为其消费设备带来更多人工智能功能。

paras.en: The Surface Laptop Ultra is now available on preorder and will begin shipping on Oct. 16, Pavan Davuluri, Microsoft's executive vice president of Windows and devices, said at a company event in San Francisco on Wednesday. The computer has the world's first magnetic USB-C port, similar to Apple's MagSafe charging connector, along with two other standard USB-C ports, Microsoft said in a blog post.
paras.zh: 微软 Windows 和设备执行副总裁 Pavan Davuluri 周三在旧金山举行的一次公司活动上表示，Surface Laptop Ultra 现已开始接受预订，并将于 10 月 16 日开始发货。微软在博客文章中表示，该电脑拥有世界上第一个磁性 USB-C 端口，类似于苹果的 MagSafe 充电连接器，以及另外两个标准 USB-C 端口。

paras.en: While Microsoft Windows is the most popular operating system for PCs, the company isn't among the top six PC vendors in terms of unit shipments, according to an estimate from researcher Gartner. As the AI boom matures and chip technology advances, tech giants including Microsoft, Apple and Google are aiming to allow users to run more AI workloads from their devices rather than relying on the cloud.
paras.zh: 根据研究机构 Gartner 的估计，虽然 Microsoft Windows 是最流行的 PC 操作系统，但就出货量而言，该公司并未跻身前六名 PC 供应商之列。随着人工智能热潮的成熟和芯片技术的进步，微软、苹果和谷歌等科技巨头的目标是让用户从他们的设备上运行更多的人工智能工作负载，而不是依赖云。

paras.en: Users can install and run a variety of models on the new laptop without having to worry about racking up high monthly bills. Microsoft first talked about the Surface Laptop Ultra in May, but is just now providing specifics.
paras.zh: 用户可以在新笔记本电脑上安装和运行各种型号，而不必担心每月收取高额账单。微软于 5 月份首次谈论 Surface Laptop Ultra，但现在才提供具体细节。

paras.en: "Microsoft might get me back to Windows," Max Weinbach, an analyst at Creative Strategies, wrote on X after the announcement.
paras.zh: Creative Strategies 分析师马克斯·温巴赫 (Max Weinbach) 在宣布这一消息后在 X 上写道：“微软可能会让我回到 Windows。”

paras.en: Davuluri also said that Meta will introduce a version of its popular Muse AI agent for Windows, capitalizing on the surging popularity of the personal agent, which has jumped to the top of Apple's App store, surpassing ChatGPT.
paras.zh: Davuluri 还表示，Meta 将推出其流行的 Windows 版 Muse AI 代理，利用个人代理的高涨人气，该代理已跃居苹果应用商店榜首，超越 ChatGPT。

paras.en: Microsoft is still trying to solidify its role as a key player in AI. The company offers its own AI models, but they're less popular than leading models from OpenAI and Anthropic and aren't at the forefront in terms of performance, according to one benchmark. Developers are more likely to have used alternatives, according to a recent survey.
paras.zh: 微软仍在努力巩固其作为人工智能领域关键参与者的角色。该公司提供自己的人工智能模型，但根据一项基准测试，它们不如 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的领先模型受欢迎，而且在性能方面并不处于领先地位。根据最近的一项调查，开发商更有可能使用替代方案。

paras.en: This isn't the first time Microsoft has sought to use the AI boom as a way to boost sales of its devices.
paras.zh: 这并不是微软第一次寻求利用人工智能热潮来提高其设备的销量。

paras.en: In 2024, the company introduced the Copilot+ PC standard, requiring the inclusion of neural processing units that ensure a minimum level of AI performance, along with compliant Surface computers. But Microsoft has since "simplified product naming to lead with the Surface brand, while continuing to deliver premium hardware and hybrid AI experiences," a spokesperson said.
paras.zh: 2024 年，该公司推出了 Copilot+ PC 标准，要求包含可确保最低水平 AI 性能的神经处理单元以及兼容的 Surface 计算机。但微软发言人表示，自此之后，微软“简化了产品命名，以 Surface 品牌为主导，同时继续提供优质硬件和混合人工智能体验”。

paras.en: The new device can contain up to 128 gigabytes of unified memory and supply up to one petaflop of computing power. The Blackwell RTX Spark GPU inside the computer has as much processing power as Nvidia's DGX-1 data center server from 2016, which cost $250 million, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said at Wednesday's event.
paras.zh: 新设备可包含高达 128 GB 的统一内存，并提供高达 1 petaflop 的计算能力。 Nvidia 首席执行官 Jensen Huang 在周三的活动中表示，计算机内的 Blackwell RTX Spark GPU 的处理能力与 Nvidia 2016 年的 DGX-1 数据中心服务器相当，后者耗资 2.5 亿美元。

paras.en: A presenter showed how apps on the Surface Laptop Ultra can route some AI coding requests run on the computer's local GPU, displaying a green leaf icon, and others to the cloud. Through Windows 11, developers can confine coding agents to Microsoft Execution Containers that will prevent unwanted system access.
paras.zh: 演示者展示了 Surface Laptop Ultra 上的应用程序如何将在计算机本地 GPU 上运行的一些 AI 编码请求（显示绿叶图标）和其他请求路由到云端。通过 Windows 11，开发人员可以将编码代理限制在 Microsoft 执行容器中，以防止不必要的系统访问。

paras.en: Microsoft is updating its Windows 11 device setup experience to help people get started quickly with open-source OpenClaw AI agent software.
paras.zh: Microsoft 正在更新其 Windows 11 设备设置体验，以帮助人们快速开始使用开源 OpenClaw AI 代理软件。

paras.en: Microsoft has been releasing its own computers since 2012, and CEO Satya Nadella indicated on Tuesday that the company's position in the market is evolving.
paras.zh: 微软自 2012 年以来一直在发布自己的电脑，首席执行官萨蒂亚·纳德拉 (Satya Nadella) 周二表示，该公司在市场上的地位正在演变。

paras.en: "I think today is the day we'll start talking and thinking about the frontier ecosystem taking maybe slightly different contours two years from now, five years from now, 10 years from now," Nadella said at the event. "That classic edge that distributed computing will always remain distributed will be more true."
paras.zh: 纳德拉在活动中表示：“我认为今天是我们开始讨论和思考前沿生态系统的一天，两年后、五年后、十年后，前沿生态系统的轮廓可能会略有不同。” “分布式计算将始终保持分布式这一经典优势将更加真实。”

articles.title: Trump’s diesel order exposes White House limits to counter surging fuel prices

paras.en: Truckers likely won't see much in the way of relief from President Donald Trump's executive order that allows them to use off-road diesel fuel on America's highways without federal penalties, analysts say.
paras.zh: 分析人士表示，唐纳德·特朗普总统的行政命令允许卡车司机在美国高速公路上使用越野柴油而不受联邦处罚，卡车司机可能不会看到太大的缓解。

paras.en: Off-road diesel is exempt from federal and state excise taxes because it is used for construction and farm equipment, railways and to heat homes. It is dyed red to differentiate it from taxed on-road diesel, but is otherwise the same fuel.
paras.zh: 非公路柴油可免征联邦和州消费税，因为它用于建筑和农用设备、铁路以及家庭供暖。它被染成红色，以区别于征税的道路柴油，但在其他方面是相同的燃料。

paras.en: The federal government charges an excise tax of 24.4 cents per gallon for on-road diesel. In theory, Trump's order spares truckers the tax by allowing them to use red-dyed fuel on the highway, without worrying that the federal government will impose penalties.
paras.zh: 联邦政府对道路柴油征收每加仑 24.4 美分的消费税。从理论上讲，特朗普的命令允许卡车司机在高速公路上使用红色燃料，从而免除了他们的税收，而不必担心联邦政府会施加处罚。

paras.en: But the president's action only defers the actual tax payment itself until the end of the year, while calling on the Treasury Secretary to look for ways to eliminate the deferred obligation altogether.
paras.zh: 但总统的行动只是将实际纳税本身推迟到年底，同时呼吁财政部长寻找完全消除递延义务的方法。

paras.en: "While it might be deferred, it may not disappear entirely," said Andy Lipow, president of Lipow Oil Associates. "Maybe you save a little bit of money up front, but you might have to pay it to the government later."
paras.zh: Lipow Oil Associates 总裁安迪·利波 (Andy Lipow) 表示：“虽然它可能会被推迟，但它可能不会完全消失。” “也许你可以先存一点钱，但以后可能需要向政府支付。”

paras.en: Trump cannot defer state excise taxes, which can be higher than the federal obligation, at a national average of 35.5 cents per gallon. Some states have taken independent action to give relief to diesel users.
paras.zh: 特朗普不能推迟州消费税，该税可能高于联邦义务，全国平均税率为每加仑 35.5 美分。一些州已采取独立行动，为柴油用户提供救济。

paras.en: Although Trump is waiving federal penalties for using off-road diesel on highways, states in principle could enforce their local laws prohibiting the red-dyed fuel on the road.
paras.zh: 尽管特朗普免除了对在高速公路上使用越野柴油的联邦处罚，但各州原则上可以执行当地法律，禁止在道路上使用红色燃料。

paras.en: "It's not like every state trooper is going to pull over the truck and look at your diesel fuel, but you're a trucker — do you need that aggravation?" Lipow said.
paras.zh: “并不是每个州警都会把卡车停下来检查你的柴油，但你是一名卡车司机——你需要这么恼怒吗？”利波说道。

paras.en: Trump's executive order comes as he faces political pressure to take action on diesel prices ahead of midterm elections on Nov. 3, when Republicans face competitive races in farm states such as Iowa. Retail diesel prices hit a record high in September and currently average $6.30 a gallon nationally, according to AAA.
paras.zh: 特朗普发布行政命令之际，他面临着在 11 月 3 日中期选举之前对柴油价格采取行动的政治压力，届时共和党将在爱荷华州等农业州面临激烈的竞选。根据 AAA 的数据，9 月份柴油零售价格创下历史新高，目前全国平均柴油价格为每加仑 6.30 美元。

paras.en: The president flirted with a diesel export ban last month but ultimately abandoned the idea, telling reporters Friday that "it was never really on the table." The oil industry and big business groups were staunchly opposed. Trump publicly voiced concerns that a diesel export ban would raise gasoline prices.
paras.zh: 总统上个月曾考虑实施柴油出口禁令，但最终放弃了这个想法，周五告诉记者“它从未真正提上台面”。石油工业和大企业集团坚决反对。特朗普公开表达了对柴油出口禁令将提高汽油价格的担忧。

paras.en: Diesel futures dropped overnight Monday into Tuesday morning after Trump's executive order, but ultimately turned higher. Futures were up more than 1% Wednesday.
paras.zh: 在特朗普发布行政命令后，柴油期货周一至周二上午隔夜下跌，但最终走高。周三期货上涨超过 1%。

paras.en: "What it shows you is there are no good options for the administration or any administration to bring down the price of fuel, because the bottleneck is refineries," Lipow said.
paras.zh: “这表明政府或任何政府都没有好的选择来降低燃料价格，因为瓶颈在于炼油厂，”利波说。

paras.en: Diesel prices are high around the world because Ukraine is bombarding Russian refineries and strikes by Iran and its allies have taken capacity offline in the Middle East.
paras.zh: 由于乌克兰轰炸俄罗斯炼油厂，以及伊朗及其盟国的罢工导致中东产能停产，全球柴油价格居高不下。

paras.en: G7 countries led by France, facing pressure from the Trump administration, agreed Friday to release diesel stocks, though it's unclear in what quantities.
paras.zh: 以法国为首的七国集团国家面临特朗普政府的压力，周五同意释放柴油库存，但具体数量尚不清楚。

paras.en: "They're pulling every every lever they can," Jeff Currie, CEO of Real Macro and a senior advisor at Carlyle, told CNBC's "Squawk Box" on Tuesday.
paras.zh: Real Macro 首席执行官兼凯雷高级顾问杰夫·柯里 (Jeff Currie) 周二对 CNBC 的“Squawk Box”节目表示：“他们正在竭尽全力。”

paras.en: But Trump's executive order allowing red-dyed diesel on the road "won't have a profound impact" on fuel prices, Currie said.
paras.zh: 但柯里表示，特朗普允许红色柴油上路的行政命令“不会对燃油价格产生深远影响”。

paras.en: There is one action the administration could take that would be effective, Lipow said. "End the conflict."
paras.zh: 利波说，政府可以采取一项有效的行动。 “结束冲突。”

paras.en: "The Strait [of Hormuz] reopens, oil flows, those refineries in the Middle East start kicking up runs, more refined products make it to the market," the analyst said. "The market will react to that."
paras.zh: 这位分析师表示：“霍尔木兹海峡重新开放，石油流动，中东的炼油厂开始开工，更多的精炼产品进入市场。” “市场将会对此做出反应。”

articles.title: What is AI model distillation, and why is it so hard to stop?

paras.en: To make grain-based liquor, you heat a fermented mash in a still until alcohol-rich vapor rises and then cool it back into a stronger liquid. Chemists and whiskey makers know this as distillation. Artificial intelligence developers have borrowed the word to describe boiling down a big AI model into a smaller one—and lately the biggest AI companies say that rivals have been distilling like bootleggers.
paras.zh: 为了酿造谷物酒，您需要在蒸馏器中加热发酵的麦芽浆，直到富含酒精的蒸气上升，然后将其冷却回更浓的液体。化学家和威士忌制造商将其称为蒸馏。人工智能开发人员借用这个词来形容将大型人工智能模型精简为较小的模型——最近，最大的人工智能公司表示，竞争对手一直在像盗版者一样进行提炼。

paras.en: In September Anthropic and OpenAI each detailed how they caught and killed campaigns to distill their flagship models—that is, to extract enough information from the models to train new models that mimic the originals at a fraction of the size and cost.
paras.zh: 9 月，Anthropic 和 OpenAI 各自详细介绍了他们如何抓住并扼杀提炼其旗舰模型的活动，即从模型中提取足够的信息来训练模仿原始模型的新模型，而其规模和成本却只有一小部分。

paras.en: Distillation has become a sore spot for American AI companies as they try to justify high valuations and fight off competition from each other and open-source alternatives. If, say, a Chinese model developer can piggyback on all the money and computing power those companies have invested, the incentive to keep making new models starts to evaporate.
paras.zh: 蒸馏已成为美国人工智能公司的痛处，因为它们试图证明高估值的合理性，并对抗彼此和开源替代品的竞争。比如说，如果中国模型开发商能够利用这些公司投资的所有资金和计算能力，那么继续制作新模型的动力就会开始消失。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: And no one expects distillation to stop any time soon—so we asked the researchers who study it to explain the situation.
paras.zh: 没有人预计蒸馏会很快停止，因此我们请研究它的研究人员解释这一情况。

paras.en: Just as a still concentrates a large batch of weak liquid into a smaller batch of strong stuff, AI distillation condenses a big model into a smaller one that, ideally, acts like the original. The process starts with the existing large model, called the teacher. Developers prompt the teacher many times over and then feed its responses into the new model, called the student, to train the latter.
paras.zh: 就像蒸馏器将大量稀液体浓缩成一小批浓液体一样，人工智能蒸馏将一个大模型浓缩成一个较小的模型，理想情况下，它的作用与原始模型一样。该过程从现有的大型模型（称为教师）开始。开发人员多次提示老师，然后将其响应输入到称为学生的新模型中，以训练后者。

paras.en: In a way, every response contains information about what the teacher learned during training, so that knowledge passes to the student without going through the process of collecting data, finding patterns in those data and getting human feedback. Distillation lets someone reverse engineer an AI model just by using it and watching its responses.
paras.zh: 在某种程度上，每个响应都包含有关教师在培训期间学到的内容的信息，因此知识可以传递给学生，而无需经历收集数据、查找这些数据中的模式和获取人类反馈的过程。蒸馏让人们只需使用它并观察其响应即可对人工智能模型进行逆向工程。

paras.en: It helps that AI models tend to give away more than just their final answers. “Oftentimes the teacher model doesn’t just give you the label, but it actually gives you more fine-grained information,” says Yevgeniy Vorobeychik, a professor of computer science at Washington University in St. Louis. That could include the odds a model assigns to each possible response or, as in the case OpenAI described, an encrypted record of the step-by-step reasoning its more powerful models work through before they answer.
paras.zh: 人工智能模型往往会给出的不仅仅是最终答案，这一点很有帮助。圣路易斯华盛顿大学计算机科学教授叶夫根尼·沃罗贝奇克 (Yevgeniy Vorobeychik) 表示：“教师模型通常不仅仅为您提供标签，而且实际上为您提供更细粒度的信息。”这可能包括模型分配给每个可能响应的几率，或者如 OpenAI 所描述的情况那样，包括其更强大的模型在回答之前逐步推理的加密记录。

paras.en: Plenty of distillation is aboveboard. Smaller models let developers get more for less. In fact, the concept predates large language models (LLMs); by the 2000s, researchers were studying it as a way to increase efficiency for neural networks. “We cared about making it smaller, easier to use, faster to apply,” says Alexandru Niculescu-Mizil, a machine learning researcher at Qube Research & Technologies, who cowrote an early paper on the idea in 2006.
paras.zh: 大量的蒸馏是光明正大的。较小的模型可以让开发人员以更少的成本获得更多的成果。事实上，这个概念早于大型语言模型（LLM）。到了 2000 年代，研究人员开始研究它作为提高神经网络效率的一种方法。 Qube Research & Technologies 的机器学习研究员 Alexandru Niculescu-Mizil 表示：“我们希望使其更小、更易于使用、应用更快。”他于 2006 年与他人共同撰写了一篇关于这一想法的早期论文。

paras.en: Distilling someone else’s model is another matter. The term first caught mainstream attention in early 2025, when DeepSeek, then a little-known Chinese start-up, released a reasoning model, called R1, that it said it had trained for less than $300,000—a fraction of what American labs had spent. Allegations quickly emerged that DeepSeek had trained R1 in part on responses extracted from OpenAI’s models.
paras.zh: 提炼别人的模型是另一回事。这个术语首次引起主流关注是在 2025 年初，当时一家名不见经传的中国初创公司 DeepSeek 发布了一款名为 R1 的推理模型，据称该模型的训练成本不到 30 万美元——只是美国实验室花费的一小部分。很快就有指控称 DeepSeek 部分地根据从 OpenAI 模型中提取的响应来训练 R1。

paras.en: These days the word is generally associated with accusations of model theft, mostly aimed at Chinese developers such as DeepSeek and Moonshot AI, the maker of Kimi. In their September reports, Anthropic and OpenAI both blamed labs based in China for the recent distillation campaigns they caught, calling the activity “illicit” and “unauthorized.” DeepSeek and Moonshot AI have both fended off these accusations in the past. Of course, Anthropic and OpenAI have themselves been accused of training their models on data obtained without authorization from all over the internet.
paras.zh: 如今，这个词通常与模型盗窃的指控联系在一起，主要针对 DeepSeek 和 Kimi 的制造商 Moonshot AI 等中国开发商。 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 在 9 月份的报告中都将最近发现的蒸馏活动归咎于中国实验室，称该活动“非法”且“未经授权”。 DeepSeek 和 Moonshot AI 过去都曾驳斥过这些指控。当然，Anthropic 和 OpenAI 本身也被指控利用未经授权从互联网上获得的数据来训练他们的模型。

paras.en: Still, though the companies also cast distillation as a security risk, their most obvious interest in stopping it is protecting their competitive advantage. “The text that it produces in response to your prompt is being stolen by some rival companies,” says Alexander Panfilov, a Ph.D. student at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems in Germany. “But on a conceptual level, what you are stealing [are] capabilities.”
paras.zh: 尽管如此，尽管这些公司也将蒸馏视为一种安全风险，但他们阻止蒸馏的最明显利益是保护自己的竞争优势。 “它根据你的提示生成的文本正在被一些竞争对手公司窃取，”博士亚历山大·潘菲洛夫 (Alexander Panfilov) 说。德国马克斯·普朗克智能系统研究所的学生。 “但在概念层面上，你窃取的是能力。”

paras.en: In general, distillation is done by collecting thousands and thousands of AI responses to different kinds of queries. Those prompts and responses then become training data for the student, usually through a process called supervised fine-tuning, which treats the teacher’s answers as targets the student should try to emulate. Over many rounds, training nudges the student’s internal settings, called weights, so that its answers more closely match the teacher’s.
paras.zh: 一般来说，蒸馏是通过收集成千上万的人工智能对不同类型查询的响应来完成的。这些提示和响应通常会通过一个称为监督微调的过程成为学生的训练数据，该过程将教师的答案视为学生应该尝试模仿的目标。在多轮训练中，训练会推动学生的内部设置（称为权重），使其答案更接近老师的答案。

paras.en: The key is getting those data. Anthropic and OpenAI have detailed several creative methods they believe attackers used to do so. According to Anthropic, some labs routed their own customers’ prompts to Claude and then saved Claude’s responses to train their own models. The company also said that distillers try to obscure where they are located. OpenAI, meanwhile, said distillers tried to get at its models’ hidden reasoning by “copying encrypted reasoning from one conversation and asking a model in another conversation to decrypt” it.
paras.zh: 关键是获取这些数据。 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 详细介绍了他们认为攻击者常用的几种创造性方法。据 Anthropic 称，一些实验室将自己客户的提示发送给克劳德，然后保存克劳德的回答来训练自己的模型。该公司还表示，酿酒厂试图掩盖其所在地。与此同时，OpenAI 表示，蒸馏器试图通过“复制一个对话中的加密推理并要求另一个对话中的模型解密”来了解其模型的隐藏推理。

paras.en: Panfilov was co-lead author of a preprint paper detailing that kind of attack, and OpenAI credited him and his colleagues with bringing the attacks to the company’s attention. In this case, the goal was to distill how the models reason, or generate longer responses in order to solve hard problems step-by-step. Panfilov and his colleagues called their project “Stolen Thoughts,” a sign of how tightly the concept has become intertwined with thievery.
paras.zh: 潘菲洛夫是一篇预印本论文的共同主要作者，该论文详细介绍了此类攻击，OpenAI 称赞他和他的同事让公司注意到了这些攻击。在这种情况下，目标是提炼模型的推理方式，或生成更长的响应，以便逐步解决难题。潘菲洛夫和他的同事将他们的项目称为“被盗的想法”，这表明这个概念与盗窃紧密地交织在一起。

paras.en: The AI companies are hesitant to reveal exactly how they caught these latest attempts because doing so would show the next distiller what to avoid. Broadly, though, the firms seem to have watched for accounts prompting their models in suspicious ways, whether by firing off lots of prompts in a short time or by asking telltale kinds of questions. Anthropic, for instance, said that, from May to July, it observed more than 151 million exchanges between Claude and accounts tied to Chinese e-commerce giant Alibaba, which also makes the Qwen family of AI models.
paras.zh: 人工智能公司不愿透露他们是如何捕捉到这些最新尝试的，因为这样做会告诉下一个蒸馏器应该避免什么。不过，总体而言，这些公司似乎一直在关注以可疑方式提示其模型的账户，无论是在短时间内发出大量提示，还是提出泄露信息的问题。例如，Anthropic 表示，从 5 月到 7 月，它观察到 Claude 与中国电子商务巨头阿里巴巴相关账户之间的交易次数超过 1.51 亿次，阿里巴巴也生产 Qwen 系列人工智能模型。

paras.en: Panfilov says the attack he studied is easy to detect, but he worries that cleverer ones can’t be spotted without trampling everyone’s privacy. “I don’t have a good idea how [AI companies] would do it, especially given that they claim this zero data retention policy,” he says, referring to arrangements under which the companies don’t store some customers’ prompts and responses.
paras.zh: 潘菲洛夫表示，他研究的攻击很容易被发现，但他担心，如果不侵犯每个人的隐私，就无法发现更聪明的攻击。他说：“我不太清楚（人工智能公司）会如何做到这一点，特别是考虑到他们声称实行零数据保留政策。”他指的是这些公司不存储某些客户的提示和回复的安排。

paras.en: Both OpenAI and Anthropic have warned that the distillers’ methods will only get more sophisticated, given how valuable distillation can be.
paras.zh: OpenAI 和 Anthropic 都警告说，考虑到蒸馏的价值，蒸馏器的方法只会变得更加复杂。

paras.en: The trouble is that the very qualities that make AI models informative and useful also make them good to train on. So attempts to make a model harder to distill may also make it worse. Over the summer, Vorobeychik and his colleagues found that a model’s reasoning can be rewritten so that it will make poor training material for a copycat, without making the model’s answers any less accurate. They also found that the rewritten reasoning was harder for people to follow, however. “Just by virtue of the fact that they’re harder to read for the LLM to train, it’s also harder for humans to digest,” Vorobeychik says. That’s an unwelcome trade for a technology whose output already takes flak for being hard to parse.
paras.zh: 问题在于，人工智能模型具有信息丰富性和实用性的特质也使得它们很适合训练。因此，尝试让模型更难提炼也可能会让情况变得更糟。今年夏天，沃罗贝奇克和他的同事发现模型的推理可以被重写，这样它就可以成为模仿者的糟糕培训材料，同时又不会降低模型答案的准确性。然而，他们还发现，重写后的推理更难让人理解。 “由于它们更难阅读以供法学硕士培训，因此人类也更难消化，”沃罗贝奇克说。对于一项技术来说，这是一项不受欢迎的交易，因为该技术的输出已经因难以解析而受到批评。

paras.en: Panfilov also notes that distillation can be done in pieces in which “each query in itself is benign.” That would make it even harder to distinguish someone prompting a model for ordinary use from someone trying to build a model of their own. AI companies will have to balance protecting their models’ capabilities against actually flexing them for the public, which is, after all, what they’re selling.
paras.zh: 潘菲洛夫还指出，蒸馏可以分块进行，其中“每个查询本身都是良性的”。这将使区分促使模型用于普通用途的人和试图构建自己的模型的人变得更加困难。人工智能公司必须在保护其模型的功能与实际向公众展示它们之间取得平衡，毕竟，这才是他们所销售的。

paras.en: All this suggests that stopping illicit distillation will mean finding new attacks before stamping them out. The labs, in effect, are playing revenuers, the liquor-tax agents who once hunted down and dismantled illegal stills. But as fears about distillation intertwine with fears about Chinese AI capabilities more broadly, busting stills one at a time may not be enough to put the American AI industry at ease.
paras.zh: 所有这些都表明，停止非法蒸馏将意味着在消灭新的攻击之前发现它们。事实上，这些实验室正在扮演收税者的角色，他们是曾经追捕并拆除非法蒸馏器的酒类税代理人。但随着对蒸馏的担忧与对中国人工智能能力的更广泛担忧交织在一起，一次破坏一张静态图片可能不足以让美国人工智能行业放心。

articles.title: Why does weed cause anxiety? A new brain study investigates cannabis paranoia

paras.en: Whether you are smoking or eating it, marijuana can be relaxing—or it can cause feelings of anxiety, panic and paranoia. But despite the prevalence of these unnerving experiences—studies suggest frequent cannabis use is associated with higher odds of anxiety—scientists have little understanding as to why they occur.
paras.zh: 无论您是吸食还是吸食大麻，大麻都可以让人放松，但也可能引起焦虑、恐慌和偏执的感觉。尽管这些令人不安的经历很普遍——研究表明频繁吸食大麻与更高的焦虑几率有关——但科学家们对它们发生的原因知之甚少。

paras.en: “From a biological perspective, we really know almost nothing,” says Sachin Patel, a neuroscientist at Northwestern University.
paras.zh: “从生物学的角度来看，我们实际上几乎一无所知，”西北大学的神经科学家萨钦·帕特尔说。

paras.en: In a bid to understand why one of the world’s most popular drugs summons such negative emotions, Patel and his colleagues investigated its effect on mice. The team’s findings, published last week in Nature Communications, reveal that, when given such a drug, rodents suffer adverse reactions similar to the paranoia human cannabis users feel. The effect is driven by a specific group of neurons in the central amygdala, a brain region that processes fear and anxiety.
paras.zh: 为了了解为什么世界上最受欢迎的药物之一会引起如此负面的情绪，帕特尔和他的同事研究了它对老鼠的影响。该研究小组上周发表在《自然通讯》上的研究结果表明，当给予这种药物时，啮齿类动物会出现类似于人类大麻使用者偏执的不良反应。这种效应是由杏仁核中央的一组特定神经元驱动的，杏仁核是处理恐惧和焦虑的大脑区域。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: The researchers injected mice with varying doses of CP55940, a synthetic cannabinoid that mimics the effects of tetrahydrocannabinol, or TCH, the main psychoactive compound in weed. Then they placed the mice in a cage with a petri dish full of fox urine. As expected, the animals became anxious, either fleeing the threatening odor or freezing in place. These responses were more extreme in mice who received larger doses—a relatable result if you’ve ever found yourself peering suspiciously through the living room blinds after one toke too many.
paras.zh: 研究人员给小鼠注射了不同剂量的 CP55940，这是一种合成大麻素，可以模仿四氢大麻酚（TCH）的作用，TCH 是杂草中主要的精神活性化合物。然后他们将小鼠放入装有装满狐狸尿液的培养皿的笼子中。正如预期的那样，动物们变得焦虑起来，要么逃离威胁性的气味，要么僵在原地。这些反应在接受较大剂量的老鼠中更为极端——如果你发现自己在服用过多的老鼠后，发现自己透过客厅的百叶窗怀疑地凝视着，那么这个结果是相关的。

paras.en: To tease out a connection between the animals’ behavior and their brain activity, the researchers turned to the central amygdala, which past research has shown to play a role in threat responses. Looking through small microscopes implanted in the mice’s heads, Patel’s team zoomed in on a particular subset of brain cells, called somatostatin neurons, as the animals reacted to the fox urine scent. “The take-home,” Patel says, “was that those cells were hyperactive when combining cannabinoids with the stress exposure.”
paras.zh: 为了弄清楚动物的行为和大脑活动之间的联系，研究人员转向中央杏仁核，过去的研究表明杏仁核在威胁反应中发挥着作用。通过植入小鼠头部的小型显微镜，帕特尔的团队放大了一个特定的脑细胞子集，称为生长抑素神经元，当动物对狐狸尿液的气味做出反应时。 “结果是，”帕特尔说，“当大麻素与压力暴露相结合时，这些细胞会变得过度活跃。”

paras.en: The researchers found that cannabinoids suppress the release of a neurotransmitter called gamma-aminobutyric acid, or GABA, which tamps down brain activity. In other words, the drug essentially weakens the central amygdala’s “brake,” Patel says, allowing fear and anxiety to run wild. When the researchers silenced the somatostatin neurons, the mice stopped trying so hard to avoid the threatening odor in their midst.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，大麻素会抑制一种名为γ-氨基丁酸（GABA）的神经递质的释放，这种神经递质会抑制大脑活动。换句话说，这种药物本质上削弱了中央杏仁核的“刹车”，帕特尔说，让恐惧和焦虑失控。当研究人员使生长抑素神经元沉默后，小鼠就不再那么努力地躲避它们中间的威胁性气味。

paras.en: “This elegantly demonstrates a causal role,” says Ozge Gunduz-Cinar, a neuroscientist at the U.S. National Institute on Alcohol Abuse and Alcoholism, who was not involved in the study. She notes, however, that the researchers “examined only a single inhibitory cell type in a single brain region using an innate fear model,” suggesting there may be more to this story.
paras.zh: “这巧妙地证明了因果关系，”美国国家酒精滥用和酒精中毒研究所的神经科学家奥兹格·冈杜兹-西纳尔（Ozge Gunduz-Cinar）说，他没有参与这项研究。然而，她指出，研究人员“使用先天恐惧模型仅检查了单个大脑区域中的单一抑制细胞类型”，这表明这个故事可能还有更多内容。

paras.en: Humans are not mice, so it is unclear whether our own cannabis-induced anxiety arises in the exact same way. But Patel suspects a similar mechanism, given that stoned mice exhibit a pattern of behavior that might feel familiar to anyone who’s overdone it on edibles. “The fact that we can mimic that behavioral response in animals quite nicely makes me think that the neural data we have has some relevance to what’s probably going on in humans,” he says.
paras.zh: 人类不是老鼠，因此尚不清楚我们自己的大麻引起的焦虑是否以完全相同的方式产生。但帕特尔怀疑存在类似的机制，因为中毒的老鼠表现出的一种行为模式可能会让那些吃太多食物的人感到熟悉。 “我们可以很好地模仿动物的行为反应，这一事实让我认为我们拥有的神经数据与人类可能发生的事情有一定的相关性，”他说。

paras.en: Human relevance might be difficult to prove, though. You could hypothetically get someone high, put them in a brain scanner, make them stare at pictures of scary faces and then look to see how their brain activity changes as dread wells up inside them—but that wouldn’t be very kind. “It’s a little difficult from an ethical perspective,” Patel acknowledges. Still, he believes that a deeper understanding of how marijuana affects the brain could produce new ways to counteract a bad trip.
paras.zh: 不过，人类的相关性可能很难证明。假设你可以让某人兴奋起来，将他们放入脑部扫描仪中，让他们盯着恐怖面孔的照片，然后看看当恐惧在他们内心涌动时，他们的大脑活动如何变化——但这并不是很好。 “从道德角度来看，这有点困难，”帕特尔承认。尽管如此，他相信，更深入地了解大麻如何影响大脑可能会产生新的方法来抵消糟糕的旅行。

articles.title: The Atlantic hurricane season has been eerily quiet—Tropical Storm Isaias could change that

paras.en: Tropical Storm Isaias, a cyclone in the Gulf of Mexico, is expected to strengthen into a hurricane by Thursday, according to the U.S. National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration. If it does, Isaias would be the latest-forming first hurricane in the Atlantic season since reliable records began.
paras.zh: 据美国国家海洋和大气管理局称，墨西哥湾的热带气旋伊萨亚斯预计将在周四增强为飓风。如果确实如此，伊萨亚斯将成为自有可靠记录以来大西洋季节中最新形成的第一场飓风。

paras.en: As of Wednesday morning, Isaias sat about 260 miles (420 kilometers) off the coast of Progreso, Mexico, and NOAA forecast that it is headed toward the U.S. Gulf Coast, including parts of Mississippi, Alabama and Florida.
paras.zh: 截至周三上午，“伊萨亚斯”号距离墨西哥普罗格雷索海岸约 260 英里（420 公里），美国国家海洋和大气管理局 (NOAA) 预测，它正朝着美国墨西哥湾沿岸前进，包括密西西比州、阿拉巴马州和佛罗里达州的部分地区。

paras.en: Isaias’s winds are up to some 45 miles per hour (75 kilometers per hour) as of this writing. To be considered a hurricane, winds must hit or surpass 74 mph (119 kmh).
paras.zh: 截至撰写本文时，伊萨亚斯的风速高达每小时 45 英里（75 公里）。风速必须达到或超过 74 英里/小时（119 公里/小时）才能被视为飓风。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。
