articles.title: NASA’s Webb finds signs of Mars-sized worlds smashing together

paras.en: NASAâs Webb finds signs of Mars-sized worlds smashing together
paras.zh: 美国宇航局韦伯发现火星大小的世界粉碎在一起的迹象

paras.en: - NASAâs James Webb Space Telescope is giving astronomers a glimpse of the kinds of violent collisions that may have shaped our own solar system, including the giant impact thought to have created the Moon. By studying 21 rare âextreme debris disksâ around young stars, researchers found that their dust can reveal the scale and intensity of planetary collisions.
paras.zh: - 美国宇航局的詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜让天文学家得以一睹可能塑造了我们太阳系的各种剧烈碰撞，包括被认为创造了月球的巨大撞击。通过研究年轻恒星周围的 21 个罕见的“极端碎片盘”，研究人员发现它们的尘埃可以揭示行星碰撞的规模和强度。

paras.en: Scientists think one of the most important events in the early solar system was a colossal collision between the young Earth and a Mars-sized body known as Theia. The impact likely vaporized huge quantities of rock and hurled material into space. Some of that debris eventually came together to form the Moon, where NASA's Artemis program is returning humans, preparing for Mars, and shaping the future of space exploration.
paras.zh: 科学家认为，早期太阳系中最重要的事件之一是年轻的地球与火星大小的忒伊亚天体之间的巨大碰撞。这次撞击可能会蒸发大量岩石并将物质抛入太空。其中一些碎片最终聚集在一起形成了月球，美国宇航局的阿尔忒弥斯计划正在月球上载人，为登陆火星做准备，并塑造太空探索的未来。

paras.en: That ancient impact dramatically altered Earth. Now, astronomers are using NASA's James Webb Space Telescope to investigate young star systems that appear to be experiencing similarly violent events. By studying these systems, researchers can estimate how energetic the collisions were and learn more about how rocky planets form and evolve.
paras.zh: 那场古老的撞击极大地改变了地球。现在，天文学家正在使用美国宇航局的詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜来研究似乎正在经历类似暴力事件的年轻恒星系统。通过研究这些系统，研究人员可以估计碰撞的能量有多大，并更多地了解岩石行星如何形成和演化。

paras.en: The team's findings published Oct 1. in The Astrophysical Journal.
paras.zh: 该团队的研究结果于 10 月 1 日发表在《天体物理学杂志》上。

paras.en: The material surrounding a star changes significantly over time. Young stars begin with a juvenile, gas-rich protoplanetary disk where forming planets can reside. As the system matures, that environment develops into a gas-poor debris disk.
paras.zh: 恒星周围的物质随着时间的推移发生显着变化。年轻的恒星始于一个年轻的、富含气体的原行星盘，形成的行星可以驻留在其中。随着系统的成熟，该环境会发展成为缺乏气体的碎片盘。

paras.en: During its years of operation, NASA's retired Spitzer Space Telescope studied these debris disks and identified an unusual category known as extreme debris disks. These systems contain exceptionally large amounts of warm dust close to their stars, roughly in the same region where rocky planets orbit in our own solar system.
paras.zh: 在多年的运行过程中，美国宇航局退役的斯皮策太空望远镜研究了这些碎片盘，并发现了一种不寻常的类别，称为极端碎片盘。这些系统在其恒星附近含有异常大量的温暖尘埃，大致位于我们太阳系中岩石行星绕轨道运行的同一区域。

paras.en: Kate Su of the Space Science Institute in Boulder, Colorado, led a team of astronomers that used Webb to investigate these unusual systems in greater detail.
paras.zh: 科罗拉多州博尔德空间科学研究所的凯特·苏（Kate Su）领导了一个天文学家小组，利用韦伯对这些不寻常的系统进行了更详细的研究。

paras.en: Theoretical models suggest extreme debris disks should be relatively common, but observations tell a different story. Based on data gathered so far, scientists estimate that only about 1% of young stars display observable signs of this stage. Our own solar system may also have passed through such a phase while it was forming.
paras.zh: 理论模型表明极端碎片盘应该相对常见，但观察结果却讲述了不同的故事。根据迄今为止收集到的数据，科学家估计只有约 1% 的年轻恒星表现出可观测到的这一阶段的迹象。我们自己的太阳系在形成时也可能经历过这样的阶段。

paras.en: Even though these systems are uncommon, the researchers assembled a sample of 21 extreme debris disks. Five came from archival Spitzer observations, and 16 were studied with Webb. Of the Webb sample, 12 disks were newly observed, while four were follow-up observations of systems previously examined by Spitzer.
paras.zh: 尽管这些系统并不常见，研究人员还是组装了 21 个极端碎片盘的样本。其中 5 个来自斯皮策望远镜的观测档案，16 个是与韦伯一起研究的。在韦伯样本中，有 12 个圆盘是新观察到的，另外 4 个是对斯皮策先前检查过的系统进行的后续观察。

paras.en: "This is the first time we have gathered enough systems to truly understand this subclass that we call extreme debris disks," said Su, lead author of the paper. "Before Webb, we had limited information. We knew that they are weird and very different from the typical cold debris disks that we know, like Vega and Fomalhaut. Now that we have more data, we can pin down what these disks represent for planet formation and evolution."
paras.zh: 该论文的主要作者苏说：“这是我们第一次收集到足够的系统来真正了解这个我们称之为极端碎片盘的子类。” “在韦伯之前，我们掌握的信息有限。我们知道它们很奇怪，与我们所知道的典型冷碎片盘（如织女星和北落师门）非常不同。现在我们有了更多数据，我们可以确定这些盘对行星形成和演化的代表意义。”

paras.en: Dust Reveals the Nature of Planetary Collisions
paras.zh: 尘埃揭示了行星碰撞的本质

paras.en: The researchers confirmed that extreme debris disks have three defining characteristics. Their dust grains are smaller than those found in protoplanetary or more typical debris disks, they contain unusually high concentrations of warm dust, and their brightness changes irregularly over time. Webb and Spitzer revealed these features through mid-infrared spectra.
paras.zh: 研究人员证实，极端碎片盘具有三个定义特征。它们的尘埃颗粒比原行星或更典型的碎片盘中发现的尘埃颗粒更小，它们含有异常高浓度的温暖尘埃，并且它们的亮度随着时间的推移不规则地变化。韦伯和斯皮策通过中红外光谱揭示了这些特征。

paras.en: To understand what might be producing these unusual traits, the researchers examined the minerals present in the disks. Their analysis showed that the systems could be divided into two broad groups: silica-rich disks and silica-poor disks.
paras.zh: 为了了解可能产生这些不寻常特征的原因，研究人员检查了圆盘中存在的矿物质。他们的分析表明，这些系统可以分为两大类：富含二氧化硅的盘和缺乏二氧化硅的盘。

paras.en: On Earth, volcanic glass such as obsidian is an example of silica-rich material. The silica-poor mineral forsterite, meanwhile, can be seen as green sand grains on certain beaches in Hawaii.
paras.zh: 在地球上，黑曜石等火山玻璃是富含二氧化硅的材料的一个例子。与此同时，在夏威夷的某些海滩上，贫硅矿物镁橄榄石可以被视为绿色沙粒。

paras.en: Whether a disk is rich or poor in silica can reveal important information about the collision that created its debris. The distinction may also help explain why some of the disks fluctuate more dramatically in infrared brightness.
paras.zh: 圆盘中二氧化硅的含量是否丰富，可以揭示有关产生其碎片的碰撞的重要信息。这种区别也可能有助于解释为什么某些圆盘的红外亮度波动更剧烈。

paras.en: "To just see their mid-infrared emission and beautiful spectral features with Webb, which allowed us to identify their compositions, was the most exciting thing for me," said Agnes Kospal of Konkoly Observatory in Budapest, Hungary, and a coauthor of the study. "We have no other way to study these planetary embryos directly because they are too small."
paras.zh: 该研究的合著者、匈牙利布达佩斯康科利天文台的艾格尼丝·科斯帕尔（Agnes Kospal）表示：“用韦伯望远镜观察它们的中红外发射和美丽的光谱特征，这使我们能够识别它们的成分，这对我来说是最令人兴奋的事情。” “我们没有其他方法来直接研究这些行星胚胎，因为它们太小了。”

paras.en: Mars-Sized Worlds May Be Smashing Together
paras.zh: 火星大小的世界可能正在粉碎在一起

paras.en: Roughly one-third of the disks in the sample are silica-rich. The researchers say these systems likely formed after extremely energetic collisions between Mars-sized bodies. Such impacts would be powerful enough to vaporize a substantial amount of rocky material.
paras.zh: 样本中大约三分之一的圆盘富含二氧化硅。研究人员表示，这些系统可能是在火星大小的天体之间发生极其剧烈的碰撞后形成的。这种撞击的威力足以使大量岩石物质蒸发。

paras.en: The other two-thirds are silica-poor. These systems appear to result from lower-energy collisions, including grazing impacts between Moon-sized objects.
paras.zh: 另外三分之二缺乏二氧化硅。这些系统似乎是低能量碰撞的结果，包括月球大小物体之间的掠过碰撞。

paras.en: The researchers also found an important age difference between the two groups. Silica-rich disks have only been identified around stars younger than 300 million years. Silica-poor disks, however, occur around stars spanning a much wider range of ages and tend to show stronger changes in brightness.
paras.zh: 研究人员还发现两组之间存在重要的年龄差异。仅在年龄小于 3 亿年的恒星周围发现了富含二氧化硅的圆盘。然而，贫硅盘出现在年龄范围更广的恒星周围，并且往往表现出更强的亮度变化。

paras.en: The team suggests that this variability may come from the rapid evolution of newly created debris. Changes in the material's orbit, along with additional collisions, could cause the infrared brightness to rise and fall over time.
paras.zh: 研究小组认为，这种变化可能来自新产生的碎片的快速演化。材料轨道的变化以及额外的碰撞可能会导致红外亮度随着时间的推移而上升和下降。

paras.en: The findings may also help scientists reconstruct the history of our own solar system, which could have passed through more than one extreme debris disk phase.
paras.zh: 这些发现还可能帮助科学家重建我们太阳系的历史，太阳系可能经历了不止一个极端的碎片盘阶段。

paras.en: "How rocky planets formed and giant planets evolved are part of the broader story of the solar system's formation. It's all one story," said Su. "Our work on extreme debris disks helps us bring together the big picture of what we currently understand."
paras.zh: “岩石行星的形成和巨行星的演化是太阳系形成更广泛故事的一部分。这都是一个故事，”苏说。 “我们对极端碎片盘的研究有助于我们了解目前所了解的情况。”

paras.en: Clues to the Collision That Formed the Moon
paras.zh: 形成月球的碰撞的线索

paras.en: Computer simulations suggest terrestrial planets, including Earth, should emerge within the first few hundred million years after a solar system begins forming.
paras.zh: 计算机模拟表明，包括地球在内的类地行星应该在太阳系开始形成后的最初几亿年内出现。

paras.en: That timeline matches the ages of the silica-rich extreme debris disks observed so far. It is also consistent with estimates that Earth and the Moon formed roughly 100 million years after the Sun, with the Moon likely being the result of a collision between Earth and a Mars-sized object.
paras.zh: 该时间线与迄今为止观察到的富含二氧化硅的极端碎片盘的年龄相符。这也与地球和月球在太阳形成后大约一亿年的估计相一致，月球很可能是地球和火星大小的物体碰撞的结果。

paras.en: Scientists are also interested in whether the Sun may once have passed through a silica-poor extreme debris disk phase.
paras.zh: 科学家们还对太阳是否曾经经历过贫硅极端碎片盘阶段感兴趣。

paras.en: If the older silica-poor disks and their seemingly random periods of changing infrared brightness are caused by orbital instability, the pattern would be broadly compatible with the Late Heavy Bombardment hypothesis for our solar system.
paras.zh: 如果较旧的贫硅盘及其看似随机的红外亮度变化周期是由轨道不稳定引起的，那么这种模式将与我们太阳系的晚期重轰炸假说大致兼容。

paras.en: Under that scenario, the giant planets shifted significantly from their original positions. Their movement disturbed the orbits of smaller objects, setting off catastrophic collisions and producing brief periods filled with large amounts of dust, similar to what astronomers now observe in extreme debris disks.
paras.zh: 在这种情况下，巨行星明显偏离了原来的位置。它们的运动扰乱了较小物体的轨道，引发了灾难性的碰撞，并产生了充满大量尘埃的短暂时期，类似于天文学家现在在极端碎片盘中观察到的情况。

paras.en: "Of course, there's many things we still don't know about these disks," said Attila Moor of Konkoly Observatory, a coauthor of the study. "We expect no silica-rich systems among older extreme debris disks. We only have three disks in our sample that fit that age criteria, so it'll be nice to observe more of these systems to confirm our hypothesis."
paras.zh: “当然，关于这些圆盘，我们还有很多事情不知道，”该研究的合著者、康科利天文台的阿蒂拉·摩尔说。 “我们预计在较古老的极端碎片盘中不会存在富含二氧化硅的系统。我们的样本中只有三个符合该年龄标准的盘，因此观察更多这些系统以证实我们的假设将是很好的。”

paras.en: The James Webb Space Telescope is the world's premier space science observatory. Webb is solving mysteries in our solar system, looking beyond to distant worlds around other stars, and probing the mysterious structures and origins of our universe and our place in it. Webb is an international program led by NASA with its partners, ESA (European Space Agency) and CSA (Canadian Space Agency).
paras.zh: 詹姆斯·韦伯太空望远镜是世界上首屈一指的太空科学天文台。韦伯正在解开太阳系中的谜团，展望其他恒星周围的遥远世界，并探索宇宙的神秘结构和起源以及我们在其中的位置。韦伯是由 NASA 及其合作伙伴 ESA（欧洲航天局）和 CSA（加拿大航天局）领导的一项国际计划。

paras.en: - Kate Y. L. Su, Attila MoÃ³r, Ãgnes KÃ³spÃ¡l, George H. Rieke, Antranik A. Sefilian, Renu Malhotra, Ilaria Pascucci, Alan P. Jackson, PÃ©ter ÃbrahÃ¡m, Nicholas P. Ballering. Extreme Debris Disks: Insights into Violent Collisions in Planet Formation and Destruction. The Astrophysical Journal, 2026; 1010 (1): 1 DOI: 10.3847/1538-4357/ae88fe
paras.zh: - Kate Y. L. Su、Attila Moór、Ágnes Kóspál、George H. Rieke、Antranik A. Sefilian、Renu Malhotra、Ilaria Pascucci、Alan P. Jackson、Péter ábrahám、Nicholas P. Ballering。极端碎片盘：深入了解行星形成和毁灭中的暴力碰撞。天体物理学杂志，2026； 1010 (1): 1 DOI: 10.3847/1538-4357/ae88fe

articles.title: Rethinking risk with electronics for space
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: In this episode, SpaceNews’ Mike Gruss speaks with Ken Stoler, the space business development lead for Arrow. They discuss how spacecraft designers and operators have changed their attitudes toward risk, how the move toward massive megaconstellations has started to impact purchasing behavior in the space supply chain and the challenges and constraints of adding more AI-enabling computing power to spacecraft.
paras.zh: 在本集中，SpaceNews 的 Mike Gruss 与 Arrow 太空业务开发主管 Ken Stoler 进行了交谈。他们讨论了航天器设计者和运营商如何改变对风险的态度，向巨型星座的转变如何开始影响航天供应链中的购买行为，以及为航天器增加更多支持人工智能的计算能力的挑战和限制。

paras.en: Arrow Electronics is a Fortune 500-ranked distributor of electronic components and enterprise computing products that helps thousands of leading manufacturers and service providers turn technology ideas into market-ready solutions. From concept and design through sourcing, integration, manufacturing, and lifecycle management, Arrow comes alongside innovators with deep engineering expertise, comprehensive supply chain services and one of the industry’s most extensive product portfolios. Whether helping enable next-generation aerospace and defense systems, AI-driven applications, industrial automation, robotics platforms or connected devices, Arrow helps its customers accelerate innovation, solve complex design challenges, and bring mission-critical technologies to market faster.
paras.zh: Arrow Electronics 是财富 500 强电子元件和企业计算产品分销商，帮助数千家领先制造商和服务提供商将技术理念转化为市场就绪的解决方案。从概念和设计到采购、集成、制造和生命周期管理，Arrow 与拥有深厚工程专业知识、全面供应链服务和业界最广泛产品组合之一的创新者并肩作战。无论是帮助实现下一代航空航天和国防系统、人工智能驱动的应用、工业自动化、机器人平台还是互联设备，Arrow 都可以帮助客户加速创新、解决复杂的设计挑战，并更快地将关键任务技术推向市场。

paras.en: Space Minds is a new audio and video podcast from SpaceNews that focuses on the inspiring leaders, technologies and exciting opportunities in space.
paras.zh: Space Minds 是 SpaceNews 推出的新音频和视频播客，重点关注太空中鼓舞人心的领导者、技术和令人兴奋的机会。

paras.en: The weekly podcast features compelling interviews with scientists, founders and experts who love to talk about space, covers the news that has enthusiasts daydreaming, and engages with listeners. Join David Ariosto, Mike Gruss and journalists from the SpaceNews team for new episodes every Thursday.
paras.zh: 每周播客对热爱谈论太空的科学家、创始人和专家进行引人注目的采访，报道让爱好者们做白日梦的新闻，并与听众互动。每周四与 David Ariosto、Mike Gruss 和 SpaceNews 团队的记者一起观看新剧集。

paras.en: Watch a new episode every Thursday on SpaceNews.com and on our YouTube, Spotify and Apple channels.
paras.zh: 每周四在 SpaceNews.com 以及我们的 YouTube、Spotify 和 Apple 频道上观看新剧集。

paras.en: Be the first to know when new episodes drop! Enter your email, and we’ll make sure you get exclusive access to each episode as soon as it goes live!
paras.zh: 成为第一个知道新剧集何时发布的人！输入您的电子邮件，我们将确保您在每集上线后立即获得独家访问权限！

paras.en: Note: By registering, you consent to receive communications from SpaceNews and our partners.
paras.zh: 注意：注册即表示您同意接收来自 SpaceNews 和我们合作伙伴的通信。

articles.title: World Space Week 2026 Celebrates the “Rocket Revolution”
articles.author: World Space Week Association

paras.en: HOUSTON, Texas (September 30, 2026)— World Space Week events, beginning October 4 in 100 nations, will celebrate how launch innovation has stimulated the rapidly-growing space economy and enabled new uses of space to help the world.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯州休斯顿（2026 年 9 月 30 日）——世界太空周活动将于 10 月 4 日在 100 个国家开始，庆祝发射创新如何刺激快速增长的太空经济，并实现太空的新用途来帮助世界。

paras.en: “This year’s theme is the Rocket Revolution,” said Dennis Stone, World Space Week Association President. “It recognizes how increased space access and falling launch prices have stimulated the space ecosystem and exciting new space applications,” he said. The rocketry theme will also be used to inspire student interest in STEM, he added.
paras.zh: “今年的主题是火箭革命，”世界太空周协会主席丹尼斯·斯通说。他说：“它认识到太空准入的增加和发射价格的下降如何刺激了太空生态系统并令人兴奋的新太空应用。”他补充说，火箭主题还将用于激发学生对 STEM 的兴趣。

paras.en: Planned World Space Week 2026 activities include:
paras.zh: 2026 年世界空间周计划活动包括：

paras.en: ESA and The Pokémon Company International will celebrate World Space Week 2026 with a Europe-wide family exhibition combining real space science with Pokémon, alongside special Pokémon GO activities at participating museums.
paras.zh: ESA 和 Pokémon Company International 将为庆祝 2026 年世界太空周举办一场欧洲范围内的家庭展览，将真实的太空科学与 Pokémon 相结合，并在参与的博物馆举办特别的 Pokémon GO 活动。

paras.en: NASA Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex will host a World Space Week Expo featuring Space Shuttle Atlantis, highlighting the Rocket Revolution and its impact on space exploration and access.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局肯尼迪航天中心游客中心将举办世界航天周博览会，以亚特兰蒂斯号航天飞机为主题，突出火箭革命及其对太空探索和进入的影响。

paras.en: Students and rocket clubs around the world will put the Rocket Revolution into action by launching model rockets. In the U.S., enthusiasts will launch Vulcan model rockets provided by United Launch Alliance and Estes.
paras.zh: 世界各地的学生和火箭俱乐部将通过发射模型火箭将火箭革命付诸实践。在美国，爱好者将发射由联合发射联盟和 Estes 提供的 Vulcan 模型火箭。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Education and SUPARCO, Pakistan’s national space agency, will lead large-scale national celebrations, with thousands of schools and events engaging students and the public in World Space Week.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯教育部和巴基斯坦国家航天局 SUPARCO 将领导大规模的全国庆祝活动，数千所学校和活动将吸引学生和公众参与世界空间周。

paras.en: UN-declared World Space Week, the largest space event on Earth, last year was celebrated by 50,000 events held by space agencies, schools, aerospace companies, and others according to the Association. World Space Week is held each October 4-10.
paras.zh: 据该协会称，联合国宣布的世界空间周是地球上最大的太空活动，去年由太空机构、学校、航空航天公司和其他机构举办了 50,000 场活动来庆祝。世界空间周于每年 10 月 4 日至 10 日举行。

paras.en: John Elbon, former ULA Interim CEO, serves as Honorary Chair of World Space Week 2026 to help showcase the launch industry. Tory Bruno, President of Blue Origin National Security, will serve as Honorary Chair in 2027 with the theme “To the Moon.”
paras.zh: ULA 前临时首席执行官 John Elbon 担任 2026 年世界太空周名誉主席，帮助展示发射行业。蓝色起源国家安全总裁托里·布鲁诺 (Tory Bruno) 将担任 2027 年名誉主席，主题为“To the Moon”。

paras.en: “We encourage students and the public to celebrate space in their own way next week as part of the biggest space event in the world,” Stone said. The public can see what’s planned in their area at worldspaceweek.org.
paras.zh: 斯通说：“我们鼓励学生和公众下周以自己的方式庆祝太空，作为世界上最大的太空活动的一部分。”公众可以在 worldspaceweek.org 上查看他们所在地区的计划。

paras.en: The largest space event on Earth, UN-declared World Space Week is celebrated October 4–10 annually. It is an international celebration of the contribution of space science and technology to the betterment of the human condition. World Space Week consists of numerous space-related events held by space agencies, aerospace companies, schools, planetaria, museums, astronomy clubs, and others in a common timeframe to achieve greater student and public impact through synchronization. In 2025, 50,000 events were reported in 102 countries.
paras.zh: 联合国宣布的世界空间周是地球上最大的太空活动，每年 10 月 4 日至 10 日举行庆祝活动。这是一次国际性庆祝空间科学技术对改善人类状况所做贡献的活动。世界空间周由航天机构、航空航天公司、学校、天文馆、博物馆、天文学俱乐部和其他机构在同一时间范围内举办的众多与太空相关的活动组成，以通过同步实现更大的学生和公众影响。 2025 年，102 个国家报告了 50,000 起事件。

paras.en: World Space Week Association is the global coordinator of World Space Week. As an international non-government, non-profit organization, it serves as a permanent observer on the UN Committee on the Peaceful Uses of Outer Space and is supported by voluntary contributions from sponsors including Blue Origin, United Launch Alliance, Texas Instruments, Firefly Aerospace, L3 Harris, BAE Systems, Black Sky, Airbus, Club for the Future, Cesium Astro, Space Foundation, Gaia Horizons, and Space News. The Association was founded in 1982 and is one of the world’s oldest space advocacy organizations.
paras.zh: 世界空间周协会是世界空间周的全球协调机构。作为一个国际非政府、非营利组织，它是联合国和平利用外层空间委员会的常任观察员，并得到了赞助商的自愿捐款支持，这些赞助商包括蓝色起源、联合发射联盟、德州仪器、Firefly Aerospace、L3 Harris、BAE Systems、Black Sky、空客、未来俱乐部、Cesium Astro、太空基金会、Gaia Horizo​​ns 和 Space News。该协会成立于 1982 年，是世界上历史最悠久的太空倡导组织之一。

paras.en: Dennis Stone, dstone@worldspaceweek.org (USA)
paras.zh: 丹尼斯·斯通，dstone@worldspaceweek.org（美国）

paras.en: Alma Okpalefe, aokpalefe@worldspaceweek.org (Nigeria)
paras.zh: Alma Okpalefe，aokpalefe@worldspaceweek.org（尼日利亚）

paras.en: Ilayda Edali, iedali@worldspaceweek.org (Netherlands)
paras.zh: Ilayda Edali，iedali@worldspaceweek.org（荷兰）

articles.title: Announcing the finalists for the 2026 SpaceNews Icon Awards
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: The SpaceNews Icon Awards celebrate the year’s most iconic achievements in shaping the future of the space industry. Today, we’re proud to announce the shortlist for 2026 — a selection of individuals, organizations, and missions that exemplify excellence in innovation, exploration and sustainability.
paras.zh: 太空新闻偶像奖旨在表彰今年在塑造航天工业未来方面最具标志性的成就。今天，我们很自豪地宣布 2026 年入围名单，其中包括在创新、探索和可持续发展方面表现卓越的个人、组织和使命。

paras.en: This year’s honorees represent a range of accomplishments — from returning astronauts to the vicinity of the moon and expanding the capacity to run AI on orbit to accelerating the realization of on-orbit servicing and advancing scale through partnerships and acquisitions. These finalists reflect the creativity and ambition propelling today’s growth.
paras.zh: 今年的获奖者代表了一系列成就——从让宇航员重返月球附近、扩大在轨道上运行人工智能的能力，到加速实现在轨服务以及通过合作和收购扩大规模。这些决赛入围者反映了推动当今发展的创造力和雄心。

paras.en: Winners will be announced at the 2026 SpaceNews Icon Awards on Dec. 1 in Washington D.C., where we’ll celebrate their contributions and share the stories behind their successes.
paras.zh: 获奖者名单将于 12 月 1 日在华盛顿特区举行的 2026 年太空新闻偶像奖上公布，届时我们将庆祝他们的贡献并分享他们成功背后的故事。

paras.en: Tickets are available now – register by Oct. 31 to take advantage of our early bird rate.
paras.zh: 门票现已发售——请在 10 月 31 日之前注册，以享受我们的早鸟价。

paras.en: Honoring individuals whose leadership and vision have left a lasting impact on the space industry, shaping exploration, national security and commercial growth for generations.
paras.zh: 表彰其领导力和远见对航天工业产生持久影响、影响几代人的探索、国家安全和商业增长的个人。

paras.en: Mark Dankberg. A satellite communications pioneer who co-founded Viasat and spent decades advancing high-capacity satellite broadband, helping reshape how satellite technology connects consumers, governments and businesses.
paras.zh: 马克·丹克伯格。卫星通信先驱，Viasat 的联合创始人，花费数十年时间推进高容量卫星宽带的发展，帮助重塑卫星技术连接消费者、政府和企业的方式。

paras.en: Jean-Yves Le Gall. One of Europe’s most influential space leaders, with decades of leadership at CNES and Arianespace that helped strengthen Europe’s launch capabilities, international partnerships and position in the global space economy.
paras.zh: 让-伊夫·勒加尔。欧洲最具影响力的太空领导者之一，在法国国家空间研究中心和阿丽亚娜航天公司拥有数十年的领导地位，帮助加强了欧洲的发射能力、国际合作伙伴关系以及在全球太空经济中的地位。

paras.en: Chris Scolese. Capped a career spanning NASA and national security space after nearly seven years as director of the National Reconnaissance Office, where he oversaw a transformation of the agency’s architecture and growing integration of commercial capabilities. Scolese previously served as NASA’s chief engineer and director of Goddard Space Flight Center.
paras.zh: 克里斯·斯科莱斯。在担任国家侦察办公室主任近七年后，他在美国宇航局和国家安全领域的职业生涯结束了，在那里他监督了该机构架构的转型和商业能力的不断整合。斯科莱斯此前曾担任美国宇航局总工程师和戈达德太空飞行中心主任。

paras.en: Karen St. Germain. Helped shape NASA’s Earth science enterprise through senior leadership roles overseeing missions, research and the use of satellite observations to better understand Earth’s climate and environment.
paras.zh: 凯伦·圣日耳曼。通过监督任务、研究和卫星观测使用的高级领导角色，帮助塑造美国宇航局的地球科学事业，以更好地了解地球的气候和环境。

paras.en: Coyote Smith. A longtime military space leader and educator whose career has helped shape thinking about spacepower, national security space strategy and the development of the next generation of space professionals.
paras.zh: 郊狼·史密斯。一位长期的军事太空领导者和教育家，其职业生涯帮助塑造了对太空力量、国家安全太空战略和下一代太空专业人员发展的思考。

paras.en: Recognizing partnerships that bring together organizations and nations to advance space exploration, science and commerce.
paras.zh: 认可将组织和国家聚集在一起推动太空探索、科学和商业的伙伴关系。

paras.en: Clay Mowry. Now chief executive of the American Institute of Aeronautics and Astronautics (AIAA), he has worked across industry, government and professional organizations to build connections within an increasingly international and multidisciplinary space community.
paras.zh: 克莱·莫里。他现任美国航空航天学会 (AIAA) 首席执行官，曾在行业、政府和专业组织中工作，在日益国际化和多学科的太空社区中建立联系。

paras.en: Loft Orbital–Marlan Space. U.S.-French and Emirati capabilities joined in a major international space initiative, including plans for the 50-satellite Altair-Next Gen constellation combining Earth observation, onboard computing and artificial intelligence.
paras.zh: 阁楼轨道——马兰空间。美国、法国和阿联酋联合参与了一项重大国际太空计划，其中包括由 50 颗卫星组成的 Altair-Next Gen 星座计划，该星座结合了地球观测、机载计算和人工智能。

paras.en: K2 Space–SES. Paired K2 Space’s high-power satellite platforms with SES’s software-defined payloads for meoSphere, a next-generation MEO network beginning with 28 spacecraft and designed to serve commercial and defense customers.
paras.zh: K2 空间——SES。将 K2 Space 的高功率卫星平台与 SES 软件定义的 meoSphere 有效载荷配对，meoSphere 是下一代 MEO 网络，从 28 颗航天器开始，旨在为商业和国防客户提供服务。

paras.en: Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope. Brought together NASA, ESA, JAXA, France’s CNES, Germany’s Max Planck Institute for Astronomy and institutions across the scientific community to develop a next-generation observatory for studying dark energy, exoplanets and the evolution of the universe. Roman launched Aug. 30, beginning a new chapter in international space science.
paras.zh: 南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜。美国宇航局、欧空局、日本宇宙航空研究开发机构、法国国家空间研究中心、德国马克斯·普朗克天文研究所以及整个科学界的机构聚集在一起，开发下一代天文台，用于研究暗能量、系外行星和宇宙演化。 Roman 于 8 月 30 日发射升空，开启了国际空间科学的新篇章。

paras.en: SMILE. The Solar wind Magnetosphere Ionosphere Link Explorer brought ESA and the Chinese Academy of Sciences together for the first mission jointly designed, implemented, launched and operated by Europe and China. The spacecraft launched May 19 to study the interaction between the solar wind and Earth’s magnetosphere.
paras.zh: 微笑。太阳风磁层电离层链接探测器将欧空局和中国科学院联合起来，执行欧洲和中国联合设计、实施、发射和运营的首次任务。该航天器于 5 月 19 日发射升空，旨在研究太阳风与地球磁层之间的相互作用。

paras.en: Recognizing new or rapidly growing companies driving innovation and opening new markets in the space economy.
paras.zh: 认可在太空经济中推动创新和开辟新市场的新公司或快速成长的公司。

paras.en: Benoît Deper / Aerospacelab. Built Aerospacelab into a rapidly expanding European satellite manufacturer and operator, pursuing vertically integrated spacecraft production and constellation development from Europe and the United States.
paras.zh: 伯努瓦·德佩 / 航空航天实验室。将航空航天实验室打造成一家快速扩张的欧洲卫星制造商和运营商，追求欧洲和美国垂直整合的航天器生产和星座开发。

paras.en: Lux Aeterna. Emerged from stealth with plans to develop reusable satellites capable of returning payloads to Earth, raising $10 million in 2026 as it works toward its first reentry demonstration mission.
paras.zh: 永恒之光。该公司计划开发能够将有效载荷返回地球的可重复使用卫星，并在 2026 年筹集 1000 万美元，以实现首次再入演示任务。

paras.en: Katalyst Space Technologies. Pushed commercial satellite servicing into new territory with LINK, a rapidly developed robotic spacecraft sent to attempt the rescue of NASA’s Swift observatory, while expanding into GEO servicing, deorbiting and other robotic space operations.
paras.zh: 催化剂空间技术。 LINK 是一种快速开发的机器人航天器，被派去尝试救援 NASA 的雨燕天文台，将商业卫星服务推向新领域，同时扩展到 GEO 服务、离轨和其他机器人太空操作。

paras.en: Skyroot Aerospace. Advanced India’s growing private launch sector with Vikram-1, India’s first privately developed orbital-class launch vehicle.
paras.zh: 天根航空航天公司。 Vikram-1 是印度第一个私人开发的轨道级运载火箭，推动印度不断发展的私人发射领域。

paras.en: Recognizing technologies that push the boundaries of engineering and create new capabilities for space operations.
paras.zh: 认识到突破工程界限并为太空作战创造新能力的技术。

paras.en: Cailabs. Advanced laser communications from individual optical ground stations toward shared infrastructure, launching an optical-ground-station-as-a-service model with plans for an international network of roughly 15 stations.
paras.zh: 凯拉布斯。从单个光学地面站到共享基础设施的先进激光通信，推出了光学地面站即服务模型，并计划建立一个由大约 15 个站组成的国际网络。

paras.en: D-Orbit. Continued expanding the capabilities of its ION orbital transfer vehicle beyond satellite deployment into hosted payloads, orbital transportation, cloud computing and other in-space logistics services.
paras.zh: D 轨道。继续将 ION 轨道传输飞行器的功能扩展到卫星部署之外，扩展到托管有效载荷、轨道运输、云计算和其他太空物流服务。

paras.en: Xona Space Systems. Advanced a commercial alternative to traditional GPS with Pulsar, a low Earth orbit positioning, navigation and timing architecture designed to provide more precise, resilient navigation services from a new generation of satellites.
paras.zh: 希纳空间系统公司。 Pulsar 是一种低地球轨道定位、导航和授时架构，旨在通过新一代卫星提供更精确、更有弹性的导航服务，从而推出传统 GPS 的商业替代方案。

paras.en: Recognizing individuals whose leadership and innovation have set new benchmarks for excellence and inspired progress across the space community.
paras.zh: 表彰其领导力和创新能力为卓越树立新基准并激励整个航天界进步的个人。

paras.en: Steve Altemus, Intuitive Machines. Continued expanding Intuitive Machines from lunar transportation into a broader space infrastructure company, including the $800 million acquisition of Lanteris Space Systems and investments in communications, navigation and data services.
paras.zh: 史蒂夫·阿尔特穆斯，《直觉机器》。继续将 Intuitive Machines 从月球运输扩展到更广泛的空间基础设施公司，包括以 8 亿美元收购 Lanteris Space Systems 以及对通信、导航和数据服务的投资。

paras.en: Ian Cinnamon, Apex. Helped establish a new model for satellite manufacturing at Apex, emphasizing standardized spacecraft platforms, faster production and an approach designed to bring mass-production economics to the satellite industry.
paras.zh: 伊恩·肉桂，Apex。帮助 Apex 建立卫星制造的新模式，强调标准化航天器平台、更快的生产以及旨在为卫星行业带来大规模生产经济效益的方法。

paras.en: Rafal Modrzewski, ICEYE. Led ICEYE’s continued expansion of the world’s largest commercial synthetic aperture radar satellite fleet, combining commercial services with increasingly important sovereign intelligence capabilities for governments around the world.
paras.zh: 拉法尔·莫杰夫斯基，ICEYE。领导 ICEYE 持续扩大全球最大的商业合成孔径雷达卫星群，将商业服务与对世界各国政府日益重要的主权情报能力结合起来。

paras.en: Shey Sabripour, CesiumAstro. Built CesiumAstro around advanced active phased-array communications technology, helping move high-throughput, software-defined connectivity from a promising technology toward operational space systems.
paras.zh: Shey Saripour，CesiumAstro。围绕先进的有源相控阵通信技术构建 CesiumAstro，帮助将高吞吐量、软件定义的连接从有前景的技术转向可操作的空间系统。

paras.en: Recognizing transactions and investments that reshape markets, create new competitors or alter the trajectory of the space industry.
paras.zh: 认可重塑市场、创造新竞争对手或改变航天工业轨迹的交易和投资。

paras.en: AE Industrial Partners–Rocketdyne. AE Industrial agreed to acquire a controlling interest in L3Harris’ Space Propulsion and Power Systems business, reviving the Rocketdyne name for a company whose propulsion heritage stretches back more than six decades.
paras.zh: AE 工业合作伙伴——Rocketdyne。 AE Industrial 同意收购 L3Harris 太空推进和动力系统业务的控股权，从而为一家其推进历史可追溯至六十多年前的公司重新启用 Rocketdyne 名称。

paras.en: EQT–Exolaunch. EQT agreed to acquire Exolaunch, giving the previously self-funded German launch integration and deployment company its first outside investment and resources to expand internationally and develop new services.
paras.zh: EQT-Exolaunch。 EQT 同意收购 Exolaunch，为这家之前自筹资金的德国发射集成和部署公司提供了第一笔外部投资和资源，以进行国际扩张和开发新服务。

paras.en: Intuitive Machines–Lanteris Space Systems. Intuitive Machines completed its $800 million acquisition of the former Maxar Space Systems, adding decades of satellite manufacturing experience as it seeks to become a vertically integrated space prime.
paras.zh: 直观机器——兰特里斯空间系统。 Intuitive Machines 完成了对前 Maxar Space Systems 的 8 亿美元收购，在其寻求成为垂直整合的太空巨头的过程中，增加了数十年的卫星制造经验。

paras.en: Katalyst Space Technologies–NASA. NASA turned to Katalyst for an unusually rapid commercial servicing mission designed to rendezvous with and raise the orbit of the agency’s Swift observatory, testing a new model for acquiring time-sensitive in-space services.
paras.zh: Katalyst 空间技术——美国宇航局。 NASA 向 Katalyst 寻求一项异常快速的商业服务任务，旨在与该机构的雨燕天文台交会并提升其轨道，测试一种获取时间敏感的太空服务的新模型。

paras.en: SpaceX IPO. SpaceX’s long-awaited public offering brought one of the world’s most valuable private companies to public markets in a landmark transaction for the commercial space sector.
paras.zh: SpaceX 首次公开募股。 SpaceX 期待已久的公开发行将世界上最有价值的私营公司之一带到了公开市场，这是商业航天领域具有里程碑意义的交易。

paras.en: Recognizing advances that harness artificial intelligence and high-performance computing to transform spacecraft, space data and operations.
paras.zh: 认识到利用人工智能和高性能计算来改变航天器、空间数据和操作的进步。

paras.en: Aethero. Launched its Phobos spacecraft with an NVIDIA-powered edge-computing module, demonstrating a platform designed for continuous onboard processing and compute-as-a-service applications.
paras.zh: 埃泰罗。推出了配备 NVIDIA 驱动的边缘计算模块的 Phobos 航天器，展示了一个专为连续机载处理和计算即服务应用程序而设计的平台。

paras.en: Alex Greenberg, Loft Orbital. Helped drive Loft Orbital’s push to bring artificial intelligence and high-performance computing directly into orbit, enabling satellites to process increasingly large volumes of data before sending actionable information to the ground.
paras.zh: 亚历克斯·格林伯格，阁楼轨道。帮助推动 Loft Orbital 推动人工智能和高性能计算直接进入轨道，使卫星能够在向地面发送可操作信息之前处理越来越多的数据。

paras.en: Starcloud. Advanced the emerging concept of space-based data centers by developing high-performance orbital computing infrastructure intended to run increasingly demanding AI workloads in space.
paras.zh: 星云.通过开发旨在在太空中运行要求日益严格的人工智能工作负载的高性能轨道计算基础设施，推进新兴的天基数据中心概念。

paras.en: Recognizing companies and missions that have advanced commercial space capabilities and contributed to the growth of the space economy.
paras.zh: 表彰具有先进商业航天能力并为航天经济增长做出贡献的公司和任务。

paras.en: ICEYE. Expanded its synthetic aperture radar network while deploying a new generation of spacecraft capable of imagery down to 16-centimeter resolution and supporting both commercial and sovereign missions worldwide.
paras.zh: 冰眼。扩大其合成孔径雷达网络，同时部署能够将图像分辨率低至 16 厘米的新一代航天器，并支持全球商业和主权任务。

paras.en: Impulse Space and Starfish Space. Demonstrated autonomous rendezvous and proximity operations using Impulse Space’s Mira spacecraft and Starfish Space technology, advancing commercial capabilities needed for future satellite servicing and other in-space operations.
paras.zh: 脉冲空间和海星空间。使用 Impulse Space 的 Mira 航天器和 Starfish Space 技术展示了自主交会和邻近操作，提高了未来卫星服务和其他太空操作所需的商业能力。

paras.en: SEOPS and Exolaunch. Expanded launch integration and rideshare services at a time of growing demand for alternatives in the commercial launch market, helping satellite operators secure access to orbit across a broader range of launch vehicles.
paras.zh: SEOPS 和 Exolaunch。在商业发射市场对替代品的需求不断增长之际，扩大了发射集成和乘车共享服务，帮助卫星运营商确保更广泛的运载火箭进入轨道。

paras.en: Recognizing leadership in using space technology to protect Earth and advancing more sustainable operations in space.
paras.zh: 认可在利用空间技术保护地球和推进更可持续的太空运营方面的领导地位。

paras.en: Hydrosat. Expanded the use of thermal infrared satellite data for water, agriculture and climate applications while unveiling Osiris, a next-generation constellation designed to combine 25-meter thermal imagery with broad-area coverage and daily revisit.
paras.zh: 海德萨特。扩大了热红外卫星数据在水、农业和气候应用中的使用，同时推出了 Osiris，这是一个下一代星座，旨在将 25 米热图像与大面积覆盖和每日重访相结合。

paras.en: Space Data Association. Continued bringing satellite operators together to share operational data and promote collision avoidance, responsible operations and sustainable use of increasingly congested orbital environments.
paras.zh: 空间数据协会。继续将卫星运营商聚集在一起，共享运行数据并促进避免碰撞、负责任的运行和可持续利用日益拥挤的轨道环境。

paras.en: Vera C. Rubin Observatory. Began issuing real-time scientific alerts in February, creating a system expected to eventually generate millions of alerts each night about changing objects and events ranging from asteroids to supernovae.
paras.zh: 维拉·C·鲁宾天文台。从二月份开始发布实时科学警报，创建了一个系统，预计最终将在每晚生成数百万个关于从小行星到超新星等物体和事件变化的警报。

paras.en: Celebrating breakthroughs in exploration, science and public-sector space missions.
paras.zh: 庆祝探索、科学和公共部门太空任务方面的突破。

paras.en: Artemis 2 Team. Returned astronauts to the vicinity of the moon for the first time in more than half a century, carrying NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover and Christina Koch and Canadian astronaut Jeremy Hansen on a nearly 10-day flight around the moon aboard Orion. The April mission brought together NASA, international partners and a vast industrial team supporting Orion, the Space Launch System and ground systems.
paras.zh: 阿尔忒弥斯2小队。半个多世纪以来，宇航员首次返回月球附近，美国宇航局宇航员里德·怀斯曼、维克多·格洛弗、克里斯蒂娜·科赫以及加拿大宇航员杰里米·汉森乘坐猎户座飞船进行了近 10 天的绕月飞行。四月份的任务汇集了美国宇航局、国际合作伙伴以及支持猎户座、太空发射系统和地面系统的庞大工业团队。

paras.en: Copernicus Sentinel-1D Team. Brought Sentinel-1D into full operations in May, restoring and strengthening Europe’s flagship radar Earth observation capability and continuing more than a decade of global environmental monitoring through Copernicus.
paras.zh: 哥白尼哨兵-1D 团队。 Sentinel-1D 于 5 月全面投入运行，恢复和加强了欧洲旗舰雷达地球观测能力，并通过哥白尼继续进行了十多年的全球环境监测。

paras.en: Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope Team. Successfully launched NASA’s next flagship astrophysics observatory Aug. 30, beginning a mission designed to survey the universe far faster than Hubble while investigating dark energy, exoplanets and some of astronomy’s biggest unanswered questions.
paras.zh: 南希·格雷斯·罗马太空望远镜团队。 8 月 30 日成功发射了 NASA 的下一个旗舰天体物理观测站，开始了一项旨在以比哈勃望远镜快得多的速度观测宇宙的任务，同时研究暗能量、系外行星和一些天文学上尚未解答的最大问题。

paras.en: Recognizing individuals, organizations and missions making significant contributions to national security space capabilities.
paras.zh: 表彰对国家安全太空能力做出重大贡献的个人、组织和任务。

paras.en: Gurpartap “GP” Sandhoo. Took leadership of the Space Development Agency while also becoming the Space Force’s portfolio acquisition executive for missile warning and tracking, overseeing deployment of the Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture and its growing constellation of military satellites.
paras.zh: 古尔帕塔普·“GP”·桑胡。领导太空发展局，同时还成为太空部队负责导弹预警和跟踪的采购主管，监督扩散战士太空架构及其不断增长的军事卫星群的部署。

paras.en: Impulse Space. Expanded its national security role with a $28 million Space Force contract for a future space domain awareness mission using its highly maneuverable Mira spacecraft in low Earth orbit.
paras.zh: 脉冲空间。通过一份价值 2800 万美元的太空部队合同，扩大了其在国家安全方面的作用，该合同将使用其高度机动的 Mira 航天器在近地轨道上执行未来的太空领域感知任务。

paras.en: SpaceWERX. Continued using the Space Force’s small-business innovation programs to move emerging commercial technologies toward military applications and broaden the pool of companies contributing to national security space.
paras.zh: SpaceWERX。继续利用太空军的小型企业创新计划，将新兴商业技术推向军事应用，并扩大为国家安全领域做出贡献的公司群体。

paras.en: VICTUS HAZE Team. Demonstrated the Space Force’s most advanced tactically responsive space mission to date, with Rocket Lab and True Anomaly spacecraft supporting realistic rendezvous and proximity operations and space domain awareness scenarios after a rapid-response launch campaign.
paras.zh: VICTUS HAZE 团队。展示了太空军迄今为止最先进的战术响应太空任务，火箭实验室和真实异常航天器在快速响应发射活动后支持现实的交会和接近操作以及空间域感知场景。

paras.en: Join us for the 2026 SpaceNews Icon Awards in Washington, D.C., on Dec. 1.
paras.zh: 请与我们一起参加 12 月 1 日在华盛顿特区举行的 2026 年太空新闻偶像奖。

articles.title: Artemis II Crew Moon Photo Annotations
articles.author: HQ Web Team

paras.en: A visualization of a dark Moon eclipsing the Sun is marked with handwritten notes in this April 6, 2026, screenshot from an Artemis II crew member’s tablet.
paras.zh: 2026 年 4 月 6 日，阿尔忒弥斯二号机组成员平板电脑上的屏幕截图显示了暗月遮住太阳的可视化效果，并带有手写笔记。

paras.en: NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman (in blue) and Victor “Ike” Glover (in green) and CSA (Canadian Space Agency) Jeremy Hansen (in red) observed impact flashes and their locations, which are noted on the image. Overall, the astronauts reported seeing five extremely faint “pinprick” bursts of light from their view aboard Orion, which was 46,000 miles away from the Moon at the time. These flashes are sparked by rocky fragments hitting the Moon.
paras.zh: NASA 宇航员 Reid Wiseman（蓝色）、Victor“Ike”Glover（绿色）和 CSA（加拿大航天局）Jeremy Hansen（红色）观察到了撞击闪光及其位置，这些都在图像上注明。总体而言，宇航员报告称，他们在猎户座飞船上看到了五次极其微弱的“针刺”光线，当时猎户座飞船距离月球 46,000 英里。这些闪光是由撞击月球的岩石碎片引发的。

paras.en: From April 1 through April 10, 2026, NASA’s Artemis II crew traveled to the Moon and back and along the way, captured stunning imagery and scientific observations of our nearest neighbor. Now, the full lunar science dataset from their journey is available to the global science community, and to the public, for further study. Read about the report, listen to crew audio observations, and explore more.
paras.zh: 2026 年 4 月 1 日至 4 月 10 日，美国宇航局阿耳忒弥斯二号宇航员往返月球，沿途捕捉到了我们最近邻居的令人惊叹的图像和科学观察结果。现在，他们旅程中的完整月球科学数据集可供全球科学界和公众使用，以供进一步研究。阅读该报告，聆听机组人员的音频观察，并探索更多内容。

articles.title: NASA’s Curiosity Captures Dawn Breaking on Wind-Carved Cliffs

paras.en: NASA’s Curiosity Mars rover captured this panorama of sunrise illuminating distant, wind-carved features called yardangs on Aug. 11, 2026, the 4,982nd Martian day, or sol, of the mission. Scientists are eager to learn more about how the yardang layer formed.
paras.zh: 2026 年 8 月 11 日，即任务执行的第 4,982 个火星日（sol），NASA 的“好奇号”火星探测器拍摄了这张日出全景图，照亮了遥远的、被风雕刻的特征，称为“雅丹”。科学家们渴望更多地了解雅丹层是如何形成的。

paras.en: Figure A is a crop zooming in on the distant yardangs.
paras.zh: 图 A 是远处雅丹的作物放大图。

paras.en: Since 2014, Curiosity has been ascending 3-mile-tall (5-kilometer-tall) Mount Sharp, which is made up of a series of distinct layers that were deposited one on top of the other. In the area of the vast mountain’s shoulder where the rover is climbing, that stack of layers ends with the yardang layer. Before the yardang layer was laid down, Mount Sharp may have begun eroding, creating a gap in the otherwise continuous record of climate history that Curiosity has been reading from the layers. Scientists aren’t entirely sure how the layer formed; one theory is that it’s a pile of volcanic ash, similar to what’s seen along the Red Planet’s equator.
paras.zh: 自 2014 年以来，好奇号一直在攀登 3 英里（5 公里高）高的夏普山，该山由一系列不同的层组成，一层一层地沉积在一起。在漫游者正在攀爬的广阔山肩区域，这一层的堆叠以雅丹层结束。在雅丹层沉积之前，夏普山可能已经开始侵蚀，从而在好奇号从这些层中读取的气候历史记录中创造了一个空白，否则气候历史记录是连续的。科学家们并不完全确定该层是如何形成的。一种理论认为它是一堆火山灰，类似于在红色星球赤道上看到的情况。

paras.en: This panorama was captured by Curiosity’s Mastcam and is made up six individual images that were stitched together after being sent back to Earth. Unlike most of Curiosity’s Mastcam images, this one was processed without the usual white balancing, an artistic choice that preserves the early morning appearance.
paras.zh: 这张全景图是由好奇号的桅杆摄像机拍摄的，由六张单独的图像组成，这些图像在发送回地球后拼接在一起。与好奇号的大多数桅杆摄像头图像不同，这张图像的处理没有使用通常的白平衡，这是一种保留清晨外观的艺术选择。

paras.en: Curiosity was built by NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory, which is managed by Caltech in Pasadena, California. JPL leads the mission on behalf of NASA’s Science Mission Directorate in Washington as part of NASA’s Mars Exploration Program portfolio. Malin Space Science Systems in San Diego built and operates Mastcam.
paras.zh: 好奇号由美国宇航局喷气推进实验室建造，该实验室由位于加利福尼亚州帕萨迪纳的加州理工学院管理。作为 NASA 火星探索计划组合的一部分，喷气推进实验室代表位于华盛顿的 NASA 科学任务理事会领导这项任务。圣地亚哥的马林空间科学系统公司建造并运营桅杆摄像机。

articles.title: NASA’s Curiosity Looks Back After Reaching Elevation Milestone

paras.en: NASA’s Curiosity Mars rover captured this view looking back at the floor of Gale Crater, with the crater’s rim visible in the distance, on Sept. 5, 2026, the 5,006th Martian day, or sol, of the mission. Just nine days prior, on Aug. 26 (Sol 4,996), Curiosity set a mission milestone by reaching 1 kilometer of elevation above the crater floor. Since 2014, Curiosity has been climbing the lower foothills of Mount Sharp, a 3-mile-tall (5-kilometer-tall) mountain located within Gale Crater.
paras.zh: 2026 年 9 月 5 日，即任务执行的第 5006 个火星日，NASA 的好奇号火星探测器在回望盖尔陨石坑底部时捕捉到了这一景象，远处可以看到陨石坑的边缘。就在九天前的 8 月 26 日（太阳公历 4,996），好奇号到达了火山口地面上方 1 公里的高度，设定了一个任务里程碑。自 2014 年以来，好奇号一直在攀登夏普山的较低山麓，这是一座位于盖尔陨石坑内的 3 英里高（5 公里高）的山峰。

paras.en: A sand ridge extends across the foreground of the image, and a trench left by the rover’s right front wheel is visible at right. Geologic layering inside the ridge, as well as the size and composition of its sand grains, will provide clues to how the feature formed.
paras.zh: 沙脊延伸穿过图像的前景，右侧可以看到火星车右前轮留下的沟槽。山脊内部的地质分层及其沙粒的大小和成分将为了解该特征的形成方式提供线索。

paras.en: This panorama is made up of 95 individual images taken by Curiosity’s Mast Camera, or Mastcam. The color in these images has been adjusted to match the lighting conditions as the human eye would see them on Earth.
paras.zh: 这张全景图由好奇号的桅杆相机 (Mastcam) 拍摄的 95 张单独图像组成。这些图像中的颜色已经过调整，以匹配人眼在地球上看到的照明条件。

paras.en: Curiosity was built by NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory, which is managed by Caltech in Pasadena, California. JPL leads the mission on behalf of NASA’s Science Mission Directorate in Washington as part of NASA’s Mars Exploration Program portfolio. Malin Space Science Systems in San Diego built and operates Mastcam.
paras.zh: 好奇号由美国宇航局喷气推进实验室建造，该实验室由位于加利福尼亚州帕萨迪纳的加州理工学院管理。作为 NASA 火星探索计划组合的一部分，喷气推进实验室代表位于华盛顿的 NASA 科学任务理事会领导这项任务。圣地亚哥的马林空间科学系统公司建造并运营桅杆摄像机。

articles.title: Reform, or lose trust: Governments press the UN to reflect the world as it is

paras.en: Reform, or lose trust: Governments press the UN to reflect the world as it is
paras.zh: 要么改革，要么失去信任：各国政府敦促联合国反映世界的本来面目

paras.en: Can the UN still remain relevant if it still looks and acts like the organization it was when it was formed in 1945? The debate over UN reform at the General Assembly in New York last month produced a striking common refrain from a diverse range of Member States.
paras.zh: 如果联合国的外观和行为仍然与 1945 年成立时的组织一样，它还能保持其影响力吗？上个月在纽约举行的联合国大会上关于联合国改革的辩论引起了不同会员国的一致反对。

paras.en: Many governments believe the United Nations can only remain credible and effective if its institutions better reflect the realities of the 21st century.
paras.zh: 许多政府认为，只有联合国机构能够更好地反映 21 世纪的现实，联合国才能保持可信和有效。

paras.en: From questions of Security Council representation to institutional effectiveness, delegates repeatedly returned to the relationship between power, fairness and legitimacy.
paras.zh: 从安理会代表性问题到机构有效性问题，代表们反复回到权力、公平与合法性之间的关系。

paras.en: For this third and final analysis piece highlighting key themes, UN News looked at some of the speeches during the annual General Debate of the 193 Member States attending the UN General Assembly.
paras.zh: 对于第三篇也是最后一篇强调关键主题的分析文章，《联合国新闻》研究了参加联合国大会的 193 个会员国在年度一般性辩论期间的一些演讲。

paras.en: As Secretary-General António Guterres put it: “The United Nations exists because power requires rules – and humanity needs a place where power answers to principle.”
paras.zh: 正如秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯所说：“联合国之所以存在，是因为权力需要规则——而人类需要一个权力服从原则的地方。”

paras.en: Security Council reform sat at the centre of discussions about UN reform.
paras.zh: 安理会改革是联合国改革讨论的核心。

paras.en: Speaker after speaker argued that representation and legitimacy can't be separated, and Africa's continued absence from permanent membership was a recurrent theme.
paras.zh: 一个又一个的发言者认为，代表性和合法性不能分开，而非洲持续缺席常任理事国身份是一个反复出现的主题。

paras.en: Kenya put it bluntly: “The equality proclaimed in this Assembly ends at the doors of the Security Council."
paras.zh: 肯尼亚直言不讳地说：“大会上宣布的平等止于安理会门口。”

paras.en: Guyana made a similar case for the wider world: “We need a Security Council that reflects the geopolitical realities of the 21st century, not the power structures of 1945; a Council that embraces the emerging multipolarity of our world, including permanent representation from Africa, and Latin America and the Caribbean.”
paras.zh: 圭亚那为更广泛的世界提出了类似的理由：“我们需要一个反映21世纪地缘政治现实的安理会，而不是1945年的权力结构；一个拥抱我们世界正在出现的多极化的安理会，包括来自非洲、拉丁美洲和加勒比地区的常任代表。”

paras.en: The UN chief Mr. Guterres agreed, calling the status quo indefensible: “A 21st century Security Council without permanent African seats is unjust and indefensible.”
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长古特雷斯先生对此表示同意，并称现状是站不住脚的：“21世纪的安理会没有非洲常任理事国席位，这是不公正和站不住脚的。”

paras.en: General Assembly President Khalilur Rahman echoed this sentiment: “Africa cannot be asked to wait indefinitely for its rightful place on the Council.”
paras.zh: 大会主席哈利勒·拉赫曼也表达了同样的观点：“不能要求非洲无限期地等待其在安理会的合法席位。”

paras.en: Consensus on reform, disagreement over how
paras.zh: 改革达成共识，改革方式存在分歧

paras.en: While support for reform was widespread, governments proposed different solutions.
paras.zh: 尽管改革得到广泛支持，但各国政府提出了不同的解决方案。

paras.en: Spain went furthest, calling for both fairer regional representation and scrapping the veto outright: “We need to reform the Security Council so that all of the regions in the world have fair representation, and so that we can do away with the right of veto of the permanent members.”
paras.zh: 西班牙走得最远，呼吁更公平的地区代表性并彻底废除否决权：“我们需要改革安理会，以便世界上所有地区都有公平的代表性，这样我们就可以废除常任理事国的否决权。”

paras.en: Russia, one of the five Permanent Members of the Council, took a more cautious approach backing “the expansion of representation by Asia, Africa and Latin America” but adding that reforms shouldn't “undermine the intergovernmental nature of the UN system or erode the prerogatives of the UN Security Council and its Permanent Members."
paras.zh: 作为安理会五个常任理事国之一的俄罗斯采取了更为谨慎的态度，支持“扩大亚洲、非洲和拉丁美洲的代表性”，但补充说，改革不应“破坏联合国系统的政府间性质或削弱联合国安理会及其常任理事国的特权”。

paras.en: A second thread ran through the week: Trust, and how easily it erodes when rules get applied selectively.
paras.zh: 本周的第二个主题是：信任，以及当有选择地应用规则时信任是多么容易被侵蚀。

paras.en: Hungary argued cooperation and self-interest aren't actually in opposition: “We believe that national interest and international cooperation do not have to stand against each other,” adding that “the United Nations cannot demand trust. It must earn it.”
paras.zh: 匈牙利认为，合作和自身利益实际上并不对立：“我们认为，国家利益和国际合作不必相互对立”，并补充说，“联合国不能要求信任。它必须赢得信任。”

paras.en: Several delegations linked public confidence in international institutions to the consistent application of rules and principles. Concerns were raised about unequal treatment, selective implementation of international law and failures to respond effectively to crises.
paras.zh: 一些代表团将公众对国际机构的信心与规则和原则的一致适用联系起来。人们对不平等待遇、选择性实施国际法以及未能有效应对危机表示担忧。

paras.en: While the UN has championed its UN80 Initiative, that aims to make the United Nations more coherent, effective and responsive to today's challenges, countries also offered competing visions of operational reform.
paras.zh: 尽管联合国大力倡导其联合国80周年倡议，该倡议旨在使联合国更加协调一致、更加有效并能够更好地应对当今的挑战，但各国也提出了相互竞争的业务改革愿景。

paras.en: Switzerland and Costa Rica emphasized clear priorities, efficiency and measurable results.
paras.zh: 瑞士和哥斯达黎加强调明确的优先事项、效率和可衡量的成果。

paras.en: The President of the General Assembly highlighted overlapping mandates, bureaucratic silos and the need for better coordination at the country level.
paras.zh: 大会主席强调了任务授权重叠、官僚主义孤岛以及在国家一级加强协调的必要性。

paras.en: However, several speakers warned against treating reform as a cost-cutting exercise.
paras.zh: 然而，一些发言者警告不要将改革视为削减成本的做法。

paras.en: China said reform should improve institutional performance rather than merely reduce budgets and mandates.
paras.zh: 中国表示，改革应该提高机构绩效，而不仅仅是减少预算和任务。

paras.en: Guyana argued that resources should match the responsibilities assigned to the Organization.
paras.zh: 圭亚那认为，资源应与分配给本组织的职责相匹配。

paras.en: Spain called for United Nations agencies, funds and programmes to receive more resources and greater executive capacity.
paras.zh: 西班牙呼吁联合国各机构、基金和方案获得更多资源和更强的执行能力。

paras.en: The differences were not simply about spending. They concerned what the United Nations should do, how much authority it should have and whether better delivery requires stronger operational capacity – or a narrower institutional role.
paras.zh: 差异不仅仅在于支出。他们关心的是联合国应该做什么、应该拥有多大的权力以及更好的交付是否需要更强的行动能力 — — 或者更窄的机构作用。

paras.en: A recurring question throughout the debate was not whether the United Nations should exist, but whether it can produce results.
paras.zh: 辩论中反复出现的一个问题不是联合国是否应该存在，而是它能否产生成果。

paras.en: General Assembly President Rahman put it most sharply: “Outside these walls, people are not asking whether the United Nations still exists. They are asking whether it works.” He maintained that it is people which matter, not process: “Every penny must be invested to achieve impact on the ground for the people we serve.”
paras.zh: 大会主席拉赫曼说得最尖锐：“在高墙之外，人们不是在问联合国是否仍然存在。他们是在问它是否有效。”他坚持认为，重要的是人，而不是过程：“每一分钱都必须投入到为我们所服务的人们产生实际影响。”

paras.en: The United States offered a contrasting model based on institutional retrenchment: “We cut the UN budget for the first time ever, slashing it by 15 percent in 2026 and eliminating more than 4,000 positions from the UN bureaucracy,” while rejecting international involvement in areas considered national prerogatives.
paras.zh: 美国提供了一个基于机构紧缩的对比模式：“我们有史以来第一次削减联合国预算，到2026年将其削减15%，并从联合国官僚机构中裁减4000多个职位”，同时拒绝国际社会参与被视为国家特权的领域。

paras.en: For all the disagreement over vetoes, institutional power and competing reform models, delegates kept circling back to the same core concern.
paras.zh: 尽管在否决权、机构权力和相互竞争的改革模式等问题上存在分歧，代表们却不断回到同一个核心问题上。

paras.en: Namely that the scale of today's problems has outgrown the structures meant to solve them and that Member States need to work towards building a more resilient and effective organization.
paras.zh: 也就是说，当今问题的规模已经超出了旨在解决这些问题的结构，会员国需要努力建立一个更有弹性和更有效的组织。

paras.en: As Guyana noted: “This is why we must not abandon multilateralism because it is imperfect; we must renew it because humanity still needs it.”
paras.zh: 正如圭亚那指出的：“这就是为什么我们不能放弃多边主义，因为它不完美；我们必须更新它，因为人类仍然需要它。”

articles.title: Critical funding gap threatens health response in Yemen

paras.en: Critical funding gap threatens health response in Yemen
paras.zh: 严重的资金缺口威胁也门的卫生反应

paras.en: Renewed clashes between Saudi-backed Yemeni Government forces and Houthi rebels supported by Iran, have intensified in recent weeks.
paras.zh: 最近几周，沙特支持的也门政府军与伊朗支持的胡塞武装之间的冲突再次加剧。

paras.en: More than 200,000 people have been displaced, according to latest figures from UN migration agency, IOM, while close to 3,800 have fled to Djibouti across the Red Sea.
paras.zh: 根据联合国移民机构国际移民组织的最新数据，已有超过 20 万人流离失所，近 3,800 人越过红海逃往吉布提。

paras.en: WHO said its immediate funding requirements have increased from $9 million to $31 million. An additional $700,000 is also needed to support refugees in Djibouti.
paras.zh: 世卫组织表示，其当前的资金需求已从 900 万美元增加到 3100 万美元。还需要额外 70 万美元来支持吉布提的难民。

paras.en: “The situation is evolving into a complex emergency, with health needs rising as resources are already severely stretched,” said Dr. Syed Jaffar Hussain, WHO Representative in Yemen.
paras.zh: 世卫组织驻也门代表赛义德·贾法尔·侯赛因博士说：“局势正在演变为复杂的紧急情况，由于资源已经严重紧张，卫生需求不断增加。”

paras.en: Fighting has mainly occurred on the coast in Lahj governorate in southwestern Yemen near the strategic Bab al-Mandeb Strait, in neighbouring Taiz governorate and in Marib governorate in northern Yemen.
paras.zh: 战斗主要发生在也门西南部拉赫吉省靠近战略要地曼德海峡的海岸、邻近的塔伊兹省和也门北部的马里布省。

paras.en: As of 2 October, there were 959 reported deaths and 4,207 injuries across 10 governorates, according to the Yemeni health authorities.
paras.zh: 据也门卫生当局称，截至 10 月 2 日，10 个省报告了 959 人死亡、4,207 人受伤。

paras.en: Health services in conflict-affected governorates are struggling to cope with mounting needs. Nearly half of health facilities in these areas lack partner support, with critical gaps in frontline trauma care and outpatient services.
paras.zh: 受冲突影响省份的卫生服务正在努力满足日益增长的需求。这些地区近一半的医疗机构缺乏合作伙伴的支持，一线创伤护理和门诊服务存在严重缺口。

paras.en: “For people with severe injuries, access to trauma care within the first hour can determine whether they survive,” said Dr. Hussain.
paras.zh: “对于重伤的人来说，在第一个小时内获得创伤护理可以决定他们是否存活，”侯赛因博士说。

paras.en: “Yet trauma stabilization points on the Lahj coast and in Al-Dhale have no partners to operate them. Few agencies are able to provide trauma care, leaving critical gaps along the front lines.”
paras.zh: “然而，Lahj 海岸和 Al-Dhale 的创伤稳定点没有合作伙伴来运营。很少有机构能够提供创伤护理，从而在前线留下了严重的空白。”

paras.en: WHO noted that displaced families are among those most affected. Of the nearly 198,000 people who have been uprooted, less than one per cent had received health services as of last week.
paras.zh: 世卫组织指出，流离失所的家庭是受影响最严重的群体之一。截至上周，在近 198,000 名背井离乡者中，只有不到 1% 的人获得了医疗服务。

paras.en: Hospitals are facing shortages of surgical supplies, anaesthetics, blood-bank materials and fuel, while delivery of essential supplies is becoming slower and more expensive. Emergency maternity services have also been suspended in Marib and Ras Al-Arah in Lahj governorate.
paras.zh: 医院正面临手术用品、麻醉剂、血库材料和燃料的短缺，而基本用品的运送速度变得越来越慢、越来越昂贵。拉赫吉省的马里布和拉斯阿拉赫的紧急产妇服务也已暂停。

paras.en: Meanwhile, disease outbreaks are further complicating the emergency response. Cholera cases have tripled in three weeks, including infections detected in displacement camps, while dengue and malaria cases are also rising.
paras.zh: 与此同时，疾病爆发使应急响应进一步复杂化。霍乱病例在三周内增加了两倍，其中包括在流离失所者营地发现的感染病例，而登革热和疟疾病例也在增加。

paras.en: More than 22,000 suspected measles cases and 128 deaths have been reported this year, as the disease spreads among unvaccinated displaced children. Malnutrition among these groups is also a growing concern. The coming El Niño is likely to worsen disease outbreaks and malnutrition.
paras.zh: 由于麻疹在未接种疫苗的流离失所儿童中传播，今年已报告了超过 22,000 例疑似麻疹病例和 128 人死亡。这些群体的营养不良也日益引起人们的关注。即将到来的厄尔尼诺现象可能会加剧疾病爆发和营养不良。

paras.en: WHO is preparing to scale up trauma and emergency care, outbreak response and essential health services and supplies, including maternal and newborn care services.
paras.zh: 世卫组织正准备扩大创伤和紧急护理、疫情应对以及基本卫生服务和用品，包括孕产妇和新生儿护理服务。

paras.en: As the main health coordinator in Yemen, the agency also acts as the provider of last resort where no partner can deliver services.
paras.zh: 作为也门的主要卫生协调员，该机构也是没有合作伙伴可以提供服务的最后手段的提供者。

paras.en: Yet without urgent additional financing, WHO warned that the gaps between available services and needs will continue to widen.
paras.zh: 然而，世卫组织警告称，如果不紧急提供额外资金，现有服务与需求之间的差距将继续扩大。

articles.title: Kenya races to trace all contacts after first Ebola death, WHO official says

paras.en: Kenya races to trace all contacts after first Ebola death, WHO official says
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织官员称，肯尼亚在首例埃博拉死亡事件后加紧追踪所有接触者

paras.en: Kenya’s first Ebola death has triggered a race to trace everyone the victim came into contact with, as the United Nations and partners provide full support, the World Health Organization’s (WHO) top official in the country has told UN News in her first interview on the case.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚首例埃博拉死亡病例引发了一场竞相追踪与受害者接触过的所有人的行动，世界卫生组织（WHO）驻该国高级官员在接受《联合国新闻》采访时表示，在联合国和合作伙伴的全力支持下，该国出现了首例埃博拉死亡病例。

paras.en: Speaking in Nairobi on Wednesday, WHO Representative Dr. Neema Rusibamayila Kimambo said the coming days would be decisive in preventing community spread of the Bundibugyo strain of the virus, which has now claimed its first life in Kenya.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织代表 Neema Rusibamayila Kimambo 博士周三在内罗毕发表讲话时表示，未来几天对于防止本迪布焦病毒株的社区传播至关重要，该病毒现已在肯尼亚首次出现。

paras.en: The victim, a local man who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) for several years, fell ill there, where a deadly outbreak continues to spread in the east.
paras.zh: 受害者是一名在刚果民主共和国生活了几年的当地男子，他在那里生病了，而致命的疫情仍在东部蔓延。

paras.en: He flew to Nairobi via Kampala and Entebbe in Uganda on 3 October, went straight to hospital and died in the Kenyan capital on Monday.
paras.zh: 他于10月3日经乌干达坎帕拉和恩德培飞往内罗毕，直接送往医院，并于周一在肯尼亚首都去世。

paras.en: Authorities have since identified the people who had come in direct contact with him from social contact and his admission to hospital. So far, there have been no other infections.
paras.zh: 此后，当局通过社交接触和他入院的情况确认了与他有直接接触的人。到目前为止，没有其他感染病例。

paras.en: “This is an outbreak of an imported case, one who came in and went straight to hospital, but the Government is working to identify all the relevant contacts as part of their response to this outbreak,” Dr Kimambo told UN News.
paras.zh: 金博博士告诉《联合国新闻》：“这是一次输入性病例的爆发，一名患者入境后直接送往医院，但政府正在努力查明所有相关接触者，作为应对此次疫情的一部分。”

paras.en: She said a list of contacts has been identified, including around 10 of the man’s relatives who “have been very cooperative, and some actually volunteered themselves and they are now already placed under quarantine.”
paras.zh: 她说，已经确定了一份接触者名单，其中包括该男子的大约 10 名亲戚，他们“一直非常合作，有些人实际上是自愿的，现在已经被隔离。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, 21 health workers who served him in hospital, as well as lab nurses and others, have also been contacted.
paras.zh: 与此同时，我们还联系了在医院为他提供服务的 21 名卫生工作者以及实验室护士和其他人员。

paras.en: Even though these professionals used infection prevention and control (IPC) measures, “the plan is to make sure that they are all under quarantine and decisions have already been made where the staff of the Nairobi Hospital are to be quarantined,” she said.
paras.zh: 她说，尽管这些专业人员采取了感染预防和控制（IPC）措施，但“计划是确保他们都受到隔离，并且已经做出了隔离内罗毕医院工作人员的决定”。

paras.en: The Kenyan Government is also working with the airline to contact the roughly 23 passengers and four crew members who were on the flight from Entebbe to Kampala.
paras.zh: 肯尼亚政府还与该航空公司合作，联系从恩德培飞往坎帕拉航班上的约 23 名乘客和 4 名机组人员。

paras.en: She said the Government was making “every effort” to find all possible contacts: “Because to make sure that we contain this and we do not get community spread, it is critical that all contacts are identified and are quarantined.”
paras.zh: 她说，政府正在“尽一切努力”寻找所有可能的接触者：“为了确保我们遏制这种情况并且不会出现社区传播，因此识别所有接触者并进行隔离至关重要。”

paras.en: WHO is supporting Kenya, the DRC and Uganda in contact tracing, surveillance, screening and other response measures to rapidly identify potential cases and prevent any further spread of the virus.
paras.zh: 世卫组织正在支持肯尼亚、刚果民主共和国和乌干达采取接触者追踪、监测、筛查和其他应对措施，以快速识别潜在病例并防止病毒进一步传播。

paras.en: It is also working with the Africa CDC (Centres for Disease Control and Prevention) to both support Kenya and mobilise Member States.
paras.zh: 它还与非洲疾病预防控制中心（疾病控制和预防中心）合作，支持肯尼亚并动员会员国。

paras.en: Dr. Kimambo stressed that it is important for people to know how Ebola is spread, namely through contact with the bodily fluids of an infected person such as sweat, blood and saliva.
paras.zh: Kimambo 博士强调，人们了解埃博拉病毒如何传播非常重要，即通过接触感染者的体液（如汗液、血液和唾液）传播。

paras.en: She highlighted the need to “maintain utmost hygiene” through regular handwashing, use of hand sanitizers, and avoiding “a lot of hand holding”, in addition to identifying symptoms and seeking medical care early.
paras.zh: 她强调，除了识别症状并及早就医之外，还需要通过定期洗手、使用洗手液和避免“大量握手”来“保持最大的卫生”。

paras.en: “I think one key message is not to panic,” she said. “And the second one is let us take necessary precautions and quickly. If someone is feeling unwell, they should go to a health facility to seek care.”
paras.zh: “我认为一个关键信息是不要恐慌，”她说。 “第二个是让我们迅速采取必要的预防措施。如果有人感到不适，他们应该去医疗机构寻求治疗。”

paras.en: Even before the confirmed case in Kenya, WHO and other UN agencies were supporting Ebola preparedness in the country following its emergence in the DRC in May.
paras.zh: 早在肯尼亚出现确诊病例之前，世界卫生组织和其他联合国机构就已在刚果民主共和国五月份出现埃博拉病毒后支持该国的防备工作。

paras.en: The International Organization for Migration (IOM) monitored movements at borders, for example, while children’s agency UNICEF worked on community risk management and issues around water, sanitation and hygiene.
paras.zh: 例如，国际移民组织（IOM）监测边境流动，而儿童机构联合国儿童基金会则致力于社区风险管理以及水、环境卫生和个人卫生等问题。

paras.en: WHO focused on measures such as strengthening surveillance, training case managers and conducting simulation exercises.
paras.zh: 世卫组织重点采取加强监测、培训病例管理人员和开展模拟演习等措施。

paras.en: Asked about the risk of Ebola spreading in Kenya, Dr. Kimambo underlined the importance of quarantining so that contacts can be monitored and quickly tested should they develop symptoms.
paras.zh: 当被问及埃博拉病毒在肯尼亚传播的风险时，金博拉博士强调了隔离的重要性，以便对接触者进行监测，并在出现症状时进行快速检测。

paras.en: “I think these next few days are critical because we know the incubation period will start from between two to eight days,” she said.
paras.zh: “我认为接下来的几天至关重要，因为我们知道潜伏期将从两到八天开始，”她说。

paras.en: “If we are able to ensure that we do proper contact listing, get all contacts, put them in quarantine, then that will be the key to really contain and stop any community spread.”
paras.zh: “如果我们能够确保正确列出接触者名单，获取所有接触者，将他们隔离，那么这将是真正遏制和阻止任何社区传播的关键。”

articles.title: Rahm to quit LIV Golf over 'unacceptable' terms

paras.en: Jon Rahm to quit LIV Golf over 'unacceptable' terms for proposed relaunch
paras.zh: 乔恩·拉姆 (Jon Rahm) 因重新启动的条款“不可接受”而退出 LIV Golf

paras.en: Jon Rahm is set to quit LIV Golf after deeming the terms proposed to him for the relaunch of the series “unacceptable”; Rahm is reportedly owed up to $150m (£113m) from the contract he signed three years ago, with both sides now working towards a separation agreement
paras.zh: 乔恩·拉姆 (Jon Rahm) 认为向他提出的重新启动该系列赛的条款“不可接受”，因此决定退出 LIV Golf。据报道，拉姆在三年前签署的合同中欠下高达 1.5 亿美元（1.13 亿英镑）的债务，双方目前正在努力达成分居协议

paras.en: Jon Rahm is to quit LIV Golf after deeming the terms offered for the proposed relaunch of the breakaway series “unacceptable”.
paras.zh: 乔恩·拉姆 (Jon Rahm) 认为重新启动该系列赛所提出的条款“不可接受”，因此将退出 LIV Golf。

paras.en: LIV Golf is currently going through Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceedings in the US after Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund withdrew its support at the end of the season, having invested $5bn (£3.7bn) over four years.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯公共投资基金在赛季结束时撤回了对 LIV Golf 的支持，该基金在四年内投资了 50 亿美元（37 亿英镑），目前正在美国按照第 11 章破产程序进行破产程序。

paras.en: While players including Sergio Garcia successfully petitioned the court to lift the automatic stay on their contracts, effectively freeing them to explore other opportunities for next year, Rahm was not granted the same route out.
paras.zh: 虽然包括塞尔吉奥·加西亚在内的球员成功向法院请求解除合同的自动中止，从而有效地让他们在明年探索其他机会，但拉姆却没有获得同样的解约途径。

paras.zh: - 天空体育直播哪些高尔夫比赛以及何时直播？完整电视节目表

paras.en: The Spaniard is one of LIV Golf's two biggest names, alongside Bryson DeChambeau, and is reportedly owed up to $150m (£113m) for the remainder of the contract he signed almost three years ago.
paras.zh: 这位西班牙人是 LIV Golf 的两名大牌球员之一，与布莱森·德尚博 (Bryson DeChambeau) 并列，据报道，他三年前签署的合同剩余部分的欠款高达 1.5 亿美元（1.13 亿英镑）。

paras.en: "Mr Rahm has independently reviewed the proposed terms of LIV 2.0 and has determined that those terms are unacceptable to him, and he will not be participating going forward in LIV 2.0," attorney John Beck told a bankruptcy hearing.
paras.zh: 律师 John Beck 在破产听证会上表示：“Rahm 先生独立审查了 LIV 2.0 的拟议条款，并确定这些条款对他来说是不可接受的，因此他将不再参与 LIV 2.0。”

paras.en: The Athletic has also reported that Rahm and LIV are working towards a separation agreement, with a deal expected to be finalised by October 15.
paras.zh: 《The Athletic》还报道称，拉姆和 LIV 正在努力达成分居协议，预计该协议将于 10 月 15 日敲定。

paras.en: Rahm withdrew from this week's Open de Espana in Madrid to remain at home with wife Kelley, who is expecting their fourth child.
paras.zh: 拉姆退出了本周在马德里举行的西班牙公开赛，留在家里与即将生下第四个孩子的妻子凯莉在一起。

paras.en: The 31-year-old has already taken steps towards a potential return to the traditional tours. In May, he ended his dispute with the DP World Tour and paid around £2.21m in fines for playing in conflicting events, securing conditional releases for 2026 and making him eligible for the Ryder Cup.
paras.zh: 这位 31 岁的选手已经采取措施，有可能重返传统巡回赛。今年 5 月，他结束了与 DP 世界巡回赛的纠纷，并因参加冲突赛事支付了约 221 万英镑的罚款，获得了 2026 年有条件释放的资格，并获得了参加莱德杯的资格。

paras.en: Rahm previously declined the PGA Tour's offer of reinstatement through a specially created Returning Member Program, which was made available to him, Cameron Smith, Bryson DeChambeau and Brooks Koepka. Koepka was the only player to accept.
paras.zh: 拉姆此前拒绝了美巡赛通过专门制定的回归会员计划恢复的提议，该计划向他、卡梅伦·史密斯、布赖森·德尚博和布鲁克斯·科普卡提供。科普卡是唯一接受的球员。

paras.en: As a result, Rahm would face a mandatory one-year suspension before being eligible to return to the PGA Tour, meaning he could not play on the circuit until late August next year.
paras.zh: 因此，拉姆在有资格重返美巡赛之前将面临强制禁赛一年，这意味着他要到明年八月下旬才能参加巡回赛。

articles.title: Garcia targets Ryder Cup return

paras.en: Ryder Cup 2027: Sergio Garcia targets European team spot and refuses to rule out PGA Tour return
paras.zh: 2027 年莱德杯：塞尔吉奥·加西亚瞄准欧洲队席位并拒绝排除美巡赛回归的可能性

paras.en: Sergio Garcia is targeting a return to the European Ryder Cup team for the 2027 tournament at Adare Manor, with the Spaniard also refusing to rule out a return to the PGA Tour watch the Open de Espana live on Sky Sports Golf from Thursday at 1pm
paras.zh: 塞尔吉奥·加西亚 (Sergio Garcia) 的目标是重返欧洲莱德杯队参加在阿黛尔庄园 (Adare Manor) 举行的 2027 年比赛，西班牙人也拒绝排除重返 PGA 巡回赛的可能性，并从周四下午 1 点开始在天空体育高尔夫直播观看西班牙公开赛

paras.en: Sergio Garcia is desperate to be involved in next year's Ryder Cup, either as a player or vice-captain, with his time on LIV Golf appearing to be coming to an end.
paras.zh: 塞尔吉奥·加西亚 (Sergio Garcia) 迫切希望以球员或副队长的身份参加明年的莱德杯，而他在 LIV Golf 的时光似乎即将结束。

paras.en: The Saudi-backed breakaway league filed for bankruptcy last month, with its restructuring plan likely to release players from their existing contracts ahead of a potential LIV 2.0 relaunch.
paras.zh: 沙特支持的脱离联盟上个月申请破产，其重组计划可能会在 LIV 2.0 重新启动之前解除球员现有合同。

paras.en: This week, Garcia successfully secured a court ruling to lift an automatic stay on his contract, allowing him to seriously consider his options for 2027.
paras.zh: 本周，加西亚成功获得法院裁决，解除合同自动中止，使他能够认真考虑 2027 年的选择。

paras.en: Europe's all-time leading Ryder Cup points scorer now has his sights firmly set on Adare Manor next September.
paras.zh: 这位欧洲历史上莱德杯得分王现在将目光坚定地瞄准了明年九月的阿黛尔庄园。

paras.en: "I think everything is an option," he told a press conference at the Open de Espana in Madrid.
paras.zh: “我认为一切都是一种选择，”他在马德里西班牙公开赛的新闻发布会上说。

paras.en: "That doesn't mean I won't go or that I'll definitely stay with LIV, but settling the LIV 1.0 matter now avoids potential repercussions related to that contract.
paras.zh: “这并不意味着我不会去，也不意味着我一定会留在 LIV，但现在解决 LIV 1.0 问题可以避免与该合同相关的潜在影响。

paras.en: "I don't really know how things will end up with the DP World Tour regarding LIV 2.0, we'll have to see, [but] I want to try and give myself the best chance of making that team.
paras.zh: “我真的不知道关于 LIV 2.0 的 DP 世界巡演结果会如何，我们必须拭目以待，[但]我想尝试给自己最好的机会加入该团队。

paras.en: "Everyone knows how much I love the Ryder Cup and the possibility of playing in another one, or if not, finding some way to help in another way, as vice-captain or something like that could be something very interesting."
paras.zh: “每个人都知道我有多喜欢莱德杯，也知道参加另一场比赛的可能性，或者如果没有，找到某种方式以另一种方式提供帮助，作为副队长或类似的事情可能会非常有趣。”

paras.en: Garcia, who has spoken to European captain Luke Donald, added: "I told him that I'm going to do everything possible to see if I can get into that team and I also told him that if I don't get into that team, I'll help in any way I can."
paras.zh: 加西亚曾与欧洲队队长卢克·唐纳德交谈过，他补充道：“我告诉他，我将尽一切努力看看我是否能进入那支球队，我还告诉他，如果我不能进入那支球队，我会尽我所能提供帮助。”

paras.en: The 2017 Masters champion would first need to regain his DP World Tour membership.
paras.zh: 这位2017年大师赛冠军首先需要重新获得DP世界巡回赛会员资格。

paras.en: Garcia resigned his membership in 2023 after being sanctioned for playing in conflicting LIV events. He later paid around £750,000 in fines in an unsuccessful bid to qualify for the Ryder Cup at Bethpage last year, but ultimately lost his card after failing to meet the minimum number of events.
paras.zh: 加西亚因参加冲突的 LIV 赛事而受到制裁，并于 2023 年辞去会员资格。去年，他在贝斯佩奇争夺莱德杯参赛资格的失败中支付了约 75 万英镑的罚款，但最终因未达到最低赛事数量而失去了参赛资格。

paras.en: Garcia has also not ruled out a return to the PGA Tour, although under its rules he would have to serve a suspension until August.
paras.zh: 加西亚也不排除重返美巡赛的可能性，尽管根据其规则，他必须停赛至八月。

paras.en: "It's definitely a possibility. I turn 47 in January, and the Champions Tour is a possibility," he said.
paras.zh: “这绝对是有可能的。一月份我就47岁了，冠军巡回赛是有可能的，”他说。

paras.en: "Besides, I'd like the chance to play some of those tournaments, especially the big ones on the Champions Tour. These are things that I'm starting to consider at my age."
paras.zh: “此外，我希望有机会参加其中一些比赛，尤其是冠军巡回赛中的大型比赛。这些是我在我这个年纪开始考虑的事情。”

articles.title: Late-night Fury vs Joshua ringwalk application submitted

paras.en: Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua: Cardiff Council asked to approve 1am ringwalk at Principality Stadium
paras.zh: 泰森·富里 vs 安东尼·约书亚：卡迪夫议会要求批准凌晨 1 点在公国体育场进行环形走道

paras.en: An application has been made to Cardiff Council for the ringwalk for the Tyson Fury vs Anthony Joshua fight to take place at 1am; They would like the premises also open until 3.30am; It has been described as a 'very limited, one-off occasion'
paras.zh: 已向卡迪夫市政府申请在凌晨 1 点举行泰森·富里 (Tyson Fury) 与安东尼·约书亚 (Anthony Joshua) 比赛的拳击场；他们希望营业场所也开放至凌晨 3.30 点；它被描述为“非常有限的一次性场合”

paras.en: Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua are set for a 1am ringwalk in their heavyweight boxing clash in Cardiff.
paras.zh: 泰森·富里和安东尼·约书亚将于凌晨 1 点在卡迪夫举行重量级拳击比赛。

paras.en: The Principality Stadium will host the biggest fight in British boxing history, with the bout being billed as taking place on Friday December 11.
paras.zh: 公国体育场将举办英国拳击史上规模最大的一场比赛，这场比赛预计将于 12 月 11 日周五举行。

paras.en: However, the expected schedule for the showdown has now been revealed, which will see the main event take place in the early hours of Saturday morning UK time.
paras.zh: 然而，对决的预期时间表现已公布，主要赛事将在英国时间周六凌晨举行。

paras.en: - Fury vs Joshua: Have your say - who wins the mega-fight?
paras.zh: - 富里 vs 约书亚：你说说看 - 谁赢得了这场大战？

paras.en: - Denzel Bentley fighting to keep world title with WBO appeal
paras.zh: - 丹泽尔·本特利 (Denzel Bentley) 向 WBO 上诉，力争保住世界冠军头衔

paras.en: - Bentley to fight Mosley Jr on November 7 live on Sky Sports
paras.zh: - 本特利将于 11 月 7 日在天空体育直播对阵小莫斯利

paras.en: - Follow boxing for news and highlights in the free Sky Sports app
paras.zh: - 在免费的天空体育应用程序中关注拳击新闻和亮点

paras.en: An application to Cardiff Council confirmed the ringwalk is planned to start at around 1am, after a short live music performance, and the stadium will remain open until 3.30am.
paras.zh: 向卡迪夫市议会提交的申请确认，环形步道计划在短暂的现场音乐表演后于凌晨 1 点左右开始，体育场将开放至凌晨 3.30。

paras.en: Those timings would suit peak viewing time in the United States, with Saudi Arabia's boxing supremo Turki Alalshikh, his American business partner Dana White and broadcasters Netflix having originally pushed for New York's Madison Square Garden as the venue.
paras.zh: 这些时间安排将适合美国的观看高峰时间，沙特阿拉伯拳击霸主图尔基·阿拉什赫(Turki Alalshikh)、他的美国商业伙伴达纳·怀特(Dana White)和广播公司Netflix最初推动将纽约麦迪逊广场花园作为比赛场地。

paras.en: Despite Cardiff being announced as the venue last month, required changes to its premises licence to allow the early-hours fight to go ahead have yet to be secured.
paras.zh: 尽管卡迪夫上个月被宣布为比赛场地，但为允许凌晨比赛继续进行而需要更改其场地许可证的要求尚未确定。

paras.en: In a bid to obtain the necessary permissions, Millennium Stadium plc has applied to the council to extend timings at the venue "on a very limited one-off occasion".
paras.zh: 为了获得必要的许可，千禧体育场有限公司已向理事会申请“在非常有限的一次性情况下”延长场馆的开放时间。

paras.en: The application seeks to extend permitted hours for boxing and wrestling entertainment from an existing cut-off of 1am to 3am on December 12.
paras.zh: 该申请旨在将拳击和摔跤娱乐的允许时间从现有的 12 月 12 日凌晨 1 点延长至凌晨 3 点。

paras.en: A council spokesperson said: "This is to facilitate the proposed Anthony Joshua v Tyson Fury bout, with the ringwalk commencing at 1am."
paras.zh: 市议会发言人表示：“这是为了促进拟议的安东尼·约书亚与泰森·富里的比赛，环道将于凌晨 1 点开始。”

paras.en: The licence variation seeks an extension for live music on the same date, to facilitate a short live performance immediately before the ring walk.
paras.zh: 许可证的变更寻求延长同一日期的现场音乐表演，以便在环形步行之前进行简短的现场表演。

paras.en: It also proposes an extension for recorded music, late-night refreshment and supply of alcohol until 3am, with the stadium closing time being moved to 3.30am.
paras.zh: 它还建议将录制的音乐、深夜茶点和酒精供应延长至凌晨 3 点，并将体育场关闭时间移至凌晨 3.30。

paras.en: The applicants added that the roof will be shut throughout the event and enhanced security and stewarding arrangements will be in place.
paras.zh: 申请人补充说，屋顶将在整个活动期间关闭，并将加强安全和管理安排。

paras.en: An application to vary a premises licence must be advertised, including by displaying a notice at or on the premises, for 28 consecutive days.
paras.zh: 变更营业场所许可证的申请必须连续 28 天进行公告，包括在营业场所内或场所内张贴通知。

paras.en: Members of the public and other authorities may make an objection to the Principality Stadium application, or a comment in support, until November 3.
paras.zh: 公众和其他当局可以在 11 月 3 日之前对公国体育场的申请提出反对或支持评论。

paras.en: If no relevant representations are received, the council must grant the application.
paras.zh: 如果没有收到相关陈述，理事会必须批准该申请。

paras.en: If objections are made, then a council hearing will be held to consider them.
paras.zh: 如果有人提出反对，那么将举行理事会听证会来考虑这些反对意见。

paras.en: This may result in modifications to the conditions of the licence, or the application may be refused altogether.
paras.zh: 这可能会导致许可证条件的修改，或者申请可能会被完全拒绝。

paras.en: After the fight was announced last month, Cardiff Council leader Chris Weaver said: "The contest at Principality Stadium has the potential to bring significant economic benefits to the city and attract visitors from across the UK and beyond.
paras.zh: 上个月宣布这场比赛后，卡迪夫市议会领导人克里斯·韦弗表示：“在公国体育场举行的比赛有可能为这座城市带来巨大的经济效益，并吸引来自英国各地及其他地区的游客。

paras.en: "Major events provide a welcome boost for local businesses, support jobs and showcase Cardiff to a global audience.
paras.zh: “重大活动为当地企业提供了受欢迎的推动力，支持就业并向全球观众展示卡迪夫。

paras.en: "There are still some arrangements to be finalised with the organisers, including any required changes to Principality Stadium's premises licence, but we are looking forward to welcoming fans to the city for what promises to be an unforgettable night of boxing."
paras.zh: “仍有一些安排需要与组织者敲定，包括对公国体育场场地许可证的任何必要变更，但我们期待着欢迎球迷来到这座城市，度过一个难忘的拳击之夜。”
