articles.title: Russian strikes on Ukrainian cities kill at least 21 in a major attack that Kyiv saw coming

paras.en: KYIV, Ukraine — Russian missiles and drones pounded Kyiv and a dozen other Ukrainian regions overnight into Wednesday, killing at least 21 civilians, including four children, and wounding around 60 in Moscow’s latest devastating barrage, Ukrainian officials said.
paras.zh: 乌克兰基辅——乌克兰官员称，俄罗斯导弹和无人机连夜袭击了基辅和乌克兰其他十几个地区，造成至少 21 名平民死亡，其中包括 4 名儿童，在莫斯科最新的毁灭性攻击中，约 60 人受伤。

paras.en: Ukraine had anticipated the attack, with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy warning the previous day that intelligence services had concluded that Russia was building up for a “massive” strike.
paras.zh: 乌克兰已经预料到了这次袭击，总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基前一天警告说，情报部门得出的结论是，俄罗斯正在为一场“大规模”袭击做准备。

paras.en: Although Ukraine knew about the looming attack, which coincided with Russian President Vladimir Putin’s 74th birthday, it couldn’t fend it off completely.
paras.zh: 尽管乌克兰知道即将发生的袭击事件，且恰逢俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京 (Vladimir Putin) 74 岁生日，但它无法完全抵御。

paras.en: Russian strikes kill at least 21, wound 60 across Ukraine
paras.zh: 俄罗斯空袭乌克兰各地，造成至少21人死亡、60人受伤

paras.en: The deaths and damage illustrated the difficulty Ukraine has in countering Russia’s ballistic missiles and the new jet-powered drones used in Moscow’s escalating bombardments. Without ammunition for its U.S.-made Patriot air defense systems, Ukraine can’t stop Russian ballistic weapons. It is racing to develop a new generation of interceptors fast enough to catch Moscow’s high-flying jet-propelled drones.
paras.zh: 这些死亡和损失表明，乌克兰在对抗俄罗斯的弹道导弹和莫斯科不断升级的轰炸中使用的新型喷气式无人机方面遇到了困难。如果没有美制爱国者防空系统的弹药，乌克兰就无法阻止俄罗斯的弹道武器。它正在竞相开发新一代拦截器，其速度足以捕获莫斯科高空飞行的喷气式无人机。

paras.en: Russia and Ukraine are engaged in a long-range aerial war as their armies remain largely deadlocked on the battlefield, more than 4 ½ years after Moscow’s all-out invasion of its neighbor. The unrelenting aerial attacks are hurting Russia but could be ruinous for smaller Ukraine.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰正在进行一场远程空战，距离莫斯科全面入侵其邻国已有 4.5 年多，两国军队在战场上基本陷入僵局。无情的空袭正在伤害俄罗斯，但对较小的乌克兰来说可能是毁灭性的。

paras.en: U.S.-led peace efforts appear unlikely to bring any short-term relief, with the possibility of holding low-level technical talks still under discussion. Putin, meanwhile, is pressing ahead with the invasion in the belief that Ukrainians will buckle under the pressure and Kyiv’s Western supporters won’t stay the course, Western analysts say.
paras.zh: 美国领导的和平努力似乎不太可能带来任何短期缓解，举行低级别技术会谈的可能性仍在讨论中。与此同时，西方分析人士表示，普京正在推进入侵行动，因为他相信乌克兰人会在压力下屈服，而基辅的西方支持者也不会坚持到底。

paras.en: “Russia is pursuing a deliberate strategy of terror,” European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said on X. “Trying to make daily life impossible for Ukrainians who want to live in peace.”
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会主席乌尔苏拉·冯德莱恩 (Ursula von der Leyen) 在 X 上表示：“俄罗斯正在推行蓄意的恐怖战略。试图让想要和平生活的乌克兰人的日常生活变得不可能。”

paras.en: Russia wants Ukrainians to be afraid to fall asleep, official says
paras.zh: 官员称俄罗斯希望乌克兰人不敢入睡

paras.en: A Russian strike destroyed an apartment block in Pryluky, in Ukraine’s northern Chernihiv region, killing 15 people, including four children, and wounding about 50, authorities said.
paras.zh: 当局称，俄罗斯的一次空袭摧毁了乌克兰北部切尔尼戈夫地区普雷卢基的一座公寓楼，造成 15 人死亡，其中包括 4 名儿童，约 50 人受伤。

paras.en: Deaths were also reported in three other Ukrainian cities, including the capital Kyiv, according to Zelenskyy.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，包括首都基辅在内的其他三个乌克兰城市也报告了死亡病例。

paras.en: “The Russians wanted to strike painfully and demonstratively,” the Ukrainian leader said on social media.
paras.zh: 这位乌克兰领导人在社交媒体上表示：“俄罗斯人想要进行痛苦且示威性的打击。”

paras.en: Ukraine is looking worldwide for available Patriot missiles, which are in short supply due to the Iran war.
paras.zh: 乌克兰正在全球范围内寻找可用的爱国者导弹，该导弹由于伊朗战争而供应短缺。

paras.en: “Russian ballistic missiles remain the greatest challenge. And air defense packages for us right now are a vital necessity,” Zelenskyy said.
paras.zh: “俄罗斯弹道导弹仍然是最大的挑战。目前防空系统对我们来说至关重要，”泽伦斯基说。

paras.en: In Kremenchuk, in the Poltava region, two people were killed and seven injured, said Vitalii Diakivnych, head of the regional military administration, and a rescue operation was continuing.
paras.zh: 波尔塔瓦地区的克列缅丘克地区军事管理局局长维塔利·迪亚基夫内奇(Vitalii Diakivnych)表示，在波尔塔瓦地区的克列缅丘克，有两人死亡、七人受伤，救援行动仍在继续。

paras.en: “That is exactly what the enemy is counting on. For us to be afraid to fall asleep. To let our children out of our sight. To plan anything. So that everyone thinks: next time it could be my address,” he said.
paras.zh: “这正是敌人所指望的。让我们不敢入睡。让我们的孩子离开我们的视线。计划任何事情。这样每个人都会想：下次可能是我的演讲，”他说。

paras.en: Russia’s Defense Ministry said the military carried out a massive strike overnight targeting industrial facilities involved in the production and storage of missiles and drones across Ukraine. The ministry said that port and ship repair facilities in the southern Odesa region and ships carrying cargo for the Ukrainian military were also hit.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯国防部表示，军方连夜对乌克兰境内涉及导弹和无人机生产和储存的工业设施进行了大规模打击。该部表示，敖德萨南部地区的港口和船舶修理设施以及为乌克兰军方运送货物的船只也受到袭击。

paras.en: Ukraine strikes back with attacks on Russian oil facilities, Zelenskyy says
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，乌克兰对俄罗斯石油设施发动袭击进行反击

paras.en: Ukraine has hit back at Russia by launching long-range drones and missiles at oil refineries and storage depots.
paras.zh: 乌克兰通过向炼油厂和储油库发射远程无人机和导弹来回击俄罗斯。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said Wednesday that Ukraine targeted two oil facilities and a training ground in the Perm, Samara, and Astrakhan regions of Russia.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基周三表示，乌克兰的目标是俄罗斯彼尔姆、萨马拉和阿斯特拉罕地区的两个石油设施和一个训练场。

paras.en: Russian officials made no immediate comment.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯官员没有立即发表评论。

paras.en: Zelenskyy also indicated that Ukraine had struck in the Black Sea. He posted images of a fire said to show an oil tanker burning in the water near the Russian city of Sochi.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基还表示，乌克兰在黑海发动了袭击。他发布了火灾图像，据称显示一艘油轮在俄罗斯城市索契附近的水中燃烧。

paras.en: It was not possible to independently verify the images.
paras.zh: 无法独立验证这些图像。

paras.en: Some Russian online media late Tuesday also posted the images. Unconfirmed media reports said it was carrying oil from Novorossiysk to India and was attacked by Ukrainian sea drones.
paras.zh: 周二晚间，一些俄罗斯网络媒体也发布了这些图片。未经证实的媒体报道称，该船正在从新罗西斯克向印度运送石油，并遭到乌克兰海上无人机的袭击。

articles.title: Judge rules evidence from Christa Pike's botched execution be preserved

paras.en: A US judge has ordered the Tennessee Department of Correction to preserve all evidence related to the botched execution of Christa Pike.
paras.zh: 一名美国法官命令田纳西州惩教部保存与克里斯塔·派克处决失败有关的所有证据。

paras.en: The 50-year-old has been on death row since being convicted of the murder of classmate Colleen Slemmer in 1996.
paras.zh: 这位 50 岁的男子自 1996 年因谋杀同学科琳·斯莱默 (Colleen Slemmer) 被定罪以来一直被关在死囚牢房。

paras.en: The failed execution has renewed scrutiny of how US states carry out the death penalty, in particular the use of lethal injection.
paras.zh: 这次执行死刑的失败重新引发了人们对美国各州如何执行死刑，特别是注射死刑的审查。

paras.en: A judge in the US state of Tennessee has ordered authorities to preserve evidence related to the botched execution of convicted killer Christa Pike.
paras.zh: 美国田纳西州的一名法官下令当局保留与被定罪的杀手克里斯塔·派克处决失败有关的证据。

paras.en: The 50-year-old's lawyers filed an emergency court motion after Pike survived two doses of a lethal injection drug last week.
paras.zh: 上周，派克注射了两剂注射死刑药物，幸免于难，这位 50 岁的男子的律师向法院提出了紧急动议。

paras.en: She had been sentenced to death for the murder of a classmate, Colleen Slemmer, in 1996, a crime committed when she was 18 years old.
paras.zh: 1996 年，她因谋杀同学科琳·斯莱默 (Colleen Slemmer) 而被判处死刑，当时她年仅 18 岁。

paras.en: According to the Death Penalty Information Center, she is the first person to survive the administration of lethal injection drugs in the US.
paras.zh: 据死刑信息中心称，她是美国注射死刑第一人。

paras.en: He attorney, Luke Ihnen, told the court on Wednesday, local time, Pike was "speaking limitedly".
paras.zh: 他的律师卢克·伊南 (Luke Ihnen) 当地时间周三告诉法庭，派克“发言有限”。

paras.en: At the hearing in Nashville, Mr Ihnen asked the court to order the Tennessee Department of Correction to save evidence in the case and provide more information about what went wrong.
paras.zh: 在纳什维尔举行的听证会上，伊南要求法院命令田纳西州惩教部保存该案的证据，并提供更多有关问题所在的信息。

paras.en: The judge ordered the state to preserve "anything that was in the actual room".
paras.zh: 法官命令州政府保留“实际房间内的任何物品”。

paras.en: "Part of the issue that we are facing is up until yesterday, our client was unconscious, unable to communicate with counsel, unable to communicate with medical providers, and without her consent" a new lawsuit cannot be filed, Mr Ihnen told the court.
paras.zh: 伊宁先生告诉法庭，“我们面临的部分问题是直到昨天，我们的当事人已经失去知觉，无法与律师沟通，无法与医疗服务提供者沟通，并且未经她的同意”无法提起新的诉讼。

paras.en: Her legal team said that Pike's prognosis remained unclear and, at a minimum, she faced a lengthy recovery. Her arms were burned and blistered after the attempted lethal injection and she was handcuffed to a hospital bed, they said.
paras.zh: 她的法律团队表示，派克的预后仍不清楚，至少她面临着漫长的康复过程。他们说，在尝试注射死刑后，她的手臂被烧伤并起水泡，她被铐在医院病床上。

paras.en: Pike's attorneys wanted the court order to require the prison system to preserve information from the attempted execution, including drug lot numbers, needles, execution logs and other information.
paras.zh: 派克的律师希望法院下令，要求监狱系统保存企图执行死刑的信息，包括毒品批号、针头、执行日志和其他信息。

paras.en: Chancery Court Judge I'Ashea Myles indicated that her order to save the evidence would be sweeping, saying the state should maintain recordings, witness accounts and emails along with drugs, syringes, IV lines and other medical items.
paras.zh: 衡平法院法官 I'Ashea Myles 表示，她保存证据的命令将是全面的，并表示州政府应保存录音、证人账户和电子邮件以及药物、注射器、静脉输液管和其他医疗物品。

paras.en: The Tennessee Attorney General's Office said a court order was unnecessary. Assistant Attorney General John W Ayers said evidence from the death chamber had already been collected and logged.
paras.zh: 田纳西州总检察长办公室表示，没有必要下达法院命令。助理司法部长约翰·W·艾尔斯表示，死亡室的证据已经收集并记录下来。

paras.en: Governor Bill Lee, a Republican, has called what happened "deeply disturbing" and ordered a "comprehensive, third-party review to determine exactly what occurred". The governor postponed the state's only other execution scheduled for this year.
paras.zh: 共和党州长比尔·李称所发生的事情“令人深感不安”，并下令进行“全面的第三方审查，以确定究竟发生了什么”。州长推迟了该州今年原定的唯一一次处决。

paras.en: Tennessee's prison chief resigned in the wake of the failed execution, which has renewed scrutiny of how states carry out the death penalty, in particular the use of lethal injection.
paras.zh: 田纳西州监狱长在执行失败后辞职，这使得各州如何执行死刑，特别是注射死刑的方式重新受到审查。

paras.en: Christa Pike's recovery remains uncertain
paras.zh: 克里斯塔·派克的康复情况仍不确定

paras.en: Medical and lethal injection experts have focused on the possibility that a problem with the IV line caused the drug to pool in Pike's tissue rather than entering her bloodstream.
paras.zh: 医学和注射死刑专家重点关注静脉输液管问题导致药物聚集在派克的组织中而不是进入她的血液的可能性。

paras.en: Pike's lawyers wrote in their court filing that "apparently at no point did any member of the execution team realise that the IV lines were not correctly placed or that the veins had blown".
paras.zh: 派克的律师在法庭文件中写道，“显然，执行小组的任何成员都没有意识到静脉输液管放置不正确或静脉已经破裂”。

paras.en: The attempted execution got underway around 7:30pm on September 30, when Pike was given a chance to make a final statement.
paras.zh: 9 月 30 日晚上 7 点 30 分左右，尝试执行死刑，派克有机会做出最后陈述。

paras.en: About five minutes later, Pike raised her head and said her arm was hurting.
paras.zh: 大约五分钟后，派克抬起头说她的手臂很疼。

paras.en: At some point she appeared to lose consciousness, but she could be heard audibly breathing until media were escorted from the witness room at 8:53pm. An ambulance arrived at the prison at 9:14pm to take Pike to a hospital.
paras.zh: 在某个时刻，她似乎失去了知觉，但可以听到她的呼吸声，直到晚上 8 点 53 分媒体被护送出证人室。晚上 9 点 14 分，一辆救护车抵达监狱，将派克送往医院。

paras.en: Doctor Joel Zivot, a professor of anaesthesiology and surgery in Atlanta who consulted as an expert for Pike's legal team, said it could be weeks or months before anyone knew exactly what her recovery might look like, and whether her competency could be restored so the state could try again to execute her.
paras.zh: 亚特兰大麻醉学和外科教授乔尔·齐沃特医生为派克的法律团队提供咨询，他表示，可能需要几周或几个月的时间，人们才能确切地知道她的康复情况，以及她的能力是否可以恢复，以便州政府可以再次尝试处决她。

articles.title: Performance explores perinatal mental health and world of motherhood
articles.author: Sophie Landau

paras.en: For Adelaide-based independent dancer Zoë Dunwoodie, a dialogue like this runs subconsciously; a mind-body connection enhanced by her craft.
paras.zh: 对于阿德莱德的独立舞者 Zoë Dunwoodie 来说，这样的对话会在潜意识中进行。她的技艺增强了身心的联系。

paras.en: "If I've ever got anything going on, I funnel it through the dance.
paras.zh: “如果我有任何事情发生，我都会通过舞蹈来表达。

paras.en: "The body's just a fascinating place, and I think the older I get, the more I'm fascinated with it."
paras.zh: “身体是一个令人着迷的地方，我认为随着年龄的增长，我对它越着迷。”

paras.en: These reflections from the trained contemporary dancer and up-and-coming choreographer are apt, given the themes of her performance in development, LLAMA.
paras.zh: 考虑到她正在发展的表演主题“骆驼”，这位训练有素的当代舞者和崭露头角的编舞家的这些想法是恰当的。

paras.en: It's about a pregnant woman who finds out she carries a gene which could turn her into a llama — yes, a llama — and her journey into motherhood may trigger that transformation.
paras.zh: 这是关于一名孕妇发现自己携带一种基因，可以将她变成一只美洲驼——是的，一只美洲驼——而她成为母亲的旅程可能会引发这种转变。

paras.en: The protagonist, played by Dunwoodie, finds her world infiltrated by llamas; shadow puppetry, masks and llama-like embodiments illustrate this rift in reality.
paras.zh: 邓伍迪 (Dunwoodie) 饰演的主角发现她的世界被美洲驼渗透了。皮影戏、面具和骆驼般的化身都说明了现实中的这种裂痕。

paras.en: The piece was conceived in 2023 with the fusion of three key ideas: motherhood, her grandmother's postpartum mental health, and her mother's love of llamas.
paras.zh: 该作品构思于 2023 年，融合了三个关键理念：母性、祖母的产后心理健康以及母亲对美洲驼的爱。

paras.en: Dunwoodie was grappling with her "biological clock ticking".
paras.zh: 邓伍迪正在努力应对她的“生物钟滴答作响”。

paras.en: "I was asking friends about babies and engaging with babies a lot more … maybe subconsciously or on purpose I was consuming a lot of content about motherhood," she said.
paras.zh: “我向朋友询问有关婴儿的问题，并更多地与婴儿接触……也许是潜意识或故意地，我消费了很多有关母性的内容，”她说。

paras.en: The performing artist was also pondering her family history, namely that of her maternal grandmother.
paras.zh: 这位表演艺术家也在思考她的家族史，即她外祖母的家族史。

paras.en: "I never met her … but I know she struggled a lot with some mental instabilities … my mum thinks it could have been a postnatal depression that might have gone into a psychosis," she said.
paras.zh: “我从未见过她……但我知道她在精神不稳定方面挣扎了很多……我妈妈认为这可能是产后抑郁症，可能会发展成精神病，”她说。

paras.en: "The 1930s to 50s … it would have been a 'brush it under the carpet' sort of thing.
paras.zh: “20 世纪 30 年代到 50 年代……这可能是一种‘把它隐藏起来’之类的事情。

paras.en: "She was diagnosed with some other mental illnesses … and the connection to motherhood might not have been so recognised."
paras.zh: “她被诊断出患有其他一些精神疾病……与母性的联系可能没有得到如此认可。”

paras.en: Dunwoodie does not intend for this work to be taken as the gospel of perinatal mental health, but she does draw inspiration from it.
paras.zh: 邓伍迪无意让这项工作被视为围产期心理健康的福音，但她确实从中汲取了灵感。

paras.en: One of the llamas from the shadow world, a wizened matriarch named Grizabella, crochets the wool that dangles from her.
paras.zh: 来自阴影世界的一只美洲驼，一位名叫格里扎贝拉（Grizabella）的干瘪女族长，正在用钩针编织她身上悬挂的羊毛。

paras.en: "My mum's mum used to crochet these really amazing tapestries and quilts, and then she'd unravel them," Dunwoodie said.
paras.zh: “我妈妈的妈妈过去常常钩编这些非常令人惊叹的挂毯和被子，然后她会把它们拆开，”邓伍迪说。

paras.en: "So there's this theme I want to get into … that juxtaposition of the protagonist's world unravelling as well.
paras.zh: “所以我想探讨这个主题……主角的世界也随之瓦解。

paras.en: "Grizabella embraces the protagonist and is like, 'It's okay to be a llama, it's actually great, you don't need to fight it.'
paras.zh: “格里扎贝拉拥抱了主角，说道，‘成为一只美洲驼没关系，它实际上很棒，你不需要与它战斗。’

paras.en: "Which is a question I had about this postnatal depression psychosis world … where is this place that these mothers go to cope with what their realities are? In reality it might not be a safe space."
paras.zh: “关于这个产后抑郁症精神病世界，我有一个问题……这些母亲用来应对现实的地方在哪里？实际上，这可能不是一个安全的地方。”

paras.en: The final element is Dunwoodie's mother's "slight obsession with llamas".
paras.zh: 最后一个元素是邓伍迪的母亲“对美洲驼的轻微痴迷”。

paras.en: "Sorry mum … it's not an obsession, I think it's just she really likes them," she said.
paras.zh: “对不起，妈妈……这不是痴迷，我想这只是她真的很喜欢它们，”她说。

paras.en: In 2023, Dunwoodie received funds through Adelaide Festival Centre's inSPACE Program for LLAMA's first development for the stage.
paras.zh: 2023 年，邓伍迪通过阿德莱德节日中心的 inSPACE 计划获得了 LLAMA 首次舞台开发的资金。

paras.en: Then had a baby and embarked on her own journey into motherhood.
paras.zh: 随后生下了孩子，开始了自己的母亲之旅。

paras.en: This deepened her connection to the text and themes of matrescence, a term coined in the 70s exploring the radical physiological, psychological and social changes during pregnancy, childbirth, and motherhood.
paras.zh: 这加深了她与女性期文本和主题的联系，女性期是一个在 70 年代创造的术语，探讨怀孕、分娩和母亲期间发生的根本性生理、心理和社会变化。

paras.en: After another inSPACE development in January this year, Dunwoodie embarked on an EXPOUND residency in March, a joint initiative between Australian Dance Theatre and CreateSA.
paras.zh: 继今年 1 月的另一项 inSPACE 开发项目之后，邓伍迪于 3 月开始了 EXPOUND 驻场项目，这是澳大利亚舞蹈剧院和 CreateSA 的联合项目。

paras.en: She received a $30,000 grant and up to six weeks of studio space at the Lion Arts Centre to further develop LLAMA.
paras.zh: 她获得了 30,000 美元的资助以及狮子艺术中心长达六周的工作室空间，以进一步开发 LLAMA。

paras.en: "It was a huge honour to get that amount of money," she said.
paras.zh: “获得这笔钱是一种巨大的荣幸，”她说。

paras.en: "A bit overwhelming because I was like, 'Okay, what am I going to do?', but pay your creatives, that's where the money goes."
paras.zh: “有点不知所措，因为我想，‘好吧，我要做什么？’，但是付钱给你的创意人员，这就是钱的去向。”

paras.en: The artist invested in performers, a composer, costume, props, and a screen for the shadow puppetry.
paras.zh: 艺术家投资了表演者、作曲家、服装、道具和皮影戏的屏幕。

paras.en: One of those performers, Jazzy Williamson-Gray, has portrayed a llama in the developments.
paras.zh: 其中一位表演者贾兹·威廉姆森·格雷 (Jazzy Williamson-Gray) 在片中扮演了一只美洲驼。

paras.en: "It's very unique and very specific in its embodiment, and its physicality," she said.
paras.zh: “它的体现和物理性非常独特和具体，”她说。

paras.en: "It's allowed me to explore really serious themes in a way that contains lightness as well."
paras.zh: “它让我能够以一种轻松的方式探索真正严肃的主题。”

paras.en: The independent dancer said the llamas create hooves by planting their index and middle fingers on the ground while on all fours.
paras.zh: 这位独立舞者说，美洲驼四肢着地，将食指和中指放在地上，从而形成蹄子。

paras.en: "We do come up into quite awkward, non-human positions to explore the qualities of being a human and being a llama and where they meld together," she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“我们确实陷入了相当尴尬的、非人类的境地，以探索作为人类和美洲驼的品质以及它们融合在一起的地方。”

paras.en: Another member of the creative team is Tanya Voges, a dancer and creative arts therapist.
paras.zh: 创意团队的另一名成员是舞蹈家兼创意艺术治疗师 Tanya Voges。

paras.en: She uses dance to facilitate trauma-informed, psychotherapeutic sessions for various groups, including mothers seeking perinatal mental health support.
paras.zh: 她利用舞蹈为不同群体（包括寻求围产期心理健康支持的母亲）提供创伤相关的心理治疗课程。

paras.en: After assisting Dunwoodie with grant writing, Voges offered to help navigate these themes.
paras.zh: 在协助邓伍迪撰写资助金后，沃格斯主动提出帮助解决这些主题。

paras.en: "Saying, 'Actually, would you like my support? Because you're currently a mum of a really young baby, and dealing with subject matter that is influenced by this time of life, when it doesn't go well,'" she said.
paras.zh: “说，‘实际上，你想要我的支持吗？因为你现在是一个非常年幼的婴儿的妈妈，并且正在处理受生命中这个阶段影响的主题，当事情进展不顺利时，’”她说。

paras.en: For Dunwoodie, exploring motherhood and mental health allows her to better understand it.
paras.zh: 对于邓伍迪来说，探索母性和心理健康可以让她更好地理解这一点。

paras.en: "I've had amazing support from the people I've been working with … a beautiful bubble of people.
paras.zh: “我得到了与我一起工作的人们的大力支持……一群美丽的人。

paras.en: "Especially when I had my baby in the space as well, so generous, so loving and chill about there being a small human hanging out."
paras.zh: “尤其是当我在这个空间里生下我的孩子时，对于有一个小人在外面闲逛，我感到非常慷慨、充满爱心和冷静。”

paras.en: Like a child that has come to term in the safety of the womb, Dunwoodie is ready to shepherd LLAMA into the world.
paras.zh: 就像一个在子宫里安全足月的孩子一样，邓伍迪已经准备好将 LLAMA 带到这个世界上。

paras.en: Between getting her real baby into childcare, seeking out a producer and securing more funding, late 2027 could be the due date that sees the performer don the white, paper llama mask.
paras.zh: 在让她真正的孩子进入托儿所、寻找制片人和获得更多资金之间，2027 年末可能是表演者戴上白色纸美洲驼面具的截止日期。

paras.en: "I do wear a mask when I'm a mum some days," she said.
paras.zh: “当我当妈妈的时候，有时候我确实会戴口罩，”她说。

paras.en: "I've just got to put that llama head on, hope people are distracted by that and not the fact that I haven't showered today."
paras.zh: “我必须把那只美洲驼放在头上，希望人们能被它分散注意力，而不是因为我今天没有洗澡。”

articles.title: Greens launch election platform with promise to slash grocery prices

paras.en: The Greens have launched their 2026 state election platform, promising to address the price of groceries and community safety if elected.
paras.zh: 绿党推出了 2026 年州选举纲领，承诺如果当选，将解决食品杂货价格和社区安全问题。

paras.en: The party has pledged $300 million towards building 10 state-owned supermarkets offering discounted essentials.
paras.zh: 该党已承诺投入 3 亿美元建设 10 家国有超市，提供生活必需品打折服务。

paras.en: The Greens will also invest $1 billion over four years into community safety, funding 24/7 crisis outreach teams of health and social workers.
paras.zh: 绿党还将在四年内投资 10 亿美元用于社区安全，资助由卫生和社会工作者组成的 24/7 危机外展团队。

paras.en: The Victorian Greens have promised to slash grocery prices by up to 30 per cent by building 10 government owned supermarkets as part of their election campaign launch.
paras.zh: 作为竞选活动的一部分，维多利亚绿党承诺通过建造 10 家政府拥有的超市，将食品杂货价格削减高达 30%。

paras.en: The party will commit $300 million to building the state-owned supermarkets across Victoria, with five in Melbourne and five in regional areas.
paras.zh: 该党将投入3亿澳元在维多利亚州建设国有超市，其中5家位于墨尔本，5家位于偏远地区。

paras.en: The stores would offer essential groceries such as bread, milk and fresh produce at a 30 per cent discount compared to the major supermarkets, while other goods would be at a 20 per cent discount.
paras.zh: 与主要超市相比，这些商店将以 30% 的折扣出售面包、牛奶和新鲜农产品等必需品，而其他商品则享受 20% 的折扣。

paras.en: Victorian Greens leader Ellen Sandell said the initiative mirrors one proposed by New York mayor Zohran Mamdani, who has pledged $100 million to build five city-owned supermarkets by 2030.
paras.zh: 维多利亚绿党领袖埃伦·桑德尔表示，这一举措与纽约市长佐兰·马姆达尼 (Zohran Mamdani) 的提议相呼应，后者承诺在 2030 年之前斥资 1 亿美元建造 5 家市属超市。

paras.en: "Zohran Mamdani's done this in New York, we should do this too in Victoria to bring down the cost of living for all Victorians," Ms Sandell said.
paras.zh: 桑德尔女士说：“佐兰·马姆达尼在纽约做到了这一点，我们也应该在维多利亚州这样做，以降低所有维多利亚州人的生活成本。”

paras.en: "Parents shouldn't be standing at the supermarket wondering if they have to take things out of the trolley to afford their kids' lunches."
paras.zh: “父母不应该站在超市里思考是否必须从手推车中取出东西来支付孩子的午餐。”

paras.en: The party says it will also boost the powers of the Essential Services Commission, allowing it to set price ceilings on key essential goods.
paras.zh: 该党表示，还将增强基本服务委员会的权力，使其能够设定关键基本商品的价格上限。

paras.en: The Greens say the stores would eventually become self-sustaining, while offering an average of 25 per cent off a basket of groceries.
paras.zh: 绿党表示，这些商店最终将实现自给自足，同时提供一篮子杂货平均 25% 的折扣。

paras.en: Ms Sandell said additional savings would come from the state-owned stores not needing to pay for expenses like advertising or chase profits.
paras.zh: 桑德尔女士表示，额外的节省将来自国有商店，它们不需要支付广告费或追逐利润等费用。

paras.en: "As well as the profit motive, Coles and Woolworths spend an extraordinary amount on CEO salaries, on dividends for shareholders," Ms Sandell said.
paras.zh: “除了利润动机之外，Coles 和 Woolworths 在首席执行官薪资和股东股息上花费了大量资金，”桑德尔女士说。

paras.en: "All of those costs will be cut out with a publicly-owned option."
paras.zh: “所有这些成本都将通过公有选择来削减。”

paras.en: Research from the party's think-tank The Green Institute proposes expenses at government-owned stores could be cut by 25 per cent by eliminating operating costs such as security guards and CCTV at stores.
paras.zh: 党的智库绿色研究所的研究建议，通过消除商店保安和闭路电视等运营成本，可以将政府拥有的商店的开支削减25%。

paras.en: In the 2025/26 financial year, Coles supermarkets had a profit margin of 5.7 per cent before tax, while Woolworths had an operating profit margin on 5.5 per cent before tax.
paras.zh: 在2025/26财年，Coles超市的税前利润率为5.7%，而Woolworths的税前营业利润率为5.5%。

paras.en: It means for every $100 spent at one of their supermarkets, Coles made $5.70 and Woolworths made $5.50 before tax.
paras.zh: 这意味着在他们的超市每消费 1​​00 澳元，Coles 的税前收入为 5.70 澳元，Woolworths 的税前收入为 5.50 澳元。

paras.en: Senior economics lecturer at the University of Melbourne Aaron Barkley said the proposed plan was "ambitious", but that governments faced significant challenges competing with existing companies in the industry.
paras.zh: 墨尔本大学高级经济学讲师亚伦·巴克利表示，拟议的计划“雄心勃勃”，但政府在与业内现有公司竞争时面临着重大挑战。

paras.en: "You really need to be in this position to have a sizeable share of the market before you're really going to make a serious dent in the existing competitive landscape," Dr Barkley said.
paras.zh: 巴克利博士说：“在真正对现有竞争格局产生重大影响之前，你确实需要处于这个位置，占据相当大的市场份额。”

paras.en: Dr Barkley said government involvement in a market could be effective, but it often needed to be targeted.
paras.zh: 巴克利博士表示，政府参与市场可能是有效的，但通常需要有针对性。

paras.en: "In other instances where this policy has been floated or implemented, like in New York City for example, the point is made that on a per-item-basis the profit margins tend to be not that high," Dr Barkley said.
paras.zh: 巴克利博士说：“在其他已经提出或实施这项政策的情况下，例如在纽约市，就每个项目而言，利润率往往不会那么高。”

paras.en: "In order to get the discounts that are being claimed here, that's really going to end up being taxpayer funded, and if you're taxpayer funding this, then maybe other avenues might be better for achieving the same goal."
paras.zh: “为了获得这里所要求的折扣，这实际上最终将由纳税人提供资金，如果你是纳税人提供资金，那么也许其他途径可能会更好地实现相同的目标。”

paras.en: Dr Barkley said targeted subsidies for people on lower incomes or in rural areas could be equally as effective in alleviating grocery stress.
paras.zh: 巴克利博士表示，为低收入或农村地区的人们提供有针对性的补贴对于缓解食品杂货压力同样有效。

paras.en: Greens to borrow from NYC's Mamdani on crime
paras.zh: 绿党在犯罪问题上向纽约市议员马姆达尼借鉴

paras.en: The Greens have also pledged to pour $1 billion into community safety over four years in a program also inspired by one introduced in New York City in March.
paras.zh: 绿党还承诺在四年内为社区安全投入 10 亿美元，该计划的灵感也来自于 3 月份在纽约市推出的一项计划。

paras.en: "We've seen New York just experience their safest summer on record after mayor Mamdani introduced an Office of Community Safety," Ms Sandell said.
paras.zh: 桑德尔女士说：“在市长马姆达尼设立社区安全办公室后，我们看到纽约刚刚经历了有记录以来最安全的夏天。”

paras.en: "It's been proven to work in New York and we should be adopting kind of ideas here in Victoria to keep our community safe."
paras.zh: “事实证明，这在纽约行得通，我们应该在维多利亚州采用这种想法来保证我们社区的安全。”

paras.en: The newly established office would fund 24/7 crisis outreach teams of health and social workers.
paras.zh: 新成立的办公室将为卫生和社会工作者组成的 24/7 危机外展团队提供资金。

paras.en: The Greens also pledged further funding for frontline mental health, alcohol and other drug treatment and homelessness services.
paras.zh: 绿党还承诺为前线心理健康、酒精和其他药物治疗以及无家可归者服务提供更多资金。

paras.en: Ms Sandell said the approaches to crime proposed by the Coalition and Labor were not working, as Victorians did not feel any safer.
paras.zh: 桑德尔女士表示，联盟党和工党提出的打击犯罪的方法并没有奏效，因为维州人并没有感到更安全。

paras.en: The government have pledged to hire 1,500 more police officers if re-elected, while the Coalition has promised to recruit 3,000 new officers if elected.
paras.zh: 政府承诺，如果再次当选，将再雇用 1,500 名警察，而联盟党则承诺，如果当选，将招募 3,000 名新警察。

paras.en: "It would be ludicrous to keep trying to double down on the same failed approach," she said.
paras.zh: “继续尝试在同一个失败的方法上加倍努力是可笑的，”她说。

articles.title: What's still within Trump's power even if the Democrats sweep the U.S. midterms

paras.en: What's still within Trump's power even if the Democrats sweep the U.S. midterms
paras.zh: 即使民主党在美国中期选举中大获全胜，特朗普还能掌控什么

paras.en: Donald Trump has used executive orders to pursue his agenda without legislation
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普在没有立法的情况下利用行政命令来实现他的议程

paras.en: Republicans are heading into November’s U.S. midterm elections facing mounting pressure to defend their House majority, as Democrats make gains in several key races.
paras.zh: 随着民主党在几场关键竞选中取得进展，共和党在即将举行的 11 月美国中期选举中面临着捍卫众议院多数席位的越来越大的压力。

paras.en: The stakes extend beyond the balance of power in Congress. If Democrats win both the House and Senate, they would unlock tools to investigate the Trump administration, challenge its policies and shape what legislation moves forward.
paras.zh: 其利害关系超出了国会的权力平衡范围。如果民主党赢得众议院和参议院，他们将解锁调查特朗普政府、挑战其政策并制定立法进展的工具。

paras.en: But a change in Congress doesn’t necessarily mean a change in the president’s ability to act.
paras.zh: 但国会的更迭并不一定意味着总统行动能力的改变。

paras.en: Washington correspondents Katie Simpson, Willy Lowry and Paul Hunter break down whether a party switch in Congress and the Senate could curb Trump's power, and what it could mean for Canada-U.S. trade relations.
paras.zh: 华盛顿记者凯蒂·辛普森（Katie Simpson）、威利·洛瑞（Willy Lowry）和保罗·亨特（Paul Hunter）分析了国会和参议院的党派变更是否会限制特朗普的权力，以及这对加美贸易关系意味着什么。

paras.en: We've included some highlights below, edited for length and clarity. Listen to the full podcast discussion here.
paras.zh: 我们在下面列出了一些要点，并对其长度和清晰度进行了编辑。在这里收听完整的播客讨论。

paras.en: Willy Lowry: Let’s get to our listener question of the week. Ben essentially wants to know how much Democratic control of Congress would actually matter if Trump makes most of his policy decisions outside legislation, like executive orders.
paras.zh: 威利·洛瑞：让我们来谈谈本周的听众问题。本本质上想知道，如果特朗普的大部分政策决定都在立法之外（例如行政命令），那么民主党对国会的控制实际上会有多大影响。

paras.en: For the Canadians listening, could we talk about how presidents usually try to introduce policy change, and how Trump's approach differs?
paras.zh: 对于加拿大人来说，我们能否谈谈总统通常如何尝试引入政策变革，以及特朗普的做法有何不同？

paras.en: Katie Simpson: So, passing legislation — huge bills that have legacy policies in there and getting them through Congress — take a look at Donald Trump and the way he promoted passing the big, beautiful bill — which included all kinds of changes to be rolled out through the time of his presidency, related to funding cuts, tax cuts, all of these different kinds of things that are his policy priorities.
paras.zh: 凯蒂·辛普森：所以，通过立法——包含遗留政策的巨额法案并让它们在国会获得通过——看看唐纳德·特朗普和他推动通过这项庞大而美丽的法案的方式——其中包括在他的总统任期内推出的各种变革，与削减资金、减税有关，所有这些不同的事情都是他的政策优先事项。

paras.en: That typically is how things go, where a president works with lawmakers in Congress to get things through that entire process — the lawmaking process — to advance your agenda that you were elected to implement, and so he is trying to do that.
paras.zh: 事情通常都是这样进行的，总统与国会议员合作，让事情通过整个过程——立法过程——以推进你当选要实施的议程，所以他正在努力做到这一点。

paras.en: But if you don't have the cooperation of Congress, Donald Trump has illustrated — even though Republicans do control Congress right now, it's divided — the small minority in the House can be difficult to get things through, but he can still operate very effectively outside of that, through executive orders.
paras.zh: 但唐纳德·特朗普已经说明，如果没有国会的合作——尽管共和党现在确实控制着国会，但国会是分裂的——众议院的少数派可能很难让事情获得通过，但他仍然可以通过行政命令在国会之外非常有效地运作。

paras.en: Paul Hunter: [To] declare things an emergency, declare things [a] national security matter, and it's incredible what he has shown the executive office, a.k.a. the president, can do without needing the approval of Congress.
paras.zh: 保罗·亨特：宣布紧急情况，宣布国家安全问题，令人难以置信的是，他向行政办公室（又名总统）​​展示了无需国会批准即可做到的事情。

paras.en: He went to war in Iran. He went and got Nicolás Maduro out of Venezuela. He brought in the tariffs — some have been reversed, some are still facing challenges.
paras.zh: 他参加了伊朗战争。他去把尼古拉·马杜罗带出了委内瑞拉。他引入了关税——有些关税已经取消，有些仍面临挑战。

paras.en: He [also] challenged birthright citizenship, which was overturned in the courts, but is still back in the court.
paras.zh: 他还对与生俱来的公民身份提出了质疑，这一观点在法庭上被推翻，但仍然回到了法庭。

paras.en: He has shown intent and ability to get things through simply with the stroke of a pen and that won't change no matter what Democrats do in the midterms.
paras.zh: 他已经表现出了只需大笔一挥就能解决问题的意图和能力，无论民主党在中期选举中做什么，这一点都不会改变。

paras.en: Will he face more hurdles? Will he face investigations? Subpoenas to his family, to his business associates, other things like that? Will he face impeachment? That's a question Democrats have to ask themselves because they can impeach him. Is it worth the energy?
paras.zh: 他会面临更多的困难吗？他会面临调查吗？向他的家人、他的商业伙伴或其他类似的事情发出传票？他会面临弹劾吗？这是民主党人必须问自己的问题，因为他们可以弹劾他。值得付出精力吗？

paras.en: But all that to say, it'll be a lot of optics, but I'm not convinced it'll actually slow him down in terms of what he wants to do outside of the legislative agenda, which would be paralyzed.
paras.zh: 但话虽如此，这将是很多光学问题，但我不相信这实际上会减慢他在立法议程之外想做的事情，因为立法议程将陷入瘫痪。

paras.en: Willy Lowry: I think you're right. It is amazing over the last nearly two years, how irrelevant Congress has been outside of the government shutdowns and the Epstein files, which outside of those two factors, they've basically been relegated.
paras.zh: 威利·洛瑞：我认为你是对的。令人惊讶的是，在过去的近两年里，除了政府关门和爱泼斯坦文件之外，国会是多么无关紧要，除了这两个因素之外，他们基本上已经被降级了。

paras.en: Katie Simpson: It's illustrated that it's not the balance in power that it is intended to be. The only thing right now that really is a check on Donald Trump's power is the court system.
paras.zh: 凯蒂·辛普森：这表明这并不是预期的权力平衡。目前唯一真正能够制约唐纳德·特朗普权力的是法院系统。

paras.en: Willy Lowry: So, how much would actually change if power does go to the Democrats in Congress?
paras.zh: 威利·洛瑞：那么，如果国会权力确实落入民主党手中，实际上会发生多少变化？

paras.en: Katie Simpson: Donald Trump did an interview with Fox News host Laura Ingraham on the sidelines of the midterm convention that they held in Dallas, and he openly declared, ‘I'm going to become a blocker.’
paras.zh: 凯蒂·辛普森：唐纳德·特朗普在达拉斯举行的中期大会间隙接受了福克斯新闻主持人劳拉·英格拉汉姆的采访，他公开宣称，“我将成为一名阻击者。”

paras.en: So, if legislation is passed through Congress that he does not approve of, he will use his veto power, and then between blocking legislation that does not align with his agenda, and continuing on with executive orders — the powers that his different departments have, to pursue particularly tariff policy and foreign policy, Trump is signaling how he will continue to fight for his agenda, even if American voters send a message to Washington that they want change.
paras.zh: 因此，如果国会通过了他不批准的立法，他将使用否决权，然后在阻止与他的议程不符的立法和继续执行行政命令之间——他的不同部门拥有的权力，特别是关税政策和外交政策，特朗普正在表明他将如何继续为他的议程而战，即使美国选民向华盛顿发出他们希望改变的信息。

articles.title: Christa Pike 'angry and confused' after botched lethal injection, her lawyers say

paras.en: Christa Pike 'angry and confused' after botched lethal injection, her lawyers say
paras.zh: 克里斯塔·派克的律师称，注射死刑失败后，她“愤怒又困惑”

paras.en: - Christa Pike, who survived a lethal injection late last month, is "angry and confused" after regaining consciousness this week, her lawyers say. They say she is "speaking limitedly" and shackled to her bed.
paras.zh: 克里斯塔·派克(Christa Pike)的律师表示，上个月末注射死刑后幸存下来的克里斯塔·派克(Christa Pike)本周恢复知觉后感到“愤怒和困惑”。他们说她“说话有限”，并被铐在床上。

paras.en: - A Tennessee judge has ordered the state to preserve evidence related to the botched execution.
paras.zh: - 田纳西州的一名法官已命令该州保存与拙劣处决有关的证据。

paras.en: - Pike, 50, is the first known person to receive lethal injection drugs and survive. She was injected with two doses of pentobarbital on Sept. 30.
paras.zh: - 50 岁的派克是已知的第一个接受注射死刑并幸存下来的人。 9月30日，她注射了两剂戊巴比妥。

paras.en: - Pike was sentenced to the death penalty for the 1995 beating and stabbing death of classmate Colleen Slemmer.
paras.zh: - 派克因 1995 年殴打并刺死同学科琳·斯莱默 (Colleen Slemmer) 而被判处死刑。

paras.en: - October 7 Use of pentobarbital raises many concerns — and hurdles Darius Mahdavi Health-care professionals have also raised concerns about the drugs that are being used for executions. Pentobarbital, the drug used in Pike's failed execution, has not been clinically tested or approved for use in lethal injections in humans. In most jurisdictions, it is used almost exclusively for veterinary euthanasia. Virtually all major pharmaceutical companies have taken public stances against the use of their drugs for capital punishment. Over the past decade most have worked to directly prohibit their use for this purpose, raising further legal complications. This means that to acquire the pentobarbital used in lethal injections, states typically need to have it specially made. This relies on a compounding pharmacy — a specialized medical business that does not require certification, raising questions about quality control. State investigations, including in Tennessee, have found their own protocols are routinely disregarded during executions by lethal injection. Under former president Joe Biden, the U.S. Department of Justice concluded that "the Department should err on the side of humane treatment and avoidance of unnecessary pain and suffering and cease the use of pentobarbital," unless new evidence arose. Under Trump, the practice was resumed for federal executions earlier this year.
paras.zh: - 10 月 7 日 戊巴比妥的使用引起了许多担忧和障碍 Darius Mahdavi 卫生保健专业人员也对用于处决的药物提出了担忧。派克处决失败时使用的戊巴比妥尚未经过临床测试或批准用于人类注射死刑。在大多数司法管辖区，它几乎专门用于兽医安乐死。几乎所有主要制药公司都公开表明立场，反对将其药物用于死刑。在过去的十年中，大多数国家都努力直接禁止将其用于此目的，从而进一步增加了法律复杂性。这意味着，要获得用于注射死刑的戊巴比妥，各州通常需要专门制造。这依赖于复合药房——一种不需要认证的专业医疗企业，这引发了质量控制方面的问题。包括田纳西州在内的各州调查发现，在注射死刑期间，他们自己的协议经常被忽视。在前总统乔·拜登的领导下，美国司法部得出的结论是，除非出现新的证据，否则“司法部应该错误地采取人道待遇，避免不必要的痛苦和折磨，并停止使用戊巴比妥”。在特朗普的领导下，今年早些时候恢复了联邦处决的做法。

paras.en: - Dozens of botched executions since 1982 in U.S.: nonprofit Darius Mahdavi It took almost two hours for Joseph Wood to die after he was given a lethal injection of drugs. Critics say it's the third time in six months that an execution has gone wrong. And a change in execution laws may be to blame. Pike is believed to be the first person to survive a lethal injection, but she is far from the first person to go through a botched execution attempt in the U.S. Earlier this year, a doctor spent over an hour trying to establish an IV for the lethal injection of Tennessee death row inmate Tony Carruthers. According to his lawyers, they attempted to insert the needle more than a dozen times and even tried to establish a central line before giving up. That same doctor, Mark Fowler, oversaw the failed execution of Pike last week. According to the Death Penalty Information Center, a U.S.-based nonprofit, there have been at least 64 botched executions since 1982, with 51 of those being lethal injections. For years, experts and human rights advocates have raised concerns about the ability of states to find competent individuals to carry out executions by lethal injection. Some doctors have publicly argued that administering a lethal injection violates their oath to "do no harm." The American Medical Association's Code of Medical Ethics prohibits physicians from participating in capital punishment in any way, but the AMA is not a regulatory body. However, anesthesiologists — the professionals most capable of effectively and responsibly administering the type of drug used in a lethal injection — are barred from doing so by the American Board of Anesthesiology, under penalty of losing their certification and, effectively, their ability to practice.
paras.zh: - 自 1982 年以来，美国发生了数十起拙劣的处决事件：非营利组织大流士·马哈达维 (Darius Mahdavi) 约瑟夫·伍德 (Joseph Wood) 在接受注射死刑后，花了近两个小时才死亡。批评人士称，这是六个月内第三次执行出错。执行法的改变可能是罪魁祸首。派克被认为是第一个在注射死刑中幸存的人，但她远不是第一个在美国执行死刑失败的人。今年早些时候，一名医生花了一个多小时试图为田纳西州死囚托尼·卡拉瑟斯的注射死刑建立静脉注射。据他的律师称，他们尝试进针十几次，甚至试图建立中心线，然后才放弃。上周，同一位医生马克·福勒 (Mark Fowler) 监督了对派克的处决，但失败了。据总部位于美国的非营利组织死刑信息中心称，自 1982 年以来，至少发生了 64 起拙劣的处决事件，其中 51 起是注射死刑。多年来，专家和人权倡导者一直对各国能否找到有能力的个人执行注射死刑表示担忧。有些医生有 公开辩称注射死刑违反了他们“不伤害”的誓言。美国医学会的医学道德准则禁止医生以任何方式参与死刑，但美国医学会并不是一个监管机构。然而，麻醉师——最有能力有效和负责任地管理注射死刑所用药物类型的专业人员——被美国麻醉学委员会禁止这样做，否则将面临失去认证和执业能力的处罚。

paras.en: - Verity Stevenson Ihnen reiterated that he and his colleagues had earlier raised the issue of vein access in Pike's case ahead of her planned execution, namely in a lawsuit in January, but that they had been "scoffed at" by the attorney general. He said his team had also raised issues with the drug used in lethal injections, pentobarbital, as well as the "secrecy" surrounding the execution procedure itself. Pike's team has previously said they were concerned that some of the state's supply of the drug may be expired.
paras.zh: - Verity Stevenson Ihnen 重申，他和他的同事早些时候在派克计划执行死刑之前，即在一月份的诉讼中提出了派克案件中的静脉接入问题，但他们遭到了司法部长的“嘲笑”。他说，他的团队还对注射死刑所使用的药物戊巴比妥以及执行程序本身的“保密”提出了问题。派克的团队此前曾表示，他们担心该州供应的部分药物可能会过期。

paras.en: - 'Where am I and who are you?' Verity Stevenson Randy Spivey, a lawyer for Christa Pike, says Pike is experiencing 'a lot of cognitive confusion' after regaining consciousness following a failed lethal injection late last month. Spivey said he was not in the room when Pike regained consciousness Tuesday, but he was told that her first words after waking up were: "'Where am I,' and 'who are you?'" He said "there's still a lot of cognitive confusion," but that she had asked about members of her legal team as well as members of the victim Colleen Slemmer's family. Spivey said Pike is "angry and confused about everything right now." Pike is aware the state tried to execute her, but Spivey said he did not want to say more about what his client remembers at this time "because it's evolving and I want to be very careful of that." She's "very aware of what they did to her up to a point."
paras.zh: - “我在哪里，你是谁？”克里斯塔·派克的律师维里蒂·史蒂文森·兰迪·斯皮维表示，派克在上个月末注射死刑失败后恢复意识后，正在经历“严重的认知混乱”。斯皮维说，当派克周二恢复知觉时，他并不在房间里，但他被告知，她醒来后的第一句话是：“‘我在哪里’和‘你是谁？’”他说，“仍然有很多认知混乱”，但她询问了她的法律团队成员以及受害者科琳·斯莱默家人的情况。斯皮维说派克“对现在的一切感到愤怒和困惑”。派克知道政府试图处决她，但斯皮维表示，他不想透露更多关于他的委托人此时记得的事情，“因为事情正在发展，我想对此非常小心。”她“非常清楚他们在某种程度上对她做了什么”。

paras.en: - What's in the court order? Verity Stevenson Myles's request for the state's preservation of evidence was quite lengthy. She also noted that it should "have no problem doing this because you all are already doing that," as Ayers earlier stated they were doing. Myles said the state must preserve all drugs, syringes, IV lines, tubing, needles, catheters, medical supplies, restraints and gurneys that were in the execution room, as well as waste packaging, labels and manufacturer information. "All photographs, video recordings, audio recordings, any surveillance footage of the execution will need to be maintained," Myles said. She also ordered the preservation of recordings or other evidence from witness and recording rooms on the night of Sept. 30. The judge also called for the preservation of handwritten notes and logs, checklists, timelines, incident reports, witness accounts, emails, text messages and Signal communications related to the execution. Myles said officials must preserve records concerning any "deviation from the protocol," as well as complications, delays, equipment problems and issues involving access to Pike's veins. Pike's lawyers had warned ahead of the execution, when they attempted to prevent it from happening, that prison medical staff had previously struggled to access her veins, which are small. She also ordered the state to preserve medical and monitoring records, time logs, documentation concerning Pike's psychological condition, and policies, protocols, training manuals and other internal guidance that may have been relevant to the execution. The order will also cover communications surrounding the decision to call 911 and emergency medical services, the decision to stop the second execution attempt, and communications involving the Tennessee Department of Correction, state officials and the governor's office. "I want you all to preserve all of that information," Myles said. She also instructed the state to take "special care" not to lose, misplace or accidentally delete any relevant evidence. And if evidence has already been discarded, deleted or destroyed, the judge said she wants the state to take "an affirmative step to try to claw back that information."
paras.zh: - 法庭命令中有什么内容？维里蒂·史蒂文森·迈尔斯要求州政府保存证据的请求相当冗长。她还指出，正如艾尔斯早些时候所说的那样，“这样做应该没有问题，因为你们都已经在这样做了”。迈尔斯说，州政府必须保存行刑室内的所有药物、注射器、静脉输液管、管子、针头、导管、医疗用品、约束装置和轮床，以及废物包装、标签和制造商信息。迈尔斯说：“行刑过程中的所有照片、录像、录音和任何监控录像都需要保留。”她还下令保存9月30日晚来自证人和录音室的录音或其他证据。法官还要求保存与执行有关的手写笔记和日志、清单、时间表、事件报告、证人账户、电子邮件、短信和信号通信。迈尔斯表示，官员们必须保留有关任何“偏离方案”以及并发症、延误、设备问题和涉及派克静脉的问题的记录。派克的律师在案发前警告过 执行死刑时，当他们试图阻止这种情况发生时，监狱医务人员此前一直在努力接触她的静脉，因为她的静脉很小。她还命令该州保存医疗和监测记录、时间日志、有关派克心理状况的文件，以及可能与执行有关的政策、协议、培训手册和其他内部指导。该命令还将涵盖围绕拨打 911 和紧急医疗服务的决定、停止第二次处决尝试的决定以及涉及田纳西州惩教部、州官员和州长办公室的通信。 “我希望你们保留所有这些信息，”迈尔斯说。她还指示国家“特别小心”，不要丢失、放错地方或意外删除任何相关证据。如果证据已经被丢弃、删除或销毁，法官表示她希望州政府采取“积极的步骤，试图收回这些信息”。

paras.en: - Trying to get answers Verity Stevenson Randy Spivey, another lawyer on Pike's legal team, said Pike was "brain dead" until Tuesday, a day after her lawyers had been warned she'd be taken off life support. When she woke up, she had a ventilator in her mouth and very swollen arms and hands which she may not regain the use of, he said. "Christa is a survivor," Spivey said, noting his client had survived several instances of rape and abuse as well as suicide attempts — and now, an execution attempt. He said the botched execution was "foreseeable and foreseen" due to the medical issues he and his team had raised ahead of the attempt. Pike's future as well as her mental health remain uncertain, Spivey said, adding that he and his team would do everything in their power to get answers about why it went so wrong. "We have to ask: how much suffering is enough?" he said, adding it would be "unimaginable" for the state of Tennessee to try and execute her again.
paras.zh: - 试图得到答案 派克法律团队的另一位律师维里蒂·史蒂文森·兰迪·斯皮维表示，派克直到周二才“脑死亡”，一天前，她的律师被警告说她将被取消生命维持系统。他说，当她醒来时，她的嘴里含着呼吸机，手臂和手非常肿胀，她可能无法重新使用。斯皮维说：“克里斯塔是一名幸存者。”他指出，他的当事人曾经历过多次强奸和虐待以及自杀未遂事件，现在又遭遇了一次处决。他表示，由于他和他的团队在执行之前提出了医疗问题，这次执行失败是“可以预见的”。斯皮维说，派克的未来以及她的心理健康状况仍然不确定，并补充说，他和他的团队将尽一切努力寻找问题的答案。 “我们要问：多少痛苦才足够？”他说，并补充说田纳西州再次尝试处决她是“难以想象的”。

paras.en: - Seeking transparency Verity Stevenson Standing outside the courthouse, Ihnen said the hearing was an exercise in requesting more transparency from the state of Tennessee, whose "word" he said has so far been "shrouded in secrecy." "Today was just a first step among many to preserve and enforce Christa's constitutional rights after this unprecedented botched execution," Ihnen said. "I hope that you saw today some of the frustrations that we've had…. The goal posts keep moving."
paras.zh: - 寻求透明度 维里蒂·史蒂文森 (Verity Stevenson) 站在法院外，伊宁表示，听证会是要求田纳西州提高透明度的一次演习，他说田纳西州的“言论”迄今为止一直“处于保密状态”。伊南说：“在这次史无前例的拙劣处决之后，今天只是许多人为维护和执行克里斯塔宪法权利而迈出的第一步。” “我希望你今天看到了我们所经历的一些挫折……球门柱不断前进。”

paras.en: - Judge says Tennessee must preserve evidence Verity Stevenson Chancery Court Judge l'Ashea Myles has granted the defence's request for evidence to be preserved. "Anything that was in the actual room needs to be preserved and maintained," Myles said. Ayers had earlier listed some of the items in the evidence, including observation logs, medical waste and products and readouts of an EKG exam. He said it's possible the state no longer has some of Pike's IV lines, which were cut. The defence had included IV lines in its request. "We want all of it, that's the request," Ihnen said, noting he believes what happened to Pike is "prejudicial." Myles acknowledged the "case is unique, to say the least."
paras.zh: - 法官称田纳西州必须保留证据 Verity Stevenson 衡平法院法官 l'Ashea Myles 已批准辩方保留证据的请求。 “实际房间里的任何东西都需要保存和维护，”迈尔斯说。艾尔斯早些时候列出了证据中的一些项目，包括观察日志、医疗废物和产品以及心电图检查的读数。他说，该州可能不再拥有派克的一些静脉注射管线，这些管线已被切断。辩方在其请求中包括了 IV 线。 “我们想要这一切，这就是我们的要求，”伊宁说，并指出他认为发生在派克身上的事情是“有偏见的”。迈尔斯承认，“至少可以说，这个案例是独一无二的。”

paras.en: - Pentobarbital may have spread outside Pike's veins: doctor Verity Stevenson Dr. Joel Zivot, a professor of anesthesiology and surgery in Atlanta who consulted as an expert for Pike's legal team, has raised the possibility that the lethal injections of pentobarbital administered to Pike may not have been done properly and could have seeped into her bodily tissues outside her veins. Zivot said her arms are blistered and experienced burns during the process. He said Tuesday that it could be weeks or months before anyone knows exactly what her recovery might look like or whether her competency could be restored to a level that might enable the state to try to execute her again.
paras.zh: - 戊巴比妥可能已经扩散到派克的静脉外：亚特兰大麻醉学和外科教授乔尔·齐沃特博士（Verity Stevenson）提出了一种可能性，即对派克进行致命注射的戊巴比妥可能没有正确注射，并且可能渗入了她静脉外的身体组织。齐沃特说，在此过程中，她的手臂起了水泡并被烧伤。他周二表示，可能需要几周或几个月的时间，才有人确切知道她的康复情况，或者她的能力是否可以恢复到可能使该州再次尝试处决她的水平。

articles.title: Olivia Rodrigo’s Daisy Chain Fields under fire as 2 vendors say they're still owed money
articles.author: Alexandra Mae Jones

paras.en: Olivia Rodrigo’s Daisy Chain Fields under fire as 2 vendors say they're still owed money
paras.zh: 奥利维亚·罗德里戈 (Olivia Rodrigo) 的菊花链领域 (Daisy Chain Fields) 受到批评，两名供应商称他们仍欠钱

paras.en: Vendors also allege poor working conditions at Aug. 29 concert
paras.zh: 供应商还称 8 月 29 日音乐会的工作条件很差

paras.en: Olivia Rodrigo’s inaugural festival, Daisy Chain Fields, won praise for its all-woman lineup and charitable focus on reproductive rights and fighting gender-based violence.
paras.zh: 奥利维亚·罗德里戈 (Olivia Rodrigo) 的首届音乐节“雏菊链场”(Daisy Chain Fields) 因其全女性阵容以及对生殖权利和打击性别暴力的慈善关注而赢得赞誉。

paras.en: But the festival is coming under fire from two vendors alleging they endured poor working conditions and hadn't received proper payment for their services.
paras.zh: 但该节日遭到了两名供应商的批评，他们声称他们的工作条件很差，而且没有收到适当的服务报酬。

paras.en: The one-day festival brought swarms of fans to Great Park in Irvine, Calif., to see performers including Chappell Roan, Doechii, Mitski, Bikini Kill and Rodrigo herself.
paras.zh: 这个为期一天的音乐节吸引了大批粉丝来到加利福尼亚州欧文市的大公园，观看查普尔·罗恩 (Chappell Roan)、多奇伊 (Doechii)、米茨基 (Mitski)、比基尼·基尔 (Bikini Kill) 和罗德里戈 (Rodrigo) 本人等表演者。

paras.en: All performers donated their time, with proceeds from the festival going to 10 organizations centering women's rights, including Planned Parenthood, National Women's Law Center, Black Mamas Matter and the National Institute for Reproductive Health.
paras.zh: 所有表演者都贡献了自己的时间，节日收益将捐赠给 10 个以妇女权利为中心的组织，包括计划生育协会、国家妇女法律中心、Black Mamas Matter 和国家生殖健康研究所。

paras.en: The $10 million US initially raised by the festival was then matched by Melinda French Gates to bring the total to $20 million US.
paras.zh: 音乐节最初筹集的 1000 万美元后来由梅琳达·弗伦奇·盖茨 (Melinda French Gates) 配捐，使总额达到 2000 万美元。

paras.en: Now, more than a month later, two vendors are sharing that their festival experience was far from perfect.
paras.zh: 现在，一个多月后，两家供应商表示，他们的节日体验远非完美。

paras.en: Mary Chacon, owner of Ugly Oats Kitchen, posted "An Open Letter to Olivia Rodrigo" on Instagram on Tuesday, saying she still hasn’t "been paid out of our sales (in violation of our contract)" yet, which prompted her to share her experience vending at Daisy Chain Fields.
paras.zh: Ugly Oats Kitchen 的老板 Mary Chacon 周二在 Instagram 上发布了“一封致 Olivia Rodrigo 的公开信”，称她仍然“没有从我们的销售中获得报酬（违反了我们的合同）”，这促使她分享了自己在 Daisy Chain Fields 售货的经历。

paras.en: Chacon stated that their point of contact for the festival, DLS Events, only provided piecemeal information on setup and didn’t tell them about a free staff food area, which she said was also too far away from their booth to access.
paras.zh: Chacon 表示，他们的音乐节联系人 DLS Events 只提供了有关设置的零碎信息，并没有告诉他们免费的员工食品区，她说该食品区距离他们的展位也太远，无法进入。

paras.en: A girl does a cartwheel during the Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival at Great Park in Irvine, Calif., on Aug. 29. (Mario Anzuoni/Reuters)
paras.zh: 8 月 29 日，在加利福尼亚州欧文市大公园举办的菊花链田音乐节期间，一名女孩在侧手翻。（Mario Anzuoni/路透社）

paras.en: "Ugly Oats is a micro-bakery run out of my apartment. I, as a mom investing my own money, have no extra funds," Chacon wrote, adding that she was "forever grateful for the opportunity to be present at a historic feminist event," and that she hoped issues will be resolved for vendors next year.
paras.zh: 查康写道：“丑陋的燕麦是我公寓里经营的一家微型面包店。作为一名自己投资的妈妈，我没有多余的资金。”她补充说，她“永远感激有机会参加历史性的女权主义活动”，并希望明年供应商的问题能够得到解决。

paras.en: CBC News has reached out for comment from Rodrigo’s team, as well as C3 Presents, the company that produced the event, and the two companies highlighted by Chacon as managing vendors for the festival: DLS Events and Jetty Event Productions.
paras.zh: CBC News 已联系 Rodrigo 的团队、该活动的制作公司 C3 Presents 以及 Chacon 强调的作为该节日管理供应商的两家公司：DLS Events 和 Jetty Event Productions 来征求评论。

paras.en: The business, which is operated solely by owner Veronica Licha Lopez, posted on Instagram that there was poor communication from organizers in the weeks leading up to the event, and that her business experienced a "significant financial loss" by participating.
paras.zh: 该企业由业主维罗妮卡·利查·洛佩兹 (Veronica Licha Lopez) 独自经营，她在 Instagram 上发帖称，在活动开始前几周，组织者沟通不畅，她的企业因参与而遭受了“重大财务损失”。

paras.en: - Audio Olivia Rodrigo makes history with Daisy Chain Fields and wears a piece of Vancouver in the process
paras.zh: - 音频 Olivia Rodrigo 凭借 Daisy Chain Fields 创造了历史，并在此过程中佩戴了温哥华的一部分

paras.en: - Olivia Rodrigo's music festival raises $20M US for charities that help women and girls
paras.zh: - 奥利维亚·罗德里戈 (Olivia Rodrigo) 的音乐节为帮助妇女和女孩的慈善机构筹集了 2000 万美元

paras.en: "We’re still waiting to be paid. After everything we spent to participate, we have still not received what we are owed for the event," the post stated.
paras.zh: 帖子中写道：“我们仍在等待付款。在我们为参加活动付出了一切之后，我们仍然没有收到这次活动的欠款。”

paras.en: "Supporting women shouldn’t stop at putting women on a stage.… Because vendors are talent, too."
paras.zh: “支持女性不应该仅仅停留在让女性登上舞台……因为供应商也是人才。”

paras.en: The festival included more than 50 food and drink vendors. While the majority haven't commented since the event, several gushed about their experiences in the wake of the festival.
paras.zh: 节日期间有 50 多家食品和饮料摊贩。虽然大多数人在活动结束后都没有发表评论，但一些人在节日结束后滔滔不绝地讲述了他们的经历。

paras.en: Rodrigo performs at Daisy Chain Fields on Aug. 29. (Mario Anzuoni/Reuters)
paras.zh: 罗德里戈于 8 月 29 日在 Daisy Chain Fields 表演。（Mario Anzuoni/路透社）

paras.en: Bubble tea stall Buo Buo shared on social media in August that it was "a FEMININOMENONAL experience" to vend at the event — a reference to a Chappel Roan song — while Mano Po, which specializes in Filipino cuisine, stated that being part of the festival's inaugural year "feels extra special."
paras.zh: 珍珠奶茶摊位 Buo Buo 今年 8 月在社交媒体上表示，在活动中售卖饮料是“一种女性化的体验”（指的是 Chappel Roan 的歌曲），而专营菲律宾美食的 Mano Po 则表示，作为节日首届的一部分“感觉特别特别”。

paras.en: "As a women- and minority-owned business, being surrounded by women who create, lead, support and uplift each other means so much to us," its Aug. 31 post reads.
paras.zh: “作为一家由女性和少数族裔拥有的企业，周围都是女性，她们互相创造、领导、支持和提升，对我们来说意义重大，”该公司 8 月 31 日的帖子写道。

paras.en: Rodrigo hasn’t publicly commented on the criticisms.
paras.zh: 罗德里戈尚未对这些批评公开发表评论。

paras.en: Although charity music festivals aren't a new concept — from 1985’s Live Aid concert to a virtual festival curated by Lady Gaga to raise money for COVID-19 relief in 2020 — Daisy Chain Fields is the first one to focus on women's and reproductive rights.
paras.zh: 尽管慈善音乐节并不是一个新概念——从 1985 年的 Live Aid 音乐会到 Lady Gaga 为 2020 年的新冠肺炎 (COVID-19) 救济筹款而举办的虚拟音乐节，但 Daisy Chain Fields 是第一个关注女性权利和生殖权利的音乐节。

paras.en: The festival sparked some concerns from local authorities in its immediate wake due to a heat wave bringing high temperatures during the event, and a traffic crush from the tens of thousands of fans. But city leaders told local media they are already on board to host the event next year.
paras.zh: 由于热浪带来的高温以及数万名粉丝的交通拥堵，该音乐节一开始就引发了地方当局的一些担忧。但市领导告诉当地媒体，他们已经准备好明年举办这一活动。

paras.en: Rodrigo has been outspoken in the fight for reproductive rights, lambasting abortion bans ahead of the Daisy Chain Fields festival as not "pro-life" but "pro-control." During her GUTS tour in 2024/2025, she partnered with local women-focused charities and donated a portion of her ticket sales. She is currently on the North American leg of her Unraveled tour.
paras.zh: 罗德里戈在争取生殖权利方面一直直言不讳，他在菊花链田节之前痛斥堕胎禁令不是“反堕胎”而是“支持控制”。在 2024/2025 年 GUTS 巡演期间，她与当地关注女性的慈善机构合作，并捐赠了部分门票收入。她目前正在进行 Unraveled 巡演的北美站。

paras.en: In the wake of the festival, Rodrigo shared on social media that it was "the greatest joy of my career," saying the event felt like "a collective hope that things can get better and a reminder of how much we really care about people at the end of the day."
paras.zh: 节日结束后，罗德里戈在社交媒体上分享说，这是“我职业生涯中最大的快乐”，并表示这次活动感觉就像“集体希望事情能够变得更好，并提醒我们最终我们是多么关心人们。”

paras.en: Signs are displayed behind festivalgoers on the Marigold Stage at the Daisy Chain Fields Music Festival. (Chris Pizzello/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 在菊花链田音乐节的万寿菊舞台上，标志牌悬挂在音乐节观众身后。 （克里斯·皮泽罗/美联社）

articles.title: EU enlargement: European Commission tables reforms to prepare bloc for new members

paras.en: The European Commission wants to inject new momentum into its enlargement process, which has seen some candidate countries waiting for decades to join.
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会希望为其东扩进程注入新的动力，一些候选国已经等待了几十年才能加入。

paras.en: Albania, Montenegro, Moldova and Ukraine are currently the frontrunners to join the bloc, with EU officials expressing the hope that Montenegro could do so as early as 2028.
paras.zh: 阿尔巴尼亚、黑山、摩尔多瓦和乌克兰目前是加入欧盟的领跑者，欧盟官员表示希望黑山最早能在 2028 年加入欧盟。

paras.en: "A larger union is a long-term investment in Europe's peace, security and prosperity," Enlargement Commissioner Marta Kos told journalists in Strasbourg on October 6.
paras.zh: “扩大联盟是对欧洲和平、安全与繁荣的长期投资，”扩大欧盟委员玛尔塔·科斯 (Marta Kos) 10 月 6 日在斯特拉斯堡对记者表示。

paras.en: One key question is how the EU can take in more countries in the near future without becoming harder to run or running the risk of democratic backsliding in new member states.
paras.zh: 一个关键问题是，欧盟如何在不久的将来接纳更多国家，而又不会变得更难管理，也不冒新成员国民主倒退的风险。

paras.en: The Commission's answer to this question is to simultaneously require candidate countries to meet EU standards and get the bloc itself to reform by removing obstacles in the accession process and protecting its democratic values.
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会对这个问题的回答是，同时要求候选国满足欧盟标准，并通过消除入盟过程中的障碍并保护其民主价值观来推动欧盟本身进行改革。

paras.en: Less unanimity, more qualified majority votes
paras.zh: 一致意见较少，合格多数票较多

paras.en: One of the main stumbling blocks in accession negotiations so far has been the need for unanimous decisions across all 27 members. In the past, individual states have often blocked a candidate's progress because of bilateral issues.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，入盟谈判的主要障碍之一是需要所有 27 个成员国做出一致决定。过去，个别国家经常因为双边问题而阻止候选人的进展。

paras.en: The delays caused by Hungary's blocking of Ukraine's negotiation process are a prominent example.
paras.zh: 匈牙利阻挠乌克兰谈判进程造成的拖延就是一个突出的例子。

paras.en: Now — and not for the first time — the Commission is recommending that member states move away from the principle of unanimity for decisions like the opening of negotiation clusters, replacing it with qualified majority voting.
paras.zh: 现在——这并不是第一次——委员会建议成员国在诸如开放谈判集群之类的决策中放弃一致同意的原则，而以合格的多数投票取代。

paras.en: "Every cluster that you open is subject to three individual decisions, and every single decision is subject to unanimity. It's mind-blowing, and I think this clearly needs to go," a Commission official, who wished to remain anonymous, told journalists on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 一位不愿透露姓名的欧盟委员会官员周二对记者表示：“开放的每个集群都需要经过三项单独的决定，而每一项决定都需要获得一致同意。这令人兴奋，我认为这显然需要取消。”

paras.en: The catch is that a shift to qualified majority voting would itself require a unanimous decision.
paras.zh: 问题在于，转向合格多数投票本身就需要一致决定。

paras.en: "I have some reservations as to whether there will be unanimous agreement from the member states to move to qualified majority voting," Tinatin Akhvlediani, head of the enlargement program at the Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS) told DW, pointing to previous attempts to change voting rules that were shot down by member states.
paras.zh: 欧洲政策研究中心（CEPS）扩大项目负责人蒂纳汀·阿赫夫勒迪亚尼（Tatinatin Akhvlediani）对德国之声表示：“对于成员国是否会一致同意采用合格多数投票，我持保留态度。”他指出，此前改变投票规则的尝试均被成员国否决。

paras.en: To incentivize reform in candidate countries, the Commission is proposing gradual integration, which means that these countries could be granted some of the benefits of membership before joining — as long as they meet the EU's criteria.
paras.zh: 为了激励候选国进行改革，欧盟委员会提议逐步一体化，这意味着这些国家可以在加入之前获得一些成员资格的好处——只要它们符合欧盟的标准。

paras.en: "Gradual integration is not a substitute for full membership. It is the accelerator for enlargement," Kos said on Tuesday, underlining that the process would stay merit-based.
paras.zh: 科斯周二表示：“逐步整合并不能取代正式会员资格。它是扩大会员规模的加速器。”他强调，这一过程将继续以绩效为基础。

paras.en: This could have a motivational effect on candidate countries, Nina Vujanovic, a research fellow at Brussels-based think tank Bruegel, told DW: "Reforms are important, but it is also important to reward that process a little bit earlier, ahead of accession," she said.
paras.zh: 总部位于布鲁塞尔的布鲁盖尔智库研究员尼娜·武亚诺维奇(Nina Vujanovic)向德国之声表示，这可能会对候选国产生激励作用：“改革很重要，但在加入之前尽早奖励这一过程也很重要，”她说。

paras.en: Earlier access to EU benefits is not entirely new: Montenegro, for example, already participates in the Single Euro Payments Area (SEPA) even though it is not yet a member.
paras.zh: 提前获得欧盟福利并不是什么新鲜事：例如，黑山虽然还不是成员国，但已经加入了单一欧元支付区（SEPA）。

paras.en: The Commission now wants to give candidate countries such early access more systematically and link it to strategic alignment.
paras.zh: 委员会现在希望更系统地为候选国提供这种早期参与机会，并将其与战略调整联系起来。

paras.en: "This is not something that will be available [to candidate countries] unless they really orient themselves on the EU," a Commission official told journalists.
paras.zh: 一位欧盟委员会官员对记者表示：“除非候选国真正以欧盟为目标，否则它们不会获得这种待遇。”

paras.en: Making strategic alignment a condition is new and reflects the EU's efforts to adjust to the geopolitical tensions members and candidates are facing.
paras.zh: 将战略联盟作为一个条件是新的，反映了欧盟为适应成员国和候选人面临的地缘政治紧张局势所做的努力。

paras.en: "The EU is trying to keep candidate countries out of the hands of Russia," Heather Grabbe, a senior fellow at Bruegel, told DW. "Strategic alignment is aimed very squarely at politicians like Aleksandar Vucic in Serbia, who has clearly promoted Russian interests," she said.
paras.zh: 布鲁盖尔研究所高级研究员希瑟·格拉布 (Heather Grabbe) 告诉德国之声：“欧盟正试图阻止候选国落入俄罗斯之手。”她说：“战略联盟的目标非常明确，就是像塞尔维亚的亚历山大·武契奇这样的政客，他们明显促进了俄罗斯的利益。”

paras.en: The new procedures would demand alignment not only with the EU's foreign and security policy, but also with its standards on economic security. "Trading gas with Russia is simply not something that builds trust with the European Union," said Nina Vujanovic.
paras.zh: 新程序不仅要求与欧盟的外交和安全政策保持一致，而且还要求与经济安全标准保持一致。 “与俄罗斯进行天然气贸易根本无法与欧盟建立信任，”尼娜·武亚诺维奇说。

paras.en: The lessons the EU learned from Hungary, Poland
paras.zh: 欧盟从匈牙利和波兰吸取的教训

paras.en: To prevent breaches of democratic rules by new member states, the Commission proposes a 15-year period within which it would be easier to sanction new members by cutting financial support or restricting voting rights.
paras.zh: 为了防止新成员国违反民主规则，委员会提出了一个 15 年的期限，在此期间，可以更容易地通过削减财政支持或限制投票权来制裁新成员国。

paras.en: In an interview with The Guardian and other European media, Commissioner Kos made it clear that the EU had learned its lesson from the democratic backsliding it saw in the past in countries like Poland or Hungary: "No more Viktor Orban. We have to have quicker mechanisms than only Article 7."
paras.zh: 在接受《卫报》和其他欧洲媒体采访时，科斯委员明确表示，欧盟已经从过去在波兰或匈牙利等国家看到的民主倒退中吸取了教训：“不再有维克多·欧尔班。我们必须拥有比第七条更快的机制。”

paras.en: Double standard or necessary protection?
paras.zh: 双重标准还是必要的保护？

paras.en: Critics point out that this safeguard would create unequal conditions within the union.
paras.zh: 批评者指出，这种保障措施将在工会内部造成不平等的条件。

paras.en: "It is inherently unfair," says Heather Grabbe. "In the 2040s, why should Montenegro face different conditions than, say, Slovenia?"
paras.zh: “这本质上是不公平的，”希瑟·格拉布说。 “在 2040 年代，为什么黑山会面临与斯洛文尼亚等国不同的情况？”

paras.en: Many current candidate countries have a shaky record when it comes to democratic norms, as Tinatin Akhvlediani points out: "They are actually fragile democracies. So, this approach vis-a-vis these countries can be very much justified."
paras.zh: 当前许多候选国家在民主规范方面的记录都不稳定，正如蒂纳丁·阿赫夫勒迪亚尼 (Tinatin Akhvlediani) 指出的那样：“它们实际上是脆弱的民主国家。因此，针对这些国家的这种做法是非常合理的。”

paras.en: Experts say that while it might be desirable to apply similarly strict rules to all members, it is not realistically feasible as it would have to be approved unanimously and, as Grabbe says, "it's very hard to get turkeys to vote for Christmas."
paras.zh: 专家表示，虽然对所有成员适用同样严格的规则可能是可取的，但实际上并不可行，因为它必须得到一致批准，而且正如格拉布所说，“很难让火鸡投票支持圣诞节。”

paras.en: Although the Commission's push for new rules in relation to enlargement is likely to move the debate forward, it is ultimately up to member states to decide how much of it becomes reality.
paras.zh: 尽管欧盟委员会推动与扩大有关的新规则可能会推动辩论，但最终要由成员国来决定其中多少内容成为现实。

paras.en: The European Council, which is made up of the heads of state or government of the 27 EU member states, the European Council president and the president of the European Commission, is expected to discuss the proposals at its upcoming meeting on October 15–16.
paras.zh: 欧洲理事会由 27 个欧盟成员国的国家元首或政府首脑、欧洲理事会主席和欧盟委员会主席组成，预计将在 10 月 15 日至 16 日召开的会议上讨论这些提案。

paras.en: The outcome of those talks will determine how quickly the Commission's new enlargement agenda can move forward.
paras.zh: 这些会谈的结果将决定委员会新的扩大议程能够以多快的速度推进。

articles.title: Gerhard Schröder visits latest Russian employer, Hyperglobus

paras.en: Gerhard Schröder visited one of the Moscow branches of the new Hyperglobus supermarket chain on Wednesday, a few days after being named a member of its supervisory board.
paras.zh: 格哈德·施罗德 (Gerhard Schröder) 周三参观了新的 Hyperglobus 连锁超市在莫斯科的一家分店，几天前，他被任命为监事会成员。

paras.en: Russian TV footage showed employees at the branch greeting the former German chancellor and his current wife, So-yeon Schröder-Kim, with sustained applause.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯电视画面显示，该分行的员工在热烈的掌声中向德国前总理及其现任妻子素妍·施罗德·金致意。

paras.en: Schröder has current or recent links to a series of Russian businesses and to President Vladimir Putin, issues that have become increasingly contentious in Germany in recent years, particularly since Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022.
paras.zh: 施罗德当前或最近与一系列俄罗斯企业以及弗拉基米尔·普京总统有联系，这些问题近年来在德国变得越来越有争议，特别是自俄罗斯于 2022 年全面入侵乌克兰以来。

paras.en: The new Russian supermarket chain Hyperglobus was spun off from Germany's Globus Holding last year.
paras.zh: 新的俄罗斯连锁超市 Hyperglobus 去年从德国 Globus Holding 分拆出来。

paras.en: Last week, Hyperglobus announced that Schröder had been appointed to the supervisory board. The supermarket confirmed that the former chancellor and Social Democrat had visited a branch on the western outskirts of Moscow on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 上周，Hyperglobus 宣布任命施罗德为监事会成员。该超市证实，这位前总理和社会民主党人周三参观了莫斯科西郊的一家分店。

paras.en: "I'm very pleased to be here, to see this wonderful hypermarket, to see the results of your work and to meet you, my wonderful colleagues," RBC television in Russia quoted Schröder as saying.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯皇家广播公司电视台援引施罗德的话说：“我很高兴来到这里，看到这个精彩的大卖场，看到你们的工作成果，并见到你们，我出色的同事。”

paras.en: Schröder also reportedly called last week for the continuation of remaining trade ties between Russia and countries like Germany amid the sanctions imposed since the start of the war in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 据报道，施罗德上周还呼吁在乌克兰战争爆发以来实施的制裁中继续保持俄罗斯与德国等国家之间的剩余贸易关系。

paras.en: "It is exactly in these crisis times that these ties are especially important: they allow us to hear each other and look for ways forward," newspaper RBK reported him as saying last Friday.
paras.zh: “正是在这些危机时期，这些联系尤其重要：它们让我们能够倾听彼此的声音并寻找前进的道路，”《RBK》报纸上周五报道了他的说法。

paras.en: What's the deal with Schröder, Putin, Russia and Ukraine?
paras.zh: 施罗德、普京、俄罗斯和乌克兰有何关系？

paras.en: Schröder's close ties to Putin came under scrutiny even while he was still in office, notably in 2004 when Schröder responded to a question from a reporter by saying that, yes, he believed Putin was a "flawless democrat" or lupenreiner Demokrat.
paras.zh: 施罗德与普京的密切关系甚至在他还在任时就受到了密切关注，特别是在 2004 年，施罗德在回答记者提问时表示，是的，他相信普京是一位“完美的民主党人”或“lupenreiner Demokrat”。

paras.en: Even 22 years ago, this assertion strained credulity in many eyes — not least among opposition groups or in war-torn Chechnya.
paras.zh: 即使在 22 年前，这一说法在许多人眼中仍然令人难以置信——尤其是在反对派团体或饱受战争蹂躏的车臣。

paras.en: On leaving politics, Schröder kept close ties to the Kremlin and took up a series of senior roles, perhaps most famously on the board of the Rosneft energy giant and before that on the board of the Nord Stream gas pipeline project that was majority owned by Gazprom.
paras.zh: 离开政坛后，施罗德与克里姆林宫保持着密切联系，并担任了一系列高级职务，其中最著名的可能是能源巨头俄罗斯石油公司的董事会，以及之前担任俄罗斯天然气工业股份公司多数股权的北溪天然气管道项目的董事会。

paras.en: In 2014, not long after the annexation of Crimea and as a Russian-backed civil war brewed in Ukraine, Schröder was Nord Stream's guest of honor in St. Petersburg, where he celebrated his 70th birthday in lavish style.
paras.zh: 2014 年，克里米亚被吞并后不久，俄罗斯支持的乌克兰内战正在酝酿之中，施罗德成为北溪公司在圣彼得堡的贵宾，在那里他奢华地庆祝了自己的 70 岁生日。

paras.en: Four years later, after an election many in the West decried as bordering on a sham, Schröder took a prominent place at the 2018 swearing-in ceremony for Putin's fourth presidential term at the Kremlin (pictured above).
paras.zh: 四年后，在一场被西方许多人谴责近乎虚假的选举之后，施罗德在 2018 年普京在克里姆林宫第四次总统任期的宣誓就职仪式上占据了显着位置（如上图所示）。

paras.en: Now-deceased Russian opposition leader Alexei Navalny once said Schröder was Putin's "errand boy."
paras.zh: 现已去世的俄罗斯反对派领导人阿列克谢·纳瓦尔尼曾表示施罗德是普京的“跑腿”。

paras.en: In 2024, Schröder was stripped of a state-funded office and staff — typically provided to former chancellors — on the basis that he was no longer fulfilling any obligations tied to his previous role in government.
paras.zh: 2024 年，施罗德被剥夺了国家资助的办公室和工作人员（通常是为前总理提供的），理由是他不再履行与之前在政府中的角色相关的任何义务。

paras.en: His party, the center-left Social Democrats, tried on several occasions to eject him as a member. Each attempt failed to clear the high legal bars required, and he remains a member, having joined in 1963.
paras.zh: 他的政党，中左翼社会民主党，曾多次试图将他驱逐出党籍。每次尝试都未能通过所需的高额法律门槛，但他于 1963 年加入，仍然是会员。

paras.en: Putin has often suggested him as a possible peace mediator between Russia, Ukraine and Europe — with Schröder also expressing a willingness to take on the role — even though the reality is he would likely be entirely unacceptable as a mediator to all parties other than Russia, and particularly to Ukraine.
paras.zh: 普京经常建议他担任俄罗斯、乌克兰和欧洲之间可能的和平调解人——施罗德也表示愿意担任这一角色——尽管现实情况是，他可能完全无法接受除俄罗斯以外的所有各方，尤其是乌克兰的调解人。

paras.en: If you rely on our team for trusted reporting, please take a moment to select us as your Preferred Source on Google, so you'll always see our verified news first.
paras.zh: 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

articles.title: Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, Turkey: Could the Mecca defense pact become a game changer in the war against the Houthis in Yemen?

paras.en: The latest iteration of Saudi Arabia's defense deal with Turkey and Pakistan, the Mecca Joint Defense Agreement, is taking shape amid the country's escalating conflict with Yemen's Houthi militia.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯与土耳其和巴基斯坦的最新防务协议《麦加联合防务协议》正在该国与也门胡塞民兵冲突不断升级的情况下成形。

paras.en: According to the trilateral defense commitment, which was signed by Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman, Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan and Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on August 7, 2026, an armed attack on any one of the three states involved should be regarded as an attack on them all.
paras.zh: 根据沙特王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼、土耳其总统雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安和巴基斯坦总理谢赫巴兹·谢里夫于2026年8月7日签署的三边防务承诺，对涉及的三个国家中任何一个国家的武装攻击都应被视为对所有国家的攻击。

paras.en: Yet, despite ongoing Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and Saudi attacks on Houthi militants in Yemen, neither Pakistan nor Turkey had joined Saudi Arabia's combat operations since the deal was signed, arguing that the command and operational structures were still being developed.
paras.zh: 然而，尽管胡塞武装不断袭击沙特阿拉伯，沙特也门也门胡塞武装分子发动袭击，但自协议签署以来，巴基斯坦和土耳其都没有加入沙特阿拉伯的作战行动，他们认为指挥和作战结构仍在制定中。

paras.en: But since Monday, the situation has changed after an emergency meeting between Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkey's defense and foreign ministers and senior military chiefs in the Saudi capital Riyadh. According to a joint statement, Turkey and Pakistan decided to implement the collective defense commitments in practical terms immediately. This means providing military forces and capabilities and ensuring their rapid deployment in Saudi Arabia. The appointment of a retired Pakistani lieutenant general, Nauman Mahmood, as the alliance's first secretary-general was also announced. He will serve a three-year term.
paras.zh: 但自周一以来，沙特阿拉伯、巴基斯坦和土耳其国防部长、外交部长以及高级军事首长在沙特首都利雅得举行紧急会议后，情况发生了变化。根据联合声明，土耳其和巴基斯坦决定立即切实履行集体防御承诺。这意味着提供军事力量和能力，并确保其在沙特阿拉伯的快速部署。还宣布任命退役巴基斯坦中将瑙曼·马哈茂德为该联盟首任秘书长。他的任期为三年。

paras.en: "Ankara and Islamabad undoubtedly will seek to strengthen the Saudi kingdom's posture vis-a-vis the Houthi threat and demonstrate that the Mecca agreement can pass its first real test and show up as a game-changing alliance," Burcu Ozcelik, a senior research fellow for Middle East security at the London-based Royal United Services Institute, told DW.
paras.zh: 伦敦皇家联合军种研究所中东安全高级研究员布尔库·奥兹塞利克（Burcu Ozcelik）告诉德国之声：“安卡拉和伊斯兰堡无疑将寻求加强沙特王国应对胡塞威胁的立场，并证明麦加协议能够通过第一次真正的考验，并成为一个改变游戏规则的联盟。”

paras.en: "However, what the activation of the Mecca pact means operationally, including the specific capabilities deployed and the scope of their missions, has not been made public," she said, adding that this was "not unusual for such a military operation amid myriad sensitivities."
paras.zh: 她说：“然而，麦加协议的启动在行动上意味着什么，包括部署的具体能力及其任务范围，尚未公开。”她补充说，“对于此类具有无数敏感性的军事行动来说，这并不罕见。”

paras.en: According to the 2026 Global Firepower military strength ranking, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Turkey between them have about 1.4 million active personnel, some 3,400 military aircraft, 6,000 tanks and more than 340 naval assets.
paras.zh: 根据2026年全球火力军事实力排名，沙特阿拉伯、巴基斯坦和土耳其三国拥有约140万现役人员、约3,400架军用飞机、6,000辆坦克和340多种海军资产。

paras.en: On Wednesday, Saudi Arabia intercepted another ballistic missile north of Riyadh. Earlier this week, Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces had launched a large-scale offensive, to recapture territory along the Red Sea coast around the strategic Bab el-Mandeb Strait and the city of Mokha. Saudi Arabia launched airstrikes to support the offensive.
paras.zh: 周三，沙特阿拉伯在利雅得以北拦截了另一枚弹道导弹。本周早些时候，沙特支持的也门政府军发动了大规模攻势，以夺回红海沿岸战略性的曼德海峡和莫卡市周围的领土。沙特阿拉伯发动空袭支援攻势。

paras.en: Turkey considers a solution through dialogue
paras.zh: 土耳其考虑通过对话解决

paras.en: The scope of a potential Turkish military deployment remains unclear. Turkey is a NATO member, which means that any military involvement on its part could carry broader implications for the entire military alliance.
paras.zh: 土耳其潜在军事部署的范围仍不清楚。土耳其是北约成员国，这意味着其任何军事参与都可能对整个军事联盟产生更广泛的影响。

paras.en: Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan noted after the meeting in Riyadh on Monday that there were not only military options on the table. "We also discussed what could be done to resolve the problem peacefully and through dialogue,"
paras.zh: 土耳其外交部长哈坎·菲丹周一在利雅得会议后指出，摆在桌面上的不仅仅是军事选择。 “我们还讨论了如何通过对话和平解决问题，”

paras.en: Turkey's involvement in the Mecca defense deal has been criticized by opposition parties in the country. Under Turkey's constitution, international agreements generally require approval by the Grand National Assembly of Turkey but this has not yet been granted.
paras.zh: 土耳其参与麦加防务协议遭到该国反对党的批评。根据土耳其宪法，国际协议通常需要土耳其大国民议会的批准，但尚未获得批准。

paras.en: "How can the so-called Mecca agreement on joint defense be valid and implemented without having been submitted to the Turkish parliament for approval?" Namik Tan, an Istanbul lawmaker from the social democratic Yeni Parti and a former Turkish ambassador to Israel and the United States, asked in a statement.
paras.zh: “所谓的麦加联防协议未经土耳其议会批准，怎么能有效并得到执行呢？”来自社会民主党新党的伊斯坦布尔议员、前土耳其驻以色列和美国大使纳米克·谭（Namik Tan）在一份声明中问道。

paras.en: Yani Bagcioglu, a retired Turkish admiral, also warned that "the risk of Turkish forces and commercial vessels linked to Turkey becoming targets of Houthi attacks should not be overlooked."
paras.zh: 土耳其退役海军上将雅尼·巴格乔格鲁也警告说，“土耳其军队和与土耳其有联系的商船成为胡塞武装袭击目标的风险不应被忽视。”

paras.en: Pakistan's tightrope walk amid the Iran war
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦在伊朗战争中走钢丝

paras.en: The third signatory, Pakistan, is walking its own particular tightrope. On Monday, Defense Minister Khawaja Muhammad Asif told Pakistani television channel Geo News that Pakistan and Turkey were playing a "supportive role," with their forces involved in "reconnaissance and other things," while Saudi forces were engaged in combat.
paras.zh: 第三个签署国巴基斯坦正在走自己独特的钢丝。周一，国防部长卡瓦贾·穆罕默德·阿西夫对巴基斯坦电视频道《地理新闻》表示，巴基斯坦和土耳其正在发挥“支持作用”，两国军队参与“侦察和其他活动”，而沙特军队则参与战斗。

paras.en: "Pakistan's contribution to the defense of Saudi Arabia is nothing new," Imtiaz Gul, an independent Pakistani security analyst, told DW. "The arrangement has existed for six decades," he said, adding that "defense against the Houthis nevertheless represents a different kind of challenge because the group is considered an Iranian extension and by implication, Iran would consider this an attack on its regional interests."
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦独立安全分析师伊姆蒂亚兹·居尔 (Imtiaz Gul) 告诉德国之声：“巴基斯坦对沙特阿拉伯国防的贡献并不是什么新鲜事。”他说：“这种安排已经存在了六十年。”他补充说，“尽管如此，针对胡塞武装的防御仍然代表着一种不同类型的挑战，因为该组织被认为是伊朗的延伸，这意味着伊朗将认为这是对其地区利益的攻击。”

paras.en: A direct engagement in Yemen at Saudi Arabia's side would, therefore, risk not only ending Pakistan's apparent neutral status as a mediator in the US-Iran war, but also strain relations with Tehran, he said. He pointed out that Saudi Arabia was a close ally of the US, while the Houthis are backed by Iran.
paras.zh: 他说，因此，在也门与沙特阿拉伯直接接触不仅可能会结束巴基斯坦在美伊战争中作为调解人的明显中立地位，而且还会导致与德黑兰的关系紧张。他指出，沙特是美国的亲密盟友，而胡塞武装则得到伊朗的支持。

paras.en: Hisham Al-Omeisy, a Yemeni conflict analyst in Washington, told DW that "for years, a cornerstone of the Houthi narrative and rallying cry has been a fight against perceived external enemies." Accordingly, he added, foreign boots on the ground in Yemen would "not only backfire, it would solidify the Houthi local coalitions and fuel their recruitment drives."
paras.zh: 华盛顿的也门冲突分析师希沙姆·奥梅西 (Hisham Al-Omeisy) 告诉德国之声，“多年来，胡塞武装叙事和战斗口号的基石一直是与外部敌人的斗争。”因此，他补充说，外国军队进入也门“不仅会适得其反，还会巩固胡塞当地联盟并助长他们的招募活动。”

paras.en: Haroon Janjua in Islamabad contributed to this article.
paras.zh: 伊斯兰堡的 Haroon Janjua 对本文做出了贡献。

articles.title: Most Americans oppose Trump’s taxpayer-funded ‘golden age’ ads: Poll

paras.en: In one, a choir sings “love me” over a montage of Trump as he declares the US will “never be a communist country”. Another uses images of Mount Rushmore as Trump heralds a new “golden age of America”. The third is darker: Trump walks towards the camera in black and white, warning of a “final battle” against the “deep state” and other perceived enemies.
paras.zh: 其中一张，唱诗班在特朗普宣称美国“永远不会成为共产主义国家”的蒙太奇中唱着“爱我”。另一张则使用了拉什莫尔山的图像，特朗普预示着新的“美国黄金时代”的到来。第三个则更黑暗：特朗普走向黑白镜头，警告称将与“深层政府”和其他被视为敌人的“最后一战”。

paras.en: All three end with a disclaimer saying they were “Paid for by the U.S. Government.”
paras.zh: 这三个项目都以免责声明结尾，称它们是“由美国政府支付的”。

paras.en: Democratic lawmakers have said the White House transferred $20m in Department of Homeland Security funds to pay for the campaign and have called for independent investigations.
paras.zh: 民主党议员表示，白宫从国土安全部拨款 2000 万美元用于支付竞选费用，并呼吁进行独立调查。

paras.en: But criticism has also come from within Trump’s own party.
paras.zh: 但批评也来自特朗普自己的党内。

paras.en: “It shouldn’t be paid for with taxpayer dollars,” Republican Senate Majority Leader John Thune told reporters last month.
paras.zh: “它不应该用纳税人的钱来支付，”共和党参议院多数党领袖约翰·图恩上个月告诉记者。

paras.en: “There’s nothing in here about a particular policy that’s at all focused,” Richard Painter, a former White House ethics lawyer under George W Bush, told The Associated Press news agency.
paras.zh: 乔治·W·布什时期的前白宫道德律师理查德·佩因特对美联社表示：“这里没有任何关于特定政策的内容。”

paras.en: “You watch all three ads; they’re sheer propaganda,” said Painter. “This is increasingly looking like what authoritarian governments do to promote their leaders.”
paras.zh: “你看了这三个广告；它们纯粹是宣传，”佩因特说。 “这越来越像独裁政府为提拔领导人而采取的做法。”

articles.title: Saudi Arabia says Houthi attacks on airports killed three foreign nationals

paras.en: Three civilians have been killed and 36 injured in Houthi attacks on Abha and King Khalid International airports on Tuesday and Wednesday, according to a statement from the Saudi General Authority of Civil Aviation.
paras.zh: 根据沙特民航总局的一份声明，胡塞武装周二和周三对艾卜哈国际机场和哈立德国王国际机场发动袭击，造成 3 名平民死亡、36 人受伤。

paras.en: The attack on Abha Airport killed two female residents, a Moroccan and an Algerian, and injured 28 others, it added.
paras.zh: 报道补充说，艾卜哈机场的袭击造成两名女性居民（一名摩洛哥人和一名阿尔及利亚人）死亡，另有 28 人受伤。

paras.en: The attack on King Khalid International Airport in the capital Riyadh killed a Sudanese citizen and injured eight residents, including five Saudi citizens.
paras.zh: 首都利雅得哈立德国王国际机场遇袭，造成一名苏丹公民死亡，八名居民受伤，其中包括五名沙特公民。
