paras.en: On September 18, Saudi-led coalition forces said they intercepted and destroyed a suspected Houthi ballistic missile fired towards the airport in Riyadh from Yemen.
paras.zh: 9月18日，沙特领导的联军表示，他们拦截并摧毁了一枚疑似胡塞武装从也门向利雅得机场发射的弹道导弹。

paras.en: A day later, at least one explosion was heard near the airport on September 19 in Riyadh, and a large plume of black smoke was seen rising from a fuel storage area at King Khalid International Airport.
paras.zh: 一天后，9月19日，利雅得机场附近至少听到一声爆炸，哈立德国王国际机场的燃料储存区冒出大量黑烟。

paras.en: Saudi-backed Yemeni forces from the country’s internationally recognized government are locked in escalating combat with Iran-aligned Houthi forces who seized a broad swath of territory astride the strategic Bab al-Mandeb strait which connects the Arabian and Red Seas.
paras.zh: 沙特支持的也门军队与伊朗结盟的胡塞武装的战斗不断升级，胡塞武装占领了连接阿拉伯海和红海的战略性曼德海峡的大片领土。

articles.title: Witnesses spot Eritrean troops inside northern Ethiopia as tensions flare

paras.en: Eritrean soldiers have been seen driving through a northern town inside Ethiopia, witnesses tell the Reuters news agency, days after the neighbouring countries severed ties.
paras.zh: 目击者告诉路透社，在邻国断绝关系几天后，有人看到厄立特里亚士兵开车穿过埃塞俄比亚境内的一个北部城镇。

paras.en: At least two witnesses told Reuters they saw “dozens” of Eritrean soldiers drive through Adigrat in two trucks on Wednesday. The town is located 25km (15 miles) south of the border with Eritrea.
paras.zh: 至少两名目击者告诉路透社，他们周三看到“数十名”厄立特里亚士兵乘坐两辆卡车驶过阿迪格拉特。该镇位于厄立特里亚边境以南 25 公里（15 英里）处。

paras.en: The witnesses said they could identify the soldiers as Eritrean by their off-white camouflage uniforms.
paras.zh: 目击者称，通过这些士兵的灰白色迷彩服，他们可以认出他们是厄立特里亚人。

paras.en: Another Adigrat resident who was not in town at the time said family members had told him they had also seen Eritrean troops, according to Reuters, which could not independently verify their accounts.
paras.zh: 据路透社报道，另一名当时不在城里的阿迪格拉特居民表示，家人告诉他，他们还看到了厄立特里亚军队，但路透社无法独立核实他们的说法。

paras.en: “The Eritrean army has entered Tigray in uniform, equipped with heavy weaponry,” said Gebreigziabher Beyene, commander of the Tigray Peace Force, a pro-government militia that has fought alongside the federal army.
paras.zh: “厄立特里亚军队已身着制服、配备重型武器进入提格雷，”提格雷和平部队指挥官格布雷格齐阿贝尔·贝耶内 (Gebreigziabher Beyene) 说。提格雷和平部队是一支与联邦军队并肩作战的亲政府民兵组织。

paras.en: “This force is being struck by drones,” he said, adding Eritrea was “deliberately deploying its forces so that the fighting takes place inside Tigray rather than spilling into Eritrea”.
paras.zh: 他说：“这支部队正在遭到无人机袭击。”他补充说，厄立特里亚正在“刻意部署部队，以便战斗发生在提格雷境内，而不是蔓延到厄立特里亚”。

paras.en: Last week, the chief administrator in Ethiopia’s northeastern Afar region said Eritrean troops were fighting in the area, but Reuters was unable to confirm the claim.
paras.zh: 上周，埃塞俄比亚东北部阿法尔地区的首席行政长官表示，厄立特里亚军队正在该地区作战，但路透社无法证实这一说法。

paras.en: In a statement on X, Eritrea’s Information Minister Yemane Meskel did not deny that troops had crossed the border, but said Ethiopia’s government was creating “a fallacious narrative of ‘self-defense’ to rationalise and camouflage its war of aggression”.
paras.zh: 在 X 网站的一份声明中，厄立特里亚新闻部长耶马内·梅斯克尔没有否认军队越过边界，但表示埃塞俄比亚政府正在制造“一种错误的‘自卫’叙事，以合理化和掩饰其侵略战争”。

paras.en: If confirmed, it would mark the first time Eritrean forces have been seen inside Ethiopia since the renewal of fighting between Ethiopian forces and a seven-group armed alliance, including the Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF), on September 23.
paras.zh: 如果得到证实，这将标志着自 9 月 23 日埃塞俄比亚军队与包括提格雷人民解放阵线 (TPLF) 在内的七支武装联盟重新爆发战斗以来，厄立特里亚军队首次出现在埃塞俄比亚境内。

paras.en: Ethiopia has accused Eritrea, as well as Egypt and Sudan of backing the armed alliance which is fighting to remove the government. All three countries have denied involvement.
paras.zh: 埃塞俄比亚指责厄立特里亚以及埃及和苏丹支持旨在推翻政府的武装联盟。这三个国家都否认参与其中。

paras.en: Eritrea announced it was severing ties with Ethiopia on Thursday after Addis Ababa announced it would close its embassy in Asmara and expel 10 Eritrean diplomats.
paras.zh: 亚的斯亚贝巴宣布将关闭驻阿斯马拉大使馆并驱逐 10 名厄立特里亚外交官后，厄立特里亚周四宣布与埃塞俄比亚断绝关系。

paras.en: In a statement, Eritrea’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs said Ethiopia’s actions had left it with “no option but to reciprocate in kind and sever all diplomatic ties with Ethiopia”.
paras.zh: 厄立特里亚外交部在一份声明中表示，埃塞俄比亚的行为使其“别无选择，只能以牙还牙，并断绝与埃塞俄比亚的所有外交关系”。

paras.en: On Monday, Ethiopian forces captured Tigray’s regional capital Mekelle, days after the TPLF confirmed that it had withdrawn from the city and moved its regional administration “temporarily” to another location.
paras.zh: 周一，埃塞俄比亚军队占领了提格雷地区首府默克莱，几天前，提格雷人民解放阵线确认已从该市撤军，并将其地区行政机构“暂时”迁往另一个地点。

paras.en: It happened as Ethiopia’s Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed was sworn in for another five-year term, during which he insisted that his landlocked country must have access to the Red Sea.
paras.zh: 这件事发生在埃塞俄比亚总理阿比·艾哈迈德宣誓就职，开始另一个五年任期之际，他坚称这个内陆国家必须拥有通往红海的通道。

paras.en: On the same day, Eritrea joined Somalia, Sudan and Egypt in issuing a joint declaration calling for a political and peaceful solution to the war in Ethiopia.
paras.zh: 同日，厄立特里亚与索马里、苏丹和埃及一道发表联合声明，呼吁政治与和平解决埃塞俄比亚战争。

paras.en: The declaration appeared to push back against several policies pursued by Ethiopia in recent years, highlighting widening rifts between Addis Ababa and its neighbours.
paras.zh: 该声明似乎是对埃塞俄比亚近年来推行的多项政策的反击，凸显了亚的斯亚贝巴与其邻国之间不断扩大的裂痕。

articles.title: DIY fertilizer is a blessing as farmers face steep prices due to the Iran war
articles.author: Durrie Bouscaren

paras.en: DIY fertilizer is a blessing as farmers face steep prices due to the Iran war
paras.zh: 由于伊朗战争，农民面临高昂的价格，自制肥料是一件幸事

paras.en: On 12 acres outside of Lusaka, Kanangwa Newlove has built a paradise.
paras.zh: Kanangwa Newlove 在卢萨卡郊外 12 英亩的土地上建造了一个天堂。

paras.en: Shady fruit trees dot her fields. During the growing season, long tomato vines drape over trellises. There are tidy rows of corn, pumpkins and a local leafy green called blackjack. Eleven varieties of lettuce.
paras.zh: 成荫的果树点缀着她的田野。在生长季节，长长的番茄藤蔓覆盖在棚架上。那里整齐地排列着一排排玉米、南瓜和当地一种叫做二十一点的绿叶蔬菜。十一个品种的生菜。

paras.en: "I started taking vegetables to my workmates, and before I knew it I was supplying the supermarket," Newlove says. "It went on and on."
paras.zh: “我开始给我的同事送蔬菜，不知不觉间我就开始为超市供货了，”纽洛夫说。 “事情一直持续着。”

paras.en: For many farmers, 2026 has been a challenging year. The Iran war choked off the Strait of Hormuz and dramatically halted international trade shipments — including fertilizers. Prices spiked globally. The effects were quickly felt in African countries, where smallholder farmers are often vulnerable to rapid changes in fertilizer costs.''
paras.zh: 对于许多农民来说，2026 年是充满挑战的一年。伊朗战争封锁了霍尔木兹海峡，并大幅停止了包括化肥在内的国际贸易运输。全球价格飙升。非洲国家很快就感受到了影响，这些国家的小农往往容易受到化肥成本快速变化的影响。”

paras.en: Newlove, however, didn't feel the pinch. For years, she's fertilized her plants with a homemade, fermented compost known as bokashi.
paras.zh: 然而，纽洛夫并没有感到压力。多年来，她一直用一种名为“博卡西”的自制发酵堆肥给植物施肥。

paras.en: With roots in ancient Korean farming traditions and popularized in Japan, bokashi is relatively easy to make. According to Newlove, it's also highly effective.
paras.zh: 博卡西起源于韩国古代农业传统，并在日本流行，制作起来相对容易。根据 Newlove 的说法，它也非常有效。

paras.en: "We could now have a potent fertilizer —– organic —– which is ready in [weeks]. For us that was amazing," Newlove says. "It was a game changer, to be honest."
paras.zh: “我们现在可以拥有一种强效肥料——有机肥料——在几周内就可以准备好。对我们来说，这太棒了，”纽洛夫说。 “说实话，这改变了游戏规则。”

paras.en: Bokashi has become so popular in Zambia, she says, that farmers now sell homemade bokashi compost at markets and swap tips on social media. The Kasisi Agricultural Training Centre offers bokashi training and often sends students to her farm to see it in action.
paras.zh: 她说，博卡西在赞比亚非常受欢迎，农民现在在市场上出售自制的博卡西堆肥，并在社交媒体上交流小贴士。卡西西农业培训中心提供博卡西培训，并经常派学生到她的农场观看实际操作。

paras.en: "[Zambian farmers] have been looking for alternatives — how to grow food but reduce costs," says Rabecca Mwila of the Knowledge Platform for Organic Agriculture and Agroecology in Africa. "Inputs such as bokashi have come in to provide a cushion for them."
paras.zh: “[赞比亚农民]一直在寻找替代方案——如何种植粮食并降低成本，”非洲有机农业和农业生态知识平台的拉贝卡·姆维拉 (Rabecca Mwila) 说。 “博卡西等投入为他们提供了缓冲。”

paras.en: For home composters, bokashi is a method of fermenting food scraps in an anaerobic environment — no oxygen allowed! But many farmers make a version of bokashi outdoors. Ingredients are often easy to find on a farm: leaves or crop residues, animal dung, charcoal and ash from a fireplace. Then, they add yeast and a source of sugar (molasses or bananas, in a pinch) to jump start the fermentation process. The mixture heats up as microbes break it down.
paras.zh: 对于家用堆肥机来说，博卡西是一种在厌氧环境（不允许有氧气）下发酵食物残渣的方法！但许多农民在户外制作博卡西。农场里的原料通常很容易找到：树叶或农作物残渣、动物粪便、木炭和壁炉的灰烬。然后，他们添加酵母和糖源（必要时加入糖蜜或香蕉）以启动发酵过程。当微生物分解混合物时，混合物会升温。

paras.en: After a couple of weeks of fermentation, the concoction is buried underground near Newlove's crops, so it can break down completely.
paras.zh: 经过几周的发酵后，这种混合物被埋在纽洛夫农作物附近的地下，这样它就可以完全分解。

paras.en: "There's a lot of excitement from farmers because they've been able to testify that it's cheaper for them, and their soil is rebuilding," Mwila says. "They're able to see earthworms."
paras.zh: “农民们非常兴奋，因为他们能够证明这对他们来说更便宜，而且他们的土壤正在重建，”姆维拉说。 “他们能够看到蚯蚓。”

paras.en: As climate change makes rainfall less predictable and dry seasons longer, Mwila says farmers are increasingly interested in inexpensive, sustainable options.
paras.zh: 姆维拉表示，由于气候变化使降雨变得更加难以预测，旱季变得更长，农民对廉价、可持续的选择越来越感兴趣。

paras.en: Many voice concerns about the longer-term impact of commercial fertilizers. "Because of the overuse of synthetic fertilizers and pesticides and herbicides, the soil is completely depleted," says Mwila.
paras.zh: 许多人对商业化肥的长期影响表示担忧。 “由于过度使用合成肥料、杀虫剂和除草剂，土壤已完全枯竭，”姆维拉说。

paras.en: Zambia once imported nearly all of its fertilizer. After global prices tripled following the COVID-19 pandemic and the Russian invasion of Ukraine, finding alternatives became a matter of food security.
paras.zh: 赞比亚曾经几乎所有化肥都是进口的。在 COVID-19 大流行和俄罗斯入侵乌克兰之后，全球价格上涨了两倍，寻找替代品成为粮食安全问题。

paras.en: In addition to bokashi, the Zambian government has promoted the growth of its domestic fertilizer industry. Last week, a Chinese-Zambian conglomerate announced its intention to build a $1.5 billion fertilizer plant in the country.
paras.zh: 除了博卡西之外，赞比亚政府还推动了国内化肥行业的发展。上周，一家中赞企业集团宣布有意在该国建设一座耗资 15 亿美元的化肥厂。

paras.en: Although global fertilizer prices largely dropped over the summer, including in Zambia, some fertilizers remain expensive in southern African countries, including Malawi, Tanzania and South Africa.
paras.zh: 尽管包括赞比亚在内的全球化肥价格在夏季大幅下降，但马拉维、坦桑尼亚和南非等南部非洲国家的一些化肥价格仍然昂贵。

paras.en: While the government subsidizes fertilizer, there isn't always enough to go around. Donald Zulu, a lecturer and researcher at Copperbelt University in northern Zambia, says that without subsidies — a farmer will pay about $400 USD to buy enough fertilizer to grow 2.5 acres of corn.
paras.zh: 虽然政府对化肥进行补贴，但并不总是足够的。赞比亚北部铜带大学 (Copperbelt University) 讲师兼研究员唐纳德·祖鲁 (Donald Zulu) 表示，如果没有补贴，农民将支付约 400 美元购买足够种植 2.5 英亩玉米的化肥。

paras.en: "It's quite expensive and out of reach for many smallholder farmers," Zulu says.
paras.zh: “这非常昂贵，对于许多小农来说是遥不可及的，”祖鲁说。

paras.en: Seeking an alternative, he started working with WeForest and local farmers to study how well bokashi worked on corn and cabbage in 2024.
paras.zh: 为了寻找替代方案，他开始与 WeForest 和当地农民合作，研究 2024 年 bokashi 在玉米和卷心菜上的效果如何。

paras.en: "The results were very encouraging," Zulu says. "Bokashi echoed the yields of mineral fertilizer."
paras.zh: “结果非常令人鼓舞，”祖鲁说。 “博卡西呼应了矿物肥料的产量。”

paras.en: This suggested that small-scale farmers could use bokashi — which is cheaper — and grow a comparable amount of food. But to his surprise, the best-performing crops were planted with smaller amounts of both bokashi and mineral fertilizers.
paras.zh: 这表明小规模农民可以使用更便宜的博卡西来种植相当数量的粮食。但令他惊讶的是，效果最好的作物是使用较少量的博卡西肥料和矿物肥料种植的。

paras.en: "That's where bokashi becomes key in terms of helping farmers to be food secure," he said.
paras.zh: “这就是博卡西在帮助农民确保粮食安全方面发挥关键作用的地方，”他说。

paras.en: For farmers like Kanangwa Newlove, bokashi is less about the cost, and more about building a sustainable farming practice that preserves the land.
paras.zh: 对于像卡南瓜·纽洛夫这样的农民来说，博卡西并不是成本，而是建立一种保护土地的可持续农业实践。

paras.en: "Even when you're making it, you don't need to wear a mask because it's not toxic. There's no harmful chemicals," Newlove says. "So it's all just like a labor of love."
paras.zh: “即使在制作过程中，你也不需要戴口罩，因为它无毒。没有有害化学物质，”纽洛夫说。 “所以这一切就像是一种爱的劳动。”

articles.title: Greetings from Lahore, Pakistan, whose high court offers an oasis for chatter and chai
articles.author: Diaa Hadid

paras.en: Greetings from Lahore, Pakistan, whose high court offers an oasis for chatter and chai
paras.zh: 来自巴基斯坦拉合尔的问候，其高等法院为聊天和茶提供了绿洲

paras.en: I'm always eager for an excuse to visit the Lahore High Court in the British-built quarters of Pakistan's second-largest city.
paras.zh: 我总是渴望有借口去参观位于巴基斯坦第二大城市的英国人建造的拉合尔高等法院。

paras.en: To me, the high court is a near-perfect specimen of British South Asian colonial architecture: Mughal in its curly arches that frame porticos, the Gothic detail that emerges through the red brick baked on the city's outskirts in pluming kilns.
paras.zh: 对我来说，高等法院是英国南亚殖民建筑的近乎完美的典范：莫卧儿王朝的卷曲拱门构成了门廊，哥特式的细节通过在城市郊区的羽毛窑中烘烤的红砖而显现出来。

paras.en: Within, it's a sea of busy, flapping penguins: Pakistani lawyers in their uniforms of white shirts and black suits rushing between courtrooms.
paras.zh: 里面是一片忙碌的、扑腾着翅膀的企鹅的海洋：身着白衬衫和黑西装制服的巴基斯坦律师在法庭之间奔波。

paras.en: They take a rest in the main square, all chatter and chai under the banyan trees that still shade the men and women of law.
paras.zh: 他们在主广场休息，在榕树下聊天和喝茶，榕树仍然为法律的男男女女遮荫。

paras.en: It's a contrast to the wheezy, heavily polluted city. Lahore has far fewer trees outside its elite quarters — a signal of a broader crisis in Pakistan, where there's one standard for the masses and another for those who hold power.
paras.zh: 这与气喘吁吁、污染严重的城市形成鲜明对比。拉合尔的精英住宅区以外的树木要少得多，这是巴基斯坦存在更广泛危机的信号，那里对群众有一个标准，对掌权者有另一个标准。

paras.en: For more Far-Flung Postcards, click here.
paras.zh: 欲了解更多遥远的明信片，请点击此处。

articles.title: Gut microbes followed migrating humans across continents, new study suggests
articles.author: Pien Huang

paras.en: Gut microbes followed migrating humans across continents, new study suggests
paras.zh: 新研究表明肠道微生物跟随人类跨越大陆迁徙

paras.en: The Hadza people are hunter-gatherers who have roamed northern Tanzania for thousands of years.
paras.zh: 哈扎人是狩猎采集者，他们在坦桑尼亚北部游荡了数千年。

paras.en: The indigenous Tsimane people forage, fish and hunt in the Bolivian Amazon, some 7,000 miles away.
paras.zh: 土著提斯曼人在约 7,000 英里外的玻利维亚亚马逊地区觅食、捕鱼和打猎。

paras.en: These two rural communities, separated by an ocean, may appear to have little in common. But a new study shows that they share remarkable similarities when it comes to the bacteria in their guts.
paras.zh: 这两个远隔重洋的农村社区似乎没有什么共同点。但一项新的研究表明，就肠道细菌而言，它们有着显着的相似之处。

paras.en: Experts say the new paper in the journal Nature suggests this microbial kinship may have taken shape long ago, before human migration split these groups' ancestors apart.
paras.zh: 专家表示，《自然》杂志上的这篇新论文表明，这种微生物亲缘关系可能很久以前就已经形成，早在人类迁徙导致这些群体的祖先分裂之前。

paras.en: The study, which relied on stool samples from both groups, also showed that both the Hadza and Tsimane microbiomes were markedly different from city folk, even those living nearby.
paras.zh: 这项基于两组粪便样本的研究还表明，哈扎人和提斯曼人的微生物组与城市居民，甚至是居住在附近的城市居民显着不同。

paras.en: The findings suggest that some strains of gut bacteria have long coexisted with humans, possibly to their mutual benefit. It's an idea that some scientists say raises questions about the impacts of losing those microbes to modern lifestyles.
paras.zh: 研究结果表明，某些肠道细菌菌株长期以来与人类共存，这可能是为了互惠互利。一些科学家表示，这个想法引发了人们对现代生活方式中失去这些微生物的影响的疑问。

paras.en: "If we were inhabited by very similar microbes over a long period of time, it suggests that our human genomes may have come to expect a certain set of microbes and functions," says Justin Sonnenburg, a professor of microbiology and immunology at Stanford University and the study's senior author. "When you start to lose biodiversity in your gut, there may be big issues for your human biology to adjust to and accommodate."
paras.zh: 斯坦福大学微生物学和免疫学教授、该研究的资深作者贾斯汀·索南伯格（Justin Sonnenburg）说：“如果我们在很长一段时间内居住着非常相似的微生物，这表明我们的人类基因组可能已经预料到了一组特定的微生物和功能。” “当你的肠道开始失去生物多样性时，你的人体生物学可能会出现需要调整和适应的大问题。”

paras.en: Other researchers not affiliated with the paper say the hypothesis is intriguing, but not yet proven — and that perhaps there's a reason these microbes tend not to appear in city dwellers' guts.
paras.zh: 其他与该论文无关的研究人员表示，这个假设很有趣，但尚未得到证实——也许这些微生物不会出现在城市居民的肠道中是有原因的。

paras.en: "Another alternative is that the industrialized microbiome profile may actually be adapted to an industrialized lifestyle," says Andrew Moeller, an associate professor of evolutionary biology at Princeton University. "From a health perspective, is it good or deleterious that industrialized humans have lost a lot of ancestral microbial taxa [groups]? We actually don't know."
paras.zh: “另一种选择是，工业化的微生物组实际上可能适应工业化的生活方式，”普林斯顿大学进化生物学副教授安德鲁·莫勒说。 “从健康的角度来看，工业化人类失去了许多祖先的微生物类群（群体）是好事还是坏事？我们实际上不知道。”

paras.en: Documenting what's been kept and lost is a step towards figuring that out, he says.
paras.zh: 他说，记录下被保留和丢失的东西是解决这个问题的一个步骤。

paras.en: Sonnenburg has previously contrasted the microbiomes of the Hadza with those of industrialized people. He and his colleagues wanted to compare these two communities with one another. "They're living a lifestyle that's much more similar to the lifestyle our ancestors lived, and so therefore is more hospitable to microbes that were handed down through many generations over the course of human evolution," Sonnenburg says.
paras.zh: 索南伯格此前曾将哈扎人的微生物组与工业化人群的微生物组进行了对比。他和他的同事想将这两个社区进行相互比较。索南伯格说：“他们的生活方式与我们祖先的生活方式非常相似，因此更适合在人类进化过程中代代相传的微生物。”

paras.en: Still, the major overlap was "startling," he says. In comparing the genetic material in stool samples from dozens of individuals collected by the Tsimane Health and Life History Project, with previous analysis from the Hadza community, Sonnenburg and his colleagues found they had around 1,200 of the same bacterial species living in their guts — a near-90% overlap.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，他表示，主要的重叠还是“令人震惊”。在将 Tsimane 健康和生活史项目收集的数十个人的粪便样本中的遗传物质与哈扎社区之前的分析进行比较时，Sonnenburg 和他的同事发现，他们的肠道内生活着大约 1,200 种相同的细菌种类——接近 90% 的重叠。

paras.en: In a typical gut microbiome, hundreds to thousands of species interact with each other — mostly bacteria, along with some fungi and viruses. "The microbes are helping us digest foods in our gut, secreting molecules that get absorbed into the bloodstream," Sonnenburg says. "And our blood, of course, circulates throughout our bodies."
paras.zh: 在典型的肠道微生物组中，数百到数千个物种相互作用——主要是细菌，还有一些真菌和病毒。 “微生物正在帮助我们消化肠道中的食物，分泌被吸收到血液中的分子，”索南伯格说。 “当然，我们的血液在我们的全身循环。”

paras.en: The gut bacteria can influence moods, behavior, and the body's response to infections, affecting fundamental parts of biology and health, he adds.
paras.zh: 他补充说，肠道细菌可以影响情绪、行为和身体对感染的反应，影响生物学和健康的基本部分。

paras.en: Microbiomes are dynamic — which means they can also change quickly, depending on what foods we eat and what medicines we take.
paras.zh: 微生物组是动态的——这意味着它们也可以快速变化，具体取决于我们吃什么食物和服用什么药物。

paras.en: So it's remarkable that the Hadza and the Tsimane — isolated communities living very far apart, eating different vegetables, fish and meats — have gut bacteria that are much the same, Sonnenburg says.
paras.zh: 索南伯格说，值得注意的是，哈扎人和提斯曼人——生活在相距很远的偏僻社区，吃不同的蔬菜、鱼和肉——拥有几乎相同的肠道细菌。

paras.en: He and his colleagues think Hadza and Tsimane peoples' shared microbial profile goes back to their common ancestors in Africa, before some of those humans left the continent, passed through Eurasia and crossed a land-bridge that once connected Russia with Alaska, and eventually settled in the Bolivian Amazon. Later, as sea levels rose, the land bridge disappeared.
paras.zh: 他和他的同事认为，哈扎人和提斯曼人的共同微生物特征可以追溯到他们在非洲的共同祖先，当时其中一些人离开非洲大陆，穿过欧亚大陆，穿过曾经连接俄罗斯和阿拉斯加的陆桥，最终定居在玻利维亚亚马逊地区。后来，随着海平面上升，陆桥消失了。

paras.en: "Once the land bridge went away, we had a clear picture that it was going to be very hard for them to exchange gut bacteria through traditional human contact means," says Ben Good, a theoretical biophysicist at Stanford and a study co-author.
paras.zh: “一旦陆桥消失，我们就清楚地意识到，它们将很难通过传统的人类接触方式交换肠道细菌，”斯坦福大学理论生物物理学家、研究合著者本·古德说。

paras.en: Using dating techniques based on the rates at which bacteria change, they determined that on average, the microbial strains likely shared a common ancestor about 17,000 years ago — with some dating much further back. "That is consistent with the idea that these populations in South America, Africa and probably in other parts of the world are not just acquiring microbes from their environment that match their lifestyle, so much as transmitting microbes over generations," Sonnenburg says.
paras.zh: 他们利用基于细菌变化率的测年技术，确定平均而言，这些微生物菌株可能在大约 17,000 年前拥有一个共同的祖先，其中一些的历史可以追溯到更早的时候。索南伯格说：“这与南美洲、非洲以及可能世界其他地区的这些人群不仅从环境中获取与他们的生活方式相匹配的微生物的想法是一致的，而且还在代代相传微生物。”

paras.en: Other researchers agree that the findings support the concept that large swaths of the gut microbiome migrated with humans — and likely evolved with them, too.
paras.zh: 其他研究人员一致认为，这些发现支持了这样的观点，即大量肠道微生物群与人类一起迁移，并且很可能也与人类一起进化。

paras.en: "If the bacteria and the humans had a shared history for many, many generations, there are more opportunities for selection," says Taichi Suzuki, an assistant professor at Arizona State University not affiliated with this paper, who conducts microbiome research. "We would expect more potential dependencies between [the co-evolved] gut microbes and our own genome, basically."
paras.zh: “如果细菌和人类有着很多很多代的共同历史，那么就有更多的选择机会，”亚利桑那州立大学助理教授铃木太一（Taichi Suzuki）说，他不参与本文，他从事微生物组研究。 “基本上，我们预计[共同进化的]肠道微生物与我们自己的基因组之间存在更多潜在的依赖性。”

paras.en: Babies are born with a blank slate microbiome, and start acquiring gut bacteria right away.
paras.zh: 婴儿出生时微生物组是一片空白，并立即开始获得肠道细菌。

paras.en: "We first get our microbes from our mother's vaginal canal, mother's skin," says Suzuki at Arizona State, "Then as we develop, we get microbes mostly from other individuals in the household and the community."
paras.zh: 亚利桑那州立大学的铃木说：“我们首先从母亲的阴道管、母亲的皮肤中获取微生物，然后随着我们的发育，我们主要从家庭和社区中的其他个体获取微生物。”

paras.en: This human-to-human transmission occurs through the fecal-oral route — ingesting microscopic particles of poo in the air and dust — and serves the important function of passing along microbes that are specific to humans, says Moeller at Princeton. "Something that might make that less disgusting is realizing how tiny these things are," he says, "They're a micron or less in length, and in principle, you just need one cell to found a new population."
paras.zh: 普林斯顿大学的莫勒说，这种人与人之间的传播是通过粪口途径发生的——摄入空气中粪便的微小颗粒和灰尘——并发挥着传播人类特有微生物的重要功能。 “意识到这些东西有多么微小，可能会让这种感觉不那么恶心，”他说，“它们的长度只有一微米或更小，原则上，你只需要一个细胞就能建立一个新的群体。”

paras.en: The gut also picks up generalist microbes that exist in the environment by ingesting food, soil and water, Moeller says. For instance, E. coli — a bacteria that's found in many places, and thrives in the bodies of humans and many animals.
paras.zh: 莫勒说，肠道还通过摄入食物、土壤和水来吸收环境中存在的普通微生物。例如，大肠杆菌——一种在许多地方都有发现的细菌，并且在人类和许多动物体内大量繁殖。

paras.en: Some researchers hypothesize that the microbes that have co-evolved with humans may help protect human health — or at least do less harm. For instance, in a case study, those with African ancestry have been found to have a far lower risk of getting seriously ill from an African strain of H. pylori, presumably because their genomes developed alongside the bacteria, compared with those of other ancestries who are susceptible to developing a deadly stomach cancer. It's an example that shows the potential harms of a mismatch between gut microbes and the human genome, Suzuki says.
paras.zh: 一些研究人员推测，与人类共同进化的微生物可能有助于保护人类健康，或者至少减少危害。例如，在一项案例研究中，发现非洲血统的人因非洲幽门螺杆菌菌株患重病的风险要低得多，这可能是因为他们的基因组与细菌一起发育，而与其他易患致命胃癌的血统的人相比。铃木说，这个例子显示了肠道微生物与人类基因组不匹配的潜在危害。

paras.en: Around 60% of the gut microbes the Hadza and Tsimane people share are rare or absent from the guts of people who live modern, industrialized lives, according to the paper. "The microbes that inhabit my gut are very unlikely to be the microbes that were handed down through the generations from my great great grandparents," Sonnenburg, the Stanford co-author, says. "They are much more likely to be a product of my current lifestyle and the people that I've interacted with locally."
paras.zh: 论文称，哈扎人和提斯曼人共有的肠道微生物中，大约有 60% 在现代工业化生活的人们的肠道中很少见或不存在。斯坦福大学的合著者索南伯格说：“我肠道里的微生物不太可能是我的曾曾祖父母世代相传的微生物。” “它们更有可能是我目前的生活方式以及我在当地接触过的人的产物。”

paras.en: He thinks losing these ancestral microbes may be harming human health. While proving causation is tricky, "a lot of the arrows are pointing in the same direction, that our modern microbiome has changed in ways that may be propagating inflammation, may be unhealthy for us and leading to inflammatory diseases," Sonnenburg says.
paras.zh: 他认为失去这些祖先微生物可能会损害人类健康。虽然证明因果关系很棘手，但“很多箭头都指向同一个方向，即我们的现代微生物组已经发生了变化，可能会传播炎症，可能对我们不健康并导致炎症性疾病，”索南伯格说。

paras.en: Much scientific work will be needed to prove or disprove the theory. "With regards to the evolutionary questions like, which of [these] microbes have we co-evolved with? Which ones have we lost that would be beneficial to regain? It's still early days for that line of questioning," Moeller at Princeton says.
paras.zh: 需要大量的科学工作来证明或反驳该理论。普林斯顿大学的莫勒说：“关于进化问题，比如，我们与哪些微生物共同进化？我们失去了哪些微生物，但有利于重新获得？目前这些问题还处于早期阶段。”

paras.en: Still, he adds, determining which gut bacteria have been with humans for a long time helps move the field forward.
paras.zh: 不过，他补充说，确定哪些肠道细菌已经存在于人类很长时间有助于推动该领域的发展。

articles.title: Jon Rahm won't participate under LIV Golf's 'unacceptable' new terms amid league's bankruptcy, lawyers say

paras.en: LIV Golf is doing whatever it can to stay alive after the Public Investment Fund (PIF) ended its monetary commitment to the league — however, it may now need to stay afloat without its best player.
paras.zh: 在公共投资基金 (PIF) 结束对联盟的资金承诺后，LIV Golf 正在尽一切努力维持生存——然而，它现在可能需要在没有最好的球员的情况下维持生计。

paras.en: Jon Rahm shocked the golf world nearly three years ago when, after publicly dismissing the league, he joined it on a deal that was rumored to be between $300 and $600 million.
paras.zh: 近三年前，琼·拉姆 (Jon Rahm) 在公开宣布解散该联盟后，以传闻中价值 300 至 6 亿美元的交易加入该联盟，震惊了高尔夫界。

paras.en: But at Wednesday's bankruptcy hearing, Rahm's attorneys stated that he will not be part of what has been dubbed "LIV 2.0."
paras.zh: 但在周三的破产听证会上，拉姆的律师表示，他不会参与所谓的“LIV 2.0”。

paras.en: CLICK HERE FOR MORE SPORTS COVERAGE ON FOXNEWS.COM
paras.zh: 单击此处查看 FOXNEWS.COM 上的更多体育报道

paras.en: Rahm "has independently reviewed the proposed terms of LIV 2.0 ... and has determined that those terms are unacceptable to him, and he will be not be participating going forward," according to Front Office Sports.
paras.zh: 据 Front Office Sports 报道，拉姆“已经独立审查了 LIV 2.0 的拟议条款……并确定这些条款对他来说是不可接受的，他将不会继续参加”。

paras.en: The PIF halted funding in April to redirect money toward domestic projects and manage financial pressures from the regional war with Iran. Following the decision, PIF governor Yasir Al-Rumayyan resigned from LIV’s board.
paras.zh: PIF于四月份停止了资助，将资金重新用于国内项目并应对与伊朗的地区战争带来的财务压力。做出该决定后，PIF 理事 Yasir Al-Rumayyan 辞去 LIV 董事会职务。

paras.en: LIV filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in New Jersey last month. Between 2021 and 2026, LIV spent an estimated $5 billion to $8 billion. Bankruptcy filings show the league owes millions of dollars in unpaid compensation to top players, including Rahm, Bryson DeChambeau, Dustin Johnson and Cam Smith.
paras.zh: LIV 上个月在新泽西州根据美国破产法第 11 章申请破产。 2021 年至 2026 年间，LIV 的支出估计为 50 亿至 80 亿美元。破产文件显示，联盟欠顶级球员数百万美元的未付赔偿，其中包括拉姆、布赖森·德尚博、达斯汀·约翰逊和卡姆·史密斯。

paras.en: Rahm is reportedly owed more than $7 million and was "more than willing to fulfill" the details of his original contract.
paras.zh: 据报道，拉姆被欠了超过 700 万美元，并且“非常愿意履行”他最初合同的细节。

paras.en: PIF provided $50 million to help LIV pay its bills and continue operating during the bankruptcy case. The league’s future depends on a proposed restructuring plan called "LIV 2.0."
paras.zh: PIF 提供了 5000 万美元帮助 LIV 支付账单并在破产案期间继续运营。联盟的未来取决于一项名为“LIV 2.0”的拟议重组计划。

paras.en: Under the proposal, London-based private equity firm BC Partners, which has financial ties to player agency GSE Worldwide, would fund a 2027 relaunch. The plan would also give the players majority ownership of the league.
paras.zh: 根据该提案，总部位于伦敦的私募股权公司 BC Partners（与玩家代理机构 GSE Worldwide 有财务关系）将为 2027 年的重新启动提供资金。该计划还将赋予球员联盟的多数所有权。

paras.en: LIV has laid off most of its operational staff, left event contractors waiting for payment and faces a lawsuit from the Premier Golf League alleging breach of confidence and conspiracy.
paras.zh: LIV 已解雇了大部分运营人员，活动承包商等待付款，并面临英超高尔夫联盟的诉讼，指控其违反保密协议和共谋。

paras.en: Brooks Koepka was the first big name to leave LIV Golf, doing so late last year and returning to the PGA Tour. Patrick Reed followed in his footsteps shortly after.
paras.zh: 布鲁克斯·科普卡 (Brooks Koepka) 是第一个离开 LIV Golf 的大牌球员，他于去年年底离开并重返 PGA 巡回赛。不久之后帕特里克·里德也追随了他的脚步。

paras.en: Shortly after the PIF pulled its funding, LIV CEO Scott O'Neil said the LIV calendar would not be altered, but that did not occur. The league's originally-scheduled championship weekend was cancelled, forcing it to be played a week earlier.
paras.zh: PIF 撤回资金后不久，LIV 首席执行官斯科特·奥尼尔 (Scott O'Neil) 表示 LIV 日历不会改变，但这并没有发生。联盟原定的冠军周末被取消，迫使比赛提前一周举行。

paras.en: Rahm is a two-time major winner, winning the 2021 U.S. Open and the 2023 Masters. He and Tyrell Hatton were the lone LIV Golfers on Team Europe during last year's Ryder Cup.
paras.zh: 拉姆是两届大满贯冠军，赢得了 2021 年美国公开赛和 2023 年大师赛冠军。去年莱德杯期间，他和泰瑞尔·哈顿 (Tyrell Hatton) 是欧洲队中唯一的 LIV 高尔夫球手。

paras.en: OutKick's Alejandro Avila contributed to this report.
paras.zh: OutKick 的 Alejandro Avila 对本报告做出了贡献。

articles.title: Parents of slain IDF soldier Omer Neutra mark three years since Oct 7 massacre in mourning

paras.en: For 421 days, Ronen and Orna Neutra fought to bring their 21-year-old son Omer home from Hamas captivity, believing he was still alive. Three years after the Oct. 7 massacre, they are marking the anniversary by mourning the loss of their son.
paras.zh: Ronen 和 Orna Neutra 用了 421 天的时间，奋力将 21 岁的儿子奥马尔从哈马斯的囚禁中带回家，他们相信他还活着。 10 月 7 日大屠杀发生三年后，他们通过哀悼失去儿子的方式来纪念周年纪念日。

paras.en: "It doesn't get easier," Orna Neutra told "Fox & Friends" Wednesday. "For us, this is three years since Omer was killed, but it's really the first year where we can properly go to his gravesite and mourn him and have a memorial."
paras.zh: “这并没有变得更容易，”奥娜·诺伊特拉周三告诉《福克斯与朋友》。 “对我们来说，奥马尔被杀已经三年了，但这确实是我们第一次能够正确地去他的墓地哀悼他并举行纪念活动。”

paras.en: Omer Neutra, a Long Island native and grandson of Holocaust survivors, moved to Israel after high school and enlisted in the Israel Defense Forces (IDF). Hamas terrorists attacked his tank near the Gaza border on Oct. 7, 2023, killing him and taking his remains into Gaza.
paras.zh: 奥马尔·诺伊特拉 (Omer Neutra) 是长岛本地人，也是大屠杀幸存者的孙子，高中毕业后移居以色列，并加入了以色列国防军 (IDF)。 2023 年 10 月 7 日，哈马斯恐怖分子在加沙边境附近袭击了他的坦克，杀死了他并将他的遗体带入加沙。

paras.en: For 421 days, Neutra's parents didn't know he had died and continued their fight to bring him home alive.
paras.zh: 在 421 天的时间里，Neutra 的父母并不知道他已经死了，并继续努力把他活着带回家。

paras.en: The couple pleaded for Omer's release for over a year, believing he was among the Hamas hostages who could still be brought home.
paras.zh: 这对夫妇恳求释放奥马尔一年多，相信他是仍然可以被带回家的哈马斯人质之一。

paras.en: "For 14 months, we were fighting to bring him back alive," Orna recounted. "We thought he was a live hostage."
paras.zh: “14 个月来，我们一直在努力把他活着救回来，”奥纳回忆道。 “我们以为他是活人质。”

paras.en: The Neutras wouldn't learn their son had been killed on Oct. 7 until 421 days after the attack. Even then, their wait to bring him home was far from over.
paras.zh: 直到袭击发生 421 天后，中性人才得知他们的儿子于 10 月 7 日被杀。即便如此，他们对带他回家的等待还远未结束。

paras.en: "After that, it took over a year," Orna said. "We actually just buried him on November 7th, 2025, and that's less than a year, so it's been such a crazy ordeal... it's very difficult."
paras.zh: “从那以后，花了一年多的时间，”奥纳说。 “我们实际上是在 2025 年 11 月 7 日才埋葬了他，这还不到一年，所以这是一次疯狂的磨难……非常困难。”

paras.en: Israel is marking three years since the deadliest single-day massacre of Jews since the Holocaust. As the anniversary arrives, Omer's parents say remembering their son also means remembering what he believed he was defending.
paras.zh: 以色列正在纪念自大屠杀以来最严重的单日犹太人屠杀事件发生三周年。随着周年纪念日的到来，奥马尔的父母说记住他们的儿子也意味着记住他认为自己正在捍卫的东西。

paras.en: "It's all about moral clarity," Ronen Neutra said. "Our son is a grandson of Holocaust survivors. He understood that Israel is the only state where Jewish people are fully protected and protecting themselves."
paras.zh: “这一切都与道德清晰度有关，”罗南·诺伊特拉（Ronen Neutra）说。 “我们的儿子是大屠杀幸存者的孙子。他明白以色列是唯一一个犹太人得到充分保护和自我保护的国家。”

articles.title: Your phone says it's updated. Check other settings, too

paras.en: Most of us have done it. A software update pops up when we're busy, so we swipe it away and figure we'll deal with it later. Then later turns into tomorrow, and suddenly that update has been sitting there much longer than we planned. There's another wrinkle. Even when your phone appears to be running the latest software, there may be another security update or protection worth checking.
paras.zh: 我们大多数人都做到了。当我们忙碌时会弹出软件更新，因此我们将其滑开并认为稍后再处理。然后后来变成了明天，突然之间，更新的停留时间比我们计划的要长得多。还有另一个皱纹。即使您的手机似乎运行的是最新软件，也可能存在其他值得检查的安全更新或保护。

paras.en: Apple, Google and Samsung all have ways to get security fixes onto your phone between larger software releases. However, they handle those protections differently. If you use an iPhone running iOS 27, a Google Pixel running Android 17 or a Samsung Galaxy running the latest software available for your model, there are a few places I would check right now.
paras.zh: 苹果、谷歌和三星都有办法在较大的软件版本之间对你的手机进行安全修复。然而，他们以不同的方式处理这些保护。如果您使用运行 iOS 27 的 iPhone、运行 Android 17 的 Google Pixel 或运行适用于您的型号的最新软件的三星 Galaxy，我现在会检查几个地方。

paras.en: Kurt "CyberGuy" Knutsson shares practical ways to stay safer, smarter and more confident with technology. Explore classes on stopping spam, phone security, financial protection and using AI to get better healthcare. Each class is free, easy to follow and comes with a free printable checklist.
paras.zh: Kurt“Cyber​​Guy”Knutsson 分享了利用技术保持更安全、更智能和更自信的实用方法。探索有关阻止垃圾邮件、电话安全、财务保护和使用人工智能获得更好医疗保健的课程。每门课程都是免费的，易于学习，并附有免费的可打印清单。

paras.en: See the classes and register at CyberGuyLive.com
paras.zh: 请访问 Cyber​​GuyLive.com 查看课程并注册

paras.en: Your iPhone can get security fixes between full updates
paras.zh: 您的 iPhone 可以在完整更新之间获得安全修复

paras.en: Apple has a feature called Background Security Improvements that can deliver certain security protections without waiting for another complete iOS update. Apple says these lightweight releases can protect Safari, WebKit and other system libraries. That gives Apple another way to address certain vulnerabilities between larger software releases. iOS 27 is Apple's latest public iPhone software, so make sure your compatible iPhone is running it before checking the security setting below.
paras.zh: Apple 有一项名为“后台安全改进”的功能，可以提供某些安全保护，而无需等待另一次完整的 iOS 更新。苹果表示，这些轻量级版本可以保护 Safari、WebKit 和其他系统库。这为苹果提供了另一种方法来解决较大软件版本之间的某些漏洞。 iOS 27 是 Apple 最新的公共 iPhone 软件，因此在检查下面的安全设置之前，请确保您的兼容 iPhone 正在运行它。

paras.en: How to check that your iPhone is running the latest iOS software
paras.zh: 如何检查您的 iPhone 是否运行最新的 iOS 软件

paras.en: If your iPhone says iOS 27 and no newer update appears, you're current at the time you check.
paras.zh: 如果您的 iPhone 显示为 iOS 27 并且没有出现更新的更新，则您在检查时处于最新状态。

paras.en: How to turn on Background Security Improvements on iPhone
paras.zh: 如何在 iPhone 上打开后台安全改进

paras.en: Your iPhone can then automatically install eligible Background Security Improvements as Apple releases them. These smaller protections do not replace regular iOS updates. You should still install full updates because they can contain additional security patches, bug fixes and broader changes throughout the operating system.
paras.zh: 然后，您的 iPhone 可以在 Apple 发布时自动安装符合条件的后台安全改进。这些较小的保护措施不会取代常规的 iOS 更新。您仍然应该安装完整更新，因为它们可能包含额外的安全补丁、错误修复和整个操作系统的更广泛的更改。

paras.en: Samsung Galaxy phones have their own update process
paras.zh: 三星 Galaxy 手机有自己的更新流程

paras.en: Samsung Galaxy phones run Android, but Samsung adds its One UI software on top. Because of that, Galaxy owners often see different menus than Pixel owners. As of today, One UI 9 is Samsung's latest interface. Samsung began its U.S. rollout on Sept. 16 with the Galaxy S26 Ultra, S26+ and S26 after One UI 9 debuted on its newest foldable phones. However, you should not assume that every Galaxy phone eligible for One UI 9 has received it yet. Samsung rolls updates out by device, carrier and region. Whether your Galaxy has One UI 9 already or is still waiting for it, you can check directly from Settings.
paras.zh: 三星 Galaxy 手机运行 Android，但三星在其之上添加了 One UI 软件。因此，Galaxy 用户经常会看到与 Pixel 用户不同的菜单。截至今天，One UI 9 是三星最新的界面。 One UI 9 在其最新的可折叠手机上首次亮相后，三星于 9 月 16 日开始在美国推出 Galaxy S26 Ultra、S26+ 和 S26。但是，您不应假设每部符合 One UI 9 资格的 Galaxy 手机都已收到。三星按设备、运营商和地区推出更新。您的 Galaxy 是否已经安装或仍在等待 One UI 9，您可以直接从“设置”中进行检查。

paras.en: How to check for the latest Samsung Galaxy software
paras.zh: 如何检查最新的 Samsung Galaxy 软件

paras.en: Depending on your Galaxy model or carrier, Samsung says you may instead see Download and install, System updates or Check for software updates. If an update appears, follow the on-screen instructions to install it. You can also check which version your phone is running by going to:
paras.zh: 三星表示，根据您的 Galaxy 型号或运营商，您可能会看到“下载并安装”、“系统更新”或“检查软件更新”。如果出现更新，请按照屏幕上的说明进行安装。您还可以通过以下方式检查您的手机运行的版本：

paras.en: That screen shows details about the software currently installed on your Galaxy.
paras.zh: 该屏幕显示有关当前安装在 Galaxy 上的软件的详细信息。

paras.en: How to check the Google Play system update on Samsung Galaxy
paras.zh: 如何检查 Samsung Galaxy 上的 Google Play 系统更新

paras.en: Galaxy phones also use Google's underlying system services, so there is one more update worth checking.
paras.zh: Galaxy手机还使用谷歌的底层系统服务，因此还有一项更新值得检查。

paras.en: - Follow the prompts if an update is available
paras.zh: - 如果有可用更新，请按照提示操作

paras.en: If you have a Samsung Galaxy, you may be running the latest Samsung software available for your phone and still have a separate Google Play system update waiting to install.
paras.zh: 如果您拥有 Samsung Galaxy，您的手机可能正在运行最新的 Samsung 软件，并且仍有单独的 Google Play 系统更新等待安装。

paras.en: Google Pixel uses a different security update system
paras.zh: Google Pixel 使用不同的安全更新系统

paras.en: Pixel owners will not find Apple's Background Security Improvements setting. Google handles the job differently. As of today, supported Pixel phones are running Android 17. Google began rolling out its September 2026 Pixel software update on Sept. 15, while the October 2026 Android Security Bulletin was published Oct. 5. Pixel phones receive regular Android software updates that can include security fixes. They also receive Google Play system updates, which let Google update certain parts of Android separately from a complete operating system release. That means Pixel owners should check two areas rather than assuming one update screen tells the whole story.
paras.zh: Pixel 用户不会找到 Apple 的后台安全改进设置。谷歌以不同的方式处理这项工作。截至今天，受支持的 Pixel 手机正在运行 Android 17。Google 于 9 月 15 日开始推出 2026 年 9 月 Pixel 软件更新，而 2026 年 10 月 Android 安全公告于 10 月 5 日发布。Pixel 手机会定期接收 Android 软件更新，其中可能包含安全修复程序。他们还接收 Google Play 系统更新，这使得 Google 可以独立于完整的操作系统版本来更新 Android 的某些部分。这意味着 Pixel 用户应该检查两个区域，而不是假设一个更新屏幕就能说明全部情况。

paras.en: How to check for the latest update on Google Pixel
paras.zh: 如何检查 Google Pixel 的最新更新

paras.en: - Follow the on-screen instructions if an update is available
paras.zh: - 如果有可用更新，请按照屏幕上的说明进行操作

paras.en: Google says supported Pixel devices running Android 17 are receiving the September 2026 software update in phases. Your exact availability can depend on the device and carrier. Pixel phones can also install downloaded Android updates in the background. However, you may need to restart the phone before the update becomes active.
paras.zh: 谷歌表示，受支持的运行 Android 17 的 Pixel 设备将分阶段接收 2026 年 9 月的软件更新。您的确切可用性可能取决于设备和运营商。 Pixel 手机还可以在后台安装下载的 Android 更新。但是，您可能需要重新启动手机才能使更新生效。

paras.en: How to check the Google Play system update on Pixel
paras.zh: 如何检查 Pixel 上的 Google Play 系统更新

paras.en: If an update is available, follow the prompts to install it. The Google Play system update can be easy to overlook because the name sounds like an update for the Play Store. It actually helps Google update underlying parts of Android and its system services.
paras.zh: 如果有可用更新，请按照提示进行安装。 Google Play 系统更新很容易被忽视，因为名字听起来像是 Play 商店的更新。它实际上帮助谷歌更新了Android的底层部分及其系统服务。

paras.en: Don't assume automatic updates mean you're fully current
paras.zh: 不要以为自动更新就意味着您完全是最新的

paras.en: I'm a fan of automatic updates because they remove one more thing you have to remember. Still, I wouldn't turn them on and completely forget about them. An update might need your phone to restart before the protection becomes active. Your device may also be waiting for Wi-Fi, sufficient battery power or the next stage of a phased rollout. That's why I like checking the update screens every so often. If you see an update waiting, finish it. A downloaded security fix cannot fully protect you if your phone still needs a restart before activating it.
paras.zh: 我是自动更新的粉丝，因为它们删除了您必须记住的另一件事。不过，我不会打开它们并完全忘记它们。更新可能需要您的手机重新启动才能保护生效。您的设备也可能正在等待 Wi-Fi、充足的电池电量或分阶段推出的下一阶段。这就是为什么我喜欢经常检查更新屏幕。如果您看到正在等待更新，请完成它。如果您的手机在激活之前仍需要重新启动，则下载的安全修复程序无法完全保护您。

paras.en: Older phones may eventually stop getting security fixes
paras.zh: 较旧的手机最终可能会停止获得安全修复

paras.en: Your phone can keep working long after the manufacturer stops supporting it. That's where things can get tricky. If a phone no longer receives security updates, newly discovered vulnerabilities may remain unpatched. That can leave an otherwise usable device exposed to security problems that newer phones have already fixed. Apple supports iPhones with software and security updates for years, but older models eventually stop receiving the newest iOS releases. If you're wondering whether your current iPhone has reached that point, check out our guide on whether it's time to upgrade to a new iPhone at CyberGuy.com.
paras.zh: 在制造商停止支持后，您的手机仍可以继续工作很长时间。这就是事情变得棘手的地方。如果手机不再接收安全更新，新发现的漏洞可能仍未修补。这可能会让其他可用的设备面临新手机已经修复的安全问题。 Apple 多年来一直为 iPhone 提供软件和安全更新，但较旧的型号最终会停止接收最新的 iOS 版本。如果您想知道您当前的 iPhone 是否已达到这一点，请在 Cyber​​Guy.com 上查看我们的指南，了解是否该升级到新 iPhone。

paras.en: Google currently provides seven years of operating system and security updates for Pixel 8 and newer phones, measured from when each device first became available in the U.S. Samsung also provides extended software support for many newer Galaxy devices, although the support period depends on the model. If your iPhone, Pixel or Samsung Galaxy no longer receives security updates, that should become part of the decision about when it's time to replace it. If you're thinking about upgrading your Pixel or Samsung Galaxy, take a look at our Top Android phones of 2026 for our current picks at cyberguy.com .
paras.zh: 目前，谷歌为 Pixel 8 及更新的手机提供七年的操作系统和安全更新，从每款设备首次在美国上市时算起。三星还为许多更新的 Galaxy 设备提供扩展软件支持，尽管支持期限取决于型号。如果您的 iPhone、Pixel 或 Samsung Galaxy 不再收到安全更新，这应该成为何时更换的决定的一部分。如果您正在考虑升级 Pixel 或 Samsung Galaxy，请在 cyberguy.com 上查看我们当前精选的 2026 年热门 Android 手机。

paras.en: Keep your phone protected beyond software updates
paras.zh: 除了软件更新之外，还可以保护您的手机

paras.en: Updates close known security holes, but criminals have plenty of other ways to go after your phone. Phishing texts can trick you into handing over passwords. Fake websites can imitate Apple, Google or a financial institution. Malicious apps can also create problems if you install software from an untrusted source.
paras.zh: 更新可以弥补已知的安全漏洞，但犯罪分子还有很多其他方法可以追踪您的手机。网络钓鱼文本可能会诱骗您交出密码。虚假网站可能会模仿苹果、谷歌或金融机构。如果您从不受信任的来源安装软件，恶意应用程序也可能会产生问题。

paras.en: That's why I would combine current software with a strong device passcode, biometric protection and the theft-protection features available on your phone. I would also use a password manager to create and store strong, unique passwords for your accounts. Strong antivirus software can add another layer by helping detect malicious links, risky downloads and other threats before they cause trouble. Get my picks for the best 2026 antivirus protection winners for your Windows, Mac, Android and iOS devices at CyberGuy.com.
paras.zh: 这就是为什么我会将当前的软件与手机上提供的强大的设备密码、生物识别保护和防盗功能结合起来。我还会使用密码管理器为您的帐户创建和存储强而独特的密码。强大的防病毒软件可以帮助检测恶意链接、有风险的下载和其他威胁，防止它们造成麻烦，从而增加另一层保护。在 Cyber​​Guy.com 上获取我为您的 Windows、Mac、Android 和 iOS 设备挑选的 2026 年最佳防病毒保护获奖者。

paras.en: I like security protections that can do some of the work for me. I'm not going to spend every morning checking whether Apple patched WebKit or whether Google released another system update, and I don't expect you to either. Still, seeing "up to date" on one screen does not always mean you've checked every security layer your phone uses. On my iPhone, I'd look at Background Security Improvements and Software Update. If you're carrying a Pixel, check both the Android update and Google Play system update. Galaxy owners should check Samsung's software update and Google's system update too. Then finish the job when your phone asks for a restart. That extra minute could be what finally activates the protection you thought was already there.
