articles.title: German court orders detention of former intelligence chief after spying arrest
articles.author: Kate Connolly in Berlin

paras.en: A formal arrest warrant has been issued against Germany’s former top spy, with a judge ordering him to be held in pre-trial detention, a day after he was arrested on suspicion of treason and spying on behalf of an overseas intelligence agency.
paras.zh: 德国前高级间谍因涉嫌叛国罪和代表海外情报机构从事间谍活动而被捕一天后，法官下令对他进行审前拘留。

paras.en: August Hanning, 80, is accused of buying secret documents from a former colleague and using them to advise a foreign intelligence service, according to the office of the federal prosecutor.
paras.zh: 据联邦检察官办公室称，80 岁的奥古斯特·汉宁 (August Hanning) 被指控从一名前同事那里购买秘密文件，并利用这些文件为外国情报机构提供建议。

paras.en: Hanning’s arrest on Tuesday, along with that of his former office head, referred to as Manfred D. It has sent shock waves through Germany’s political and intelligence community, with analysts calling it potentially the country’s biggest espionage scandal since the end of the cold war.
paras.zh: 汉宁及其前任办公室主任曼弗雷德·D (Manfred D) 于周二被捕。这件事在德国政治和情报界引起了震动，分析人士称这可能是该国自冷战结束以来最大的间谍丑闻。

paras.en: It has raised questions in Berlin over how Germany’s foreign intelligence service can uphold its reputation internationally, particularly at a time of heightened security concerns. Also under scrutiny is the sustainability of rules governing the conduct of retired senior officials and their ability to earn extra income based on their insider knowledge and professional networks.
paras.zh: 这在柏林引发了人们对德国外国情报部门如何维护其国际声誉的质疑，特别是在安全担忧加剧之际。同样受到审查的还有管理退休高级官员行为的规则的可持续性以及他们基于内部知识和专业网络赚取额外收入的能力。

paras.en: Hanning was head of Germany’s foreign intelligence service (BND) between 1998 and 2005.
paras.zh: 汉宁于 1998 年至 2005 年间担任德国对外情报局 (BND) 负责人。

paras.en: A lawyer for Hanning denied he had been involved in any wrongdoing on Wednesday, telling the conservative daily newspaper Die Welt: “While it is true that he was in possession of confidential documents, the allegation that he passed on information contained therein to the detriment of Germany, let alone for payment, is incorrect.”
paras.zh: 汉宁的一名律师周三否认他参与了任何不当行为，并向保守派日报《世界报》表示：“虽然他确实拥有机密文件，但有关他传递其中包含的信息损害德国的指控是不正确的，更不用说为了付款了。”

paras.en: Manfred D, who was also placed under formal arrest on Wednesday by the judge in Karlsruhe, has yet to respond to questions via his lawyer.
paras.zh: 周三，曼弗雷德·D (Manfred D) 也被卡尔斯鲁厄法官正式逮捕，但他尚未通过律师回答问题。

paras.en: Hanning is alleged to have agreed in 2010 to pay for information from Manfred D, who allegedly then smuggled it out of the BND. Manfred D, 64, had worked under Hanning and went on to serve subsequent BND bosses after Hanning, before retiring in March this year.
paras.zh: 据称，汉宁于 2010 年同意向曼弗雷德·D 支付信息费用，据称曼弗雷德·D 随后将这些信息偷带出德国联邦情报局。 64 岁的曼弗雷德·D (Manfred D) 曾在汉宁手下工作，并在汉宁之后继续为德国联邦情报局 (BND) 老板服务，并于今年 3 月退休。

paras.en: Hanning is believed to have received about 2,000 documents from Manfred D until June 2022, some of which were classified, according to prosecutors. He is alleged to have used the information in his papers for his private consulting work.
paras.zh: 据检察官称，截至 2022 年 6 月，汉宁据信从 Manfred D 收到了约 2000 份文件，其中一些文件属于机密。据称，他将论文中的信息用于私人咨询工作。

paras.en: Prosecutors were alerted to Hanning’s alleged criminal activities by investigators gathering evidence in a separate child kidnapping case involving a steakhouse restaurant dynasty, which the former spy chief is accused of participating in using his former contacts with Israeli intelligence. Christina Block, an heiress to the business, allegedly paid Hanning and a retired police officer more than €100,000 (£85,000) for their roles in the alleged abduction of her two children from her ex-husband.
paras.zh: 调查人员在涉及一家牛排餐厅王朝的另一起儿童绑架案中收集证据，从而向检察官发出了有关汉宁涉嫌犯罪活动的警报，这位前间谍头子被指控利用他以前与以色列情报部门的联系参与了这起案件。该公司的女继承人克里斯蒂娜·布洛克(Christina Block)据称向汉宁和一名退休警官支付了超过10万欧元(85,000英镑)的费用，因为他们涉嫌绑架了她前夫的两个孩子。

paras.en: A report in Der Spiegel on Wednesday said investigators were looking into a possible connection to the foreign intelligence service of Azerbaijan as one of the agencies Hanning may have been passing information to.
paras.zh: 《明镜周刊》周三的一篇报道称，调查人员正在调查与阿塞拜疆外国情报机构之间可能存在的联系，因为汉宁可能一直向其传递信息。

paras.en: Azerbaijan’s media and broadcasting council denied any connection to Hanning or the investigation. “The malicious intent of the forces behind this disinformation operation is to damage Azerbaijan-Germany relations,” the council said in a statement.
paras.zh: 阿塞拜疆媒体和广播委员会否认与汉宁或调查有任何联系。该委员会在一份声明中表示：“这一虚假信息行动背后势力的恶意意图是损害阿塞拜疆与德国的关系。”

paras.en: The scandal has awakened memories of the Günter Guillaume affair, when an East German Stasi spy and his wife posing as refugees infiltrated the government of the then chancellor Willy Brandt, leading to Brandt’s resignation in 1974.
paras.zh: 这起丑闻唤醒了人们对君特·纪尧姆事件的记忆，当时一名东德斯塔西间谍和他的妻子冒充难民潜入时任总理威利·勃兰特的政府，导致勃兰特于 1974 年辞职。

paras.en: Marc Henrichmann, the head of the parliamentary committee overseeing the intelligence services, which has repeatedly raised questions about the post-career consulting activities of intelligence agency employees but has been told legal obstacles stood in the way of challenging them, said he was “fairly flabbergasted” by the affair, but stressed it was as yet unclear the breadth and extent of the alleged wrongdoing.
paras.zh: 监督情报部门的议会委员会主席马克·亨里奇曼(Marc Henrichmann)多次对情报机构雇员的离职后咨询活动提出质疑，但被告知挑战这些活动存在法律障碍。他表示，他对这起事件“相当震惊”，但强调目前尚不清楚所指控的不当行为的广度和程度。

paras.en: “As yet we don’t know exactly what happened,” he told the public broadcaster Deutschlandfunk, while acknowledging the need to “restore broken trust” in the BND.
paras.zh: “到目前为止，我们还不知道究竟发生了什么，”他告诉公共广播公司 Deutschlandfunk，同时承认需要“恢复对德国联邦情报局破碎的信任”。

paras.en: On Wednesday, politicians and intelligence analysts called for stricter regulation around allowing former security employees to make use of their influence and knowledge after retiring.
paras.zh: 周三，政界人士和情报分析师呼吁加强监管，允许前安全员工在退休后利用他们的影响力和知识。

paras.en: The scandal comes at a time when Germany is attempting to make its intelligence agencies, including the BND and its domestic sibling, the BfV, more robust, efficient and independent from those of its allies, in particular boosting their powers of surveillance to more effectively tackle sabotage and hacking attacks, amid rising threats from external powers such as Russia and Iran.
paras.zh: 此次丑闻发生之际，德国正试图使其情报机构（包括德国联邦情报局及其国内兄弟机构德国联邦情报局）变得更加强大、高效并独立于其盟友，特别是在俄罗斯和伊朗等外部势力日益威胁的情况下，增强其监视能力，以更有效地应对破坏和黑客攻击。

paras.en: The scandal is yet another blow to the BND’s reputation. Not only is it notoriously dependent on information from foreign agencies to foil terror attacks on German soil, but it has faced other cases of its staff allegedly spying for other countries.
paras.zh: 这起丑闻是对德国联邦情报局声誉的又一次打击。众所周知，该公司不仅依赖外国机构的信息来挫败德国领土上的恐怖袭击，而且还面临着其工作人员涉嫌为其他国家从事间谍活动的其他案件。

paras.en: It has also been reeling from the case of a department head, Carsten L, who was accused in December 2022 of spying for Russia. His trial is now being heard by Berlin’s higher regional court.
paras.zh: 它还因部门主管 Carsten L 的案件而感到不安，他于 2022 年 12 月被指控为俄罗斯从事间谍活动。柏林高等地区法院目前正在审理对他的审判。

paras.en: Sensitivities over the country’s past, when dictatorships misused their powers of surveillance to spy on their own people, have made reform of the agencies hard to pursue.
paras.zh: 由于独裁政权滥用监视权力来监视本国人民，该国过去的敏感性使得这些机构的改革难以进行。

paras.en: Hanning, the son of a brickyard owner, rose through the ranks of the intelligence service to become its head. After the attacks of 11 September 2001, he oversaw the investigation into some of the terrorists who had studied in Hamburg. He initiated wide-reaching reforms of the BND including bringing it closer to politics, becoming a close adviser to the then interior minister Wolfgang Schäuble. He spoke out against a “culture of leaks” and was deeply critical of the NSA whistleblower Edward Snowden, calling him an “internal offender”.
paras.zh: 汉宁是一个砖厂老板的儿子，他在情报部门晋升为情报部门的负责人。 2001 年 9 月 11 日袭击事件发生后，他监督了对一些曾在汉堡学习的恐怖分子的调查。他对德国联邦情报局发起了广泛的改革，包括使其更加贴近政治，成为时任内政部长沃尔夫冈·朔伊布勒的亲密顾问。他公开反对“泄密文化”，并对美国国家安全局举报人爱德华·斯诺登进行了严厉批评，称他为“内部罪犯”。

paras.en: Once his civil service career was over, Hanning continued to hold a role as a respected behind-the-scenes negotiator, and frequently intervened in government security policy debates. At the same time he built up his consultant business, founding an agency with his wife, Ruth, called Hanning Consult, and worked for various other global consulting agencies. He even produced a “spy cookbook” with his wife, called “Top(f) Secret” (Topf being the German word for saucepan).
paras.zh: 公务员生涯结束后，汉宁继续担任受人尊敬的幕后谈判代表，并经常介入政府安全政策的辩论。与此同时，他建立了自己的咨询业务，与妻子露丝 (Ruth) 创立了一家名为 Hanning Consult 的机构，并在其他多家全球咨询机构工作。他甚至与妻子一起制作了一本“间谍食谱”，名为“Top(f) Secret”（Topf 是德语中的平底锅）。

articles.title: French police suspend use of stun grenades at school protests as minister rejects accusations of brutality
articles.author: Jon Henley in Paris

paras.en: France’s interior minister has suspended the use of stun grenades by police at high school demonstrations but rejected mounting accusations of police brutality during a fortnight of protests marred by often violent clashes that have injured hundreds.
paras.zh: 法国内政部长已暂停警察在高中示威活动中使用眩晕手榴弹，但否认了有关警察在两周的抗议活动中施行暴行的越来越多的指控，抗议活动经常发生暴力冲突，造成数百人受伤。

paras.en: Laurent Nuñez told RTL radio on Wednesday that he had ordered a temporary halt to the use of the grenades “in the context of the high school students’ movement” after a 15-year-old lost a hand during a protest in Lens, northern France, on Monday.
paras.zh: 洛朗·努涅斯 (Laurent Nuñez) 周三对 RTL 电台表示，周一一名 15 岁的年轻人在法国北部朗斯 (Lens) 的一次抗议活动中失去了一只手，之后他已下令“在高中生运动的背景下”暂时停止使用手榴弹。

paras.en: Authorities have not confirmed the exact circumstances – in particular, whether the boy had picked up the grenade or been struck by it – but said up to 200 protesters had been hurling projectiles at police when the riot squad intervened.
paras.zh: 当局尚未证实具体情况，特别是男孩是捡到手榴弹还是被手榴弹击中，但表示，当防暴队介入时，有多达 200 名抗议者向警察投掷弹丸。

paras.en: Nuñez said he was suspending use of the grenades “until we know exactly what happened in this case”. But he later told MPs that accusations of “police repression” were “excessive” because officers “are not intervening if the protests are peaceful”.
paras.zh: 努涅斯表示，他将暂停使用手榴弹，“直到我们确切知道这起案件发生了什么”。但他后来告诉国会议员，对“警察镇压”的指控“过度”，因为警察“如果抗议活动是和平的，就不会干预”。

paras.en: The injured boy’s mother said on Wednesday that her son’s hand had been amputated. She told BFMTV: “His life has been stolen. He’s a 15-year-old kid, how can children be treated like that?” She said her son had not tried to pick up the grenade.
paras.zh: 受伤男孩的母亲周三表示，她儿子的手已被截肢。她告诉BFMTV：“他的生命被偷走了。他只是一个15岁的孩子，怎么能这样对待孩子呢？”她说她的儿子没有试图捡起手榴弹。

paras.en: The education ministry said classes had been wholly or partially suspended in 429 of the country’s 3,700 lycées – high schools attended by pupils aged between 15 and 18 – on Wednesday, a significantly lower number than on Tuesday.
paras.zh: 教育部表示，全国 3,700 所高中（15 至 18 岁学生就读的高中）中，周三已有 429 所全部或部分停课，数量明显低于周二。

paras.en: However, 80 university campuses, including the prestigious Sciences Po in Paris, were blockaded in largely peaceful protests by students on Wednesday, unions said, and teachers’ and other unions said they backed further strike action on Thursday.
paras.zh: 然而，工会表示，周三，包括著名的巴黎政治学院在内的 80 所大学校园在基本上和平的抗议活动中被封锁，教师工会和其他工会表示，他们支持周四的进一步罢工行动。

paras.en: Nuñez told parliament that 215 teenagers and 89 school staff had been injured since the start of the protests, which are over chronic teacher shortages, crowded classes, dilapidated buildings and long school days, while 761 police officers had also been wounded.
paras.zh: 努涅斯告诉议会，自抗议活动开始以来，已有 215 名青少年和 89 名学校工作人员受伤，原因是长期师资短缺、班级拥挤、建筑破旧和上课时间长，同时还有 761 名警察受伤。

paras.en: He said 18 internal police investigations had been launched over allegations of brutality during the demonstrations, including one incident in which a young protester lost multiple teeth and another in which a student lost the use of an eye.
paras.zh: 他说，警方已针对示威期间的暴行指控启动了 18 项内部调查，其中包括一名年轻抗议者失去多颗牙齿的事件和一名学生失去一只眼睛的事件。

paras.en: He said inquiries were always opened over accusations of “non-proportional” policing, but he insisted officers were there to protect the students. Rights groups and trades unions have repeatedly accused the police of using unnecessary force.
paras.zh: 他说，调查总是针对“不成比例”的警务指控展开，但他坚称警察在那里是为了保护学生。人权组织和工会一再指责警方使用不必要的武力。

paras.en: On Tuesday at least 250,000 pupils, parents, teachers and unionists took to the streets in cities across France on the biggest day yet of the campaign, prompting the president, Emmanuel Macron, to hold an emergency cabinet meeting.
paras.zh: 周二，至少 25 万名学生、家长、教师和工会成员走上法国各地城市的街头，这是这场运动迄今为止规模最大的一天，促使总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙 (Emmanuel Macron) 召开紧急内阁会议。

paras.en: Most marches passed off without serious incident but some, including in Paris, ended in sporadic vandalism and running skirmishes with riot police, with officers firing teargas and carrying out baton charges to disperse protesters.
paras.zh: 大多数游行都没有发生严重事件，但包括巴黎在内的一些游行却以零星的破坏行为和与防暴警察发生小规模冲突而告终，警察发射催泪瓦斯并使用警棍冲锋驱散抗议者。

paras.en: The prime minister, Sébastien Lecornu, is due to make a speech on Wednesday on the demonstrations as well as the dire state of the country’s finances, which is severely constraining the government’s capacity to act on the protesters’ demands.
paras.zh: 总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努将于周三就示威活动以及该国严峻的财政状况发表讲话，该国财政状况严重限制了政府对抗议者的要求采取行动的能力。

paras.en: Lecornu on Tuesday condemned the violence and told parliament it could not be tolerated, while also rejecting accusations that the government had ordered “police repression” against the protesters.
paras.zh: 勒科尔努周二谴责暴力事件，并告诉议会这是不能容忍的，同时也否认政府下令“警察镇压”抗议者的指控。

paras.en: Over the past fortnight, demonstrators have set dustbins on fire outside their schools, destroyed bus shelters and hurled projectiles at riot police, who have responded using batons, teargas and riot-control rounds.
paras.zh: 在过去的两周里，示威者在学校外放火焚烧垃圾箱，摧毁公交车候车亭，并向防暴警察投掷弹丸，而防暴警察则使用警棍、催泪瓦斯和防暴弹进行回应。

paras.en: Twenty-four schools have been burned or ransacked, while more than 6,600 people have been arrested, almost all of them minors. More than 1,800 are being prosecuted, nearly 1,500 of them under 18, the justice ministry has said.
paras.zh: 24 所学校被烧毁或洗劫，超过 6,600 人被捕，其中几乎全是未成年人。司法部表示，超过 1,800 人正在受到起诉，其中近 1,500 人未满 18 岁。

paras.en: Anne Savinel-Barras, the president of Amnesty France, on Wednesday welcomed the decision to suspend police use of stun grenades as “an important first step” but said the devices should be “permanently banned from the policing of all protests.”
paras.zh: 国际特赦组织法国主席安妮·萨维内尔-巴拉斯周三对警察暂停使用眩晕手榴弹的决定表示欢迎，认为这是“重要的第一步”，但表示应“永久禁止在所有抗议活动中使用这些装置”。

paras.en: She added: “Protests should not be battlefields. Stun grenades are designed to shock, disorient, and sow panic, often among dense crowds. Some can cause permanent hearing loss as well as life-changing mutilations due to the blast and shrapnel.
paras.zh: 她补充说：“抗议不应该成为战场。眩晕手榴弹的目的是震惊、迷惑和散布恐慌，通常是在密集的人群中。有些手榴弹可能会导致永久性听力损失，以及由于爆炸和弹片而导致改变生活的残害。

paras.en: The protests, months before key presidential elections to choose Macron’s successor, have rattled a government trying to reduce a ballooning budget deficit amid mounting investor concern over France’s sky-high debt and weak economic growth.
paras.zh: 距离选择马克龙继任者的关键总统选举还有几个月的抗议活动，让试图减少不断膨胀的预算赤字的政府感到不安，因为投资者对法国高额债务和疲软的经济增长的担忧日益加剧。

paras.en: They have also sparked a heated political row, with the government accusing the radical-left La France Insoumise party of encouraging and even orchestrating the movement after numerous LFI MPs attended school blockades.
paras.zh: 它们还引发了一场激烈的政治争端，政府指责激进左翼的“法国不苏米斯”党在众多 LFI 议员参加学校封锁后鼓励甚至策划了这场运动。

paras.en: The party’s veteran leader and presidential candidate, Jean-Luc Mélenchon, has strongly supported the protests while urging non-violence.
paras.zh: 该党资深领导人兼总统候选人让-吕克·梅朗雄强烈支持抗议活动，同时敦促非暴力。

articles.title: Minister denies police brutality as student protests continue across France – Europe live, as it happened
articles.author: Nadeem Badshah (now),  Jakub Krupa Tom Ambrose (earlier)

paras.en: French interior minister rejects allegation of heavy-handed police response to student protests
paras.zh: 法国内政部长否认警方对学生抗议采取严厉措施的指控

paras.en: French interior minister Laurent Nuñez rejected allegations of police brutality in their response to on-going French student protests, saying officers only intervene when there is damage or violence.
paras.zh: 法国内政部长洛朗·努涅斯否认了有关警察在应对法国学生抗议活动时施行暴行的指控，称警察只会在发生破坏或暴力事件时进行干预。

paras.en: Addressing French lawmakers, he said the protest movement was “unprecedented” because of “very serious violence,” franceinfo reported.
paras.zh: 据法国资讯网报道，他在向法国立法者发表讲话时表示，由于“暴力行为非常严重”，此次抗议运动是“史无前例的”。

paras.en: French interior minister Laurent Nuñez rejected allegations of police brutality in their response to on-going student protests, saying officers only intervene when there is damage or violence. Addressing French lawmakers, he said the protest movement was “unprecedented” because of “very serious violence,” Nuñez said a total of 6,629 people have been arrested since the protests began. Meanwhile, 761 police officers and gendarmes have been injured, alongside 215 students and 89 members of teaching staff.
paras.zh: 法国内政部长洛朗·努涅斯否认了有关警察在应对正在进行的学生抗议活动中施行暴行的指控，称警察只会在发生破坏或暴力事件时进行干预。努涅斯在向法国立法者发表讲话时表示，由于“非常严重的暴力行为”，此次抗议运动是“史无前例的”。努涅斯表示，自抗议活动开始以来，共有 6,629 人被捕。与此同时，761 名警察和宪兵、215 名学生和 89 名教职人员受伤。

paras.en: France PM Sébastien Lecornu listed five key areas the government will address: replacing absent teachers, improving school facilities, organising the school day, and revising Parcoursup, France’s web portal and pre-enrolment platform, to make it more user-friendly. He added the government’s initial decisions “will be presented at the end of October.” On the protests, he said: “The police have not been instructed to confront high school students.”
paras.zh: 法国总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努列出了政府将解决的五个关键领域：替换缺席教师、改善学校设施、组织上课日以及修改法国门户网站和预注册平台Parcoursup，使其更加用户友好。他补充说，政府的初步决定“将于十月底提出”。关于抗议活动，他说：“警方没有接到与高中生对峙的指示。”

paras.en: A new Elabe poll for BFMTV shows that 55% of French people support the high school protests. While 35% oppose the movement, 10% say they have no clear view.
paras.zh: BFMTV 的一项新的 Elabe 民意调查显示，55% 的法国人支持高中抗议活动。虽然 35% 的人反对这项运动，但 10% 的人表示他们没有明确的看法。

paras.en: US secretary of state Marco Rubio called for the nations of the West to return to their civilizational roots and restore the values that drove the rise of Europe and North America to global dominance for centuries in a speech in Athens.
paras.zh: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥在雅典发表讲话，呼吁西方国家回归文明根源，恢复几个世纪以来推动欧洲和北美崛起并占据全球主导地位的价值观。

paras.en: Volodymyr Zelenskyy has accused Russia’s military of deliberately killing civilians and bombing residential buildings as a macabre gift for Vladimir Putin, who celebrates his 74th birthday on Wednesday. Ukraine’s president described Russia’s overnight drone and missiles strikes, which killed at least 24 people, as “despicable”. “The Russians wanted to strike painfully and demonstratively,” he said.
paras.zh: 弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基指责俄罗斯军方故意杀害平民并轰炸住宅楼，作为送给周三庆祝自己 74 岁生日的弗拉基米尔·普京的恐怖礼物。乌克兰总统称俄罗斯夜间无人机和导弹袭击造成至少 24 人死亡，这是“卑鄙的”。 “俄罗斯人想要进行痛苦而示威性的打击，”他说。

paras.en: A knife attack at a vocational school in Ostrołęka, Poland left at least seven people injured, including two seriously, as reported by Poland’s RMF FM radio.
paras.zh: 据波兰 RMF FM 电台报道，波兰奥斯特罗文卡一所职业学校发生持刀袭击事件，造成至少 7 人受伤，其中两人伤势严重。

paras.en: On the government pledging to review the demands made by students and present proposals at the end of October on issues ranging from renovating buildings to make more teachers available, Lecornu said: “In the past, too many promises were not kept, quite simply because they were untenable.
paras.zh: 关于政府承诺审查学生提出的要求，并在 10 月底就翻修建筑物、提供更多教师等问题提出建议，莱科努表示：“过去，有太多的承诺没有兑现，原因很简单，因为它们是站不住脚的。

paras.en: “What I want are concrete, quick and fully funded answers.”
paras.zh: “我想要的是具体、快速且资金充足的答案。”

paras.en: Lecornu also confirmed that France will release 10 million barrels of diesel from its strategic stocks to try to ease tight supplies amid surging energy prices stemming from the wars in Iran and in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 勒科尔努还证实，法国将从其战略库存中释放1000万桶柴油，以缓解因伊朗和乌克兰战争导致能源价格飙升而导致的供应紧张。

paras.en: He said: “Last Friday, President (Emmanuel) Macron convened an emergency meeting of the G7, which decided to mobilize strategic reserves in a coordinated manner. As part of this effort, we will make 10 million barrels of diesel from our reserves available to distributors in France.”
paras.zh: 他表示：“上周五，马克龙总统召开了七国集团紧急会议，决定以协调一致的方式调动战略储备。作为这项努力的一部分，我们将从储备中向法国经销商提供 1000 万桶柴油。”

paras.en: Lecornu said the move “will automatically lower prices at the pump by an estimated amount ranging from 0.12 to 0.18 euros per liter of diesel.”
paras.zh: Lecornu表示，此举“将自动降低加油站价格，预计每升柴油降低0.12至0.18欧元”。

paras.en: Government to present school proposals by end of this month, says Lecornu
paras.zh: 勒科尔努表示，政府将在本月底之前提出学校提案

paras.en: Lecornu listed five key areas the government will address: replacing absent teachers, improving school facilities, organising the school day, and revising Parcoursup, France’s web portal and pre-enrolment platform, to make it more user-friendly.
paras.zh: 勒科尔努列出了政府将解决的五个关键领域：替换缺席教师、改善学校设施、组织上课日以及修改法国门户网站和预注册平台Parcoursup，使其更加用户友好。

paras.en: He added the government’s initial decisions “will be presented at the end of October.”
paras.zh: 他补充说，政府的初步决定“将于十月底提出”。

paras.en: Lecornu added the dialogue sessions that began in high schools on Wednesday are to continue “starting tomorrow, in each high school, and until next week.”
paras.zh: 莱科努补充说，周三在高中开始的对话会议将“从明天开始，在每所高中继续进行，直到下周”。

paras.en: 'Police not instructed to confront students,' says Lecornu
paras.zh: 莱科努说：“警方没有接到与学生对峙的指示”

paras.en: France PM Sébastien Lecornu has begun his address by discussing the high school student protests, Liberation reported. He said: “The police have not been instructed to confront high school students.”
paras.zh: 据《解放报》报道，法国总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努在讲话开始时讨论了高中学生的抗议活动。他说：“警方没有接到与高中生对峙的指示。”

paras.en: A formal arrest warrant has been issued against Germany’s former top spy, with a judge ordering him to be held in pre-trial detention a day after he was arrested on suspicion of treason and spying on behalf of an overseas intelligence agency.
paras.zh: 德国前最高间谍已发出正式逮捕令，法官下令对他进行审前拘留，一天后他因涉嫌叛国罪和代表海外情报机构从事间谍活动而被捕。

paras.en: August Hanning, 80, is accused of buying secret documents from a former colleague and using them to advise a foreign intelligence service, according to the country’s office of the federal prosecutor.
paras.zh: 据该国联邦检察官办公室称，80 岁的奥古斯特·汉宁 (August Hanning) 被指控从一名前同事那里购买秘密文件，并利用这些文件为外国情报机构提供建议。

paras.en: Wednesday’s formal arrest warrant followed Hanning’s arrest on Tuesday, along with that of his former office head, Manfred D. It has sent shock waves through Germany’s political and intelligence community, with analysts calling it potentially the country’s biggest espionage scandal since the end of the cold war.
paras.zh: 继周二汉宁及其前办公室主任曼弗雷德·D（Manfred D）被捕后，周三发布了正式逮捕令。这在德国政治和情报界引起了震动，分析人士称这可能是该国自冷战结束以来最大的间谍丑闻。

paras.en: A lawyer for Hanning denied he had been involved in any wrongdoing on Wednesday, telling the conservative daily newspaper Die Welt: “While it is true that he was in possession of confidential documents, the allegation that he passed on information contained therein to the detriment of Germany, let alone for payment, is incorrect.”
paras.zh: 汉宁的一名律师周三否认他参与了任何不当行为，并向保守派日报《世界报》表示：“虽然他确实拥有机密文件，但有关他传递其中包含的信息损害德国的指控是不正确的，更不用说为了付款了。”

paras.en: West should 'learn from the men of Ancient Greece', says Rubio in Athens speech
paras.zh: 卢比奥在雅典演讲中表示，西方应该“向古希腊人学习”

paras.en: US secretary of state Marco Rubio called for the nations of the West to return to their civilizational roots and restore the values that drove the rise of Europe and North America to global dominance for centuries in a speech in Athens.
paras.zh: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥在雅典发表讲话，呼吁西方国家回归文明根源，恢复几个世纪以来推动欧洲和北美崛起并占据全球主导地位的价值观。

paras.en: Rubio said: “It has become fashionable today to believe that enlightened foreign policy means prioritizing the ‘global community’ over one’s own people. And I think here, too, we have much more to learn from the men of Ancient Greece. They knew that there was nothing selfish or wrong about loyalty to your nation, nor anything selfish or wrong about fighting to defend its interests above all else.”
paras.zh: 卢比奥说：“如今，一种流行的观点认为，开明的外交政策意味着将‘全球社会’置于本国人民之上。我认为，在这方面，我们还需要向古希腊人学习更多东西。他们知道，忠于国家并没有什么自私或错误的地方，为捍卫国家利益而奋斗也没有什么自私或错误的地方。”

paras.en: Rubio also urged Europe to uphold its traditional values.
paras.zh: 卢比奥还敦促欧洲维护其传统价值观。

paras.en: “Today, we find ourselves at a crossroads.
paras.zh: “今天，我们发现自己处于十字路口。

paras.en: “The next decade will write the story of the next century. The course we take will determine whether the West maintains its place at the head of the world, or resigns itself to a future of atrophy, and servitude, and decline. We will either choose to act now or lose the choice to act at all.”
paras.zh: “下一个十年将书写下一个世纪的故事。我们采取的路线将决定西方是否继续保持其世界领先地位，还是屈服于萎缩、奴役和衰落的未来。我们要么选择现在采取行动，要么根本失去采取行动的选择。”

paras.en: France summoned Iran’s ambassador over what foreign ministry spokesperson Pascal Confavreux described as an Iranian disinformation campaign targeting France’s secondary school student protest movement.
paras.zh: 法国召见了伊朗大使，外交部发言人帕斯卡·康夫鲁克斯 (Pascal Confavreux) 称，这是伊朗针对法国中学生抗议运动的虚假信息活动。

paras.en: The envoy was told of the “absolutely unacceptable” nature of false content disseminated online by official Iranian foreign ministry accounts, Confavreux said in a statement, adding that Tehran’s October 6 summons of the French ambassador was baseless.
paras.zh: Confavreux 在一份声明中表示，特使被告知伊朗外交部官方账户在网上传播的虚假内容“绝对不可接受”，并补充说德黑兰 10 月 6 日对法国大使的传唤毫无根据。

paras.en: “These undignified provocations must cease,” he said.
paras.zh: “这些有损尊严的挑衅行为必须停止，”他说。

paras.en: Iran on Tuesday summoned France’s envoy in Tehran over the ongoing student protests, accusing Paris of the “violent treatment” of demonstrators and of extensive human rights violations, according to Iranian state media.
paras.zh: 据伊朗官方媒体报道，伊朗周二就正在进行的学生抗议活动召见了法国驻德黑兰特使，指责巴黎“暴力对待”示威者并广泛侵犯人权。

paras.en: Back to the protests in France and the administrative court has suspended the ban on gatherings around 45 schools in Haute-Garonne, Occitanie, seeing it as an attack on the freedom to demonstrate, BFMTV reported.
paras.zh: 据 BFMTV 报道，回到法国的抗议活动，行政法院暂停了对奥克西塔尼上加龙省 45 所学校周围集会的禁令，认为这是对示威自由的攻击。

paras.en: The ban “is neither appropriate nor proportionate and whose necessity is not established, constitutes a serious and manifestly illegal infringement of the freedom of demonstration and the freedom of assembly,” the administrative court of Toulouse said in its decision.
paras.zh: 图卢兹行政法院在其裁决中表示，该禁令“既不适当也不相称，其必要性也未得到证实，构成对示威自由和集会自由的严重且明显的非法侵犯”。

paras.en: Russian missiles and drones struck Ukrainian cities including Kyiv, Pryluky and Kremenchuk overnight on Tuesday. Two people were killed in Kyiv, while a strike destroyed an apartment block in Pryluky, in Ukraine’s northern Chernihiv region, killing at least nine people including three children.
paras.zh: 周二夜间，俄罗斯导弹和无人机袭击了基辅、普雷卢基和克列缅丘克等乌克兰城市。基辅有两人死亡，乌克兰北部切尔尼戈夫地区普雷卢基的一栋公寓楼遭到袭击，造成至少九人死亡，其中包括三名儿童。

paras.en: Following the attack on a teacher in La Ciotat who was doused with gasoline during student protests, three 16-year-olds will appear before the Marseille juvenile court in February 2027, newspaper Liberation reported.
paras.zh: 据《解放报》报道，拉西约塔的一名教师在学生抗议期间被泼汽油，事件发生后，三名 16 岁青少年将于 2027 年 2 月在马赛少年法庭出庭。

paras.en: More from the Greek capital where visiting US Secretary of state, Marco Rubio, has been dominating the news.
paras.zh: 来自希腊首都的更多消息一直占据新闻头条，来访的美国国务卿马可·卢比奥 (Marco Rubio) 一直占据着新闻头条。

paras.en: In a day packed with talk of energy and defense, gas ‘corridors’ and trade, counterterrorism and US military bases - all earning Greece the encomium of being the region’s “pillar of stability” according to Rubio – it is the foreign policy chief, himself, who has made the news.
paras.zh: 在这一天，人们谈论的话题包括能源和国防、天然气“走廊”和贸易、反恐和美国军事基地——据卢比奥称，所有这些都为希腊赢得了该地区“稳定支柱”的赞誉——而成为新闻焦点的是这位外交政策负责人本人。

paras.en: Rubio’s decision to use the trip to deliver a major address “on democracy and its future” from the ancient Pnyx has imbued the visit with an air of excitement.
paras.zh: 卢比奥决定利用这次访问在古老的普尼克斯发表“关于民主及其未来”的重要讲话，这让这次访问充满了兴奋的气氛。

paras.en: Until last night it was far from sure that the US secretary of state would have access to the setting because of security reasons.
paras.zh: 直到昨晚，出于安全原因，还很难确定美国国务卿是否可以进入该场所。

paras.en: Only hours before more than 1,500 protestors, appalled by the war in Iran, had marched through the streets of central Athens waving banners declaring him persona non grata.
paras.zh: 就在几个小时前，1,500 多名对伊朗战争感到震惊的抗议者在雅典市中心的街道上游行，挥舞着标语，宣称他是不受欢迎的人。

paras.en: Excerpts of Rubio’s address released by the State department suggest he will focus on the shared values that have united Americans and Europeans in what has also been described as a rallying cry for “a great renewal of the Western spirit.”
paras.zh: 美国国务院公布的卢比奥讲话摘录表明，他将重点关注将美国人和欧洲人团结在一起的共同价值观，这也被称为“西方精神伟大复兴”的战斗口号。

paras.en: But there are also fears the US secretary of state may use the setting to make a speech in the spirit of the blistering attack on Europe issued by Vice President JD Vance at the Munich Security conference last year. The speech is scheduled to take place in the next half hour.
paras.zh: 但也有人担心，美国国务卿可能会利用这一场合发表讲话，其精神与副总统万斯去年在慕尼黑安全会议上对欧洲的猛烈攻击。演讲预计在接下来的半小时内进行。

paras.en: Poll shows majority of French people supports high school protests, demands, but uncertain about their future
paras.zh: 民意调查显示大多数法国人支持高中抗议和要求，但对自己的未来不确定

paras.en: A new Elabe poll for BFMTV shows that 55% of French people support the high school protests.
paras.zh: BFMTV 的一项新的 Elabe 民意调查显示，55% 的法国人支持高中抗议活动。

paras.en: While 35% oppose the movement, 10% say they have no clear view.
paras.zh: 虽然 35% 的人反对这项运动，但 10% 的人表示他们没有明确的看法。

paras.en: Support for the students’ demands is even higher, with 72% considering them legitimate – a view shared by majorities across the political spectrum, from left to right.
paras.zh: 对学生要求的支持甚至更高，72% 的人认为这些要求是合法的——从左到右的各个政治派别中的大多数人都同意这一观点。

paras.en: However, the public is far more divided over what should happen next: 55% believe students have made their point and should end the protests, while 27% think they should carry on.
paras.zh: 然而，公众对于接下来应该发生什么的分歧更大：55% 的人认为学生已经表达了自己的观点，应该结束抗议活动，而 27% 的人认为他们应该继续下去。

paras.en: 'Impunity must end,' Le Pen says, as she offers her support to police over student protests
paras.zh: 勒庞表示，“有罪不罚现象必须结束”，她在学生抗议活动中向警方表示支持

paras.en: French far-right National Rally leader Marine Le Pen offered her strong support for the police, saying “impunity must end,” and “those who vandalise our schools, and their parents when they are minors, must pay for the damage they cause.”
paras.zh: 法国极右翼全国集会领袖马琳·勒庞对警方表示强烈支持，她表示“必须结束有罪不罚现象”，“那些破坏我们学校及其未成年父母的人必须为他们造成的损失付出代价。”

paras.en: “The French people should no longer have to finance the vandals,” she told reporters on a visit to Cournon-d’Auvergne.
paras.zh: “法国人民不应该再为破坏者提供资金，”她在访问奥弗涅库尔农时告诉记者。

paras.en: She also said the police should have the support of the nation, and “not face constant accusations from those in power,” as she chose to use the protests to criticise the French president, Emmanuel Macron.
paras.zh: 她还表示，警察应该得到全国的支持，“不要面临当权者的不断指控”，因为她选择利用抗议活动来批评法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙(Emmanuel Macron)。

paras.en: “While the far left spreads false accusations to stoke violence, Emmanuel Macron once again chooses to undermine those who protect the French people,” she said.
paras.zh: 她说：“虽然极左派散布虚假指控以煽动暴力，但马克龙却再次选择破坏那些保护法国人民的人。”

paras.en: Le Pen leads the presidential polls ahead of next year’s election, with 33-34% of vote share in the first round, well ahead of Édouard Philippe and Jean-Luc Mélenchon at around 16-18%.
paras.zh: 勒庞在明年大选前的总统民意调查中领先，在第一轮选举中获得 33-34% 的选票，远远领先于爱德华·菲利普 (Édouard Philippe) 和让-吕克·梅朗雄 (Jean-Luc Mélenchon) 的 16-18% 左右。

articles.title: France halts use of stun grenades after boy's hand blown off in student protests

paras.en: France has suspended the use of stun grenades for policing student protests that have swept the country, after a 15-year-old's hand was blown off earlier this week.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，一名 15 岁青少年的手被炸掉，法国已暂停使用眩晕手榴弹来维持席卷全国的学生抗议活动。

paras.en: Interior Minister Laurent NuÃ±ez said he had requested the pause until the facts of Monday's incident in Lens had been "clarified", with conflicting accounts offered by protesters and officials.
paras.zh: 内政部长洛朗·努涅斯表示，他已要求暂停，直到周一朗斯事件的事实得到“澄清”，抗议者和官员的说法相互矛盾。

paras.en: The disruption continued on Wednesday with more than 500 schools fully or partially shut.
paras.zh: 周三，混乱仍在继续，500 多所学校全部或部分关闭。

paras.en: Prime Minister SÃ©bastien Lecornu has defended the police response, after several groups complained of police using disproportionate force towards teenagers.
paras.zh: 在几个团体抱怨警察对青少年使用过度武力后，总理塞巴斯蒂安·勒科尔努为警方的反应进行了辩护。

paras.en: In an address to the nation on Wednesday evening, he denied security forces had "orders to confront" the young people.
paras.zh: 在周三晚上向全国发表的讲话中，他否认安全部队接到“命令对抗”年轻人。

paras.en: He said the government would look into the demands made by students and promised they would present a set of proposals at the end of October, ranging from renovating buildings to make more teachers available. He gave no further details.
paras.zh: 他表示，政府将调查学生的要求，并承诺将在 10 月底提出一系列建议，包括翻修建筑物和提供更多教师等。他没有透露更多细节。

paras.en: The "anger of young people does not come from nowhere," he said.
paras.zh: 他说，“年轻人的愤怒并非凭空而来”。

paras.en: Education Minister Ãdouard Geffray said 24 schools had been "set alight or vandalised" to such an extent that they would be shut for several weeks, affecting 30,000 pupils.
paras.zh: 教育部长杜阿尔·格弗雷 (Ádouard Geffray) 表示，24 所学校被“纵火或破坏”，以致学校将关闭数周，影响 3 万名学生。

paras.en: Hundreds of thousands of people took to the streets on Tuesday to call for better school conditions and in some cities tear gas and water cannon were deployed. The interior ministry said 488 people were arrested and 43 members of the security forces were hurt.
paras.zh: 周二，数十万人走上街头，呼吁改善学校条件，一些城市还动用了催泪瓦斯和水枪。内政部称，488 人被捕，43 名安全部队成员受伤。

paras.en: NuÃ±ez told French radio RTL that police watchdog IGPN had opened 18 investigations to determine whether officers had been "proportionate" during the demonstrations, which have spread from high school pupils to their parents, university students and unions.
paras.zh: 努涅斯告诉法国 RTL 广播电台，警方监管机构 IGPN 已展开 18 项调查，以确定警察在示威活动中是否“相称”，示威活动已从高中生蔓延至家长、大学生和工会。

paras.en: "There is a police action that raises questions for all of us within the Ministry of the Interior; it's what happened in Lens," he said as he confirmed the suspension of stun grenades - weapons which are considered non-lethal and send out small rubber pellets when they detonate.
paras.zh: 他在确认暂停使用眩晕手榴弹时说道：“警方的一项行动向我们内政部内部的所有人提出了疑问；这就是在朗斯发生的事情。”眩晕手榴弹被认为是非致命性武器，引爆时会发出小橡胶颗粒。

paras.en: The 15-year-old boy's hand was torn off after a so-called anti-encirclement grenade was fired in unclear circumstances near the Auguste BÃ©hal high school in the northern city near Lille.
paras.zh: 在里尔附近北部城市的奥古斯特·贝哈尔高中附近，一枚所谓的反围剿手榴弹在不明情况下被发射，这名 15 岁男孩的手被撕裂。

paras.en: Authorities have said he picked up the grenade which then exploded, but students have alleged he was hit directly after an officer fired. According to the local prefect, police had been confronted by more than 200 students throwing stones and fireworks.
paras.zh: 当局表示，他捡起了手榴弹，随后爆炸，但学生们声称，他是在一名警官开枪后直接被击中的。据当地省长称，200 多名学生向警察投掷石块和烟花。

paras.en: The national secretary of policing union UNSA said he was sceptical about the move, saying it had been based "on emotion".
paras.zh: 警察工会UNSA全国秘书表示，他对此举持怀疑态度，称此举是基于“情感”。

paras.en: "We are dealing with increasingly violent people," Jean-Paul Nascimento told FranceInfo, cautioning that without the weapon to disperse crowds there may be more clashes at close quarters. "That's where there will perhaps be even more injuries," he warned.
paras.zh: 让-保罗·纳西门托告诉法国新闻社：“我们正在应对日益暴力的人群。”他警告说，如果没有驱散人群的武器，可能会发生更多近距离冲突。他警告说：“那里可能会出现更多受伤的情况。”

paras.en: Concerns have also been stoked by the case of a 14-year-old hit in the face with a tear gas grenade last week. The boy's lawyer said he had lost several teeth and suffered a fractured jaw in the incident at Saint-Ouen-l'AumÃ´ne, north-west of Paris, and a police officer has been charged.
paras.zh: 上周一名 14 岁青少年被催泪瓦斯手榴弹击中脸部的事件也引发了人们的担忧。男孩的律师表示，男孩在巴黎西北部圣旺欧姆讷的事件中失去了几颗牙齿，下巴骨折，一名警官已受到指控。

paras.en: And in a separate development on Wednesday, a 16-year-old suffered a serious hand injury outside a school in Strasbourg, reportedly while handling a mortar firework.
paras.zh: 在周三的另一起事件中，一名 16 岁的青少年在斯特拉斯堡一所学校外手部严重受伤，据报道当时他是在处理迫击炮烟花时。

paras.en: Prosecutors also said an investigation for attempted murder had been opened after a 17-year-old student protester complained an officer "held his head underwater" while trying to arrest him near a river in the north-eastern city of Belfort. French reports say the boy has himself been charged with aggravated assault for allegedly attacking the officer.
paras.zh: 检察官还表示，在一名 17 岁的学生抗议者抱怨一名警官在东北部城市贝尔福的一条河附近试图逮捕他时“将他的头放在水下”后，已对谋杀未遂展开调查。法国报道称，这名男孩本人因涉嫌袭击警官而被指控犯有严重攻击罪。

paras.en: Addressing France's National Assembly on Wednesday, both NuÃ±ez and Education Minister Geffray said the speed at which the protests had turned violent was unprecedented.
paras.zh: 周三，努涅斯和教育部长格弗雷在法国国民议会发表讲话时表示，抗议活动演变为暴力的速度是前所未有的。

paras.en: Geffray said dozens of headteachers and deputies had been injured, many deliberately so, and alleged the movement had been "very quickly infiltrated by ultra-violent groups".
paras.zh: 格弗雷表示，数十名校长和副校长受伤，其中许多人是故意受伤，并声称该运动“很快就被极端暴力团体渗透”。

paras.en: "We have never seen anything like this," he said of the disorder which officials report has harmed more than 200 students and 700 police officers, and prompted more than 6,600 arrests.
paras.zh: “我们从未见过这样的事情，”他在谈到官方报告的这场骚乱时说道，这场骚乱已经伤害了 200 多名学生和 700 名警察，并导致 6,600 多人被捕。

paras.en: NuÃ±ez later said he found it "excessive to speak of police repression of the movement", insisting that officers were only acting in response to violence and damage.
paras.zh: 努涅斯后来说，他发现“谈论警察镇压运动有些过分”，并坚称警察只是针对暴力和破坏采取行动。

paras.en: The national coordinator of the radical-left France Unbowed (LFI) party said that it had taken "several children being maimed for life for NuÃ±ez to give up using grenades against high school students".
paras.zh: 激进左翼法国不屈党（LFI）的国家协调员表示，“努涅斯在数名儿童终生残废后才放弃对高中生使用手榴弹”。

paras.en: The prime minister has accused LFI of trying to "sow chaos" during the protests ahead of elections to select President Emmanuel Macron's successor in April.
paras.zh: 总理指责 LFI 试图在 4 月份选举总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙 (Emmanuel Macron) 继任者的选举前的抗议活动中“制造混乱”。

paras.en: Its leader Jean-Luc MÃ©lenchon is currently second in the opinion polls behind Marine Le Pen of the hard-right National Rally - who on Wednesday said Macron was "always on the side of attacking the police".
paras.zh: 其领导人让-吕克·梅朗雄目前在民意调查中排名第二，落后于极右翼全国集会的马琳·勒庞——她周三表示，马克龙“始终站在攻击警察的一边”。

paras.en: The president held an emergency meeting late on Tuesday with Prime Minister Lecornu and other key ministers to find a way out of the crisis after almost a quarter of all lycÃ©es were disrupted by the day's protests - with government figures putting the number of protesters at more than 250,000.
paras.zh: 周二晚间，总统与莱科尔努总理和其他主要部长举行了紧急会议，以寻找摆脱危机的出路。当天的抗议活动导致几乎四分之一的中学被扰乱，政府数据显示抗议者人数超过 25 万人。

paras.en: Lecornu announced that schools should set aside half the day for students to voice their concerns, and noted on social media that an online consultation seeking their opinions had drawn 30,000 responses within a day.
paras.zh: 莱科努宣布，学校应留出半天时间让学生表达自己的担忧，并在社交媒体上指出，征求学生意见的在线咨询一天之内就收到了 3 万份回复。

paras.en: But students' unions - who put the number of protesters at 450,000 - maintain a fourth round of demonstrations is planned for Thursday in Paris and other cities, and told reporters they had requested a meeting with Lecornu due to a lack of "concrete measures" outlined so far.
paras.zh: 但学生会 - 预计抗议者人数为 45 万人 - 维持第四轮示威活动计划于周四在巴黎和其他城市举行，并告诉记者，由于迄今为止缺乏概述的“具体措施”，他们已要求与勒科努会面。

paras.en: The union representing school leaders told FranceInfo that a solution would require "something more than simple consultation periods", while the head of the USL high school union, Ryad Rani, told French radio on Wednesday: "We are telling M. NuÃ±ez, calm your police officers down and call for restraint."
paras.zh: 代表学校领导的工会告诉FranceInfo，解决方案需要“不仅仅是简单的协商期”，而USL高中工会主席里亚德·拉尼(Ryad Rani)周三对法国电台表示：“我们告诉努涅斯先生，让你的警察冷静下来，并呼吁他们保持克制。”

articles.title: Children killed while they slept as Russian missile kills 19 in block of flats

paras.en: A Russian missile has killed 19 people including five children in an apartment block in northern Ukraine, destroying 30 flats as families slept.
paras.zh: 一枚俄罗斯导弹在乌克兰北部的一座公寓楼炸死了 19 人，其中包括 5 名儿童，并摧毁了正在睡觉的 30 套公寓。

paras.en: Three of the children were one-year-olds in the attack on Pryluky, east of Kyiv, early on Wednesday, and one of the boys died with his mother and grandmother, officials said.
paras.zh: 官员称，周三早些时候基辅东部普雷卢基发生的袭击事件中，其中三名儿童才一岁，其中一名男孩与他的母亲和祖母一起死亡。

paras.en: Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky said it was one of Russia's "most vile strikes", and suggested the Russian military had carried it out as a "birthday gift" to Vladimir Putin, who turned 74 on Wednesday.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基表示，这是俄罗斯“最卑鄙的袭击”之一，并暗示俄罗斯军方将此次袭击作为送给周三74岁生日的弗拉基米尔·普京的“生日礼物”。

paras.en: Moscow made no mention of the attack on Pryluky but said its "massive strike" had targeted military industries in Kyiv and elsewhere.
paras.zh: 莫斯科没有提及对普雷卢基的袭击，但表示其“大规模袭击”针对的是基辅和其他地方的军事工业。

paras.en: Across the country, the death toll on Wednesday climbed to 25, as Russian strikes claimed two lives in the capital, two in Kremenchuk, and two more in Oleksandriya. More than 430 apartments and private homes were damaged and dozens of people were injured in the attack on the central city of Kremenchuk, the regional leader said.
paras.zh: 周三，全国范围内的死亡人数攀升至 25 人，俄罗斯的空袭造成首都两人死亡、克列缅丘克两人死亡、奥列克山德里亚两人死亡。地区领导人表示，在中部城市克列缅丘克的袭击中，超过 430 间公寓和私人住宅遭到破坏，数十人受伤。

paras.en: Rescue teams in Pryluky spent hours searching for victims in the rubble of a five-storey block of flats.
paras.zh: 普里卢基的救援队花了几个小时在一栋五层公寓的废墟中寻找遇难者。

paras.en: Late in the afternoon rescuers said the body of a fifth child had been found at the scene. More than 50 residents were wounded in the attack that also damaged other residential buildings as well as a youth centre.
paras.zh: 下午晚些时候，救援人员表示，现场发现了第五名儿童的尸体。袭击造成 50 多名居民受伤，其他住宅楼和一个青年中心也受损。

paras.en: Chernihiv regional head Vyacheslav Chaus said the town was hit by five cruise missiles, one of which slammed into the apartment building.
paras.zh: 切尔尼戈夫地区负责人维亚切斯拉夫·乔斯表示，该镇遭到五枚巡航导弹袭击，其中一枚击中了公寓楼。

paras.en: Zelensky named the one-year-old victims as Oleksandr, Kyrylo, and Serhii, and said a boy of eight called Maxsym had also been killed.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基将三名一岁的受害者命名为奥列克桑德尔 (Oleksandr)、凯里洛 (Kyrylo) 和谢尔希 (Serhii)，并表示一名名叫马克西姆 (Maxsym) 的八岁男孩也被杀害。

paras.en: Prime Minister Serhii Koretskyi said a boy called Sasha had died with his mother, Kateryna and her mother Viktoriia, and only the boy's elder sister Olha had survived.
paras.zh: 总理谢尔希·科列茨基(Serhii Koretskyi)表示，一个名叫萨沙(Sasha)的男孩与他的母亲卡特琳娜(Kateryna)和母亲维多利亚(Viktoriia)一起死亡，只有男孩的姐姐奥尔哈(Olha)幸存。

paras.en: Local reports said they had lived on the fifth floor and that Viktoriia had been looking after her grandson while her daughter worked in a factory.
paras.zh: 当地报道称，他们住在五楼，维多利亚一直在照顾她的孙子，而她的女儿则在一家工厂工作。

paras.en: "The Russians wanted to strike painfully and demonstratively," Zelensky said, adding that 70 missiles were fired in total.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基说：“俄罗斯人想要进行痛苦且具有示范性的打击。”他补充说，总共发射了 70 枚导弹。

paras.en: Zelensky added that Ukraine had itself struck targets in attacks on Russia's Perm, Samara and Astrakhan regions in the past 24 hours, adding there was "also a response in the Black Sea", without providing further details.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基补充说，乌克兰在过去24小时内对俄罗斯彼尔姆、萨马拉和阿斯特拉罕地区的袭击袭击了目标，并补充说“黑海也做出了回应”，但没有提供更多细节。

paras.en: In Kyiv, many residents spent the night in underground stations to escape the Russian barrage. Mayor Vitaly Klitschko said last week the capital was being torn apart by Russian attacks.
paras.zh: 在基辅，许多居民在地铁站过夜以躲避俄罗斯的炮火。市长维塔利·克里琴科上周表示，首都正因俄罗斯的袭击而四分五裂。

paras.en: Ukraine's national police posted pictures online showing what it says is an unexploded Russian Iskander missile in the middle of a Kyiv district. BBC Verify has confirmed the images are genuine and the apparent missile fragments came down in an area of open land surrounded by high-rise apartment buildings.
paras.zh: 乌克兰国家警察在网上发布的照片​​显示，据称在基辅地区中部有一枚未爆炸的俄罗斯伊斯坎德尔导弹。 BBC verify 已证实这些图像是真实的，明显的导弹碎片落在了高层公寓楼周围的开阔地带。

paras.en: Another verified video shows damage to cars and what appears to be rubble and a fallen tree in an area surrounded by apartment blocks in Kremenchuk.
paras.zh: 另一段经过验证的视频显示，克列缅丘克公寓楼周围的地区出现了汽车受损、瓦砾和倒下的树木等情况。

paras.en: Ukraine's air force said it had succeeded in shooting down five ballistic missiles and 39 cruise missiles and more than 100 drones, including 46 of Russia's jet-powered drones which have caused so much damage in recent weeks.
paras.zh: 乌克兰空军表示，已成功击落 5 枚弹道导弹、39 枚巡航导弹和 100 多架无人机，其中包括 46 架俄罗斯喷气式无人机，这些无人机在最近几周造成了巨大损失。

paras.en: However, that would mean that as many as 26 cruise or ballistic missiles penetrated its defences, and Zelensky renewed a call for allies to provide air defence support packages to Ukraine.
paras.zh: 然而，这将意味着多达 26 枚巡航或弹道导弹突破其防御，泽连斯基再次呼吁盟友向乌克兰提供防空支援包。

paras.en: According to Zelensky, one of the "key targets" of the attack was Ukraine's energy infrastructure, which Moscow earlier said it would intensify strikes on following Ukraine's strikes on Moscow's energy facilities.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，这次袭击的“关键目标”之一是乌克兰的能源基础设施，莫斯科早些时候表示，继乌克兰袭击莫斯科能源设施后，将加大对乌克兰能源基础设施的打击力度。

paras.en: In a separate post on Wednesday, Zelensky said Ukraine had struck four targets in retaliatory attacks in the past 24 hours, including two oil facilities and a training ground as well as a target in the Black Sea.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基在周三的另一篇帖子中表示，乌克兰在过去24小时内对四个目标进行了报复性袭击，其中包括两个石油设施和一个训练场以及黑海的一个目标。

paras.en: On Tuesday evening, footage emerged showing a huge plume of smoke engulfing an oil tanker off the coast of Sochi, along the Black Sea in southern Russia.
paras.zh: 周二晚上，视频显示，俄罗斯南部黑海索契海岸附近的一艘油轮被滚滚浓烟吞没。

paras.en: The Russian transport ministry later said unmanned boats had attacked the Liberian-flagged Aframax Rio oil tanker. Authorities claim the crew was rescued.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯交通运输部后来表示，无人驾驶船只袭击了悬挂利比里亚国旗的阿芙拉型油轮。当局声称船员已获救。

paras.en: Separately, Bulgaria has halted a search for the missing crew of a ship that sank after being hit by a drone on Tuesday, Vice-Admiral Rumen Nikolov from the Maritime Administration Executive Agency said, as reported by Bulgaria's BTA news agency. No details of the crew are known, but Nikolov said it was assumed there were Syrians on board.
paras.zh: 另外，据保加利亚 BTA 通讯社报道，保加利亚海事管理局执行机构副海军上将鲁门·尼科洛夫表示，保加利亚已停止搜寻周二被无人机击中沉没的一艘船的失踪船员。目前还不清楚船员的详细信息，但尼科洛夫表示，据推测船上有叙利亚人。

paras.en: Tracking data shows the ship was anchored at the southern end of the Bosphorus strait until Monday when it entered the Black Sea heading north. Its last reported position on ship-tracking site MarineTraffic was at 23:43 GMT on Monday in what is known as the Bulgarian exclusive economic zone of the Black Sea.
paras.zh: 跟踪数据显示，这艘船一直停泊在博斯普鲁斯海峡南端，直到周一进入黑海向北行驶。船舶追踪网站 MarineTraffic 上最后一次报告的位置是格林尼治标准时间周一 23:43，位于保加利亚黑海专属经济区。

paras.en: Bulgarian specialist news outlet Maritime.bg reported the Alfa Watan was attacked by a drone and sank 70nm (130km) east of Byala.
paras.zh: 保加利亚专业新闻媒体 Maritime.bg 报道称，Alfa Watan 号遭到无人机袭击，并在比亚拉以东 70 海里（130 公里）处沉没。

paras.en: As well as the civilian cargo ship, a second vessel - carrying grain - was also hit within Bulgaria's exclusive economic zone, its Prime Minister Rumen Radev said on Tuesday. The 18 crew members on the second vessel were rescued.
paras.zh: 保加利亚总理鲁门·拉德夫周二表示，除了民用货船外，第二艘运载谷物的船只也在保加利亚专属经济区内遭到袭击。第二艘船上的18名船员获救。

paras.en: Bulgaria has not said who it believes was behind the attacks, and Moscow has not commented on the incident.
paras.zh: 保加利亚没有透露袭击的幕后黑手，莫斯科也没有对这一事件发表评论。

paras.en: Russia has intensified strikes in the Black Sea, particularly the eastern side, as part of its war against Ukraine. In an evening address on Tuesday, Zelensky claimed Russia was responsible for the attacks.
paras.zh: 作为对乌克兰战争的一部分，俄罗斯加强了对黑海特别是东部地区的打击。泽伦斯基在周二晚间的讲话中声称俄罗斯对此次袭击负责。

articles.title: Trump to speak to Putin about plague lab worker's death in Russia

paras.en: US President Donald Trump says he has a call set up with Vladimir Putin about the death of a lab worker at a plague research centre in Siberia.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，他已与弗拉基米尔·普京通电话，讨论西伯利亚瘟疫研究中心一名实验室工作人员的死亡事件。

paras.en: Russian officials say they are investigating the death of the 28-year-old employee and have not confirmed that the suspected disease is pneumonic plague. They insist there is no risk of an epidemic.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯官员称，他们正在调查这名28岁员工的死亡事件，尚未确认疑似疾病为肺鼠疫。他们坚称不存在流行病风险。

paras.en: Trump told reporters on Wednesday evening he did not believe it was a bioweapon, adding "we're going to find out soon enough, but we don't think so,"
paras.zh: 特朗普周三晚上告诉记者，他不相信这是一种生物武器，并补充说“我们很快就会发现，但我们不这么认为”。

paras.en: "If you listen to them, it's under control," he said, referring to Russian authorities.
paras.zh: “如果你听他们的，事情就在控制之中，”他指的是俄罗斯当局。

paras.en: "We hope it is," he added. Reports emerged on Friday of almost 200 people being placed under observation after the death.
paras.zh: “我们希望如此，”他补充道。周五有报道称，死亡后近 200 人正在接受观察。

paras.en: Referring to China's initial response to the Covid pandemic, Trump said: "Well, China didn't say much, and Russia is not saying much either. But they do say they have it very much under control."
paras.zh: 在谈到中国​​对新冠疫情的初步反应时，特朗普表示：“中国没有说太多，俄罗斯也没有说太多。但他们确实说他们已经很好地控制了疫情。”

paras.en: Pneumonic plague is a serious lung infection, often described as the most virulent form of plague.
paras.zh: 肺鼠疫是一种严重的肺部感染，通常被描述为毒性最强的鼠疫形式。

paras.en: Trump said the US was in "deep discussions" with Russia, but the Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said no phone call had been scheduled.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，美国正在与俄罗斯进行“深入讨论”，但克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫表示，尚未安排通话。

paras.en: The head of the World Health Organization (WHO) has called for more transparency from Russia, and requested further information on the lab tests on the individual who died.
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织（WHO）负责人呼吁俄罗斯提高透明度，并要求提供有关死者实验室检测的更多信息。

paras.en: "We don't yet have the full picture of this event," Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said, adding that the WHO was also seeking "verification of media reports of a second employee with pneumonia of undetermined cause."
paras.zh: 谭德塞表示：“我们还没有全面了解这一事件。”他补充说，世卫组织还在寻求“核实媒体报道的第二名员工患有不明原因肺炎的情况”。

paras.en: Ghebreyesus called on Russia to provide "timely, complete and transparent information" in order to clarify "conflicting reports" and help the WHO assess the potential public health risks.
paras.zh: 格布雷耶苏斯呼吁俄罗斯提供“及时、完整和透明的信息”，以澄清“相互矛盾的报告”，并帮助世卫组织评估潜在的公共卫生风险。

paras.en: Speaking to reporters on Wednesday, Putin's spokesman said Russia's reporting of the death to the WHO was in line with standard practice, and accused the media of reporting "false information".
paras.zh: 普京发言人周三对记者表示，俄罗斯向世界卫生组织报告死亡事件符合标准做法，并指责媒体报道“虚假信息”。

paras.en: The US has issued a formal diplomatic message to Russia requesting additional information. Peskov told reporters he was not aware of such a request.
paras.zh: 美国已向俄罗斯发出正式外交信息，要求提供更多信息。佩斯科夫告诉记者，他不知道有这样的要求。

paras.en: The lab worker, named in Russian media as Darya Shipilova, had reportedly fallen ill a couple of days earlier.
paras.zh: 据俄罗斯媒体报道，这名实验室工作人员名叫达里娅·希皮洛娃(Darya Shipilova)，据报道几天前生病了。

paras.en: Unconfirmed reports suggested that she had become ill after either breaking a test tube containing the pathogen at the Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia and the Far East where she worked or following a field trip to a region where plague occurs naturally among wild rodents.
paras.zh: 未经证实的报道称，她是在她工作的西伯利亚和远东抗鼠疫研究所打破含有病原体的试管后生病的，或者是在对野生啮齿类动物自然发生鼠疫的地区进行实地考察后生病的。

paras.en: As the US and the WHO sought more information, the country's health watchdog, Rospotrebnadzor, issued a statement saying "there are no epidemic risks for the population of Irkutsk and the Irkutsk region".
paras.zh: 在美国和世卫组织寻求更多信息之际，该国卫生监督机构俄罗斯联邦国家运输局发表声明称，“伊尔库茨克和伊尔库茨克地区的居民不存在流行病风险”。

paras.en: It said more than 90% of the people who had been in contact with the victim had "completed medical observation" and "no health disorders associated with infectious pathology were detected".
paras.zh: 声明称，90%以上与受害者有过接触的人已经“完成了医学观察”，并且“没有发现与传染性病理学相关的健康问题”。

paras.en: Neighbouring Mongolia's government has ordered "health surveillance" measures on its border with Russia, AFP news agency reported. The country's health ministry said it would "maintain continuous surveillance and monitoring to prevent potential risks".
paras.zh: 据法新社报道，邻国蒙古政府已下令在其与俄罗斯的边境采取“健康监测”措施。该国卫生部表示将“保持持续监测和监测，以防止潜在风险”。

paras.en: This was a precautionary measure, it said, adding "the current risk level is low."
paras.zh: 它表示，这是一项预防措施，并补充说“目前的风险水平较低”。

paras.en: Lithuania's health ministry said it has made preparations to manage any possible case in the country.
paras.zh: 立陶宛卫生部表示，已做好准备应对该国任何可能出现的病例。

paras.en: Laboratory testing is available, patients would be isolated in infectious disease hospitals, contacts would be identified, and the country has the stocks of medicines suitable for treatment, according to Nerija Kaulakien, an adviser at the Ministry of Health's Communications Division, in an interview with ELTA news agency.
paras.zh: 卫生部通讯司顾问内里贾·考拉金 (Nerija Kaulakien) 在接受 ELTA 通讯社采访时表示，已经可以进行实验室检测，患者将被隔离在传染病医院，确定接触者，并且该国拥有适合治疗的药物库存。

paras.en: There was no evidence of "an increased risk of plague" at the moment, she said.
paras.zh: 她说，目前没有证据表明“鼠疫风险增加”。

paras.en: In the immediate wake of the laboratory worker's death, Russia's health watchdog had issued a statement saying the woman had died of "pneumonia of an undetermined etiology" and that testing found "no microorganisms related to her professional activities".
paras.zh: 实验室工作人员死亡后，俄罗斯卫生监督机构立即发表声明称，该妇女死于“病因不明的肺炎”，检测结果“没有发现与她的职业活动相关的微生物”。

paras.en: However, after this announcement, a pro-government federal news outlet deleted five posts mentioning a possible plague case, and authorities in the town of Baikalsk deleted a message advising against travel to Shelekhov because of a possible plague infection.
paras.zh: 然而，在这一消息发布后，一家亲政府的联邦新闻媒体删除了五篇提到可能发生鼠疫病例的帖子，贝加尔斯克镇当局删除了一条建议不要前往谢列霍夫旅行的消息，因为可能感染鼠疫。

paras.en: Ongoing speculation into the lab worker's death has sparked a back and forth between Russia and the US, with questions about a possible spread outside of Russia.
paras.zh: 对这名实验室工作人员死亡的持续猜测引发了俄罗斯和美国之间的争论，人们质疑病毒是否可能传播到俄罗斯境外。

paras.en: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the US had "measures" available to help Russia if the situation turned out to be more serious than claimed.
paras.zh: 美国国务卿卢比奥表示，如果情况比声称的更严重，美国可以采取“措施”帮助俄罗斯。

paras.en: According to the WHO, pneumonic plague has a very short incubation period - sometimes just 24 hours - and can be fatal, if not diagnosed and treated early.
paras.zh: 据世界卫生组织称，肺鼠疫的潜伏期非常短，有时仅为 24 小时，如果不及早诊断和治疗，可能会致命。

paras.en: - contact with bodily fluids or contaminated materials
paras.zh: - 接触体液或受污染的材料

paras.en: - the inhalation of respiratory particles
paras.zh: - 吸入呼吸道颗粒

paras.en: Symptoms include shortness of breath and coughing, often with blood-tainted phlegm.
paras.zh: 症状包括呼吸短促和咳嗽，常伴有带血的痰。

paras.en: The bacterium that causes the plague, Yersinia pestis, found among rodents such as marmots in the area.
paras.zh: 引起鼠疫的细菌是鼠疫耶尔森氏菌，在该地区的土拨鼠等啮齿动物中发现。

paras.en: It killed up to half the population of Europe in the 14th Century when it was known as the Black Death.
paras.zh: 它在 14 世纪杀死了欧洲一半的人口，当时它被称为黑死病。

paras.en: It was in response to an outbreak in the 1920s that the Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia and the Far East, was founded just over 100 years ago.
paras.zh: 100 多年前，为了应对 20 年代的鼠疫疫情，西伯利亚和远东抗鼠疫研究所成立。

articles.title: Mpox is still spreading in the US — here's what to know about vaccines, symptoms and treatment
articles.author: Nicoletta Lanese

paras.en: Mpox is an infectious disease caused by a poxvirus, meaning a virus in the same family as smallpox. The infection was formerly known as monkeypox.
paras.zh: Mpox 是一种由痘病毒引起的传染病，痘病毒是与天花属于同一家族的病毒。这种感染以前被称为猴痘。

paras.en: Historically, mpox was endemic to Africa, and the virus consistently spread in the continent's central, eastern and western regions. In 2022, an unprecedented global outbreak spurred the widespread transmission of mpox in places that had seen only sporadic cases in the past.
paras.zh: 从历史上看，mpox是非洲的地方病，该病毒一直在非洲大陆的中部、东部和西部地区传播。 2022年，一场史无前例的全球疫情导致MPOX在过去仅出现零星病例的地区广泛传播。

paras.en: Today, many countries affected by that outbreak — including Germany, Portugal and the United States — are still contending with local mpox transmission. Here's what to know about the virus, how it spreads and how to prevent infection.
paras.zh: 如今，许多受此次疫情影响的国家——包括德国、葡萄牙和美国——仍在与当地的 MPOX 传播作斗争。以下是有关该病毒、其传播方式以及如何预防感染的信息。

paras.en: Mpox is still spreading at low levels in the United States and may soon be considered endemic to the country. While case counts have fallen dramatically since the peak of the global outbreak in summer 2022, some people are still advised to get vaccinated against the virus.
paras.zh: Mpox 在美国仍处于低水平传播，可能很快就会成为该国的地方病。尽管自 2022 年夏季全球疫情爆发高峰以来，病例数已大幅下降，但仍建议一些人接种该病毒疫苗。

paras.en: The mpox vaccine currently used in the U.S. is called JYNNEOS. One dose is about 35% to 86% effective, while the complete two-dose series is 66% to 90% effective. (The effectiveness varies, in part, because some studies include people with HIV and people without HIV, and inadequately treated HIV can undermine the body's response to vaccines.)
paras.zh: 美国目前使用的mpox疫苗称为JYNNEOS。一剂的有效率约为 35% 至 86%，而完整的两剂系列的有效率为 66% 至 90%。 （效果有所不同，部分原因是一些研究包括艾滋病毒感染者和未感染艾滋病毒的人，而治疗不当的艾滋病毒可能会破坏身体对疫苗的反应。）

paras.en: The JYNNEOS vaccine is not currently recommended for routine use in the general population because, beyond vulnerable groups, the risk is not high enough to warrant a universal vaccination strategy. The current outbreak is primarily affecting men who have sex with men, and those sexual networks are the primary targets for JYNNEOS vaccination.
paras.zh: 目前不建议在普通人群中常规使用 JYNNEOS 疫苗，因为除了弱势群体之外，风险还不够高，不足以保证采取普遍的疫苗接种策略。当前的疫情主要影响男男性行为者，而这些性网络是 JYNNEOS 疫苗接种的主要目标。

paras.en: However, not all men who have sex with men need to be vaccinated, according to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). Instead, vaccination is recommended for a specific subset of the group, including those who, in the last six months, have had more than one sex partner, have had sex at commercial sex venues, or have been diagnosed with other sexually transmitted diseases.
paras.zh: 然而，根据美国疾病控制与预防中心 (CDC) 的说法，并非所有男男性行为者都需要接种疫苗。相反，建议针对该群体的特定子集接种疫苗，包括在过去六个月内有过一个以上性伴侣、在商业性场所发生性行为或已被诊断患有其他性传播疾病的人。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Nonbinary and transgender people with these risk factors are also recommended to get two doses of JYNNEOS, as are any sexual partners of anyone in the above groups.
paras.zh: 还建议具有这些风险因素的非二元性别和跨性别者以及上述群体中任何人的性伴侣服用两剂 JYNNEOS。

paras.en: Vaccines are also recommended after a suspected exposure to mpox, as they can help prevent or reduce the severity of the infection.
paras.zh: 在怀疑接触过mpox后，也建议接种疫苗，因为它们可以帮助预防或减轻感染的严重程度。

paras.en: "For those who are eligible and have not yet completed vaccination, now is a good time to talk with a healthcare provider about getting protected," Dr. Demetre Daskalakis, chief medical officer of Callen-Lorde, an LGBTQ+ community health center in New York City, told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: 纽约市 LGBTQ+ 社区健康中心 Callen-Lorde 的首席医疗官 Demetre Daskalakis 博士在一封电子邮件中告诉《Live Science》：“对于那些符合条件但尚未完成疫苗接种的人来说，现在是与医疗保健提供者讨论获得保护的好时机。”

paras.en: With the exception of laboratory researchers who work with mpox, people who have received two doses of JYNNEOS are fully vaccinated and do not need a booster, he said. And if a person has caught mpox in the past and recovered, they do not need to get a vaccine, he added.
paras.zh: 他说，除了从事 MPOX 工作的实验室研究人员之外，接受两剂 JYNNEOS 的人都已完全接种疫苗，不需要加强接种。他补充说，如果一个人过去感染过麻疹并且康复了，他们就不需要接种疫苗。

paras.en: The poxvirus family also includes smallpox, which has been eradicated worldwide. Mpox and smallpox cause some similar symptoms, but mpox tends to be far milder than smallpox. However, the viruses are closely related enough that vaccines designed to prevent smallpox can also protect against mpox.
paras.zh: 痘病毒家族还包括天花，天花已在世界范围内被消灭。痘痘和天花会引起一些相似的症状，但痘痘往往比天花温和得多。然而，这些病毒密切相关，旨在预防天花的疫苗也可以预防天花。

paras.en: Mpox was initially named monkeypox because the virus behind the disease was discovered in captive monkeys in Denmark. But monkeys are not the main hosts of the virus in the wild; rodents and small mammals mostly found in West and Central Africa likely are. Health officials changed the name to mpox in 2022.
paras.zh: Mpox 最初被命名为猴痘，因为这种疾病背后的病毒是在丹麦圈养的猴子身上发现的。但猴子并不是该病毒在野外的主要宿主。主要发现于西非和中非的啮齿动物和小型哺乳动物很可能是这样。卫生官员于 2022 年将其名称更改为 MPOX。

paras.en: There are two major branches of the mpox family tree, called clade I and clade II. These clades were historically thought to have very different death rates, with clade I being the deadlier of the two. The case-fatality rate (CFR) of clade I has been estimated to range from 1.4% to over 10%, depending on the outbreak, while the CFR for clade II has been estimated at between 0.1% and 3.6%.
paras.zh: MPOX 家族树有两个主要分支，称为进化枝 I 和进化枝 II。历史上人们认为这些进化枝具有非常不同的死亡率，其中进化枝 I 是两者中最致命的。根据疫情的不同，分支 I 的病死率 (CFR) 估计为 1.4% 至 10% 以上，而分支 II 的病死率估计为 0.1% 至 3.6% 之间。

paras.en: However, as both clades have spread beyond Africa, data suggests that the CFR for clade I may be lower than once thought, said Joel Wertheim, a professor of medicine in the Division of Infectious Diseases and Global Public Health at the University of California, San Diego.
paras.zh: 然而，由于这两个分支已传播到非洲以外的地区，数据表明分支 I 的病死率可能比以前想象的要低，加州大学圣地亚哥分校传染病和全球公共卫生部门的医学教授乔尔·沃特海姆 (Joel Wertheim) 说。

paras.en: The features of a given outbreak — such as the surrounding health infrastructure, patients' access to timely medical care, and the population's underlying risk factors for severe disease — likely play a big role in determining the virus's death toll, Wertheim told Live Science. In short, rather than being an immutable feature of the virus itself, the CFR is dependent on the underlying health of and resources available to a given population.
paras.zh: 沃特海姆告诉《生活科学》，特定疫情的特征——例如周围的卫生基础设施、患者及时获得医疗护理的情况以及人群患严重疾病的潜在风险因素——可能在决定病毒死亡人数方面发挥着重要作用。简而言之，病死率并非是病毒本身不可改变的特征，而是取决于特定人群的基本健康状况和可用资源。

paras.en: Mpox can spread from infected animals to humans through the animals' bites or scratches. Additionally, people can get the virus when they come into close contact with animals and/or their bodily fluids during hunting, skinning, trapping, cooking, eating animals or handling carcasses, the World Health Organization (WHO) notes.
paras.zh: Mpox 可以通过动物的咬伤或抓伤从受感染的动物传播给人类。此外，世界卫生组织（WHO）指出，人们在狩猎、剥皮、诱捕、烹饪、食用动物或处理动物尸体时与动物和/或其体液密切接触时也可能感染病毒。

paras.en: The virus also spreads from person to person, primarily through very close contact, including intimate contact during sex. The virus typically enters the body through broken skin, the respiratory tract or mucous membranes (thin tissues found in the eyes, nose, mouth, anus and genitals), spreading via bodily fluids such as spit, mucus or blood. People can also pick up the virus via objects, such as clothing or linen, that are contaminated with the bodily fluids of an infected person.
paras.zh: 该病毒还可以在人与人之间传播，主要通过非常密切的接触，包括性行为期间的亲密接触。该病毒通常通过破损的皮肤、呼吸道或粘膜（眼睛、鼻子、嘴巴、肛门和生殖器中的薄组织）进入人体，通过唾液、粘液或血液等体液传播。人们还可以通过被感染者体液污染的物体（例如衣服或亚麻制品）感染病毒。

paras.en: The virus can spread through small respiratory droplets expelled during speaking or breathing. However, this is thought to be a less-common transmission route than close contact. There is also evidence that asymptomatic spread sometimes occurs, though it's unclear how frequently that happens.
paras.zh: 该病毒可以通过说话或呼吸时排出的小呼吸道飞沫传播。然而，与密切接触相比，这被认为是一种不太常见的传播途径。还有证据表明，有时会发生无症状传播，但尚不清楚这种情况发生的频率。

paras.en: Mpox can spread from mother to baby during pregnancy or birth. This route of infection can result in pregnancy loss, stillbirth, death of the newborn, or complications for the mother.
paras.zh: Mpox 可以在怀孕或分娩期间从母亲传播给婴儿。这种感染途径可能导致流产、死产、新生儿死亡或母亲出现并发症。

paras.en: These images of mpox rashes depict how the lesions can look on different skin tones. (The images were shared by the CDC prior to the infection's name being changed.)
paras.zh: 这些MPOX皮疹的图像描绘了不同肤色下皮损的外观。 （这些图像是在感染名称更改之前由 CDC 共享的。）

paras.en: Symptoms of mpox typically appear within a week of a person being exposed to the virus, but they can sometimes take up to 21 days to develop. Once they emerge, symptoms last about two to four weeks, although the illness can linger longer in people with weakened immune systems.
paras.zh: mpox 的症状通常会在人接触病毒后一周内出现，但有时可能需要长达 21 天的时间才能出现。一旦出现，症状会持续约两到四个星期，但在免疫系统较弱的人中，这种疾病可能会持续更长时间。

paras.en: Common symptoms include rash (see images), fever, sore throat, headache, muscle aches, back pain, swollen lymph nodes and low energy. Often, mpox rashes first appear on the face and then spread to other parts of the body; however, if a person becomes infected during sex, the rash may instead start around their genitals. The rashes begin as flat, discolored patches of skin and then progress into raised bumps, blisters, and large, pus-filled pimples that eventually scab over and fall off.
paras.zh: 常见症状包括皮疹（见图）、发烧、喉咙痛、头痛、肌肉酸痛、背痛、淋巴结肿大和精力不足。通常，痘痘皮疹首先出现在面部，然后扩散到身体的其他部位；然而，如果一个人在性行为中被感染，皮疹可能会从生殖器周围开始。皮疹开始时是扁平、变色的皮肤斑块，然后发展成凸起的肿块、水泡和大的、充满脓液的丘疹，最终结痂并脱落。

paras.en: Some people with mpox develop painful swelling of the rectum (proctitis), while others have pain and difficulty when peeing (dysuria) or when swallowing.
paras.zh: 有些患有MPOX的人会出现直肠疼痛性肿胀（直肠炎），而另一些人则在小便（排尿困难）或吞咽时感到疼痛和困难。

paras.en: Mpox rashes can make people vulnerable to bacterial skin infections, which can cause abscesses or other serious skin damage. Additional complications of the illness include pneumonia, infection of the cornea that can cause vision loss, and vomiting and diarrhea that causes dehydration or malnutrition. Mpox can also lead to blood infections, the intense immune reaction sepsis and, rarely, brain infections (encephalitis) or heart inflammation (myocarditis).
paras.zh: 痘痘皮疹会使人容易受到细菌性皮肤感染，从而导致脓肿或其他严重的皮肤损伤。该疾病的其他并发症包括肺炎、可能导致视力丧失的角膜感染以及导致脱水或营养不良的呕吐和腹泻。 Mpox 还可导致血液感染、强烈的免疫反应败血症，以及罕见的脑部感染（脑炎）或心脏炎症（心肌炎）。

paras.en: Children, pregnant people, and people with weakened immune systems, including from HIV infection, have a higher risk of serious illness and death from mpox.
paras.zh: 儿童、孕妇和免疫系统较弱的人（包括艾滋病毒感染者）患严重疾病和死于MPOX的风险较高。

paras.en: Beyond vaccination, other strategies to decrease the risk of mpox infection include washing hands frequently, avoiding contact with contaminated objects and materials used by people with mpox, avoiding contact with other people's scabs or rashes, and using condoms, although they may only reduce, not eliminate, the risk of mpox exposure during sex.
paras.zh: 除了疫苗接种外，降低MPOX感染风险的其他策略包括经常洗手、避免接触MPOX患者使用过的受污染物体和材料、避免接触他人的结痂或皮疹以及使用避孕套，尽管它们只能降低而不是消除性行为中MPOX暴露的风险。

paras.en: Mpox treatment aims to manage a person's rashes and pain while also preventing complications. "Early and supportive care is important to help manage symptoms and avoid further problems," according to the WHO.
paras.zh: Mpox 治疗旨在控制皮疹和疼痛，同时预防并发症。世界卫生组织表示，“早期支持性护理对于帮助控制症状和避免进一步的问题非常重要”。

paras.en: There is no antiviral drug approved for use in mpox, although some are available for emergency use in various countries. For example, the U.S. allows the use of certain smallpox medicines for mpox.
paras.zh: 目前还没有批准用于治疗 MPOX 的抗病毒药物，尽管一些国家有一些可供紧急使用。例如，美国允许使用某些天花药物来治疗痘痘。

paras.en: Severe mpox infections also may be treated with vaccinia immune globulin intravenous, which contains antibodies taken from the blood of people who were immunized against smallpox.
paras.zh: 严重的mpox感染也可以通过静脉注射痘苗免疫球蛋白来治疗，其中含有从天花免疫接种者血液中提取的抗体。

paras.en: People who have recently been exposed to mpox can be given an mpox vaccine to reduce the severity of their symptoms or to prevent the illness altogether. This approach is known as post-exposure prophylaxis, or PEP.
paras.zh: 最近接触过 MPOX 的人可以接种 MPOX 疫苗，以减轻症状的严重程度或完全预防疾病。这种方法称为暴露后预防 (PEP)。

paras.en: "Post-exposure vaccine should be given as soon as possible, ideally within 4 days of exposure; administration 4 through 14 days after exposure may still provide some protection against monkeypox," the CDC states.
paras.zh: CDC 指出：“暴露后疫苗应尽快接种，最好在暴露后 4 天内接种；暴露后 4 至 14 天接种仍可提供一定程度的预防猴痘的保护作用。”

paras.en: This article is for informational purposes only and is not meant to offer medical advice.
paras.zh: 本文仅供参考，并不旨在提供医疗建议。

paras.en: Nicoletta Lanese is the health channel editor at Live Science and was previously a news editor and staff writer at the site. She is a recipient of the 2026 AHCJ International Health Study Fellowship, with a project focused on antibiotic stewardship practices in Japan and the U.S. They hold a graduate certificate in science communication from UC Santa Cruz and degrees in neuroscience and dance from the University of Florida. Beyond Live Science, Lanese's work has appeared in The Scientist, Science News, the Mercury News, Mongabay and Stanford Medicine Magazine, among other outlets. Based in NYC, she also remains involved in dance and performs in local choreographers' work.
paras.zh: Nicoletta Lanese 是 Live Science 的健康频道编辑，此前曾担任该网站的新闻编辑和特约撰稿人。她是 2026 年 AHCJ 国际健康研究奖学金的获得者，该项目的重点是日本和美国的抗生素管理实践。他们拥有加州大学圣克鲁斯分校的科学传播研究生证书以及佛罗里达大学的神经科学和舞蹈学位。除了《Live Science》之外，Lanese 的作品还出现在《科学家》、《科学新闻》、《水星新闻》、《Mongabay》和《斯坦福医学杂志》等媒体上。她以纽约为基地，仍然参与舞蹈并在当地编舞家的工作中表演。

articles.title: Lost 'heart' of the Colorado River shines like a silver serpent in Utah
articles.author: Harry Baker

paras.en: Where is it? Lake Powell, Utah [37.47537121, -110.70474226]
What's in the photo? A "sunglint" transforming a reservoir into a giant silver river
paras.zh: 照片里有什么？ “sunglint”将水库变成一条巨大的银色河流

paras.en: Who took the photo? An unnamed astronaut on board the International Space Station
paras.zh: 照片是谁拍的？国际空间站上的一名未透露姓名的宇航员

paras.en: This eye-catching astronaut photo mosaic shows a rare "sunglint" transforming a snaking reservoir into a giant silver river.
paras.zh: 这张引人注目的宇航员马赛克照片展示了罕见的“sunglint”将蜿蜒的水库变成了一条巨大的银色河流。

paras.en: The winding waterway at the heart of this image is a section of Lake Powell in southern Utah. The artifical reservoir starts around 70 miles (110 kilometers) southwest of the town of Moab and ends roughly 60 miles (100 km) northeast of the Grand Canyon in Arizona. When full, Lake Powell holds up to 1.2 billion cubic feet (33.3 million cubic meters) of water, making it the second-largest reservoir in the U.S. — close behind the nearby Lake Mead, which stretches across the Arizona-Nevada border.
paras.zh: 该图像中心的蜿蜒水道是犹他州南部鲍威尔湖的一部分。 The artifical reservoir starts around 70 miles (110 kilometers) southwest of the town of Moab and ends roughly 60 miles (100 km) northeast of the Grand Canyon in Arizona. When full, Lake Powell holds up to 1.2 billion cubic feet (33.3 million cubic meters) of water, making it the second-largest reservoir in the U.S. — close behind the nearby Lake Mead, which stretches across the Arizona-Nevada border.

paras.en: Lake Powell is located on the Colorado River, inside a steep ravine known as Glen Canyon. The reservoir emerged in the 1960s, following the construction of the Glen Canyon Dam, which caused water levels to rise by around 200 feet (60 meters) over the next two decades. In addition to generating hydroelectric power, the artificial lake has become a popular tourist destination. (Lake Mead is also located along the Colorado River and was created by the construction of the Hoover Dam.)
paras.zh: 鲍威尔湖位于科罗拉多河沿岸，位于被称为格伦峡谷的陡峭峡谷内。该水库于 20 世纪 60 年代格伦峡谷大坝建成后出现，导致水位在接下来的二十年里上升了约 200 英尺（60 米）。除了产生水力发电外，人工湖还成为一个受欢迎的旅游目的地。 （米德湖也位于科罗拉多河沿岸，是由胡佛水坝的建设而形成的。）

paras.en: This image mosaic, which stitches together several astronaut photos into a single image, was captured during a sunglint, according to NASA's Earth Observatory. This phenomenon occurs when sunlight bounces off a reflective surface directly into the line of sight of an observer in orbit, such as a satellite or an astronaut, giving the object a metallic, mirror-like gleam.
paras.zh: 据美国宇航局地球观测站称，这张马赛克图像将多张宇航员照片拼接成一张图像，是在阳光照射期间拍摄的。当阳光从反射表面直接反射到轨道上的观察者（例如卫星或宇航员）的视线时，就会发生这种现象，使物体发出金属般的镜面光泽。

paras.en: Normally, this effect would be visible only across a small section of the lake. But by combining photos taken as the sunglint moved along the reservoir's length, the entire body of water was illuminated.
paras.zh: 通常情况下，这种效应只能在湖的一小部分区域看到。但通过结合阳光沿着水库长度移动时拍摄的照片，整个水体都被照亮了。

paras.en: The reservoir is named after John Wesley Powell, an explorer and former director of the U.S. Geological Survey, who mapped out Glen Canyon and other parts of the Colorado River in the late 1860s. Powell was particularly captivated by Glen Canyon, which contained a "labyrinth of overhanging cliffs, hanging gardens, sweeping river bends, and natural arches set amidst a backdrop of colorful buttes and mesas," Earth Observatory representatives wrote.
paras.zh: 该水库以探险家、美国地质调查局前局长约翰·韦斯利·鲍威尔 (John Wesley Powell) 的名字命名，他在 1860 年代末绘制了格伦峡谷和科罗拉多河其他部分的地图。鲍威尔对格伦峡谷尤其着迷，地球观测站的代表写道，峡谷中“有一个由悬垂的悬崖、空中花园、宽阔的河湾和自然拱门组成的迷宫，背景是色彩缤纷的山丘和台地”。

paras.en: Powell later described his recollections of the canyon. "Past these towering monuments, past these mounded billows of orange sandstone, past these oak-set glens, past these fern-decked alcoves, past these mural curves, we glide hour after hour, stopping now and then, as our attention is arrested by some new wonder," Powell wrote in his 1875 book "Canyons of the Colorado."
paras.zh: 鲍威尔后来描述了他对峡谷的回忆。鲍威尔在 1875 年出版的《科罗拉多峡谷》一书中写道：“经过这些高耸的纪念碑，经过这些堆积如山的橙色砂岩，经过这些橡树丛生的峡谷，经过这些长满蕨类植物的壁龛，经过这些壁画曲线，我们滑行了一小时又一小时，时不时停下来，因为我们的注意力被一些新奇观吸引了。”

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Some of the sights that Powell marveled over still exist, including many smaller canyons that branch off the reservoir and are cast in deep shadow. A similar effect is seen in sections of Utah's Green River, a tributary of the Colorado River that has long perplexed geologists due to its ability to flow "uphill."
paras.zh: 鲍威尔惊叹的一些景点仍然存在，包括许多从水库分支出来并投在深深阴影中的较小峡谷。犹他州格林河的部分地区也出现了类似的现象，格林河是科罗拉多河的支流，由于其“上坡”流动的能力，长期以来一直困扰着地质学家。

paras.en: From above, one of the canyon's most striking geological features — a large, doughnut-shaped depression known as The Rincon — is visible as a dark ring surrounding a bend along one of the widest sections of the lake. This rusty doughnut, which is up to 3 miles (5 km) across, is a former section of the Colorado River that dried out thousands of years ago when part of the canyon collapsed, enabling water to bypass the rocky loop.
paras.zh: 从上方俯瞰，可以看到峡谷最引人注目的地质特征之一——一个被称为“林孔”的巨大的甜甜圈形状的凹陷——沿着湖最宽的部分之一，可以看到一个黑色的环围绕着一个弯道。这个生锈的甜甜圈直径达 3 英里（5 公里），是科罗拉多河的前一段，数千年前，由于部分峡谷塌陷，水流绕过岩石环路，该河段干涸。

paras.en: However, many of the other wonders that Powell described have been lost beneath the reservoir's elevated water level. These include a side canyon dubbed the Music Temple, which was shaped in a way that gave it remarkable acoustic properties, according to the Earth Observatory.
paras.zh: 然而，鲍威尔描述的许多其他奇迹已经在水库升高的水位之下消失了。据地球观测站称，其中包括一个被称为“音乐圣殿”的侧峡谷，其形状使其具有非凡的声学特性。

paras.en: During periods of drought, when the reservoir's water levels temporarily drop, other lost geological treasures can be exposed. For example, in 2023, researchers found rare fossils from a mammal-like Jurassic creature lurking beneath the lake's high-water line.
paras.zh: 在干旱期间，当水库水位暂时下降时，其他丢失的地质宝藏可能会暴露出来。例如，2023 年，研究人员在湖水高水位线下方发现了一种类似哺乳动物的侏罗纪生物的稀有化石。

paras.en: In recent years, some environmental groups have petitioned to drain Lake Powell and return Glen Canyon to its former glory as the "heart of the Colorado River," according to Newsweek. Such a change may help to alleviate pressure on the rest of the river, which has lost a significant amount of water in recent decades. But experts told Newsweek that this is unlikely to happen.
paras.zh: 据《新闻周刊》报道，近年来，一些环保组织请求排干鲍威尔湖，让格伦峡谷恢复昔日“科罗拉多河心脏”的辉煌。这样的变化可能有助于减轻河流其他部分的压力，近几十年来，河流已经流失了大量的水。但专家告诉《新闻周刊》，这种情况不太可能发生。

paras.en: A 2020 astronaut photo shows the unusual point where two contrastingly colored Patagonian lakes meet. The duo was originally a single body of water but was split by a narrow land bridge.
paras.zh: 一张 2020 年宇航员的照片显示了两个颜色对比鲜明的巴塔哥尼亚湖泊交汇处的不寻常点。这两个水域原本是一个水域，但被一座狭窄的陆桥分开。

paras.en: A 2024 astronaut photo shows the icy surface of Pangong Lake breaking apart in the lofty Tibetan Plateau. The point where the ice meets the water almost perfectly matches a disputed border between China and India.
paras.zh: 一张 2024 年宇航员拍摄的照片显示，班公湖的冰面在高耸的青藏高原上破裂。冰与水的交汇点几乎完美地符合中国和印度之间有争议的边界。

paras.en: A 2024 satellite photo shows a series of ephemeral lakes that merged into a single emerald structure in Australia's Northern Territory following two years of extreme rainfall.
paras.zh: 一张 2024 年的卫星照片显示，在经历了两年的极端降雨之后，澳大利亚北领地的一系列短暂湖泊合并成一个翠绿的结构。

paras.en: Harry is a U.K.-based senior staff writer at Live Science. He studied marine biology at the University of Exeter before training to become a journalist. He covers a wide range of topics including space exploration, planetary science, space weather, climate change, animal behavior and paleontology. His recent work on the solar maximum won "best space submission" at the 2024 Aerospace Media Awards and was shortlisted in the "top scoop" category at the NCTJ Awards for Excellence in 2023. He also writes Live Science's weekly Earth from space series.
paras.zh: 哈里是《Live Science》驻英国的高级撰稿人。在接受记者培训之前，他在埃克塞特大学学习海洋生物学。他涵盖的主题广泛，包括太空探索、行星科学、太空天气、气候变化、动物行为和古生物学。他最近关于太阳活动极大期的工作赢得了 2024 年航空航天媒体奖的“最佳太空作品”，并入围了 2023 年 NCTJ 卓越奖的“顶级独家报道”类别。他还撰写了《Live Science》的每周地球从太空系列文章。
